+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# t_ac2fa555 (paridade global admin, 11/10/2026): o painel admin do V3 lista os jobs
+# do pg_cron e liga/desliga os da propria aplicacao. No V2 nao havia RPC: nada acessava
+# cron.job/cron.job_run_details e nao havia caminho de escrita.
+#
+# A migration 20261011173000_admin_cron_jobs.sql cria:
+#   public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos()          -> text[]   (lista unica dos tocaveis)
+#   public.admin_list_cron_jobs()                -> tabela   (nome/agenda/ativo/ultima)
+#   public.admin_toggle_cron_job(text, boolean)  -> jsonb    (liga/desliga + auditoria)
+# As duas RPCs nascem SECURITY DEFINER, com search_path fixo e guarda is_admin(auth.uid()).
+#
+# ESTE CONTRATO roda em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel (docker), no formato do irmao
+# department-whatsapp-mode-rpc.test.sh (ANTES/DEPOIS + MUTACOES em copia temporaria,
+# expect_error/check_error, um banco so). NENHUMA credencial de producao entra aqui.
+#
+#   ANTES   ‚Äî sem a migration, as tres funcoes nao existem (to_regprocedure nulo).
+#   DEPOIS  ‚Äî aplica o ARQUIVO REAL e prova, com papel real (authenticated/anon) e stub
+#             de cron.alter_job (o real pertence a supabase_admin; o local nao o expoe):
+#             admin lista so os jobs da aplicacao (manutencao/limpeza fora), a ultima
+#             execucao aparece, anon/agente/sem JWT levam 42501, job de manutencao e
+#             nome desconhecido levam 22023, toggle e idempotente, altera cron.job
+#             preservando o jobid e grava auditoria em public.audit_logs.
+#   MUTACAO A ‚Äî GRANT do list passa a anon: o contrato FALHA (anon leria a agenda).
+#   MUTACAO B ‚Äî allow-list ganha 'vacuum-contacts-daily': o contrato FALHA (manutencao
+#               passaria a ser desligavel).
+#   MUTACAO C ‚Äî guarda vira `IF FALSE`: o contrato FALHA (agente passaria).
+#
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/admin-cron-jobs-rpc.test.sh
+#      ADMIN_CRON_JOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE=postgres:17-alpine  (default)
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011173000_admin_cron_jobs.sql"
+postgres_image="${ADMIN_CRON_JOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-admin-cron-jobs-test-$$"
+tmp_base="${TMPDIR:-$repo_root/.tmp}"
+tmp_dir="$tmp_base/zapp-v2-admin-cron-jobs-test.$$"
+passed=0
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-admin-cron-jobs-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  case "$tmp_dir" in
+    */zapp-v2-admin-cron-jobs-test.*) rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir" ;;
+  esac
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+ok()   { printf '[OK] %s\n' "$1"; ((passed += 1)); }
+
+psql_q()    { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+# Erro esperado de TOPO: qualquer desvio encerra o teste.
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" message="$2" sql="$3" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v VERBOSITY=verbose -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$message"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava o erro '$message'"; }
+  ok "$label"
+}
+
+assert_eq() { # fase label esperado obtido
+  local fase="$1" label="$2" expected="$3" actual="$4"
+  if [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]]; then
+    printf '[OK] %s: %s = %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$actual"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '[FAIL] %s: %s deveria ser %s, obtido %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$expected" "$actual" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+
+check_error() { # label mensagem sql
+  local label="$1" message="$2" sql="$3" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v VERBOSITY=verbose -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: a chamada passou (esperava %s): %s\n' "$label" "$message" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  if [[ "$out" != *"$message"* ]]; then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: erro divergente (esperava %s): %s\n' "$label" "$message" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  printf '[OK] %s\n' "$label"
+  return 0
+}
+
+ADMIN_SUB='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'
+AGENT_SUB='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'
+SIG_LIST='public.admin_list_cron_jobs()'
+SIG_TOGGLE='public.admin_toggle_cron_job(text,boolean)'
+SIG_HELPER='public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos()'
+REVOKE_LIST_LINE='REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.admin_list_cron_jobs()'
+GRANT_LIST_LINE='GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_list_cron_jobs() TO authenticated;'
+
+admin_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$ADMIN_SUB';"
+agent_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$AGENT_SUB';"
+anon_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE anon; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$ADMIN_SUB';"
+noauth_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;"
+
+checa_contrato() { # fase  -> 0 se TODAS as assercoes passam, 1 na primeira violacao
+  local fase="$1" result
+  # listagem: so os jobs da aplicacao
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin lista os jobs da aplicacao' '4' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT count(*) FROM public.admin_list_cron_jobs(); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'manutencao/limpeza fora da listagem' '0' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT count(*) FROM public.admin_list_cron_jobs() WHERE jobname IN ('cleanup-link-preview-cache','vacuum-contacts-daily'); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'ultima execucao do job aparece' 'succeeded' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT last_status FROM public.admin_list_cron_jobs() WHERE jobname='talkx-scheduler-1min'; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # ACL
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(authenticated, $SIG_LIST, EXECUTE)" 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$SIG_LIST','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(anon, $SIG_LIST, EXECUTE)" 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$SIG_LIST','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(service_role, $SIG_LIST, EXECUTE)" 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('service_role','$SIG_LIST','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "helper sem EXECUTE para authenticated" 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$SIG_HELPER','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  # quem nao pode
+  check_error "$fase: anon e barrado pela ACL (42501)" '42501' \
+    "$anon_call SELECT public.admin_list_cron_jobs(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: agente e barrado pela guarda (42501)" '42501' \
+    "$agent_call SELECT public.admin_list_cron_jobs(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: sem JWT e barrado pela guarda (42501)" '42501' \
+    "$noauth_call SELECT public.admin_list_cron_jobs(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: agente nao faz toggle (42501)" '42501' \
+    "$agent_call SELECT public.admin_toggle_cron_job('talkx-scheduler-1min', true); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  # allow-list: manutencao (existe em cron.job) e desconhecido
+  check_error "$fase: job de manutencao recusado (22023)" '22023' \
+    "$admin_call SELECT public.admin_toggle_cron_job('vacuum-contacts-daily', false); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: job desconhecido recusado (22023)" '22023' \
+    "$admin_call SELECT public.admin_toggle_cron_job('nao-existe-esse-job', false); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  # caminho de sucesso: idempotencia + alteracao real + jobid preservado
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'toggle no-op e idempotente' 'false' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT (public.admin_toggle_cron_job('talkx-scheduler-1min', false))->>'alterado'; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'toggle altera o estado' 'true' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT (public.admin_toggle_cron_job('talkx-scheduler-1min', true))->>'alterado'; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'cron.job.active mudou para t' 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT active FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='talkx-scheduler-1min'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'jobid preservado (alter_job, nao recria)' '6' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT jobid FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='talkx-scheduler-1min'")" || return 1
+  # auditoria
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'auditoria gravada' 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT count(*) >= 2 FROM public.audit_logs WHERE action='admin_cron_job_toggle' AND entity_type='cron_job'")" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+exige_falha_do_contrato() { # fase
+  local fase="$1" evid
+  evid="$( ( checa_contrato "$fase" ) 2>&1 || true )"
+  if [[ "$evid" == *'[FAIL]'* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$evid" | sed 's/^/[EVIDENCIA] /'
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n' "$evid" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+
+drop_funcoes() {
+  psql_q -c "DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_toggle_cron_job(text, boolean);
+             DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_list_cron_jobs();
+             DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos();" >/dev/null
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $migration"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ leitura estatica do arquivo do repo (afirmacao grep -F, nunca contagem) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+grep -qF "$REVOKE_LIST_LINE" "$migration" || fail 'o repo perdeu o REVOKE do list'
+grep -qF "$GRANT_LIST_LINE" "$migration" || fail 'o repo perdeu o GRANT do list para authenticated'
+grep -qF 'cron.alter_job(job_id := v_jobid, active := p_ativo)' "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o repo perdeu o uso de cron.alter_job (nao pode virar DML direto em cron.job)'
+grep -qF "IF NOT public.is_admin(auth.uid()) THEN" "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o repo perdeu a guarda is_admin'
+grep -qF "INSERT INTO public.audit_logs" "$migration" || fail 'o repo perdeu a auditoria'
+ok 'o arquivo do repo tem REVOKE/GRANT, alter_job, guarda e auditoria (o teste so le)'
+
+mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=admin_cron_jobs_test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
+  if psql_q -c 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break
+  else
+    ready=0
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || { printf 'FAIL: PostgreSQL de teste n√£o iniciou\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ bootstrap: schema minimo + stub do pg_cron + seeds ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+# cron.alter_job REAL pertence a supabase_admin (postgres local nao tem EXECUTE); aqui
+# entra um stub com a MESMA assinatura, dono postgres, que so muda `active` na linha ‚Äî
+# e o suficiente para exercitar o codigo real da RPC num banco descartavel.
+cat > "$tmp_dir/bootstrap.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;

+CREATE SCHEMA cron;
+CREATE TABLE cron.job (
+  jobid    bigint PRIMARY KEY,

+  command  text NOT NULL,

+  runid          bigint DEFAULT 0,

+  return_message text,
+  start_time     timestamptz,
+  end_time       timestamptz
+);
+CREATE FUNCTION cron.alter_job(
+  job_id   bigint,
+  schedule text DEFAULT NULL,
+  command  text DEFAULT NULL,
+  database text DEFAULT NULL,
+  username text DEFAULT NULL,
+  active   boolean DEFAULT NULL
+) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN
+  UPDATE cron.job AS j
+    SET active = coalesce(alter_job.active, j.active)
+    WHERE j.jobid = alter_job.job_id;
+  RETURN FOUND;
+END;
+$$;

+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = 'admin')
+$$;

+);

+#!/usr/bin/env bash

+# - as 17 tabelas de contatos/mensagens deixam de conceder QUALQUER privilegio de
+#   tabela a `anon` (o achado: 8 privilegios por tabela, inclusive TRUNCATE, que
+#   ignora RLS);
+# - `authenticated` e `service_role` seguem intactos (a migration so mexe em anon);
+# - a migration e idempotente (reaplicar nao muda nada);
+# - a linha de rollback restaura exatamente a ACL anterior de anon.

+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011003020_revoke_anon_privileges_contact_messages.sql"
+postgres_image="${ANON_PRIVS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-anon-privs-test-$$"

+  case "$tmp_dir" in /tmp/zapp-v2-anon-privs.*) rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir" ;; esac
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-anon-privs-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then

+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Cartao t_675d0cac / t_7602496c (feat(db) RPCs assumir_conversa / devolver_conversa_fila):
+# a V2 so tinha "Transferir"; a V3 tem "Assumir" e "Devolver a fila". A correcao
+# e a migration ADITIVA 20261011094027_assume_return_conversation.sql, com duas
+# RPCs SECURITY DEFINER auditadas:
+#   public.assume_conversation(p_contact_id uuid)            -> jsonb
+#   public.return_conversation_to_queue(p_contact_id, reason) -> jsonb
+#
+# ESTE CONTRATO roda em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel (docker), no formato de
+# talk-me-queue-contract.test.sh (corrida real entre dois docker exec) e
+# department-whatsapp-mode-rpc.test.sh (bootstrap minimo + contrato reutilizavel
+# para as mutacoes). UM banco so, so `docker run`/`docker exec ... psql`/`docker rm`
+# ‚Äî compativel com o docker-shim do db-guard.yml (E47). NENHUMA credencial real.
+#
+#   ANTES      ‚Äî sem a RPC nao existe "Assumir": prova-se has_function_privilege=0
+#                e a chamada morta (42883 / nao existe). Reproduz a lacuna.
+#   DEPOIS     ‚Äî aplica o ARQUIVO REAL da migration e prova: permissoes (authenticated
+#                t, anon f), quem pode assumir (membro da fila, admin), quem nao pode
+#                (fora da fila 42501, ja tem dono -> already_assigned), takeover de
+#                admin, assumir archived -> conversation_not_active, devolver a fila pelo
+#                DONO nao-admin (M1 devolve C_TAKE) e pelo admin, outro agente negado,
+#                idempotencia, anon/sem-JWT/inexistente, e audit_logs por acao
+#                sem dado pessoal (so chaves conhecidas).
+#   CORRIDA    ‚Äî duas transacoes reais: a 1a assume e SEGURA o UPDATE (pg_sleep) antes
+#                do COMMIT; a 2a le o responsavel antigo e o UPDATE condicional a barra
+#                (concurrent_assignment). Exatamente 1 vencedor + 1 linha de auditoria.
+#   ROLLBACK   ‚Äî extrai o bloco de rollback do PROPRIO arquivo, executa e prova que as
+#                duas funcoes somem; reaplica e prova idempotencia.
+#   MUTACAO A  ‚Äî copia sem o portao de fila (RAISE not_authorized): um de fora assume
+#                -> o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO B  ‚Äî copia sem o portao "ja tem dono" (RAISE already_assigned): um membro
+#                rouba a conversa -> o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO C  ‚Äî copia sem o WHERE condicional do UPDATE: na corrida os dois vencem
+#                -> o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO D  ‚Äî copia sem a barreira do dono no devolver
+#                ('v_contact.assigned_to <> v_profile_id AND NOT v_is_admin' -> 'NOT v_is_admin'):
+#                so admin devolveria; o dono nao-admin e barrado -> o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO E  ‚Äî copia sem o portao de fila no devolver: admin fora da fila devolve
+#                contato alheio -> o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO F  ‚Äî copia voltando a bloquear resolved no assumir: resolved nao reabre
+#                -> o contrato FALHA.
+#
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/assume-return-conversation.test.sh
+#      ASSUME_RETURN_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE=postgres:17-alpine  (default)
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011094027_assume_return_conversation.sql"
+postgres_image="${ASSUME_RETURN_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-assume-return-test-$$"
+tmp_base="${TMPDIR:-$repo_root/.tmp}"
+tmp_dir="$tmp_base/zapp-v2-assume-return-test.$$"
+passed=0
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-assume-return-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  case "$tmp_dir" in
+    */zapp-v2-assume-return-test.*) rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir" ;;
+  esac
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+ok()   { printf '[OK] %s\n' "$1"; ((passed += 1)); }
+
+psql_q()    { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_error() { # label mensagem sql
+  local label="$1" message="$2" sql="$3" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v VERBOSITY=verbose -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$message"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava o erro '$message'"; }
+  ok "$label"
+}
+
+assert_eq() { # fase label esperado obtido  (nao sai; usado tambem nas mutacoes)
+  local fase="$1" label="$2" expected="$3" actual="$4"
+  if [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]]; then
+    printf '[OK] %s: %s = %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$actual"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '[FAIL] %s: %s deveria ser %s, obtido %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$expected" "$actual" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+
+check_error() { # label mensagem sql  (nao sai; devolve 1)
+  local label="$1" message="$2" sql="$3" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v VERBOSITY=verbose -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: passou (esperava erro %s): %s\n' "$label" "$message" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  if [[ "$out" != *"$message"* ]]; then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: erro divergente (esperava %s): %s\n' "$label" "$message" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  printf '[OK] %s\n' "$label"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ identificadores sinteticos ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+QUEUE1='40000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'
+QUEUE2='40000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'
+P_ADMIN='10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'; U_ADMIN='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'
+P_M1='10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';    U_M1='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'
+P_M2='10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3';    U_M2='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'
+P_X='10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a4';     U_X='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a4'
+C_WAIT='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+C_TAKE='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
+C_OWN='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'
+C_RES='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'
+C_RACE='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'
+C_NOQ='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'
+C_Q2='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007'
+C_ARCH='30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000008'
+C_MISS='30000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000ffff'
+
+SIG_A='public.assume_conversation(uuid)'
+SIG_R='public.return_conversation_to_queue(uuid,text)'
+REVOKE_A='REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.assume_conversation(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;'
+GRANT_A='GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.assume_conversation(uuid) TO authenticated;'
+REVOKE_R='REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.return_conversation_to_queue(uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;'
+GRANT_R='GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.return_conversation_to_queue(uuid, text) TO authenticated;'
+
+pref_admin="SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims='{\"role\":\"authenticated\"}'; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$U_ADMIN';"
+pref_m1="SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims='{\"role\":\"authenticated\"}'; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$U_M1';"
+pref_m2="SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims='{\"role\":\"authenticated\"}'; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$U_M2';"
+pref_x="SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims='{\"role\":\"authenticated\"}'; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$U_X';"
+pref_anon="SET LOCAL ROLE anon; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims='{\"role\":\"anon\"}'; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$U_ADMIN';"
+pref_noauth="SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;"
+
+reset_estado() {
+  psql_q -c "
+    UPDATE public.contacts SET assigned_to=NULL, conversation_status='waiting', conversation_status_changed_at=now()
+      WHERE id IN ('$C_WAIT','$C_RACE');
+    UPDATE public.contacts SET assigned_to=NULL, conversation_status='open'   WHERE id='$C_TAKE';
+    UPDATE public.contacts SET assigned_to='$P_M1', conversation_status='open' WHERE id='$C_OWN';
+    UPDATE public.contacts SET assigned_to='$P_M1', conversation_status='resolved' WHERE id='$C_RES';
+    UPDATE public.contacts SET assigned_to='$P_M1', conversation_status='archived' WHERE id='$C_ARCH';
+    UPDATE public.contacts SET assigned_to='$P_M1', conversation_status='waiting'  WHERE id='$C_NOQ';
+    UPDATE public.contacts SET assigned_to='$P_X', conversation_status='open' WHERE id='$C_Q2';
+    DELETE FROM public.audit_logs;
+  " >/dev/null
+}
+
+assume_fields() { # contact_id -> ok|assigned_to|status
+  psql_q -c "BEGIN; $1 WITH r AS (SELECT public.assume_conversation('$2') AS j) SELECT (j->>'ok')||'|'||(j->>'assigned_to')||'|'||(j->>'conversation_status') FROM r; COMMIT;"
+}
+
+checa_contrato() { # fase
+  local fase="$1" result
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(authenticated,$SIG_A,EXECUTE)" 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$SIG_A','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(authenticated,$SIG_R,EXECUTE)" 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$SIG_R','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(anon,$SIG_A,EXECUTE)" 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$SIG_A','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(anon,$SIG_R,EXECUTE)" 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$SIG_R','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+
+  reset_estado
+
+  # Prova do gatilho de updated_at (recusa real de 06/10: backfill reescrevia a data
+  # de TODAS as linhas). Aqui o UPDATE e por PK (1 linha); so ela pode mudar updated_at.
+  local t_wait_before t_take_before
+  t_wait_before="$(psql_q -c "SELECT updated_at FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_WAIT'")"
+  t_take_before="$(psql_q -c "SELECT updated_at FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_TAKE'")"
+
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin assume contato na fila' "true|$P_ADMIN|open" \
+    "$(assume_fields "$pref_admin" "$C_WAIT")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'estado apos admin assumir (open + responsavel)' "$P_ADMIN|open" \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT assigned_to||'|'||conversation_status FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_WAIT'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'auditoria de assumir = 1 linha' '1' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_WAIT' AND action='conversation_assumed'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'auditoria sem chave de dado pessoal' '0' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys((SELECT details FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_WAIT' AND action='conversation_assumed')) k WHERE k NOT IN ('queue_id','previous_assigned_to','assigned_to','previous_status','status')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'updated_at avanca so na linha tocada (1 linha por PK)' 'true|true' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT ((SELECT updated_at FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_WAIT') > '$t_wait_before')::text||'|'||((SELECT updated_at FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_TAKE') = '$t_take_before')::text")" || return 1
+
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'membro da fila assume contato livre' "true|$P_M1|open" \
+    "$(assume_fields "$pref_m1" "$C_TAKE")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'dono nao-admin devolve a fila' 'true' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "BEGIN; $pref_m1 WITH r AS (SELECT public.return_conversation_to_queue('$C_TAKE','resolvido pelo dono') AS j) SELECT (j->>'ok') FROM r; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'estado apos dono devolver (sem dono + waiting, queue mantida)' "|waiting|$QUEUE1" \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT coalesce(assigned_to::text,'')||'|'||conversation_status||'|'||queue_id FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_TAKE'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'auditoria de devolver pelo dono = 1 linha' '1' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_TAKE' AND action='conversation_returned_to_queue'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'motivo do dono gravado na auditoria' 'resolvido pelo dono' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT details->>'reason' FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_TAKE' AND action='conversation_returned_to_queue'")" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: agente fora da fila e barrado (42501)" '42501' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_x SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_OWN'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: contato ja tem outro responsavel (already_assigned)" 'already_assigned' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_m2 SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_OWN'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin assume conversa ja open e mantem open (takeover)' "true|$P_ADMIN|open" \
+    "$(assume_fields "$pref_admin" "$C_OWN")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'estado apos takeover admin (open + responsavel)' "$P_ADMIN|open" \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT assigned_to||'|'||conversation_status FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_OWN'")" || return 1
+
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin assume conversa resolved e reabre como open' "true|$P_ADMIN|open" \
+    "$(assume_fields "$pref_admin" "$C_RES")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'auditoria da reabertura guarda previous_status resolved' 'resolved|open' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT (details->>'previous_status')||'|'||(details->>'status') FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_RES' AND action='conversation_assumed'")" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: assumir conversa arquivada (conversation_not_active)" 'conversation_not_active' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_admin SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_ARCH'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: quem nao e o dono nao pode devolver (42501)" '42501' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_m2 SELECT public.return_conversation_to_queue('$C_OWN','nao e meu'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin devolve a fila' 'true' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "BEGIN; $pref_admin WITH r AS (SELECT public.return_conversation_to_queue('$C_OWN','sem tempo') AS j) SELECT (j->>'ok') FROM r; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'estado apos devolver (sem dono + waiting, queue mantida)' "|waiting|$QUEUE1" \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT coalesce(assigned_to::text,'')||'|'||conversation_status||'|'||queue_id FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_OWN'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'motivo gravado na auditoria de devolver' 'sem tempo' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT details->>'reason' FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_OWN' AND action='conversation_returned_to_queue'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'devolver e idempotente (sem 2a linha de auditoria)' '1' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "BEGIN; $pref_admin SELECT public.return_conversation_to_queue('$C_OWN','sem tempo'); COMMIT;" >/dev/null; psql_q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_OWN' AND action='conversation_returned_to_queue'")" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: devolver conversa arquivada (conversation_not_active)" 'conversation_not_active' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_admin SELECT public.return_conversation_to_queue('$C_ARCH','x'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: anon nao tem EXECUTE (42501)" '42501' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_anon SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_WAIT'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: sem JWT e barrado (not_authenticated)" 'not_authenticated' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_noauth SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_WAIT'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: contato inexistente (contact_not_found)" 'contact_not_found' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_admin SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_MISS'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: contato sem fila e barrado para nao-admin (42501)" '42501' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_m2 SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_NOQ'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: admin sem fila tambem nao assume (42501)" '42501' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_admin SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_NOQ'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: admin fora da fila nao assume contato de outra fila (42501)" '42501' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_admin SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_Q2'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: admin fora da fila nao devolve contato de outra fila (42501)" '42501' \
+    "BEGIN; $pref_admin SELECT public.return_conversation_to_queue('$C_Q2','fora da fila'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  return 0
+}
+
+checa_corrida() { # fase  (corrida real: sessao 1 segura o UPDATE antes do COMMIT)
+  local fase="$1" s1="$tmp_dir/corrida-1.out" s2="$tmp_dir/corrida-2.out" vencedores
+  reset_estado
+  set +e
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "BEGIN; $pref_m1 SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_RACE'); SELECT pg_sleep(3); COMMIT;" >"$s1" 2>&1 &
+  local pid1=$!
+  sleep 1.5   # a sessao 1 ja atualizou (segura o lock) e ainda nao commitou
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "BEGIN; $pref_m2 SELECT public.assume_conversation('$C_RACE'); COMMIT;" >"$s2" 2>&1
+  local st2=$?
+  wait "$pid1"; local st1=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( st1 != 0 )) || ! grep -q '"ok": true' "$s1"; then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: a 1a sessao deveria vencer; saida=%s\n' "$fase" "$(cat "$s1")" >&2; return 1
+  fi
+  if (( st2 == 0 )); then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: a 2a sessao venceu junto (esperava conflito): %s\n' "$fase" "$(cat "$s2")" >&2; return 1
+  fi
+  if ! grep -Eq 'concurrent_assignment|already_assigned' "$s2"; then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: conflito da corrida sem erro claro: %s\n' "$fase" "$(cat "$s2")" >&2; return 1
+  fi
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'corrida: exatamente um responsavel' "$P_M1" \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT assigned_to FROM public.contacts WHERE id='$C_RACE'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'corrida: uma unica linha de auditoria' '1' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id='$C_RACE' AND action='conversation_assumed'")" || return 1
+  printf '[OK] %s: corrida resolve com um vencedor (%s)\n' "$fase" "$(cat "$s2" | tail -1)"
+  return 0
+}
+
+exige_falha() { # fase
+  local fase="$1" evid
+  evid="$( ( "$2" "$fase" ) 2>&1 || true )"
+  if [[ "$evid" == *'[FAIL]'* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$evid" | sed 's/^/[EVIDENCIA] /'
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n' "$evid" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ pre-checagens do ambiente ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $migration"
+mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ leitura estatica do arquivo do repo ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+grep -qF "$REVOKE_A" "$migration" || fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o REVOKE de assumir'
+grep -qF "$GRANT_A" "$migration"  || fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o GRANT de assumir'
+grep -qF "$REVOKE_R" "$migration" || fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o REVOKE de devolver'
+grep -qF "$GRANT_R" "$migration"  || fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o GRANT de devolver'
+grep -qF 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assume_conversation(p_contact_id uuid)' "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o CREATE OR REPLACE de assume_conversation'
+grep -qF 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.return_conversation_to_queue(p_contact_id uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL)' "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o CREATE OR REPLACE de return_conversation_to_queue'
+grep -qF 'SET search_path = pg_catalog, public' "$migration" || fail 'faltou SET search_path nas RPCs'
+grep -qF 'v_user_id IS NULL' "$migration" || fail 'faltou o portao auth.uid() NULL -> not_authenticated'
+if grep -qF 'assigned_to = auth.uid()' "$migration"; then
+  fail 'a migration usa assigned_to=auth.uid(): a coluna referencia profiles(id), nao auth.users(id)'
+fi
+ok 'arquivo do repo: REVOKE/GRANT, SECURITY DEFINER com search_path, portao auth.uid() e sem auth.uid() em assigned_to'
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ ANTES: sem as RPCs nao existe "Assumir" ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=assume_return_test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
+  if psql_q -c 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break; else ready=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || { printf 'FAIL: PostgreSQL de teste nao iniciou\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/bootstrap.sql" <<SQL
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS \$\$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid
+\$\$;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL,
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.queue_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  queue_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  assigned_to uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  queue_id uuid,
+  conversation_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
+    CHECK (conversation_status IN ('open','waiting','resolved','archived')),
+  conversation_status_changed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.audit_logs (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid,
+  action text NOT NULL,
+  entity_type text,
+  entity_id uuid,
+  details jsonb DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+-- Helpers de producao (corpo identico as migrations que os criam).
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS \$\$
+  SELECT profile.id FROM public.profiles AS profile
+  WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.user_id = _user_id LIMIT 1
+\$\$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS \$\$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin','supervisor'))
+\$\$;
+
+-- FSM real (20260905090000) e guarda de responsavel real (20260924203300).
+CREATE FUNCTION public.enforce_conversation_status_transition() RETURNS TRIGGER AS \$\$
+BEGIN
+  IF OLD.conversation_status = NEW.conversation_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
+  IF NOT (
+    (OLD.conversation_status = 'open'     AND NEW.conversation_status IN ('waiting','resolved','archived')) OR
+    (OLD.conversation_status = 'waiting'  AND NEW.conversation_status IN ('open','resolved')) OR
+    (OLD.conversation_status = 'resolved' AND NEW.conversation_status IN ('open','archived')) OR
+    (OLD.conversation_status = 'archived' AND NEW.conversation_status = 'open')
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid conversation_status transition: % -> %', OLD.conversation_status, NEW.conversation_status
+      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
+  END IF;
+  NEW.conversation_status_changed_at = NOW();
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+\$\$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_contacts_fsm_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON public.contacts
+  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.conversation_status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.conversation_status)
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.enforce_conversation_status_transition();
+
+-- Gatilho real de updated_at (20251215024517): regrava updated_at em toda linha
+-- tocada -- o teste prova que o UPDATE e por PK, entao so a linha alvo muda.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS TRIGGER AS \$\$
+BEGIN
+  NEW.updated_at = now();
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+\$\$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public;
+CREATE TRIGGER update_contacts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.contacts
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.prevent_contact_assignee_hijack() RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS \$\$
+BEGIN
+  IF (current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb->>'role') = 'authenticated'
+     AND NEW.assigned_to IS NOT NULL
+     AND NOT is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+  THEN
+    IF NEW.queue_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+      IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM profiles p JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = p.user_id
+        WHERE p.id = NEW.assigned_to AND p.is_active = true
+          AND ur.role IN ('agent','supervisor','admin')
+      ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sem permissao para atribuir contato a este agente';
+      END IF;
+    ELSIF NEW.assigned_to <> get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid()) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sem permissao para atribuir contato a este agente';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+\$\$;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_contact_assignee_hijack BEFORE UPDATE ON public.contacts
+  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.assigned_to IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.assigned_to)
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_contact_assignee_hijack();
+
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated;
+
+INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, user_id, role) VALUES
+  ('$P_ADMIN','$U_ADMIN','admin'),
+  ('$P_M1','$U_M1','agent'),
+  ('$P_M2','$U_M2','agent'),

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# feat(db): auto-reconexao de conexoes WhatsApp (colunas por conexao + reconnection_logs).
+#
+# BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito): sem a migration, a tabela public.reconnection_logs
+#           nao existe, as colunas de politica de reconexao nao existem e a view operacional
+#           whatsapp_connections_safe nao expoe health_reason.
+# BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada: colunas com DEFAULT/limites reais; a view passa a expor
+#           health_reason SEM perder o mascaramento de qr_code/instance_id; a tabela nova tem
+#           RLS ligada (staff le, nao-staff nao ve a linha, anon sem grant, authenticated sem
+#           INSERT/DELETE: o log nao se forja de dentro do app); ON DELETE CASCADE limpa o
+#           historico; o comando de retencao AGENDADO (extraido do PROPRIO arquivo da migration)
+#           apaga o que passou de 30 dias e preserva o recente; depois o ROLLBACK extraido do
+#           arquivo desfaz tudo, e reaplicar (inclusive SEM pg_cron) e idempotente.
+#
+# Executa como os papeis reais (authenticated/anon/postgres); nunca como service_role no lugar
+# do usuario. O unico stub e o esquema `cron`, que emula a interface minima do pg_cron
+# (schedule/unschedule + cron.job) para provar o AGENDAMENTO sem depender da extensao.
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261012134000_auto_reconnect_logs.sql"
+postgres_image="${AUTO_RECONNECT_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-auto-reconnect-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-auto-reconnect-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+as_role() {
+  local role="$1" jwt="$2" sql="$3"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE $role; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" j="$3" s="$4" a
+  a="$(as_user "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_ok_as() { local l="$1" j="$2" s="$3"; as_user "$j" "$s" >/dev/null || fail "$l: deveria ter sucesso (como authenticated)"; printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"; }
+expect_error_as() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" j="$3" s="$4" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_user "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_error_role() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" role="$3" j="$4" s="$5" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_role "$role" "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_error() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" s="$3" out st
+  set +e; out="$(psql_sql "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_column_count() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" table="$3" col="$4" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = '$table' AND column_name = '$col';" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+

+CREATE FUNCTION cron.schedule(p_jobname text, p_schedule text, p_command text) RETURNS bigint
+  LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
+  DECLARE j bigint;
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO cron.job(jobname, schedule, command) VALUES (p_jobname, p_schedule, p_command)
+      ON CONFLICT (jobname) DO UPDATE SET schedule = excluded.schedule, command = excluded.command
+      RETURNING jobid INTO j;
+    RETURN j;
+  END $fn$;

+  LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
+  BEGIN
+    DELETE FROM cron.job WHERE job.jobid = p_jobid;
+    RETURN true;
+  END $fn$;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# SEC-DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE-06/08 (docs/audits/SEGURANCA_DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE_2026-10-07.md).
+#
+# Prova, em PostgreSQL descartavel, a migration
+# 20261011010002_bucket_limits_e_team_chat_files_identidade.sql:
+#
+#   RED   ‚Äî antes da migration: `stickers`/`audio-memes` nascem SEM file_size_limit e SEM
+#           allowed_mime_types (bucket publico aceita texto arbitrario), e em `team-chat-files`
+#           a policy de SELECT/DELETE compara a pasta com auth.uid() (id de USUARIO) enquanto a
+#           de INSERT grava a pasta com current_profile_id() (id de PROFILE) ‚Äî o dono do envio
+#           NAO lista nem apaga o proprio arquivo;
+#   GREEN ‚Äî a migration aplica com ON_ERROR_STOP=1 e:
+#             * os dois buckets recebem 512000 bytes + lista de MIME (o `text/html` do cenario da
+#               auditoria fica fora);
+#             * o dono (mesmo usuario do profile dono da pasta) passa a listar e a apagar o proprio
+#               arquivo ‚Äî a identidade fica igual nos tres verbos;
+#             * o ramo de membro da conversa (p.user_id = auth.uid()) continua valendo: o membro
+#               ve o anexo da conversa mas NAO ve o arquivo pessoal de outro e NAO apaga nada;
+#             * o ramo de admin (is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())) continua vendo tudo;
+#             * anon nao le.
+#
+# O pre-estado do Supabase (schema auth, papeis, storage) e recriado a mao, como nos harnesses
+# irmaos, porque a regra testada e justamente a que a migration aperta.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
+migrations_dir="$repo_root/supabase/migrations"
+migration_file="20261011010002_bucket_limits_e_team_chat_files_identidade.sql"
+postgres_image="${BUCKETS_CHAT_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="buckets-team-chat-$$"
+test_password="buckets_chat_test_only"
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+start_postgres() {
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL container failed to start (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL bootstrap was not stable (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+    docker logs "$container_name" >&2 || true
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+
+start_postgres || fail 'PostgreSQL de teste nao iniciou'
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ infraestrutura que o Supabase fornece (auth, papeis, storage) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE SCHEMA storage;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
+  )::text
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
+  )::uuid
+$$;
+
+CREATE ROLE anon;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated;
+CREATE ROLE service_role;
+ALTER ROLE service_role BYPASSRLS;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA storage TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- storage.foldername: mesma semantica do Storage (todos os segmentos menos o nome do arquivo).
+CREATE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text) RETURNS text[] LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
+  SELECT (string_to_array(name, '/'))[1:greatest(array_length(string_to_array(name, '/'), 1) - 1, 0)]
+$$;
+
+CREATE TYPE public.app_role AS ENUM ('admin', 'supervisor', 'agent');
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid NOT NULL, role public.app_role NOT NULL);
+-- Em producao `authenticated` LE `profiles` (a policy de team-chat-files faz
+-- `p.id = mem.profile_id ... p.user_id = auth.uid()`), mas NAO le `user_roles` ‚Äî dai o
+-- `is_admin_or_supervisor` SECURITY DEFINER logo abaixo.
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO authenticated;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin', 'supervisor'))
+$$;
+
+-- Helper identico ao da migration 20260928420000: profile do usuario logado, por auth.uid().
+CREATE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() FROM anon;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# R2-DB-010 (item 296, P2) ‚Äî "Usuario pode zerar o contador de requisicoes do catalogo pela RPC
+# publica autenticada" (docs/reconciliation/reaudit/2026-10-03/reports/database/report.md).
+#
+# Roda em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel, aplicando as MIGRATIONS REAIS do repositorio e executando
+# como o PAPEL REAL (`authenticated`, com request.jwt.claims), nunca como postgres:
+#
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito), so com as migrations 20261002681230 e 20261003122707:
+#             * a cota e consumida normalmente (60/min em bootstrap);
+#             * o ataque `p_window_ms = 0` apaga TODOS os hits da propria chave (inclusive o hit
+#               recem-inserido) -> devolve true e a chamada seguinte volta a ser liberada;
+#             * janela negativa faz o mesmo; `p_limit` arbitrario tambem libera.
+#
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration nova aplicada (20261007000311):
+#             * a cota e a janela vem de politica confiavel compilada na funcao;
+#             * os MESMOS ataques (janela 0/negativa/1 ms/enorme, limite arbitrario) nao apagam
+#               historico e seguem negando (false);
+#             * o caminho normal (edge) nao muda: 60/min em bootstrap e 120/min em list_products,
+#               mesmo com a edge enviando os argumentos de sempre;
+#             * acao inventada cai no balde 'global' (sem balde novo e ilimitado);
+#             * isolamento por usuario e por acao preservado; anon segue sem EXECUTE;
+#               authenticated mantem EXECUTE (a edge chama com o JWT do usuario).
+#
+#   BLOCO C ‚Äî o bloco BEGIN-ROLLBACK da propria migration e EXTRAIDO do arquivo e EXECUTADO:
+#             o corpo anterior da funcao volta (o argumento manda de novo, inclusive o expurgo
+#             com janela 0) e reaplicar a migration e idempotente.
+#
+# Para provar o VERMELHO (o teste falha sem a correcao):
+#   CATALOG_RATE_LIMIT_SEM_FIX=1 scripts/db-audit/catalog-rate-limit-policy-pinned.test.sh
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+mig_shared="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261002681230_catalogo_rate_limit_compartilhado.sql"
+mig_append="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261003122707_catalogo_rate_limit_hits_append_only.sql"
+mig_fix="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261007000311_catalogo_rate_limit_politica_confiavel.sql"
+postgres_image="${CATALOG_RATE_LIMIT_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-catalog-rate-limit-test-$$"
+sem_fix="${CATALOG_RATE_LIMIT_SEM_FIX:-0}"
+tmp_base="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d "$tmp_base/zapp-v2-catalog-rate-limit-test.XXXXXX")"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-catalog-rate-limit-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  case "$tmp_dir" in
+    "$tmp_base"/zapp-v2-catalog-rate-limit-test.*) rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir" ;;
+  esac
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+expect_count() {  # comparacao de valor ja obtido (nao re-executa SQL)
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  expect_count "$1" "$2" "$(psql_sql "$3" | tail -n1)"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  expect_count "$1" "$2" "$(as_user "$3" "$4" | tail -n1)"
+}
+expect_error_as() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" jwt="$3" sql="$4" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_user "$jwt" "$sql" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+hits_of() {  # hits na chave (user, action) ‚Äî lido como postgres, so para a prova
+  psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM public.catalog_rate_limit_hits WHERE user_id='$1' AND action='$2';" | tail -n1
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+for m in "$mig_shared" "$mig_append" "$mig_fix"; do
+  [[ -f "$m" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $m"
+done
+
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s) ==\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break; else ready=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+-- Default privileges do Supabase: funcao nova nasce executavel por anon/authenticated.
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# CT-E / PB-30 ‚Äî prova em Postgres 17 descartavel (docker) que public.contacts_stats_series(boolean)
+# devolve empresas_distinct e as 4 series do useContactsKpi (novos 30d em buckets de 4/6 dias,
+# total cumulativo 12s, empresas cumulativas 12s, fornecedores por semana) com o MESMO escopo de
+# public.contacts_stats / search_contacts: RED (funcao inexistente), arrays conferidos na mao para
+# admin/agente A/agente B/escopo vazio, include_legacy, anon/PUBLIC sem EXECUTE, service_role le tudo,
+# invariantes (soma dos 7 = novos 30d; ultimo ponto = total/empresas) e o Rollback do cabecalho
+# voltando ao RED. A migration REAL e achada pelo marcador 'contacts_stats_series(boolean)'.
+set -euo pipefail
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$(grep -rlF 'contacts_stats_series(boolean)' "$repo_root/supabase/migrations" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/_superseded/' | sort | tail -1 || true)"
+[[ -n "$migration" && -f "$migration" ]] || { echo '[FALHA] migration de contacts_stats_series nao encontrada' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+fail() { printf '[FALHA] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$1"; }
+cid="contacts-stats-series-rpc-$RANDOM$RANDOM"
+cleanup() { [[ "$cid" =~ ^contacts-stats-series-rpc-[0-9]+$ ]] && docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+psql_exec() { docker exec -i "$cid" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_val()  { docker exec "$cid" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1" 2>&1 || true; }
+assert_eq() { [[ "$3" == "$2" ]] || fail "$1: esperado '$2', obtido '$3'"; pass "$1 (= $3)"; }
+assert_has() { [[ "$3" == *"$2"* ]] || fail "$1: esperado conter '$2', obtido -> $3"; pass "$1 ($2)"; }
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao acessivel'
+docker run --rm -d --name "$cid" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=contacts_stats_series_test_only "${CONTACTS_STATS_SERIES_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}" >/dev/null
+ready=false
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  m="$(docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -c 'database system is ready to accept connections' || true)"
+  if [[ "$m" -ge 2 ]] && docker exec "$cid" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=true; break; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+[[ "$ready" == true ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL 17 descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+user_admin='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'; user_agent_a='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
+user_agent_b='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'; user_agent_c='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'
+prof_a='b0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a'; prof_b='b0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b'
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ ambiente minimo: auth, roles, os 4 helpers que a RPC usa e a tabela contacts ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+psql_exec >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO PUBLIC;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), current_user) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN; CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN; CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role));
+CREATE TABLE public.user_profiles (user_id uuid NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, profile_id uuid NOT NULL);
+CREATE TABLE public.agent_visibility (user_id uuid NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, visible uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[]);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_uid uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=_uid AND r.role IN ('admin','supervisor')) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_visible_agent_ids(_uid uuid) RETURNS SETOF uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
+  SELECT unnest(COALESCE((SELECT v.visible FROM public.agent_visibility v WHERE v.user_id=_uid),'{}'::uuid[])) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(_uid uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
+  SELECT p.profile_id FROM public.user_profiles p WHERE p.user_id=_uid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.can_edit_contact(p_assigned_to uuid, p_queue_id uuid, p_visible uuid[], p_profile uuid, p_is_admin boolean)
+  RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$
+  SELECT COALESCE(COALESCE(p_is_admin,false) OR p_assigned_to=ANY(COALESCE(p_visible,'{}'::uuid[])),false) $$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(uuid), public.get_visible_agent_ids(uuid),
+  public.get_profile_id_for_user(uuid), public.can_edit_contact(uuid,uuid,uuid[],uuid,boolean) TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (

+SQL

@@ -0,0 +1,168 @@
+-- Contrato runtime GENERICO para migrations sem contrato dedicado.
+--
+-- Por que existe: o db-migrate.yml so aceitava versions com um contrato runtime
+-- escrito a mao no proprio workflow. Com 12 contratos e 460 migrations, toda
+-- migration nova caia no fallback "Migration sem contrato runtime permitido" e
+-- o DDL acabava aplicado fora do workflow, por MCP, sem dry-run nem confirmacao
+-- de hash ‚Äî foi essa a causa dos drifts de setembro/2026.
+--
+-- O que este contrato prova: NAO prova a semantica da migration alvo (para isso
+-- existem os contratos dedicados). Prova que o estado estrutural do schema
+-- public e exatamente o mesmo entre o dry-run e o apply, fechando a janela
+-- TOCTOU ‚Äî que e a propriedade de seguranca que o workflow usa para autorizar
+-- a aplicacao. Qualquer criacao, remocao ou alteracao de tabela, coluna,
+-- funcao (inclusive so o corpo), policy, trigger, constraint ou indice muda o
+-- structure_sha256 e, por consequencia, o runtime_sha256 ‚Äî e o apply aborta.
+--
+-- Efeito colateral aceito: se OUTRA sessao aplicar qualquer DDL entre o dry-run
+-- e o apply, o hash muda e o apply falha fechado. O caminho e repetir o dry-run
+-- e usar o hash novo, nunca relaxar a comparacao.
+--
+-- ORDER BY ... COLLATE "C" e proposital: torna a assinatura independente do
+-- locale do cluster, para que o hash dependa so do conteudo do catalogo.
+WITH signatures AS (
+  SELECT 'rel:' || c.relkind::text || ':' || c.relname || ':' || c.relrowsecurity::text AS sig
+  FROM pg_class AS c
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'S')
+
+  UNION ALL
+  SELECT 'col:' || c.relname || ':' || a.attname || ':'
+    || format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) || ':' || a.attnotnull::text
+    || ':' || coalesce(pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid), '')
+  FROM pg_attribute AS a
+  JOIN pg_class AS c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+  LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef AS d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND a.attnum > 0
+    AND NOT a.attisdropped
+    AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm')
+
+  UNION ALL
+  SELECT 'fn:' || p.proname || '(' || pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) || '):'
+    || p.prosecdef::text || ':' || p.provolatile::text || ':'
+    || coalesce(array_to_string(p.proconfig, ','), '') || ':'
+    || coalesce(array_to_string(p.proacl::text[], ','), '') || ':'
+    || md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))
+  FROM pg_proc AS p
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND p.prokind = 'f'
+
+  UNION ALL
+  SELECT 'pol:' || pol.tablename || ':' || pol.policyname || ':' || pol.permissive || ':'
+    || coalesce(array_to_string(pol.roles, ','), '') || ':' || pol.cmd || ':'
+    || coalesce(pol.qual, '') || ':' || coalesce(pol.with_check, '')
+  FROM pg_policies AS pol
+  WHERE pol.schemaname = 'public'
+
+  UNION ALL
+  SELECT 'trg:' || c.relname || ':' || t.tgname || ':' || md5(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid))
+  FROM pg_trigger AS t
+  JOIN pg_class AS c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND NOT t.tgisinternal
+
+  UNION ALL
+  SELECT 'con:' || co.conname || ':' || pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid) || ':' || co.convalidated::text
+  FROM pg_constraint AS co
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = co.connamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+
+  UNION ALL
+  SELECT 'idx:' || ic.relname || ':' || pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)
+  FROM pg_index AS i
+  JOIN pg_class AS ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
+  JOIN pg_class AS tc ON tc.oid = i.indrelid
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = tc.relnamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+), structure AS (
+  SELECT encode(
+    sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(sig, E'\n' ORDER BY sig COLLATE "C"), ''), 'UTF8')),
+    'hex'
+  ) AS structure_sha256
+  FROM signatures
+), relation_state AS (
+  SELECT
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')) AS table_count,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.relkind = 'v') AS view_count,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.relkind = 'm') AS matview_count,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND c.relrowsecurity) AS rls_enabled_count
+  FROM pg_class AS c
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+), function_state AS (
+  SELECT
+    count(*) AS function_count,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prosecdef) AS security_definer_count,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prosecdef AND p.proconfig IS NOT NULL
+      AND EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.proconfig) AS cfg WHERE cfg LIKE 'search\_path=%'
+      )) AS security_definer_fixed_path_count
+  FROM pg_proc AS p
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND p.prokind = 'f'
+), policy_state AS (
+  SELECT count(*) AS policy_count
+  FROM pg_policies
+  WHERE schemaname = 'public'
+), trigger_state AS (
+  SELECT count(*) AS trigger_count
+  FROM pg_trigger AS t
+  JOIN pg_class AS c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND NOT t.tgisinternal
+), constraint_state AS (
+  SELECT
+    count(*) AS constraint_count,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE co.convalidated) AS validated_constraint_count
+  FROM pg_constraint AS co
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = co.connamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+), index_state AS (
+  SELECT count(*) AS index_count
+  FROM pg_index AS i
+  JOIN pg_class AS tc ON tc.oid = i.indrelid
+  JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = tc.relnamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+), ledger_state AS (
+  SELECT count(*) AS ledger_count
+  FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations
+), payload AS (
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'server_major', current_setting('server_version_num')::integer / 10000,
+    'database', current_database(),
+    'contract', 'generic',
+    'table_count', rs.table_count,
+    'view_count', rs.view_count,
+    'matview_count', rs.matview_count,
+    'rls_enabled_count', rs.rls_enabled_count,
+    'function_count', fs.function_count,
+    'security_definer_count', fs.security_definer_count,
+    'security_definer_fixed_path_count', fs.security_definer_fixed_path_count,
+    'policy_count', ps.policy_count,
+    'trigger_count', ts.trigger_count,
+    'constraint_count', cs.constraint_count,
+    'validated_constraint_count', cs.validated_constraint_count,
+    'index_count', ixs.index_count,
+    'ledger_count', ls.ledger_count,
+    'structure_sha256', st.structure_sha256
+  ) AS value
+  FROM relation_state AS rs
+  CROSS JOIN function_state AS fs
+  CROSS JOIN policy_state AS ps
+  CROSS JOIN trigger_state AS ts
+  CROSS JOIN constraint_state AS cs
+  CROSS JOIN index_state AS ixs
+  CROSS JOIN ledger_state AS ls
+  CROSS JOIN structure AS st
+)
+SELECT (value || jsonb_build_object(
+  'runtime_sha256', encode(sha256(convert_to(value::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
+))::text
+FROM payload;
added in remote
  their  100644 c0d0ffce27e7389d05b05d6fbde9c63519db1883 scripts/db-audit/conversation-events-insert-autor-visivel.test.sh

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato do INSERT em public.conversation_events (N-143, SEC-RLS_CONTATOS_MENSAGENS-09).
+#
+# Defeito: a politica "Authorized users can insert events" (20260412170036) aceitava
+# performed_by NULL (evento "do sistema" forjado por usuario) e media a visibilidade por
+# contacts.assigned_to, ignorando is_contact_visible_to_user.
+#
+# BLOCO A (antes): com a politica vigente, o agente comum grava evento SEM autor.
+# BLOCO B (depois): aplica a migration do cartao e prova, com papel real (SET LOCAL ROLE
+#   authenticated + claims): autor = proprio perfil (NULL vira o perfil do chamador pelo
+#   BEFORE INSERT), autor alheio recusado, contato invisivel recusado, contato visivel por
+#   fila aceito, admin tambem nao forja autor, service_role segue gravando evento sem autor.
+# BLOCO C (vacuidade): ZAPP_CONVEVENTS_SEM_CORRECAO=1 nao aplica a migration e o BLOCO B
+#   tem de FALHAR.
+#
+# Funcoes reais extraidas dos arquivos versionados:
+#   current_profile_id          -> 20260928140000_tasks_unify_reminders_kanban.sql
+#   is_contact_visible_to_user  -> 20260909200000_harden_inbox_contact_authorization.sql
+#   politica antiga             -> 20260412170036_1c09550f-234f-4215-954f-9e0efd5ed610.sql
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261010071402_conversation_events_insert_autor_e_contato_visivel.sql"
+arq_politica_antiga="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260412170036_1c09550f-234f-4215-954f-9e0efd5ed610.sql"

+expect_error() {

+  set -e

+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria passar, mas falhou"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+# Extrai o CREATE FUNCTION <nome> de um arquivo versionado, verbatim.
+extrair_funcao() {
+  python3 - "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+caminho, nome = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+fonte = open(caminho, encoding='utf-8').read()
+padrao = re.compile(r'^CREATE (?:OR REPLACE )?FUNCTION public\.' + re.escape(nome)
+                    + r'\s*\(.*?\n(?:\$function\$|\$\$);', re.S | re.M)
+achado = padrao.search(fonte)
+if not achado:
+    sys.exit('funcao %s nao encontrada em %s' % (nome, caminho))
+sys.stdout.write(achado.group(0) + '\n')
+PY
+}

+# Executa $2 como o usuario autenticado $1 (papel real + claims), em transacao propria.
+como() {
+  printf "BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{\"sub\":\"%s\",\"role\":\"authenticated\"}', true); %s COMMIT;" "$1" "$2"
+}

+# Extrai o bloco executavel de rollback (linhas comentadas '--   <stmt>;') do proprio arquivo da
+# migration, verbatim ‚Äî prova que o rollback escrito no cabecalho roda.
+extrair_rollback() {
+  python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
+import sys
+saida = []
+for l in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines():
+    if l.startswith('--   '):
+        saida.append(l[len('--   '):])
+    elif saida and not l.startswith('--'):
+        break
+if not saida:
+    sys.exit('bloco de rollback executavel nao encontrado em %s' % sys.argv[1])
+sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(saida) + '\n')
+PY
+}

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'

+expect_index_exists 'B13 reaplicar apos o rollback recria o indice de position' idx_conversation_tasks_owner_status_position 1
+expect_value 'B14 rollback + recriacao nao perderam linhas' '9' 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.conversation_tasks'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato de autorizacao dos INSERTs de conversation_tasks e conversation_events
+# (auditoria docs/audits/SEGURANCA_RLS_CONTATOS_MENSAGENS_2026-10-07.md: SEC-...-06 e -09).
+#
+# Defeitos cobertos:
+#   -06: conversation_tasks INSERT nao valida a visibilidade do contato (o guard so cobre UPDATE).
+#   -09: conversation_events INSERT aceita performed_by nulo (evento sem ator) e a policy usa
+#        only assigned_to direto, ignorando fila/carteira que is_contact_visible_to_user cobre.
+#
+# BLOCO A (antes da migration) fixa o comportamento atual (o defeito). BLOCO B (depois) prova a
+# correcao e garante que os fluxos reais seguem: tarefa para contato proprio, evento sem
+# performed_by (vira o ator), evento para contato visto por FILA, evento de admin, anon recusado.
+#
+# Perfis: ALICE (agente), BRUNO (agente), CAROL (admin).
+# Contatos: CVIS (da ALICE, visivel), CHID (do BRUNO, invisivel), CQUEUE (fila Q1, ALICE na fila).

+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-conv-insert-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+# Roda o SQL (SET ROLE + INSERT) exigindo sucesso; a saida nao interessa.
+run_ok() { psql_sql "$1" >/dev/null; }
+
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c '\set VERBOSITY verbose' -c "$sql" 2>&1)"; status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;

+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub',
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')
+     ), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;

+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL, UNIQUE (user_id, role));
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, assigned_to uuid, queue_id uuid);

+  AS $$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1 $$;

+  AS $$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND user_id = _user_id LIMIT 1 $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_visible_agent_ids(_user_id uuid) RETURNS SETOF uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $$ SELECT profile.id FROM public.profiles AS profile WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.user_id = _user_id $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public'
+  AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin','supervisor')) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_contact_visible_to_user(_contact_id uuid, _user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $$
+  SELECT _user_id = auth.uid() AND EXISTS (

+            AND member.profile_id = public.get_profile_id_for_user(_user_id)
+            AND member.is_active = true
+        )
+      )
+  )
+  $$;

+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_visible_agent_ids(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_contact_visible_to_user(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

+CREATE TABLE public.conversation_tasks (

+);

+ALTER TABLE public.conversation_tasks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.conversation_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+-- Corpos ATUAIS de producao ‚Äî o defeito (guarda so assigned_to direto / aceita performed_by nulo).
+CREATE POLICY tasks_insert_own ON public.conversation_tasks
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated

+CREATE POLICY "Authorized users can insert events" ON public.conversation_events

+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles, public.user_roles, public.contacts, public.queue_members TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON public.conversation_tasks TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON public.conversation_events TO authenticated, service_role;

+#
+# R2-AUTH-036 (Sala de Crise): prova, em PostgreSQL 17 descart√°vel, que a RPC
+# public.crisis_room_snapshot() mede as 4 m√©tricas da tela num √∫nico agregado

+# nunca com zeros ("falha de medi√ß√£o n√£o vira opera√ß√£o normal").

+#   2. presen√ßa real (heartbeat recente) e universo habilitado, n√£o profiles.is_active;
+#   3. SLA restrito √†s √∫ltimas 24 h (o hist√≥rico antigo N√ÉO infla);
+#   4. queue_ratio NULL quando n√£o h√° agente online (n√£o 0);
+#   5. opera√ß√£o grande: o agregado passa de 1.000 (o LIMIT 1000 do PostgREST n√£o morde);
+#   6. agente comum, anon e service_role: exce√ß√£o/permiss√£o negada, sem zeros.
+

+container_name="zapp-crisis-room-snapshot-test-$$"
+passed=0
+
+admin_user="11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
+agent_user="22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
+offline_user="33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"
+disabled_user="44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444"

+cleanup() {

+  fi

+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }

+psql_script() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres; }
+psql_query() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }

+# Chama a RPC como um ator autenticado (papel authenticated + claim `sub`), o
+# mesmo mecanismo do harness real. `expr` √© uma express√£o SQL que usa o retorno.
+call_as() {
+  local sub="$1" expr="$2"
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres <<SQL
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub = '$sub';
+SELECT $expr;
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+}
+
+# Chama a RPC como um papel arbitr√°rio (anon/service_role) e devolve sa√≠da+status.
+call_as_role() {
+  local role="$1" out_var="$2" status_var="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres 2>&1 <<SQL
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE $role;
+SELECT public.crisis_room_snapshot();
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  printf -v "$out_var" '%s' "$output"
+  printf -v "$status_var" '%s' "$status"
+}
+
+assert_eq() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
+  if [[ "$actual" != "$expected" ]]; then
+    fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  fi
+  ((passed += 1))
+  printf '[PASS] %s (= %s)\n' "$label" "$actual"
+}
+
+assert_denied() {
+  local label="$1" output="$2" status="$3" needle="$4"
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    fail "$label: a chamada deveria falhar (nao devolver zeros), mas saiu 0"
+  fi
+  if [[ "$output" != *"$needle"* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label: faltou a marca '$needle' no erro"
+  fi
+  if [[ "$output" =~ (unanswered_messages|online_agents|queue_ratio) ]]; then
+    fail "$label: o erro vazou o payload de metricas"
+  fi
+  ((passed += 1))
+  printf '[PASS] %s (negado com excecao)\n' "$label"
+}
