+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Prova, em PostgreSQL descartavel, da remocao do job pg_cron residual
+# `vacuum-messages-post-expurgo` (item 471 / DELTA-CRON-ANUAL).
+#
+# A. reproduz a API do pg_cron usada (cron.job + cron.schedule/unschedule/alter_job) e os
+#    12 jobs REAIS da frota (nomes e horarios do canonico; os comandos dos jobs que nao
+#    sao o alvo sao curtos de proposito -- o defeito nao esta no comando deles), com os 3
+#    papeis do Supabase (anon/authenticated/service_role);
+# B. RED 1 -- o job residual esta VIVO na agenda anual (`20 3 2 9 *`): e o defeito do cartao;
+# C. RED 2 -- remover o job SEM reescrever public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento() faz o
+#    caminho de recuperacao documentado ABORTAR ("esperado 1x em cron.job, encontrado 0"):
+#    e por isso que a correcao precisa das duas coisas na mesma migration;
+# D. GREEN -- aplica ESTE arquivo de migration (o real): o job some, os outros 11 jobs
+#    ficam intactos (nome, agenda, comando, dono e active identicos) e a funcao segue viva:
+#    apply(false) = apply(true) = 8, e ela nao recria o job removido;
+# E. ACL da funcao: PUBLIC fora, anon/authenticated levam 42501, service_role executa;
+# F. idempotencia: aplicar de novo nao falha e nao muda nada;
+# G. rollback: extraido do PROPRIO arquivo (`^-- Rollback:`), executado no banco -- o job
+#    volta com agenda e comando de antes e a funcao volta a ter as 9 linhas (apply = 9,
+#    devolvendo o job a `0 3 2 9 *`); reaplicar a migration remove de novo.
+#
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/cron-remocao-vacuum-messages.test.sh <migration da remocao>
+set -euo pipefail
+
+IMG="${CRON_REMOCAO_VACUUM_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+NAME="cron-rm-vac-$$"
+MIG="${1:?uso: $0 <caminho da migration que remove o job residual>}"
+RAIZ="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
+MIG_ESC="$RAIZ/supabase/migrations/20261002541230_pg_cron_escalonar_jobs.sql"
+JOB='vacuum-messages-post-expurgo'
+FALHAS=0
+ok()   { echo "  [OK]     $*"; }
+ruim() { echo "  [FALHOU] $*"; FALHAS=$((FALHAS+1)); }
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo "docker ausente"; exit 2; }
+[[ -f "$MIG" ]] || { echo "migration nao encontrada: $MIG"; exit 2; }
+[[ -f "$MIG_ESC" ]] || { echo "migration do escalonamento nao encontrada: $MIG_ESC"; exit 2; }
+
+docker rm -f "$NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+docker run -d --name "$NAME" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=teste -e POSTGRES_DB=teste "$IMG" >/dev/null
+trap 'docker rm -f "$NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
+
+for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
+  docker exec "$NAME" pg_isready -U postgres -d teste >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
+  sleep 1
+done
+docker exec "$NAME" pg_isready -U postgres -d teste >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "PG nao subiu"; exit 2; }
+
+q()            { docker exec -i -e PGPASSWORD=teste "$NAME" psql -U postgres -d teste -X -q -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 "$@"; }
+aplica()       { docker exec -i -e PGPASSWORD=teste "$NAME" psql -U postgres -d teste -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < "$1" >/dev/null; }
+aplica_stdin() { docker exec -i -e PGPASSWORD=teste "$NAME" psql -U postgres -d teste -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /dev/stdin >/dev/null; }
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------- bootstrap (A)
+q >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+CREATE SCHEMA cron;
+CREATE TABLE cron.job (
+  jobid    bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
+  jobname  text NOT NULL,
+  schedule text NOT NULL,
+  command  text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'select 1',
+  username text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
+  active   boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
+  UNIQUE (jobname, username)          -- indice unico real do pg_cron (jobname, username)
+);
+-- pg_cron de verdade: unschedule/schedule/alter_job resolvem o dono POR DENTRO e alcancam
+-- cron.job (que e do supabase_admin). Aqui os stubs fazem o mesmo papel.
+CREATE FUNCTION cron.alter_job(job_id bigint, schedule text)
+RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $f$
+  UPDATE cron.job SET schedule = alter_job.schedule WHERE jobid = alter_job.job_id;
+$f$;
+CREATE FUNCTION cron.unschedule(job_name text)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
+BEGIN
+  DELETE FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = job_name AND username = session_user;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE 'Job named % not found', job_name; END IF;
+  RETURN true;
+END;
+$f$;
+CREATE FUNCTION cron.unschedule(job_id bigint)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
+BEGIN
+  DELETE FROM cron.job WHERE jobid = job_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE 'Job with id % not found', job_id; END IF;
+  RETURN true;
+END;
+$f$;
+CREATE FUNCTION cron.schedule(p_jobname text, p_schedule text, p_command text)
+RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
+DECLARE v_id bigint;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT jobid INTO v_id FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = p_jobname AND username = session_user;
+  IF v_id IS NULL THEN
+    INSERT INTO cron.job (jobname, schedule, command) VALUES (p_jobname, p_schedule, p_command)
+      RETURNING jobid INTO v_id;
+  ELSE
+    UPDATE cron.job SET schedule = p_schedule, command = p_command WHERE jobid = v_id;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v_id;
+END;
+$f$;
+INSERT INTO cron.job (jobname, schedule, command) VALUES
+  ('talkx-scheduler-1min',        '* * * * *',     'SELECT public.trigger_talkx_engine_tick()'),
+  ('tasks-notify-due',            '* * * * *',     'SELECT public.notify_due_tasks()'),
+  ('ai-jobs-tick-1min',           '1-59 * * * *',  'SELECT public.trigger_ai_jobs_tick()'),
+  ('expire-stale-agent-presence', '*/2 * * * *',   'SELECT public.expire_stale_agent_presence()'),
+  ('multiplix-send-trigger',      '*/2 * * * *',   'SELECT public.multiplix_send_trigger()'),
+  ('gmail-incremental-sync',      '*/5 * * * *',   'SELECT public.gmail_incremental_sync()'),
+  ('connection-health-check',     '*/5 * * * *',   'SELECT public.connection_health_check()'),
+  ('cleanup-edge-rate-limits',    '*/15 * * * *',  'DELETE FROM public.edge_rate_limits WHERE updated_at < now() - interval ''1 hour'''),
+  ('avatars-refresh',             '0 * * * *',     'SELECT public.batch_fetch_avatars()'),
+  ('cleanup-link-preview-cache',  '0 3 * * *',     'SELECT public.cleanup_link_preview_cache()'),
+  ('vacuum-contacts-daily',       '30 3 * * *',    'VACUUM ANALYZE public.contacts'),
+  ('vacuum-messages-post-expurgo','0 3 2 9 *',     'VACUUM FULL ANALYZE public.messages');
+SQL
+ok "A. API do cron reproduzida + os 12 jobs reais semeados"
+
+# A funcao REAL vem da migration do escalonamento (nao de uma copia): aplica-la tambem
+# leva a frota ao estado vivo de hoje (o job alvo em `20 3 2 9 *`).
+aplica "$MIG_ESC"
+ok "A. 20261002541230 aplicada: frota no estado vivo (offsets escalonados)"
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------- RED 1: o defeito (B)
+VIVO="$(q -c "SELECT schedule||'|'||command||'|'||username||'|'||active FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='$JOB'")"
+if [[ "$VIVO" = "20 3 2 9 *|VACUUM FULL ANALYZE public.messages|postgres|true" ]]; then
+  ok "B. RED: o job residual esta VIVO na agenda anual (20 3 2 9 *, active, dono postgres)"
+else
+  ruim "B. estado de partida inesperado: '$VIVO'"
+fi
+
+# -------------------------------------- RED 2: sem a reescrita a funcao aborta (C)
+CX="$(q -c "BEGIN; SELECT cron.unschedule('$JOB'); SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(false);" 2>&1 || true)"
+if printf '%s' "$CX" | grep -q 'esperado 1x em cron.job'; then
+  ok "C. RED: com o job fora, apply_pg_cron_escalonamento() ABORTA (a remocao sozinha quebra o caminho de recuperacao)"
+else
+  ruim "C. a funcao nao abortou com o job ausente: $CX"
+fi
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='$JOB'")" = "1" ]] \
+  && ok "C. a transacao de prova nao deixou rastro (o job continua la)" \
+  || ruim "C. a prova de RED 2 mexeu no banco"
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------- GREEN: aplica a migration (D)
+ANTES="$(q -c "SELECT jobname||'|'||schedule||'|'||command||'|'||username||'|'||active FROM cron.job ORDER BY jobname")"
+aplica "$MIG"
+
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='$JOB'")" = "0" ]] \
+  && ok "D. o job residual foi REMOVIDO" \
+  || ruim "D. o job residual continua em cron.job"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job")" = "11" ]] \
+  && ok "D. a frota ficou com 11 jobs" \
+  || ruim "D. contagem de jobs inesperada: $(q -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job')"
+DEPOIS="$(q -c "SELECT jobname||'|'||schedule||'|'||command||'|'||username||'|'||active FROM cron.job ORDER BY jobname")"
+ANTES_SEM="$(printf '%s\n' "$ANTES" | grep -v "^$JOB|")"
+if [[ "$DEPOIS" = "$ANTES_SEM" ]]; then
+  ok "D. os outros 11 jobs intactos (agenda, comando, dono e active identicos)"
+else
+  ruim "D. algum outro job foi tocado"
+  diff <(printf '%s\n' "$ANTES_SEM") <(printf '%s\n' "$DEPOIS") || true
+fi
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(false)")" = "8" ]] \
+  && ok "D. apply(false) segue vivo: aplica os 8 jobs restantes" \
+  || ruim "D. apply(false) nao devolveu 8"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(true)")" = "8" ]] \
+  && ok "D. apply(true) segue vivo: reverte os 8 jobs restantes" \
+  || ruim "D. apply(true) nao devolveu 8"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='$JOB'")" = "0" ]] \
+  && ok "D. a funcao NAO recria o job removido" \
+  || ruim "D. a funcao recriou o job removido"
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------- ACL (E)
+for papel in anon authenticated; do
+  SAIDA="$(q -c "SET ROLE $papel; SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(false);" 2>&1 || true)"
+  if printf '%s' "$SAIDA" | grep -q 'permission denied for function'; then
+    ok "E. $papel nao executa (42501)"
+  else
+    ruim "E. $papel executou: $SAIDA"
+  fi
+done
+SAIDA="$(q -c "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(false);" 2>&1 || true)"
+[[ "$SAIDA" = "8" ]] && ok "E. service_role executa (8)" || ruim "E. service_role: $SAIDA"
+PUB="$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p, aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,'{}'::aclitem[])) a WHERE p.oid = 'public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(boolean)'::regprocedure AND a.grantee = 0 AND a.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE'")"
+NULA="$(q -c "SELECT (proacl IS NULL)::text FROM pg_proc WHERE oid = 'public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(boolean)'::regprocedure")"
+if [[ "$PUB" = "0" && "$NULA" = "false" ]]; then
+  ok "E. PUBLIC fora da ACL da funcao (ACL explicita, sem o EXECUTE padrao)"
+else
+  ruim "E. PUBLIC: EXECUTE para PUBLIC=$PUB, proacl nula=$NULA"
+fi
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------- idempotencia (F)
+S1="$(q -c "SELECT string_agg(jobname||' '||schedule||' '||command, ',' ORDER BY jobname) FROM cron.job")"
+aplica "$MIG"
+S2="$(q -c "SELECT string_agg(jobname||' '||schedule||' '||command, ',' ORDER BY jobname) FROM cron.job")"
+[[ "$S1" = "$S2" ]] && ok "F. idempotente: 2a aplicacao nao mudou nada" || ruim "F. a 2a aplicacao mudou a frota"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job")" = "11" ]] && ok "F. nao duplicou job (11)" || ruim "F. duplicou job"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(false)")" = "8" ]] \
+  && ok "F. a funcao segue viva apos reaplicar" || ruim "F. apply(false) deixou de funcionar"
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------- rollback (G)
+RB="$(grep '^-- Rollback:' "$MIG" | cut -d' ' -f3-)"
+[[ -n "$RB" ]] || ruim "G. a migration nao tem a linha '-- Rollback:' preenchida"
+printf '%s\n' "$RB" | aplica_stdin
+VOLTOU="$(q -c "SELECT schedule||'|'||command||'|'||username||'|'||active FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='$JOB'")"
+if [[ "$VOLTOU" = "20 3 2 9 *|VACUUM FULL ANALYZE public.messages|postgres|true" ]]; then
+  ok "G. rollback devolveu o job com agenda, comando, dono e active de antes"
+else
+  ruim "G. o job nao voltou como estava: '$VOLTOU'"
+fi
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job")" = "12" ]] && ok "G. frota de volta a 12 jobs" || ruim "G. frota nao voltou a 12"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(true)")" = "9" ]] \
+  && ok "G. a funcao do rollback tem as 9 linhas" \
+  || ruim "G. a funcao do rollback nao devolveu 9"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT schedule FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='$JOB'")" = "0 3 2 9 *" ]] \
+  && ok "G. revertida, ela devolve o job ao horario original (0 3 2 9 *)" \
+  || ruim "G. horario original esperado nao veio"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(false)")" = "9" ]] \
+  && ok "G. e volta a escalonar o job (20 3 2 9 *)" \
+  || ruim "G. reescalonamento do rollback falhou"
+aplica "$MIG"
+[[ "$(q -c "SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job WHERE jobname='$JOB'")" = "0" ]] \
+  && ok "G. reaplicar a migration remove de novo (ciclo fecha)" \
+  || ruim "G. reaplicar a migration nao removeu o job"
+
+echo
+if [[ "$FALHAS" -eq 0 ]]; then echo "RESULTADO: TODAS AS PROVAS PASSARAM"; exit 0; fi
+echo "RESULTADO: $FALHAS PROVA(S) FALHARAM"; exit 1

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Harness descartavel (Docker postgres:17-alpine) ‚Äî DASHBOARD-03 (paridade V3 -> V2).
+#
+# Prova, em PostgreSQL 17, que a RPC public.dashboard_daily_series(p_days int)
+# devolve a serie diaria de atividade no fuso de America/Sao_Paulo e que a trava
+# de papel funciona:
+#   RED (antes da migration 20261012235745): a funcao nao existe.
+#   GREEN (depois):
+#     1. admin e supervisor leem a serie; os numeros batem com a contagem manual;
+#     2. authenticated NAO-staff (agente comum) -> 42501 dashboard_daily_series_requires_staff;
+#     3. anon nao tem EXECUTE (ACL) e PUBLIC fica sem EXECUTE;
+#     4. service_role (chamador interno) le, mesmo sem papel de usuario;
+#     5. p_days e limitado a 90 (1000 -> 90 linhas) e o piso e 1 (0 -> 1 linha);
+#        dias sem movimento aparecem com contadores 0 e mediana NULL (sem amostra);
+#     6. reaplicar a migration nao quebra (idempotencia);
+#     7. o Rollback do cabecalho roda e remove a funcao (volta ao RED).
+#
+# A migration REAL e referenciada pelo NOME DO ARQUIVO (pinado), nunca por busca
+# por marcador: a busca por marcador (`grep -rlF ... | tail -1`) passaria a
+# devolver uma migration futura (ex.: _v2) depois que ela existir, e o passo 7
+# (Rollback) reaplicaria a migration errada. O objeto sob teste e aplicado do
+# arquivo real de supabase/migrations, nunca recriado aqui.
+#
+# Fixtures: apenas o ambiente minimo (schema auth, roles, IS_ADMIN_OR_SUPERVISOR e
+# as 4 tabelas que a RPC le) que a migration real toca. As tabelas sao stubs com
+# as colunas usadas pela RPC (messages, contacts, conversation_closures,
+# conversation_sla) ‚Äî o mesmo padrao dos harnesses irmaos.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261012235745_dashboard_daily_series.sql"
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || { printf '[FALHA] migration 20261012235745_dashboard_daily_series.sql nao encontrada\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+fail() { printf '[FALHA] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$1"; }
+
+cid="dashboard-daily-series-$RANDOM$RANDOM"
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$cid" =~ ^dashboard-daily-series-[0-9]+$ ]]; then

+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

+psql_exec() { docker exec -i "$cid" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_val()  { docker exec "$cid" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1" 2>&1 || true; }

+assert_eq() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  pass "$label (= $actual)"
+}
+assert_has() {
+  local label="$1" pattern="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == *"$pattern"* ]] || fail "$label: esperado conter '$pattern', obtido -> $actual"
+  pass "$label ($pattern)"
+}

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'

+pg_image="${DASHBOARD_DAILY_SERIES_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"

+# Extracao estrita: ancora na linha-marcador exata e captura SOMENTE as linhas
+# de instrucao SQL (`--   `, tres espacos) IMEDIATAMENTE apos ela; a primeira
+# linha fora desse marcador encerra (prosa de cabecalho, mesmo iniciada por
+# `-- `, nunca chega ao psql). Se nenhuma linha de instrucao existir, falha.
+rollback_sql="$(awk '/^-- Rollback \(SQL execut√°vel, na ordem\):$/{f=1;next} f&&/^--   /{sub(/^--   /,"");print;next} f{exit}' "$migration")"
+[[ -n "$rollback_sql" ]] || fail 'Rollback executavel nao encontrado no cabecalho da migration'

+rolled_exist="$(psql_val "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.dashboard_daily_series(integer)')::text")"
+assert_eq '7. apos o Rollback a funcao nao existe (volta ao RED)' '' "$rolled_exist"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# departments-admin-gestao (cartao t_8f85d6e8): a tela de departamentos do V3 e do admin
+# precisa CRIAR, RENOMEAR e EXCLUIR com seguranca. Em V2 `departments` tinha escrita ampla
+# para admin OU supervisor (policy departments_admin_write, 20260902120000) e DELETE de
+# TABELA concedido ao authenticated ‚Äî qualquer admin podia apagar a linha direto via
+# PostgREST e disparar o ON DELETE CASCADE de team_conversations (FK de 20260929200000),
+# apagando conversas em cascata SEM checagem.
+#
+# A correcao (migration 20261011191021_departments_admin.sql) e aditiva:
+#   - departments_admin_write passa a exigir public.is_admin(auth.uid()) (GATE 16);
+#   - REVOKE DELETE ON public.departments FROM authenticated (a exclusao so passa pela RPC);
+#   - RPC public.delete_department(uuid, uuid) -> jsonb: so admin, recusa quando ha
+#     membros/conversas/filas e p_move_to e nulo (devolvendo contagens), e com p_move_to
+#     move membros e conversas, apaga a linha e audita ‚Äî tudo numa transacao;
+#   - RPC public.departments_overview() -> contagens por departamento (so admin).
+#
+# ESTE CONTRATO roda em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel (docker), no formato dos testes irmaos
+# department-whatsapp-mode-rpc.test.sh e l11-departments-acl-escrita.test.sh. UM banco so,
+# so `docker run`/`docker exec ... psql`/`docker rm`: compativel com o docker-shim do
+# db-guard.yml (E47). NENHUMA credencial de producao entra aqui.
+#
+#   ANTES  ‚Äî estado pre-migration: authenticated tem DELETE de tabela e a escrita aceita
+#            supervisor; prova-se o defeito (delete direto apaga conversa em cascata).
+#   DEPOIS ‚Äî aplica o arquivo REAL da migration e prova: DELETE revogado; escrita so admin;
+#            RPC so para admin (anon/agente recebem 42501); recusa com contagens sem apagar;
+#            move+apaga+auditoria; overview; e o caso de retorno.
+#   ESTATICO ‚Äî o arquivo do repo tem is_admin e as RPCs; a revogacao de DELETE e
+#            provada por SQL real no contrato DEPOIS e na MUTACAO A.
+#   MUTACAO A ‚Äî copia sem a linha do REVOKE: com o DELETE ainda concedido, o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO B ‚Äî copia com o portao de papel desligado: o agente passa, o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO C ‚Äî copia com overview liberado para supervisor: o contrato FALHA.
+#   ROLLBACK ‚Äî o bloco `-- Rollback (...)` do arquivo roda e devolve o estado anterior.
+#
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/departments-admin-management.test.sh
+#      DEPARTMENTS_ADMIN_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE=postgres:17-alpine  (default)
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011191021_departments_admin.sql"
+postgres_image="${DEPARTMENTS_ADMIN_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-dept-admin-test-$$"
+tmp_base="${TMPDIR:-$repo_root/.tmp}"
+tmp_dir="$tmp_base/zapp-v2-dept-admin-test.$$"
+passed=0
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-dept-admin-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  case "$tmp_dir" in
+    */zapp-v2-dept-admin-test.*) rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir" ;;
+  esac
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+ok()   { printf '[OK] %s\n' "$1"; ((passed += 1)); }
+
+# Um banco so (compativel com o docker-shim).
+psql_q() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+q1() { psql_q -c "$1"; }
+
+# Variantes usadas DENTRO do contrato: imprimem [FAIL] e retornam 1 ‚Äî a mutacao precisa
+# que o contrato FALHE, com evidencia no log.
+assert_eq() { # fase label esperado obtido
+  local fase="$1" label="$2" expected="$3" actual="$4"
+  if [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]]; then
+    printf '[OK] %s: %s = %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$actual"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '[FAIL] %s: %s deveria ser %s, obtido %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$expected" "$actual" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+
+extract_sqlstate() {
+  printf '%s\n' "$1" | python3 -c 'import re,sys; text=sys.stdin.read(); m=re.search(r"ERROR:\s+([0-9A-Z]{5}):", text); print(m.group(1) if m else "")'
+}
+
+check_error() { # label sqlstate mensagem_opcional sql
+  local label="$1" expected_sqlstate="$2" expected_message="$3" sql="$4" out status actual_sqlstate
+  set +e
+  out="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v VERBOSITY=verbose -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: a chamada passou (esperava SQLSTATE %s): %s\n' "$label" "$expected_sqlstate" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  actual_sqlstate="$(extract_sqlstate "$out")"
+  if [[ "$actual_sqlstate" != "$expected_sqlstate" ]]; then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: SQLSTATE divergente (esperava %s, obteve %s): %s\n' "$label" "$expected_sqlstate" "${actual_sqlstate:-vazio}" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  if [[ -n "$expected_message" && "$out" != *"$expected_message"* ]]; then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: mensagem divergente (esperava conter %s): %s\n' "$label" "$expected_message" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  printf '[OK] %s (SQLSTATE %s)\n' "$label" "$expected_sqlstate"
+  return 0
+}

+reseed() { printf '%s\n' "$SEED_SQL" | psql_q >/dev/null; }

+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ contrato DEPOIS: devolve 0 se TODAS passam, 1 na primeira violacao ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+checa_contrato() { # fase
+  local fase="$1"
+  reseed
+
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'has_table_privilege(authenticated, departments, DELETE)' 'f' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.departments','DELETE')")" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: DELETE direto do admin e barrado (42501, grant revogado)" '42501' '' \
+    "$admin_call DELETE FROM public.departments WHERE id='$DEP_VAZIO'; COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: INSERT do supervisor e barrado pela RLS (42501)" '42501' '' \
+    "$sup_call INSERT INTO public.departments (name) VALUES ('Depto Supervisor'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: INSERT do agente e barrado pela RLS (42501)" '42501' '' \
+    "$agent_call INSERT INTO public.departments (name) VALUES ('Depto Agente'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  q1 "$admin_call INSERT INTO public.departments (name) VALUES ('Departamento Novo'); COMMIT;" >/dev/null \
+    || { printf '[FAIL] %s: o admin deveria inserir direto\n' "$fase" >&2; return 1; }
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin INSERT direto conta 1' '1' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.departments WHERE name='Departamento Novo'")" || return 1
+
+  q1 "$agent_call UPDATE public.departments SET name='HACK' WHERE id='$DEP_VAZIO'; COMMIT;" >/dev/null || true
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'agente nao renomeia (UPDATE RLS filtra)' 'Departamento Vazio' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT name FROM public.departments WHERE id='$DEP_VAZIO'")" || return 1
+
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(authenticated, $SIG_DEL, EXECUTE)" 't' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$SIG_DEL','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(anon, $SIG_DEL, EXECUTE)" 'f' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$SIG_DEL','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: anon nao executa a RPC (42501)" '42501' '' \
+    "$anon_call SELECT public.delete_department('$DEP_VAZIO', NULL); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: agente nao executa a RPC (42501)" '42501' '' \
+    "$agent_call SELECT public.delete_department('$DEP_VAZIO', NULL); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: supervisor nao executa a RPC (42501, so admin)" '42501' '' \
+    "$sup_call SELECT public.delete_department('$DEP_VAZIO', NULL); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  check_error "$fase: departamento inexistente recusado" 'P0002' 'department_not_found' \
+    "$admin_call SELECT public.delete_department('$DEP_INEXISTENTE', NULL); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: mover para si mesmo recusado" '22023' 'invalid_move_target' \
+    "$admin_call SELECT public.delete_department('$DEP_ALFA', '$DEP_ALFA'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  # recusa com contagens, SEM apagar
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'sem destino: recusa department_in_use' 'department_in_use' \
+    "$(q1 "$admin_call SELECT (public.delete_department('$DEP_ALFA', NULL))->>'error'; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'sem destino: Alfa continua' '1' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.departments WHERE id='$DEP_ALFA'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'sem destino: membros contados >=1' 't' \
+    "$(q1 "$admin_call SELECT ((public.delete_department('$DEP_ALFA', NULL))->>'members')::int >= 1; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'sem destino: filas contadas >=1' 't' \
+    "$(q1 "$admin_call SELECT ((public.delete_department('$DEP_ALFA', NULL))->>'queues')::int >= 1; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+
+  # move + apaga + audita (updated_at preservado: o gatilho e desligado so no UPDATE da RPC)
+  local ts_perfil_antes ts_perfil_depois ts_conv_antes ts_conv_depois
+  ts_perfil_antes="$(q1 "SELECT updated_at::text FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id='$AGENT_SUB'")"
+  ts_conv_antes="$(q1 "SELECT updated_at::text FROM public.team_conversations WHERE id='60000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1'")"
+
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: ok true' 'true' \
+    "$(q1 "$admin_call SELECT (public.delete_department('$DEP_ALFA', '$DEP_BETA'))->>'ok'; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+
+  ts_perfil_depois="$(q1 "SELECT updated_at::text FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id='$AGENT_SUB'")"
+  ts_conv_depois="$(q1 "SELECT updated_at::text FROM public.team_conversations WHERE id='60000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1'")"
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: updated_at do membro ANTES=DEPOIS' "$ts_perfil_antes" "$ts_perfil_depois" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: updated_at da conversa ANTES=DEPOIS' "$ts_conv_antes" "$ts_conv_depois" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: membro mudou de departamento' "$DEP_BETA" \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT department_id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id='$AGENT_SUB'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: Alfa apagado' '0' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.departments WHERE id='$DEP_ALFA'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: membros movidos' '3' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE department_id='$DEP_BETA'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: conversas movidas' '2' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.team_conversations WHERE department_id='$DEP_BETA'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: auditoria global sobrevive' '1' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_logs WHERE action='delete_department' AND entity_id='$DEP_ALFA'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'com destino: auditoria do destino registrada' '1' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.department_audit_logs WHERE department_id='$DEP_BETA' AND action='delete_department'")" || return 1
+
+  # vazio sem destino: apaga
+  reseed
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'vazio: ok true' 'true' \
+    "$(q1 "$admin_call SELECT (public.delete_department('$DEP_VAZIO', NULL))->>'ok'; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'vazio: apagado' '0' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.departments WHERE id='$DEP_VAZIO'")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'vazio: auditoria global registrada' '1' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_logs WHERE action='delete_department' AND entity_id='$DEP_VAZIO'")" || return 1
+
+  # conflito do indice unico ao mover conversa-tipo
+  reseed
+  check_error "$fase: mover 2 conversas-tipo colidiria (recusa)" '22023' 'move_target_already_has_department_conversation' \
+    "$admin_call SELECT public.delete_department('$DEP_GAMA', '$DEP_BETA'); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'conflito: Gama continua' '1' \
+    "$(q1 "SELECT count(*) FROM public.departments WHERE id='$DEP_GAMA'")" || return 1
+
+  # overview
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'overview: admin ve as 4 linhas' '4' \
+    "$(q1 "$admin_call SELECT count(*) FROM public.departments_overview(); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: overview do supervisor e barrado (42501, so admin)" '42501' '' \
+    "$sup_call SELECT * FROM public.departments_overview(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: overview do agente e barrado (42501)" '42501' '' \
+    "$agent_call SELECT * FROM public.departments_overview(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: overview do anon e barrado (42501)" '42501' '' \
+    "$anon_call SELECT * FROM public.departments_overview(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+
+  return 0
+}
+
+exige_falha_do_contrato() { # fase
+  local fase="$1" evid
+  evid="$( ( checa_contrato "$fase" ) 2>&1 || true )"
+  if [[ "$evid" == *'[FAIL]'* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$evid" | sed 's/^/[EVIDENCIA] /'
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n' "$evid" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $migration"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ leitura estatica do arquivo do repo ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+grep -qF 'USING (public.is_admin(auth.uid()))' "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu a policy de escrita para is_admin()'
+grep -qF 'IF NOT public.is_admin(v_uid) THEN' "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o portao de papel da RPC delete_department'
+grep -qF "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_department(" "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu a RPC delete_department'
+grep -qF "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.departments_overview()" "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu a RPC departments_overview'
+grep -qF 'GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.delete_department(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;' "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o GRANT de EXECUTE da RPC'
+if grep -qF 'GRANT DELETE ON public.departments' "$migration"; then
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo CONCEDE DELETE em public.departments (nao pode)'
+fi
+ok 'o arquivo do repo tem is_admin/RPCs e nao concede DELETE; REVOKE e validado por SQL real'
+
+mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=dept_admin_test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
+  if psql_q -c 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break
+  else
+    ready=0
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || { printf 'FAIL: PostgreSQL de teste n√£o iniciou\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ bootstrap: schema minimo fiel + seeds + estado PRE-migration ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+cat > "$tmp_dir/bootstrap.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid
+$$;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = 'admin')
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin','supervisor'))
+$$;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text,
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
+  department_id uuid,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1
+$$;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.departments (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
+  whatsapp_mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
+  whatsapp_api_key text,
+  whatsapp_instance_id text,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+ALTER TABLE public.departments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY departments_select ON public.departments
+  FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
+-- Estado PRE-migration (20260902120000): escrita para admin OU supervisor.
+CREATE POLICY departments_admin_write ON public.departments
+  FOR ALL TO authenticated
+  USING (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()))
+  WITH CHECK (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+
+ALTER TABLE public.profiles
+  ADD CONSTRAINT profiles_department_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES public.departments(id);
+
+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversations (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'group',
+  name text,
+  department_id uuid REFERENCES public.departments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_team_conversations_dept_unique
+  ON public.team_conversations(department_id) WHERE type = 'department' AND department_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+-- Gatilhos de updated_at reais (update_updated_at_column: NEW.updated_at = now()).
+CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public AS $$
+BEGIN
+  NEW.updated_at = now();
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+CREATE TRIGGER update_profiles_updated_at
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
+CREATE TRIGGER update_team_conversations_updated_at
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.team_conversations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
+
+CREATE TABLE public.queues (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL);
+CREATE TABLE public.queue_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  queue_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.queues(id),
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.department_audit_logs (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  department_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.departments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  action text NOT NULL,
+  profile_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  details jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  profile_name text
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.audit_logs (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid,
+  action text NOT NULL,
+  entity_type text,
+  entity_id uuid,
+  details jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated;
+-- Estado PRE-migration: DELETE de TABELA concedido ao authenticated.
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.departments TO authenticated;
+SQL
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/bootstrap.sql" >/dev/null
+ok 'bootstrap: roles, auth.uid(), catalogo minimo, policies PRE e grants PRE'

+reseed
+ok 'fixtures carregadas'

+echo
+echo '‚îÄ‚îÄ ANTES: o defeito medido (delete direto e escrita ampla) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ'
+v="$(q1 "SELECT has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.departments','DELETE')")"
+[[ "$v" == t ]] || fail "ANTES nao reproduziu: authenticated DELETE = $v"

+mut_d="$tmp_dir/departments_admin_mut_wrong_sqlstate.sql"
+python3 - "$migration" "$mut_d" <<'MUT_D_PY'
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+src = Path(sys.argv[1])
+dst = Path(sys.argv[2])
+s = src.read_text()
+old = "RAISE EXCEPTION 'move_target_already_has_department_conversation' USING ERRCODE = '22023';"

+dst.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

+        out.append(line.removeprefix('--   '))

+v="$(q1 "SELECT to_regprocedure('$SIG_OVW') IS NULL")"
+[[ "$v" == t ]] || fail 'ROLLBACK: a RPC departments_overview nao foi removida'

+  "$passed" "$postgres_image"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato do despacho de mensagens agendadas (public.dispatch_scheduled_messages).
+#
+# Causa raiz: public.scheduled_messages tem RLS, indice de pendentes e hook de tela,
+# mas NADA envia a mensagem quando chega a hora ‚Äî nenhuma Edge, nenhuma funcao SQL e
+# nenhum job do pg_cron toca a tabela. Mensagem agendada nunca sai.
+#
+# BLOCO B (depois): a funcao pega as pendentes vencidas em lote, enfileira a mensagem
+#   pelo caminho canonico (enqueue_outbound_message) COMO O DONO, e marca sent/failed.
+#   Prova: so vencidas e pendentes; mensagem enfileirada com conexao e status; sent_at
+#   preenchido e error_message nulo; idempotente no retry; contato legado usa o
+#   fallback; midia (localizador) preservada; sem permissao do dono NAO envia;
+#   remetente inativo / sem conexao / contato invisivel viram failed com motivo e
+#   auditoria; lote obediente ao p_limit; falha de um item nao cancela os outros.
+# BLOCO C (concorrencia): com a linha travada por outra sessao, o despacho pula o item
+#   (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) e, apos liberar, enfileira uma unica vez ‚Äî sem duplicar.
+# BLOCO D (vacuidade): ZAPP_DISPATCH_SEM_CORRECAO=1 nao carrega a funcao e o BLOCO B
+#   tem de FALHAR (prova que as assercoes nao sao vazias).
+#
+# O corpo real da funcao e extraido do arquivo da migration versionada (nunca copiado),
+# assim como o de enqueue_outbound_message (20260930200000_enforce_enqueue_connection_scope.sql)
+# e as linhas de ACL ‚Äî tudo verbatim.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011133612_dispatch_scheduled_messages.sql"
+arq_enqueue="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260930200000_enforce_enqueue_connection_scope.sql"
+postgres_image="${DISPATCH_SCHEDULED_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-dispatch-scheduled-test-$$"
+sem_correcao="${ZAPP_DISPATCH_SEM_CORRECAO:-0}"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-dispatch-scheduled-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c '\set VERBOSITY verbose' -c "$sql" 2>&1)"; status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+# Extrai o CREATE FUNCTION <nome> de um arquivo versionado, verbatim.
+extrair_funcao() {
+  python3 - "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+caminho, nome = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+fonte = open(caminho, encoding='utf-8').read()
+padrao = re.compile(r'^CREATE (?:OR REPLACE )?FUNCTION public\.' + re.escape(nome)
+                    + r'\s*\(.*?\n(?:\$function\$|\$\$);', re.S | re.M)
+achado = padrao.search(fonte)
+if not achado:
+    sys.exit('funcao %s nao encontrada em %s' % (nome, caminho))
+sys.stdout.write(achado.group(0) + '\n')
+PY
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+[[ -f "$arq_enqueue" ]] || fail "enqueue nao encontrado: $arq_enqueue"
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1)); (( ready_checks >= 2 )) && break
+  else ready_checks=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+
+# --- corpos reais (enqueue canonico + a funcao sob teste + ACL), verbatim ------------
+extrair_funcao "$arq_enqueue" enqueue_outbound_message > "$tmp_dir/enqueue.sql"
+if [[ "$sem_correcao" == 1 ]]; then
+  : > "$tmp_dir/dispatch.sql"
+else
+  {
+    python3 - "$migration" <<'PY'
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+fonte = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+inicio = fonte.index('ALTER TABLE public.scheduled_messages\n')
+fim = fonte.index('\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dispatch_scheduled_messages')
+print(fonte[inicio:fim].rstrip())
+PY
+    extrair_funcao "$migration" dispatch_scheduled_messages
+    sed -n '/^REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public\.dispatch_scheduled_messages/,/^ *TO service_role;/p' "$migration"
+  } > "$tmp_dir/dispatch.sql"
+fi
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub',
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')
+     ), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.permissions (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL UNIQUE, description text, category text
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.role_permissions (
+  role text NOT NULL, permission_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.permissions(id),
+  PRIMARY KEY (role, permission_id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role));
+CREATE FUNCTION public.user_has_permission(_user_id uuid, _permission_name text)
+  RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
+       JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp.role = ur.role
+       JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
+       WHERE ur.user_id = _user_id AND p.name = _permission_name) $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid)
+  RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT _user_id = '99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999'::uuid $$;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, name text, job_title text);
+CREATE TABLE public.whatsapp_connections (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, name text, status text NOT NULL, instance_id text, is_default boolean DEFAULT false,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.queues (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL);
+CREATE TABLE public.whatsapp_connection_queues (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), whatsapp_connection_id uuid NOT NULL, queue_id uuid NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.queue_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), queue_id uuid NOT NULL, profile_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  whatsapp_connection_id uuid REFERENCES public.whatsapp_connections(id),
+  assigned_to uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
+  conversation_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
+  deleted_at timestamptz
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.messages (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.contacts(id),
+  client_message_id uuid, whatsapp_connection_id uuid, agent_id uuid,
+  sender text, content text, message_type text, media_url text, caption text,
+  reply_to_id uuid, is_read boolean, status text, external_id text, status_updated_at timestamptz
+);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_contact_client_msg_uq
+  ON public.messages (contact_id, client_message_id) WHERE client_message_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_contact_visible_to_user(_contact_id uuid, _user_id uuid)
+  RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT _contact_id <> 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'::uuid $$;
+
+-- Tabela real das agendadas (colunas usadas pela funcao).
+CREATE TABLE public.scheduled_messages (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  content text NOT NULL,
+  message_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text',
+  media_url text,
+  scheduled_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
+  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
+  sent_at timestamptz,
+  error_message text,
+  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  whatsapp_connection_id uuid REFERENCES public.whatsapp_connections(id),
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE public.audit_logs (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid, action text NOT NULL, entity_type text, entity_id uuid,
+  details jsonb DEFAULT '{}', ip_address text, user_agent text,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+-- A infraestrutura (service_role) enxerga as tabelas que o despacho escreve.
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO service_role;
+SQL
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" <<'SQL'
+DELETE FROM public.audit_logs;
+DELETE FROM public.messages;
+DELETE FROM public.scheduled_messages;
+
+INSERT INTO public.permissions (id, name) VALUES
+  ('f0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'send_messages');
+-- papel 'agent' e 'admin' TEM send_messages; BOB nao tem papel nenhum.
+INSERT INTO public.role_permissions (role, permission_id) VALUES
+  ('agent', 'f0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'),
+  ('admin', 'f0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES
+  ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', 'agent'),
+  ('99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999', 'admin');
+INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, user_id, is_active) VALUES
+  ('aa000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', true),
+  ('bb000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222', true),
+  ('cc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999', true),
+  ('dd000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333', false);
+INSERT INTO public.whatsapp_connections (id, name, status, instance_id, updated_at) VALUES
+  ('e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Principal', 'connected', 'inst-1', now()),
+  ('e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'Antiga', 'disconnected', 'inst-2', now() - interval '1 day');
+INSERT INTO public.contacts (id, whatsapp_connection_id, assigned_to, is_active) VALUES
+  ('c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', NULL, true),
+  ('c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', NULL, NULL, true),
+  ('c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', NULL, true),
+  ('c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009', 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', NULL, true),
+  ('c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', NULL, true);
+UPDATE public.contacts SET conversation_status = 'archived'
+  WHERE id = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004';
+UPDATE public.profiles SET name = 'Carla Souza', job_title = 'Vendedora'
+  WHERE id = 'aa000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+SQL
+
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/pre.sql"
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/enqueue.sql"
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/seed.sql"
+
+# --- atalhos ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+carla='aa000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+bob='bb000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+inativo='dd000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+admin='cc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+c1='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+c2='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
+c9='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'
+c4='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'
+e1='e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+e2='e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
+CARLA='{"sub":"11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","role":"authenticated"}'
+SERVICE='"role":"service_role"'
+
+# Despacho como a infraestrutura chama (service_role), com o claim de servico.
+svc() { printf "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims','{%s}',false); %s" "$SERVICE" "$1"; }
+limpar() { psql_sql "DELETE FROM public.audit_logs; DELETE FROM public.messages; DELETE FROM public.scheduled_messages;" >/dev/null; }
+
+echo '-- BLOCO B: DEPOIS da migration ----------------------------------------------------'
+
+if [[ "$sem_correcao" == 1 ]]; then
+  echo '[MUTACAO] funcao NAO carregada (ZAPP_DISPATCH_SEM_CORRECAO=1): o BLOCO B tem de FALHAR'
+else
+  psql_file "$tmp_dir/dispatch.sql"
+fi
+
+# B1 ‚Äî so vencidas e pendentes
+limpar
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001','$c1','texto agendado','text', now() - interval '10 min','pending','$carla'),
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002','$c1','futura','text', now() + interval '1 hour','pending','$carla'),
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003','$c1','cancelada','text', now() - interval '10 min','cancelled','$carla'),
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004','$c1','ja enviada','text', now() - interval '10 min','sent','$carla');" >/dev/null
+
+expect_value 'B1 o lote despeja so a vencida pendente (1 linha)' '1' \
+  "$(svc "SELECT count(*) FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+expect_value 'B1b so a vencida pendente mudou de estado (sent|pending|cancelled|sent)' \
+  'sent|pending|cancelled|sent' \
+  "SELECT string_agg(status, '|' ORDER BY id) FROM public.scheduled_messages"
+
+expect_value 'B2 a mensagem foi enfileirada pelo dono, com conexao e status sending' \
+  "1|agent|sending|$e1|$carla|*Carla - Vendedora:*<NL>texto agendado" \
+  "SELECT count(*)::text || '|' || min(sender) || '|' || min(status) || '|' || min(whatsapp_connection_id::text) \
+        || '|' || min(agent_id::text) || '|' || replace(min(content), chr(10), '<NL>') \
+   FROM public.messages WHERE client_message_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'"
+expect_value 'B2b o client_message_id da mensagem e o id do agendamento' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE client_message_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'"
+
+expect_value 'B3 sent_at e message_id preenchidos e error_message nulo na enviada' 'true|NULO' \
+  "SELECT (sent_at IS NOT NULL AND message_id IS NOT NULL)::text || '|' || coalesce(error_message, 'NULO') \
+   FROM public.scheduled_messages WHERE id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'"
+expect_value 'B3b a coluna message_id da agendada e o id da mensagem criada' 'true' \
+  "SELECT (message_id = (SELECT id FROM public.messages WHERE client_message_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'))::text \
+   FROM public.scheduled_messages WHERE id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'"
+
+# B3c ‚Äî o message_id DEVOLVIDO pelo despacho e igual ao messages.id (ponto 1/3 da recusa).
+# As duas consultas rodam na mesma sessao: a primeira guarda o message_id devolvido
+# numa TEMP, a segunda compara com a linha criada (mesma sessao enxerga o INSERT).
+limpar
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020','$c1','confere retorno','text', now() - interval '5 min','pending','$carla');" >/dev/null
+expect_value 'B3c o message_id devolvido e igual ao messages.id da mensagem criada' 'true' \
+  "$(svc "SELECT message_id::text INTO TEMP t_ret FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages(); SELECT ((SELECT message_id FROM t_ret) = (SELECT id::text FROM public.messages WHERE client_message_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020'))::text;")"
+
+expect_value 'B4 reprocessar nao reenvia (0 linhas no lote)' '0' \
+  "$(svc "SELECT count(*) FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+expect_value 'B4b nenhuma mensagem nova foi criada (segue 1)' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE client_message_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020'"
+
+# B5 ‚Äî contato legado sem conexao atribuida usa o fallback
+limpar
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005','$c2','legado','text', now() - interval '5 min','pending','$carla');" >/dev/null
+expect_value 'B5 contato legado sem conexao: enfileira usando o fallback e devolve message_id' 'sent|true' \
+  "$(svc "SELECT outcome || '|' || (message_id IS NOT NULL)::text FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+expect_value 'B5b o agendamento legado ficou sent' "sent" \
+  "SELECT status FROM public.scheduled_messages WHERE id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'"
+expect_value 'B5c a mensagem legada saiu pela conexao conectada' "$e1" \
+  "SELECT whatsapp_connection_id::text FROM public.messages WHERE client_message_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'"
+
+# B6 ‚Äî midia: o localizador privado e preservado no enfileiramento
+limpar
+midia='https://exemplo.invalid/storage/v1/object/public/whatsapp-media/agendada.png'
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, media_url, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006','$c1','legenda','image','$midia', now() - interval '5 min','pending','$carla');" >/dev/null
+expect_value 'B6 midia: a agendada com localizador e enfileirada' '1' \
+  "$(svc "SELECT count(*) FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+expect_value 'B6b o localizador privado foi preservado na mensagem (image)' "image|$midia" \
+  "SELECT message_type || '|' || media_url FROM public.messages WHERE client_message_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'"
+
+# B7 ‚Äî sem permissao do dono nao envia
+limpar
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007','$c1','texto do bob','text', now() - interval '5 min','pending','$bob');" >/dev/null
+expect_value 'B7 dono sem send_messages: o item falha com message_id nulo no retorno' "failed|NULO" \
+  "$(svc "SELECT outcome || '|' || coalesce(message_id::text, 'NULO') FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+expect_value 'B7b o agendamento ficou failed sem_permissao com message_id nulo' 'true' \
+  "SELECT (status = 'failed' AND error_message = 'sem_permissao' AND message_id IS NULL)::text \
+   FROM public.scheduled_messages WHERE id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007'"
+expect_value 'B7c nada foi enfileirado pelo dono sem permissao' '0' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages"
+expect_value 'B7d falha auditada com motivo, sem telefone nem conteudo' 'true' \
+  "SELECT (action = 'scheduled_message_dispatch_failed' \
+           AND entity_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007' \
+           AND (details->>'reason') = 'sem_permissao' \
+           AND details::text NOT LIKE '%texto do bob%')::text \
+   FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007'"
+
+# B8 ‚Äî remetente inativo
+limpar
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000008','$c1','inativo','text', now() - interval '5 min','pending','$inativo');" >/dev/null
+expect_value 'B8 remetente inativo: failed com autor_inativo' "autor_inativo" \
+  "$(svc "SELECT failure_reason FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+expect_value 'B8b auditado' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000008'"
+
+# B9 ‚Äî nenhuma conexao conectada
+limpar
+psql_sql "UPDATE public.whatsapp_connections SET status = 'disconnected' WHERE id = '$e1';
+  INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009','$c1','sem conexao','text', now() - interval '5 min','pending','$carla');" >/dev/null
+expect_value 'B9 sem conexao conectada: failed com conexao_invalida' 'true' \
+  "$(svc "SELECT (outcome = 'failed' AND failure_reason = 'conexao_invalida')::text FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+psql_sql "UPDATE public.whatsapp_connections SET status = 'connected' WHERE id = '$e1';" >/dev/null
+
+# B10 ‚Äî contato invisivel para o dono
+limpar
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010','$c9','invisivel','text', now() - interval '5 min','pending','$carla');" >/dev/null
+expect_value 'B10 contato invisivel: failed com contato_invalido e message_id nulo' 'failed|contato_invalido|NULO' \
+  "$(svc "SELECT outcome || '|' || failure_reason || '|' || coalesce(message_id::text, 'NULO') FROM public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()")"
+
+# B11 ‚Äî lote obedece ao p_limit
+limpar
+psql_sql "INSERT INTO public.scheduled_messages (id, contact_id, content, message_type, scheduled_at, status, created_by) VALUES
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011','$c1','lote 1','text', now() - interval '14 min','pending','$carla'),

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# W56: teste offline do docker-shim.
+# Nao precisa de Docker real nem de Postgres real ‚Äî usa stubs no PATH.
+# Cobre: run, logs, exec psql, rm, pull, tag, image inspect, SKIP_DOCKER_SHIM.
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+SHIM="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/docker-shim"
+TMPDIR_TEST="$(mktemp -d)"
+STATE_DIR="$TMPDIR_TEST/state"
+BIN_DIR="$TMPDIR_TEST/bin"
+mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR" "$BIN_DIR"
+
+PASS=0
+FAIL=0
+
+ok() { printf '[OK]   %s\n' "$1"; PASS=$((PASS+1)); }
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); }
+check() {
+  local desc="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
+  if [[ "$actual" == *"$expected"* ]]; then ok "$desc"
+  else fail "$desc: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"; fi
+}
+
+cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMPDIR_TEST"; }
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ fake docker (DOCKER_REAL) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+# S√≥ usado quando o shim passa a chamada adiante (SKIP_DOCKER_SHIM=1 ou
+# comando desconhecido sem estado). Grava o que recebeu em $TMPDIR_TEST/docker.log
+cat > "$BIN_DIR/docker" << 'ENDFAKE'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$TMPDIR_TEST_LOG/docker.log"
+exit 0
+ENDFAKE
+# O heredoc nao expande $TMPDIR_TEST dentro ‚Äî injetar via sed
+sed -i "s|\$TMPDIR_TEST_LOG|$TMPDIR_TEST|g" "$BIN_DIR/docker"
+chmod +x "$BIN_DIR/docker"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ fake psql ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+# Simula as chamadas do shim:
+#   SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles  ‚Üí lista fixa de roles
+#   CREATE DATABASE / DROP DATABASE / DDL    ‚Üí exit 0 (silencioso)
+#   qualquer outra -c ou -f  ‚Üí exit 0 (silencioso)
+cat > "$BIN_DIR/psql" << 'ENDPSQL'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Detecta a query pelo ultimo argumento -c
+query=""
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    -c) shift; query="$1";;
+    *) ;;
+  esac
+  shift 2>/dev/null || shift
+done
+if printf '%s' "$query" | grep -qi "rolname"; then
+  printf 'postgres\n'
+  printf 'supabase_admin\n'
+fi
+exit 0
+ENDPSQL
+chmod +x "$BIN_DIR/psql"
+
+export PATH="$BIN_DIR:$PATH"
+
+# Variaveis de ambiente do shim
+export DOCKER_REAL="$BIN_DIR/docker"
+export POSTGRES_SERVICE_HOST="127.0.0.1"
+export POSTGRES_SERVICE_PORT="5432"
+export POSTGRES_SERVICE_PASS="testpass"
+export POSTGRES_SERVICE_USER="postgres"
+export DOCKER_SHIM_STATE_DIR="$STATE_DIR"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ 1. docker run --name ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+out="$("$SHIM" run --name my_container postgres:17-alpine)"
+check "run: retorna shimid" "shimid_my_container" "$out"
+[[ -f "$STATE_DIR/my_container.db" ]] \
+  && ok "run: cria arquivo de estado .db" \
+  || fail "run: nao criou arquivo de estado .db"
+db_name="$(cat "$STATE_DIR/my_container.db")"
+check "run: nome sanitizado comeca com shim_" "shim_" "$db_name"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ 2. docker logs ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+logs_out="$("$SHIM" logs my_container)"
+check "logs: emite 'database system is ready'" "database system is ready to accept connections" "$logs_out"
+check "logs: emite texto de initdb" "PostgreSQL init process complete" "$logs_out"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ 3. docker exec ... psql ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+# Deve passar o psql apontando para o DB do shim; exit 0
+"$SHIM" exec -i my_container psql -c "SELECT 1;" \
+  && ok "exec psql: sai com 0" \
+  || fail "exec psql: saiu com erro"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ 4. docker exec comando nao-psql ‚Üí erro ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+if "$SHIM" exec -i my_container bash -c "echo x" 2>/dev/null; then
+  fail "exec nao-psql: devia falhar"
+else
+  ok "exec nao-psql: falha esperada"
+fi
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ 5. docker rm ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+"$SHIM" rm -f my_container \
+  && ok "rm: sai com 0" \
+  || fail "rm: saiu com erro"
+[[ ! -f "$STATE_DIR/my_container.db" ]] \
+  && ok "rm: remove arquivo de estado .db" \
+  || fail "rm: nao removeu arquivo de estado .db"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ 6. docker logs de container sem estado ‚Üí passa pro real ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+>"$TMPDIR_TEST/docker.log"
+"$SHIM" logs unknown_container 2>/dev/null || true
+[[ -f "$TMPDIR_TEST/docker.log" ]] \
+  && ok "logs container desconhecido: delega ao DOCKER_REAL" \

+/**
+ * W58/W27: valida o dry-run do modo apply_all_missing.
+ *
+ * Diferente de avaliarPlanoDoDryRun (que verifica um alvo unico ou bundle
+ * pre-autorizado), esta funcao recebe a lista completa de versions esperadas
+ * e verifica que o dry-run anuncia exatamente essas, em ordem estrita.
+ * "Exatamente" = mesmo conjunto e mesma ordem; um a mais ou um a menos recusa.
+ *
+ * @param {{ texto: string, esperados: string[] }} entrada
+ * @returns {{ ok: true, migracoes: object[] } | { ok: false, motivo: string }}
+ */
+export function avaliarPlanoDoDryRunApplyAll({ texto, esperados }) {
+  const { cabecalhoReconhecido, migracoes } = parseDryRunPlan(texto);
+  if (!cabecalhoReconhecido) {
+    return { ok: false, motivo: 'saida do dry-run nao reconhecida (falta o cabecalho "DRY RUN: migrations will *not* be pushed to the database.")' };
+  }
+  if (migracoes.length === 0) {
+    return { ok: false, motivo: 'o dry-run nao anunciou nenhuma migration' };
+  }
+  const versions = migracoes.map((m) => m.version);
+  for (let i = 1; i < versions.length; i += 1) {
+    if (versions[i] <= versions[i - 1]) {
+      return { ok: false, motivo: `bundle fora de ordem estrita: ${versions[i - 1]} antes de ${versions[i]}` };
+    }
+  }
+  const faltando = esperados.filter((v) => !versions.includes(v));
+  const extra = versions.filter((v) => !esperados.includes(v));
+  if (faltando.length > 0 || extra.length > 0) {
+    const partes = [];
+    if (faltando.length > 0) partes.push(`faltando: ${faltando.join(', ')}`);
+    if (extra.length > 0) partes.push(`extra: ${extra.join(', ')}`);
+    return { ok: false, motivo: `o dry-run nao corresponde ao conjunto esperado ‚Äî ${partes.join('; ')}` };
+  }
+  return { ok: true, migracoes };
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato de autorizacao da EDICAO de mensagem (RPC public.edit_message).
+#
+# Causa raiz: o cliente editava mensagem com UPDATE direto em public.messages. A
+# policy de UPDATE e por CONTATO (visibilidade), nao por remetente: qualquer
+# agente que ve o contato reescrevia o conteudo de uma mensagem RECEBIDA ou ja
+# enviada, e ainda podia trocar sender / external_id / created_at.
+#
+# BLOCO A (antes da migration): o UPDATE direto de content por authenticated
+#   reescreve uma mensagem RECEBIDA na janela (o defeito).
+# BLOCO B (depois): o UPDATE direto de content e recusado (42501
+#   message_content_edit_requires_rpc) mesmo com a marca de sessao forjada; a RPC
+#   edit_message edita a propria mensagem enviada e recusa recebida, sem
+#   permissao, fora da janela, apagada, sem external_id e contato invisivel;
+#   sender/external_id continuam imutaveis para o cliente; soft delete continua
+#   s√≥ com tombstone exato na primeira transi√ß√£o, undelete √© recusado, is_read e
+#   transcription continuam; service_role segue escrevendo; ACL fecha
+#   anon e a guarda. O teste roda em Postgres real descartavel: o BLOCO A
+#   recebe o schema minimo do contrato afetado e o BLOCO B executa a migration do cartao por cima.
+#
+# Prova de papel real: tudo roda sob SET ROLE (authenticated / service_role),
+# com claims sinteticas, nunca como postgres.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011151650_edit_message_rpc.sql"
+postgres_image="${EDIT_MESSAGE_AUTHZ_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-${EDIT_MESSAGE_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-edit-message-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-edit-message-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c '\set VERBOSITY verbose' -c "$sql" 2>&1)"; status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-147 (P3) ‚Äî remover o ramo `OR is_admin_or_supervisor` das policies de email_threads/email_messages.
+#
+# O ramo e inerte (gmail_accounts so mostra a conta ao dono), entao o ACESSO nao muda: so o dono
+# ve/atualiza. O que a migration muda e o TEXTO das policies. Por isso o vermelho do estado anterior
+# e estrutural (BLOCO B.1), e o comportamento (dono ve; admin/supervisor de outra conta NAO ve) tem
+# de ficar verde antes e depois.
+#
+# Aplica as MIGRATIONS REAIS num Postgres 17 descartavel e roda com o PAPEL REAL
+# (`SET ROLE authenticated` + `request.jwt.claims`):
+#   * 20251215025014 ‚Äî app_role, user_roles e is_admin_or_supervisor (trechos reais, via sed);
+#   * 20260403105341 ‚Äî gmail_accounts, email_threads, email_messages e as policies originais;
+#   * 20260404173941 ‚Äî SELECT de gmail_accounts so do dono (trecho real, via sed);
+#   * 20260829030000 ‚Äî remove as policies de INSERT de email;
+#   * 20261010120000 ‚Äî a migration do cartao (opcional: sem ela o BLOCO B falha ‚Äî e o "vermelho").
+#
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado anterior: dono ve; admin e supervisor de outra conta NAO veem; o ramo existe no texto.
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada: ramo ausente do texto; o comportamento do BLOCO A segue identico.
+#   BLOCO C ‚Äî o Rollback do proprio arquivo devolve o texto antigo, com o mesmo comportamento.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+mig_dir="$repo_root/supabase/migrations"
+migration="$mig_dir/20261010120000_email_rls_remover_ramo_admin.sql"
+mig_roles="$mig_dir/20251215025014_fcc5bc79-55e3-4972-8765-6a7840fdce5a.sql"
+mig_email="$mig_dir/20260403105341_f342fbf7-d1d3-48b1-83b0-03df78b6c590.sql"
+mig_gmail="$mig_dir/20260404173941_26ed03e4-e874-44a0-b864-5db85b0ec44c.sql"
+mig_drop_ins="$mig_dir/20260829030000_drop_insert_policies_email.sql"
+postgres_image="${EMAIL_RLS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-email-rls-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-email-rls-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" j="$3" s="$4" a
+  a="$(as_user "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+for f in "$mig_roles" "$mig_email" "$mig_gmail" "$mig_drop_ins"; do
+  [[ -f "$f" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $f"
+done
+
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s) ==\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break; else ready=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ambiente (pre-migrations)
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
+
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE TABLE auth.users (id uuid PRIMARY KEY);
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+     )::uuid $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- dependencias de 20260403105341 que vivem em outras migrations
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid());
+CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS trigger
+  LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$;
+SQL
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" >/dev/null
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- migrations reais
+# 20251215025014: so o que o contrato precisa (enum + user_roles + is_admin_or_supervisor); o resto
+# do arquivo depende de storage/calls/whatsapp_connections, que nao interessam aqui.
+sed -n '/^CREATE TYPE public.app_role/p' "$mig_roles" > "$tmp_dir/roles.sql"
+sed -n '/^CREATE TABLE public.user_roles/,/^);/p' "$mig_roles" >> "$tmp_dir/roles.sql"
+sed -n '/^CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor/,/^\$\$;\?$/p' "$mig_roles" >> "$tmp_dir/roles.sql"
+grep -q 'is_admin_or_supervisor' "$tmp_dir/roles.sql" || fail 'nao extrai is_admin_or_supervisor da migration real'
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/roles.sql" >/dev/null
+
+psql_file "$mig_email" >/dev/null
+# 20260404173941: trecho 1 (SELECT de gmail_accounts so do dono); os trechos 2 e 3 sao de outras tabelas.
+sed -n '1,/^USING (user_id = auth.uid());$/p' "$mig_gmail" > "$tmp_dir/gmail_select.sql"
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/gmail_select.sql" >/dev/null
+psql_file "$mig_drop_ins" >/dev/null
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/grants.sql" <<'SQL'
+GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON public.gmail_accounts, public.email_threads, public.email_messages TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.user_roles TO authenticated;
+SQL
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/grants.sql" >/dev/null
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- dados
+OWNER_ID='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'
+ADMIN_ID='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222'
+SUPERV_ID='33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'
+OWNER="{\"sub\":\"$OWNER_ID\",\"role\":\"authenticated\"}"
+ADMIN="{\"sub\":\"$ADMIN_ID\",\"role\":\"authenticated\"}"
+SUPERV="{\"sub\":\"$SUPERV_ID\",\"role\":\"authenticated\"}"
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" <<SQL
+INSERT INTO auth.users (id) VALUES ('$OWNER_ID'), ('$ADMIN_ID'), ('$SUPERV_ID');

+INSERT INTO public.gmail_accounts (id, user_id, email_address)

+SQL
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" >/dev/null

+# Contrato de acesso ‚Äî identico antes e depois da migration (o que NAO pode mudar).
+check_access() {
+  local tag="$1"
+  expect_value_as "$tag dono ve a thread" '1' "$OWNER" 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.email_threads;'
+  expect_value_as "$tag dono ve a mensagem" '1' "$OWNER" 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.email_messages;'
+  expect_value_as "$tag admin de outra conta NAO ve a thread" '0' "$ADMIN" 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.email_threads;'
+  expect_value_as "$tag admin de outra conta NAO ve a mensagem" '0' "$ADMIN" 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.email_messages;'
+  expect_value_as "$tag supervisor de outra conta NAO ve a thread" '0' "$SUPERV" 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.email_threads;'
+  expect_value_as "$tag admin de outra conta NAO atualiza a thread" '0' "$ADMIN" \
+    "WITH u AS (UPDATE public.email_threads SET is_starred = true RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM u;"
+  expect_value_as "$tag admin de outra conta NAO atualiza a mensagem" '0' "$ADMIN" \
+    "WITH u AS (UPDATE public.email_messages SET is_read = true RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM u;"
+  expect_value_as "$tag dono atualiza a thread" '1' "$OWNER" \
+    "WITH u AS (UPDATE public.email_threads SET is_starred = true RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM u;"
+  expect_value_as "$tag dono atualiza a mensagem" '1' "$OWNER" \
+    "WITH u AS (UPDATE public.email_messages SET is_read = true RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM u;"
+}
+
+# Quantas das 4 policies (SELECT/UPDATE x threads/messages) ainda citam is_admin_or_supervisor.
+POLICIES_COM_RAMO="SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public'
+  AND tablename IN ('email_threads','email_messages') AND cmd IN ('SELECT','UPDATE')
+  AND qual LIKE '%is_admin_or_supervisor%';"
+POLICIES_TOTAL="SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public'
+  AND tablename IN ('email_threads','email_messages') AND cmd IN ('SELECT','UPDATE');"
+
+printf '\n============ BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (migrations reais) ============\n'
+expect_value 'A.1 existem 4 policies SELECT/UPDATE nas tabelas de email' '4' "$POLICIES_TOTAL"
+expect_value 'A.2 as 4 ainda citam is_admin_or_supervisor (ramo presente)' '4' "$POLICIES_COM_RAMO"
