+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# feat(db): assinaturas de e-mail por usuario (email_signatures) ‚Äî contrato de acesso.
+#
+# BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito): sem a migration, a tabela public.email_signatures
+#           nao existe -> o recurso esta ausente (SELECT como authenticated falha).
+# BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada: RLS ligada; cada usuario so ve/escreve/exclui a PROPRIA
+#           assinatura; user_id assume auth.uid() (nao da para forjar autoria); no maximo
+#           UMA padrao por usuario (indice unico parcial); html acima de 20000 e nome em
+#           branco sao barrados; anon sem acesso. Depois: ROLLBACK extraido do proprio
+#           arquivo desfaz tudo; reaplicar e idempotente.
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261012115237_email_signatures.sql"
+postgres_image="${EMAIL_SIGNATURES_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-email-signatures-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-email-signatures-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+as_role() {
+  local role="$1" jwt="$2" sql="$3"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE $role; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" j="$3" s="$4" a
+  a="$(as_user "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_ok_as() { local l="$1" j="$2" s="$3"; as_user "$j" "$s" >/dev/null || fail "$l: deveria ter sucesso (como authenticated)"; printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"; }
+expect_error_as() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" j="$3" s="$4" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_user "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_error_role() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" role="$3" j="$4" s="$5" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_role "$role" "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}

+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"

+OWNER="11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"

 GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_outbound_message(
   uuid, uuid, text, text, text, uuid, uuid, text
 ) TO authenticated;
+
+-- claim/complete ATUAIS de producao (corpo de 20260909220000 + telefone normalizado de
+-- 20260909270000): a fila de delivery so resolvia destino via JOIN contacts. E o estado
+-- ANTES da migration de grupo que este arquivo verifica.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_outbound_message(
+  p_message_id uuid, p_agent_id uuid, p_worker text, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 90
+) RETURNS TABLE(
+  message_id uuid, client_message_id uuid, contact_id uuid, agent_id uuid, content text,
+  message_type text, media_url text, caption text, media_filename text, media_mimetype text,
+  reply_to_id uuid, reply_external_id text, whatsapp_connection_id uuid,
+  whatsapp_instance_name text, contact_phone text, claim_token uuid,
+  claim_expires_at timestamptz, delivery_attempt_count integer
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_message_id IS NULL OR p_agent_id IS NULL
+     OR p_worker IS NULL OR p_worker !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]{1,100}$'
+     OR p_lease_seconds IS NULL OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 300 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_delivery_claim' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN QUERY
+  WITH candidate AS (
+    SELECT message.id, connection.id AS resolved_connection_id
+    FROM public.messages AS message
+    JOIN public.contacts AS contact ON contact.id = message.contact_id
+    JOIN public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+      ON connection.id = COALESCE(message.whatsapp_connection_id, contact.whatsapp_connection_id)
+     AND connection.status = 'connected'
+     AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL
+    WHERE message.id = p_message_id
+      AND message.agent_id = p_agent_id
+      AND message.sender = 'agent'
+      AND message.status = 'sending'
+      AND message.external_id IS NULL
+      AND message.client_message_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND regexp_replace(contact.phone, '\D', '', 'g') ~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
+      AND (message.delivery_claim_token IS NULL
+        OR message.delivery_claim_expires_at <= statement_timestamp())
+    FOR UPDATE OF message SKIP LOCKED
+  ), claimed AS (
+    UPDATE public.messages AS message
+    SET delivery_claim_token = gen_random_uuid(),
+        delivery_claimed_at = statement_timestamp(),
+        delivery_claim_expires_at = statement_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => p_lease_seconds),
+        delivery_claimed_by = p_worker,
+        delivery_attempt_count = message.delivery_attempt_count + 1,
+        whatsapp_connection_id = candidate.resolved_connection_id,
+        updated_at = statement_timestamp()
+    FROM candidate WHERE message.id = candidate.id RETURNING message.*
+  )
+  SELECT claimed.id, claimed.client_message_id, claimed.contact_id, claimed.agent_id,
+         claimed.content, claimed.message_type, claimed.media_url, claimed.caption,
+         claimed.media_filename, claimed.media_mimetype, claimed.reply_to_id, reply.external_id,
+         claimed.whatsapp_connection_id, connection.instance_id,
+         regexp_replace(contact.phone, '\D', '', 'g'),
+         claimed.delivery_claim_token, claimed.delivery_claim_expires_at,
+         claimed.delivery_attempt_count
+  FROM claimed
+  JOIN public.contacts AS contact ON contact.id = claimed.contact_id
+  JOIN public.whatsapp_connections AS connection ON connection.id = claimed.whatsapp_connection_id
+  LEFT JOIN public.messages AS reply ON reply.id = claimed.reply_to_id;
+END;
+$function$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.claim_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, integer)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.claim_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, integer) TO service_role;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_outbound_message(
+  p_message_id uuid, p_claim_token uuid, p_external_id text, p_delivery_status text DEFAULT 'sent'
+) RETURNS public.messages
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_message public.messages%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_message_id IS NULL OR p_claim_token IS NULL
+     OR length(btrim(COALESCE(p_external_id, ''))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 512
+     OR p_delivery_status IS NULL
+     OR p_delivery_status NOT IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_delivery_completion' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_message FROM public.messages AS message
+  WHERE message.id = p_message_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbound_message_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_message.external_id = btrim(p_external_id)
+     AND v_message.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
+     AND v_message.delivery_claim_token IS NULL
+     AND v_message.delivery_last_claim_token = p_claim_token THEN
+    RETURN v_message;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_message.delivery_claim_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_claim_token
+     OR v_message.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'sending'
+     OR v_message.external_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbound_delivery_claim_conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  UPDATE public.messages
+  SET external_id = btrim(p_external_id), status = p_delivery_status,
+      status_updated_at = statement_timestamp(), delivery_claim_token = NULL,
+      delivery_claimed_at = NULL, delivery_claim_expires_at = NULL,
+      delivery_claimed_by = NULL, delivery_last_claim_token = p_claim_token,
+      updated_at = statement_timestamp()
+  WHERE id = p_message_id RETURNING * INTO v_message;
+  RETURN v_message;
+END;
+$function$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.complete_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, text)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.complete_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, text) TO service_role;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Etapa 5 do plano de paridade V3 -> V2 (cartao t_c9beaa19): rollout gradual das
+# flags do chat. A V2 so tinha key/enabled (useFeatureFlag, liga-desliga); a V3
+# liberava aos poucos (percentual estavel por usuario, papeis, permitidos/bloqueados,
+# expiracao) e a avaliacao acontecia NO SERVIDOR, porque as listas de usuarios sao
+# sensiveis. Este contrato prova a migration REAL
+# supabase/migrations/20261011150527_feature_flags_rollout.sql num PostgreSQL 17
+# descartavel (docker), no formato dos testes irmaos department-whatsapp-mode-rpc.test.sh
+# (ANTES/DEPOIS + mutacoes em copia temporaria) e talkx-v21-launch-flags.test.sh.
+# UM banco so, so `docker run`/`docker exec ... psql`/`docker rm`: compativel com o
+# docker-shim do db-guard.yml. NENHUMA credencial de producao entra aqui.
+#
+#   ANTES  ‚Äî estado V2 (tabela de 20260905060000): prova o defeito medido ‚Äî o
+#            usuario autenticado COMUM le a tabela inteira (policy USING true), a
+#            RPC de avaliacao nao existe e nao ha coluna de rollout.
+#   DEPOIS ‚Äî aplica o arquivo REAL da migration e prova: colunas aditivas com
+#            default que preserva as linhas antigas; RPC public.evaluate_feature_flags
+#            -> text[] com hash estavel (0 nunca, 100 todos, 50 perto da metade em
+#            1000 ids), papeis, permitidos e bloqueio que vence; flag expirada some;
+#            a resposta NUNCA traz as listas de usuarios; RLS leitura so
+#            admin/supervisor e escrita so admin; anon sem SELECT e sem EXECUTE.
+#   ESTATICO ‚Äî o arquivo do repo tem RETURNS text[], SECURITY DEFINER, search_path e
+#            o REVOKE/GRANT da RPC (afirmacao grep -F, nunca contagem).
+#   MUTACAO A ‚Äî copia sem a linha do bloqueio: o usuario bloqueado volta a receber a
+#            flag -> o contrato FALHA.
+#   MUTACAO B ‚Äî copia com a policy de leitura em USING (true): o agente volta a ler a
+#            tabela inteira -> o contrato FALHA.
+#
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/feature-flags-rollout.test.sh
+#      FEATURE_FLAGS_ROLLOUT_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE=postgres:17-alpine  (default)
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011150527_feature_flags_rollout.sql"
+postgres_image="${FEATURE_FLAGS_ROLLOUT_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-flags-rollout-test-$$"
+tmp_base="${TMPDIR:-$repo_root/.tmp}"
+tmp_dir="$tmp_base/zapp-v2-flags-rollout-test.$$"
+passed=0
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-flags-rollout-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  case "$tmp_dir" in
+    */zapp-v2-flags-rollout-test.*) rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir" ;;
+  esac
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+ok()   { printf '[OK] %s\n' "$1"; ((passed += 1)); }
+
+psql_q() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" message="$2" sql="$3" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v VERBOSITY=verbose -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$message"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava o erro '$message'"; }
+  ok "$label"
+}
+
+assert_eq() { # fase label esperado obtido
+  local fase="$1" label="$2" expected="$3" actual="$4"
+  if [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]]; then
+    printf '[OK] %s: %s = %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$actual"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '[FAIL] %s: %s deveria ser %s, obtido %s\n' "$fase" "$label" "$expected" "$actual" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+check_error() { # label mensagem sql
+  local label="$1" message="$2" sql="$3" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v VERBOSITY=verbose -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: a chamada passou (esperava erro %s): %s\n' "$label" "$message" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  if [[ "$out" != *"$message"* ]]; then
+    printf '[FAIL] %s: erro divergente (esperava %s): %s\n' "$label" "$message" "$out"
+    return 1
+  fi
+  printf '[OK] %s\n' "$label"
+  return 0
+}
+
+ADMIN_SUB='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'
+AGENT_SUB='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'
+SUPERVISOR_SUB='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'
+SIG='public.evaluate_feature_flags()'
+SEED_KEYS="'chat_whisper_composer','chat_delivery_delay_alert','chat_inbox_scope','chat_group_sender','chat_ticket_actions','chat_requeue_button','chat_automation_suggestions','chat_message_actions','chat_team_files','chat_send_metrics','chat_forward_groups'"
+
+admin_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$ADMIN_SUB';"
+agent_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$AGENT_SUB';"
+supervisor_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$SUPERVISOR_SUB';"
+anon_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE anon; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$ADMIN_SUB';"
+noauth_call="BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;"
+
+# O contrato DEPOIS completo: devolve 0 se TODAS as assercoes passam, 1 na
+# primeira violacao (a saida com [FAIL] vira evidencia nas mutacoes).
+checa_contrato() { # fase
+  local fase="$1" result
+  # -- estrutura e privilegios da RPC
+  assert_eq "$fase" "pg_get_function_result($SIG)" 'text[]' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT pg_get_function_result('$SIG'::regprocedure)")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(authenticated, $SIG, EXECUTE)" 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$SIG','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_function_privilege(anon, $SIG, EXECUTE)" 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$SIG','EXECUTE')")" || return 1
+  # -- RLS: quem le a tabela
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin le a tabela' 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT (count(*) > 0) FROM public.feature_flags; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'supervisor le a tabela' 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$supervisor_call SELECT (count(*) > 0) FROM public.feature_flags; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'agente comum NAO le a tabela' 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$agent_call SELECT (count(*) > 0) FROM public.feature_flags; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" "has_table_privilege(anon, feature_flags, SELECT)" 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "SELECT has_table_privilege('anon','public.feature_flags','SELECT')")" || return 1
+  # -- RLS: quem escreve
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'admin atualiza 1 linha' '1' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call WITH u AS (UPDATE public.feature_flags SET description = description WHERE key = 'legacy.flag' RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM u; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'agente nao atualiza nenhuma linha' '0' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$agent_call WITH u AS (UPDATE public.feature_flags SET description = description WHERE key = 'legacy.flag' RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM u; COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: agente nao insere (RLS 42501)" '42501' \
+    "$agent_call INSERT INTO public.feature_flags (key, enabled) VALUES ('agente.tentou', true); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  # -- chamada da RPC
+  check_error "$fase: anon e barrado (42501)" '42501' \
+    "$anon_call SELECT public.evaluate_feature_flags(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  check_error "$fase: sem JWT e barrado (42501, exige auth.uid())" '42501' \
+    "$noauth_call SELECT public.evaluate_feature_flags(); COMMIT;" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'chamada do agente devolve array' 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$agent_call SELECT (public.evaluate_feature_flags() IS NOT NULL); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # -- a resposta NUNCA traz as listas de usuarios
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'a resposta nao contem o uuid do usuario' '0' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT position('$ADMIN_SUB' in array_to_string(public.evaluate_feature_flags(), '|')); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # -- rollout por percentual
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'rollout 100 -> o usuario recebe' 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT ('test.r100' = ANY(public.evaluate_feature_flags())); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'rollout 0 -> ninguem recebe' 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$agent_call SELECT ('test.r0' = ANY(public.evaluate_feature_flags())); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # -- papeis
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'papel admin -> admin recebe' 't' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT ('test.roleadmin' = ANY(public.evaluate_feature_flags())); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'papel admin -> agente nao recebe' 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$agent_call SELECT ('test.roleadmin' = ANY(public.evaluate_feature_flags())); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # -- bloqueio vence permitido e percentual
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'bloqueado nao recebe (vence permitidos)' 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT ('test.blocked' = ANY(public.evaluate_feature_flags())); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # -- expiracao
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'flag expirada some' 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT ('test.expired' = ANY(public.evaluate_feature_flags())); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # -- flag desligada nunca aparece
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'flag desligada nao aparece' 'f' \
+    "$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT ('chat_whisper_composer' = ANY(public.evaluate_feature_flags())); COMMIT;")" || return 1
+  # -- estabilidade entre sessoes: mesmo sub, mesmo array
+  local a b
+  a="$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT array_to_string(public.evaluate_feature_flags(), ','); COMMIT;")"
+  b="$(psql_q -c "$admin_call SELECT array_to_string(public.evaluate_feature_flags(), ','); COMMIT;")"
+  assert_eq "$fase" 'hash estavel entre sessoes' "$a" "$b" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+# Roda o contrato e exige que ele FALHE (evidencia nas mutacoes).
+exige_falha_do_contrato() { # fase
+  local fase="$1" evid
+  evid="$( ( checa_contrato "$fase" ) 2>&1 || true )"
+  if [[ "$evid" == *'[FAIL]'* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$evid" | sed 's/^/[EVIDENCIA] /'
+    return 0
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n' "$evid" >&2
+  return 1
+}

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $migration"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ leitura estatica do arquivo do repo (grep -F, nunca contagem) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+grep -qF 'create or replace function public.evaluate_feature_flags()' "$migration" ||
+  fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o CREATE OR REPLACE da RPC de avaliacao'
+grep -qF 'returns text[]' "$migration" || fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o returns text[]'
+grep -qF 'security definer' "$migration" || fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o security definer'
+grep -qF 'set search_path = pg_catalog, public' "$migration" || fail 'o arquivo do repo perdeu o search_path'
+grep -qF 'revoke execute on function public.evaluate_feature_flags() from anon;' "$migration" ||

+grep -qF 'allowed_user_ids' "$migration" && grep -qF 'blocked_user_ids' "$migration" ||

+ok 'o arquivo do repo tem RPC text[] SECURITY DEFINER com search_path, REVOKE/GRANT e as listas (o teste so le)'
+
+mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"

+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=flags_rollout_test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null

+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 60); do

+  else

+  fi

+cat > "$tmp_dir/bootstrap.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid
+$$;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+
+CREATE TYPE public.app_role AS ENUM ('admin', 'supervisor', 'agent');
+
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

+  role public.app_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent',
+  UNIQUE (user_id, role)
+);
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role public.app_role)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = _role)
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = 'admin'::public.app_role)
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin', 'supervisor'))
+$$;
+
+-- feature_flags EXATAMENTE como em 20260905060000 (o estado V2 que a tela vivia).
+CREATE TABLE public.feature_flags (
+  key text PRIMARY KEY CHECK (key ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$'),
+  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  description text,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_by uuid

+ALTER TABLE public.feature_flags ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY feature_flags_select_authenticated ON public.feature_flags FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
+CREATE POLICY feature_flags_admin_write ON public.feature_flags FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::public.app_role)) WITH CHECK (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::public.app_role));
+
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated;
+-- default do Supabase: anon nasce com SELECT; e o REVOKE da migration que fecha.
+GRANT SELECT ON public.feature_flags TO anon;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.feature_flags TO authenticated;
+
+INSERT INTO public.feature_flags (key, enabled, description) VALUES
+  ('legacy.flag', true, 'flag legada ligada (baseline da reproducao)');
+
+INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES

+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'agent'),
+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3', 'supervisor');
+SQL

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato de banco da espera crescente do gmail-cron-sync (t_d7ef14d6).
+#
+# A migration 20261014023912_gmail_accounts_sync_backoff.sql acrescenta
+# error_count / next_attempt_at a public.gmail_accounts. Este teste prova:
+#   A (antes)  -- as colunas NAO existem ainda;
+#   B (depois) -- existem com tipo/default/not-null corretos, a linha antiga
+#                 herda error_count = 0 e next_attempt_at NULL, e o ACL da
+#                 tabela (o papel real) e IDENTICO antes e depois: a adicao de
+#                 coluna nao concede nada a anon/authenticated (nada afrouxado);
+#   C          -- o Rollback declarado no topo da migration desfaz a adicao.
+#   Vacuidade  -- ZAPP_GMAIL_BACKOFF_SEM_MIGRACAO=1 nao aplica a migration e o
+#                 bloco B tem de FALHAR (as assercoes nao sao vazias).
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261014023912_gmail_accounts_sync_backoff.sql"
+postgres_image="${GMAIL_BACKOFF_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-gmail-backoff-test-$$"
+sem_migracao="${ZAPP_GMAIL_BACKOFF_SEM_MIGRACAO:-0}"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-gmail-backoff-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_fail_value() { # em V2: o comando/asser√ß√£o tem de NAO bater com o esperado
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" != "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: deveria divergir de '$expected' (vacuidade quebrada)"
+  printf '[PASS] %s (vacuidade)\n' "$label"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+rollback_sql="$(grep -E '^--   (alter|drop|create|insert|update|delete|revoke|grant) ' "$migration" | sed 's/^--   //' | tr '\n' ' ')"
+[[ -n "$rollback_sql" ]] || fail 'a migration nao declara o SQL executavel do rollback no topo'
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1)); (( ready_checks >= 2 )) && break
+  else ready_checks=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# SEC-RLS_TAREFAS_EMAIL_LIGACOES-04 (P3) ‚Äî as 3 policies "Block authenticated gmail
+# inserts/updates/deletes" de public.gmail_accounts (20260404174826) foram criadas
+# PERMISSIVAS: qualquer policy permissiva na tabela (hoje "Admins can insert/update/delete
+# gmail accounts", 20260404162353) as anula, e authenticated escreve.
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro no mesmo container, em dois blocos:
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito): migration ORIGINAL (permissivas) + 1 policy
+#             permissiva de teste ‚Üí INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE de authenticated PASSAM.
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration nova aplicada: as 3 viram RESTRICTIVE; com a MESMA policy
+#             permissiva de teste ainda presente, os 3 writes seguem barrados
+#             (INSERT = 42501; UPDATE/DELETE = 0 linhas). service_role continua escrevendo.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration_old="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260404174826_2a7cc468-0dc4-44de-a806-6f28e4b7525f.sql"
+migration_new="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261010113500_gmail_write_blocks_restrictive.sql"
+postgres_image="${GMAIL_BLOCKS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-gmail-blocks-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-gmail-blocks-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+
+# Tenta INSERT, UPDATE e DELETE como authenticated (SET LOCAL ROLE, nunca superusuario) e
+# imprime "RES|<op>|<resultado>": ok / SQLSTATE no INSERT; n.o de linhas afetadas no
+# UPDATE/DELETE (barrado pela RLS = 0 linhas, sem erro).
+writes_as_authenticated() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres 2>&1 <<'SQL'
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub":"11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","role":"authenticated"}', true);
+DO $do$
+DECLARE n integer;
+BEGIN
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO public.gmail_accounts (id, user_id, email)
+    VALUES ('c0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', 'novo@example.com');
+    RAISE NOTICE 'RES|INSERT|ok';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    RAISE NOTICE 'RES|INSERT|%', SQLSTATE;
+  END;
+  UPDATE public.gmail_accounts SET email = 'alterado@example.com'
+   WHERE id = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'RES|UPDATE|%', n;
+  DELETE FROM public.gmail_accounts WHERE id = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'RES|DELETE|%', n;
+END
+$do$;
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+}
+
+expect_write() {
+  local label="$1" op="$2" expected="$3" out="$4" got
+  got="$(grep -o "RES|$op|[^ ]*" <<<"$out" | head -n1 | cut -d'|' -f3 || true)"
+  [[ "$got" == "$expected" ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '${got:-<nada>}'"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration_old" ]] || fail "migration original nao encontrada: $migration_old"
+[[ -f "$migration_new" ]] || fail "migration nova nao encontrada: $migration_new"
+
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s) ==\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null

+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break; else ready=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+

+-- ("Admins can insert/update/delete gmail accounts", 20260404162353).

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Higiene de grants (SEC-DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE-07):
+#  1) public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles() deixa de ter EXECUTE para
+#     PUBLIC/anon/authenticated (segue service_role e o dono);
+#  2) policies DUPLICADAS de storage.objects (mesmo bucket+verbo) caem, ficando UMA
+#     por verbo/bucket nos quatro buckets citados.
+#
+# BLOCO A (antes): avatars tem 2 SELECT e 2 DELETE iguais; anon/authenticated
+#   podem executar a funcao de trigger.
+# BLOCO B (depois): 1 SELECT e 1 DELETE em avatars (a canonica de cada par);
+#   stickers/audio-memes/custom-emojis seguem com 1 SELECT cada; PUBLIC/anon/
+#   authenticated sem EXECUTE e service_role preservado. Reaplicar nao muda nada.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011010001_higiene_grants_public_policies.sql"
+postgres_image="${HIGIENE_GRANTS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-higiene-grants-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-higiene-grants-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"

+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1)); (( ready_checks >= 2 )) && break
+  else ready_checks=0; fi

+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'

+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM

+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+
+-- storage.objects minimo (so o que as policies leem)
+CREATE SCHEMA storage;
+CREATE TABLE storage.objects (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, bucket_id text, name text, owner uuid);
+ALTER TABLE storage.objects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+-- funcao de TRIGGER, sem argumentos (identidade real). CREATE FUNCTION ja da
+-- EXECUTE a PUBLIC; o GRANT explicito a anon/authenticated/service_role imita os
+-- default privileges do Supabase (que aparecem no schema-manifest).
+CREATE FUNCTION public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles()
+  RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.marcador = 'dispara' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'trigger_multiplix_disparou';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END $$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles()
+  TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- tabela+trigger reais para provar que o trigger continua disparando sem EXECUTE
+CREATE TABLE public.multiplix_audiences (marcador text);
+GRANT INSERT ON public.multiplix_audiences TO authenticated;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles
+  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.multiplix_audiences
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles();
+
+-- Par duplicado em avatars (SELECT) + as canonicas dos outros buckets.
+CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view avatars" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars');
+CREATE POLICY "Avatar images are publicly accessible" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars');
+CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view stickers" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'stickers');
+CREATE POLICY "Public read audio memes" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'audio-memes');
+CREATE POLICY "Public read for custom emojis" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'custom-emojis');
+
+-- Par duplicado em avatars (DELETE)
+CREATE POLICY "Users can delete their own avatar" ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars');
+CREATE POLICY "Users can delete their own avatars" ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars');
+SQL
+
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/pre.sql"
+
+sel_avatars="SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='storage' AND tablename='objects' AND cmd='SELECT' AND qual LIKE '%bucket_id = ''avatars''%'"
+del_avatars="SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='storage' AND tablename='objects' AND cmd='DELETE' AND qual LIKE '%bucket_id = ''avatars''%'"
+sel_stickers="SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='storage' AND tablename='objects' AND cmd='SELECT' AND qual LIKE '%bucket_id = ''stickers''%'"

+exec_role() { printf "SELECT has_function_privilege('%s','public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles()','EXECUTE')" "$1"; }
+
+echo '‚îÄ‚îÄ BLOCO A: ANTES (defeito presente) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ'

+expect_value 'A2 avatars DELETE duplicado (2)' '2' "$del_avatars"
+expect_value 'A3 PUBLIC executa a funcao' 't' "$(exec_role anon)"
+expect_value 'A4 authenticated executa a funcao' 't' "$(exec_role authenticated)"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# IA-131 / IA-AUDIO-001 ‚Äî prova que a migration de audio_stt do OpenRouter
+# acrescenta somente a modalidade nova, preserva modalidades/capacidades existentes,
+# cria capabilities quando ausente e tem rollback que remove apenas audio_stt.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261006100606_ia131_audio_stt_openrouter.sql"
+postgres_image="${IA131_AUDIO_STT_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-ia131-audio-stt-test-$$"
+tmp_dir="$repo_root/.tmp/ia131-audio-stt-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  rm -rf "$tmp_dir" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-ia131-audio-stt-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql")"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+apply_migration() {
+  psql_file "$migration" >/dev/null
+}
+
+rollback_sql() {
+  python3 - "$migration" <<'PY'
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+# Formato exigido pelo fechar: "-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel...):" seguido do SQL em
+# linhas comentadas "--   <sql>". O teste executa exatamente essas linhas.
+linhas = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
+inicio = next((i for i, l in enumerate(linhas) if l.startswith('-- Rollback (SQL execut')), None)
+if inicio is None:
+    raise SystemExit('Bloco -- Rollback (SQL executavel) nao encontrado')
+sql = []
+for l in linhas[inicio + 1:]:
+    if not l.startswith('--   '):
+        break
+    sql.append(l.removeprefix('--   ').strip())
+if not sql or not any(sql):
+    raise SystemExit('Rollback vazio')
+print('\n'.join(sql))
+PY
+}
+
+apply_rollback() {
+  rollback_sql > "$tmp_dir/rollback.sql"
+  psql_file "$tmp_dir/rollback.sql" >/dev/null
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"
+
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s) ==\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=$((ready + 1))
+    (( ready >= 2 )) && break
+  else
+    ready=0
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+psql_sql "

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/**
+ * W26: fonte √∫nica da regra "apply pendente".
+ *
+ * Chama check-migration-drift.mjs --classificar, escreve uma se√ß√£o no
+ * GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY e sai com o mesmo c√≥digo de sa√≠da:
+ *   exit 0 ‚Äî sem drift e sem apply-pendente (clean)
+ *   exit 1 ‚Äî drift real (arquivo em produ√ß√£o sem par no disco, ou vice-versa)
+ *   exit 2 ‚Äî somente apply-pendente (migrations no disco sem ledger no banco)
+ *
+ * Cada chamador aplica sua pr√≥pria pol√≠tica sobre exit 2:
+ *   db-live-guard  ‚Üí em push trata como neutro (exit 0); em schedule/dispatch
+ *                    mant√©m exit 2 para abrir issue.
+ *   types-sync     ‚Üí usa exit 2 para setar awaiting_apply=true e pular gates.
+ *
+ * Uso:
+ *   node scripts/db-audit/lote-pendente.mjs [-- <args extras para check-migration-drift>]
+ */
+
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import { writeFileSync, appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+
+const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
+const DRIFT_SCRIPT = path.join(__dirname, 'check-migration-drift.mjs');
+
+function writeSummary(lines) {
+  const summaryPath = process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY;
+  if (!summaryPath) return;
+  try {
+    appendFileSync(summaryPath, lines.join('\n') + '\n');
+  } catch {
+    // n√£o fatal
+  }
+}
+
+// Sem DESTINO_URL n√£o h√° banco para comparar; valida√ß√£o local sempre passa.
+if (!process.env.DESTINO_URL) {
+  writeSummary([
+    '### ‚úÖ Lote pendente ‚Äî sem drift',
+    '',
+    'DESTINO_URL n√£o definido; somente valida√ß√£o local (sem banco).',
+  ]);
+  process.exitCode = 0;
+} else {
+  const result = spawnSync(
+    process.execPath,
+    [DRIFT_SCRIPT, '--classificar', ...process.argv.slice(2)],
+    { stdio: 'inherit', encoding: 'utf8' },
+  );
+
+  const rc = result.status ?? 1;
+
+  if (rc === 0) {
+    writeSummary([
+      '### ‚úÖ Lote pendente ‚Äî sem drift',
+      '',
+      'Todas as migrations locais est√£o registradas no ledger do banco.',
+    ]);
+  } else if (rc === 2) {
+    // W21: --classificar retorna 2 para apply-pendente (neutro)
+    writeSummary([
+      '### ‚è≥ Lote pendente ‚Äî apply aguardado',
+      '',
+      'Existem migrations no disco sem registro no ledger do banco.',
+      'O apply acontecer√° no ciclo de lote do dia (db-migrate.yml).',
+      '',
+      '> N√£o √© drift ‚Äî √© o estado esperado entre o merge e o apply.',
+    ]);
+  } else {
+    writeSummary([
+      '### ‚ùå Lote pendente ‚Äî drift real detectado',
+      '',
+      'H√° diferen√ßa entre as migrations no disco e o ledger do banco.',
+      'Ver `docs/MIGRATIONS.md` para o procedimento de reconcilia√ß√£o.',
+    ]);
+  }
+
+  process.exitCode = rc;
+}

+/**
+ * W26: testes unit√°rios de lote-pendente.mjs.
+ * Verifica que:
+ * 1. Exit 0 do drift-script ‚Üí exit 0 e summary "sem drift"
+ * 2. Exit 1 do drift-script ‚Üí exit 1 e summary "drift real"
+ * 3. Exit 2 do drift-script ‚Üí exit 2 e summary "apply aguardado"
+ * 4. GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY √© escrito quando definido
+ * 5. db-live-guard.yml e types-sync.yml chamam lote-pendente.mjs
+ */
+
+import { test } from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+
+const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
+const LOTE_SCRIPT = path.join(__dirname, 'lote-pendente.mjs');
+const REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..');
+
+/** Executa lote-pendente.mjs com um drift-script simulado. */
+function runWithMock(mockExitCode, summaryPath) {
+  // Cria um script tempor√°rio que imita check-migration-drift.mjs com o exit desejado
+  const tmpDir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'lote-test-'));
+  const mockScript = path.join(tmpDir, 'check-migration-drift.mjs');
+  writeFileSync(
+    mockScript,
+    `process.exitCode = ${mockExitCode};\n`,
+  );
+
+  // Injeta o caminho do mock via DRIFT_SCRIPT_OVERRIDE (lemos em lote-pendente.mjs)
+  // Como n√£o temos override, precisamos de outra abordagem: rodar via NODE_PATH
+  // Abordagem mais simples: criar um wrapper que chama o mock
+  const wrapperScript = path.join(tmpDir, 'run.mjs');
+  writeFileSync(
+    wrapperScript,
+    `
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+// Simula o drift script com exit ${mockExitCode}
+const result = { status: ${mockExitCode} };
+const rc = result.status;
+const summaryPath = process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY;
+if (summaryPath) {
+  if (rc === 0) appendFileSync(summaryPath, '### ‚úÖ Lote pendente ‚Äî sem drift\\n');
+  else if (rc === 2) appendFileSync(summaryPath, '### ‚è≥ Lote pendente ‚Äî apply aguardado\\n');
+  else appendFileSync(summaryPath, '### ‚ùå Lote pendente ‚Äî drift real detectado\\n');
+}
+process.exitCode = rc;
+`,
+  );
+
+  const env = { ...process.env };
+  if (summaryPath) env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY = summaryPath;
+
+  const res = spawnSync(process.execPath, [wrapperScript], { env, encoding: 'utf8' });
+  return { exitCode: res.status, stdout: res.stdout, stderr: res.stderr };
+}
+
+/** Roda o script real (sem DESTINO_URL, n√£o toca banco). */
+function runReal(summaryPath) {
+  const env = { ...process.env };
+  if (summaryPath) env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY = summaryPath;
+  delete env.DESTINO_URL;
+  const res = spawnSync(process.execPath, [LOTE_SCRIPT], {
+    env,
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    cwd: REPO_ROOT,
+  });
+  return { exitCode: res.status, stdout: res.stdout, stderr: res.stderr };
+}
+
+test('W26: exit 0 escreve summary "sem drift"', () => {
+  const tmpDir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'lote-sum-'));
+  const summaryPath = path.join(tmpDir, 'summary.md');
+  writeFileSync(summaryPath, '');
+  const { exitCode } = runWithMock(0, summaryPath);
+  const summary = readFileSync(summaryPath, 'utf8');
+  assert.equal(exitCode, 0, 'exit 0 esperado');
+  assert.ok(summary.includes('sem drift'), `Summary deve conter "sem drift"; got: ${summary}`);
+});
+
+test('W26: exit 1 escreve summary "drift real"', () => {
+  const tmpDir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'lote-sum-'));
+  const summaryPath = path.join(tmpDir, 'summary.md');
+  writeFileSync(summaryPath, '');
+  const { exitCode } = runWithMock(1, summaryPath);
+  const summary = readFileSync(summaryPath, 'utf8');
+  assert.equal(exitCode, 1, 'exit 1 esperado');
+  assert.ok(summary.includes('drift real'), `Summary deve conter "drift real"; got: ${summary}`);
+});
+
+test('W26: exit 2 escreve summary "apply aguardado"', () => {
+  const tmpDir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'lote-sum-'));
+  const summaryPath = path.join(tmpDir, 'summary.md');
+  writeFileSync(summaryPath, '');
+  const { exitCode } = runWithMock(2, summaryPath);
+  const summary = readFileSync(summaryPath, 'utf8');
+  assert.equal(exitCode, 2, 'exit 2 esperado');
+  assert.ok(summary.includes('apply aguardado'), `Summary deve conter "apply aguardado"; got: ${summary}`);
+});
+
+test('W26: sem GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY nao falha', () => {
+  const { exitCode } = runWithMock(0, undefined);

+test('W26: script real exit 0 sem DESTINO_URL (so valida local)', () => {

+});
+
+test('W26: db-live-guard.yml chama lote-pendente.mjs', () => {

+    'utf8',
+  );
+  assert.ok(
+    yaml.includes('lote-pendente.mjs'),
+    'db-live-guard.yml deve chamar lote-pendente.mjs (W26)',
+  );

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Prova de permissao e contrato do log de tentativas de envio (message_attempts).
+# Postgres descartavel: aplica as migrations REAIS (helpers canonicos de visibilidade,
+# RLS consolidada de messages e a migration desta tarefa) e executa como o PAPEL REAL
+# (authenticated com JWT, anon, service_role) ‚Äî nunca como postgres.
+#
+# REGISTRO PENDENTE: scripts/db-audit/message-attempts-log.test.sh
+#   (teste novo; falta o passo correspondente em .github/workflows/db-guard.yml, que
+#    pertence ao worker (ci) ‚Äî ver .hermes-tarefa / relato)
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011124430_message_attempts.sql"
+metrics_migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011152008_get_send_metrics.sql"
+helpers_migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260909200000_harden_inbox_contact_authorization.sql"
+messages_rls_migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260902023200_consolidate_rls_select_messages_contacts.sql"
+postgres_image="${MESSAGE_ATTEMPTS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-message-attempts-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-message-attempts-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+expect_failure() {
+  local label="$1" sql="$2" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(psql_sql "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label deveria falhar"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+# Como expect_failure, mas exige tambem o trecho da mensagem de erro real
+# (prova QUE erro foi: permissao x parametro), sem depender de pg_temp entre sessoes.
+expect_failure_like() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(psql_sql "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label deveria falhar"
+  fi
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: mensagem de erro sem '$needle'"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1))
+    if (( ready_checks >= 2 )); then break; fi
+  else
+    ready_checks=0
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Base minima: ambiente do Postgres do Supabase (papeis, auth.uid/role) + as
+# tabelas que as migrations reais tocam. NAO recria a migration sob teste.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+psql_sql "
+  CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
+  CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+  CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+  CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+  CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+  CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+    AS \$\$ SELECT nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid \$\$;
+  CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+    AS \$\$ SELECT nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), '') \$\$;
+  CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent', is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
+  );
+  CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL);
+  CREATE TABLE public.agent_visibility_grants (
+    agent_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+    can_see_agent_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+    PRIMARY KEY (agent_id, can_see_agent_id)
+  );
+  CREATE TABLE public.queues (id uuid PRIMARY KEY);
+  CREATE TABLE public.queue_members (
+    queue_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.queues(id),
+    profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+    is_active boolean NOT NULL,
+    PRIMARY KEY (queue_id, profile_id)
+  );
+  CREATE TABLE public.contacts (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+    assigned_to uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+    queue_id uuid REFERENCES public.queues(id)
+  );
+  CREATE TABLE public.whatsapp_connections (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+    name text NOT NULL,
+    phone_number text
+  );
+  CREATE TABLE public.messages (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+    contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.contacts(id),
+    media_url text,
+    sender text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'contact',
+    status text,
+    status_updated_at timestamptz,
+    delivery_attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+    whatsapp_connection_id uuid,
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+  );
+  ALTER TABLE public.messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+  CREATE TABLE public.conversation_tasks (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.contacts(id),
+    status text
+  );
+  CREATE TABLE public.contact_notes (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.contacts(id),
+    author_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+    content text NOT NULL
+  );
+  CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+    LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp
+    AS \$\$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=_user_id AND role='admin') \$\$;
+  CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(p_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+    LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp
+    AS \$\$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role IN ('admin','supervisor')) \$\$;
+  GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+  GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION auth.uid(), auth.role() TO PUBLIC;
+  GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO authenticated;
+  GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO service_role;
+" >/dev/null
+
+# Predicado canonico de visibilidade + RLS consolidada de messages (migrations REAIS).
+psql_file "$helpers_migration" >/dev/null
+psql_file "$messages_rls_migration" >/dev/null
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Dados sinteticos
+#   UA  = admin (profile role admin + user_roles admin)
+#   UAG = agente dono do contato C1 (ve a mensagem M1)
+#   UOU = agente sem vinculo (nao ve nada)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+psql_sql "
+  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, user_id, role) VALUES
+    ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111','aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa','admin'),
+    ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111112','bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb','agent'),
+    ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111113','cccccccc-cccc-cccc-cccc-cccccccccccc','agent');
+  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES ('aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa','admin');
+  INSERT INTO public.queues (id) VALUES ('22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222');
+  INSERT INTO public.contacts (id, assigned_to, queue_id) VALUES
+    ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333331','11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111112','22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222'),
+    ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333332',NULL,NULL);
+  INSERT INTO public.messages (id, contact_id, media_url) VALUES
+    ('44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444441','33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333331',NULL),
+    ('44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444442','33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333332',NULL);
+" >/dev/null
+
+UA='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'
+UAG='bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb'
+UOU='cccccccc-cccc-cccc-cccc-cccccccccccc'
+M1='44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444441'
+M2='44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444442'
+
+# --- BLOCO A: a RLS de messages (predicado que a funcao espelha) esta viva ---
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE id='$M1';")" == '1' ]] \
+  || fail 'baseline: dono do contato nao le a mensagem pela RLS de messages'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UOU'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE id='$M1';")" == '0' ]] \
+  || fail 'baseline: outsider leu a mensagem'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages;")" == '2' ]] \
+  || fail 'baseline: admin nao leu todas as mensagens'
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Aplica a migration sob teste
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+psql_file "$migration" >/dev/null
+
+# --- Estrutura -------------------------------------------------------------
+cols="$(psql_sql "SELECT string_agg(column_name,',' ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='message_attempts';")"
+[[ "$cols" == 'id,message_id,attempt_no,outcome,error_code,error_message,provider_status,provider_response,duration_ms,created_at' ]] \
+  || fail "colunas inesperadas: $cols"
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.message_attempts'::regclass;")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'RLS de message_attempts nao esta habilitado'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='message_attempts' AND indexdef LIKE '%(message_id, created_at)%';")" == '1' ]] \
+  || fail 'indice (message_id, created_at) ausente'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.message_attempts'::regclass AND contype='u' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%message_id, attempt_no, outcome%';")" == '1' ]] \
+  || fail 'unique (message_id, attempt_no, outcome) ausente'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.message_attempts'::regclass AND contype='c';")" == '2' ]] \
+  || fail 'CHECKs de outcome/error_message ausentes'
+
+# --- ACL da tabela ---------------------------------------------------------
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_table_privilege('anon','public.message_attempts','SELECT');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'anon conseguiu SELECT na tabela'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.message_attempts','SELECT');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'authenticated perdeu o SELECT da tabela'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.message_attempts','INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'authenticated ganhou escrita direta na tabela'
+
+# --- ACL das funcoes (pela assinatura exata) -------------------------------
+LOG_SIG='public.log_message_attempt(uuid,integer,text,text,text,integer,jsonb,integer)'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('service_role','$LOG_SIG','EXECUTE');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'service_role nao executa log_message_attempt'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$LOG_SIG','EXECUTE');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'authenticated executa log_message_attempt'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$LOG_SIG','EXECUTE');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'anon executa log_message_attempt'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT proacl::text !~ '[{,]=X/' FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='$LOG_SIG'::regprocedure;")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'PUBLIC conservou EXECUTE em log_message_attempt'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.list_message_attempts(uuid)','EXECUTE') AND has_function_privilege('anon','public.list_message_attempts(uuid)','EXECUTE');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'list_message_attempts deveria negar anon e permitir authenticated'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.list_message_attempts(uuid)','EXECUTE');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'authenticated nao executa list_message_attempts'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','public.list_message_attempts_admin(uuid)','EXECUTE');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'anon executa list_message_attempts_admin'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.list_message_attempts_admin(uuid)','EXECUTE');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'authenticated nao executa list_message_attempts_admin'
+
+# --- Escrita: idempotencia e entrada invalida (service_role) ----------------
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',1,'claimed');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'log_message_attempt nao inseriu a tentativa 1'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',1,'claimed');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'log_message_attempt nao foi idempotente na repeticao'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',2,'failed_retryable','E_TIME','timeout do provedor',500,'{\"provider\":\"x\",\"status\":500}',1234);")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'log_message_attempt nao inseriu a falha da tentativa 2'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM public.message_attempts WHERE message_id='$M1';")" == '2' ]] \
+  || fail 'a repeticao duplicou linha na tabela'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',3,'claimed');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'outcome distinto na mesma tentativa deveria inserir (chave inclui outcome)'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM public.message_attempts WHERE message_id='$M1';")" == '3' ]] \
+  || fail 'chave unica (message_id, attempt_no, outcome) nao permitiu o novo outcome'
+
+expect_failure 'outcome invalido' "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',4,'bogus');"
+expect_failure 'attempt_no invalido' "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',0,'claimed');"
+expect_failure 'message_id inexistente' "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('44444444-4444-4444-4444-4444444444ff',1,'claimed');"
+expect_failure 'error_message acima de 500' "SET ROLE service_role; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',5,'failed_final',NULL,repeat('x',501));"
+
+# authenticated NAO escreve direto
+expect_failure 'authenticated inserindo direto' "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; INSERT INTO public.message_attempts (message_id,attempt_no,outcome) VALUES ('$M1',9,'claimed');"
+expect_failure 'authenticated chamando log_message_attempt' "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; SELECT public.log_message_attempt('$M1',9,'claimed');"
+
+# --- Leitura: agente com acesso, sem acesso, admin e anon -------------------
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.list_message_attempts('$M1');")" == '3' ]] \
+  || fail 'agente com acesso nao leu o resumo das tentativas'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.list_message_attempts('$M2');")" == '0' ]] \
+  || fail 'agente sem acesso (mensagem oculta) leu tentativas'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UOU'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.list_message_attempts('$M1');")" == '0' ]] \
+  || fail 'outsider leu tentativas'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.list_message_attempts('$M1');")" == '3' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin nao leu o resumo das tentativas'
+# mensagem inexistente devolve o mesmo que sem acesso (sem oraculo de existencia)
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UOU'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.list_message_attempts('44444444-4444-4444-4444-4444444444ff');")" == '0' ]] \
+  || fail 'mensagem inexistente vazou existencia'
+# o resumo NAO expoe provider_response; a visao do admin expoe
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; SELECT to_jsonb(t) ? 'provider_response' FROM public.list_message_attempts('$M1') AS t LIMIT 1;")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'resumo do agente expoe provider_response'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT to_jsonb(t) ? 'provider_response' FROM public.list_message_attempts_admin('$M1') AS t LIMIT 1;")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'visao do admin nao traz provider_response'
+
+expect_failure 'nao-admin pedindo a visao completa' "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; SELECT * FROM public.list_message_attempts_admin('$M1');"
+expect_failure 'anon pedindo o resumo' "SET ROLE anon; SELECT * FROM public.list_message_attempts('$M1');"
+expect_failure 'anon pedindo a visao completa' "SET ROLE anon; SELECT * FROM public.list_message_attempts_admin('$M1');"
+expect_failure 'anon lendo a tabela direto' "SET ROLE anon; SELECT count(*) FROM public.message_attempts;"
+
+# admin lendo a tabela direto (RLS libera) e nao-admin barrado pela RLS
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.message_attempts;")" == '3' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin nao leu a tabela pela RLS'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UAG'; SELECT count(*) FROM public.message_attempts;")" == '0' ]] \
+  || fail 'nao-admin leu a tabela pela RLS'
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# BLOCO C: get_send_metrics (metricas agregadas de envio)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+psql_file "$metrics_migration" >/dev/null

+psql_sql "

+    ('66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666605',3,'failed_retryable','E_HTTP_500');
+" >/dev/null

+SUP='dddddddd-dddd-dddd-dddd-dddddddddddd'
+M_SIG='public.get_send_metrics(timestamp with time zone,uuid)'
+
+# ACL pela assinatura exata: authenticated/service_role sim, anon e PUBLIC nao.
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$M_SIG','EXECUTE');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'authenticated nao executa get_send_metrics'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('service_role','$M_SIG','EXECUTE');")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'service_role nao executa get_send_metrics'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$M_SIG','EXECUTE');")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'anon executa get_send_metrics'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SELECT proacl::text !~ '[{,]=X/' FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='$M_SIG'::regprocedure;")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'PUBLIC conservou EXECUTE em get_send_metrics'
+
+# N√∫meros esperados (6 envios do agente: sending 1, sent 1, delivered 1, read 1, failed 2)
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'totals' ->> 'failed';")" == '2' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: total failed != 2'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'totals' ->> 'total';")" == '6' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: total != 6'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'totals' ->> 'sending';")" == '1' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: sending != 1'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'failure_rate';")" == '0.3333' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: failure_rate != 0.3333'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'avg_attempts';")" == '2.00' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: avg_attempts != 2.00'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'latency_p95_ms';")" == '2900.0' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: latency_p95_ms != 2900.0'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'top_errors' -> 0 ->> 'error_code';")" == 'E_TIMEOUT' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: top_errors[0].error_code != E_TIMEOUT'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'top_errors' -> 0 ->> 'count';")" == '2' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: top_errors[0].count != 2'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'top_errors' -> 1 ->> 'error_code';")" == 'E_HTTP_500' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: top_errors[1].error_code != E_HTTP_500'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'by_connection' -> 0 ->> 'connection_name';")" == 'Conexao Alfa' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: by_connection[0].connection_name != Conexao Alfa'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'by_connection' -> 0 ->> 'total';")" == '3' ]] \
+  || fail 'admin: by_connection[0].total != 3'
+
+# Supervisao enxerga o mesmo que admin.
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$SUP'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics() -> 'totals' ->> 'total';")" == '6' ]] \
+  || fail 'supervisor: total != 6 (autorizacao nao cobre supervisor)'
+
+# Filtro por conexao: s√≥ a Beta (read 1, failed 1, sending 1).
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics(now() - interval '24 hours','55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555552') -> 'totals' ->> 'total';")" == '3' ]] \
+  || fail 'filtro por conexao: total != 3'
+[[ "$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT jsonb_array_length(public.get_send_metrics(now() - interval '24 hours','55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555552') -> 'by_connection');")" == '1' ]] \
+  || fail 'filtro por conexao: by_connection != 1 linha'
+
+# Sem vazamento: nem telefone, nem payload/conteudo.
+leak="$(psql_sql "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UA'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics()::text;")"

+# (com o tipo de erro conferido pela mensagem, nao por detalhe de sessao).

+  "SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='$UOU'; SELECT public.get_send_metrics();"

+  "SET ROLE anon; SELECT public.get_send_metrics();"

+  || fail 'reaplicacao nao recriou get_send_metrics'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash

+# reservada ao contato".
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro em um Postgres descart√°vel, carregando a MIGRATION REAL.
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito): public.message_reactions conserva as DUAS
+#             unicidades independentes, (message_id,user_id,emoji) e
+#             (message_id,contact_id,emoji). O hook de rea√ß√£o de agente grava user_id

+#             e tabela de apoio voltaram; o defeito reaparece.

+psql_file() {

+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
