+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# R2-DB-019 / item 302 do BACKLOG_VERIFICADO (P2) ‚Äî "Reacoes do WhatsApp nao vinculam a
+# autoria ao usuario que grava".
+#
+# Prova, em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel com os papeis da plataforma (authenticated /
+# service_role), que public.message_reactions passou a impor a autoria nas escritas.
+#
+# Por que container descartavel: os testes de supabase/tests/*.sql rodam como service_role
+# (BYPASSRLS) e nunca provam enforcement de RLS (a propria nota de rls_dashboard.sql diz
+# isso). Aqui `SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated` + `request.jwt.claim.sub` sao papeis REAIS sem
+# BYPASSRLS, exatamente como no PostgREST.
+#
+# O pre-estado NAO e escrito a mao: e o replay verbatim, em ordem de versao, de todo
+# statement sobre message_reactions das migrations ANTERIORES a correcao (CREATE TABLE,
+# ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, CREATE/DROP POLICY). Se a cadeia de migrations mudar, o
+# pre-estado muda com ela ‚Äî o vermelho nao pode virar decorativo.
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migrations_dir="${MR_AUTORIA_MIGRATIONS_DIR:-$repo_root/supabase/migrations}"
+correcao="$(ls "$migrations_dir"/*_message_reactions_autoria.sql 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
+postgres_image="${MR_AUTORIA_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-message-reactions-autoria-$RANDOM-$$"
+
+# Identidades sinteticas (nenhum dado real, nenhuma instancia, nenhum envio).
+U_AGENTE='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'   # auth.users.id do atendente A
+P_AGENTE='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000f1'   # profiles.id do atendente A
+U_COLEGA='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'   # auth.users.id do atendente B
+P_COLEGA='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000f2'   # profiles.id do atendente B
+C_AGENTE='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1'   # contato atribuido ao atendente A
+C_COLEGA='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2'   # contato atribuido ao atendente B
+M_AGENTE='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d1'   # mensagem do contato C_AGENTE
+M_COLEGA='20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d2'   # mensagem do contato C_COLEGA (carteira do atendente B)
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-message-reactions-autoria-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; [[ -n "${last_err:-}" ]] && printf 'ultimo erro do banco: %s\n' "$last_err" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+[[ -n "$correcao" ]] || fail 'migration da correcao (supabase/migrations/*_message_reactions_autoria.sql) nao existe'
+corte="$(basename "$correcao" | cut -d_ -f1)"
+[[ "$corte" =~ ^[0-9]{14}$ ]] || fail "versao ilegivel na migration da correcao: $corte"
+
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+conta() { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM public.message_reactions WHERE $1"; }
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ pre-estado: replay dos statements reais sobre message_reactions anteriores a correcao ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+pre_estado() {
+  python3 - "$migrations_dir" "$corte" <<'PY'
+import glob, os, re, sys
+
+mig_dir, corte = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+
+
+def statements(sql):
+    """Quebra em statements respeitando string simples e dollar-quote (DO $$ ... $$)."""
+    out, buf, i, n = [], '', 0, len(sql)
+    while i < n:
+        c = sql[i]
+        if c == "'":
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < n:
+                if sql[j] == "'":
+                    if j + 1 < n and sql[j + 1] == "'":
+                        j += 2
+                        continue
+                    break
+                j += 1
+            buf += sql[i:j + 1]; i = j + 1; continue
+        if c == '$':
+            tag = re.match(r'\$[A-Za-z_]*\$', sql[i:])
+            if tag:
+                t = tag.group(0)
+                end = sql.find(t, i + len(t))
+                end = n - len(t) if end == -1 else end
+                buf += sql[i:end + len(t)]; i = end + len(t); continue
+        if c == '-' and sql[i:i + 2] == '--':
+            j = sql.find('\n', i)
+            j = n if j == -1 else j
+            buf += sql[i:j]; i = j; continue
+        if c == ';':
+            out.append(buf); buf = ''; i += 1; continue
+        buf += c; i += 1
+    if buf.strip():
+        out.append(buf)
+    return out
+
+
+for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(mig_dir, '*.sql'))):
+    nome = os.path.basename(path)
+    if nome.split('_')[0] >= corte:
+        continue
+    for st in statements(open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read()):
+        low = st.lower()
+        # \b evita casar team_message_reactions (tabela distinta, do Team Chat)
+        if not re.search(r'\bmessage_reactions\b', low):
+            continue
+        # a publicacao de realtime nao existe no container descartavel
+        if re.search(r'\balter\s+publication\b', low):
+            continue
+        alvo = (
+            re.search(r'\b(create|drop)\s+policy\b', low)
+            or re.search(r'\bcreate\s+table\s+(public\.)?message_reactions\b', low)
+            or re.search(r'\balter\s+table\s+(public\.)?message_reactions\b', low)
+            or re.search(r'\bcreate\s+(unique\s+)?index\b.*message_reactions', low)
+            or re.search(r'\bdo\s+\$', low)
+        )
+        if alvo:
+            print(st.strip() + ';\n')
+PY
+}
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ container descartavel ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+  docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  if docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=autoria_test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=false
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=true; break; fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    [[ "$ready" == true ]] && break
+  fi
+  printf 'WARN: container falhou (%s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+done
+[[ "${ready:-false}" == true ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL 17 descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ schema minimo: papeis, auth.uid(), helpers canonicos e as tabelas que as policies tocam ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid
+$$;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;   -- caminho confiavel do provedor (webhook)
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, name text NOT NULL, role text);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL, UNIQUE (user_id, role));
+CREATE TABLE public.agent_visibility_grants (agent_id uuid, can_see_agent_id uuid);
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
+  SELECT profile.id FROM public.profiles AS profile
+   WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.user_id = _user_id LIMIT 1
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_visible_agent_ids(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS SETOF uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
+  SELECT profile.id FROM public.profiles AS profile
+   WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.user_id = _user_id
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin','supervisor'))
+$$;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, assigned_to uuid);
+CREATE TABLE public.messages (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, contact_id uuid, external_id text, sender text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());
+CREATE TABLE public.message_reactions_placeholder (id int);
+
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, auth TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION auth.uid() TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(uuid), public.get_visible_agent_ids(uuid),
+  public.is_admin_or_supervisor(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles, public.user_roles, public.contacts, public.messages TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+INSERT INTO public.profiles(id, user_id, name, role) VALUES
+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000f1', '20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'Atendente A', 'agent'),
+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000f2', '20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'Atendente B', 'agent');
+INSERT INTO public.contacts(id, assigned_to) VALUES
+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1', '20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000f1'),
+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', '20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000f2');
+INSERT INTO public.messages(id, contact_id, external_id, sender) VALUES
+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d1', '20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1', 'EXT-D1', 'contact'),
+  ('20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000d2', '20000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'EXT-D2', 'contact');
+DROP TABLE public.message_reactions_placeholder;
+SQL
+
+PRE="$(pre_estado)"
+for p in \
+  'CREATE TABLE public.message_reactions' \
+  'message_reactions_insert_policy' \
+  'Users can insert reactions for assigned contacts' \
+  'message_reactions_update_policy' \
+  'message_reactions_delete_policy' \
+  'Users can delete their own reactions'; do
+  printf '%s' "$PRE" | grep -q "$p" || fail "pre-estado incompleto (replay das migrations perdeu '$p')"
+done
+printf '%s' "$PRE" | psql_test >/dev/null || fail 'pre-estado nao aplicou no container'
+psql_test -q >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.message_reactions TO authenticated, service_role;
+SQL
+
+# Reacao do colega e reacao do CLIENTE (gravacao do provedor) ja existentes na mensagem de A.
+psql_test -q >/dev/null <<SQL
+INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES
+  ('$M_AGENTE', '$P_COLEGA', NULL, 'üòÄ'),
+  ('$M_AGENTE', NULL, '$C_AGENTE', '‚ù§Ô∏è');
+SQL
+
+tenta() { # $1 = auth uid, $2 = SQL: rc 0 = passou pela RLS
+  local rc=0 err
+  err="$(mktemp)"
+  psql_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -At >/dev/null 2>"$err" <<SQL || rc=$?
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub = '$1';
+$2
+ROLLBACK;
+SQL
+  last_err="$(tr -d '\r' <"$err" | grep -v '^NOTICE' | tr '\n' ' ')"
+  rm -f "$err"
+  printf '%s' "$rc"
+}
+
+tenta_afeta() { # $1 = auth uid, $2 = statement com CTE (DELETE/UPDATE ... RETURNING) que devolve
+  # count(*) das linhas afetadas. Imprime o numero; 'rc=N' se o statement deu erro.
+  # Necessario porque DELETE/UPDATE barrados pela RLS saem com rc 0 sem tocar linha:
+  # so o RETURNING conta quantas linhas a escrita realmente atingiu.
+  local rc=0 err out
+  err="$(mktemp)"; out="$(mktemp)"
+  psql_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -At >"$out" 2>"$err" <<SQL || rc=$?
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub = '$1';
+$2
+ROLLBACK;
+SQL
+  last_err="$(tr -d '\r' <"$err" | grep -v '^NOTICE' | tr '\n' ' ')"
+  if [[ "$rc" == 0 ]]; then
+    grep -E '^[0-9]+$' "$out" | tail -1 || true
+  else
+    printf 'rc=%s' "$rc"
+  fi
+  rm -f "$err" "$out"
+}
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ red-first: o pre-estado reproduz o defeito ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE','$P_COLEGA',NULL,'üêç');")" == 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'harness invalido: antes da correcao o INSERT com user_id de um colega deveria passar'
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE',NULL,'$C_AGENTE','üò°');")" == 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'harness invalido: antes da correcao o INSERT com user_id NULL (reacao de Cliente) deveria passar'
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE','$P_AGENTE','$C_COLEGA','üî•');")" == 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'harness invalido: antes da correcao o INSERT gravando em contato alheio deveria passar'
+# DELETE/UPDATE sob RLS saem com rc 0 mesmo sem afetar linha: o vermelho so vale se provar
+# que a escrita do pre-estado realmente atingiu a reacao alheia (RETURNING conta 1).
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "DELETE FROM public.message_reactions WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üòÄ';")" == 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'harness invalido: antes da correcao o DELETE da reacao de outro autor deveria passar'
+[[ "$(tenta_afeta "$U_AGENTE" "WITH d AS (DELETE FROM public.message_reactions WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üòÄ' RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM d;")" == 1 ]] \
+  || fail 'harness invalido: antes da correcao o DELETE da reacao do colega deveria afetar 1 linha'
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "UPDATE public.message_reactions SET emoji = 'üíÄ' WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = '‚ù§Ô∏è';")" == 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'harness invalido: antes da correcao o UPDATE da reacao de outro autor deveria passar'
+[[ "$(tenta_afeta "$U_AGENTE" "WITH u AS (UPDATE public.message_reactions SET emoji = 'üíÄ' WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = '‚ù§Ô∏è' RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM u;")" == 1 ]] \
+  || fail 'harness invalido: antes da correcao o UPDATE da reacao do Cliente deveria afetar 1 linha'
+printf '[OK] red-first: o pre-estado (replay das migrations) deixa um atendente personificar colega/Cliente e mexer na reacao alheia.\n'
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ aplica a correcao (duas vezes: prova idempotencia/replay) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+psql_test < "$correcao" >/dev/null || fail 'a correcao nao aplicou'
+psql_test < "$correcao" >/dev/null || fail 'a correcao nao e replayavel (segunda aplicacao falhou)'
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ verde: so a propria autoria passa ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+# G1 - caminho legitimo do app (src/hooks/reactions/useReactionMutations.ts): proprio perfil
+#      e o contato DA MENSAGEM.
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE','$P_AGENTE','$C_AGENTE','üëç');")" == 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'G1: a reacao legitima do proprio atendente foi barrada'
+# G1b - o mesmo caminho legitimo, agora efetivado (a escrita real persiste)
+psql_test -q >/dev/null <<SQL
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub = '$U_AGENTE';
+INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE','$P_AGENTE','$C_AGENTE','üëç');
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+[[ "$(conta "message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND user_id = '$P_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üëç'")" == 1 ]] \
+  || fail 'G1b: a reacao legitima do atendente nao persistiu'
+# G2 - personificar colega
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE','$P_COLEGA',NULL,'üòÄ');")" != 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'G2: INSERT com user_id de outro profile passou'
+# G3 - falsificar reacao de Cliente (user_id nulo em chamada de agente)
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE',NULL,'$C_AGENTE','üò°');")" != 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'G3: INSERT com user_id NULL passou'
+# G4 - autorizar por um contato e gravar em outro
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE','$P_AGENTE','$C_COLEGA','üî•');")" != 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'G4: INSERT com contact_id diferente do contato da mensagem passou'
+# G4b - contact_id NULO nao abre caminho: a reacao de agente (modelo do item 303 grava contact_id
+#       nulo) so vale na carteira do proprio atendente. Em mensagem de contato alheio continua barrado.
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_COLEGA','$P_AGENTE',NULL,'üî•');")" != 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'G4b: INSERT com contact_id nulo em mensagem de contato alheio passou'
+# G1c - reacao de agente com contact_id NULO na propria carteira passa (RETURNING conta 1 linha gravada,
+#       dentro de BEGIN/ROLLBACK): e o formato que o gatilho message_reactions_normalize_author
+#       (item 303) grava depois de zerar contact_id.
+[[ "$(tenta_afeta "$U_AGENTE" "WITH i AS (INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE','$P_AGENTE',NULL,'üôè') RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM i;")" == 1 ]] \
+  || fail 'G1c: a reacao do atendente com contact_id nulo (modelo de autoria do item 303) foi barrada'
+# G5 - DELETE da reacao alheia (colega e Cliente) nao pode mais acontecer
+psql_test -q >/dev/null <<SQL
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub = '$U_AGENTE';
+DELETE FROM public.message_reactions WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üòÄ';
+DELETE FROM public.message_reactions WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = '‚ù§Ô∏è';
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+[[ "$(conta "message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji IN ('üòÄ','‚ù§Ô∏è')")" == 2 ]] \
+  || fail 'G5: o atendente apagou reacao de outro autor'
+# G6 - UPDATE da reacao alheia nao pode mais acontecer; o proprio emoji continua editavel
+psql_test -q >/dev/null <<SQL
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub = '$U_AGENTE';
+UPDATE public.message_reactions SET emoji = 'üíÄ' WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = '‚ù§Ô∏è';
+UPDATE public.message_reactions SET emoji = 'üéâ' WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üëç';
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+[[ "$(conta "message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = '‚ù§Ô∏è'")" == 1 ]] || fail 'G6a: o atendente alterou reacao do Cliente'
+[[ "$(conta "message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üéâ'")" == 1 ]] || fail 'G6b: o atendente nao conseguiu editar a propria reacao'
+# G7 - UPDATE tentando trocar o autor (WITH CHECK)
+[[ "$(tenta "$U_AGENTE" "UPDATE public.message_reactions SET user_id = '$P_COLEGA' WHERE message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üéâ';")" != 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'G7: UPDATE trocou o user_id da propria reacao'
+# G8 - a ingestao do provedor (service_role/BYPASSRLS) segue gravando a reacao do CONTATO
+psql_test -q >/dev/null <<SQL
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE service_role;
+INSERT INTO public.message_reactions(message_id, user_id, contact_id, emoji) VALUES ('$M_AGENTE',NULL,'$C_AGENTE','üçÄ');
+COMMIT;
+SQL

+[[ "$(conta "message_id = '$M_AGENTE' AND emoji = 'üéâ' AND user_id = '$P_AGENTE'")" == 0 ]] \
+  || fail 'G10a: o atendente nao conseguiu apagar a propria reacao'
+[[ "$(conta "message_id = '$M_AGENTE'")" == $((reacoes_antes - 1)) ]] \
+  || fail 'G10b: a contagem nao caiu de 1 apos o DELETE da propria reacao'

+printf '[OK] verde: message_reactions so aceita a propria autoria; provedor (service_role) intacto.\n'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato do remetente de grupo em public.messages (sender_participant_jid,
+# sender_display_name) ‚Äî paridade V3 -> V2, decisao do Joaquim 11/10/2026.
+#
+# PostgreSQL 17 descartavel: monta a base minima do Supabase (papeis, auth.uid/role,
+# as tabelas que as migrations reais precisam), aplica as migrations REAIS do caminho de
+# leitura (helpers de visibilidade 20260909200000 e a RLS consolidada de messages
+# 20260902023200) e a migration DESTA tarefa; executa como PAPEL REAL (authenticated com
+# JWT por request.jwt.claim.sub, anon, service_role) ‚Äî nunca como postgres nas provas de
+# visibilidade.
+#
+# BLOCO A (antes): a RLS de messages ja separa dono (pode) / outsider (nao pode) / admin
+#   (ve tudo) / anon (nao pode).
+# BLOCO B (depois): as duas colunas nascem text e anulaveis; INSERT omitindo e informando
+#   funciona; a visibilidade de leitura por papel NAO muda; nenhuma policy nova; a
+#   reaplicacao e idempotente; o rollback do cabecalho derruba as colunas.
+#
+# REGISTRO PENDENTE (teste novo): falta o passo correspondente em
+#   .github/workflows/db-guard.yml (arquivo de CI) ‚Äî ver relato do cartao.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="${MESSAGE_GROUP_SENDER_MIGRATION:-$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011140613_messages_group_sender.sql}"
+helpers_migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260909200000_harden_inbox_contact_authorization.sql"
+messages_rls_migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260902023200_consolidate_rls_select_messages_contacts.sql"
+postgres_image="${MESSAGES_GROUP_SENDER_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-messages-group-sender-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-messages-group-sender-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_failure() {
+  local label="$1" sql="$2" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(psql_sql "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label deveria falhar (anon/outsider com SELECT)"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+col_prop() { # col_prop <coluna> <is_nullable|data_type>
+  psql_sql "SELECT $2 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='messages' AND column_name='$1';"
+}
+policy_count() { psql_sql "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='messages';"; }

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+[[ -f "$helpers_migration" ]] || fail "helpers nao encontrados: $helpers_migration"
+[[ -f "$messages_rls_migration" ]] || fail "RLS nao encontrada: $messages_rls_migration"

+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do

+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1))
+    if (( ready_checks >= 2 )); then break; fi
+  else
+    ready_checks=0
+  fi
+  sleep 1

+  CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE

+  CREATE TABLE public.profiles (

+  GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

+  GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO authenticated;
+  GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO service_role;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-144 ‚Äî Prova que a migration 20261010101613 revoga EXECUTE de PUBLIC, anon e
+# authenticated na fun√ß√£o de gatilho REAL
+# public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles() (criada pela migration
+# real 20261001261230, F35 ‚Äî sem stub da fun√ß√£o) e que s√≥ postgres/service_role
+# conservam EXECUTE, sem quebrar a inser√ß√£o como authenticated (fun√ß√£o trigger
+# dispensa EXECUTE no disparo).
+#
+# Bloco A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito, fun√ß√£o real p√≥s-F35): PUBLIC/anon/
+#   authenticated t√™m EXECUTE; nenhuma entrada expl√≠cita para service_role.
+# Bloco B ‚Äî migration aplicada: s√≥ postgres/service_role t√™m EXECUTE; chamada
+#   direta como anon/authenticated recebe `permission denied`; INSERT como
+#   authenticated funciona (o gatilho dispara).
+# Bloco C ‚Äî rollback extra√≠do do pr√≥prio arquivo da migration: PUBLIC volta.
+# Bloco D ‚Äî reaplica√ß√£o idempotente: s√≥ postgres/service_role.

+}

+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}

+migration_arquivo() {
+  local file="$migrations_dir/$1"
+  [[ -f "$file" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $1"
+  printf '  ¬∑ %s\n' "$1" >&2
+  psql_file "$file" >/dev/null

+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}

+as_anon() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE anon; $1"
+}
+
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+
+expect_ok_as() {
+  local l="$1" j="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(as_user "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$4" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$4', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+
+# Prova que o papel recebe `permission denied` ao chamar a fun√ß√£o diretamente
+# (SELECT ...): a checagem de EXECUTE vem antes de qualquer execu√ß√£o.
+expect_perm_denied() {
+  local l="$1" modo="$2" output status
+  set +e
+  if [[ "$modo" == anon ]]; then
+    output="$(as_anon 'SELECT public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles();' 2>&1)"
+    status=$?
+  else
+    output="$(as_user "$modo" 'SELECT public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles();' 2>&1)"
+    status=$?
+  fi
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$l: deveria ter falhado, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *permission*denied* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$l: falhou sem 'permission denied'"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}

+      printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL container failed to start (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi

+    done

+    docker logs "$container_name" >&2 || true
+  done
+  return 1

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-011 (P2 ¬∑ banco, inventario A4): dedup de policies de leitura e exclusao em
+# storage.objects para avatar, figurinha (stickers), meme (audio-memes) e emoji
+# (custom-emojis).
+#
+# A prova roda num PostgreSQL 17 descartavel, contra os ARQUIVOS REAIS do repo
+# aplicados verbatim (nada de CREATE POLICY copiado para dentro do teste):
+#   20260511233306_0e3f3b66-5585-4762-af6b-549c050f6275.sql -> a origem, que cria
+#     DOIS pares com USING identico em avatars (SELECT: "Anyone can view avatars"
+#     + "Avatar images are publicly accessible"; DELETE: singular "Users can
+#     delete their own avatar" + plural "Users can delete their own avatars") e
+#     UMA policy por verbo de leitura/exclusao em stickers, audio-memes e
+#     custom-emojis.
+#   20261011000019_n011_storage_drop_duplicate_avatar_policies.sql -> o fix, que
+#     apaga as 2 redundantes de avatars.
+#
+# O contrato prova:
+#   (a) contagem exata por bucket+verbo: avatars SELECT/DELETE = 1 (os nomes
+#       mantidos), stickers/audio-memes/custom-emojis SELECT/DELETE = 1;
+#   (b) comportamento com papel real: dono apaga o proprio avatar, outro usuario
+#       autenticado nao apaga o alheio, anonimo nao le nem apaga;
+#   (c) rollback: o bloco extraido da linha `-- Rollback:` da propria migration
+#       restaura as 2 policies, e reaplicar o fix volta a 1 (idempotencia).
+#
+# N011_WITHOUT_FIX=1 pula o fix para reproduzir o estado ANTERIOR (vermelho):
+# as contagens de avatars voltam a 2 e o teste falha.
+#
+# Inicia container proprio e roda CREATE ROLE anon/authenticated ‚Äî as roles sao
+# globais ao cluster, entao o docker-shim do E47 colidiria com as do shim: o
+# passo do workflow usa SKIP_DOCKER_SHIM=1, como os vizinhos.
+# As sessoes usam SET ROLE + request.jwt.claim.sub, como no resto da suite.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
+migrations="$repo_root/supabase/migrations"
+origin_migration="$migrations/20260511233306_0e3f3b66-5585-4762-af6b-549c050f6275.sql"
+fix_migration="$migrations/20261011000019_n011_storage_drop_duplicate_avatar_policies.sql"
+postgres_image="${N011_AVATAR_DEDUP_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-${POSTGRES_TEST_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}}"
+container_name="n011-avatar-dedup-test-$$"

+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }

+psql_q() { psql_test -Atqc "$1"; }

+run_as() {
+  local role="$1" sub="$2" sql="$3"
+  psql_test -Atqc "SET ROLE $role; SET request.jwt.claim.sub = '$sub'; $sql" 2>&1
+}

+expect_ok_as() {
+  local label="$1" role="$2" sub="$3" sql="$4" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(run_as "$role" "$sub" "$sql")"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria passar, mas falhou"; }
+  printf '%s' "$out"
+}

+expect_error_as() {
+  local label="$1" role="$2" sub="$3" needle="$4" sql="$5" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(run_as "$role" "$sub" "$sql")"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle'"; }
+  pass "$label"
+}

+# (a) Uma policy por bucket+verbo de leitura/exclusao, com os nomes mantidos.
+check_count() {
+  local label="$1" bucket="$2" cmd="$3" expected_names="$4" got
+  got="$(psql_q "SELECT coalesce(string_agg(policyname, '|' ORDER BY policyname), '') FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'storage' AND tablename = 'objects' AND cmd = '$cmd' AND qual LIKE '%$bucket%'")"
+  [[ "$got" == "$expected_names" ]] || fail "$label: esperado [$expected_names], obtido [$got]"
+  pass "$label"

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// N-011 (P2 ¬∑ banco, achado SEC-DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE-07): dedup das policies de
+// leitura e de exclusao duplicadas em storage.objects.
+//
+// Prova OFFLINE, sem docker: roda em qualquer runner (inclusive no espelho do CI do
+// E47, que FINJE o docker e nao aplica migration). Le os ARQUIVOS REAIS de
+// supabase/migrations/ na ordem de versao e simula o estado final das policies de
+// storage.objects, aplicando cada CREATE POLICY / DROP POLICY / ALTER POLICY.
+// Nada de CREATE POLICY copiado para dentro do teste.
+//
+// O que o contrato prova:
+//   (a) o par duplicado em avatars existe DE VERDADE no estado anterior: 2 SELECT e
+//       2 DELETE, cada par com papel + USING identicos ‚Äî por isso remover um dos
+//       lados nao muda o acesso efetivo (policies permissivas combinam por OR);
+//   (b) no estado final: 1 policy por bucket+verbo de leitura/exclusao em avatars,
+//       stickers, audio-memes e custom-emojis, com os nomes originais mantidos;
+//   (c) o fix so mexe em avatars: a assinatura de toda policy de outro bucket fica
+//       identica antes/depois e o total de policies cai exatamente 2;
+//   (d) o fix nao tem DDL alheia: so DROP POLICY IF EXISTS em storage.objects;
+//   (e) a linha `-- Rollback:` da propria migration recria as 2 policies com a
+//       assinatura exata do estado anterior (rollback executavel de verdade);
+//   (f) reaplicar o fix e idempotente (DROP POLICY IF EXISTS).
+//
+// Vermelho: N011_WITHOUT_FIX=1 (ou a migration do fix ausente do disco) roda contra
+// o estado ANTERIOR ‚Äî as contagens de avatars voltam a 2 e a suite falha.
+
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path';
+import { test } from 'node:test';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+
+const raiz = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..');
+const dirMig = join(raiz, 'supabase', 'migrations');
+const FIX = '20261016105108_n011_storage_drop_duplicate_avatar_policies.sql';
+const caminhoFix = join(dirMig, FIX);
+// Dois gatilhos para rodar contra a BASE (estado anterior, sem o fix): a variavel
+// N011_WITHOUT_FIX=1 e a ausencia do proprio arquivo da migration no disco ‚Äî assim
+// a prova vermelha tambem vale "worktree da base + so o teste".
+const semFix = process.env.N011_WITHOUT_FIX === '1' || !existsSync(caminhoFix);
+
+const ler = (caminho) => readFileSync(caminho, 'utf8');
+// Texto do fix: vazio quando a migration esta ausente (rodada da BASE) ‚Äî os testes
+// que dependem do arquivo entao falham, que e o resultado honesto.
+const lerFix = () => (existsSync(caminhoFix) ? ler(caminhoFix) : '');
+const normaliza = (txt) => txt.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
+
+const TAG_DOLAR = /\$([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)?\$/;
+
+// Quebra o SQL em statements, respeitando aspas, identificadores e dollar-quote.
+function divide(sql) {
+  const stmts = [];
+  let buf = '';
+  let i = 0;
+  while (i < sql.length) {
+    const c = sql[i];
+    if (sql.startsWith('--', i)) {
+      const j = sql.indexOf('\n', i);
+      i = j < 0 ? sql.length : j;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (c === "'") {
+      let j = i + 1;
+      while (j < sql.length) {
+        if (sql[j] === "'") {
+          if (sql[j + 1] === "'") { j += 2; continue; }
+          j += 1;
+          break;
+        }
+        j += 1;
+      }
+      buf += sql.slice(i, j);
+      i = j;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (c === '"') {
+      const j = sql.indexOf('"', i + 1);
+      const fim = j < 0 ? sql.length : j + 1;
+      buf += sql.slice(i, fim);
+      i = fim;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (c === '$') {
+      const m = sql.slice(i).match(new RegExp('^' + TAG_DOLAR.source));
+      if (m) {
+        const tag = m[0];
+        const j = sql.indexOf(tag, i + tag.length);
+        if (j < 0) { buf += sql.slice(i); i = sql.length; }
+        else { buf += sql.slice(i, j + tag.length); i = j + tag.length; }
+        continue;
+      }
+    }
+    if (c === ';') {
+      stmts.push(buf);
+      buf = '';
+      i += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+    buf += c;
+    i += 1;
+  }
+  if (buf.trim()) stmts.push(buf);
+  return stmts.map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
+}
+
+// Conteudo balanceado de `palavra (` ... `)` (USING / WITH CHECK).
+function clausula(texto, palavra) {
+  const re = new RegExp(palavra + '\\s*\\(', 'i');
+  const m = texto.match(re);
+  if (!m) return null;
+  const inicio = m.index + m[0].length;
+  let prof = 1;
+  for (let i = inicio; i < texto.length; i += 1) {
+    if (texto[i] === '(') prof += 1;
+    else if (texto[i] === ')') {
+      prof -= 1;
+      if (prof === 0) return normaliza(texto.slice(inicio, i));
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+const RE_CP = /^create\s+policy\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|([A-Za-z0-9_]+))\s+on\s+storage\.objects\b([\s\S]*)$/i;
+const RE_DP = /^drop\s+policy\s+(if\s+exists\s+)?(?:"([^"]+)"|([A-Za-z0-9_]+))\s+on\s+storage\.objects\s*$/i;
+const RE_AP = /^alter\s+policy\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|([A-Za-z0-9_]+))\s+on\s+storage\.objects\b([\s\S]*)$/i;
+const RE_CMD = /\bFOR\s+(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|ALL)\b/i;
+const RE_ROLES = /\bTO\s+([^()]*?)(?=\bUSING\b|\bWITH\s+CHECK\b|$)/i;
+const RE_BUCKET = /bucket_id\s*=\s*'([^']*)'/;
+
+const assinatura = (reg) => [reg.cmd.toUpperCase(), reg.roles, reg.using, reg.withCheck].join(' | ');
+
+function bucketDe(using, withCheck) {
+  for (const txt of [using, withCheck]) {
+    if (txt) {
+      const m = txt.match(RE_BUCKET);
+      if (m) return m[1];
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function parseCriacao(resto) {
+  const mCmd = resto.match(RE_CMD);
+  const mRoles = resto.match(RE_ROLES);
+  const using = clausula(resto, '\\bUSING');
+  const withCheck = clausula(resto, '\\bWITH\\s+CHECK');
+  return {
+    cmd: mCmd ? mCmd[1].toUpperCase() : 'ALL',
+    roles: mRoles ? normaliza(mRoles[1]) : 'public',
+    using,
+    withCheck,
+    bucket: bucketDe(using, withCheck),
+  };
+}
+
+// Estado final (nome -> registro) das policies de storage.objects.
+function estado(arquivos) {
+  const pol = new Map();
+  for (const caminho of arquivos) {
+    for (const st of divide(ler(caminho))) {
+      let m = st.match(RE_CP);
+      if (m) {
+        pol.set(m[1] ?? m[2], parseCriacao(m[3]));
+        continue;
+      }
+      m = st.match(RE_AP);
+      if (m) {
+        const nome = m[1] ?? m[2];
+        assert.ok(pol.has(nome), `ALTER POLICY em policy inexistente (${nome}) em ${basename(caminho)}`);
+        const reg = pol.get(nome);
+        const mRoles = m[3].match(RE_ROLES);
+        if (mRoles) reg.roles = normaliza(mRoles[1]);
+        const using = clausula(m[3], '\\bUSING');
+        const withCheck = clausula(m[3], '\\bWITH\\s+CHECK');
+        if (using !== null) reg.using = using;
+        if (withCheck !== null) reg.withCheck = withCheck;
+        reg.bucket = bucketDe(reg.using, reg.withCheck);
+        continue;
+      }
+      m = st.match(RE_DP);
+      if (m) pol.delete(m[2] ?? m[3]);
+    }
+  }
+  return pol;
+}
+
+const arquivosTodos = readdirSync(dirMig)
+  .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.sql'))
+  .sort()
+  .map((f) => join(dirMig, f));
+
+const arquivosBase = arquivosTodos.filter((a) => a !== caminhoFix);
+const antes = estado(arquivosBase);
+const depois = semFix ? estado(arquivosBase) : estado(arquivosTodos);
+
+const grupo = (tab, bucket, cmd) =>
+  [...tab.entries()].filter(([, r]) => r.bucket === bucket && r.cmd === cmd).map(([n]) => n).sort();
+
+const PARES = [
+  ['avatars', 'SELECT', 'Anyone can view avatars', 'Avatar images are publicly accessible'],
+  ['avatars', 'DELETE', 'Users can delete their own avatar', 'Users can delete their own avatars'],
+];
+const SOZINHOS = [
+  ['stickers', 'SELECT', 'Anyone can view stickers'],
+  ['stickers', 'DELETE', 'Users can delete own stickers'],
+  ['audio-memes', 'SELECT', 'Public read audio memes'],
+  ['audio-memes', 'DELETE', 'Users can delete own audio memes'],
+  ['custom-emojis', 'SELECT', 'Public read for custom emojis'],
+  ['custom-emojis', 'DELETE', 'Users can delete own custom emojis'],
+];
+
+console.log(`FATO: migrations lidas = ${arquivosBase.length}`);
+console.log(`FATO: modo = ${semFix ? 'SEM FIX (estado anterior)' : 'com o fix aplicado'}`);
+for (const [bucket, cmd, mantida, removida] of PARES) {
+  console.log(`FATO: ${bucket}/${cmd} antes=[${grupo(antes, bucket, cmd).join(', ')}]`
+    + ` depois=[${grupo(depois, bucket, cmd).join(', ')}]`);
+  console.log(`      mantida "${mantida}" x removida "${removida}":`
+    + ` roles=${antes.get(mantida)?.roles} using=${antes.get(mantida)?.using}`);
+}
+console.log(`FATO: policies de storage.objects antes=${antes.size} depois=${depois.size}`);
+
+test('o fix e a migration de maior versao (nada depois dele reescreve as policies)', () => {

+});

+for (const [bucket, cmd, mantida, removida] of PARES) {
+  test(`${bucket}/${cmd}: estado ANTERIOR tem exatamente 2 policies (o par duplicado)`, () => {

+  });
+  test(`${bucket}/${cmd}: o par tem papel+USING+WITH CHECK identicos (redundancia real)`, () => {
+    assert.deepEqual(grupo(antes, bucket, cmd), [mantida, removida].sort());
+    assert.equal(assinatura(antes.get(mantida)), assinatura(antes.get(removida)));
+  });
+  test(`${bucket}/${cmd}: estado FINAL tem exatamente 1 policy ("${mantida}")`, () => {
+    assert.deepEqual(grupo(depois, bucket, cmd), [mantida]);
+  });
+  test(`a policy mantida "${mantida}" tem a mesma assinatura antes/depois`, () => {
+    assert.deepEqual(depois.get(mantida), antes.get(mantida));
+  });

+for (const [bucket, cmd, nome] of SOZINHOS) {

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-142 (P3) ‚Äî "Banco: leitura de rea√ß√µes compara o id certo do usu√°rio"
+# (docs/audits/SEGURANCA_RLS_CONTATOS_MENSAGENS_2026-10-07.md SEC-RLS_CONTATOS_MENSAGENS-08).
+#
+# A policy message_reactions_select_policy (criada em
+# 20260830110000_extend_special_agent_visibility_to_related_tables.sql) comparava
+# `user_id = auth.uid()`, mas message_reactions.user_id guarda public.profiles.id
+# (perfil) e auth.uid() devolve auth.users.id (login): para todo usu√°rio n√£o-admin
+# a compara√ß√£o nunca casava e o autor nunca via a pr√≥pria rea√ß√£o pelo ramo user_id.
+# A migration deste cart√£o troca por `user_id = get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid())`.
+#
+# N142_PRESTATE=1 roda o roteiro SEM aplicar a migration ‚Äî √© assim que se prova o
+# vermelho (A1 falha: o autor n√£o v√™ a pr√≥pria rea√ß√£o). Sem a vari√°vel, o roteiro
+# √© o normal: verde, incluindo a execu√ß√£o do -- Rollback: extra√≠do do pr√≥prio
+# arquivo da migration e a reaplica√ß√£o (A5-A7).
+#
+# Pr√©-estado fiel ao can√¥nico: tabela message_reactions com user_id REFERENCES

+}

+as_user() {

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# R2-AUTH-027 (backlog #252): o dono de um perfil normal nao pode liberar o proprio
+# flag administrativo profiles.can_download.
+#
+# O que ja existia em producao: a policy PERMISSIVE "Users can update own profile"
+# permite o UPDATE do proprio perfil (auth.uid() = user_id), o GRANT UPDATE de
+# public.profiles para authenticated esta no manifesto, e a barreira era a policy
+# RESTRICTIVE "Block sensitive field changes by non-admins" ‚Äî que preservava role,
+# access_level, permissions e is_active, e nao citava can_download. O trigger
+# prevent_profile_privilege_escalation tambem nao cobre o campo. O consumidor
+# (useDownloadPermission -> ImagePreview) le profiles.can_download como autoridade.
+#
+# A correcao e um trigger dedicado prevent_can_download_escalation sobre public.profiles,
+# que levanta excecao quando um NAO-admin/supervisor muda can_download. Ele NAO reconstroi
+# a policy RESTRICTIVE vigente (que segue intacta) e vale para qualquer caminho de UPDATE.
+#
+# BLOCO A (ANTES): aplica as migrations REAIS que deixaram a policy restritiva
+#   vigente (20260401000858 + 20260401001655 + 20260405230710) e prova o DEFEITO:
+#   um authenticated nao-admin liga can_download no proprio perfil, a coluna vira
+#   true e o proprio dono LE true (o consumidor passaria a liberar o download).
+# BLOCO B (DEPOIS): aplica a migration REAL da correcao e prova, sob papeis reais
+#   (authenticated com claims de JWT, anon), que o mesmo UPDATE nao muda mais a coluna,
+#   que o dono segue editando campo nao sensivel (full_name), que a policy restritiva
+#   vigente segue intacta e que admin/supervisor segue liberando can_download de outro usuario.
+# BLOCO C (MUTACAO): reaplica uma COPIA temporaria da migration da correcao SEM a linha que
+#   calcula a escalada (o arquivo do repo nao e editado ‚Äî o proprio teste confere) e exige
+#   que a assercao do BLOCO B FALHE. Sem isso o BLOCO B nao estaria provando nada.
+#
+# FIXTURES DECLARADAS (nao sao o objeto sob teste): pre.sql monta a superficie minima
+# para as migrations REAIS rodarem ‚Äî roles anon/authenticated, auth.uid() pelos claims
+# de JWT, user_roles + is_admin_or_supervisor (que producao define em
+# 20251215025014_fcc5bc79-55e3-4972-8765-6a7840fdce5a.sql) e as tabelas citadas de
+# passagem por essas migrations (gmail_accounts, whatsapp_connections, password_reset_requests,
+# channel_connections, sicoob_contact_mapping, storage.objects + storage.foldername).
+# As policies sobre profiles vem dos ARQUIVOS REAIS, nunca copiadas aqui.
+#
+# Uso:
+#   [MIGRATIONS_DIR=/caminho/para/supabase/migrations] \
+#     bash scripts/db-audit/profiles-can-download-authorization.test.sh
+#   PROFILES_CAN_DOWNLOAD_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE=postgres:17-alpine (default)
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+if [[ -n "${MIGRATIONS_DIR:-}" ]]; then
+  migrations_dir="$MIGRATIONS_DIR"
+elif [[ -d "$repo_root/supabase/migrations" ]]; then
+  migrations_dir="$repo_root/supabase/migrations"
+else
+  echo '[FAIL] nao encontrei supabase/migrations (use MIGRATIONS_DIR)' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+fix_migration="$(ls "$migrations_dir"/*_profiles_can_download_trigger.sql 2>/dev/null || true)"
+[[ -n "$fix_migration" ]] || { echo '[FAIL] migration da correcao (*_profiles_can_download_trigger.sql) nao encontrada' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+# Estado ANTES: as migrations REAIS que criaram as policies de SELECT e a policy
+# restritiva de UPDATE vigentes em producao (nesta ordem).
+declare -a antes=(
+  "$migrations_dir/20260401000858_6225188d-2861-4f8e-b84b-fa68b542cbb5.sql"
+  "$migrations_dir/20260401001655_509f6c72-b9c2-458c-9dc5-af298d512958.sql"
+  "$migrations_dir/20260405230710_35b60740-aa0f-437d-9029-f5c0d8e1edf0.sql"
+)
+for m in "${antes[@]}"; do
+  [[ -f "$m" ]] || { echo "[FAIL] migration base nao encontrada: $m" >&2; exit 1; }
+done
+
+postgres_image="${PROFILES_CAN_DOWNLOAD_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-can-download-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-can-download-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+ok()   { printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$1"; }
+
+psql_sql()  { docker exec -e PGOPTIONS='-c client_min_messages=warning' "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -e PGOPTIONS='-c client_min_messages=warning' -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+assert_eq() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  ok "$label"
+}
+
+# Valor de uma coluna lida como postgres (dono da tabela: ignora RLS de proposito).
+valor() { psql_sql "$1" | tail -n1; }
+
+# Roda o ataque e guarda stdout+stderr e o codigo de saida (o RLS/trigger recusa com erro).
+TENTATIVA_OUT=""
+TENTATIVA_RC=0
+tenta() {
+  local out rc
+  set +e
+  out="$(psql_sql "$1" 2>&1)"
+  rc=$?
+  set -e
+  TENTATIVA_OUT="$out"
+  TENTATIVA_RC="$rc"
+}
+# true quando o UPDATE devolveu can_download = true (a escalada passou).
+retornou_true() { grep -qx 't' <<< "$TENTATIVA_OUT"; }
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=*** "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1)); (( ready_checks >= 2 )) && break
+  else ready_checks=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'

+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"

+# Superficie real minima para as migrations REAIS aplicarem.
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'

+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;

+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub',
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')
+     ), '')::uuid $$;

+-- user_roles + is_admin_or_supervisor: copia fiel do helper de producao
+-- (20251215025014_fcc5bc79-55e3-4972-8765-6a7840fdce5a.sql).
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL,
+  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role)
+);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
+       WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin', 'supervisor')

+CREATE TABLE public.whatsapp_connections (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, name text, phone_number text, status text, is_default boolean);

+CREATE TABLE public.password_reset_requests (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid);
+CREATE SCHEMA storage;
+CREATE TABLE storage.objects (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, name text, bucket_id text);
+CREATE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text) RETURNS text[]
+  LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$ SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') $$;
+
+-- Grants como em producao: authenticated tem UPDATE em profiles; anon so SELECT.
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.profiles TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO anon;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.user_roles TO authenticated;
+
+INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, full_name, role, access_level, permissions, is_active, can_download) VALUES
+  ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', 'Alice', 'agent', 'basic', '{}'::jsonb, true, false),
+  ('22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222', 'Carol', 'admin', 'admin', '{}'::jsonb, true, false),
+  ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333', 'Dave',  'agent', 'basic', '{}'::jsonb, true, false);
+INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role)
+  VALUES ('22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222', 'admin');
+SQL

+psql_file "$tmp_dir/pre.sql"

+ALICE_UID='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'
+CAROL_UID='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222'
+DAVE_UID='33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'

+alice_escala_sql() {

+  printf '%s\n' \

+    "UPDATE public.profiles SET can_download = true WHERE user_id = '$ALICE_UID' RETURNING can_download;"

+reset_alice() { psql_sql "UPDATE public.profiles SET can_download = false WHERE user_id = '$ALICE_UID'" >/dev/null; }

+echo '‚îÄ‚îÄ BLOCO A: ANTES (migrations reais, sem a correcao) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ'

+assert_eq 'A2 dono le o proprio perfil (pre-condicao do achado)' 'f' \

+fi

+assert_eq 'A5 can_download do dono virou true no banco' 't' \

+reset_alice

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato de distribuicao de filas (round robin / menos ocupado / habilidade),
+# limite por atendente, fixacao por contato e transbordo sem ciclo.
+#
+# Prova num Postgres 17 descartavel (docker local): recria o schema minimo que os
+# objetos reais tocam, aplica a migration REAL
+# (supabase/migrations/20261011193310_queues_distribution_overflow.sql), exercita
+# as regras como o banco faz (INSERT/UPDATE em contacts dispara os triggers) e,
+# no fim, executa o bloco de rollback extraido do proprio cabecalho da migration
+# e reaplica a migration depois do rollback (nao testa segunda aplicacao direta).
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011193310_queues_distribution_overflow.sql"
+postgres_image="${QUEUES_DIST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-queues-dist-$$"
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+
+cleanup() {
+  rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-queues-dist-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || fail "$label: deveria falhar"
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: erro nao continha '$needle'"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+run_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_file_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" file="$3" actual
+  actual="$(run_file "$file" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+expect_file_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" file="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(run_file "$file" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || fail "$label: deveria falhar"
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: erro nao continha '$needle'"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"

+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1)); (( ready_checks >= 2 )) && break
+  else
+    ready_checks=0
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'

+# ---------- schema minimo + estado "antes" reproduzido ----------
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+DO $$ BEGIN CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN; EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;
+DO $$ BEGIN CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN; EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb->>'role'
+$$;

+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.queues (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  color text,
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
+  priority integer,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.queue_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  queue_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.queues(id),
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
+  UNIQUE (queue_id, profile_id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  queue_id uuid REFERENCES public.queues(id),
+  assigned_to uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.conversation_events (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  event_type text NOT NULL,
+  from_agent_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  to_agent_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  from_queue_id uuid REFERENCES public.queues(id),
+  to_queue_id uuid REFERENCES public.queues(id),
+  metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}',
+  performed_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.agent_skills (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  skill_name text NOT NULL,
+  skill_level integer
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.queue_skill_requirements (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  queue_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.queues(id),
+  skill_name text NOT NULL,
+  min_level integer
+);
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id=_user_id AND ur.role IN ('admin','supervisor'))
+$$;
+
+-- Stub do distribuidor existente (a migration substitui o corpo pelo real) + trigger ja existente
+CREATE FUNCTION public.auto_assign_to_queue_agent() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN RETURN NEW; END; $$;
+-- Stubs com o ACL REAL (para o CREATE OR REPLACE da migration preservar, como no banco de verdade)
+CREATE FUNCTION public.skill_based_assign(p_queue_id uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN RETURN NULL; END; $$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.auto_assign_to_queue_agent() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.skill_based_assign(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.skill_based_assign(uuid) TO authenticated;
+CREATE TRIGGER on_contact_queue_auto_assign
+  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF queue_id ON public.contacts
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.auto_assign_to_queue_agent();
+
+-- Gatilho de updated_at REAL do projeto (update_contacts_updated_at) ‚Äî para provar que o
+-- transbordo toca UMA linha e nao reescreve a data de todas
+CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$;
+CREATE TRIGGER update_contacts_updated_at
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.contacts
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
+
+-- Logger real de conversation_events (copiado de 20260409100431) ‚Äî prova do registro do transbordo
+CREATE FUNCTION public.log_assignment_change() RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = 'public' AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF OLD.assigned_to IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.assigned_to THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.conversation_events (contact_id, event_type, from_agent_id, to_agent_id, performed_by, metadata)
+    VALUES (NEW.id,
+      CASE WHEN OLD.assigned_to IS NULL THEN 'assign' WHEN NEW.assigned_to IS NULL THEN 'unassign' ELSE 'transfer' END,
+      OLD.assigned_to, NEW.assigned_to, COALESCE(NEW.assigned_to, OLD.assigned_to),
+      jsonb_build_object('old_queue', OLD.queue_id, 'new_queue', NEW.queue_id));
+  END IF;
+  IF OLD.queue_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.queue_id THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.conversation_events (contact_id, event_type, from_queue_id, to_queue_id, performed_by, metadata)
+    VALUES (NEW.id, 'queue_transfer', OLD.queue_id, NEW.queue_id, NEW.assigned_to,
+            jsonb_build_object('agent', NEW.assigned_to));
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END; $$;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_assignment_change
+  AFTER UPDATE ON public.contacts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_assignment_change();

+expect_value 'permissao: authenticated NAO executa queue_pick_agent' '0' \

+expect_value 'permissao: anon NAO executa queue_overflow_rewrite' '0' \
+  "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','public.queue_overflow_rewrite()','EXECUTE')::int"
+expect_value 'permissao: authenticated NAO executa queues_prevent_overflow_cycle' '0' \
+  "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.queues_prevent_overflow_cycle()','EXECUTE')::int"
+
+# ---------- 10b) quem pode / quem nao pode / anonimo (skill_based_assign) ----------
+cat > "$tmp_dir/perm-admin.sql" <<'SQL'
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims = '{"role":"authenticated"}';
+SET LOCAL app.user_id = '10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000ad';
+SELECT (public.skill_based_assign('20000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a') IS NOT NULL)::int;
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+expect_file_value 'permissao: admin (jwt authenticated) USA skill_based_assign' '1' "$tmp_dir/perm-admin.sql"
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/perm-agent.sql" <<'SQL'
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims = '{"role":"authenticated"}';
+SET LOCAL app.user_id = '10000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';
+SELECT public.skill_based_assign('20000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a');
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+expect_file_error 'permissao: agente comum (sem perfil admin) NAO usa skill_based_assign' \
+  'requer perfil admin ou supervisor' "$tmp_dir/perm-agent.sql"
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/perm-anon.sql" <<'SQL'
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE anon;
+SELECT public.skill_based_assign('20000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a');
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+expect_file_error 'permissao: anonimo NAO usa skill_based_assign (EXECUTE negado)' \
+  'permission denied for function skill_based_assign' "$tmp_dir/perm-anon.sql"
+
+# ---------- 11) rollback de verdade + reaplicacao ----------
+awk '
+  /^-- Rollback \(SQL execut/ { f=1; next }
+  f && /^--   [^ ]/ { sub(/^--   /, ""); print; next }
+  f { exit }
+' "$migration" > "$tmp_dir/rollback.sql"
+[[ -s "$tmp_dir/rollback.sql" ]] || fail 'rollback vazio: nada foi extraido do cabecalho'
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/rollback.sql" >/dev/null || fail 'o bloco de rollback nao executou'
+expect_value 'rollback: coluna distribution removida' '0' \
+  "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='queues' AND column_name='distribution')::int"
+expect_value 'rollback: funcao queue_pick_agent removida' 'f' \
+  "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.queue_pick_agent(uuid,uuid)') IS NOT NULL"
+expect_value 'rollback: body antigo do distribuidor restaurado (sem paused)' '0' \
+  "SELECT (position('paused' in pg_get_functiondef('public.auto_assign_to_queue_agent()'::regprocedure)) > 0)::int"
+psql_file "$migration" >/dev/null || fail 'a migration nao reaplicou depois do rollback'
+expect_value 'reaplicacao apos rollback: migration volta a criar distribution' '1' \
+  "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='queues' AND column_name='distribution')::int"
+
+printf '\n[OK] contrato de distribuicao/transbordo de filas provado\n'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# R2-AUTH-006 (item 72 / P1) ‚Äî "Recuperacao anonima consulta profiles protegido e nao cria
+# solicitacao" (docs/reconciliation/reaudit/2026-10-03/reports/auth/findings.json, achado
+# R2-AUTH-006; consumidor src/pages/ForgotPassword.tsx:37-68).
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro no mesmo container, em dois blocos:
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito), fiel ao canonico:
+#             * `profiles` esconde a conta de quem nao tem sessao: o SELECT do /forgot-password
+#               devolve 0 linhas como anon -> a tela mostra sucesso generico e nem tenta o INSERT;
+#             * a policy de INSERT e TO authenticated com `user_id = auth.uid()`: o anon nao tem
+#               caminho nenhum para registrar o pedido;
+#             * o gatilho public.sanitize_reset_request() escreve em NEW.reset_token, coluna
+#               removida em 20260827170000_drop_dead_reset_token_subsystem: ate o caminho
+#               authenticated morre em `record "new" has no field "reset_token"`.
+#             Resultado: NENHUMA solicitacao e persistida (o pedido nunca chega ao admin).
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration real aplicada: identidade resolvida no servidor (auth.users) para quem
+#             nao tem sessao, conta inexistente nao grava e nao revela, o cliente nao forja
+#             status/revisao/token nem atribui o pedido a outra conta, e o revisor (service_role)
+#             ve a solicitacao pendente. Caminho authenticated ainda usa o rate limit com erro; no caminho anonimo o mesmo limite e silencioso.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="${RECUPERACAO_ANONIMA_MIGRATION:-$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261015182400_recuperacao_anonima_pedido_reset.sql}"
+postgres_image="${RECUPERACAO_ANONIMA_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-recuperacao-anonima-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-recuperacao-anonima-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+as_role() {  # as_role <papel> <jwt|-> <sql>
+  local role="$1" jwt="$2" sql="$3" claims
+  if [[ "$jwt" == "-" ]]; then claims=""; else claims="SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false);"; fi
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE $role; $claims $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" r="$3" j="$4" s="$5" a
+  a="$(as_role "$r" "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_error_as() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" r="$3" j="$4" s="$5" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_role "$r" "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_same_success_as() {
+  local l="$1" r="$2" j="$3" left_sql="$4" right_sql="$5" left_out right_out left_st right_st
+  set +e; left_out="$(as_role "$r" "$j" "$left_sql" 2>&1)"; left_st=$?; set -e
+  (( left_st == 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$left_out" >&2; fail "$l: caso de referencia deveria passar"; }
+  set +e; right_out="$(as_role "$r" "$j" "$right_sql" 2>&1)"; right_st=$?; set -e
+  (( right_st == 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$right_out" >&2; fail "$l: caso limitado deveria passar em silencio como a referencia"; }
+  [[ "$right_out" == "$left_out" ]] || {
+    printf 'referencia:\n%s\nlimitado:\n%s\n' "$left_out" "$right_out" >&2
+    fail "$l: resposta publica diferente"
+  }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s) ==\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break; else ready=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Estado ANTERIOR canonico: papeis da API, auth.users/auth.uid(), profiles com as policies TO
+# authenticated, password_reset_requests com a policy de INSERT TO authenticated, os DOIS
+# gatilhos reais e os grants reais (anon ja tem INSERT de TABELA ‚Äî o que falta e a policy).
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+     )::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE TABLE auth.users (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  email text
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  email text,
+  role text DEFAULT 'agent',
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true
+);
+ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY "Users can view own profile" ON public.profiles FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (user_id = auth.uid());
+
+CREATE TABLE public.password_reset_requests (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  email text NOT NULL,
+  reason text,
+  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
+  reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id),
+  reviewed_at timestamptz,
+  rejection_reason text,
+  token_expires_at timestamptz,
+  ip_address text,
+  user_agent text,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT password_reset_requests_status_check CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected'))
+);
+ALTER TABLE public.password_reset_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY "Admins can view reset requests" ON public.password_reset_requests FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (false);  -- no teste so existe o ramo admin canonico; o foco e o caminho anonimo
+CREATE POLICY "Users can request own password reset" ON public.password_reset_requests FOR INSERT TO authenticated
+  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());
+
+-- Gatilhos REAIS, com o corpo vigente (a referencia a reset_token E o defeito)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sanitize_reset_request()
+ RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
+    NEW.reset_token := NULL;
+    NEW.token_expires_at := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_by := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_at := NULL;
+    NEW.rejection_reason := NULL;
+    NEW.status := 'pending';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE TRIGGER sanitize_reset_request_trigger BEFORE INSERT ON public.password_reset_requests
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.sanitize_reset_request();
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rate_limit_reset_requests()
+ RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_pending_count integer;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_pending_count
+  FROM public.password_reset_requests
+  WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id
+    AND status = 'pending'
+    AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
+
+  IF v_pending_count >= 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many pending reset requests. Please wait before trying again.';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_rate_limit_reset BEFORE INSERT ON public.password_reset_requests
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.rate_limit_reset_requests();
+
+-- Grants REAIS da tabela (anon ja tem INSERT de tabela na producao)
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.password_reset_requests TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.password_reset_requests TO anon;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.password_reset_requests TO service_role;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO anon;
+SQL
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" <<'SQL'
+DELETE FROM public.password_reset_requests;
+DELETE FROM public.profiles;
+DELETE FROM auth.users;
+
+-- U_EXISTE: conta real. O profiles dela tem email NULO (o caso que o cliente lia e nao achava).
+-- U_CASE: conta real com email em caixa mista no auth.users.
+-- U_OUTRO: conta real, usada para provar que o cliente nao atribui o pedido a outra conta.
+INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+  ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', 'ti.existente@example.com'),
+  ('22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222', 'Outro.Usuario@Example.COM'),
+  ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333', 'terceiro@example.com');
+
+INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, user_id, email) VALUES
+  ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', NULL),
+  ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222', 'divergente@example.com'),
+  ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333', 'terceiro@example.com');
+SQL
+
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" >/dev/null
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" >/dev/null
+
+U_EXISTE='{"sub":"11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","role":"authenticated"}'
+U_CASE='{"sub":"22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222","role":"authenticated"}'
+ANON='{"role":"anon"}'
+
+printf '\n============ BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito) ============\n'
+
+expect_value_as 'A.1 (DEFEITO) sem sessao a conta fica invisivel: o SELECT do /forgot-password devolve 0 linhas' \
+  '0' anon "$ANON" "SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE email = 'ti.existente@example.com';"
+expect_error_as 'A.2 (DEFEITO) anon nao tem policy de INSERT: o pedido e recusado pela RLS' \

+expect_error_as 'A.3 (DEFEITO) nem logado grava: o gatilho cita a coluna morta reset_token' \
+  'has no field "reset_token"' authenticated "$U_EXISTE" \
+  "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (user_id, email) VALUES ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111','ti.existente@example.com');"
+expect_value 'A.4 (DEFEITO) nenhuma solicitacao foi persistida ‚Äî o admin nunca recebe o pedido' '0' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests;"
+
+expect_ok_as() {  # expect_ok_as <rotulo> <papel> <jwt> <sql>  (sql NAO pode ter RETURNING: o anon nao tem policy de SELECT)
+  local l="$1" r="$2" j="$3" s="$4"
+  as_role "$r" "$j" "$s" >/dev/null || fail "$l: deveria ter sucesso ($r)"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}

+printf '\n============ BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada ============\n'
+psql_file "$migration" >/dev/null
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" >/dev/null

+# B.1/B.2 caminho feliz do anon: so email/reason/user_agent (sem user_id e sem RETURNING ‚Äî o
+# PostgREST do supabase-js .insert() sem .select() manda return=minimal, ou seja, sem RETURNING)
+expect_ok_as 'B.1 anon registra o pedido enviando so o email (user_id resolvido no servidor)' \
+  anon "$ANON" \
+  "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (email, reason, user_agent) VALUES ('ti.existente@example.com','esqueci','probe');"
+expect_value 'B.2 o pedido nasceu pendente, sem revisao, com o email canonico ‚Äî e o profiles.email dessa conta e NULL' \
+  '1|pending|ti.existente@example.com|0|1' \
+  "SELECT count(*)::text||'|'||coalesce(min(status),'-')||'|'||coalesce(min(email),'-')||'|'||(coalesce(bool_or(reviewed_by IS NOT NULL),false))::int||'|'||(coalesce(bool_or(reason IS NOT NULL),false))::int FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE user_id='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111';"
+
+# B.3/B.4 conta inexistente: mesma resposta publica, nada gravado (nao enumera emails)
+expect_ok_as 'B.3 anon pedindo por conta inexistente nao recebe erro (nao enumera emails)' \
+  anon "$ANON" "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (email) VALUES ('ninguem@example.com');"
+expect_value 'B.4 ...e nada foi gravado para o email inexistente' '0' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE email='ninguem@example.com';"
+
+# B.5/B.6 o cliente nao forja status/revisao/token nem atribui o pedido a outra conta
+expect_ok_as 'B.5 anon tenta forjar status/revisao/token e apontar o pedido para outra conta' \
+  anon "$ANON" \
+  "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (user_id, email, status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, rejection_reason, token_expires_at) VALUES ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333','Outro.Usuario@Example.COM','approved','33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333', now(), 'aprovado por mim', now());"
+expect_value 'B.6 ...e a linha nasceu pendente e limpa (o gatilho e a fronteira)' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE user_id='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222' AND status='pending' AND reviewed_by IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL AND rejection_reason IS NULL AND token_expires_at IS NULL;"
+expect_value 'B.7 ...e o user_id informado pelo cliente foi ignorado (vale o dono do email)' '0' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE user_id='33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333';"
+
+# B.8/B.9 a fronteira nao vira leitura: nem anon nem logado comum veem a fila
+expect_value_as 'B.8 anon nao le a fila de solicitacoes (0 linhas)' '0' anon "$ANON" \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests;"
+expect_value_as 'B.9 usuario logado comum (nao admin) tambem nao le a fila' '0' authenticated "$U_EXISTE" \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests;"
+
+# B.10 normalizacao: caixa diferente e espacos casam com a conta e gravam o email do auth.users
+expect_ok_as 'B.10 email com caixa diferente e espacos casa com a conta (auth.users)' \
+  anon "$ANON" \
+  "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (email, reason) VALUES ('  outro.usuario@EXAMPLE.com  ','caixa');"
+expect_value 'B.11 ...e o email gravado e o canonico do auth.users' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE user_id='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222' AND email='Outro.Usuario@Example.COM' AND reason='caixa';"
+
+# B.12/B.13 rate limit anonimo: 3 pendentes por hora; o 4o nao enumera, nao erra e nao grava.
+expect_ok_as 'B.12 terceiro pedido pendente do mesmo usuario ainda passa' \
+  anon "$ANON" "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (email) VALUES ('outro.usuario@example.com');"
+expect_same_success_as 'B.13 quarto pedido anonimo limitado tem a mesma resposta publica de email inexistente' \
+  anon "$ANON" \
+  "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (email) VALUES ('ninguem-rate-limit@example.com');" \
+  "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (email) VALUES ('outro.usuario@example.com');"
+expect_value 'B.13b o quarto pedido anonimo limitado nao grava linha' '3' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE user_id='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222' AND status='pending';"
+expect_value 'B.13c a referencia inexistente tambem nao grava linha' '0' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE email='ninguem-rate-limit@example.com';"
+
+# B.14 caminho authenticated segue funcionando (dono do proprio pedido)
+expect_ok_as 'B.14 logado ainda registra o proprio pedido (user_id = auth.uid())' \
+  authenticated "$U_EXISTE" \
+  "INSERT INTO public.password_reset_requests (user_id, email, reason) VALUES ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111','ti.existente@example.com','logado');"
+expect_value 'B.15 o pedido do logado foi gravado como pendente e do proprio usuario' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.password_reset_requests WHERE user_id='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111' AND reason='logado' AND status='pending';"
+
+# B.16/B.17 anon nao apaga nem altera pedido
