+REMOVED_AT_1=$(run "$AS_ADMIN SELECT removed_at::text FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW1';")
+GOT_R1=$(run "$AS_ADMIN SELECT removed_by::text || '|' || blocked_by::text FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW1';")
+[ "$GOT_R1" = "$ADMIN_PROFILE|$ADMIN_PROFILE" ] || fail "Ponto 1 (remocao): removed_by/blocked_by forjados nao foram grampeados para A (got=$GOT_R1)"
+ok "remocao com removed_by forjado e grampeada para o perfil de quem removeu"
+
+# 4b. admin B edita removal_reason da linha removida e tenta trocar a trilha:
+#     removed_by/removed_at/blocked_by de A devem ficar intactos.
+run "$AS_ADMIN2 UPDATE public.talkx_blacklist SET removal_reason = 'pedido atualizado pelo B', removed_by = '$OTHER_PROFILE', removed_at = now(), blocked_by = '$OTHER_PROFILE' WHERE id = '$ROW1';"
+GOT_TRILHA_B=$(run "$AS_ADMIN2 SELECT removed_by::text || '|' || blocked_by::text || '|' || removed_at::text || '|' || removal_reason FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW1';")
+WANT_TRILHA_B="$ADMIN_PROFILE|$ADMIN_PROFILE|$REMOVED_AT_1|pedido atualizado pelo B"
+[ "$GOT_TRILHA_B" = "$WANT_TRILHA_B" ] || fail "Ponto 1 (trilha): edicao de B trocou removed_by/removed_at/blocked_by (got=$GOT_TRILHA_B want=$WANT_TRILHA_B)"
+ok "edicao de linha removida por outro admin preserva removed_by/removed_at/blocked_by de A"
+
+# 4c. (Ponto 2 da recusa) linha ATIVA: admin B tenta reescrever blocked_by de A.
+ROW6=$(run "$AS_ADMIN INSERT INTO public.talkx_blacklist (contact_id, blocked_by, origin) VALUES ('$C6', '$OTHER_PROFILE', 'manual') RETURNING id;")
+run "$AS_ADMIN2 UPDATE public.talkx_blacklist SET blocked_by = '$OTHER_PROFILE', removal_reason = 'x' WHERE id = '$ROW6';"
+GOT_B6=$(run "$AS_ADMIN2 SELECT blocked_by::text FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW6';")
+[ "$GOT_B6" = "$ADMIN_PROFILE" ] || fail "Ponto 2 (blocked_by): UPDATE de B reescreveu blocked_by (got=$GOT_B6 want=$ADMIN_PROFILE)"
+ok "UPDATE autenticado nao reescreve blocked_by"
+
+# 5. Colunas novas gravam e leem (trilha de lote + motivo do desbloqueio).
+BATCH="99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
+run "$AS_ADMIN INSERT INTO public.talkx_blacklist (contact_id, reason, phone, import_batch_id, removal_reason) VALUES ('$C3', 'lote', '5511970000003', '$BATCH', 'pedido do cliente');"
+GOT_TRILHA=$(run "$AS_ADMIN SELECT import_batch_id::text || '|' || removal_reason FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE contact_id = '$C3';")
+[[ "$GOT_TRILHA" == "$BATCH|pedido do cliente" ]] || fail "trilha nao persistiu: $GOT_TRILHA"
+ok "colunas import_batch_id/removal_reason gravam e leem"
+
+# 6. Entradas invalidas: phone lixo vira NULL; origin sem enum mantem NULL.
+run "$AS_ADMIN INSERT INTO public.talkx_blacklist (contact_id, reason, phone, origin) VALUES ('$C4', 'x', 'abc', 'optout');"
+GOT_INV=$(run "$AS_ADMIN SELECT phone IS NULL AND reason_code IS NULL FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE contact_id = '$C4';")
+[[ "$GOT_INV" == "t" ]] || fail "phone invalido/origin sem enum nao resultou em NULLs"
+ok "phone invalido vira NULL e origin sem enum mantem reason_code NULL"
+
+# 7. DELETE como admin (a policy PERMITIRIA) e recusado pela trigger.
+DEL_OUT=$("${PSQL_NO_STOP[@]}" -c "$AS_ADMIN DELETE FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW1';" 2>&1 || true)
+echo "$DEL_OUT" | grep -q "talkx_blacklist_delete_bloqueado" \
+  || fail "DELETE como admin nao foi barrado pela trigger: $DEL_OUT"
+STILL=$(run "$AS_ADMIN SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW1';")
+[[ "$STILL" == "1" ]] || fail "linha sumiu apos DELETE barrado"
+ok "DELETE como authenticated admin recusado pela trigger (linha preservada)"
+
+# 8. DELETE como service_role (fora do RLS) e recusado pela trigger.
+DEL_OUT2=$("${PSQL_NO_STOP[@]}" -c "$AS_SERVICE DELETE FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW2';" 2>&1 || true)
+echo "$DEL_OUT2" | grep -q "talkx_blacklist_delete_bloqueado" \
+  || fail "DELETE como service_role nao foi barrado pela trigger: $DEL_OUT2"
+STILL2=$(run "$AS_SERVICE SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_blacklist WHERE id = '$ROW2';")
+[[ "$STILL2" == "1" ]] || fail "linha sumiu apos DELETE service_role barrado"
+ok "DELETE como service_role recusado pela trigger (barreira alem do RLS)"
+
+# 9. REVOKE: funcoes novas sem EXECUTE para PUBLIC/anon/authenticated
+#    (exclui a linha do dono postgres, que e implicita; zero linhas de
+#    outros grantees = ninguem mais executa ‚Äî PUBLIC incluso).
+for fn in talkx_blacklist_audit_trigger talkx_blacklist_no_delete; do
+  PRIVS=$(run "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.routine_privileges WHERE routine_schema = 'public' AND routine_name = '$fn' AND grantee <> 'postgres';")
+  [[ "$PRIVS" == "0" ]] || fail "REVOKE incompleto em $fn: $PRIVS privilegios restantes"
+  for r in authenticated anon; do
+    CAN=$(run "SELECT has_function_privilege('$r', 'public.$fn()', 'EXECUTE');")
+    [[ "$CAN" == "f" ]] || fail "$r ainda executa $fn"
+  done
+done
+ok "REVOKE ALL nas funcoes novas (PUBLIC/anon/authenticated sem EXECUTE)"
+
+# 10. Rollback da linha 2 da migration executa e restaura; reaplicar volta.
+ROLLBACK_SQL=$(sed -n 's/^-- Rollback: //p' "$F_NEW")
+[[ -n "$ROLLBACK_SQL" ]] || fail "linha -- Rollback: vazia ou ausente em $(basename "$F_NEW")"
+run "RESET ROLE; $ROLLBACK_SQL"
+for col in import_batch_id removal_reason; do
+  COL_OUT=$("${PSQL_NO_STOP[@]}" -c "SELECT $col FROM public.talkx_blacklist LIMIT 1;" 2>&1 || true)
+  echo "$COL_OUT" | grep -qi "does not exist\|nao existe" \
+    || fail "rollback nao removeu a coluna $col: $COL_OUT"
+done
+LEFT_TRG=$(run "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('trg_talkx_blacklist_audit','trg_talkx_blacklist_no_delete');")
+[[ "$LEFT_TRG" == "0" ]] || fail "rollback deixou triggers: $LEFT_TRG"
+LEFT_FN=$(run "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('talkx_blacklist_audit_trigger','talkx_blacklist_no_delete');")
+[[ "$LEFT_FN" == "0" ]] || fail "rollback deixou funcoes: $LEFT_FN"
+LEFT_POL=$(run "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy WHERE polname = 'talkx_blacklist_no_delete';")
+[[ "$LEFT_POL" == "0" ]] || fail "rollback deixou a policy: $LEFT_POL"
+ok "rollback executou e removeu colunas, triggers, funcoes e policy"
+apply "$F_NEW"
+run "$AS_ADMIN INSERT INTO public.talkx_blacklist (contact_id, reason, phone) VALUES ('$C5', 'pos-rollback', '5511960000005') RETURNING id;" >/dev/null
+ok "reaplicacao pos-rollback funciona"
+
+echo "[OK] talkx-blacklist-audit-trigger: trilha guarda, forja clamped, DELETE barrado"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# talkx-blacklist-realtime (X069p1 ¬∑ banco): escopo MINIMO de colunas da publicacao
+# Realtime da lista de supressao.
+#
+# ESCOPO DESTA ENTREGA ‚Äî leia antes de interpretar um verde:
+#   Este harness prova SOMENTE que a migration
+#   supabase/migrations/20261011000013_talkx_blacklist_realtime_column_scope.sql
+#   publica public.talkx_blacklist na publicacao supabase_realtime com a LISTA MINIMA
+#   de colunas (id, contact_id) ‚Äî so o que a tela usa para reagir quando um telefone
+#   entra ou sai da lista. NADA alem disso trafega no evento: nem `phone` (o telefone
+#   do contato nao pode ir no payload do Realtime ‚Äî a policy de SELECT e USING (true)
+#   para authenticated), nem os metadados que a tela nao consome (reason, blocked_by,
+#   created_at, removed_by, removed_at, origin, campaign_id, reason_code, expires_at,
+#   source_message_id).
+#
+#   Fechado por padrao: se uma DDL futura adicionar coluna que a tela passe a precisar,
+#   uma NOVA migration (revisada) estende a lista ‚Äî coluna nova nunca entra sozinha.
+#   O `add table (...)` falha alto se um nome da lista deixar de existir (deriva de
+#   DDL vira erro, nao silencio).
+#
+#   NAO se testa aqui o COMPORTAMENTO da assinatura no navegador (worker de telas/hooks),
+#   nem se a RPC de supressao grava a linha ‚Äî isso e de outros cartoes. Tambem NAO se
+#   prova entrega de payload pelo servico Realtime (nao se sobe o container supabase):
+#   prova-se a ESTRUTURA que o servico le, `pg_publication_tables.attnames`.
+#
+# Contrato em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel, no mesmo formato dos testes irmaos
+# (scripts/db-audit/talkx-campaign-segments.test.sh): sobe um container com
+# wal_level=logical, cria um schema minimo com os objetos que a migration toca, aplica a
+# migration REAL e prova cada caso abaixo.
+#
+# VERMELHO: rode com TALKX_BLACKLIST_REALTIME_TEST_MIGRATION apontando para a migration
+# de 12 colunas (.tmp/old-migration-12cols.sql, a entrega recusada) e o harness FALHA no
+# caso `scope_minimal` ‚Äî e a prova de que o aceite (lista minima) depende desta migration.
+# Rode apontando para um arquivo vazio e FALHA em `published_with_scope`.
+#
+# AUSENCIA DE MEDICAO CONTA COMO FALHA: cada caso registra sua execucao em CASES_SEEN e
+# o harness FALHA no fim se algum caso esperado nao tiver rodado.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="${TALKX_BLACKLIST_REALTIME_TEST_MIGRATION:-$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011000013_talkx_blacklist_realtime_column_scope.sql}"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_BLACKLIST_REALTIME_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="talkx-blacklist-realtime-test-$$"
+test_password="talkx_blacklist_realtime_test_only"

+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$1"; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_q() { psql_test -Atqc "$1"; }

+# --- registro dos casos (ausencia de medicao = falha) -----------------------
+declare -A CASES_SEEN=()
+declare -a CASES_EXPECTED=(
+  pre_state_absent published_with_scope scope_excludes_phone scope_minimal replay_idempotent rollback_removes
+)
+case_done() { CASES_SEEN["$1"]=1; }
+
+start_postgres() {
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    # wal_level=logical: `alter publication ... add table (colunas)` so tem semantica real
+    # de Realtime com wal_level adequado; caso contrario o servidor emite apenas WARNING.
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" \
+         "$postgres_image" postgres -c wal_level=logical >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: container PostgreSQL nao subiu (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL descartavel nao estabilizou (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+  done
+  return 1
+}

+psql_test < "$migration" >/dev/null || fail '(5) reaplicacao da migration falhou'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
+postgres_image="${TALKX_LAUNCH_CHECKS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="talkx-launch-checks-test-$$"
+test_password="talkx_launch_checks_test_only"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261010042500_talkx_campaign_launch_checks.sql"
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+started=0
+for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+  docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null || continue
+  for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
+    if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      sleep 1
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        started=1
+        break 2
+      fi
+    fi
+    sleep 1
+  done
+done
+[[ "$started" == 1 ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL de teste n√£o iniciou'
+
+# Esquema m√≠nimo que a fun√ß√£o l√™; a migration sob teste √© a real.
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), current_user) $$;
+CREATE ROLE anon;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated;
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin','supervisor')) $$;
+CREATE TABLE public.whatsapp_connections (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, status text NOT NULL, instance_id text);
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_templates (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, status text NOT NULL);
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_settings (key text PRIMARY KEY, value jsonb NOT NULL);
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_campaigns (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, message_template text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', media_url text,
+  whatsapp_connection_id uuid, template_id uuid, owner uuid, created_by uuid,
+  scheduled_at timestamptz, schedule_timezone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo',
+  send_window_start time, send_window_end time, business_hours_only boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false);
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_recipients (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), campaign_id uuid NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending');
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, auth TO authenticated, anon;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Harness descartavel (Docker postgres:17-alpine) ‚Äî item 122 / R3-DELTA-003.
+#
+# Defeito: o cursor de log do Talk X por timestamp perde linhas empatadas.
+# public.talkx_campaign_logs lia `created_at > p_after` com `ORDER BY created_at, id`.
+# O log e gravado em lote (varias linhas no mesmo created_at), entao a pagina seguinte
+# descartava a cauda empatada com o cursor: linhas sumiam sem erro.
+#
+# Prova:
+#   RED (com a migration REAL de X033, 20261003242707, e nada mais):
+#     - 5 linhas, sendo 3 no MESMO created_at; paginando de 2 em 2 pelo cursor de
+#       timestamp, a caminhada devolve 4 das 5 ‚Äî a 3a linha empatada nunca aparece.
+#   GREEN (depois da migration nova do item 122):
+#     1. cursor COMPOSTO (created_at, id): a caminhada devolve as 5 linhas, sem perder
+#        e sem repetir;
+#     2. cursor incompleto (p_after sem p_after_id) ERRA com talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto
+#        em vez de devolver menos linhas (o defeito nao volta em silencio);
+#     3. a chamada de 1a pagina ja documentada (campanha, NULL, limite) continua funcionando;
+#     4. a assinatura antiga (uuid,timestamptz,integer) foi removida: nao sobra overload
+#        aberto que ainda perderia linhas;
+#     5. ACL mantido: sem PUBLIC/anon, admin e service_role executam; agente nao-admin e barrado;
+#     6. idempotencia: reaplicar a migration nao quebra;
+#     7. o Rollback do cabecalho (bloco 'Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem)') RODA e devolve a
+#        assinatura antiga.
+#
+# As migrations sao encontradas por marcador interno (sobrevivem ao rename do
+# hermes-db-migrar --nova): base = 'talkx_x033_objetos_ausentes'; nova = 'talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto'.
+# N√ÉO entra no CI direto (workflows s√£o do dono do workflow): registrada na
+# ALLOWLIST de scripts/ci/check-test-inventory.mjs. Roda via Docker local.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+
+base_migration="$(grep -rlF 'talkx_x033_objetos_ausentes' "$repo_root/supabase/migrations" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/_superseded/' | sort | tail -1 || true)"
+[[ -n "$base_migration" && -f "$base_migration" ]] || { printf '[FALHA] migration base X033 nao encontrada (marcador talkx_x033_objetos_ausentes)\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+fix_migration="$(grep -rlF 'talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto' "$repo_root/supabase/migrations" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/_superseded/' | sort | tail -1 || true)"
+[[ -n "$fix_migration" && -f "$fix_migration" ]] || { printf '[FALHA] migration do item 122 nao encontrada (marcador talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto)\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+fail() { printf '[FALHA] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$1"; }
+
+cid="talkx-logs-cursor-$RANDOM$RANDOM"
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$cid" =~ ^talkx-logs-cursor-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+psql_exec() { docker exec -i "$cid" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_val()  { docker exec "$cid" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1" 2>&1; }
+psql_raw()  { docker exec "$cid" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1" 2>&1 || true; }
+
+assert_eq() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  pass "$label (= $actual)"
+}
+assert_has() {
+  local label="$1" pattern="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == *"$pattern"* ]] || fail "$label: esperado conter '$pattern', obtido -> $actual"
+  pass "$label ($pattern)"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao acessivel'
+pg_image="${TALKX_LOGS_CURSOR_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$cid" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=talkx_logs_cursor_test_only "$pg_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=false
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  markers="$(docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -c 'database system is ready to accept connections' || true)"
+  if [[ "$markers" -ge 2 ]] && docker exec "$cid" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=true; break
+  fi
+  sleep 1

+assert_eq '1. pagina 1 (cursor composto) devolve as 2 primeiras' "$l_a1,$l_a2" "$g_p1"
+g_c1="$(psql_val "$service_session SELECT id::text FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs('$c_log', NULL, 2) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1")"
+assert_eq '1. cursor da pagina 1 = ultima linha (l_a2)' "$l_a2" "$g_c1"
+g_p2="$(psql_val "$service_session SELECT string_agg(id::text, ',' ORDER BY created_at, id) FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs(p_campaign_id => '$c_log', p_after => '$t1', p_limit => 2, p_after_id => '$g_c1'::uuid)")"
+assert_eq '1. pagina 2 entrega a cauda empatada + a proxima (l_a3, l_b1)' "$l_a3,$l_b1" "$g_p2"
+g_c2="$(psql_val "$service_session SELECT id::text FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs(p_campaign_id => '$c_log', p_after => '$t1', p_limit => 2, p_after_id => '$g_c1'::uuid) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1")"
+assert_eq '1. cursor da pagina 2 = ultima linha (l_b1)' "$l_b1" "$g_c2"
+g_p3="$(psql_val "$service_session SELECT string_agg(id::text, ',' ORDER BY created_at, id) FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs(p_campaign_id => '$c_log', p_after => '$t2', p_limit => 2, p_after_id => '$g_c2'::uuid)")"
+assert_eq '1. pagina 3 devolve a ultima linha (l_b2)' "$l_b2" "$g_p3"
+g_seen="$(psql_val "$service_session SELECT count(*) FROM (
+  SELECT id FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs('$c_log', NULL, 2)
+  UNION SELECT id FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs(p_campaign_id => '$c_log', p_after => '$t1', p_limit => 2, p_after_id => '$l_a2'::uuid)
+  UNION SELECT id FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs(p_campaign_id => '$c_log', p_after => '$t2', p_limit => 2, p_after_id => '$l_b1'::uuid)) u")"
+assert_eq '1. a caminhada devolve as 5 linhas (nenhuma perdida)' '5' "$g_seen"
+
+# 2) cursor incompleto (p_after sem p_after_id) ERRA em vez de perder linhas
+guard="$(psql_raw "$service_session SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs(p_campaign_id => '$c_log', p_after => '$t1', p_limit => 2)")"
+assert_has '2. cursor de timestamp sozinho levanta talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto' 'talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto' "$guard"
+
+# 3) primeira pagina documentada (campanha, NULL, limite) continua funcionando
+doc_first="$(psql_val "$service_session SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs('$c_log', NULL, 100)")"
+assert_eq '3. chamada de 1a pagina (campanha, NULL, limite) segue valendo' '5' "$doc_first"
+
+# 4) a assinatura antiga foi removida: nao sobra overload que ainda perderia linhas
+old_sig="$(psql_val "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer)') IS NULL")"
+assert_eq '4. assinatura antiga (uuid,timestamptz,integer) nao existe mais' 't' "$old_sig"
+new_sig="$(psql_val "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid)') IS NOT NULL")"
+assert_eq '4. assinatura nova (uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid) existe' 't' "$new_sig"
+
+# 5) ACL: PUBLIC/anon sem EXECUTE, authenticated/service_role com, agente barrado
+pub_exec="$(psql_val "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a WHERE p.oid = 'public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid)'::regprocedure AND a.grantee = 0 AND a.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE'")"
+assert_eq '5. PUBLIC sem EXECUTE' '0' "$pub_exec"
+assert_eq '5. anon sem EXECUTE' 'f' "$(psql_val "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid)', 'EXECUTE')")"
+assert_eq '5. authenticated com EXECUTE' 't' "$(psql_val "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid)', 'EXECUTE')")"
+assert_eq '5. service_role com EXECUTE' 't' "$(psql_val "SELECT has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid)', 'EXECUTE')")"
+agent_call="$(psql_raw "$agent_session SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs('$c_log', NULL, 100)")"
+assert_has '5. agente nao-admin e barrado' 'talkx_admin_required' "$agent_call"
+admin_call="$(psql_val "$admin_session SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_campaign_logs('$c_log', NULL, 100)")"
+assert_eq '5. admin executa' '5' "$admin_call"
+
+# 6) idempotencia: reaplicar a migration nao quebra
+psql_exec < "$fix_migration" >/dev/null || fail 'migration do item 122 nao reaplicou (idempotencia)'
+pass 'migration do item 122 reaplicada sem erro (idempotencia)'
+
+# 7) o Rollback do cabecalho RODA e devolve a assinatura antiga
+# O SQL vem do PROPRIO arquivo: as linhas '--   ...' entre o marcador "-- Rollback (SQL executavel,
+# na ordem):" e a linha '--' seguinte. Mesma extracao dos outros testes do repo.
+mkdir -p "$repo_root/.tmp"
+sed -n '/^-- Rollback (SQL execut/,/^--$/p' "$fix_migration" | sed '1d;$d' | sed 's/^--   //' > "$repo_root/.tmp/rollback-122.sql"
+[[ -s "$repo_root/.tmp/rollback-122.sql" ]] || fail 'bloco "Rollback (SQL executavel)" do cabecalho nao encontrado'
+grep -qi '^create function public.talkx_campaign_logs' "$repo_root/.tmp/rollback-122.sql" || fail 'o rollback extraido nao recria a assinatura antiga'
+psql_exec < "$repo_root/.tmp/rollback-122.sql" >/dev/null || fail 'o Rollback do cabecalho nao rodou'
+rb_old="$(psql_val "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer)') IS NOT NULL")"
+assert_eq '7. rollback devolve a assinatura antiga' 't' "$rb_old"
+rb_new="$(psql_val "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid)') IS NULL")"
+assert_eq '7. rollback remove a assinatura nova' 't' "$rb_new"
+rb_acl="$(psql_val "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid,timestamptz,integer)', 'EXECUTE')")"
+assert_eq '7. rollback restaura o ACL (anon sem EXECUTE)' 'f' "$rb_acl"
+
+echo '[OK] Item 122: cursor de log do Talk X passa a ser composto (created_at, id); a paginacao nao perde mais linhas empatadas e o cursor incompleto falha alto em vez de perder dados.'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Talk X ¬∑ recorr√™ncia de campanha (cart√£o t_1dbea713, refazer 3).

+#       ocorr√™ncia N√ÉO voltam na 2¬™; a 3¬™ ocorr√™ncia exclui quem recebeu em

+declare -a CASES_EXPECTED=(
+  migration_applies check_status_coverage

+  dedup_third_occurrence not_completed_no_child idempotence_already_scheduled

+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi

+CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$

+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), current_user)

+CREATE ROLE anon;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated;

+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (

+#
+# ESCOPO ‚Äî o que este harness prova (contrato real, PostgreSQL 17 descartavel):
+#   (a) save_talkx_campaign_draft le `segment_ids` do payload: a lista vira as linhas
+#       ORDENADAS de talkx_campaign_segments (position 1..n) e talkx_campaigns.segment_id
+#       fica com o PRIMEIRO (compatibilidade);
+#   (b) 11 segmentos -> 22023 (teto de 10 do aceite do plano);
+#   (c) snapshot_talkx_campaign_audience resolve os segmentos NA ORDEM de position e
+#       grava em cada destinatario o PRIMEIRO segmento que o contem: 3 segmentos com
+#       10, 8 e 5 contatos e 4 repetidos -> 19 destinatarios distintos (10+8+5-4);
+#   (d) campanha de segmento unico/legado (sem linhas na tabela nova) continua resolvendo
+#       pela coluna talkx_campaigns.segment_id;
+#   (e) ACL: authenticated NAO executa o helper talkx_sync_campaign_segments (service_role).
+#
+# Aplica as migrations REAIS na ordem de versao ‚Äî X016 (talkx_audience_query),
+# X017 (snapshot), X057a (estrutura) e X057b (esta entrega) ‚Äî sobre um schema minimo
+# com os objetos que os RPCs tocam, no mesmo formato dos testes irmaos

+#
+# AUSENCIA DE MEDICAO CONTA COMO FALHA: cada caso registra sua execucao em CASES_SEEN e o
+# harness FALHA no fim se algum caso esperado nao tiver rodado.

+set -euo pipefail

+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_q() { psql_test -Atqc "$1"; }

+# --- registro dos casos (ausencia de medicao = falha) -----------------------

+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" message="$2" errcode="$3" sql="$4" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(psql_test -v VERBOSITY=verbose -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$message"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava a mensagem '$message'"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$errcode"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava o SQLSTATE '$errcode'"; }
+  pass "$label"
+}

+start_postgres() {
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    # wal_level=logical: a X057a faz ALTER PUBLICATION ADD TABLE (Realtime).
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" \
+         "$postgres_image" postgres -c wal_level=logical >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: container PostgreSQL nao subiu (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL descartavel nao estabilizou (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+  done
+  return 1
+}

+expect_error_role() { local l="$1" needle="$2" r="$3" s="$4" out st; set +e; out="$(as_role "$r" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e; (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }; [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }; printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"; }

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+# N-135: talkx_help_views + talkx_help_top_topics.
+# RED: antes da migration, tabela/RPC nao existem. GREEN: existem, agregam sem user_id,
+# RLS isola, reaplicar e no-op. Rollback extraido da migration remove tudo.
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_HELP_TOP_TOPICS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-talkx-help-top-$RANDOM-$$"
+up="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261010071304_talkx_help_views_top_topics.sql"
+
+# Extrai o rollback inline da migration (linha 2: "-- Rollback: <sql>").
+rollback_sql="$(sed -n '2s/^-- Rollback: //p' "$up")"
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao acessivel'
+[[ -f "$up" ]] || fail 'migration ausente'
+[[ -n "$rollback_sql" ]] || fail 'rollback inline nao encontrado na migration'
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=x "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=false
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  markers="$(docker logs "$container_name" 2>&1 | grep -c 'database system is ready to accept connections' || true)"
+  if [[ "$markers" -ge 2 ]] && docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=true; break
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+[[ "$ready" == true ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+# Espelha as roles/funcao do Supabase que a migration usa (auth.uid(), authenticated...).
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO PUBLIC;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO authenticated, anon;
+SQL
+
+# RED
+red_table="$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT coalesce(to_regclass('public.talkx_help_views')::text, '')")"
+[[ "$red_table" == '' ]] || fail 'RED: tabela ja existe'
+red_rpc="$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT coalesce(to_regproc('public.talkx_help_top_topics')::text, '')")"
+[[ "$red_rpc" == '' ]] || fail 'RED: RPC ja existe'
+
+# GREEN (e idempotencia: aplicar duas vezes)
+psql_test < "$up" >/dev/null || fail 'migration nao aplicou'
+psql_test < "$up" >/dev/null || fail 'migration nao e reaplicavel'
+cols="$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT string_agg(column_name, ',' ORDER BY column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='talkx_help_views' AND column_name IN ('article_id','user_id','viewed_at')")"
+[[ "$cols" == 'article_id,user_id,viewed_at' ]] || fail "colunas: [$cols]"
+rls="$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE relname='talkx_help_views'")"
+[[ "$rls" == 't' ]] || fail "RLS desligado: [$rls]"
+
+as_user() { # $1 uuid, $2 sql -> stdout+stderr, sempre exit 0
+  psql_test -Atqc "BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$1'; $2; ROLLBACK;" 2>&1 || true
+}
+A=aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
+B=aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
+
+psql_test -c "INSERT INTO public.talkx_help_views(article_id,user_id,viewed_at) VALUES
+ ('campanhas/criar','$A',now()),('campanhas/criar','$B',now()),('campanhas/criar','$B',now()),

+psql_q() { psql_test -Atqc "$1"; }

+test_password='ti_test_only'
+cid="ti-$RANDOM$RANDOM"
+cleanup() { if [[ "$cid" =~ ^ti-[0-9]+$ ]]; then docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; }

+ready=false

+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid
+$$;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL);

+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_recipients (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

+);
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_links (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), campaign_id uuid NOT NULL);
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_link_clicks (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), link_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  clicked_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(p_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(current_setting('test.is_admin', true), 'false')::boolean
+$$;
+SQL
+
+# RED: sem a migration a RPC nao existe
+S='public.talkx_insights(timestamptz,timestamptz)'

+as_user() { psql_test -Atqc "BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='$1'; SET LOCAL test.is_admin='$2'; $3 COMMIT;" 2>&1 || true; }
+A() { as_user '40000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a' 'false' "$1"; }
+C() { as_user '40000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000c' 'false' "$1"; }
+D() { as_user '40000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d' 'false' "$1"; }
+E() { as_user '40000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000e' 'false' "$1"; }
+ADM() { as_user '40000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a' 'true' "$1"; }
+P="public.talkx_insights(now() - interval '95 days', now())"
+Q="WITH r AS (SELECT $P AS j), i AS (SELECT e FROM r, jsonb_array_elements(r.j->'insights') e)"
+QL="$Q SELECT 'len=' || (SELECT count(*)::text FROM i) UNION ALL SELECT 'rule_count=' || ((SELECT r.j->'summary'->>'rule_count' FROM r)) UNION ALL SELECT 'lift_null=' || ((SELECT (SELECT r.j->'summary'->>'estimated_lift_pct' FROM r) IS NULL)::text) UNION ALL SELECT 'ids=' || (SELECT string_agg(x.e->>'id', ',' ORDER BY x.e->>'id') FROM i x)"
+QA="$QL UNION ALL SELECT 'bw=' || (SELECT concat_ws('|', x.e->>'type', x.e->>'priority', x.e->>'action', x.e->'params'->>'hour', x.e->'params'->>'reply_rate_pct', x.e->'params'->>'avg_reply_rate_pct', x.e->'params'->>'lift_pct', x.e->>'sample') FROM i x WHERE x.e->>'id'='best-window') UNION ALL SELECT 'sg=' || (SELECT concat_ws('|', x.e->'params'->>'with_segment_campaigns', x.e->'params'->>'without_segment_campaigns', x.e->>'action') FROM i x WHERE x.e->>'id'='segment-lift') UNION ALL SELECT 'tp=' || (SELECT concat_ws('|', x.e->'params'->>'campaigns', x.e->'params'->>'sent', x.e->>'action') FROM i x WHERE x.e->>'id'='best-template') UNION ALL SELECT 'lk=' || (SELECT concat_ws('|', x.e->'params'->>'low_click_campaigns', x.e->'params'->>'completed_campaigns', x.e->'params'->>'avg_click_rate_pct') FROM i x WHERE x.e->>'id'='low-clicks')"
+ck() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -qxF "$2" || fail "$3"; }
+
+out_a="$(A "$QA")"
+ck "$out_a" 'ids=best-template,best-window,low-clicks,segment-lift' 'sem as 4 dicas'
+ck "$out_a" 'rule_count=4' 'rule_count != 4'
+ck "$out_a" 'bw=timing|high|prefill_send_window|10|30.0|23.3|28.6|200' 'best-window'
+ck "$out_a" 'sg=5|5|open_segments' 'segment-lift'
+ck "$out_a" 'tp=5|500|open_template' 'best-template'
+ck "$out_a" 'lk=10|10|1.0' 'low-clicks'
+ck "$out_a" 'lift_null=true' 'lift nulo com 9'

+ck "$(A "select $P->'summary'->>'estimated_lift_pct';")" '50' 'lift != 50 com 10 em 90d'
+
+out_c="$(C "$QL")"
+ck "$out_c" 'len=0' 'C devia ter 0 dicas'; ck "$out_c" 'rule_count=0' 'C rule_count'
+ck "$out_c" 'lift_null=true' 'C lift nulo'
+out_d="$(D "$QL")"
+ck "$out_d" 'len=0' 'D devia ter 0 dicas'; ck "$out_d" 'rule_count=0' 'D rule_count'
+ck "$(ADM "$QL")" 'rule_count=4' 'admin devia ver 4'
+
+# regra 2 com 0 respostas no lado sem segmento: nao pode dividir por zero; a
+# funcao segue e avalia as outras regras (E tem low-clicks, nao segment-lift)
+out_e="$(E "$QL")"
+[[ "$out_e" != *'division_by_zero'* ]] || fail 'regra 2 dividiu por zero'
+ck "$out_e" 'len=1' 'E devia ter 1 dica'; ck "$out_e" 'rule_count=1' 'E rule_count'
+ck "$out_e" 'ids=low-clicks' 'E sem segment-lift'; ck "$out_e" 'lift_null=true' 'E lift nulo'

+# periodo invalido
+bad_range="$(A "select public.talkx_insights(now(), now() - interval '1 day');")"
+[[ "$bad_range" == *'invalid_talkx_insights_period'* ]] || fail "periodo invertido (got: $bad_range)"
+bad_null="$(A "select public.talkx_insights(NULL, now());")"
+[[ "$bad_null" == *'invalid_talkx_insights_period'* ]] || fail "p_from nulo (got: $bad_null)"
+
+# ACL
+[[ "$(psql_q "select has_function_privilege('authenticated', '$S', 'EXECUTE')")" == 't' ]] || fail 'authenticated sem EXECUTE'
+[[ "$(psql_q "select has_function_privilege('service_role', '$S', 'EXECUTE')")" == 't' ]] || fail 'service_role sem EXECUTE'
+[[ "$(psql_q "select has_function_privilege('anon', '$S', 'EXECUTE')")" == 'f' ]] || fail 'anon com EXECUTE'
+[[ "$(psql_q "select p.prosecdef from pg_proc p where p.oid = '$S'::regprocedure")" == 't' ]] || fail 'sem DEFINER'
+[[ "$(psql_q "select array_to_string(p.proconfig, ',') from pg_proc p where p.oid = '$S'::regprocedure")" == 'search_path=public, pg_temp' ]] || fail 'sem search_path fixo'

+rb="$(grep -m1 'drop function if exists public.talkx_insights' "$mig" | sed 's/^--//')"

+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done

+  done

+      WHERE campaign_id='$(camp a)' AND date_trunc('minute', ${col}_at) = (e->>'t')::timestamptz)")"

+case_done series_delivered_minute
+pass '(1) entregue cai no minuto do delivered_at, nao no do envio'

+pass '(2) KPIs: 12 enviadas/entregues, 2 respondidas, 1 opt-out da campanha (so origin=optout), taxas 100.0 e 8.3'

+state_of() { # <sessao> <expr> -> SQLSTATE do erro ou OK
+
+  psql_test -Atq 2>&1 <<SQL | grep -E '^(NOTICE:|psql:)' | tail -1 | sed 's/^NOTICE: *//'
+$1
+DO \$\$ BEGIN PERFORM $2; RAISE NOTICE 'OK'; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE NOTICE '%', SQLSTATE; END \$\$;
+SQL
+}
+expect 'outro agente => 42501' "$(state_of "$other" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp a)')")" '42501'
+case_done other_agent_denied
+expect 'campanha inexistente => 42501' "$(state_of "$admin" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('50000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000ff')")" '42501'
+case_done missing_campaign_denied
+expect 'sem login (uid nulo) => 42501' "$(state_of "SET ROLE authenticated; RESET request.jwt.claim.sub;" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp a)')")" '42501'
+expect 'anon => 42501 (sem EXECUTE)' "$(state_of "SET ROLE anon;" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp a)')")" '42501'
+case_done anon_denied
+expect 'p_bucket invalido => 22023' "$(state_of "$owner" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp a)', 15, 'week')")" '22023'
+expect 'p_window_minutes invalido => 22023' "$(state_of "$owner" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp a)', 0)")" '22023'
+case_done invalid_args
+pass '(9) dono e admin leem; outro agente, id inexistente, sem login e anon recebem 42501; argumentos invalidos 22023'
+
+# --- (9b) brecha de NULL na autorizacao --------------------------------------
+# Usuario autenticado SEM linha em profiles e sem papel de admin: a comparacao
+# de dono vira NULL e o IF nao pode deixar passar.
+noprofile="SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004';"
+expect 'sem profiles => 42501' "$(state_of "$noprofile" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp a)')")" '42501'
+case_done no_profile_denied
+pass '(9b) authenticated sem linha em profiles recebe 42501'
+# Campanha com created_by NULL lida por nao-admin => 42501; admin segue lendo.
+expect 'created_by NULL + nao-admin => 42501' "$(state_of "$other" "public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp f)')")" '42501'
+expect 'created_by NULL + admin le' "$(psql_q "$admin SELECT public.talkx_monitor_panel('$(camp f)') IS NOT NULL")" 't'
+case_done null_owner_denied
+pass '(9b) campanha sem dono: nao-admin recebe 42501, admin le'
+
+# --- (10) ACL, definer e replay ------------------------------------------------
+sig='public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid,integer,text,date,uuid)'
+expect 'anon sem EXECUTE' "$(psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$sig','EXECUTE')")" 'f'
+expect 'authenticated com EXECUTE' "$(psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$sig','EXECUTE')")" 't'
+expect 'SECURITY DEFINER com search_path fixo' "$(psql_q "SELECT prosecdef AND 'search_path=public, pg_temp' = ANY(proconfig) FROM pg_proc WHERE oid='$sig'::regprocedure")" 't'
+case_done acl
+psql_test < "$migration" >/dev/null || fail 'segunda aplicacao da migration falhou'
+expect 'uma unica funcao' "$(psql_q "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE proname='talkx_monitor_panel'")" '1'
+case_done replay
+pass '(10) ACL, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path fixo e migration replayavel'
+
+for c in "${CASES_EXPECTED[@]}"; do
+  [[ -n "${CASES_SEEN[$c]:-}" ]] || fail "caso nao medido: $c"
+done
+pass "todos os ${#CASES_EXPECTED[@]} casos medidos"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-102 (refazer t_b7ce25ec sobre a entrega 26101319059cbc): versiona a prova de que
+# supabase/migrations/20261013085500_talkx_n102_window_fixes.sql APLICA em qualquer
+# empilhamento e que a restricao de EXECUTE continua valendo quando a funcao existe.
+#
+# O defeito que este teste guarda (medido na pilha de 14/10, cartao t_ad964aab):
+#   psql:<stdin>:30: ERROR:  function public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid, timestamp with time zone) does not exist
+# A base que CRIA a funcao (20261009203548) nao esta em nenhuma branch dia/, so em branches de
+# cartoes recusados/preparacao; sem ela na pilha o REVOKE cru derrubava a aplicacao das migrations.
+#
+# Blocos:
+#   A ‚Äî banco SEM a funcao: a migration aplica com ON_ERROR_STOP=1, emite o NOTICE de base
+#       ausente e NAO cria a funcao (nada de DDL escondido para "fazer passar").
+#   B ‚Äî banco COM a funcao (stub da mesma identidade, ACL de fabrica: EXECUTE para PUBLIC):
+#       a migration tira o EXECUTE de PUBLIC/anon/authenticated e deixa so service_role.
+#       B0 prova que a assercao nao e vacua: antes da migration anon e authenticated executam.
+#   C ‚Äî replay: aplicar a migration duas vezes seguidas nao da erro (o reconciliar da pilha
+#       reaplica o conjunto inteiro quando o ledger diverge).
+#   D ‚Äî rollback: a linha `-- Rollback:` do cabecalho roda nos DOIS estados (com e sem a funcao)
+#       e devolve EXECUTE a authenticated.
+#   E ‚Äî a guarda generica scripts/db-audit/check-secdef-public-execute.sql segue verde depois.
+#
+# Override para a prova de mutacao (RED com a copia anterior, sem a guarda do DO):
+#   TALKX_N102_ACL_TEST_MIGRATION=<outra copia do .sql>
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
+migration="${TALKX_N102_ACL_TEST_MIGRATION:-$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261013085500_talkx_n102_window_fixes.sql}"
+guard_sql="$repo_root/scripts/db-audit/check-secdef-public-execute.sql"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_N102_ACL_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || { printf 'FAIL: migration nao encontrada: %s\n' "$migration" >&2; exit 1; }
+[[ -f "$guard_sql" ]] || { printf 'FAIL: guarda nao encontrada: %s\n' "$guard_sql" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+container_name=''
+containers=()
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+
+cleanup() {
+  local c
+  for c in "${containers[@]}"; do docker rm -f "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
+  rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$1"; }
+
+start_postgres() {
+  # Requer duas sondas seguidas: o runner as vezes reporta pronto um instante antes do
+  # container reiniciar. So o bootstrap e retentado; falha de assercao nunca.
+  local attempt
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=talkx_n102_acl_test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL container failed to start (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL bootstrap was not stable (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+    docker logs "$container_name" >&2 || true
+  done
+  return 1
+}

+novo_container() {
+  container_name="talkx-n102-acl-test-$$${1:+-$1}"
+  containers+=("$container_name")
+  start_postgres || fail "PostgreSQL de teste nao iniciou ($container_name)"
+}

+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_q() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -Atq -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }

+# Aplica a MIGRATION REAL como o ledger aplica: ON_ERROR_STOP, qualquer instrucao que falhe

+aplica_migration() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$migration" > "$1" 2>&1; }

+# ACL efetiva de uma role na funcao (t/f).
+acesso() { psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('$1', 'public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid,timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE')"; }

+# EXECUTE concedido a PUBLIC no ACL explicito da funcao (0 = role PUBLIC).
+acesso_public() {
+  psql_q "SELECT count(*) FROM aclexplode(coalesce(

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+# N-102a (fatia de DDL da janela de envio do Talk X) ‚Äî inventario de melhorias, banco.
+#
+# A janela de envio precisa guardar os dias da semana (send_weekdays) e o respeito ao
+# horario "nao perturbe" (respect_dnd em talkx_campaigns + setting dnd_hours em
+# talkx_settings). Sem o DDL, nenhuma RPC da janela compila.
+#
+# Prova, em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel:
+#   RED      ‚Äî a BASE LEGADA (talkx_campaigns sem as colunas, talkx_settings sem
+#              dnd_hours) nao tem o que a migration cria;
+#   GREEN    ‚Äî a migration REAL cria as duas colunas (tipo, NULL/NOT NULL, default
+#              true em respect_dnd), o setting dnd_hours e e idempotente (a segunda
+#              aplicacao e no-op; a linha legada herda o default sem perder o valor);
+#   ACL      ‚Äî a migration NAO mexe em GRANT/REVOKE: a ACL das duas tabelas fica
+#              identica antes/depois e nenhuma coluna nova recebe grant de coluna
+#              (nao ha GRANT a authenticated);
+#   ROLLBACK ‚Äî o bloco executavel do cabecalho desfaz (colunas + setting) e a
+#              migration reaplica em ciclo completo (ida e volta restauram o schema).
+#
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/retry-disposable-postgres-test.sh bash scripts/db-audit/talkx-n102a-ddl.test.sh
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_N102A_DDL_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-talkx-n102a-ddl-$RANDOM-$$"
+test_password="talkx_n102a_test_only"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-talkx-n102a-ddl-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_atomic_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao acessivel'
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=false
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  markers="$(docker logs "$container_name" 2>&1 | grep -c 'database system is ready to accept connections' || true)"
+  if [[ "$markers" -ge 2 ]] && docker exec "$container_name" \
+    psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=true
+    break
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+[[ "$ready" == true ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL 17 descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+# ---- base LEGADA: talkx_campaigns sem as colunas novas, talkx_settings sem dnd_hours ----
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_campaigns (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
+);
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaigns(id, status) VALUES
+  ('30000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'draft');
+
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_settings (
+  key         text PRIMARY KEY,
+  value       jsonb NOT NULL,
+  description text,
+  updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_settings(key, value, description) VALUES
+  ('reply_window_hours', '{"hours":48}'::jsonb, 'janela de resposta');
+SQL
+
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011003005_talkx_n102a_ddl.sql"
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail 'migration N-102a nao existe'
+
+col_present() { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.talkx_campaigns'::regclass AND attname='$1' AND NOT attisdropped"; }
+col_type()    { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT format_type(atttypid, atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.talkx_campaigns'::regclass AND attname='$1' AND NOT attisdropped"; }
+col_notnull() { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT attnotnull FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.talkx_campaigns'::regclass AND attname='$1' AND NOT attisdropped"; }
+col_default() { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT pg_get_expr(adbin, adrelid) FROM pg_attrdef WHERE adrelid='public.talkx_campaigns'::regclass AND adnum=(SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.talkx_campaigns'::regclass AND attname='$1')"; }
+dnd_rows()    { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_settings WHERE key='dnd_hours'"; }
+relacl()      { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT coalesce(relacl::text, '') FROM pg_class WHERE oid='$1'::regclass"; }
+
+# ---- RED: a base legada nao tem as colunas nem o setting ----
+[[ "$(col_present send_weekdays)" == '0' ]] || fail 'RED: send_weekdays ja existia na base legada'
+[[ "$(col_present respect_dnd)" == '0' ]] || fail 'RED: respect_dnd ja existia na base legada'
+[[ "$(dnd_rows)" == '0' ]] || fail 'RED: o setting dnd_hours ja existia na base legada'
+
+acl_campaigns_before="$(relacl public.talkx_campaigns)"
+acl_settings_before="$(relacl public.talkx_settings)"
+
+# ---- GREEN: aplica a migration REAL (atomica) e reaplica (idempotente) ----
+psql_atomic_file "$migration" >/dev/null || fail 'N-102a nao aplicou'
+psql_test < "$migration" >/dev/null || fail 'N-102a nao e replayavel (segunda aplicacao falhou)'
+
+[[ "$(col_type send_weekdays)" == 'smallint[]' ]] || fail "GREEN: send_weekdays deveria ser smallint[] (got $(col_type send_weekdays))"
+[[ "$(col_notnull send_weekdays)" == 'f' ]] || fail 'GREEN: send_weekdays deveria ser nullable'
+[[ "$(col_type respect_dnd)" == 'boolean' ]] || fail "GREEN: respect_dnd deveria ser boolean (got $(col_type respect_dnd))"
+[[ "$(col_notnull respect_dnd)" == 't' ]] || fail 'GREEN: respect_dnd deveria ser NOT NULL'
+[[ "$(col_default respect_dnd)" == 'true' ]] || fail "GREEN: default de respect_dnd deveria ser true (got $(col_default respect_dnd))"
+
+[[ "$(dnd_rows)" == '1' ]] || fail "GREEN: dnd_hours deveria ter exatamente 1 linha (got $(dnd_rows))"
+dnd_value="$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT (value->>'start')||'/'||(value->>'end')||'/'||(value->>'sundays') FROM public.talkx_settings WHERE key='dnd_hours'")"
+[[ "$dnd_value" == '22:00/08:00/true' ]] || fail "GREEN: valor de dnd_hours inesperado (got $dnd_value)"
+
+# a linha legada herda o default sem perder o valor existente (nenhum UPDATE em massa)
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT (send_weekdays IS NULL) AND respect_dnd FROM public.talkx_campaigns WHERE id='30000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'GREEN: linha legada nao herdou o default (send_weekdays NULL / respect_dnd true)'
+
+# ---- ACL: a migration nao concede nada (sem GRANT a authenticated) ----
+[[ "$(relacl public.talkx_campaigns)" == "$acl_campaigns_before" ]] || fail 'ACL: talkx_campaigns mudou de ACL (GRANT/REVOKE indevido)'
+[[ "$(relacl public.talkx_settings)" == "$acl_settings_before" ]] || fail 'ACL: talkx_settings mudou de ACL (GRANT/REVOKE indevido)'
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.talkx_campaigns'::regclass AND attname IN ('send_weekdays','respect_dnd') AND attacl IS NOT NULL")" == '0' ]] \
+  || fail 'ACL: coluna nova recebeu GRANT de coluna (deveria seguir so o GRANT da tabela)'
+
+# ---- ROLLBACK: o bloco executavel do cabecalho volta o estado anterior ----
+rb_sql="$(grep -E '^--   ' "$migration" | sed -E 's/^--   //')"
+[[ -n "$rb_sql" ]] || fail 'ROLLBACK: a migration nao tem bloco de rollback executavel'
+printf '%s\n' "$rb_sql" | psql_test >/dev/null || fail 'ROLLBACK: o rollback da migration nao executou'
+[[ "$(col_present send_weekdays)" == '0' ]] || fail 'ROLLBACK: send_weekdays nao foi removida'
+[[ "$(col_present respect_dnd)" == '0' ]] || fail 'ROLLBACK: respect_dnd nao foi removida'
+[[ "$(dnd_rows)" == '0' ]] || fail 'ROLLBACK: o setting dnd_hours nao foi removido'
+
+# ida e volta: reaplica apos o rollback
+psql_test < "$migration" >/dev/null || fail 'ROLLBACK: N-102a nao reaplicou apos o rollback'
+[[ "$(dnd_rows)" == '1' && "$(col_present respect_dnd)" == '1' ]] || fail 'ROLLBACK: reaplicacao nao restaurou o schema'
+
+printf '[OK] Talk X N-102a: DDL da janela de envio (send_weekdays/respect_dnd + dnd_hours) idempotente na base legada; ACL intacta; rollback e ida-e-volta ok.\n'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+# N-102c ‚Äî janela de envio das campanhas TalkX: prova, em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel,
+# que public.talkx_campaign_window_open (migration 20261011003008_talkx_n102c_window_open.sql):
+#   (1) ABRE dentro da janela (dia da semana permitido em send_weekdays);
+#   (2) FECHA fora dela, considerando o dia LOCAL da campanha;
+#   (3) RESPEITA O FUSO (schedule_timezone): o mesmo instante que e segunda-feira em
+#       UTC mas domingo em America/Sao_Paulo e avaliado como domingo;
+#   (4) restringe acesso: EXECUTE so para service_role (nem PUBLIC/anon/authenticated).
+#
+# RED sem a correcao: com TALKX_N102C_SKIP_FIX=1 o teste NAO aplica a migration e a
+# funcao "antiga" (fuso da sessao UTC + ISODOW) permanece ‚Äî (2),(3) e o ACL falham,
+# o script sai 1. GREEN: aplica a migration e os 4 passam.
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_N102C_WINDOW_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-n102c-window-$RANDOM-$$"
+test_password="n102c_window_test_only"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011003008_talkx_n102c_window_open.sql"
+skip_fix="${TALKX_N102C_SKIP_FIX:-}"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-n102c-window-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $migration"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" \
+  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=false
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  markers="$(docker logs "$container_name" 2>&1 | grep -c 'database system is ready to accept connections' || true)"
+  if [[ "$markers" -ge 2 ]] && docker exec "$container_name" \
+    psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=true
+    break
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+[[ "$ready" == true ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL 17 descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+# ---- roles + fixture minimo (so as colunas que a funcao le) ----
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_campaigns (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  schedule_timezone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo',
+  send_weekdays smallint[],
+  respect_dnd boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_settings (
+  key text PRIMARY KEY,
+  value jsonb NOT NULL
+);
+
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_settings(key, value)
+VALUES ('dnd_hours', '{"start":"22:00","end":"08:00","sundays":true,"holidays":[]}'::jsonb);
+
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaigns(id, schedule_timezone, send_weekdays, respect_dnd) VALUES
+  ('30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'America/Sao_Paulo', '{1,2,3,4,5}', false),
+  ('30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'America/Sao_Paulo', '{0}',         false),
+  ('30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'America/Sao_Paulo', '{1}',         false);
+SQL
+
+# ---- corpo ANTERIOR (defeito): fuso da sessao (UTC) + ISODOW; sem restricao de ACL ----
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_window_open(p_campaign_id uuid, p_at timestamptz)
+RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_dnd_hours jsonb;
+  v_weekday integer;
+  v_start_minutes integer;
+  v_end_minutes integer;
+  v_minutes_of_day integer;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign FROM public.talkx_campaigns WHERE id = p_campaign_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.send_weekdays IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_weekday := EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p_at)::integer % 7;
+    IF NOT (v_weekday = ANY(v_campaign.send_weekdays)) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.respect_dnd THEN
+    SELECT value INTO v_dnd_hours FROM public.talkx_settings WHERE key = 'dnd_hours';
+    IF v_dnd_hours IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v_dnd_hours) = 'object' THEN
+      v_minutes_of_day := EXTRACT(HOUR FROM p_at)::integer * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM p_at)::integer;
+      v_start_minutes := (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'start', ':', 1))::integer * 60 + (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'start', ':', 2))::integer;
+      v_end_minutes := (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'end', ':', 1))::integer * 60 + (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'end', ':', 2))::integer;
+      IF EXTRACT(DOW FROM p_at) = 0 AND (v_dnd_hours ->> 'sundays')::boolean = false THEN RETURN true; END IF;
+      IF jsonb_array_length(v_dnd_hours -> 'holidays') > 0 THEN
+        IF p_at::date = ANY(v_dnd_hours -> 'holidays')::date[] THEN RETURN true; END IF;
+      END IF;
+      IF v_start_minutes < v_end_minutes THEN
+        IF v_minutes_of_day >= v_start_minutes AND v_minutes_of_day < v_end_minutes THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+      ELSIF v_start_minutes > v_end_minutes THEN
+        IF v_minutes_of_day >= v_start_minutes OR v_minutes_of_day < v_end_minutes THEN RETURN false; END IF;
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN true;
+END;
+$function$;
+SQL
+
+# ---- GREEN: aplica a migration corrigida (e prova que e replayavel) ----
+if [[ -z "$skip_fix" ]]; then

+  psql_test < "$migration" >/dev/null || fail 'a migration 20261011003008 nao e replayavel (2a aplicacao falhou)'
+fi
+
+window() { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT public.talkx_campaign_window_open('$1'::uuid, '$2'::timestamptz)"; }
+
+# (1) ABRE dentro da janela ‚Äî segunda 10:00 em Sao Paulo, semana permitida {1..5}
+[[ "$(window 30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 2026-10-12T13:00:00+00)" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'deveria ABRIR dentro da janela (seg 10:00 America/Sao_Paulo, send_weekdays {1..5})'

+# (2) FECHA fora dela pelo DIA LOCAL ‚Äî domingo 22:00 em SP (UTC ja e segunda), {1} permite so segunda
+[[ "$(window 30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003 2026-10-12T01:00:00+00)" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail 'deveria FECHAR (domingo local nao esta em send_weekdays {1}); fuso/dia local ignorados'

+# (3) RESPEITA O FUSO ‚Äî mesmo instante e domingo local em SP e esta em {0}: ABRE
+[[ "$(window 30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002 2026-10-12T01:00:00+00)" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'deveria ABRIR (domingo local em America/Sao_Paulo, send_weekdays {0}); avaliou em UTC'
+
+# (4) ACL restrita ‚Äî EXECUTE so para service_role
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT has_function_privilege('service_role','public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid,timestamptz)','EXECUTE')")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail 'service_role deveria ter EXECUTE na RPC'
+for role in authenticated anon; do
+  [[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT has_function_privilege('$role','public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid,timestamptz)','EXECUTE')")" == 'f' ]] \
+    || fail "$role NAO deveria ter EXECUTE na RPC"
+done
+
+printf '[OK] Talk X N-102c: window_open abre dentro, fecha fora (dia local) e respeita o fuso; ACL restrita a service_role.\n'
+
+# ---- Rollback executavel: extrai a linha do rodape da migration, derruba a funcao e
+#      prova que reaplicar a migration a recria (reversivel de verdade) ----
+rollback_sql="$(grep -m1 -oE 'DROP FUNCTION[^;]*;' "$migration")"

+psql_test -c "$rollback_sql" >/dev/null || fail "rollback nao executou: $rollback_sql"
+[[ -z "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid,timestamptz)')")" ]] \

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Harness descartavel (Docker postgres:17-alpine) ‚Äî #126 / achado R3-DELTA-009.
+#
+# Defeito: a purga LGPD (public.purge_talkx_expired_data) grava updated_at = now() nos
+# destinatarios de campanhas TERMINAIS que ela expurga. A view de saude
+# public.talkx_engine_health media "falha recente" (failure_rate_15m, 15 min) e
+# outcome_unknown_24h (24 h) por r.updated_at; a purga do dia, entao, faz destinatarios
+# antigos e ja terminais aparecerem como se tivessem acabado de mudar de estado, e
+# talkx_engine_alerts() abre alertas FALSOS (high_failure_rate / outcome_unknown) numa
+# campanha completed/cancelled.
+#
+# Estado "antes" = as migrations reais ja aplicadas em producao:
+#   20261003242707_talkx_log_saude_alertas.sql (X033: log, saude, alertas, expurgo)
+#   20261004173439_talkx_tick_nao_aborta_no_expurgo.sql (M-DB-01: expurgo isolado no tick)
+# Correcao = a migration nova (marcador 'talkx_status_changed_at_na_saude').
+#
+# Bloco A (RED, antes da correcao):
+#   A0/A1  baseline: a campanha terminal NAO aparece na saude antes da purga;
+#   A2     a purga roda e anula a PII (prova de que o expurgo continua expurgando);
+#   A3/A4  DEFEITO: depois da purga, failure_rate_15m e outcome_unknown_24h aparecem
+#          para a campanha terminal -> "falha recente" falsa;
+#   A5/A6  DANO: talkx_engine_alerts() abre 'high_failure_rate' e 'outcome_unknown' FALSOS.
+# Bloco B (GREEN, depois da correcao):
+#   B0     coluna/trava novas existem; a view segue security_invoker e com os grants; o backfill
+#          NAO regravou updated_at (digest antes/depois identico em c_green e c_live) e o gatilho
+#          publico do status nao tem EXECUTE para cliente nenhum ‚Äî com controle (funcao sonda
+#          criada sob o mesmo default privilege do Supabase) provando que o harness concede
+#          EXECUTE por padrao, senao a afirmacao seria sobre o harness e nao sobre o banco;
+#   B1/B2  o expurgo continua anulando a PII, mas agora NAO cria sinal falso
+#          (a view le status_changed_at, que o expurgo nao move, e updated_at segue sendo
+#          empurrado ‚Äî prova de que o defeito do updated_at continua e nao e ele que cura);
+#   B3     falha REAL preservada: destinatario que muda de status para 'failed' AGORA
+#          aparece em failure_rate_15m e talkx_engine_alerts() abre high_failure_rate;
+#   B4     o gatilho novo so move status_changed_at em troca REAL de status;
+#   B5     idempotencia: reaplicar a migration nao quebra.
+# Bloco C (ROLLBACK): o SQL extraido verbatim do cabecalho da migration (entre os marcadores
+#   BEGIN-ROLLBACK-SQL / END-ROLLBACK-SQL) roda e devolve o comportamento anterior ‚Äî depois
+#   dele, a purga volta a criar o sinal falso.

+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+
+x033="$(grep -rlF 'talkx_x033_objetos_ausentes' "$repo_root/supabase/migrations" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/_superseded/' | sort | tail -1 || true)"
+mdb01="$(ls "$repo_root"/supabase/migrations/20261004173439_*.sql 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
+fix="$(grep -rlF 'talkx_status_changed_at_na_saude' "$repo_root/supabase/migrations" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/_superseded/' | sort | tail -1 || true)"

+[[ -f "$mdb01" ]] || { printf '[FALHA] migration M-DB-01 (20261004173439_*.sql) nao encontrada\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+[[ -f "$fix"   ]] || { printf '[FALHA] migration da correcao nao encontrada (marcador talkx_status_changed_at_na_saude)\n' >&2; exit 1; }
+
+fail() { printf '[FALHA] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$1"; }
+
+cid="talkx-x126-$RANDOM$RANDOM"
+rb="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rollback-x126-$RANDOM.sql"

+psql_raw()  { docker exec "$cid" psql -X -Atq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1" 2>&1 || true; }

+assert_eq() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  pass "$label (= $actual)"

+assert_has() {
+  local label="$1" pattern="$2" actual="$3"
+  [[ "$actual" == *"$pattern"* ]] || fail "$label: esperado conter '$pattern', obtido -> $actual"
+  pass "$label ($pattern)"

+user_admin='a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'

+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), current_user) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$

+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;

+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;

+# ‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê

+# No banco real, funcao nova em public nasce com EXECUTE para anon, authenticated e service_role
+# (default privileges do Supabase). Sem reproduzir isso, "authenticated sem EXECUTE" passaria
+# porque o harness nunca concedeu nada a ninguem ‚Äî afirmacao sobre o harness, nao sobre o banco.
+# Aplicado aqui (logo antes da correcao) para valer exatamente sobre a funcao que a correcao cria.
+# A sonda e criada no mesmo regime e NAO e revogada: ela e o controle que prova que o harness
+# concede EXECUTE por padrao (se ela viesse sem EXECUTE, o teste tem de parar).
+psql_exec >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public
+  GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.talkx_x126_acl_probe() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT 1 $$;
+SQL
+assert_eq 'B0-controle. harness concede EXECUTE a authenticated por padrao (sonda)' 't' \
+  "$(psql_val "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.talkx_x126_acl_probe()','EXECUTE')")"
+
+# Digest do carimbo real (id | updated_at) por campanha, lido ANTES da correcao: e o que o
+# backfill da coluna nova nao pode tocar.
+upd_digest() {
+  psql_val "SELECT md5(string_agg(id::text || '|' || updated_at::text, ',' ORDER BY id)) FROM public.talkx_recipients WHERE campaign_id='$1'"
+}
+upd_before_green="$(upd_digest "$c_green")"
+upd_before_live="$(upd_digest "$c_live")"
+[[ -n "$upd_before_green" && -n "$upd_before_live" ]] || fail 'nao consegui ler o digest de updated_at antes da correcao'
+
+# ‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê
+# CORRECAO
+# ‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê
+psql_exec < "$fix" >/dev/null || fail 'migration da correcao nao aplicou'
+pass "correcao aplicada ($(basename "$fix"))"

+# ‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê‚ïê

+assert_eq 'B0. coluna status_changed_at criada' '1' "$(psql_val "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='talkx_recipients' AND column_name='status_changed_at'")"
+assert_eq 'B0. gatilho do status criado (BEFORE UPDATE OF status)' '1' "$(psql_val "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='trg_talkx_recipients_status_changed_at' AND NOT tgisinternal")"

+# BLOCO C ‚Äî ROLLBACK: o SQL do cabecalho restaura o comportamento anterior

+assert_eq 'C0. o rollback NAO regrava updated_at em massa (c_green)' "$upd_rollback_green" "$(upd_digest "$c_green")"

+assert_eq 'C1. rollback removeu o gatilho novo' '0' "$(psql_val "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='trg_talkx_recipients_status_changed_at' AND NOT tgisinternal")"

+echo '     DEPOIS: a view le status_changed_at (so troca REAL de status), o expurgo segue anulando a PII e a falha real continua sendo detectada e alertada.'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# X040 (Fase 4 ¬∑ Tela dados ¬∑ camada banco + cron): calcular rec√™ncia, frequ√™ncia, valor e
+# segmento RFM a partir das COMPRAS LOCAIS (public.contact_purchases).
+#
+# Contrato em PostgreSQL 17 descart√°vel, no mesmo formato dos testes irm√£os

+# Monta o schema m√≠nimo que a migration toca (contacts, contact_purchases, talkx_settings,

+# (20261009032406_talkx_v4_x040_rfm_local_purchases.sql) e prova:
+#   (a) a fun√ß√£o existe, √© SECURITY DEFINER e a ACL √© s√≥ service_role (anon/authenticated n√£o);
+#   (b) 12 contatos com compras conhecidas -> last_purchase_at, orders_count, total_spent,

+#   (c) segmento RFM correto nos 7 r√≥tulos (Campe√µes, Leais, Em potencial, Novos, Em risco,
+#       Hibernando, Perdidos);
+#   (d) contato SEM compra n√£o ganha linha (rfm_segment nulo), e n√£o vira "Hibernando";
+#   (e) p_limit menor que o total n√£o causa fome: duas chamadas de 6 cobrem 12 compradores;
+#   (f) compras pendentes/canceladas/estornadas e propostas n√£o entram no RFM;
+#   (g) reexecu√ß√£o sem compra nova -> devolve 0 (changed = 0, idempotente);
+#   (h) compra nova muda s√≥ o contato afetado;
+#   (i) contato que perde compras efetivas fica com m√©tricas zeradas/nulas;
+#   (j) caminho de QUINTIS quando h√° >= monetary_min_buyers_for_quintiles compradores;
+#   (k) RLS: admin l√™ as linhas, agente (contato n√£o vis√≠vel) n√£o; anon sem SELECT;
+#   (l) linha do job em talkx_data_jobs (1x/dia);
+#   (m) migration replay√°vel (segunda aplica√ß√£o n√£o falha).

+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261009032406_talkx_v4_x040_rfm_local_purchases.sql"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_RFM_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="talkx-rfm-test-$$"
+test_password="talkx_rfm_test_only"
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$1"; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_q() { psql_test -Atqc "$1"; }
+
+start_postgres() {
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: container PostgreSQL nao subiu (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL descartavel nao estabilizou (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Harness descartavel (postgres:17-alpine): public.save_talkx_template_variants.
+# RED: a migration anterior falha as provas novas (id preservado, sucesso 2/3, payload
+# invalido, peso nulo/0, id nao-uuid). GREEN: a migration nova passa todas.
+# A chamada da RPC sai de `SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated` + claims (auth.uid() real).
+# Casos: (a) EXECUTE p/ authenticated; (b) anon sem EXECUTE; (c) not_authorized;
+# (d) template_not_found; (e) stale_template; (f) 0 variantes; (g) variante com
+# destinatario nao removida; (h) pesos != 100; (i) sem controle; (j) invalid_label;
+# (k) duplicate_label; (l) variant_not_found; (m) payload nao-array; (n) peso nulo/<=0;
+# (o) id nao-uuid; (p) sucesso 2 variantes; (q) sucesso 3 variantes; (r) id preservado;
+# (u) destinatario com variant_id NULL + []; (v) peso gigante/>100; (w) troca A<->B.
+# (s) remocao sem destinatario; (t) id preservado com label trocado.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="${TALKX_VARIANTS_MIGRATION_FILE:-$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261010151242_save_talkx_template_variants.sql}"
+fail() { printf '[FALHA] %s\n' "$1" >&2; failures=$((failures + 1)); }
+failures=0
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+test_password='talkx_variants_test_only'
+container_name="talkx-variants-$RANDOM$RANDOM"
+cleanup() { if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^talkx-variants-[0-9]+$ ]]; then docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; }
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao acessivel'
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" postgres:17-alpine >/dev/null
+
+ready=false
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  markers="$(docker logs "$container_name" 2>&1 | grep -c 'database system is ready to accept connections' || true)"
+  if [[ "$markers" -ge 2 ]] && docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready=true; break
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+[[ "$ready" == true ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL 17 descartavel nao ficou pronto'

+# (d) template inexistente -> template_not_found
+assert_err "$(call_rpc '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099' "$user_owner" NULL '[{"label":"A","content":"conteudo","weight":100}]')" template_not_found 'template inexistente'
+
+# (e) optimistic locking -> stale_template
+psql_test -Atqc "UPDATE public.talkx_templates SET updated_at = '2020-01-01' WHERE id = '$template_id'" >/dev/null
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" "'2019-01-01'::timestamptz" '[{"label":"A","content":"conteudo","weight":100}]')" stale_template 'updated_at divergido'
+psql_test -Atqc "UPDATE public.talkx_templates SET updated_at = now() WHERE id = '$template_id'" >/dev/null
+
+# (f) 0 variantes permitido
+psql_test -Atqc "DELETE FROM public.talkx_template_variants WHERE template_id = '$template_id'" >/dev/null
+r="$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" "$(expected_arg)" '[]')"
+assert_ok "$r" '0 variantes'
+[[ "$(variant_count)" == 0 ]] || fail '0 variantes: esperava 0 linhas'
+
+# (g) variante com destinatario nao pode ser removida
+psql_test >/dev/null <<SQL
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_template_variants (id, template_id, label, content, weight)
+VALUES ('$variant_id', '$template_id', 'A', 'conteudo variante', 100);
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_recipients (id, template_id, variant_id) VALUES ('$recipient_id', '$template_id', '$variant_id');
+SQL
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" "$(expected_arg)" '[]')" talkx_variant_in_use 'variante com destinatario'
+psql_test >/dev/null <<SQL

+DELETE FROM public.talkx_template_variants WHERE id = '$variant_id';
+SQL
+
+# (h) pesos != 100
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" "$(expected_arg)" '[{"label":"A","content":"conteudo","weight":50},{"label":"B","content":"","weight":40}]')" weights_must_sum_to_100 'peso != 100'
+
+# (i) sem controle
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" "$(expected_arg)" '[{"label":"A","content":"","weight":50},{"label":"B","content":"","weight":50}]')" exactly_one_variant_must_have_content 'conteudo vazio'
+
+# (j) label invalido
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" NULL '[{"label":"D","content":"conteudo","weight":50},{"label":"A","content":"","weight":50}]')" invalid_label 'label invalido'
+
+# (k) label duplicado
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" NULL '[{"label":"A","content":"conteudo A","weight":50},{"label":"A","content":"","weight":50}]')" duplicate_label 'label duplicado'
+

+
+# (p) sucesso: 2 variantes, um controle, soma 100
+psql_test -Atqc "DELETE FROM public.talkx_template_variants WHERE template_id = '$template_id'" >/dev/null

+assert_ok "$r" 'sucesso 2 variantes'
+[[ "$r" == *'"saved_count": 2'* ]] || fail "2 variantes: esperava saved_count 2 (got: $r)"
+[[ "$(variant_count)" == 2 ]] || fail '2 variantes: esperava 2 linhas'
+id_a="$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT id FROM public.talkx_template_variants WHERE template_id = '$template_id' AND label = 'A'")"

+# (q) sucesso: 3 variantes (atualiza A por id, cria B e C)
+r="$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" "$(expected_arg)" '[{"id":"'"$id_a"'","label":"A","content":"conteudo A v2","weight":40},{"label":"B","content":"","weight":30},{"label":"C","content":"","weight":30}]')"
+assert_ok "$r" 'sucesso 3 variantes'
+[[ "$r" == *'"saved_count": 3'* ]] || fail "3 variantes: esperava saved_count 3 (got: $r)"
+[[ "$(variant_count)" == 3 ]] || fail '3 variantes: esperava 3 linhas'

+# (m) payload nao-array -> invalid_variants_payload
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" NULL '{"a":1}')" invalid_variants_payload 'payload nao-array'
+
+# (n) peso nulo / <= 0 -> invalid_weight
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" NULL '[{"label":"A","content":"conteudo","weight":null},{"label":"B","content":"","weight":100}]')" invalid_weight 'peso nulo'
+assert_err "$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" NULL '[{"label":"A","content":"conteudo","weight":0},{"label":"B","content":"","weight":100}]')" invalid_weight 'peso zero'

+INSERT INTO public.talkx_template_variants (template_id, label, content, weight)
+VALUES ('$template_id', 'A', 'conteudo A', 50),

+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT label FROM public.talkx_template_variants WHERE id = '$swap_b'")" == 'B' ]] || fail 'troca A<->B: id_b deveria seguir em B'
+
+# (u) destinatario sem variante (variant_id NULL) nao bloqueia salvar []
+psql_test >/dev/null <<SQL
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_recipients (id, template_id, variant_id) VALUES ('80000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', '$template_id', NULL);
+SQL
+r="$(call_rpc "$template_id" "$user_owner" "$(expected_arg)" '[]')"
+assert_ok "$r" 'destinatario sem variante + []'
+[[ "$(variant_count)" == 0 ]] || fail 'destinatario sem variante: esperava 0 linhas'
+psql_test -Atqc "DELETE FROM public.talkx_recipients WHERE template_id = '$template_id'" >/dev/null
+
+if [[ "$failures" -eq 0 ]]; then
+  printf '[OK] save_talkx_template_variants: todas as provas GREEN passaram\n'
+else
+  printf '[FALHA] save_talkx_template_variants: %s prova(s) falharam\n' "$failures" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
