+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-111: contrato de banco da tabela oficial de campos/operadores de segmento
+# do Talk X (talkx_segment_fields) e da funcao de compilacao
+# (talkx_compile_segment_rules).
+#
+# PAPEL: este script DEVE ser executado com o papel `authenticated` (nao
+# service_role). A funcao e o caminho do usuario comum: compila regras em SQL
+# sem privil√©gio de service_role. Todas as chamadas a funcao aqui usam
+# `SET ROLE authenticated` antes de executar; nenhum teste depende de
+# service_role (a role so existe para as policies da tabela).
+#
+# Roda contra um PostgreSQL 17 descartavel (docker), no mesmo formato dos
+# testes irmaos (scripts/db-audit/talkx-audience-rpc.test.sh). Aplica a
+# MIGRATION REAL do repo DUAS vezes (idempotencia), com psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
+# e sem mascarar falha (sem `|| true` na aplicacao). Prova, com SQL executado:
+#   (a) a migration aplica e e idempotente (2a aplicacao verde na mesma base);
+#   (b) tabela existe com as colunas corretas e 18 linhas enabled=true;
+#   (c) RLS habilitado; policy SELECT para authenticated; policy ALL para
+#       service_role; authenticated sem escrita; authenticated com SELECT;
+#   (d) authenticated pode EXECUTAR a funcao (sem service_role);
+#   (e) valor malicioso "30) OR 1=1 --" em in_last_days E em not_in_last_days e
+#       RECUSADO com 22023 antes de compor SQL (item 1 do criterio);
+#   (f) valor valido (30 dias) compila predicado correto e, executado contra
+#       contatos reais, seleciona so o contato de 10 dias (dentro de 30) e nao
+#       o de 40 dias (item 2 do criterio);
+#   (g) not_in_last_days com 30 dias seleciona so o contato de 40 dias;
+#   (h) campo invalido e operador invalido para o campo -> 22023;
+#   (i) valor nao numerico em campo number -> 22023;
+#   (j) valor com aspa simples e escapado por quote_literal (sem injecao).
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011003001_talkx_segment_fields.sql"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_SEGMENT_FIELDS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="talkx-segment-fields-test-$$"
+test_password="talkx_segment_fields_test_only"
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$1"; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+# Predicado compilado, executando a funcao como `authenticated`.
+compile_auth() { printf '%s\n' "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT public.talkx_compile_segment_rules(:'json'::jsonb);" | docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -v json="$1" -Atq; }
+
+# Consulta SQL qualquer como `authenticated` (a funcao e a leitura de contacts
+# nao exigem service_role).
+query_auth() { printf '%s\n' "SET ROLE authenticated; $1" | docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atq; }
+
+# Espera 22023 com a mensagem certa, executando a funcao como `authenticated`.
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" message="$2" errcode="$3" json="$4" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(printf '%s\n' "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT public.talkx_compile_segment_rules(:'json'::jsonb);" | \
+        docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v VERBOSITY=verbose -U postgres -d postgres -v json="$json" -Atq 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$message"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava a mensagem '$message'"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$errcode"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava o SQLSTATE '$errcode'"; }
+  pass "$label"
+}
+
+start_postgres() {
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL container failed to start (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL bootstrap was not stable (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+    docker logs "$container_name" >&2 || true
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+
+start_postgres || fail 'PostgreSQL de teste nao iniciou'
+
+# Roles que a migration espera. DO block idempotente: sem `|| true` mascarando
+# falha e reaplicavel na mesma base.
+psql_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'anon') THEN CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'authenticated') THEN CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN; END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'service_role') THEN CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN; END IF;
+END
+$$;
+SQL
+
+# Aplica a migration real DUAS vezes. Operador que falha de verdade: se o psql
+# sair != 0, a pipeline sob pipefail derruba o script (sem mascarar).
+apply_migration() {
+  cat "$migration" | psql_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 || fail "Falha ao aplicar a migration real ($1)"
+}
+apply_migration '1a aplicacao'
+apply_migration '2a aplicacao (idempotencia)'
+pass 'migration aplicada e idempotente (2a aplicacao verde na mesma base)'
+
+# (b) Tabela existe com as colunas corretas e 18 linhas enabled.
+psql_test -Atqc "SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='talkx_segment_fields'" | grep -q 1 || fail 'tabela talkx_segment_fields nao existe'
+for col in field category source expr kind ops enabled; do
+  psql_test -Atqc "SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='talkx_segment_fields' AND column_name='$col'" | grep -q 1 || fail "coluna $col nao existe"
+done
+row_count=$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_segment_fields")
+(( row_count == 18 )) || fail "esperado 18 linhas seedadas, encontrou $row_count"
+enabled_count=$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_segment_fields WHERE enabled=true")
+(( enabled_count == 18 )) || fail "esperado 18 linhas enabled, encontrou $enabled_count"
+pass 'tabela existe com as colunas corretas e 18 linhas enabled=true'
+
+# (c) RLS, policies e grants.
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE relname='talkx_segment_fields'")" == t ]] || fail 'RLS nao habilitado'
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT polpermissive FROM pg_policy WHERE polname='talkx_segment_fields_select' AND polcmd='r'")" == t ]] || fail 'policy SELECT ausente'
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT polpermissive FROM pg_policy WHERE polname='talkx_segment_fields_service_role_write' AND polcmd='*'")" == t ]] || fail 'policy ALL ausente'
+for role in anon authenticated; do
+  [[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT has_table_privilege('$role','public.talkx_segment_fields','INSERT')")" == f ]] || fail "role $role nao deveria ter escrita"
+done
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.talkx_segment_fields','SELECT')")" == t ]] || fail 'authenticated deveria ter SELECT'
+pass 'RLS/policies/grants da tabela corretos'
+
+# (d) authenticated executa a funcao (sem service_role).
+[[ "$(psql_test -Atqc "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.talkx_compile_segment_rules(jsonb,integer)','EXECUTE')")" == t ]] || fail 'authenticated deveria poder EXECUTAR a funcao'
+pass 'authenticated pode EXECUTAR talkx_compile_segment_rules'
+
+# Contatos de fixture para provar que o predicado compilado seleciona de verdade.
+psql_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  email text, tags text[], company text, city text, state text,
+  group_category text, channel_type text, lead_origin text, assigned_to uuid,
+  contact_type text, conversation_status text, lead_score numeric,
+  risk_score numeric, ai_priority text, ai_sentiment text, consent_status text,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+INSERT INTO public.contacts (id, email, created_at) VALUES
+  ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'dentro@example.com', now() - interval '10 days'),
+  ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'fora@example.com',   now() - interval '40 days');
+GRANT SELECT ON public.contacts TO authenticated;
+" >/dev/null
+
+# (e) ITEM 1: valor malicioso recusado com 22023 nos DOIS ramos de data.
+inject='{"groups":[{"match":"and","rules":[{"field":"created_at","op":"in_last_days","value":"30) OR 1=1 --"}]}]}'
+expect_error 'in_last_days recusa "30) OR 1=1 --" com 22023' 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' '22023' "$inject"
+inject_neg='{"groups":[{"match":"and","rules":[{"field":"updated_at","op":"not_in_last_days","value":"30) OR 1=1 --"}]}]}'
+expect_error 'not_in_last_days recusa "30) OR 1=1 --" com 22023' 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' '22023' "$inject_neg"
+
+# (f) ITEM 2: valor valido (30 dias) compila predicado correto e seleciona so o contato dentro da janela.
+in30='{"groups":[{"match":"and","rules":[{"field":"created_at","op":"in_last_days","value":"30"}]}]}'
+pred_in30="$(compile_auth "$in30")"
+[[ -n "$pred_in30" ]] || fail 'predicado de in_last_days 30 nao deveria ser vazio'
+[[ "$pred_in30" == *"c.created_at"* ]] || fail "predicado deveria citar c.created_at, veio: $pred_in30"
+[[ "$pred_in30" == *">="* && "$pred_in30" == *"::timestamptz"* ]] || fail "predicado deveria ser >= ...::timestamptz, veio: $pred_in30"
+count_in30="$(query_auth "SELECT count(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE $pred_in30")"
+(( count_in30 == 1 )) || fail "in_last_days 30 deveria achar 1 contato, achou $count_in30"
+pass 'in_last_days 30 compila predicado correto e seleciona so o contato de 10 dias'
+
+# (g) not_in_last_days 30 seleciona so o contato de 40 dias.
+not30='{"groups":[{"match":"and","rules":[{"field":"created_at","op":"not_in_last_days","value":"30"}]}]}'
+pred_not30="$(compile_auth "$not30")"
+[[ "$pred_not30" == *"<"* && "$pred_not30" == *"::timestamptz"* ]] || fail "predicado deveria ser < ...::timestamptz, veio: $pred_not30"
+count_not30="$(query_auth "SELECT count(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE $pred_not30")"
+(( count_not30 == 1 )) || fail "not_in_last_days 30 deveria achar 1 contato, achou $count_not30"
+pass 'not_in_last_days 30 seleciona so o contato de 40 dias'
+
+# (h) campo invalido e operador invalido para o campo -> 22023.
+bad_field='{"groups":[{"match":"and","rules":[{"field":"campo_inexistente","op":"eq","value":"x"}]}]}'
+expect_error 'campo invalido gera 22023' 'invalid_talkx_segment_field' '22023' "$bad_field"
+bad_op='{"groups":[{"match":"and","rules":[{"field":"tags","op":"eq","value":"x"}]}]}'
+expect_error 'operador invalido para o campo gera 22023' 'invalid_talkx_segment_operator' '22023' "$bad_op"
+
+# (i) valor nao numerico em campo number -> 22023 (contrato do valor).
+bad_num='{"groups":[{"match":"and","rules":[{"field":"lead_score","op":"gt","value":"abc"}]}]}'
+expect_error 'valor nao numerico em number gera 22023' 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' '22023' "$bad_num"
+
+# (j) aspa simples no valor e escapada por quote_literal (sem injecao).
+esc="{\"groups\":[{\"match\":\"and\",\"rules\":[{\"field\":\"email\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":\"a' OR 1=1 --\"}]}]}"
+pred_esc="$(compile_auth "$esc")"
+[[ "$pred_esc" == *"'a'' OR 1=1 --'"* ]] || fail "o valor deveria sair escapado por quote_literal, veio: $pred_esc"
+pass 'valor com aspa simples sai escapado por quote_literal'
+
+printf '\n=== TODOS OS TESTES PASSARAM ===\n'

+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" message="$2" errcode="$3" sql="$4" out status
+  set +e
+  out="$(psql_test -v VERBOSITY=verbose -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status != 0 )) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$message"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava a mensagem '$message'"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$errcode"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$label: esperava o SQLSTATE '$errcode'"; }
+  pass "$label"
+}

+    done
+  done
+  return 1

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# X103 (Fase 9 ¬∑ telas 02/03 ¬∑ banco + testes ¬∑ DDL: sim) ‚Äî estatisticas da
+# biblioteca de segmentos (talkx_segment_library_stats).
+#
+# Contrato em PostgreSQL 17 descartavel, no mesmo formato dos testes irmaos
+# (scripts/db-audit/talkx-overview-stats.test.sh). Aplica a migration REAL
+# (supabase/migrations/20261009063248_talkx_segment_library_stats.sql) sobre um
+# schema minimo com os objetos que ela toca, e prova:
+#
+#   BLOCO A (vermelho, ANTES da migration):
+#     (A1) nao existe a RPC public.talkx_segment_library_stats(text);
+#     (A2) nao existe a tabela public.talkx_segment_library_history;
+#     (A3) o KPI da tela hoje ("Ativos este mes" = status='active') conta 3
+#          segmentos enquanto o USO REAL do mes e 2 ‚Äî e sem a migration o
+#          servidor nao tem como devolver o numero certo.
+#
+#   BLOCO B (verde, DEPOIS da migration):
+#     (a) objetos + ACL: anon sem EXECUTE/SELECT; authenticated so le (nao
+#         executa a rotina de escrita); service_role executa a rotina; RLS
+#         ligada na tabela nova com a policy de leitura;
+#     (b) KPIs: total_segments, active_this_month (uso real), variacao contra o
+#         mes anterior, crm360_connected e sua variacao;
+#     (c) conversao media com base suficiente (150 entregues / 15 conversoes =
+#         10,0%) e delta_pp contra o mes anterior (120/6 = 5,0%);
+#     (d) campanha em RASCUNHO nao conta como uso nem entra nas entregas;
+#     (e) campanha MULTI-SEGMENTO (talkx_campaign_segments) conta como uso;
+#     (f) sem dados suficientes (< 100 entregues) a conversao vem SEM NUMERO
+#         (value_pct null, has_data false) ‚Äî nunca 0 nem percentual inventado;
+#     (g) serie de 8 meses vinda do historico; mes sem retrato => has_data false;
+#     (h) escopo: o agente ve so o proprio (RLS sobre funcao SECURITY INVOKER) e
+#         nao le o retrato da biblioteca (fail-closed);
+#     (i) idempotencia: rodar a rotina duas vezes no dia mantem 1 linha por mes;
+#         chamar como authenticated e negado;
+#     (j) entrada invalida (0, 37, null, fuso invalido) estoura;
+#     (k) tudo ou nada: falha artificial no meio da rotina nao deixa NADA gravado;
+#     (l) migration replayavel (segunda aplicacao nao falha e nao duplica).
+#
+# AUSENCIA DE MEDICAO CONTA COMO FALHA: cada caso registra sua execucao em
+# CASES_SEEN e o harness FALHA no fim se algum caso esperado nao tiver rodado.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261009063248_talkx_segment_library_stats.sql"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_SEGMENT_LIBRARY_STATS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="talkx-segment-library-stats-test-$$"
+test_password="talkx_segment_library_stats_test_only"
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$1"; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_q() { psql_test -Atqc "$1"; }
+psql_err() { # psql_err "<sql>" -> imprime o stderr do psql (nao aborta)
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc "$1" 2>&1 || true
+}
+
+# --- registro dos casos (ausencia de medicao = falha) -----------------------
+declare -A CASES_SEEN=()
+declare -a CASES_EXPECTED=(
+  before_rpc_absent before_history_absent before_naive_kpi
+  objects_acl backfill_monthly
+  kpi_totals kpi_usage kpi_delta
+  conversion_base conversion_previous
+  draft_nao_conta multi_segmento
+  sem_base_minima
+  serie_8_meses serie_sem_retrato
+  escopo_agente escopo_agente_serie
+  idempotencia rotina_negada_authenticated
+  entrada_invalida atomicidade
+  replay
+)
+case_done() { CASES_SEEN["$1"]=1; }
+
+start_postgres() {
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: container PostgreSQL nao subiu (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL descartavel nao estabilizou (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $migration"
+
+start_postgres || fail 'PostgreSQL de teste nao iniciou'
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Schema minimo: os objetos que a migration referencia, no formato ANTERIOR a
+# ela. Espelha as colunas reais de profiles / user_roles / talkx_segments /
+# talkx_campaigns / talkx_campaign_segments (X057) / talkx_recipients /
+# talkx_conversions (E90+X021) e as policies de RLS do modulo.
+#
+# Todas as datas do fixture saem de date_trunc('month', agora em
+# America/Sao_Paulo) ‚Äî nada de "now() - N dias", que cruza a virada do mes e
+# faria o teste piscar.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+psql_test >/dev/null <<'SQL'
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid
+$$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''), current_user)
+$$;
+CREATE ROLE anon;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated;
+CREATE ROLE service_role BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL,
+  UNIQUE (user_id, role)
+);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
+    WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin', 'supervisor')
+  )
+$$;
+
+-- talkx_segments (20260908120000 + 20260928370000)
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_segments (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text,
+  origin text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zapp',
+  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
+  is_favorite boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  rules jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"groups":[]}'::jsonb,
+  estimated_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+  last_used_at timestamptz,
+  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT talkx_segments_origin_check CHECK (origin IN ('zapp','crm360','custom')),
+  CONSTRAINT talkx_segments_status_check CHECK (status IN ('active','inactive'))
+);
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_segments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY talkx_segments_select ON public.talkx_segments
+  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (
+    (created_by = (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1))
+    OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+  );

+-- talkx_campaigns (recorte: as colunas que a X103 le)
+CREATE TABLE public.talkx_campaigns (

+  completed_at timestamptz,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);

+CREATE POLICY "Admins can view all campaign segments" ON public.talkx_campaign_segments

+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# BLOCO A ‚Äî o defeito existe ANTES da migration (vermelho)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT to_regprocedure('public.talkx_segment_library_stats(text)') IS NULL")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail '(A1) a RPC talkx_segment_library_stats ja existia antes da migration'
+case_done before_rpc_absent
+pass '(A1) antes da migration nao existe public.talkx_segment_library_stats(text)'
+
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT to_regclass('public.talkx_segment_library_history') IS NULL")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail '(A2) a tabela de historico ja existia antes da migration'
+case_done before_history_absent
+pass '(A2) antes da migration nao existe public.talkx_segment_library_history'
+
+admin_session="SET ROLE authenticated; SET request.jwt.claim.role='authenticated'; SET request.jwt.claim.sub='20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';"
+
+naive="$(psql_q "$admin_session SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_segments WHERE status='active'")"
+[[ "$naive" == '4' ]] || fail "(A3) o KPI atual (status='active') deveria contar 4 [obtido: $naive]"
+case_done before_naive_kpi
+pass '(A3) o KPI do navegador (status=active) conta 4, mas o uso real do mes e 3 ‚Äî numero errado, sem RPC que corrija'
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# BLOCO B ‚Äî aplica a migration REAL e prova a correcao
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+psql_test < "$migration" >/dev/null || fail 'a migration nao aplicou'
+pass '(0) migration aplicada sobre o schema minimo'
+
+# --- (a) objetos, RLS e ACL -------------------------------------------------
+stats_sig='public.talkx_segment_library_stats(text)'
+month_sig='public.talkx_segment_library_month(date,text)'
+refresh_sig='public.talkx_refresh_segment_library_history(integer,text)'
+for sig in "$stats_sig" "$month_sig" "$refresh_sig"; do
+  [[ "$(psql_q "SELECT to_regprocedure('$sig') IS NOT NULL")" == 't' ]] || fail "(a) funcao ausente: $sig"
+done
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT to_regclass('public.talkx_segment_library_history') IS NOT NULL")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail '(a) tabela de historico ausente'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE oid='public.talkx_segment_library_history'::regclass")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail '(a) tabela de historico nasceu SEM RLS'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='talkx_segment_library_history'")" == '1' ]] \
+  || fail '(a) a tabela de historico deveria ter exatamente a policy de leitura'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$stats_sig','EXECUTE')")" == 'f' ]] || fail '(a) anon com EXECUTE na RPC'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('anon','$month_sig','EXECUTE')")" == 'f' ]] || fail '(a) anon com EXECUTE na medicao de mes'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT has_table_privilege('anon','public.talkx_segment_library_history','SELECT')")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail '(a) anon com SELECT no historico'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$stats_sig','EXECUTE')")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail '(a) authenticated sem EXECUTE na RPC'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('authenticated','$refresh_sig','EXECUTE')")" == 'f' ]] \
+  || fail '(a) authenticated pode executar a rotina de escrita (deveria ser so service_role)'
+[[ "$(psql_q "SELECT has_function_privilege('service_role','$refresh_sig','EXECUTE')")" == 't' ]] \
+  || fail '(a) service_role sem EXECUTE na rotina'
+case_done objects_acl
+pass '(a) objetos criados, RLS ligada, anon sem acesso, authenticated so le, rotina so do service_role'
+
+# --- (b) retrato inicial (backfill da migration) ----------------------------
+rows_total="$(psql_q 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_segment_library_history')"
+rows_months="$(psql_q "SELECT count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', counted_on)) FROM public.talkx_segment_library_history")"
+[[ "$rows_total" == '8' && "$rows_months" == '8' ]] \
+  || fail "(b) retrato inicial deveria ter 8 linhas em 8 meses [linhas: $rows_total, meses: $rows_months]"
+case_done backfill_monthly
+pass '(b) a serie nasce preenchida: 8 linhas, uma por mes (backfill idempotente da migration)'
+
+# helper: le um caminho do JSON dos KPIs no escopo de um papel
+kpi_from() { psql_q "$1 SELECT public.talkx_segment_library_stats()$2"; }
+
+# --- (c) KPIs ---------------------------------------------------------------
+total="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'total_segments'")"
+crm="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'crm360_connected'")"
+[[ "$total" == '5' ]] || fail "(c) total_segments esperado 5 [obtido: $total]"
+[[ "$crm" == '2' ]] || fail "(c) crm360_connected esperado 2 [obtido: $crm]"
+case_done kpi_totals
+pass '(c) total_segments=5 e crm360_connected=2 (admin ve todo o escopo)'
+
+ativo="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'active_this_month'")"
+[[ "$ativo" == '3' ]] || fail "(c) active_this_month esperado 3 (uso real: C1+s1, C2+s2, C5+s4) [obtido: $ativo]"
+case_done kpi_usage
+pass '(c) active_this_month=3 = uso REAL (rascunho C3 e os 2 segmentos ociosos nao contam; discorda do status=active)'
+
+prev="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'active_previous_month'")"
+delta="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'active_delta'")"
+crmprev="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'crm360_previous_month'")"
+crmdelta="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'crm360_delta'")"
+[[ "$prev" == '1' ]] || fail "(c) active_previous_month esperado 1 [obtido: $prev]"
+[[ "$delta" == '2' ]] || fail "(c) active_delta esperado 2 [obtido: $delta]"
+[[ "$crmprev" == '1' ]] || fail "(c) crm360_previous_month esperado 1 [obtido: $crmprev]"
+[[ "$crmdelta" == '1' ]] || fail "(c) crm360_delta esperado 1 [obtido: $crmdelta]"
+case_done kpi_delta
+pass '(c) variacao contra o mes anterior: ativos 1->3 (+2) e crm360 1->2 (+1)'
+
+# --- (d) conversao media com base suficiente --------------------------------
+del="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->'conversion'->>'deliveries'")"
+conv="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->'conversion'->>'conversions'")"
+val="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->'conversion'->>'value_pct'")"
+has="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->'conversion'->>'has_data'")"
+pval="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->'conversion'->>'previous_pct'")"
+dpp="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->'conversion'->>'delta_pp'")"
+minb="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->'conversion'->>'min_deliveries'")"
+[[ "$del" == '170' ]] || fail "(d) deliveries esperado 170 (C1 150 + C5 20; as 5 entregas do rascunho nao contam) [obtido: $del]"
+[[ "$conv" == '17' ]] || fail "(d) conversions esperado 17 (C1 15 + C5 2) [obtido: $conv]"
+[[ "$val" == '10.0' ]] || fail "(d) value_pct esperado 10.0 [obtido: $val]"
+[[ "$has" == 'true' ]] || fail "(d) has_data deveria ser true com 170 entregues [obtido: $has]"
+[[ "$minb" == '100' ]] || fail "(d) min_deliveries esperado 100 [obtido: $minb]"
+case_done conversion_base
+pass '(d) conversao media 10,0% (17/170) ‚Äî rascunho C3 fora das entregas'
+
+[[ "$pval" == '5.0' ]] || fail "(d) previous_pct esperado 5.0 (6/120 do mes anterior) [obtido: $pval]"
+[[ "$dpp" == '5.0' ]] || fail "(d) delta_pp esperado 5.0 [obtido: $dpp]"
+case_done conversion_previous
+pass '(d) variacao da conversao contra o mes anterior = +5,0 p.p.'
+
+# --- (e) rascunho nao conta como uso nem entra nas entregas -----------------
+[[ "$ativo" == '3' && "$del" == '170' ]] \
+  || fail "(e) o rascunho C3 (segmento s1, 5 entregues) entrou na conta [ativos=$ativo entregues=$del]"
+case_done draft_nao_conta
+pass '(e) campanha em rascunho (started_at nulo) nao conta como uso nem como entrega'
+
+# --- (f) multi-segmento (X057) conta como uso -------------------------------
+# O fixture liga s2 SO pela lista talkx_campaign_segments (nenhuma campanha tem
+# segment_id = s2): tirando a linha da lista o uso cai, devolvendo-a o uso volta.
+na_lista="$(psql_q "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments WHERE segment_id='40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002')")"
+sem_link="$(psql_q "SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_campaigns WHERE segment_id='40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'")"
+psql_q "DELETE FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments WHERE segment_id='40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'" >/dev/null
+sem_lista="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'active_this_month'")"
+psql_q "INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaign_segments (campaign_id, segment_id, position, status)
+        VALUES ('50000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002','40000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',1,'sending')" >/dev/null
+com_lista="$(kpi_from "$admin_session" "->>'active_this_month'")"
+[[ "$na_lista" == 't' && "$sem_link" == '0' && "$sem_lista" == '2' && "$com_lista" == '3' ]] \

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# X176 (TL-164) ‚Äî "Criar RPCs de leitura da supress√£o: listagem paginada, KPIs e atividade".
+#
+# Prova, em PostgreSQL 17 descart√°vel, aplicando a MIGRATION REAL, as tr√™s fun√ß√µes
+# SECURITY INVOKER de leitura da supress√£o:
+#   * public.talkx_suppression_list(...)      -> {total, rows} paginado no servidor
+#   * public.talkx_suppression_stats(p_days)  -> valor, valor anterior e s√©rie de 8 pontos
+#   * public.talkx_suppression_activity(...)  -> eventos de entidade suppression*
+# Executa como os pap√©is REAIS ‚Äî admin e supervisor pelo JWT (authenticated), anon e
+# service_role pelo papel do banco ‚Äî nunca como postgres nas asser√ß√µes ‚Äî com RLS ligada
+# e as policies vivas reproduzidas no fixture. Caminho de service_role nesta entrega:
+# SEM EXECUTE nas tr√™s RPCs (a barreira exige admin/supervisor e service_role n√£o tem
+# auth.uid()); o passo prova o GRANT negado e o permission denied, n√£o uma chamada.
+# Roteiro (cada bloco tem o estado ANTERIOR e o estado com a migration):
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî agente (sem papel) recebe 42501 nas tr√™s; anon e service_role n√£o t√™m
+#             EXECUTE; supervisor l√™ as tr√™s com o JWT real;
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî KPIs: opt-outs do per√≠odo = 3 (o de 40 dias fora), ativos n√£o contam expirado
+#             nem removido, prote√ß√£o conta s√≥ campanha iniciada com respect_suppression;
+#   BLOCO C ‚Äî listagem: total constante entre p√°ginas, limite/offset, filtro de status,
+#             busca por e-mail, busca por d√≠gitos de telefone e telefone avulso sem contato;
+#   BLOCO D ‚Äî entrada inv√°lida (limite, offset, dire√ß√£o, ordena√ß√£o, status, dias) = 22023;
+#   BLOCO E ‚Äî atividade recente l√™ os eventos suppression* com ator e contato;
+#   BLOCO F ‚Äî rollback executado a partir do PR√ìPRIO arquivo da migration e reaplica√ß√£o.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
+postgres_image="${TALKX_SUPPRESSION_READ_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="talkx-suppression-read-test-$$"
+test_password="talkx_suppression_read_test_only"
+
+migration=$(grep -rlF 'talkx_suppression_read_rpcs' "$repo_root/supabase/migrations" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/_superseded/' | sort | tail -1 || true)
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+start_postgres() {
+  # Runner hospedado pode reportar o PostgreSQL pronto um instante antes de o container
+  # reiniciar. Exige duas sondas seguidas e repete S√ì o bootstrap descart√°vel; falha de
+  # SQL/assercao nunca √© repetida.
+  local attempt
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: container PostgreSQL nao subiu (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    local _
+    for _ in $(seq 1 20); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL descartavel nao estabilizou (tentativa %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+
+[ -n "$migration" ] || fail 'migration de X176 (talkx_suppression_read_rpcs) nao encontrada'
+[ -f "$migration" ] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+printf '== migration sob teste: %s\n' "${migration#"$repo_root"/}"
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s)\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+
+start_postgres || fail 'PostgreSQL de teste nao iniciou'

+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT COALESCE(
+       NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+       NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+     )::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT COALESCE(
+       NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role',

+as_user() { # as_user <jwt> <sql>
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql" | tail -n1

+as_role() { # as_role <papel> <sql>
+  local papel="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE $papel; $sql" 2>&1 | tail -n1
+}
+as_admin() { # sa√≠da crua (sem tail) da chamada como admin, para o erro aparecer no r√≥tulo
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$ADMIN', false); $1"
+}

+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" raw a
+  raw="$(as_admin "$s" 2>&1 || true)"
+  a="$(printf '%s\n' "$raw" | tail -n1)"
+  if [ "$a" != "$e" ]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$raw" | tr '\n' ' ' >&2; printf '\n' >&2
+    fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_value_as() { # expect_value_as <r√≥tulo> <esperado> <jwt> <sql>
+  local l="$1" e="$2" jwt="$3" s="$4" raw a
+  raw="$(as_user "$jwt" "$s" 2>&1 || true)"
+  a="$(printf '%s\n' "$raw" | tail -n1)"
+  if [ "$a" != "$e" ]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$raw" | tr '\n' ' ' >&2; printf '\n' >&2
+    fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_error() { # expect_error <r√≥tulo> <trecho> <jwt|papel> <sql>
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" quem="$3" s="$4" out st
+  set +e
+  case "$quem" in
+    admin)      out="$(as_user "$ADMIN" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$? ;;
+    supervisor) out="$(as_user "$SUPERVISOR" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$? ;;
+    agente)     out="$(as_user "$AGENTE" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$? ;;
+    *)          out="$(as_role "$quem" "$s")"; st=$? ;;
+  esac
+  set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-126b (fonte X083, parte 2 de 2): prova por script as 8 colunas novas de
+# public.talkx_templates criadas pela migration 20261011000020_talkx_templates_channel_media_archive.sql
+# (cartao N-126a) ‚Äî tipo, default, CHECK, o carater E SO ADITIVO e a PRESERVACAO DO RLS.
+#
+# NAO recria talkx_templates a mao (foi a recusa do revisor nas duas tentativas
+# anteriores: "o teste faz CREATE TABLE talkx_templates a mao, o que e uma copia
+# e nao o codigo real"). Aplica, EM ORDEM, os ARQUIVOS de migration reais de
+# supabase/migrations/ ‚Äî inclusive 20260908120000_talkx_segments_templates_events.sql,
+# que e quem cria a tabela ‚Äî e so entao a migration alvo. O pre-estado que o
+# Supabase teria (schema auth, roles da API, profiles, helpers, contacts e
+# whatsapp_connections) e stub, como nos harnesses irmaos: e infraestrutura da
+# plataforma anterior as migrations do modulo, nao a tabela sob teste.
+#
+# RLS (recusa do revisor): a prova de RLS NAO compara authenticated com o dono.
+# Semeia linhas ANTES da migration alvo, le-as como authenticated NESSE momento
+# (BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub; COMMIT) e,
+# DEPOIS da migration alvo, repete a MESMA leitura e compara: as colunas antigas
+# vem identicas e as linhas pre-existentes recebem channel='whatsapp' e archived_at
+# NULL (prova o NOT NULL DEFAULT sobre dados ja gravados). Alem disso compara a
+# assinatura de pg_policies e as flags relrowsecurity/relforcerowsecurity de
+# talkx_templates antes e depois da migration alvo.
+#
+# Vermelho->verde: sem o arquivo da migration alvo em supabase/migrations/ (base
+# SEM o N-126a) a primeira assercao de coluna FALHA; com o arquivo presente PASSA.
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migrations_dir="$repo_root/supabase/migrations"
+postgres_image="${TALKX_TEMPLATE_COLUMNS_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="talkx-template-columns-test-$$"
+test_password="talkx_template_columns_test_only"
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_test() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+psql_at() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres "$@"; }
+
+migration() {
+  local file="$migrations_dir/$1"
+  [[ -f "$file" ]] || fail "migration ausente: $1"
+  printf '  ¬∑ %s\n' "$1" >&2
+  psql_test < "$file" >/dev/null
+}
+
+# Le como o papel authenticated REAL, com claim setada, num bloco explicito.
+read_as_authenticated() {
+  psql_at <<SQL
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222';
+$1;
+COMMIT;
+SQL

+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ PostgreSQL 17 descartavel LOCAL (nenhum ambiente real) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+
+start_postgres() {
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    if ! docker run -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$test_password" "$postgres_image" >/dev/null; then
+      printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL container failed to start (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+      continue
+    fi
+    for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
+      if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        sleep 1
+        if docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -U postgres -d postgres -Atqc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          return 0
+        fi
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+    done
+    printf 'WARN: PostgreSQL bootstrap was not stable (attempt %s/3)\n' "$attempt" >&2
+    docker logs "$container_name" >&2 || true
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+start_postgres || fail 'PostgreSQL de teste n√£o iniciou'

+state() { psql_test -Atqc "SELECT revision::text || ':' || COALESCE(launch_confirmations::text,'null') FROM public.talkx_campaigns WHERE id='$1'"; }

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# R2-MOD-052 / item 420 (P2) ‚Äî "Reagendar alarme pelo Salvar nao rearma uma tarefa que ja foi
+# notificada".
+#
+# CAMINHO: o cartao autoriza `tests/db-audit/...`, mas essa pasta NAO existe neste repo (tests/ so
+# tem contracts/) e o canonico desta area e `scripts/db-audit/*.test.sh`: o E48 de
+# scripts/ci/check-test-inventory.mjs e o db-guard.yml varrem SO `scripts/db-audit`, e as outras
+# 192 provas de banco moram la. O arquivo fica no canonico (igual a rodada anterior do #420);
+# o desvio do caminho escrito no cartao fica registrado no relato deste refazer.
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro no mesmo Postgres descartavel, em dois blocos:
+#
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ATUAL (o defeito), fiel ao canonico: com o gatilho de estado
+#     trg_task_state_change (WHEN NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status), um UPDATE que lista
+#     SO remind_at ‚Äî a forma exata do Salvar da ficha da tarefa ‚Äî nao passa por nenhum gatilho,
+#     entao notified_at continua preenchido, o notify_due_tasks() nunca mais ve a linha e o
+#     alarme novo nao dispara.
+#
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada (arquivo real em supabase/migrations/): mudar remind_at rearma
+#     a tarefa (notified_at volta a NULL), e os caminhos vizinhos seguem intactos: Adiar
+#     (notified_at explicito no patch), desfazer cancelamento/conclusao do R2-MOD-053 (que
+#     reescreve remind_at E notified_at do snapshot), UPDATE que nao lista remind_at (titulo,
+#     position/upsert de reordenacao) e o gatilho de estado ‚Äî tudo com o gatilho de forja
+#     (trg_prevent_conversation_task_field_forgery) ATIVO no replay e provado vivo em B.31/B.32.

+set -Eeuo pipefail

+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"

+migration="$(ls "$repo_root"/supabase/migrations/*_tasks_rearm_on_remind_change.sql 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
+postgres_image="${TASKS_REARM_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-tasks-rearm-test-$$"

+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-tasks-rearm-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi

+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" jwt="$3" sql="$4" actual
+  actual="$(as_user "$jwt" "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_ok_as() {
+  local label="$1" jwt="$2" sql="$3"
+  as_user "$jwt" "$sql" >/dev/null || fail "$label: deveria ter sucesso (como authenticated)"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$sql" 2>&1)"; status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub',
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')
+     ), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'

+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (

+  description text,

+  CONSTRAINT conversation_tasks_waiting_reason_check

+CREATE TABLE public.notifications (

+CREATE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1; $function$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() TO authenticated;

+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(auth.role(), session_user) = ANY (ARRAY['service_role','postgres','supabase_admin']) $$;

+-- DUPLO DE TESTE DO REPLAY: a canonica is_contact_visible_to_user (20260909200000) consulta
+-- contacts, queue_members, get_visible_agent_ids e get_profile_id_for_user ‚Äî tabelas que este
+-- replay NAO tem. A assinatura e a mesma; devolver `false` ja basta para o gatilho de forja
+-- abaixo exercitar o ramo do contact_id de verdade (a excecao so sai se a funcao negar a
+-- visibilidade ‚Äî provado em B.31).
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_contact_visible_to_user(_contact_id uuid, _user_id uuid)
+  RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+  AS $$ SELECT false $$;

+-- Corpo CANONICO do gatilho de forja (20260924110946, forma canonicalizada em
+-- 20261003272707:1126-1132). Replica fiel: e o gatilho que dispara antes do rearme em UPDATE
+-- de authenticated e precisa existir neste replay para que B.3-B.5 e B.15-B.17 valham com ele
+-- ativo; os dois ramos sao provados vivos em B.31/B.32.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_conversation_task_field_forgery()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $f$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_id
+     AND NEW.contact_id IS NOT NULL
+     AND NOT public.is_contact_visible_to_user(NEW.contact_id, auth.uid())
+  THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sem permissao para atribuir este contato a task';
+  END IF;
+  IF (
+    NEW.assigned_to IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.assigned_to
+    OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
+  )
+  AND NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+  THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sem permissao para alterar responsavel ou criador da task';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$f$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql
+  AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END $$;
+
+-- Corpo CANONICO do gatilho de estado (20260928140000 / 20261003272707), sem nenhum ramo de alarme.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.conversation_task_state_trigger() RETURNS trigger
+  LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
+    NEW.status_changed_at := now();
+    IF NEW.status = 'doing' AND OLD.started_at IS NULL THEN
+      NEW.started_at := now();
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.status IN ('done', 'cancelled') THEN
+      NEW.completed_at := COALESCE(OLD.completed_at, now());
+      NEW.remind_at    := NULL;
+      NEW.notified_at  := NULL;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.conversation_task_set_assignee() RETURNS trigger
+  LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.assigned_to := NEW.created_by; RETURN NEW; END; $function$;
+
+-- Corpo CANONICO endurecido do notify_due_tasks (20260930141000).
+CREATE FUNCTION public.notify_due_tasks() RETURNS integer
+  LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$
+DECLARE v_count integer := 0; v_task record;
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.is_privileged_contact_caller() THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  FOR v_task IN
+    SELECT t.id, t.title, t.created_by, t.contact_id, t.remind_at, p.user_id
+    FROM public.conversation_tasks t
+    JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = t.created_by
+    WHERE t.remind_at <= now() AND t.notified_at IS NULL AND t.status NOT IN ('done','cancelled')
+  LOOP
+    INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, title, message, type, metadata)
+    VALUES (v_task.user_id, 'Lembrete: ' || v_task.title, 'x', 'reminder_due',
+            jsonb_build_object('task_id', v_task.id));
+    UPDATE public.conversation_tasks SET notified_at = now() WHERE id = v_task.id;
+    v_count := v_count + 1;
+  END LOOP;
+  RETURN v_count;
+END;
+$function$;

+ALTER TABLE public.conversation_tasks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

+CREATE POLICY tasks_select_own ON public.conversation_tasks FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (created_by = public.current_profile_id() OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+CREATE POLICY tasks_insert_own ON public.conversation_tasks FOR INSERT TO authenticated

+CREATE POLICY tasks_update_own ON public.conversation_tasks FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
+  USING (created_by = public.current_profile_id() OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()))
+  WITH CHECK (created_by = public.current_profile_id() OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+CREATE POLICY tasks_delete_own ON public.conversation_tasks FOR DELETE TO authenticated
+  USING (created_by = public.current_profile_id() OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.conversation_tasks TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.notify_due_tasks() TO service_role;
+
+-- Gatilhos canonicos da tabela (a ordem de disparo e alfabetica pelo nome, nao esta).
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_conversation_task_field_forgery
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.conversation_tasks
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  WHEN (
+    NEW.contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_id
+    OR NEW.assigned_to IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.assigned_to

+CREATE TRIGGER update_conversation_tasks_updated_at
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.conversation_tasks

+CREATE TRIGGER trg_task_state_change
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.conversation_tasks
+  FOR EACH ROW

+CREATE TRIGGER trg_task_set_assignee
+  BEFORE INSERT ON public.conversation_tasks
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.conversation_task_set_assignee();

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# TC-002 (#55) ‚Äî "RPC ativa de conversa direta perdeu a prote√ß√£o contra cria√ß√£o concorrente"
+# (docs/reconciliation/reports/team-chat/CODE_DATABASE_TRUTH_TEAM_CHAT.md, TC-002).
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro no mesmo container, em tr√™s blocos:
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ATIVO (defeito), montado com as migrations REAIS do reposit√≥rio:
+#             aplica 20260927270007 (par + √≠ndice √∫nico do par + 1¬™ vers√£o da RPC) e
+#             20260929190000 (corpo ativo hoje: SELECT por membros + INSERT s√≥ com
+#             type/created_by; a reconcilia√ß√£o 20261003272707 repete esse mesmo corpo).
+#             Prova: duas transa√ß√µes concorrentes para o MESMO par devolvem ids
+#             DIFERENTES e deixam DUAS conversas diretas, as duas com o par NULL.
+#             (√â a "muta√ß√£o": sem a corre√ß√£o, o BLOCO B n√£o passa.)
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada: as mesmas duas transa√ß√µes devolvem o MESMO id, fica UMA
+#             conversa com os DOIS membros (ambos com member_role padr√£o 'member')
+#             e o par ordenado gravado; os dois lados conseguem LER a conversa por
+#             RLS; legado sem par n√£o duplica; self e other_profile_id nulo s√£o
+#             rejeitados; a ACL n√£o muda.
+#   BLOCO C ‚Äî idempot√™ncia e ROLLBACK: reaplica a migration; EXECUTA o bloco
+#             `-- Rollback:` extra√≠do do pr√≥prio arquivo da migration e prova, pelo
+#             COMPORTAMENTO, que o corpo anterior voltou (a corrida duplica de novo);
+#             reaplica a migration e confirma a corre√ß√£o de volta.
+#
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/tc002-direct-conversation-race.test.sh
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261006222858_tc002_find_or_create_direct_pair_upsert.sql"
+pre_e16="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260927270007_team_chat_e16_find_or_create_direct_conversation.sql"
+pre_e29="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260929190000_team_chat_e29_conversations_constraints.sql"
+postgres_image="${TC002_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-tc002-direct-pair-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  [[ -n "${tmp_dir:-}" ]] && rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-tc002-direct-pair-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+pass() { printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$1"; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  pass "$l"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" j="$3" s="$4" a
+  a="$(as_user "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  pass "$l"
+}
+expect_error_as() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" j="$3" s="$4" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_user "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  pass "$l"
+}
+
+# Primeira linha que √© um uuid ‚Äî a sess√£o que dorme imprime tamb√©m a linha vazia do pg_sleep.
+first_uuid() { grep -m1 -E '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' "$1" | tr -d '[:space:]'; }
+
+# Duas transa√ß√µes SIMULT√ÇNEAS para o mesmo par: a 1¬™ segura a transa√ß√£o aberta (pg_sleep),
+# a 2¬™ entra ~1s depois, enquanto a 1¬™ ainda n√£o commitou.
+race_pair() {  # <jwt_1> <alvo_1> <jwt_2> <alvo_2> <saida_1> <saida_2>
+  local jwt1="$1" alvo1="$2" jwt2="$3" alvo2="$4" out1="$5" out2="$6" p1
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt1', false); SELECT public.find_or_create_direct_conversation('$alvo1'); SELECT pg_sleep(3);" \
+    > "$out1" 2>&1 &
+  p1=$!
+  sleep 1
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt2', false); SELECT public.find_or_create_direct_conversation('$alvo2');" \
+    > "$out2" 2>&1 || true
+  wait "$p1" || true
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+for f in "$migration" "$pre_e16" "$pre_e29"; do
+  [[ -f "$f" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $f"
+done
+
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s) ==\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null

+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break; else ready=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'

+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"

+# ---- fixtures: roles, auth, profiles e as duas tabelas do team chat (formato can√¥nico) ----
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+     )::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  role text DEFAULT 'agent',
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true
+);
+

+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text
+);

+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  department_id uuid REFERENCES public.departments(id),
+  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
+  CONSTRAINT team_conversations_type_check CHECK (type IN ('direct', 'group', 'department'))
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversation_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

+  is_muted boolean DEFAULT false,
+  is_pinned boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  is_archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  member_role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  UNIQUE (conversation_id, profile_id),
+  CONSTRAINT team_conversation_members_member_role_check CHECK (member_role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member'))
+);
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1; $function$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(_user_id uuid, _conversation_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.team_conversation_members tcm
+      JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = tcm.profile_id
+      WHERE tcm.conversation_id = _conversation_id AND p.user_id = _user_id
+    );
+  $function$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- RLS de leitura como no reposit√≥rio: cada um v√™ s√≥ as conversas de que participa.
+ALTER TABLE public.team_conversations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.team_conversation_members ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY team_conversations_select_members ON public.team_conversations FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (public.is_team_conversation_member(auth.uid(), id)
+         OR created_by = (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1));

+  USING (public.is_team_conversation_member(auth.uid(), conversation_id));
+
+GRANT SELECT ON public.team_conversations TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.team_conversation_members TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO authenticated;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# R2-DB-020 (P1). Contrato de autoriza√ß√£o da m√≠dia do Team Chat ‚Äî a ACL de leitura
+# de storage.objects (bucket team-chat-files) e a persist√™ncia de
+# team_messages.media_path precisam derivar da LINHA EXTERNA do objeto
+# (storage.objects.name, qualifica√ß√£o expl√≠cita) e do usu√°rio autenticado ‚Äî nunca de
+# profiles.name.
+#
+# DEFEITO (pr√©-migration): a policy "Conversation members can read team chat files"
+# (20260927270012) comparava `tm.media_path = name` sem qualifica√ß√£o. No subselect o
+# `name` resolve para profiles.name (a tabela profiles est√° no JOIN). Um usu√°rio cujo
+# profiles.name fosse igual ao media_path de uma mensagem de conversa da qual participa
+# liberava a leitura de QUALQUER objeto do bucket, inclusive de conversa alheia.
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro no mesmo container:
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (policy vulner√°vel): prova o vazamento.
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada: prova a corre√ß√£o e preserva membro/dono/admin; e
+#             prova o CHECK que vincula media_path a sender_id/conversation_id.
+#   BLOCO E ‚Äî contrato de ESCRITA: a policy de INSERT team_chat_files_insert
+#             (20260928560000, j√° vigente antes desta migration) exige 1¬∫ segmento =
+#             current_profile_id ‚Äî alinhada ao formato can√¥nico que o frontend grava
+#             (TeamFileUploader.tsx / useTeamChatDraft.ts: <profile_id>/<conversation_id>/
+#             <opaco>). Sem policy de UPDATE (UPDATE revogado em 20260928560000).
+#   BLOCO C ‚Äî ROLLBACK REAL: aplica o SQL da linha "-- Rollback:" da migration e
+#             prova que ela recria uma leitura equivalente E segura (objects.name
+#             qualificado), n√£o a vers√£o vulner√°vel, nem "bucket sem policy"; e que
+#             DEVOLVE o dado (media_bucket das linhas reconciliadas, a partir da
+#             tabela de apoio) e apaga essa tabela.
+#
+# EFEITO COLATERAL COBERTO: o gatilho BEFORE UPDATE update_team_messages_updated_at
+# (20260402130912, corpo real reproduzido) regravaria updated_at de toda linha
+# reconciliada. O seed d√° data FIXA √† linha legada e o teste prova que ela N√ÉO muda
+# (a migration suspende o gatilho s√≥ na transa√ß√£o) e que o gatilho volta ligado.
+#
+# TRANSI√á√ÉO DO LEGADO (coberta de prop√≥sito ‚Äî √© o ponto cobrado na revis√£o): o
+# seed inclui uma linha de team_messages que reivindica media_bucket=
+# 'team-chat-files' com media_path FORA da chave can√¥nica (formato antigo
+# <auth_uid>/<opaco>). O teste prova, em ordem:
+#   - uma sonda com ADD CONSTRAINT VALIDADO equivalente falha nesse estado
+#     (prova que o legado existia e que NOT VALID era necess√°rio);
+#   - a migration aplica mesmo assim (CHECK entra NOT VALID, n√£o bloqueia);
+#   - INSERT/UPDATE novo com caminho divergente √© recusado j√° na hora;
+#   - a linha legada foi reconciliada (media_bucket anulado, media_path
+#     preservado como trilha) e a constraint termina convalidada;
+#   - um objeto em <auth_uid>/..., leg√≠vel pelo dono sob a policy antiga, deixa
+#     de ser leg√≠vel sob a nova (dono = current_profile_id, n√£o auth.uid), com
+#     o admin ainda lendo como controle.
+#
+# Pr√©-estado fiel: storage.objects + storage.foldername (defini√ß√£o viva do Supabase),
+# profiles/team_conversations/team_conversation_members/team_messages, helpers
+# is_admin_or_supervisor/current_profile_id/is_team_conversation_member, a policy
+# vulner√°vel de 20260927270012 (SELECT) e a policy de INSERT de 20260928560000.
+# A chave can√¥nica √© <profile_id>/<conversation_id>/<opaco>.
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261013235908_team_chat_media_acl_r2_db_020.sql"
+postgres_image="${R2DB020_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-r2db020-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-r2db020-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  if [[ "$actual" != "$expected" ]]; then
+    fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c '\set VERBOSITY verbose' -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"
+  fi
+  if [[ "$output" != *"$needle"* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1))
+    if (( ready_checks >= 2 )); then break; fi
+  else
+    ready_checks=0
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ infraestrutura Supabase (auth, papeis, storage) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub',
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')
+     ), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA storage;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA storage TO authenticated, anon, service_role;
+CREATE TABLE storage.buckets (
+  id text PRIMARY KEY,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  public boolean DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE storage.objects (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  bucket_id text NOT NULL,
+  name text NOT NULL
+);
+ALTER TABLE storage.objects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+-- Defini√ß√£o viva do Supabase para storage.foldername (retorna os segmentos, exceto o √∫ltimo).
+CREATE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text) RETURNS text[] LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+DECLARE _parts text[];
+BEGIN
+  SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
+  RETURN _parts[1:array_length(_parts,1)-1];
+END $$;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  name text NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL,
+  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role)
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversations (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct',
+  name text,
+  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversation_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  last_read_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+  is_muted boolean DEFAULT false,
+  UNIQUE (conversation_id, profile_id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.team_messages (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  sender_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  content text NOT NULL,
+  message_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text',
+  media_url text,
+  media_type text,
+  media_bucket text,
+  media_path text,
+  is_edited boolean DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+-- Gatilho BEFORE UPDATE vivo no esquema real (20260402130912): regrava updated_at
+-- em qualquer UPDATE de team_messages. Reproduzido para provar que a reconcilia√ß√£o
+-- da migration N√ÉO reescreve a data das mensagens antigas.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql
+  SET search_path = public AS $$
+BEGIN
+  NEW.updated_at = now();
+  RETURN NEW;
+END $$;
+CREATE TRIGGER update_team_messages_updated_at
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.team_messages
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
+
+-- Helpers (mesmas assinaturas/corpos do esquema vigente).
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin','supervisor')) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1 $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(_user_id uuid, _conversation_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
+  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.team_conversation_members tcm
+                JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = tcm.profile_id
+                WHERE tcm.conversation_id = _conversation_id AND p.user_id = _user_id) $$;
+
+-- RLS das tabelas de Team Chat (s√≥ o que a policy sob teste referencia).
+ALTER TABLE public.team_messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY "Members can view conversation messages" ON public.team_messages FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (public.is_team_conversation_member(auth.uid(), conversation_id));
+ALTER TABLE public.team_conversation_members ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY "Members can view conversation members" ON public.team_conversation_members FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (public.is_team_conversation_member(auth.uid(), conversation_id));
+
+-- Grants do ator (authenticated l√™ as tabelas citadas pelas policies; profiles fica
+-- leg√≠vel porque a policy ANTERIOR referencia profiles.name no subselect).
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.team_messages TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.team_conversation_members TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON storage.objects TO authenticated;
+-- Conforme 20260928560000: UPDATE foi revogado de authenticated ‚Äî n√£o h√° policy
+-- de UPDATE no bucket; quem grava s√≥ INSERTa (e DELETE fica fora do escopo).
+REVOKE UPDATE ON storage.objects FROM authenticated;
+
+-- POLICY DE INSERT VIGENTE (20260928560000), reproduzida fielmente: o 1¬∫ segmento do
+-- nome do objeto deve ser o profile_id do uploader ‚Äî √© a metade "escrita" do
+-- contrato can√¥nico <profile_id>/<conversation_id>/<opaco> que o frontend grava.
+CREATE POLICY team_chat_files_insert ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
+  WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'team-chat-files' AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = (public.current_profile_id())::text);
+
+-- POLICY VULNER√ÅVEL (20260927270012), reproduzida fielmente.
+CREATE POLICY "Conversation members can read team chat files" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT USING (
+  bucket_id = 'team-chat-files' AND (
+    (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
+    OR is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+    OR EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.team_messages tm
+      JOIN public.team_conversation_members mem ON mem.conversation_id = tm.conversation_id
+      JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = mem.profile_id
+      WHERE tm.media_bucket = 'team-chat-files' AND tm.media_path = name AND p.user_id = auth.uid()
+    )
+  )
+);
+SQL
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ seed ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+OWNER_PATH='b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa/opaque1.png'
+O2_PATH='d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/2bbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb/opaque2.png'
+
+LEGACY_TS='2026-01-02 03:04:05+00'
+RB_TABLE='team_chat_media_acl_r2_db_020_rb'
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" <<SQL
+DELETE FROM public.team_messages;
+DELETE FROM public.team_conversation_members;
+DELETE FROM public.team_conversations;
+DELETE FROM public.user_roles;
+DELETE FROM public.profiles;
+DELETE FROM storage.objects;
+
+INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, user_id, name) VALUES
+  ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', 'Alice Admin'),
+  ('b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222', 'Bob Owner'),
+  -- MEMBER: profiles.name √© deliberadamente IGUAL ao media_path de M1 ‚Äî √© o que a
+  -- policy vulner√°vel casa (tm.media_path = p.name), liberando objeto de conversa alheia.
+  ('c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333', '$OWNER_PATH'),
+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444', 'Dave Outsider');
+
+INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', 'admin');
+
+INSERT INTO public.team_conversations (id, type, name) VALUES
+  ('1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'group', 'conversa-1'),
+  ('2bbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb', 'group', 'conversa-2');
+
+INSERT INTO public.team_conversation_members (conversation_id, profile_id) VALUES
+  ('1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'),
+  ('1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'),
+  ('1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'),
+  ('2bbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb', 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+
+INSERT INTO public.team_messages (conversation_id, sender_id, content, message_type, media_bucket, media_path, updated_at) VALUES
+  ('1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'file1', 'image', 'team-chat-files', '$OWNER_PATH', '$LEGACY_TS'),
+  -- LINHA LEGADA: reivindica media_bucket='team-chat-files' com media_path fora da
+  -- chave can√¥nica ‚Äî 1¬∫ segmento √© o auth.uid do remetente (formato antigo
+  -- <auth_uid>/<opaco> da policy de INSERT anterior a 20260928560000), n√£o o
+  -- sender_id b000.... Serve para provar que a migration reconcilia dados
+  -- preexistentes em vez de assumir tabela vazia.
+  ('1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'legacy file', 'image', 'team-chat-files', '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/legacy.png', '$LEGACY_TS');
+
+INSERT INTO storage.objects (bucket_id, name) VALUES
+  ('team-chat-files', '$OWNER_PATH'),
+  ('team-chat-files', '$O2_PATH'),
+  ('team-chat-files', 'shortpath'),
+  -- Formato LEGADO <auth_uid>/<opaco> (policy de INSERT anterior a 20260928560000):
+  -- objeto do Bob (auth.uid 2222...) que a policy antiga deixava o dono ler.
+  ('team-chat-files', '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/legacy.png');
+SQL
+
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/pre.sql"
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/seed.sql"
+
+# ‚îÄ‚îÄ sess√µes de ator ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+as_actor() { # $1 = user_id (auth.uid), $2 = SQL
+  printf "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{\"sub\":\"%s\",\"role\":\"authenticated\"}', false); %s" "$1" "$2"
+}
+ADMIN_UID='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'
+OWNER_UID='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222'
+MEMBER_UID='33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'
+OUTSIDER_UID='44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444'
+
+echo '‚îÄ‚îÄ BLOCO A: comportamento ANTES da migration (o defeito) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ'
+
+# A1 (RED): MEMBER (Carol) N√ÉO deveria ler o objeto de C2, mas a policy vulner√°vel
+#           casa tm.media_path com profiles.name e libera.
+expect_value 'A1 (defeito) membro l√™ objeto de conversa ALHEIA' '1' \
