+expect_value 'A1b controle: membro l√™ o pr√≥prio objeto da conversa' '1' \
+  "$(as_actor "$MEMBER_UID" "SELECT count(*) FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='team-chat-files' AND name='$OWNER_PATH';")"
+
+# A2 (controle do legado): sob a policy ANTIGA o dono lia o objeto em
+# <auth_uid>/<opaco> (foldername[1] = auth.uid). Serve de contraste com o BLOCO B,
+# que prova o abandono desse formato.
+expect_value 'A2 controle: formato legado <auth_uid>/ era leg√≠vel pelo dono' '1' \
+  "$(as_actor "$OWNER_UID" "SELECT count(*) FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='team-chat-files' AND name='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/legacy.png';")"
+
+echo
+echo '‚îÄ‚îÄ Sonda: um ADD CONSTRAINT VALIDADO falharia neste estado (prova do legado) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ'
+# A mesma express√£o do CHECK da migration, aplicada j√° VALIDADA, √© recusada pela
+# linha legada do seed ‚Äî prova de que a tabela N√ÉO estava limpa e de que a
+# estrat√©gia NOT VALID + reconcilia√ß√£o + VALIDATE √© necess√°ria.
+expect_error 'L1 ADD CONSTRAINT validado equivalente falha com linha legada' \
+  'check constraint "probe_r2db020_canonical" of relation "team_messages" is violated by some row' \
+  "ALTER TABLE public.team_messages ADD CONSTRAINT probe_r2db020_canonical CHECK (media_bucket IS DISTINCT FROM 'team-chat-files' OR (media_path IS NOT NULL AND split_part(media_path, '/', 1) = sender_id::text AND split_part(media_path, '/', 2) = conversation_id::text AND split_part(media_path, '/', 3) <> ''));"
+psql_sql "ALTER TABLE public.team_messages DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS probe_r2db020_canonical;" >/dev/null
+printf '[PASS] sonda removida (probe_r2db020_canonical)\n'
+
+echo
+echo '‚îÄ‚îÄ Aplicando a migration ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ'
+psql_file "$migration"
+printf '[PASS] migration aplicada mesmo com linha legada (CHECK NOT VALID nao bloqueia)\n'
+
+echo
+echo '‚îÄ‚îÄ Transi√ß√£o do legado: reconcilia√ß√£o + convalida√ß√£o ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ'
+# INSERT novo com caminho divergente √© recusado j√° na hora ‚Äî NOT VALID vale para
+# toda escrita daqui pra frente.
+expect_error 'L2 insert novo com caminho divergente recusado j√° sob NOT VALID' \
+  'violates check constraint "team_messages_media_path_matches_sender_conversation"' \
+  "INSERT INTO public.team_messages (conversation_id, sender_id, content, media_bucket, media_path) VALUES ('1aaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa','b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001','x','team-chat-files','22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/legacy.png');"
+# A linha legada foi reconciliada: media_bucket anulado (deixa de reivindicar um
+# arquivo do bucket) e media_path preservado como trilha.
+expect_value 'L3 linha legada reconciliada: media_bucket anulado, media_path preservado' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.team_messages WHERE media_bucket IS NULL AND media_path='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/legacy.png';"
+# VALIDATE varreu a tabela inteira: constraint termina convalidada.
+expect_value 'L4 constraint termina convalidada (convalidated = true)' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='team_messages_media_path_matches_sender_conversation' AND contype='c' AND convalidated;"
+# EFEITO COLATERAL do UPDATE (gatilho BEFORE UPDATE): a data da mensagem legada N√ÉO
+# pode ser reescrita pela reconcilia√ß√£o.
+expect_value 'L5 reconcilia√ß√£o preserva updated_at (gatilho suspenso no UPDATE)' 't' \
+  "SELECT updated_at = '$LEGACY_TS'::timestamptz FROM public.team_messages WHERE media_path='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/legacy.png';"
+expect_value 'L6 gatilho update_team_messages_updated_at volta LIGADO' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.team_messages'::regclass AND tgname='update_team_messages_updated_at' AND tgenabled='O' AND NOT tgisinternal;"
+# Tabela de apoio do rollback: guardou o valor ANTIGO, tem RLS ligada e ningu√©m al√©m
+# do dono (que roda a migration) tem GRANT nela.
+expect_value 'L7 tabela de apoio guardou o valor antigo da linha reconciliada' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.$RB_TABLE WHERE media_bucket='team-chat-files';"
+expect_value 'L8 tabela de apoio tem RLS ligada' '1' \

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-070: view team_message_read_state com security_invoker = true.
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro no mesmo container, em dois blocos:
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito): a view nao existe.
+#             Consultar team_message_read_state falha com "relation does not exist".
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada: a view existe.
+#             Com 3 membros (A, B, C) e 1 nao-membro (D):
+#               * A envia mensagem; all_read = false (B e C nao leram).
+#               * B le; all_read = false (C nao leu).
+#               * C le; all_read = true (todos os outros leram).
+#               * D (nao membro) nao enxerga nenhuma linha.
+#
+# Pre-estado fiel ao canonico: tabelas team_messages, team_conversation_members,
+# team_message_receipts e helpers is_team_conversation_member / current_profile_id.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261009214931_team_message_read_state_view.sql"
+postgres_image="${TEAM_READ_STATE_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-team-read-state-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-team-read-state-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" jwt="$3" sql="$4" actual
+  actual="$(as_user "$jwt" "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_ok_as() {
+  local label="$1" jwt="$2" sql="$3"
+  as_user "$jwt" "$sql" >/dev/null || fail "$label: deveria ter sucesso (como authenticated)"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_error_anon() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE anon; $sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_error_as() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" jwt="$3" sql="$4" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(as_user "$jwt" "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=*** "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1)); (( ready_checks >= 2 )) && break
+  else ready_checks=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+
+# Schema base + helpers + dados de teste.
+cat > "$tmp_dir/setup.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+     )::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       'authenticated'
+     )::text $$;
+
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  role text DEFAULT 'agent',
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL,
+  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role)
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversations (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct',
+  name text,
+  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversation_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  last_read_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+  is_muted boolean DEFAULT false,
+  UNIQUE (conversation_id, profile_id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.team_messages (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  sender_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  content text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  message_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.team_message_receipts (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  message_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  conversation_id uuid REFERENCES public.team_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'delivered',
+  delivered_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+  read_at timestamptz,
+  UNIQUE (message_id, profile_id),
+  CONSTRAINT team_receipts_status_check CHECK (status IN ('delivered','read'))
+);
+
+-- Helper functions BEFORE RLS policies that reference them.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1; $function$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() TO authenticated;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(_user_id uuid, _conversation_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+AS $function$
+  SELECT EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM public.team_conversation_members tcm
+    JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = tcm.profile_id

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# N-072 ‚Äî get_team_messages_page: (a) desempate do cursor por (created_at, id); (b) p_limit <= 0 recusado.
+#
+# Mesmo roteiro no mesmo container:
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (migration 20260930280000): mensagens com o mesmo created_at somem na
+#             paginacao por cursor e p_limit zero devolve vazio sem erro.
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration nova aplicada: paginacao sem duplicata nem lacuna, limite invalido recusado,
+#             guardas de autorizacao, ACL e teto de 200 preservados.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+base_migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20260930280000_team_rpc_ambiguity_and_tcm_recursion.sql"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261010064729_team_messages_page_cursor_tiebreak_and_min_limit.sql"
+postgres_image="${TEAM_CHAT_PAGE_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-team-page-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-team-page-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+as_user() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$1', false); $2"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(as_user "$ATILA" "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_error_as() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e; output="$(as_user "$ATILA" "$sql" 2>&1)"; status=$?; set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+# Percorre o historico inteiro com paginas de $1 itens, usando o ultimo id de cada pagina como cursor.
+# Imprime os ids na ordem em que chegaram (uma linha por mensagem).
+walk_pages() {
+  local size="$1" cursor="NULL" out="" page last guard=0
+  while (( guard++ < 20 )); do
+    page="$(as_user "$ATILA" "SELECT id FROM public.get_team_messages_page('$CONV_A'::uuid, $cursor, $size);" | grep -E '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' || true)"
+    [[ -z "$page" ]] && break
+    out+="$page"$'\n'
+    last="$(tail -n1 <<<"$page")"
+    cursor="'$last'::uuid"
+  done
+  printf '%s' "$out"
+}

+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'

+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"

+ready=0

+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'

+  is_edited boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,

+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

+ALTER TABLE public.team_messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_team_messages_page(p_conversation_id uuid, p_before_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)

+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_team_messages_page(uuid, uuid, integer) TO authenticated;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Prova em PostgreSQL DESCARTAVEL da migration user_sessions_expire_diario (N-008).
+#   1. RED: expire_user_sessions nao existe antes da migration.
+#   2. GREEN: sessao vencida vira is_active=false com ended_at; sessao valida nao muda.
+#   3. Cron: 1 job diario (stub de cron.schedule); reaplicar nao duplica.
+#   4. Privilegio: authenticated/anon nao executam; service_role executa.
+#   5. Rollback: a linha -- Rollback: remove funcao e job.
+# Uso: bash scripts/db-audit/user-sessions-expire.test.sh
+set -euo pipefail
+
+MIGRATION="supabase/migrations/20261010063527_user_sessions_expire_diario.sql"
+CNAME="usess-expire-$$-$(date +%s)"
+PSQL=(docker exec -i "$CNAME" psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U postgres -d postgres)
+
+cleanup() { docker rm -f "$CNAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+[ -f "$MIGRATION" ] || { echo "[FALHOU] migration nao encontrada: $MIGRATION"; exit 1; }
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$CNAME" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=postgres postgres:17-alpine >/dev/null
+for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
+  docker exec "$CNAME" pg_isready -U postgres -d postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
+  sleep 1
+done
+docker exec "$CNAME" pg_isready -U postgres -d postgres >/dev/null
+
+# fixtures: papeis, stub de pg_cron e user_sessions minima (mesmas colunas da tabela real)
+"${PSQL[@]}" <<'SQL'
+create role anon;
+create role authenticated;
+create role service_role;
+create schema cron;
+create table cron.job (jobid serial primary key, jobname text unique, schedule text, command text);
+create function cron.schedule(p_name text, p_schedule text, p_command text) returns bigint
+  language sql as $f$
+  insert into cron.job (jobname, schedule, command) values (p_name, p_schedule, p_command)
+  on conflict (jobname) do update set schedule = excluded.schedule, command = excluded.command
+  returning jobid::bigint $f$;
+create function cron.unschedule(p_name text) returns boolean
+  language sql as $f$
+  with d as (delete from cron.job where jobname = p_name returning 1) select exists (select 1 from d) $f$;
+create table public.user_sessions (
+  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid not null,
+  is_active boolean default true,
+  started_at timestamptz not null default now(),
+  expires_at timestamptz not null default (now() + interval '24 hours'),
+  ended_at timestamptz
+);
+insert into public.user_sessions (id, user_id, expires_at) values
+  ('11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', now() - interval '2 hours'),
+  ('22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', now() + interval '2 hours');
+SQL
+
+if "${PSQL[@]}" -c "select public.expire_user_sessions()" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  echo "[FALHOU] expire_user_sessions ja existia antes da migration"; exit 1
+fi
+echo "[OK] RED: expire_user_sessions nao existia antes"
+
+"${PSQL[@]}" -f /dev/stdin < "$MIGRATION"
+"${PSQL[@]}" -f /dev/stdin < "$MIGRATION"   # idempotente
+
+N="$("${PSQL[@]}" -Atc "set role service_role; select public.expire_user_sessions()" | tail -1)"
+[ "$N" = "1" ] || { echo "[FALHOU] deveria encerrar 1 sessao, encerrou $N"; exit 1; }
+VENC="$("${PSQL[@]}" -Atc "select is_active::text || ',' || (ended_at is not null)::text from public.user_sessions where id='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111'")"
+[ "$VENC" = "false,true" ] || { echo "[FALHOU] sessao vencida: $VENC"; exit 1; }
+VALI="$("${PSQL[@]}" -Atc "select is_active::text || ',' || (ended_at is null)::text from public.user_sessions where id='22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222'")"
+[ "$VALI" = "true,true" ] || { echo "[FALHOU] sessao valida mudou: $VALI"; exit 1; }
+echo "[OK] GREEN: vencida encerrada com ended_at; valida intacta"
+
+JOBS="$("${PSQL[@]}" -Atc "select count(*) || ',' || min(schedule) from cron.job where jobname='user-sessions-expire-diario' and command like '%expire_user_sessions()%'")"
+[ "$JOBS" = "1,17 3 * * *" ] || { echo "[FALHOU] job diario: $JOBS"; exit 1; }
+echo "[OK] GREEN: 1 job diario no pg_cron (stub), sem duplicar ao reaplicar"
+
+for R in authenticated anon; do
+  if "${PSQL[@]}" -Atc "BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE $R; SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims TO '{\"sub\":\"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000\",\"role\":\"$R\"}'; SELECT public.expire_user_sessions(); ROLLBACK;" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "[FALHOU] $R executou expire_user_sessions"; exit 1
+  fi
+done
+echo "[OK] privilegio: authenticated/anon negados (SET LOCAL ROLE em transacao, com request.jwt.claims)"
+
+ROLLBACK="$(sed -n 's/^-- Rollback: //p' "$MIGRATION" | head -1)"
+"${PSQL[@]}" -c "$ROLLBACK"
+LEFT="$("${PSQL[@]}" -Atc "select (select count(*) from cron.job) + (select count(*) from pg_proc where proname='expire_user_sessions')")"
+[ "$LEFT" = "0" ] || { echo "[FALHOU] rollback deixou resto: $LEFT"; exit 1; }
+echo "[OK] rollback remove funcao e job"
+echo "[PASSOU] user-sessions-expire"

+  && proof.database === 'postgres'
+  && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(proof.runtime_sha256 || '');
+let targetOk = false;

+    && proof.security_definer === true

+# Saida VERBOSA do erro de uma chamada (mensagem + SQLSTATE + contexto), como o PostgREST/cliente
+# enxergam. E a "resposta" que o oraculo de UUID usa -- comparar o TEXTO COMPLETO das duas chamadas
+# e mais forte do que comparar so o status: pega mensagem, SQLSTATE e o ponto do codigo.
+# Filtra as linhas de diagnostico: o `SET ROLE`/`set_config` antes da chamada imprime o proprio
+# json de claims no stdout e a ordem stdout/stderr varia entre execucoes (ruido do harness, nao
+# da resposta). As linhas ERROR/CONTEXT/LOCATION sao o que o atacante le.
+psql_err() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c '\set VERBOSITY verbose' -c "$1" 2>&1 \
+    | grep -E '^(ERROR|DETAIL|HINT|CONTEXT|LOCATION):' || true
+}
+
+# Duas chamadas do MESMO chamador nao podem produzir respostas distinguiveis.
+expect_resposta_identica() {
+  local label="$1" sql_a="$2" sql_b="$3" a b
+  a="$(psql_err "$sql_a")"
+  b="$(psql_err "$sql_b")"
+  if [[ -z "$a" ]]; then
+    fail "$label: a chamada com uuid inexistente NAO deu erro (as duas deveriam recusar IGUAL)"
+  fi
+  if [[ "$a" != "$b" ]]; then
+    printf 'A (uuid inexistente):\n%s\nB (uuid fora do alcance):\n%s\n' "$a" "$b" >&2
+    fail "$label: respostas DIFERENTES -- oraculo de UUID aberto"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+# O defeito (SEC-RLS-02): as duas respostas TEM de diferir antes da correcao.
+expect_resposta_diferente() {
+  local label="$1" sql_a="$2" sql_b="$3" a b
+  a="$(psql_err "$sql_a")"
+  b="$(psql_err "$sql_b")"
+  if [[ "$a" == "$b" ]]; then
+    printf 'A:\n%s\nB:\n%s\n' "$a" "$b" >&2
+    fail "$label: as duas respostas sao IGUAIS (o defeito esperado nao esta la)"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+# expect_error + proibicao de ecoar um trecho (o uuid do alvo nao pode aparecer no erro).
+expect_error_sem_eco() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" proibido="$3" sql="$4" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c '\set VERBOSITY verbose' -c "$sql" 2>&1)"
+  status=$?
+  set -e
+  if (( status == 0 )); then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"
+  fi
+  if [[ "$output" != *"$needle"* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"
+  fi
+  if [[ "$output" == *"$proibido"* ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
+    fail "$label: o erro ECOOU o alvo ('$proibido') -- oraculo"
+  fi
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# TRA-004 / item 174 (P2, area migrations) ‚Äî "Troca de conexao padrao nao e
+# atomica e anuncia sucesso sem verificar erros".
+#
+# Roda o MESMO roteiro no mesmo container, em dois blocos:
+#   BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito), fiel ao canonico:
+#             * o par de UPDATE do hook (desmarca por `id <> alvo`, marca por
+#               `id = alvo`) nao tem transacao; a PRIMEIRA operacao sozinha ja
+#               deixa ZERO conexao padrao;
+#             * a segunda operacao com alvo inexistente afeta 0 linhas e NAO
+#               devolve erro ‚Äî a interface anuncia sucesso sem nada ter mudado;
+#             * nao existe RPC: nao ha primitiva atomica para o hook consumir.
+#   BLOCO B ‚Äî migration 20261006234158 aplicada:
+#             * set_default_whatsapp_connection troca a padrao numa unica
+#               transacao (exatamente uma padrao ao final);
+#             * falha (alvo inexistente, entrada nula) mantem a padrao anterior;
+#             * idempotente;
+#             * autorizacao = mesma policy de UPDATE (is_admin_or_supervisor);
+#               nao-admin e anon recusados; erro SEM oraculo (mesma mensagem
+#               para id inexistente e para chamador sem permissao);
+#             * concorrencia: a troca e secao critica (advisory lock) ‚Äî a RPC
+#               bloqueia enquanto outro detem a chave, e N chamadas concorrentes
+#               terminam com exatamente UMA padrao, sem erro 23505;
+#             * efeito colateral: o gatilho de updated_at so reescreve as linhas
+#               de fato alteradas (a conexao intocada preserva updated_at).
+#
+# Aplica o ARQUIVO REAL da migration; roda como o PAPEL REAL (authenticated/anon).
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261006234158_whatsapp_default_connection_rpc_atomica.sql"
+postgres_image="${WHATSAPP_DEFAULT_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-wa-default-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-wa-default-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() {
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"
+}
+psql_file() {
+  docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"
+}
+as_user() {
+  local jwt="$1" sql="$2"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$jwt', false); $sql"
+}
+as_anon() {
+  local sql="$1"
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE anon; $sql"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" s="$3" a
+  a="$(psql_sql "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_value_as() {
+  local l="$1" e="$2" j="$3" s="$4" a
+  a="$(as_user "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_ok_as() { local l="$1" j="$2" s="$3"; as_user "$j" "$s" >/dev/null || fail "$l: deveria ter sucesso (como authenticated)"; printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"; }
+expect_result_as() { # rotulo, esperado, jwt, sql
+  local l="$1" e="$2" j="$3" s="$4" a
+  a="$(as_user "$j" "$s" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$a" == "$e" ]] || fail "$l: esperado '$e', obtido '$a'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_error_as() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" j="$3" s="$4" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_user "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+expect_error_anon() {
+  local l="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" out st
+  set +e; out="$(as_anon "$sql" 2>&1)"; st=$?; set -e
+  (( st == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$out" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; fail "$l: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$l"
+}
+err_text_as() { # jwt, sql -> texto do erro (linha 'ERROR: ...'), sem o prefixo do psql
+  local j="$1" s="$2" out
+  set +e
+  out="$(as_user "$j" "$s" 2>&1)"
+  set -e
+  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -m1 -E 'ERROR|ERROR:|ERRO' | sed -E 's/^[^E]*ERROR:[[:space:]]*//' || true
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration"
+
+printf '== container: %s (imagem %s) ==\n' "$container_name" "$postgres_image"
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=$((ready + 1)); (( ready >= 2 )) && break; else ready=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto de forma estavel'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+     )::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  role text DEFAULT 'agent',
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  role text NOT NULL,
+  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role)
+);
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $f$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1; $f$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() TO authenticated;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public'
+  AS $f$
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
+      WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role IN ('admin', 'supervisor')
+    );
+  $f$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Estado canonico anterior da tabela (create 20251215024517 + indices 20260925190000).
+CREATE TABLE public.whatsapp_connections (
+  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  phone_number text NOT NULL,
+  instance_id text,
+  status text DEFAULT 'disconnected' CHECK (status IN ('connected', 'disconnected', 'connecting', 'qr_pending')),
+  qr_code text,
+  is_default boolean DEFAULT false,
+  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  instance_token_secret_id uuid
+);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whatsapp_connections_instance_id_key
+  ON public.whatsapp_connections (instance_id) WHERE instance_id IS NOT NULL;
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whatsapp_connections_one_default
+  ON public.whatsapp_connections (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() RETURNS trigger
+  AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public;
+CREATE TRIGGER update_whatsapp_connections_updated_at
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.whatsapp_connections FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
+
+ALTER TABLE public.whatsapp_connections ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can view connections" ON public.whatsapp_connections
+  FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
+CREATE POLICY "Admins can insert connections" ON public.whatsapp_connections
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+CREATE POLICY "Admins can update connections" ON public.whatsapp_connections
+  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+CREATE POLICY "Admins can delete connections" ON public.whatsapp_connections
+  FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.whatsapp_connections TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.user_roles TO authenticated;
+SQL
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" <<'SQL'
+DELETE FROM public.whatsapp_connections;

+INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, user_id, role, is_active) VALUES

+psql_file "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" >/dev/null
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" >/dev/null

+ADM='{"sub":"11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","role":"authenticated"}'
+AGENTE='{"sub":"22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222","role":"authenticated"}'
+
+C1='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+C2='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
+C3='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'
+C4='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'
+C_BOGUS='c0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000dead'
+
+printf '\n============ BLOCO A ‚Äî estado ANTERIOR (defeito) ============\n'
+
+expect_value 'A.0 ponto de partida: exatamente 1 padrao e e o C1' "$C1" \
+  "SELECT id FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+# O hook faz `.update({is_default:false}).neq('id', id)` como PRIMEIRO update
+# (roda como authenticated). Nao ha transacao: essa operacao sozinha ja apaga a
+# padrao anterior ‚Äî inclusive nas linhas que nao sao o alvo.
+expect_value_as 'A.1 (DEFEITO) 1o UPDATE do hook (`is_default=false`, id <> alvo) roda sozinho' '3' "$ADM" \
+  "WITH up AS (
+     UPDATE public.whatsapp_connections SET is_default = false WHERE id <> '$C2' RETURNING 1
+   ) SELECT count(*) FROM up;"
+expect_value 'A.2 (DEFEITO) ...e deixa ZERO conexao padrao (falha entre as duas operacoes)' '0' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+# O gatilho BEFORE UPDATE grava updated_at em TODA linha que o UPDATE toca (nao so
+# nas que mudam de valor). O 1o UPDATE do hook toca 3 linhas (todas menos o alvo).
+expect_value 'A.2b (DEFEITO) ...e o gatilho regravou updated_at em 3 linhas' '3' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE updated_at > '2020-01-04 00:00:00+00';"
+
+# O 2o update mira o alvo; se o alvo nao casa (id sumiu / digitado errado), PostgREST
+# devolve sucesso com 0 linhas e o hook toca o toast de sucesso mesmo assim.
+expect_value_as 'A.3 (DEFEITO) 2o UPDATE do hook com alvo inexistente afeta 0 linhas e NAO da erro' '0' "$ADM" \
+  "WITH up AS (
+     UPDATE public.whatsapp_connections SET is_default = true WHERE id = '$C_BOGUS' RETURNING 1
+   ) SELECT count(*) FROM up;"
+expect_value 'A.4 (DEFEITO) estado final: ZERO padrao, interface diria "atualizada"' '0' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+expect_error_as 'A.5 (DEFEITO) nao existe primitiva atomica para o hook consumir' \
+  'does not exist' "$ADM" "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C2');"
+
+printf '\n============ BLOCO B ‚Äî migration aplicada ============\n'
+psql_file "$migration" >/dev/null
+psql_file "$tmp_dir/seed.sql" >/dev/null
+
+expect_result_as 'B.1 a RPC troca a padrao numa UNICA chamada (devolve o alvo)' "$C2" "$ADM" \
+  "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C2');"
+expect_value 'B.2 ao final existe exatamente UMA padrao' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+expect_value 'B.3 ...e e o alvo C2' "$C2" \
+  "SELECT id FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+expect_value 'B.4 efeito colateral: a padrao anterior (C1) foi reescrita pelo gatilho' 'mudou' \
+  "SELECT CASE WHEN updated_at > '2020-01-01 00:00:00+00' THEN 'mudou' ELSE 'intacta' END
+     FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE id = '$C1';"
+expect_value 'B.5 efeito colateral: linhas intocadas preservam updated_at (C3/C4)' '2' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.whatsapp_connections
+    WHERE id IN ('$C3','$C4')
+      AND updated_at IN ('2020-01-03 00:00:00+00','2020-01-04 00:00:00+00');"
+# A troca toca SO as duas linhas que de fato mudam de valor (a padrao anterior e o
+# alvo) ‚Äî nao ha UPDATE em massa: o gatilho regrava updated_at em 2 linhas, contra 3
+# do caminho antigo (A.2b). Nenhuma outra linha da tabela e tocada.
+expect_value 'B.5b o gatilho regravou updated_at em exatamente 2 linhas (padrao antiga + alvo)' '2' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.whatsapp_connections
+    WHERE updated_at NOT IN ('2020-01-01 00:00:00+00','2020-01-02 00:00:00+00',
+                             '2020-01-03 00:00:00+00','2020-01-04 00:00:00+00');"
+
+expect_result_as 'B.6 idempotente: alvo que ja e padrao devolve o mesmo uuid' "$C2" "$ADM" \
+  "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C2');"
+expect_value 'B.7 idempotencia nao multiplicou padroes' '1' \
+  "SELECT count(*) FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+ERR_ADM_INEXISTENTE="$(err_text_as "$ADM" "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C_BOGUS');")"
+ERR_NAO_ADMIN="$(err_text_as "$AGENTE" "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C2');")"
+
+expect_error_as 'B.8 falha (alvo inexistente) aborta tudo: erro e NADA aplicado' \
+  'conexao inexistente ou sem permissao' "$ADM" \
+  "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C_BOGUS');"
+expect_value 'B.9 ...a padrao anterior (C2) permanece' "$C2" \
+  "SELECT id FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+expect_error_as 'B.10 entrada invalida (p_connection_id nulo) e recusada' \
+  'p_connection_id obrigatorio' "$ADM" \
+  "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection(NULL);"
+expect_value 'B.11 entrada nula nao mexeu na padrao' "$C2" \
+  "SELECT id FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+expect_error_as 'B.12 nao-admin nao troca a padrao' \
+  'conexao inexistente ou sem permissao' "$AGENTE" \
+  "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C1');"
+expect_value 'B.13 ...e a padrao segue C2' "$C2" \
+  "SELECT id FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+[[ -n "$ERR_ADM_INEXISTENTE" && "$ERR_ADM_INEXISTENTE" == "$ERR_NAO_ADMIN" ]] \
+  || fail "B.14 sem oraculo: erro difere (adm+id inexistente='$ERR_ADM_INEXISTENTE' | nao-admin+id existente='$ERR_NAO_ADMIN')"
+printf '[PASS] %s\n' 'B.14 sem oraculo: id inexistente e chamador sem permissao dao o MESMO erro'
+
+expect_error_anon 'B.15 anon nao tem EXECUTE na RPC (funcao nasce fechada)' \
+  'permission denied' "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C1');"
+expect_value_as 'B.16 leitura direta de is_default como nao-admin nao muda nada (RLS UPDATE intacta)' '0' "$AGENTE" \
+  "WITH up AS (
+     UPDATE public.whatsapp_connections SET is_default = true WHERE id = '$C1' RETURNING 1
+   ) SELECT count(*) FROM up;"
+expect_value 'B.17 a padrao continua unica (C2)' "$C2" \
+  "SELECT id FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+printf '\n---- concorrencia ----\n'
+# Sessao A segura a chave canonica da secao critica; a RPC tem de ESPERAR por ela.
+docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+  -c "BEGIN; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(841723199); SELECT pg_sleep(3); COMMIT;" \
+  >"$tmp_dir/lock.out" 2>&1 &
+lock_pid=$!
+sleep 0.6
+start_ns=$(date +%s%N)
+RPC_DURANTE_LOCK="$(as_user "$ADM" "SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$C3');" | tail -n1)"
+end_ns=$(date +%s%N)
+wait "$lock_pid" || true
+elapsed_ms=$(( (end_ns - start_ns) / 1000000 ))
+[[ "$RPC_DURANTE_LOCK" == "$C3" ]] || fail "B.18 a RPC nao devolveu o alvo durante o lock: '$RPC_DURANTE_LOCK'"
+(( elapsed_ms >= 2000 )) || fail "B.18 a RPC nao esperou a secao critica (levou ${elapsed_ms}ms; esperado >= 2000ms)"
+printf '[PASS] B.18 a RPC serializa na secao critica (esperou %sms com a chave em uso)\n' "$elapsed_ms"
+expect_value 'B.19 depois da troca serializada: exatamente 1 padrao e e o C3' "$C3" \
+  "SELECT id FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE is_default IS TRUE;"
+
+# N chamadas concorrentes, alvos diferentes: nenhuma pode estourar 23505 (indice unico)
+# e o fim tem de ser exatamente UMA padrao.
+pids=()
+conc_idx=0
+for target in "$C1" "$C2" "$C4" "$C1"; do
+  conc_idx=$((conc_idx + 1))
+  docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c "SET ROLE authenticated; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '$ADM', false); SELECT public.set_default_whatsapp_connection('$target');" \
+    >"$tmp_dir/conc-$conc_idx.out" 2>&1 &
+  pids+=("$!")
+done
+conc_fail=0
+for p in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$p" || conc_fail=1; done
+if (( conc_fail != 0 )); then

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Contrato de escopo de posse da midia privada do Storage (auditoria
+# docs/audits/SEGURANCA_DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE_2026-10-07.md, achado 01 P1).
+#
+# Causa raiz (01): a policy "whatsapp media readable via visible message"
+# (20261003142707) liberava o objeto quando QUALQUER linha de public.messages visivel
+# ao chamador tinha media_url terminando no caminho do objeto. O media_url e escrito
+# pela RPC enqueue_outbound_message a partir de texto do CLIENTE, entao o atendente
+# enfileirava no PROPRIO contato uma mensagem com p_media_url apontando para o objeto
+# de OUTRA conversa; a mensagem dele carregava aquela URL e a policy liberava a leitura.
+#
+# BLOCO A (antes): o atendente CARLA enfileira a URL do objeto da DORA e LE o objeto da
+#   DORA (defeito: vaza a midia de outro contato).
+# BLOCO B (depois): a mesma chamada e recusada com 42501 media_url_out_of_contact_scope; e,
+#   mesmo com uma linha de mensagem FORJADA (inserida por service_role, simulando uma edge
+#   com bug) apontando para o objeto da DORA, a policy NAO libera a leitura. O fluxo legitimo
+#   continua: CARLA le a propria midia recebida (caminho novo <contato>/... e caminho legado
+#   <tipo>/...), encaminha e envia midia da propria pasta; DORA nao le a midia da CARLA; e
+#   admin/supervisor segue lendo qualquer uma.
+
+set -Eeuo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+migration_policy="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261011010000_fix_whatsapp_media_select_contact_scope.sql"
+migration_rpc="$repo_root/supabase/migrations/20261010211000_enqueue_outbound_message_media_url_scope.sql"
+postgres_image="${WHATSAPP_MEDIA_SCOPE_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:17-alpine}"
+container_name="zapp-v2-whatsapp-media-scope-test-$$"
+
+cleanup() {
+  if [[ "$container_name" =~ ^zapp-v2-whatsapp-media-scope-test-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    docker rm -f "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
+
+fail() { printf '[FAIL] %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+psql_sql() { docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "$1"; }
+psql_file() { docker exec -i "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres < "$1"; }
+
+expect_error() {
+  local label="$1" needle="$2" sql="$3" output status
+  set +e
+  output="$(docker exec "$container_name" psql -X -qAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres \
+    -c '\set VERBOSITY verbose' -c "$sql" 2>&1)"; status=$?
+  set -e
+  (( status == 0 )) && { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: deveria falhar, mas passou"; }
+  [[ "$output" == *"$needle"* ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; fail "$label: esperava '$needle' no erro"; }
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+expect_value() {
+  local label="$1" expected="$2" sql="$3" actual
+  actual="$(psql_sql "$sql" | tail -n1)"
+  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || fail "$label: esperado '$expected', obtido '$actual'"
+  printf '[PASS] %s\n' "$label"
+}
+
+command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker nao esta instalado'
+docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Docker daemon nao esta acessivel'
+[[ -f "$migration_policy" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration_policy"
+[[ -f "$migration_rpc" ]] || fail "migration nao encontrada: $migration_rpc"
+
+docker run --rm -d --name "$container_name" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test_only "$postgres_image" >/dev/null
+
+ready_checks=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
+  if psql_sql 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ready_checks=$((ready_checks + 1)); (( ready_checks >= 2 )) && break
+  else ready_checks=0; fi
+  sleep 1
+done
+(( ready_checks >= 2 )) || fail 'PostgreSQL descartavel nao ficou pronto'
+
+tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; cleanup' EXIT INT TERM
+
+cat > "$tmp_dir/pre.sql" <<'SQL'
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub',
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')
+     ), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;

+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true);

+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.contacts (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, whatsapp_connection_id uuid REFERENCES public.whatsapp_connections(id),
+  assigned_to uuid, queue_id uuid
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.messages (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.contacts(id),
+  client_message_id uuid, whatsapp_connection_id uuid, agent_id uuid,

+  reply_to_id uuid, is_read boolean, status text, external_id text, status_updated_at timestamptz
+);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_contact_client_msg_uq
+  ON public.messages (contact_id, client_message_id) WHERE client_message_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.permissions (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL UNIQUE, description text, category text
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.role_permissions (
+  role text NOT NULL, permission_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.permissions(id),
+  PRIMARY KEY (role, permission_id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role));
+CREATE FUNCTION public.user_has_permission(_user_id uuid, _permission_name text)
+  RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
+       JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp.role = ur.role
+       JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
+       WHERE ur.user_id = _user_id AND p.name = _permission_name) $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid)
+  RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT _user_id = '99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999'::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(_user_id uuid)
+  RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = _user_id LIMIT 1 $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_visible_agent_ids(_user_id uuid)
+  RETURNS SETOF uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT profile.id FROM public.profiles profile
+        WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.user_id = _user_id $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_contact_visible_to_user(_contact_id uuid, _user_id uuid)
+  RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
+  AS $$ SELECT _user_id = auth.uid() AND EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.contacts c
+       WHERE c.id = _contact_id
+         AND ( public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id)
+               OR c.assigned_to IN (SELECT public.get_visible_agent_ids(_user_id))
+               OR EXISTS (
+                 SELECT 1 FROM public.queue_members qm
+                 WHERE qm.queue_id = c.queue_id
+                   AND qm.profile_id = public.get_profile_id_for_user(_user_id)
+                   AND COALESCE(qm.is_active, true)) )) $$;
+
+-- ---- Storage minimo: buckets/objects + storage.foldername + RLS ----
+CREATE SCHEMA storage;
+CREATE TABLE storage.buckets (id text PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL, public boolean DEFAULT false);
+CREATE TABLE storage.objects (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), bucket_id text REFERENCES storage.buckets(id),
+  name text, owner uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), metadata jsonb
+);
+CREATE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text) RETURNS text[] LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+declare p text[]; begin p := string_to_array(name, '/'); return p[1:array_length(p, 1) - 1]; end $$;
+ALTER TABLE storage.objects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA storage TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON storage.objects TO authenticated;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.messages, public.contacts, public.profiles TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(uuid) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_contact_visible_to_user(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_visible_agent_ids(uuid) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(uuid) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.user_has_permission(uuid, text) TO authenticated;

+-- ---- ESTADO ANTERIOR: policies de midia como estao em producao hoje ----
+-- (01) 20261003142707 ‚Äî libera por qualquer mensagem visivel com media_url no caminho.
+CREATE POLICY "whatsapp media readable via visible message"
+ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+USING (
+  objects.bucket_id = ANY (ARRAY['whatsapp-media'::text, 'audio-messages'::text])
+  AND EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+    FROM public.messages m
+    WHERE m.media_url IS NOT NULL
+      AND (
+        right(m.media_url, length('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || objects.name))
+          = '/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || objects.name
+        OR position('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || objects.name || '?' IN m.media_url) > 0
+        OR right(m.media_url, length('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || replace(objects.name, ' ', '%20')))
+          = '/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || replace(objects.name, ' ', '%20')
+        OR position('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || replace(objects.name, ' ', '%20') || '?' IN m.media_url) > 0
+      )
+  )
+);
+-- (02) 20260930700000 ‚Äî ramos por contato atribuido. O ramo EXISTS com LIKE '%/' || objects.name
+-- (achado 02) ja foi corrigido em 20261011003024 (cartao t_1561f524); o estado inicial aqui ja o
+-- reflete, para este teste isolar o achado 01 (por isso o vazamento de A2 vem so da policy de -01).
+CREATE POLICY "Users can read assigned whatsapp media"
+  ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (
+    bucket_id = 'whatsapp-media'
+    AND (
+      is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+      OR (storage.foldername(name))[1] IN (
+        SELECT c.id::text FROM public.contacts c
+        WHERE c.assigned_to IN (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid())
+      )
+      OR (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
+    )
+  );
+CREATE POLICY "Users can read assigned audio messages"
+  ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (
+    bucket_id = 'audio-messages'
+    AND (
+      is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+      OR (storage.foldername(name))[1] IN (
+        SELECT c.id::text FROM public.contacts c
+        WHERE c.assigned_to IN (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid())
+      )
+    )
+  );

+-- ---- RPC enqueue_outbound_message: corpo ATUAL de producao (20260930200000), SEM o escopo
+--      de media_url (esse e o defeito do achado 01).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_outbound_message(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_client_message_id uuid,
+  p_content text,
+  p_message_type text DEFAULT 'text',
+  p_media_url text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_reply_to_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_whatsapp_connection_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_caption text DEFAULT NULL
+) RETURNS public.messages
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_connection_id uuid;
+  v_assigned_connection_id uuid;
+  v_reply_contact_id uuid;
+  v_message public.messages%ROWTYPE;
+  v_message_type text := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_message_type, ''), 'text');
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF public.user_has_permission(auth.uid(), 'send_messages') IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'send_messages_permission_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_contact_id IS NULL OR p_client_message_id IS NULL
+     OR p_content IS NULL OR length(p_content) > 65536
+     OR v_message_type NOT IN ('text', 'image', 'audio', 'video', 'document', 'sticker', 'location')
+     OR length(COALESCE(p_media_url, '')) > 4096
+     OR length(COALESCE(p_caption, '')) > 65536
+     OR (p_media_url IS NOT NULL AND p_media_url !~ '^https://')
+     OR (v_message_type NOT IN ('text', 'location') AND p_media_url IS NULL)
+     OR (v_message_type = 'location' AND p_media_url IS NOT NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outbound_message' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT contact.whatsapp_connection_id INTO v_assigned_connection_id
+  FROM public.contacts AS contact
+  WHERE contact.id = p_contact_id
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = p_whatsapp_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+    IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF v_assigned_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = v_assigned_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL
+    ORDER BY connection.updated_at DESC, connection.id
+    LIMIT 1;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_connected_whatsapp_connection' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
+     AND v_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_assigned_connection_id
+     AND EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id
+     )
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+       FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       JOIN public.queue_members AS member ON member.queue_id = link.queue_id
+       JOIN public.profiles AS caller_profile ON caller_profile.id = member.profile_id
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id
+         AND caller_profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+         AND COALESCE(member.is_active, true)
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'whatsapp_connection_out_of_scope' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_profile_id
+  FROM public.profiles AS profile
+  WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.is_active = true
+  LIMIT 1
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF public.is_contact_visible_to_user(p_contact_id, auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_reply_to_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT reply.contact_id INTO v_reply_contact_id
+    FROM public.messages AS reply WHERE reply.id = p_reply_to_id;
+    IF NOT FOUND OR v_reply_contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_contact_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_message_contact_mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
+    hashtextextended(p_contact_id::text || ':' || p_client_message_id::text, 0)
+  );
+  INSERT INTO public.messages (
+    contact_id, client_message_id, whatsapp_connection_id, agent_id,
+    sender, content, message_type, media_url, caption, reply_to_id,
+    is_read, status, external_id, status_updated_at
+  ) VALUES (
+    p_contact_id, p_client_message_id, v_connection_id, v_profile_id,
+    'agent', p_content, v_message_type, p_media_url, p_caption, p_reply_to_id,
+    true, 'sending', NULL, statement_timestamp()
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (contact_id, client_message_id)
+    WHERE client_message_id IS NOT NULL
+  DO NOTHING RETURNING * INTO v_message;
+  IF v_message.id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT * INTO v_message
+    FROM public.messages AS message
+    WHERE message.contact_id = p_contact_id
+      AND message.client_message_id = p_client_message_id;
+    IF v_message.id IS NULL
+       OR v_message.agent_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_profile_id
+       OR v_message.sender IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent'
+       OR v_message.content IS DISTINCT FROM p_content
+       OR v_message.message_type IS DISTINCT FROM v_message_type
+       OR v_message.media_url IS DISTINCT FROM p_media_url
+       OR v_message.caption IS DISTINCT FROM p_caption
+       OR v_message.reply_to_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_reply_to_id
+       OR v_message.whatsapp_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_connection_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_message_id_reused_with_different_payload'
+        USING ERRCODE = '23505';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v_message;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_outbound_message(
+  uuid, uuid, text, text, text, uuid, uuid, text
+) FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_outbound_message(
+  uuid, uuid, text, text, text, uuid, uuid, text
+) TO authenticated;

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// W65: p√≥s-deploy health check ‚Äî 5 min ap√≥s deploy, consulta logs de erro pela
+// Management API e falha com ::error:: se a taxa de 5xx superar o limiar.
+// Degrada√ß√£o controlada: falha de transporte ou API indispon√≠vel ‚Üí ::warning::,
+// nunca ::error:: ‚Äî o check n√£o pode derrubar deploys por indisponibilidade de
+// observabilidade.
+import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+const CANONICAL_PROJECT = 'tnnnlkbymytvtqngbbqh';
+const MGMT_BASE = 'https://api.supabase.com';
+const DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 0.10; // 10% de 5xx = falha
+const DEFAULT_WAIT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 min
+const WINDOW_MINUTES = 5;
+
+function parseArgs(argv) {
+  const args = {
+    threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
+    waitMs: DEFAULT_WAIT_MS,
+    dryRun: false,
+  };
+  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i += 1) {
+    if (argv[i] === '--project-ref') args.projectRef = argv[++i];
+    else if (argv[i] === '--scope') args.scope = argv[++i];
+    else if (argv[i] === '--threshold') args.threshold = parseFloat(argv[++i]);
+    else if (argv[i] === '--wait-ms') args.waitMs = parseInt(argv[++i], 10);
+    else if (argv[i] === '--no-wait') args.waitMs = 0;
+    else if (argv[i] === '--dry-run') args.dryRun = true;
+    else if (argv[i] === '--manifest') args.manifestPath = argv[++i];
+    else throw new Error(`Argumento desconhecido: ${argv[i]}`);
+  }
+  if (!args.projectRef) throw new Error('--project-ref obrigatorio');
+  if (args.projectRef !== CANONICAL_PROJECT) throw new Error('Apenas o projeto canonico e aceito');
+  return args;
+}
+
+// Retorna lista de slugs a verificar: escopo "all" ‚Üí todas as fun√ß√µes do manifesto;
+// caso contr√°rio, s√≥ a fun√ß√£o nomeada.
+async function resolveScope(scope, manifestPath) {
+  if (scope && scope !== 'all') return [scope];
+  if (manifestPath) {
+    const raw = JSON.parse(await readFile(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
+    return (raw.functions ?? []).map((fn) => fn.name).filter(Boolean);
+  }
+  return [];
+}
+
+// Monta a SQL de an√°lise de logs de edge para a janela configurada.
+// A API de analytics do Supabase usa BigQuery-flavored SQL contra a tabela
+// `edge_logs`. O campo de status HTTP fica em metadata[offset(0)].response.statusCode
+// (array UNNEST necess√°rio porque metadata √© REPEATED).
+function buildLogsSql(slugs, windowMinutes) {
+  const slugFilter = slugs.length > 0
+    ? `AND m.function IN (${slugs.map((s) => `'${s}'`).join(', ')})`
+    : '';
+  return (
+    `SELECT ` +
+    `  COUNT(1) AS total, ` +
+    `  COUNTIF(CAST(m.response.statusCode AS INT64) >= 500) AS errors ` +
+    `FROM edge_logs ` +
+    `  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(metadata) AS m ` +
+    `WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL ${windowMinutes} MINUTE) ` +
+    slugFilter
+  ).trim();
+}
+
+// Chama a Management API de analytics do Supabase.
+// Lan√ßa se o HTTP n√£o for 2xx; devolve null se a resposta n√£o tiver linhas.
+async function queryAnalytics({ projectRef, token, sql, fetchImpl = fetch }) {
+  const url = `${MGMT_BASE}/v1/projects/${projectRef}/analytics/endpoints/logs.all`;
+  const res = await fetchImpl(url, {
+    method: 'POST',
+    headers: {
+      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+    },
+    body: JSON.stringify({ sql }),
+    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000),
+  });
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    // N√£o logar o corpo da resposta: pode conter detalhes de autentica√ß√£o.
+    throw new Error(`Management API retornou HTTP ${res.status} na consulta de analytics`);
+  }
+  const json = await res.json();
+  // A API retorna { result: [{ total: N, errors: N }] } quando bem-sucedida.
+  if (!Array.isArray(json.result) || json.result.length === 0) return null;
+  return json.result[0];
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
+  const token = process.env.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN;
+  if (!token?.trim()) {
+    console.error('::warning::SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN ausente ‚Äî health check ignorado');
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const slugs = await resolveScope(args.scope, args.manifestPath);
+  const nomeScope = args.scope || 'all';
+
+  if (args.dryRun) {
+    console.log(`[health-check] Ensaio ‚Äî escopo: ${nomeScope}; fun√ß√µes: ${slugs.length || '(todas)'}`);
+    console.log('[health-check] Dry run: sem espera e sem chamada √† API.');
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (args.waitMs > 0) {
+    const minutos = Math.round(args.waitMs / 60_000);
+    console.log(`[health-check] Aguardando ${minutos} min para os logs de p√≥s-deploy estabilizarem‚Ä¶`);
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, args.waitMs));
+  }
+
+  const sql = buildLogsSql(slugs, WINDOW_MINUTES);
+  let row;
+  try {
+    row = await queryAnalytics({
+      projectRef: args.projectRef,
+      token,
+      sql,
+    });
+  } catch (err) {
+    // Falha de transporte ou API indispon√≠vel ‚Üí warning, n√£o bloqueia o deploy.
+    console.error(`::warning::Health check falhou ao consultar a Management API: ${err.message}. Prosseguindo.`);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (row === null) {
+    console.log('[health-check] Nenhum log na janela de observa√ß√£o ‚Äî sem invoca√ß√µes recentes ou logs ainda n√£o propagados.');
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const total = Number(row.total ?? 0);
+  const errors = Number(row.errors ?? 0);
+
+  if (total === 0) {
+    console.log('[health-check] Zero invoca√ß√µes na janela ‚Äî sem tr√°fego suficiente para medir taxa de erro.');
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const errorRate = errors / total;
+  const pct = (errorRate * 100).toFixed(1);
+  console.log(`[health-check] Escopo: ${nomeScope} | invoca√ß√µes: ${total} | erros 5xx: ${errors} | taxa: ${pct}%`);
+
+  if (errorRate > args.threshold) {
+    const limiar = (args.threshold * 100).toFixed(0);
+    console.error(
+      `::error::Health check FALHOU ‚Äî taxa de 5xx (${pct}%) supera o limiar de ${limiar}% ` +
+        `nas √∫ltimas ${WINDOW_MINUTES} min. Verifique os logs da fun√ß√£o e considere o rollback ` +
+        `(dispatch com rollback_to_last_success=true).`
+    );
+    process.exitCode = 1;
+  } else {
+    console.log(`[health-check] OK ‚Äî taxa de 5xx (${pct}%) dentro do limiar.`);
+  }
+}
+
+main().catch((err) => {
+  console.error(`::warning::health-check.mjs falhou inesperadamente: ${err.message}. Prosseguindo.`);
+});

+async function esperarServidor(url, timeoutMs) {

+/** Primeira porta livre a partir de `inicio`. */
+function portaLivre(inicio) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const tentar = (porta) => {
+      const srv = net.createServer();
+      srv.once('error', (e) => {
+        if (e.code === 'EADDRINUSE' && porta < inicio + 50) return tentar(porta + 1);
+        reject(e);
+      });
+      srv.once('listening', () => srv.close(() => resolve(porta)));
+      srv.listen(porta, '127.0.0.1');
+    };
+    tentar(inicio);
+  });

+const medirNaPagina = () => {
+  const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="contact-card"]'));
+  const rects = cards.map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect());
+  const vh = window.innerHeight;
+  const out = {
+    cards: cards.length,
+    primeiraLinhaAlturaPx: null,
+    primeiraLinhaCards: 0,
+    cardsSemRolar: 0,
+  };
+  if (rects.length > 0) {
+    const topo = Math.min(...rects.map((r) => r.top));
+    const linha = rects.filter((r) => Math.abs(r.top - topo) < 4);
+    out.primeiraLinhaAlturaPx = Math.round(Math.max(...linha.map((r) => r.bottom)) - topo);
+    out.primeiraLinhaCards = linha.length;
+    out.cardsSemRolar = rects.filter((r) => r.top >= -0.5 && r.bottom <= vh + 0.5).length;
+  }
+  return out;
+};

+async function principal() {

+  { id: 'crm', titulo: 'CRM 360 indispon√≠vel', padroes: [/<TalkXCrmUnavailableState\b/] },
+  { id: 'wa', titulo: 'WhatsApp desconectado', padroes: [/<TalkXWhatsAppDisconnectedState\b/] },
+  { id: 'perm', titulo: 'Sem permiss√£o', padroes: [/<TalkXNoPermissionState\b/] },
+];
+
+/** Os valores aceitos por `?talkxState=` (prancha de refer√™ncia, X055). */
+export const ESTADOS_FORCADOS = ['empty', 'loading', 'error', 'crm', 'wa', 'perm'];
+
+/** Fonte da verdade do estado for√ßado (prancha X055). */
+export const FORCED_STATE_SRC = join(root, 'src/components/talkx/kit/forcedState.ts');
+export const BOUNDARY_SRC = join(root, 'src/components/talkx/kit/states.tsx');
+
+/**
+ * L√™ do C√ìDIGO o mecanismo do estado for√ßado: o nome do par√¢metro de URL e os
+ * valores aceites (`TALKX_FORCED_STATES` em `kit/forcedState.ts`). Se o par√¢metro
+ * for um dia renomeado, o doc regenerado muda junto e `--check` quebra at√© o
+ * doc ser regenerado ‚Äî o doc nunca envelhece sozinho.
+ */
+export function lerEstadoForcadoDoCodigo(arquivo = FORCED_STATE_SRC) {
+  const src = readFileSync(arquivo, 'utf8');
+  const params = [...src.matchAll(/\.get\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
+  const param = params.find((n) => n !== 'view') ?? null;
+  const bloco = src.match(/TALKX_FORCED_STATES\s*=\s*\[([^\]]+)\]/);
+  const valores = bloco ? [...bloco[1].matchAll(/['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g)].map((m) => m[1]) : [];
+  return { param, valores };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Onde o estado for√ßado √© implementado, em `arquivo:linha` lidos do c√≥digo:
+ * a defini√ß√£o dos valores + a leitura do par√¢metro em `forcedState.ts` e o
+ * respeito ao for√ßado no `TalkXQueryBoundary` em `kit/states.tsx`.
+ */
+export function coberturaEstadoForcado(forzadoSrc = FORCED_STATE_SRC, boundarySrc = BOUNDARY_SRC) {
+  const pontos = [];
+  const rel = (arquivo) => relative(root, arquivo).split(sep).join('/');
+  const fsrc = readFileSync(forzadoSrc, 'utf8');
+  fsrc.split('\n').forEach((linha, i) => {
+    if (/TALKX_FORCED_STATES\s*=/.test(linha) || /URLSearchParams\(search\)\.get/.test(linha)) {
+      pontos.push(`${rel(forzadoSrc)}:${i + 1}`);
+    }
+  });
+  const bsrc = readFileSync(boundarySrc, 'utf8');
+  bsrc.split('\n').forEach((linha, i) => {
+    const cod = linha.trim();
+    if (cod.startsWith('//') || cod.startsWith('*')) return;
+    if (linha.includes('currentTalkXForcedState')) pontos.push(`${rel(boundarySrc)}:${i + 1}`);
+  });
+  return pontos;
+}
+
+/** Linhas de `texto` onde cada estado aparece (1-based, na ordem do arquivo). */
+export function varrerTela(texto, estados = ESTADOS) {
+  const linhas = texto.split('\n');
+  const achados = {};
+  for (const estado of estados) {
+    const hits = [];
+    linhas.forEach((linha, indice) => {
+      if (estado.padroes.some((re) => re.test(linha))) hits.push(indice + 1);
+    });
+    achados[estado.id] = hits;
+  }
+  return achados;
+}
+
+/** Telas do m√≥dulo (`TalkX*.tsx`), em ordem alfab√©tica. */
+export function telasDoModulo(dir = TELAS_DIR) {
+  return readdirSync(dir)
+    .filter((nome) => nome.startsWith('TalkX') && nome.endsWith('.tsx')
+      && !nome.includes('.test.') && !nome.includes('.spec.'))
+    .sort();
+}
+
+/** Matriz: uma entrada por tela, com as linhas de cada estado adotado. */
+export function matriz(dir = TELAS_DIR, estados = ESTADOS) {
+  return telasDoModulo(dir).map((arquivo) => ({
+    arquivo,
+    achados: varrerTela(readFileSync(join(dir, arquivo), 'utf8'), estados),
+  }));
+}
+
+function celula(linhas) {
+  return linhas.length > 0 ? linhas.map((l) => `\`${l}\``).join(', ') : '‚Äî';
+}
+
+/** Markdown completo de `docs/talkx/ESTADOS.md`. */
+export function renderMarkdown(linhas, estados = ESTADOS, dir = TELAS_DIR, forcado = lerEstadoForcadoDoCodigo()) {
+  const caminho = (arquivo) => relative(root, join(dir, arquivo)).split('\\').join('/');
+  const porEstado = estados.map((estado) => ({
+    ...estado,
+    total: linhas.filter((l) => (l.achados[estado.id] ?? []).length > 0).length,
+  }));
+
+  const cabecalho = `| Tela | ${estados.map((e) => e.titulo).join(' | ')} |`;
+  const separador = `|---|${estados.map(() => '---').join('|')}|`;
+  const corpo = linhas
+    .map((l) => `| \`${caminho(l.arquivo)}\` | ${estados.map((e) => celula(l.achados[e.id] ?? [])).join(' | ')} |`)
+    .join('\n');
+
+  const foraDasTelas = estados.filter((e) => !linhas.some((l) => (l.achados[e.id] ?? []).length > 0));
+
+  return `# Talk X ‚Äî matriz tela √ó estado (X055)
+
+> Gerado por \`node scripts/talkx/gen-estados.mjs\`. N√£o edite √† m√£o: rode o
+> gerador. \`node scripts/talkx/gen-estados.mjs --check\` falha quando este
+> arquivo divergir do c√≥digo.
+
+Cada c√©lula traz o \`arquivo:linha\` onde a tela adota aquele estado do sistema.
+\`‚Äî\` significa que a tela ainda n√£o trata o estado (d√≠vida conhecida, n√£o
+esquecimento).
+
+Estado for√ßado para confer√™ncia visual (prancha \`?view=talkx-kit\`, s√≥ em DEV ou
+com \`VITE_TALKX_KIT=1\`, lido de \`src/components/talkx/kit/forcedState.ts\`):
+${forcado.valores.map((e) => `\`?${forcado.param}=${e}\``).join(' ¬∑ ')}
+
+${cabecalho}
+${separador}
+${corpo}
+
+## Resumo
+
+${porEstado.map((e) => `- **${e.titulo}**: ${e.total} de ${linhas.length} telas`).join('\n')}
+
+## Como usar
+
+1. \`node scripts/talkx/gen-estados.mjs\` regenera este arquivo.
+2. \`node scripts/talkx/gen-estados.mjs --check\` (rc 0) prova que ele bate com o c√≥digo.
+3. Para ver o estado na tela de verdade: abra o m√≥dulo com
+   \`?view=talkx&talkxState=<valor>\` (ex.: \`error\`) e confira contra
+   \`docs/talkx/references/17_Estados_do_Sistema_e_Modais.png\`.
+
+## Estado for√ßado ‚Äî cobertura no c√≥digo
+
+O par√¢metro \`?${forcado.param}=\` e os valores acima v√™m de
+\`src/components/talkx/kit/forcedState.ts\` (\`TALKX_FORCED_STATES\`); o
+\`TalkXQueryBoundary\` (\`src/components/talkx/kit/states.tsx\`) respeita o estado
+for√ßado antes da consulta real. Implementa√ß√£o (arquivo:linha):
+${coberturaEstadoForcado().map((p) => `- \`${p}\``).join('\n')}
+
+${foraDasTelas.length > 0
+    ? `Estados sem nenhuma tela adotando: ${foraDasTelas.map((e) => e.titulo).join(', ')}.`
+    : 'Todos os estados t√™m pelo menos uma tela adotando.'}
+`;
+}
+
+/** Markdown gerado a partir do reposit√≥rio. */
+export function gerar(dir = TELAS_DIR, estados = ESTADOS) {
+  return renderMarkdown(matriz(dir, estados), estados, dir);
+}
+
+export function main(argv) {
+  const check = argv.includes('--check');
+  const gerado = gerar();
+  if (check) {
+    if (!existsSync(SAIDA)) {
+      console.error(`gen-estados: ${relative(root, SAIDA)} n√£o existe ‚Äî rode sem --check.`);
+      return 1;
+    }
+    const atual = readFileSync(SAIDA, 'utf8');
+    if (atual !== gerado) {
+      console.error(`gen-estados: ${relative(root, SAIDA)} divergiu do c√≥digo ‚Äî rode o gerador.`);
+      return 1;
+    }
+    console.log('gen-estados: ESTADOS.md bate com o c√≥digo.');
+    return 0;
+  }
+  writeFileSync(SAIDA, gerado);
+  console.log(`gen-estados: ${relative(root, SAIDA)} atualizado (${telasDoModulo().length} telas).`);
+  return 0;
+}

+if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
+  process.exit(main(process.argv.slice(2)));
