+/**
+ * U1 ‚Äî padr√£o √∫nico das a√ß√µes do inbox que s√≥ apareciam no hover.
+ *
+ * Antes: 21 pontos escreviam `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`. O `group-hover`
+ * s√≥ dispara com ponteiro que tem hover: no celular/tablet (sem hover) a a√ß√£o
+ * ficava invis√≠vel, e no teclado o Tab at√© chegava ao bot√£o, mas o foco n√£o
+ * acendia nada na tela (o usu√°rio n√£o via onde estava). N√£o havia `focus-within`
+ * nem um caminho para `(hover: none)`.
+ *
+ * O padr√£o (mesmas classes em todos os 21 pontos, agora numa constante s√≥):
+ * - `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` ‚Äî o comportamento de antes, no mouse;
+ * - `group-focus-within:opacity-100` ‚Äî o Tab entra no grupo e a camada aparece
+ *   (o bot√£o passa a ser vis√≠vel antes mesmo de receber o foco);
+ * - `focus-visible:opacity-100` ‚Äî o pr√≥prio alvo se acende quando recebe o foco
+ *   por teclado;
+ * - `[@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100` ‚Äî em dispositivo sem hover (toque) a
+ *   camada j√° nasce vis√≠vel.
+ *
+ * `HOVER_REVEAL_TAP` acrescenta o alvo de toque m√≠nimo de 40 px
+ * (`min-h-10`/`min-w-10` = 2,5rem) e S√ì sob `(pointer: coarse)` ‚Äî o mesmo
+ * crit√©rio de `src/components/tasks/shared/pointerMedia.ts`: com mouse nada
+ * muda de tamanho. Onde o ponto √© um cont√™iner de a√ß√µes, o m√≠nimo vale para a
+ * linha/barra (altura confort√°vel de dedo); os bot√µes internos dos grupos
+ * compactos seguem no tamanho pequeno de prop√≥sito, para n√£o roubar o toque do
+ * vizinho (grade de 5 colunas do `CustomEmojiPicker`, fila de rea√ß√µes).
+ *
+ * Sem cor nova, sem sombra nova e sem anima√ß√£o nova: o `transition-opacity` que
+ * j√° existia em cada ponto continua sendo o do elemento.
+ */
+export const HOVER_REVEAL =
+  'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-within:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100';
+
+/** O padr√£o acima + alvo de toque de 40 px em ponteiro grosso. */
+export const HOVER_REVEAL_TAP =
+  `${HOVER_REVEAL} [@media(pointer:coarse)]:min-h-10 [@media(pointer:coarse)]:min-w-10`;

+export function isAllowedMediaHost(url: string): boolean {
+  let parsed: URL;

+/**
+ * Filtro LEVE no cliente: termo que pare√ßa e-mail, telefone/CPF/CNPJ ou token

+export function isLoggableSearchTerm(term: string): boolean {

+  return true;

+import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
+import { render, screen, fireEvent, act } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
+import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+import { GlobalKeyboardProvider, useGlobalKeyboard } from '@/components/keyboard/GlobalKeyboardProvider';
+
+/**
+ * X054 ‚Äî a busca ‚åòK tem UM dono (GlobalKeyboardProvider) e UMA paleta (CommandPaletteHost):
+ * `open-global-search` (Sidebar, MobileShell) e o atalho abrem a mesma paleta, os m√≥dulos
+ * entram como comandos de navega√ß√£o filtrados pelo papel e escolher um item navega direto
+ * a ele. O provider, o host, o hook de m√≥dulos e a lista real do NavigationService rodam de
+ * verdade; s√≥ o papel do usu√°rio e o cliente Supabase s√£o controlados.
+ */
+const papel = vi.hoisted(() => ({ roles: ['admin'] as string[], permissions: [] as string[] }));
+
+vi.mock('@/hooks/system/useUserRole', () => ({
+  useUserRole: () => ({
+    roles: papel.roles,
+    permissions: papel.permissions,
+    isAdmin: papel.roles.includes('admin'),
+    isSupervisor: papel.roles.includes('supervisor'),
+    isSpecialAgent: false,
+    hasRole: (r: string) => papel.roles.includes(r),
+    loading: false,
+    permissionsLoading: false,
+    refetch: vi.fn(),
+  }),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => ({
+  supabase: { functions: { invoke: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: null, error: null }) } },
+}));
+
+const PLACEHOLDER = /Buscar ou digitar comando/;
+const CAMPANHA_ID = 'camp-x054';
+const SEGMENTO_ID = 'seg-x054';
+const TEMPLATE_ID = 'tpl-x054';
+
+/** Faz o papel de Index.tsx: registra o handler de navega√ß√£o do shell. */
+function ShellFalso({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate: (view: string) => void }) {
+  const { registerNavigationHandler, unregisterNavigationHandler } = useGlobalKeyboard();
+  useEffect(() => {
+    registerNavigationHandler(onNavigate);
+    return () => unregisterNavigationHandler();
+  }, [registerNavigationHandler, unregisterNavigationHandler, onNavigate]);
+  return null;
+}
+
+function montar() {
+  const onNavigate = vi.fn();
+  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
+  client.setQueryData(['talkx-campaigns'], [{ id: CAMPANHA_ID, name: 'Black Friday Zeta', status: 'running' }]);
+  client.setQueryData(['talkx-segments'], [{ id: SEGMENTO_ID, name: 'P√∫blico Quente' }]);
+  client.setQueryData(['talkx-templates'], [{ id: TEMPLATE_ID, name: 'Modelo Aurora' }]);
+  render(
+    <MemoryRouter>
+      <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
+        <GlobalKeyboardProvider>
+          <ShellFalso onNavigate={onNavigate} />
+        </GlobalKeyboardProvider>
+      </QueryClientProvider>
+    </MemoryRouter>,
+  );
+  return { onNavigate };
+}
+
+async function abrirPorEvento() {
+  act(() => { document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-global-search')); });
+  return screen.findByPlaceholderText(PLACEHOLDER);
+}
+
+/** O t√≠tulo vem com cada letra casada em um <span>; o nome acess√≠vel n√£o √© confi√°vel, o texto √©. */
+function acharItem(titulo: string): HTMLElement | undefined {
+  return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button')).find((b) => b.textContent?.startsWith(titulo));
+}
+function itemDaPaleta(titulo: string) {
+  return vi.waitFor(() => {
+    const item = acharItem(titulo);
+    if (!item) throw new Error(`item "${titulo}" n√£o est√° na paleta`);
+    return item;
+  });
+}
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  papel.roles = ['admin'];
+  papel.permissions = [];
+  window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
+});
+
+describe('paleta √∫nica do ‚åòK (X054)', () => {
+  it('open-global-search abre a paleta √∫nica, e s√≥ uma', async () => {
+    montar();
+    expect(screen.queryByPlaceholderText(PLACEHOLDER)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await abrirPorEvento();
+
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('dialog')).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('textbox')).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('Ctrl+K tem um dono s√≥: abre e a segunda vez fecha', async () => {
+    montar();
+
+    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true });
+    await screen.findByPlaceholderText(PLACEHOLDER);
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('dialog')).toHaveLength(1);
+
+    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true });
+    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByPlaceholderText(PLACEHOLDER)).not.toBeInTheDocument());
+  });
+
+  it('admin encontra o m√≥dulo exclusivo de admin (Telemetria BD)', async () => {
+    montar();
+    const input = await abrirPorEvento();
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Telemetria' } });
+    expect(await itemDaPaleta('Telemetria BD')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('supervisor n√£o encontra m√≥dulo exclusivo de admin, mas encontra o de staff', async () => {
+    papel.roles = ['supervisor'];
+    montar();
+    const input = await abrirPorEvento();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Telemetria' } });
+    expect(acharItem('Telemetria BD')).toBeUndefined();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Carteira' } });
+    expect(await itemDaPaleta('Carteira')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('escolher um m√≥dulo navega direto a ele e fecha a paleta', async () => {
+    const { onNavigate } = montar();
+    const input = await abrirPorEvento();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Tarefas' } });
+    fireEvent.click(await itemDaPaleta('Tarefas'));
+
+    expect(onNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(onNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('tasks');
+    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByPlaceholderText(PLACEHOLDER)).not.toBeInTheDocument());
+  });
+
+  it('escolher uma campanha do Talk X abre aquela campanha, n√£o s√≥ o m√≥dulo', async () => {
+    const { onNavigate } = montar();
+    const input = await abrirPorEvento();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Black Friday' } });
+    fireEvent.click(await itemDaPaleta('Black Friday Zeta'));
+
+    expect(onNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('talkx');
+    expect(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('campaign')).toBe(CAMPANHA_ID);
+  });
+
+  it('escolher um segmento abre aquele segmento, n√£o s√≥ a aba (fora do Talk X)', async () => {
+    const { onNavigate } = montar();
+    const input = await abrirPorEvento();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Quente' } });
+    fireEvent.click(await itemDaPaleta('P√∫blico Quente'));
+
+    expect(onNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('talkx');
+    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
+    expect(params.get('segment')).toBe(SEGMENTO_ID);
+    expect(params.get('tab')).toBe('segments');
+    expect(params.get('campaign')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('j√° no Talk X: escolher um template abre aquele template (popstate)', async () => {
+    window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/?view=talkx&tab=overview');
+    const { onNavigate } = montar();
+    const input = await abrirPorEvento();
+
+    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: 'Aurora' } });
+    fireEvent.click(await itemDaPaleta('Modelo Aurora'));
+    act(() => { window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); });
+
+    expect(onNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('talkx');
+    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
+    expect(params.get('template')).toBe(TEMPLATE_ID);
+    expect(params.get('tab')).toBe('templates');
+    expect(params.get('campaign')).toBeNull();
+  });
+});

+/**
+ * chore(perf) ‚Äî o prefetch por hover do item de menu n√£o tinha efeito:
+ * `usePrefetchOnHover` chamava `prefetchQuery({ queryKey, staleTime })` SEM
+ * `queryFn`, e 6 das 8 chaves mapeadas (['contacts'], ['messages'],
+ * ['dashboard-stats'], ['team-members'], ['knowledge-base-articles'],
+ * ['queues']) n√£o correspondem a nenhuma query real do app ‚Äî o prefetch
+ * falhava em sil√™ncio. O prefetch de CHUNKS que funciona continua em
+ * `components/performance/hotRoutePrefetch.ts` (fora deste arquivo).
+ *
+ * Esta √© a prova (vermelho antes da corre√ß√£o, verde depois): passar o mouse
+ * pelo item de menu N√ÉO pode disparar `prefetchQuery` nenhuma na tela.
+ */
+import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+import { LayoutDashboard } from 'lucide-react';
+import { SidebarNavItem } from '@/components/layout/SidebarNavItem';

+const item = { id: 'inbox', icon: LayoutDashboard, label: 'Caixa de entrada' };
+
+function renderItem() {
+  const queryClient = new QueryClient({
+    defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } },
+  });
+  const prefetchSpy = vi.spyOn(queryClient, 'prefetchQuery');
+  render(
+    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
+      <SidebarNavItem
+        item={item}
+        currentView="dashboard"
+        onViewChange={vi.fn()}
+        collapsed={false}
+      />
+    </QueryClientProvider>
+  );
+  return { prefetchSpy, queryClient };
+}
+
+describe('SidebarNavItem ‚Äî hover n√£o dispara prefetch (chore/perf)', () => {
+  it('n√£o chama prefetchQuery ao passar o mouse', () => {
+    const { prefetchSpy } = renderItem();
+    fireEvent.mouseEnter(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Caixa de entrada' }));
+    expect(prefetchSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    cleanup();
+  });
+
+  it('n√£o deixa nenhuma query de hover no cache', () => {
+    const { queryClient } = renderItem();
+    fireEvent.mouseEnter(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Caixa de entrada' }));
+    expect(queryClient.getQueryCache().getAll()).toHaveLength(0);
+    cleanup();
+  });

+import { fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';

+const state = vi.hoisted(() => ({

+  isRefreshing: false,
+  timeRange: 'week' as 'today' | 'week' | 'month',
+}));

+    setTimeRange,
+    handleRefresh,
+  }),
+}));

+import { Leaderboard } from '../Leaderboard';

+function agente(overrides: Partial<LeaderboardAgent> = {}): LeaderboardAgent {
+  return {
+    id: 'a1',
+    profile_id: 'p1',

+  },

+// Os filtros s√£o <Select> do Radix; o gatilho vira um <button role="combobox"> cujo conte√∫do √©
+// s√≥ o √≠cone + o valor do <SelectValue> (texto visual "√öltimos 7 dias" etc.). Sem aria-label, o

+// O cliente Supabase √© mockado como cadeia "thenable" gen√©rica: qualquer m√©todo encadeado
+// (select/eq/gte/lte/order/limit/range) devolve a mesma cadeia e o `await` resolve um conjunto

+const h = vi.hoisted(() => {
+  function makeQuery() {
+    const resultado = { data: [] as unknown[], error: null, count: 0 };
+    const proxy: unknown = new Proxy(Object.create(null), {
+      get(_t, prop) {
+        if (prop === 'then') {
+          return (resolver: (valor: unknown) => unknown) => Promise.resolve(resolver(resultado));
+        }
+        return () => proxy;
+      },
+    });
+    return proxy;
+  }
+  return { makeQuery };
+});
+
+vi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => ({
+  supabase: { from: () => h.makeQuery() },
+}));

+import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
+import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
+
+/**
+ * t_3913180a ‚Äî ativar whitelist/blacklist mudava o modo direto, sem confirma√ß√£o e sem
+ * mostrar o pa√≠s detectado: o admin podia trancar o pr√≥prio acesso num clique s√≥.
+ * A regra de recusa √© do hook (t_21aa57dc); aqui se prova a TELA: nada √© gravado antes
+ * de confirmar, o bot√£o de confirmar fica desabilitado com o motivo do hook e a falha
+ * de leitura do pa√≠s aparece em vez de ser engolida.
+ */
+
+const { rpcMock, fromMock, updateMock, getUserMock } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
+  rpcMock: vi.fn(),
+  fromMock: vi.fn(),
+  updateMock: vi.fn(),
+  getUserMock: vi.fn(),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('sonner', () => ({ toast: { success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() } }));
+
+vi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => ({
+  supabase: {
+    rpc: rpcMock,
+    from: fromMock,
+    auth: { getUser: getUserMock },
+  },
+}));
+
+import { GeoBlockingPanel } from '../GeoBlockingPanel';
+import { ERRO_AO_LER_STATUS_DE_REDE } from '@/hooks/system/useMyNetworkStatus';
+
+const pais = (code: string, name: string) => ({
+  id: `c-${code}`,
+  country_code: code,
+  country_name: name,
+  created_at: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',
+});
+
+/** Leituras reais (a RPC do pa√≠s + as 3 consultas do hook), sem mock de hook: a prova renderiza o painel de verdade. */
+function prepararLeituras({
+  mode = 'disabled',
+  allowed = [] as unknown[],
+  blocked = [] as unknown[],
+} = {}) {
+  rpcMock.mockResolvedValue({ data: [{ country: 'BR', ip_seen: '203.0.113.7' }], error: null });
+  fromMock.mockImplementation((tabela: string) => ({
+    select: () => ({
+      limit: () => ({ single: async () => ({ data: { id: 's-1', mode }, error: null }) }),
+      order: async () => ({ data: tabela === 'allowed_countries' ? allowed : blocked, error: null }),
+    }),
+    update: (payload: unknown) => {
+      updateMock(payload);
+      return { eq: async () => ({ error: null }) };
+    },
+  }));
+}
+
+describe('GeoBlockingPanel: ativar exige confirma√ß√£o e mostra o pa√≠s detectado', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    getUserMock.mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: { id: 'u-1' } } });
+    prepararLeituras();
+  });
+
+  it('mostra o pa√≠s detectado e recusa a ativa√ß√£o sem gravar nada', async () => {
+    render(<GeoBlockingPanel />);
+    await screen.findByTestId('geo-pais-detectado');
+    expect(screen.getByTestId('geo-pais-detectado')).toHaveTextContent('Seu pa√≠s detectado: Brasil (BR)');
+
+    // whitelist sem o BR: o hook recusa ‚Äî o clique abre o di√°logo e NADA foi escrito
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Whitelist' }));
+    const motivo = await screen.findByTestId('geo-motivo-recusa');
+    expect(motivo).toHaveTextContent('A whitelist n√£o inclui o pa√≠s do seu acesso');
+    expect(screen.getByRole('alertdialog')).toHaveTextContent('Seu pa√≠s detectado: Brasil (BR)');
+    expect(screen.getByTestId('geo-confirmar-modo')).toBeDisabled();
+    expect(updateMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+
+    // nem clicando no bot√£o desabilitado
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('geo-confirmar-modo'));
+    expect(updateMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('confirmado, a troca permitida grava o modo escolhido', async () => {
+    prepararLeituras({ allowed: [pais('BR', 'Brasil')] });
+    render(<GeoBlockingPanel />);
+    await screen.findByTestId('geo-pais-detectado');
+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Whitelist' }));
+    const confirmar = await screen.findByTestId('geo-confirmar-modo');
+    expect(confirmar).toBeEnabled();
+    expect(screen.queryByTestId('geo-motivo-recusa')).toBeNull();
+    expect(updateMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); // abrir o di√°logo n√£o grava
+
+    fireEvent.click(confirmar);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(updateMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));

+  });
+
+  it('desativar continua permitido (nunca tranca o acesso) e tamb√©m passa pela confirma√ß√£o', async () => {
+    prepararLeituras({ mode: 'blacklist', blocked: [pais('BR', 'Brasil')] });

+    expect(confirmar).toBeEnabled();
+    expect(screen.queryByTestId('geo-motivo-recusa')).toBeNull();

+    fireEvent.click(confirmar);

+  });

+  it('falha de leitura do pa√≠s aparece na tela e bloqueia a ativa√ß√£o', async () => {

+
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Blacklist' }));

+      'N√£o foi poss√≠vel confirmar o pa√≠s do seu acesso',

+    expect(screen.getByTestId('geo-confirmar-modo')).toBeDisabled();
+    expect(updateMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });

+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

+import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
+import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+/**
+ * HZ2-013 ‚Äî a lista de supress√£o lia `talkx_blacklist` sem `.range()`: o
+ * PostgREST corta a resposta no teto de linhas do projeto (1000) SEM avisar.
+ * Com 1500 supress√µes, o operador via 1000 e a tela dizia "de 1.000 contatos
+ * suprimidos" ‚Äî as outras 500 n√£o existiam para ele (e as contagens por motivo
+ * e a marca√ß√£o em massa sa√≠am sobre uma lista truncada).
+ *
+ * A prova √© sobre a TELA: 1500 linhas na tabela do servidor ‚áí "de 1.500
+ * contatos suprimidos" e duas idas ao servidor por `range` (0-999 e 1000-1999).
+ */
+
+const CAP = 1000; // teto por resposta do PostgREST (o mesmo do projeto)
+
+const h = vi.hoisted(() => ({
+  allRows: [] as unknown[],
+  ranges: [] as Array<{ select: string; from: number; to: number }>,
+}));
+
+vi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => {
+  function makeChain() {
+    const rec = { select: '', from: -1, to: -1 };
+    const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+    const keep = () => chain;
+    chain.select = (fields?: string) => { rec.select = fields ?? ''; return chain; };
+    chain.is = keep;
+    chain.eq = keep;
+    chain.in = keep;
+    chain.not = keep;
+    chain.order = keep;
+    chain.or = keep;
+    chain.range = (from: number, to: number) => { rec.from = from; rec.to = to; h.ranges.push({ select: rec.select, from, to }); return chain; };
+    chain.then = (resolve: (v: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
+      Promise.resolve(run(rec)).then(resolve, reject);
+    return chain;
+  }
+
+  // Simula o PostgREST: a fatia √© aplicada AQUI e a resposta nunca passa de CAP linhas.
+  function run(rec: { select: string; from: number; to: number }) {
+    const all = h.allRows;
+    if (rec.from < 0) return { data: all.slice(0, CAP), error: null };
+    const end = Math.min(rec.to + 1, rec.from + CAP, all.length);
+    return { data: all.slice(rec.from, end), error: null };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    supabase: {
+      auth: { getUser: () => Promise.resolve({ data: { user: null }, error: null }) },
+      from: () => makeChain(),
+    },
+  };
+});
+
+vi.mock('@/lib/supabaseHelpers', () => ({
+  fromTable: () => ({
+    insert: () => Promise.resolve({ error: null }),
+    select: () => ({ in: () => Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }) }),
+  }),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('@/hooks/auth/useAuth', () => ({
+  useAuth: () => ({ profile: { id: 'profile-1' }, user: { id: 'profile-1' }, session: null, loading: false }),
+}));
+
+vi.mock('sonner', () => ({ toast: { success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn() } }));

+    ]);

+export type ActiveCampaign = {

+  if (active.length === 0) return null;

+export function TalkXCampaignReport({ campaign, creators, onBack, onViewMonitor }: TalkXCampaignReportProps) {
+  const timeZone = campaign.schedule_timezone || DEFAULT_TIMEZONE;
+  const [granularity, setGranularity] = useState<TalkXReportGranularity>('day');
+  const [heatmapMetric, setHeatmapMetric] = useState<TalkXReportHeatmapMetric>('replied');
+
+  const reportQuery = useQuery({
+    queryKey: ['talkx-campaign-report', campaign.id],
+    queryFn: async () => {
+      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('talkx_campaign_report', { p_campaign: campaign.id });
+      if (error) throw error;
+      return (data ?? null) as unknown as TalkXCampaignReportPayload | null;
+    },
+    staleTime: 60_000,
+  });
+
+  const recipientsQuery = useQuery({
+    queryKey: ['talkx-report-recipients', campaign.id],
+    queryFn: async () => {
+      const { data, error } = await fromTable('talkx_recipients')
+        .select('sent_at, delivered_at, replied_at')
+        .eq('campaign_id', campaign.id)
+        .not('sent_at', 'is', null)
+        .order('sent_at', { ascending: true })
+        .limit(REPORT_SAMPLE_LIMIT);
+      if (error) throw error;
+      return (data ?? []) as TalkXReportRecipientRow[];
+    },
+    staleTime: 60_000,

+  const clicksQuery = useQuery({

+      if (error) throw error;

+      return ((data ?? []) as ClickRow[])
+        .filter((row) => row.talkx_links?.campaign_id === campaign.id)
+        .map((row) => row.clicked_at);
+    },
+    staleTime: 60_000,
+  });
+
+  const kpis = reportQuery.data?.kpis ?? null;
+  const recipients = useMemo(() => recipientsQuery.data ?? [], [recipientsQuery.data]);
+  const clicks = useMemo(() => clicksQuery.data ?? [], [clicksQuery.data]);
+  const sampleTruncated = recipients.length >= REPORT_SAMPLE_LIMIT;
+
+  const series = useMemo(
+    () => talkxReportSeriesFromRows(recipients, granularity, timeZone),
+    [recipients, granularity, timeZone],
+  );
+
+  const heatmap = useMemo(() => {
+    if (heatmapMetric === 'clicked') return talkxReportHeatmapFromTimestamps(clicks, timeZone);
+    const key = heatmapMetric === 'sent' ? 'sent_at' : 'replied_at';
+    return talkxReportHeatmapFromTimestamps(recipients.map((row) => row[key]), timeZone);
+  }, [heatmapMetric, recipients, clicks, timeZone]);
+
+  const funnelSteps = useMemo<TalkXReportFunnelStep[]>(() => {
+    const sent = kpis?.sent_count ?? campaign.sent_count;
+    const delivered = kpis?.delivered_count ?? campaign.delivered_count;
+    const hasClicksData = clicksQuery.isSuccess;
+    return [
+      { key: 'sent', count: sent },
+      { key: 'delivered', count: delivered },
+      { key: 'replied', count: campaign.replied_count ?? 0 },
+      { key: 'clicked', count: hasClicksData ? clicks.length : null },
+      { key: 'converted', count: null },
+    ];
+  }, [kpis, campaign, clicks.length, clicksQuery.isSuccess]);
+
+  const handleGranularity = useCallback((next: TalkXReportGranularity) => setGranularity(next), []);
+  const handleMetric = useCallback((next: TalkXReportHeatmapMetric) => setHeatmapMetric(next), []);
+
+  const boundaryQuery: TalkXQueryLike = {
+    isLoading: reportQuery.isLoading,
+    isFetching: reportQuery.isFetching,
+    isError: reportQuery.isError,
+    error: reportQuery.error,
+  };
+
+  const durationText = kpis ? fmtDurationShort(kpis.duration_secs) : '‚Äî';
+  const kpiCards: { label: string; value: string; hint?: string }[] = kpis
+    ? [
+        { label: 'Destinat√°rios', value: fmtInt(kpis.total_recipients) },
+        { label: 'Enviados', value: fmtInt(kpis.sent_count) },
+        { label: 'Entregues', value: fmtInt(kpis.delivered_count), hint: `${String(kpis.delivery_rate_pct).replace('.', ',')}% dos enviados` },
+        { label: 'Respostas', value: fmtInt(campaign.replied_count ?? 0) },
+        { label: 'Lidas', value: fmtInt(kpis.read_count) },
+        { label: 'Falhas', value: fmtInt(kpis.failed_count) },
+        { label: 'A confirmar', value: fmtInt(kpis.outcome_unknown_count) },
+        { label: 'Dura√ß√£o', value: durationText },
+      ]
+    : [];
+
+  return (
+    <div className="min-h-full w-full min-w-0 bg-background p-3 md:p-4 lg:p-6 space-y-4">
+      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-3 justify-between">
+        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">

+          </div>

+/**
+ * X164 / TL-080 ‚Äî leitura crua dos destinat√°rios para os tr√™s cart√µes do
+ * relat√≥rio (tela 14) e as contas puras de agrupamento.
+ *
+ * Irm√£o do `talkxReportCharts.ts`: nada de componente aqui. A tela
+ * (`TalkXCampaignReport`) l√™ as linhas REAIS de `talkx_recipients`
+ * (sent_at / delivered_at / replied_at) e entrega as s√©ries e a grade 7x24
+ * prontas aos cart√µes apresentacionais.
+ *
+ * Fuso: o RPC `talkx_campaign_report` s√≥ devolve envios e entregues por hora, sem
+ * respostas, ent√£o o agrupamento por dia/hora e o mapa de calor s√£o feitos AQUI,
+ * sempre no fuso da CAMPANHA (`talkx_campaigns.schedule_timezone`) ‚Äî nunca no fuso
+ * de quem abre a tela.
+ */
+
+import type { TalkXReportGranularity, TalkXReportSeriesPoint } from './talkxReportCharts';
+
+/** Linha m√≠nima lida de `talkx_recipients` para montar s√©rie e mapa de calor. */
+export interface TalkXReportRecipientRow {
+  sent_at: string | null;
+  delivered_at: string | null;
+  replied_at: string | null;
+}
+
+/** Teto defensivo da amostra lida (as MAIS ANTIGAS, para a s√©rie come√ßar no in√≠cio). */
+export const REPORT_SAMPLE_LIMIT = 20_000;
+
+/** Segunda=0 ‚Ä¶ Domingo=6 (a semana do mock ‚Äî o `getDay()` come√ßa no domingo). */
+const WEEKDAY_INDEX: Record<string, number> = { Mon: 0, Tue: 1, Wed: 2, Thu: 3, Fri: 4, Sat: 5, Sun: 6 };
+
+interface ZoneParts {
+  /** Data local da campanha no formato AAAA-MM-DD. */
+  dayKey: string;
+  /** 0=Segunda ‚Ä¶ 6=Domingo. */
+  weekday: number;
+  /** Hora local da campanha (0‚Äì23). */
+  hour: number;
+}
+
+function zoneParts(value: string, timeZone: string): ZoneParts | null {
+  const date = new Date(value);
+  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null;
+  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
+    timeZone,
+    weekday: 'short',
+    hour: '2-digit',
+    hour12: false,
+    year: 'numeric',
+    month: '2-digit',
+    day: '2-digit',
+  }).formatToParts(date);
+  const get = (type: string) => parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? '';
+  const weekday = WEEKDAY_INDEX[get('weekday')];
+  if (weekday === undefined) return null;
+  const rawHour = Number(get('hour'));
+  // Alguns motores devolvem 24 para a meia-noite mesmo com hour12:false.
+  const hour = Number.isFinite(rawHour) ? rawHour % 24 : 0;
+  return { dayKey: `${get('year')}-${get('month')}-${get('day')}`, weekday, hour };
+}
+
+/**
+ * S√©rie de desempenho a partir das linhas reais. O balde √© ancorado no `sent_at`
+ * (como o Analytics): entregues e respostas contam no balde do envio.
+ * `conversions` fica 0 porque n√£o h√° fonte de convers√£o ‚Äî a linha s√≥ √© desenhada
+ * quando `hasConversionSource` for verdadeiro.
+ */
+export function talkxReportSeriesFromRows(
+  rows: TalkXReportRecipientRow[],
+  granularity: TalkXReportGranularity,
+  timeZone: string,
+): TalkXReportSeriesPoint[] {
+  const buckets = new Map<string, { bucket: string; sortKey: number; sent: number; delivered: number; replied: number }>();
+  for (const row of rows) {
+    if (!row.sent_at) continue;
+    const parts = zoneParts(row.sent_at, timeZone);
+    if (!parts) continue;
+    const key = granularity === 'hour' ? `${parts.dayKey}T${String(parts.hour).padStart(2, '0')}` : parts.dayKey;
+    const sortKey = new Date(row.sent_at).getTime();
+    let bucket = buckets.get(key);
+    if (!bucket) {
+      bucket = { bucket: row.sent_at, sortKey, sent: 0, delivered: 0, replied: 0 };
+      buckets.set(key, bucket);
+    }
+    // O instante mais antigo do balde rotula o eixo (o r√≥tulo √© formatado no fuso).
+    if (sortKey < bucket.sortKey) {
+      bucket.bucket = row.sent_at;
+      bucket.sortKey = sortKey;
+    }
+    bucket.sent += 1;
+    if (row.delivered_at) bucket.delivered += 1;
+    if (row.replied_at) bucket.replied += 1;
+  }
+  return Array.from(buckets.values())
+    .sort((a, b) => a.sortKey - b.sortKey)
+    .map(({ bucket, sent, delivered, replied }) => ({ bucket, sent, delivered, replied, conversions: 0 }));
+}
+
+/**
+ * Grade 7x24 (linha 0 = segunda) contando os instantes por dia da semana e hora
+ * no fuso da campanha. Usada tanto para envios/respostas quanto para cliques.
+ */
+export function talkxReportHeatmapFromTimestamps(
+  timestamps: (string | null | undefined)[],
+  timeZone: string,
+): number[][] {
+  const grid = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => Array.from({ length: 24 }, () => 0));
+  for (const value of timestamps) {
+    if (!value) continue;
+    const parts = zoneParts(value, timeZone);
+    if (!parts) continue;
+    grid[parts.weekday][parts.hour] += 1;
+  }
+  return grid;
+}

+/** O que o card precisa saber da linha da campanha (contadores exatos, sem amostra). */
+export interface TalkXCampaignCounterRow {
+  sent_count?: number | null;
+  delivered_count?: number | null;
+  replied_count?: number | null;
+  failed_count?: number | null;
+  outcome_unknown_count?: number | null;

+function toCount(v: unknown): number {
+  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v);
+  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? Math.floor(n) : 0;
+}
+
+function toSeconds(v: unknown): number | null {
+  if (v === null || v === undefined) return null;
+  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v);
+  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 ? n : null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Monta as m√©tricas a partir da LINHA da campanha (T13-058‚Ä¶T13-063): os totais v√™m dos
+ * contadores exatos (`sent_count`, `delivered_count`, `replied_count`, `failed_count`),
+ * nunca de amostra limitada. `avgReplySeconds` vem do painel
+ * (`talkx_campaign_report` ‚Üí `kpis.avg_reply_secs`); sem respostas √© null ("‚Äî").
+ */
+export function keyMetricsFromCampaign(
+  row: TalkXCampaignCounterRow,
+  avgReplySeconds: unknown,
+): TalkXKeyMetricsData {
+  const sent = toCount(row?.sent_count);
+  const delivered = toCount(row?.delivered_count);
+  const replied = toCount(row?.replied_count);
+  const failed = toCount(row?.failed_count);
+  const unknown = toCount(row?.outcome_unknown_count);
+  return {
+    sent,
+    delivered,
+    replied,
+    failed,
+    processed: sent + failed + unknown,
+    avgReplySeconds: toSeconds(avgReplySeconds),
+  };
+}

+export function benchmarksFromJson(payload: unknown): TalkXKeyMetricsBenchmarks {

+  const global = (payload as { global?: unknown }).global;
+  if (typeof global !== 'object' || global === null || Array.isArray(global)) {

+  return {
+    hasBaseline: count >= 1,
+    avgDeliveryRatePct: toSeconds(g.avg_delivery_rate_pct),
+    avgReplyRatePct: toSeconds(g.avg_reply_rate_pct),
+  };

+function toCount(v: unknown): number {
+  const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v);
+  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? Math.floor(n) : 0;
+}

+function hourStart(iso: string): number {
+  const t = new Date(iso).getTime();
+  if (Number.isNaN(t)) return NaN;
+  return Math.floor(t / HOUR_MS) * HOUR_MS;
+}

+export function buildSentSummaryPoints(
+  hourly: TalkXReportHourBucket[] | null | undefined,
+  replyTimestamps: Array<string | null | undefined> | null | undefined,
+  windowMinutes: number,

+  };

+  }

+    const start = hourStart(ts);

+    slot(start).replied += 1;
+  }

+  return Object.keys(byBucket)

+export function formatScheduleRelative(
+  localDateTime: string,
+  timezone: string,
+  nowMs: number = Date.now(),
+): { when: string; relative: string } | null {
+  if (!localDateTime) return null;
+  let instantMs: number;
+  try {
+    instantMs = new Date(localToUTCInTimezone(localDateTime, timezone)).getTime();
+  } catch {
+    // Hor√°rio inexistente ou amb√≠guo naquele fuso (virada de hor√°rio de ver√£o).
+    return null;
+  }
+  if (!Number.isFinite(instantMs)) return null;
+
+  const [datePart = '', timePart = ''] = localDateTime.split('T');
+  const todayLocal = utcToLocalInTimezone(new Date(nowMs).toISOString(), timezone).split('T')[0] ?? '';
+  const yesterdayLocal = utcToLocalInTimezone(new Date(nowMs - 86_400_000).toISOString(), timezone).split('T')[0] ?? '';
+  const [year = '', month = '', day = ''] = datePart.split('-');
+  const when = datePart === todayLocal
+    ? `Hoje, ${timePart}`
+    : datePart === yesterdayLocal
+      ? `Ontem, ${timePart}`
+      : `${day}/${month}/${year} ${timePart}`;
+
+  const deltaMinutes = Math.round((instantMs - nowMs) / 60_000);
+  const abs = Math.abs(deltaMinutes);
+  const prefix = deltaMinutes >= 0 ? 'Em' : 'H√°';
+  const relative = abs < 1
+    ? 'Agora'
+    : abs < 60
+      ? `${prefix} ${pluralize(abs, 'minuto', 'minutos')}`
+      : abs < 1440
+        ? `${prefix} ${pluralize(Math.round(abs / 60), 'hora', 'horas')}`
+        : `${prefix} ${pluralize(Math.round(abs / 1440), 'dia', 'dias')}`;
+
+  return { when, relative };
+}

+// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Ambiente de m√≠dia (a mesma fonte do componente: pointerMedia/matchMedia) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+/** Mente sobre as media queries do ambiente e devolve o desfazer. */
+function fingirMidia(matches: (consulta: string) => boolean) {
+  const original = window.matchMedia;
+  window.matchMedia = ((consulta: string) => ({
+    matches: matches(consulta),
+    media: consulta,
+    onchange: null,
+    addListener: () => {},
+    removeListener: () => {},
+    addEventListener: () => {},
+    removeEventListener: () => {},
+    dispatchEvent: () => false,
+  })) as unknown as typeof window.matchMedia;
+  return () => { window.matchMedia = original; };
+}

+/** Abaixo de `md`: o corte de `useNarrowViewport` (¬ß pointerMedia.ts). */

+// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Tokens reais (√© deles que sai o espa√ßo dispon√≠vel) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+const tokensCss = fs.readFileSync(
+  path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../styles/tokens.css'),
+  'utf8',
+);
+function tokenPx(nome: string): number {
+  const m = tokensCss.match(new RegExp(`--${nome}:\\s*([\\d.]+)(px|rem)`));
+  if (!m) throw new Error(`token --${nome} n√£o encontrado no CSS do app`);
+  return m[2] === 'px' ? Number(m[1]) : Number(m[1]) * 16;
+}
+
+/** Escala do Tailwind de volta para px (`min-w-[200px]`, `min-w-5` = 20px). */
+function escalaTailwind(token: string): number | null {
+  const px = token.match(/^\[(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)px\]$/);
+  if (px) return Number(px[1]);
+  if (/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(token)) return Number(token) * 4;
+  return null;
+}

+/**
+ * O piso de largura que a coluna imp√µe NAQUELA faixa ‚Äî modelo do cascade do
+ * Tailwind: a variante sem prefixo vale sempre e a de MAIOR ponto de quebra
+ * (a √∫ltima na folha de estilo) ganha das menores. Usar o "maior `min-w-*` do
+ * `className`" mentiria: em `xl` o `min-w-0` do `xl` vence o `md:min-w-[200px]`.
+ */
+const PONTOS_DE_QUEBRA = ['', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const;
+function pisoNaFaixa(className: string, faixa: 'md' | 'xl'): number {
+  const limite = PONTOS_DE_QUEBRA.indexOf(faixa);
+  let piso = 0;
+  let vencedor = -1;
+  for (const cls of className.split(/\s+/)) {
+    const m = cls.match(/^((?:[a-z]+:)*)min-w-(.+)$/);
+    if (!m) continue;
+    const prefixo = m[1].replace(/:$/, '');
+    const ponto = PONTOS_DE_QUEBRA.indexOf(prefixo as typeof PONTOS_DE_QUEBRA[number]);
+    if (ponto === -1 || ponto > limite) continue; // variante que ainda n√£o vale
+    const px = escalaTailwind(m[2]);
+    if (px === null) throw new Error(`o teste n√£o sabe converter a classe de largura: ${cls}`);
+    if (ponto >= vencedor) { vencedor = ponto; piso = px; }
+  }
+  return piso;
+}
+
+/** O v√£o entre as colunas, lido do pr√≥prio trilho (`gap-3` = 12px). */
+function gapDe(className: string): number {
+  const m = className
+    .split(/\s+/)
+    .map(c => c.match(/^(?:[a-z]+:)?gap-(\d+|\[\d+px\])$/))
+    .find(Boolean);
+  if (!m) throw new Error(`o trilho n√£o declara um \`gap\` que o teste saiba ler: ${className}`);
+  return escalaTailwind(m[1])!;
+}

+  /** Rel√≥gio da confer√™ncia; injet√°vel nos testes. Padr√£o: agora. */
+  now?: Date;
+  /** Recebe o ISO do lembrete ajustado ("Ajustar para 1 h antes do prazo"). */
+  onAjustar: (iso: string) => void;
+}
+
+interface Visual {
+  /** Par de texto AA + tinta/borda de aviso de cada estado. */
+  classe: string;
+  icone: LucideIcon;
+  /** `role` do bloco: `alert` no que exige a√ß√£o, `status` no informativo. */
+  papel: 'status' | 'alert';
+}
+
+/** Verde = coerente; √¢mbar = aviso; vermelho = erro. */
+const VISUAL: Record<RemindCoherenceState, Visual> = {
+  ok: {
+    classe: 'border-success/30 bg-success/10 text-success',
+    icone: CheckCircle2,
+    papel: 'status',
+  },
+  in_past: {
+    classe: 'border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 text-[hsl(var(--destructive-text))]',
+    icone: AlertCircle,
+    papel: 'alert',
+  },
+  after_due: {
+    classe: 'border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 text-[hsl(var(--warning-text))]',
+    icone: AlertTriangle,
+    papel: 'alert',
+  },
+  no_due: {
+    classe: 'border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 text-[hsl(var(--warning-text))]',
+    icone: AlertCircle,
+    papel: 'status',
+  },
+};
+
+/** O ajuste oferecido pelo atalho: uma hora antes do prazo. */
+const UMA_HORA_MS = 3_600_000;
+
+/** Instante v√°lido a partir de ISO/data; `null` quando ausente ou inv√°lido. */
+function comoData(value: string | Date | null): Date | null {
+  if (value === null) return null;
+  const d = typeof value === 'string' ? new Date(value) : value;
+  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
+}
+
+/**
+ * ISO do lembrete 1 h antes do prazo ‚Äî ou `null` quando esse alvo N√ÉO deixa a
+ * dupla coerente (sem prazo, prazo inv√°lido ou prazo j√° vencido). A confer√™ncia
+ * reusa `checkRemindCoherence`, ent√£o o bot√£o s√≥ aparece quando ele resolve.
+ * Interna de prop√≥sito: o arquivo exporta s√≥ o componente (fast refresh).
+ */
+function ajusteUmaHoraAntes(
+  dueDate: string | Date | null,
+  now: Date,
+): string | null {
+  const prazo = comoData(dueDate);
+  if (!prazo) return null;
+  const candidato = new Date(prazo.getTime() - UMA_HORA_MS).toISOString();
+  return checkRemindCoherence(candidato, dueDate, now).state === 'ok' ? candidato : null;
+}
+
+export function CoerenciaLembrete({
+  remindAt,
+  dueDate,
+  now = new Date(),
+  onAjustar,
+}: CoerenciaLembreteProps) {
+  const { state, message } = checkRemindCoherence(remindAt, dueDate, now);
+  // Sem lembrete n√£o h√° o que conferir: a fun√ß√£o devolve `ok` com mensagem vazia.
+  if (!message) return null;
+
+  const { classe, icone: Icone, papel } = VISUAL[state];
+  // Coerente n√£o tem o que ajustar; nos demais estados s√≥ oferece o atalho se
+  // ele levar a `ok` (o pr√≥prio `ajusteUmaHoraAntes` confere).
+  const ajuste = state === 'ok' ? null : ajusteUmaHoraAntes(dueDate, now);
+
+  return (
+    <div
+      data-testid="nt-coerencia"
+      data-state={state}
+      role={papel}
+      className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 ${classe}`}
+    >
+      <Icone aria-hidden className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
+      <span className="text-xs font-medium">{message}</span>
+      {ajuste !== null && (
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          data-testid="nt-coerencia-ajustar"
+          onClick={() => onAjustar(ajuste)}
+          className={
+            'ml-auto h-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 text-xs font-semibold ' +
+            'underline-offset-2 hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none ' +
+            'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring'
+          }
+        >
+          Ajustar para 1 h antes do prazo
+        </button>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+function renderPalette(props: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
+  const onNavigate = vi.fn();

+/**
+ * AnimatedCounter e Typewriter ‚Äî defeitos de movimento.
+ *
+ * 1) O contador guardava o valor anterior num objeto recriado a cada render
+ *    (`const prevRef = { current: 0 }`), ent√£o toda mudan√ßa de valor animava
+ *    de 0; agora o valor anterior vem de um `useRef` est√°vel.
+ * 2) O Typewriter reiniciava o efeito a cada render (identidade de
+ *    `onComplete` nas deps) e ignorava o reduzir movimento.
+ *
+ * O framer-motion √© substitu√≠do por um passe-plataforma determin√≠stico: o
+ * teste mede a l√≥gica do contador, n√£o o runtime de anima√ß√£o.
+ */
+import { describe, expect, it, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
+import { render, screen, act } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { createElement, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+
+const reduzido = { value: false };
+
+vi.mock('framer-motion', () => {
+  const propsDeMovimento = new Set([
+    'initial', 'animate', 'exit', 'transition', 'variants', 'whileHover',
+    'whileTap', 'whileFocus', 'layout', 'layoutId', 'drag', 'onAnimationComplete',
+  ]);
+  const cache = new Map<string, (props: Record<string, unknown>) => ReactNode>();
+  const motion = new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
+    get(_target, tag: string) {
+      if (typeof tag !== 'string') return undefined;
+      if (!cache.has(tag)) {
+        cache.set(tag, (props: Record<string, unknown>) => {
+          const limpos: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+          for (const [chave, valor] of Object.entries(props)) {
+            if (!propsDeMovimento.has(chave)) limpos[chave] = valor;
+          }
+          return createElement(tag, limpos, props.children as ReactNode);
+        });
+      }
+      return cache.get(tag);
+    },
+  });
+  return { motion, AnimatePresence: ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => children, Variants: undefined, useReducedMotion: () => reduzido.value };
+});
+
+import { AnimatedCounter, Typewriter } from '@/components/ui/motion/effects';
+
+type Quadro = (ts: number) => void;
+let fila: Quadro[] = [];
+
+const quadros = (ts: number) => {
+  const atuais = fila;
+  fila = [];
+  act(() => {
+    atuais.forEach((cb) => cb(ts));
+  });
+};
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  fila = [];
+  vi.stubGlobal('requestAnimationFrame', (cb: Quadro) => {
+    fila.push(cb);
+    return fila.length;
+  });
+  vi.stubGlobal('cancelAnimationFrame', () => {});
+  reduzido.value = false;
+});
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+});
+
+describe('AnimatedCounter', () => {
+  it('1. conta do ZERO at√© o valor na primeira montagem', () => {
+    render(<AnimatedCounter value={10} duration={1} />);
+    quadros(1000);
+    quadros(2000);
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('10')).toBeTruthy();
+  });
+
+  it('2. ao mudar o valor, anima do valor ANTERIOR (n√£o reinicia do zero)', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<AnimatedCounter value={10} duration={1} />);
+    quadros(1000);
+    quadros(2000);
+    expect(screen.getByText('10')).toBeTruthy();
+
+    rerender(<AnimatedCounter value={20} duration={1} />);
+    quadros(3000);
+    quadros(3500);
+
+    // 10 + (20-10) * ease(0.5) = 10 + 10*0.875 = 18.75 -> 19.
+    // Com o bug antigo (start=0) daria 0 + 20*0.875 = 17.5 -> 18.
+    expect(screen.getByText('19')).toBeTruthy();
+  });
+
+  it('3. re-renderizar com o MESMO valor n√£o reagenda anima√ß√£o', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<AnimatedCounter value={7} duration={1} />);
+    quadros(1000);
+    quadros(2000);
+    expect(screen.getByText('7')).toBeTruthy();
+
+    fila = [];
+    rerender(<AnimatedCounter value={7} duration={1} />);
+
+    expect(fila).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(screen.getByText('7')).toBeTruthy();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('Typewriter', () => {
+  it('4. com movimento reduzido mostra o texto inteiro de uma vez e avisa o fim', () => {
+    reduzido.value = true;
+    const aoCompletar = vi.fn();
+
+    render(<Typewriter text="Pronto" speed={10} onComplete={aoCompletar} />);
+
+    expect(screen.getByText('Pronto')).toBeTruthy();

+import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { PhoneInput } from '../phone-input';
+
+/**
+ * Ajuste ao UI-07 ‚Äî a m√°scara do PhoneInput tem de PRESERVAR n√∫mero
+ * internacional: s√≥ o n√∫mero brasileiro ganha `+55`.
+ *
+ * N√∫meros de outro pa√≠s com `+` (E.164) passam sem virar `+55 ...`.
+ * O formul√°rio real √© controlado (o pai guarda o `value` formatado).
+ */
+function Harness({ initial = '', onChange }: { initial?: string; onChange?: (f: string, r: string) => void }) {
+  const [value, setValue] = useState(initial);
+  return (
+    <PhoneInput
+      value={value}
+      onChange={(formatted, raw) => {
+        setValue(formatted);
+        onChange?.(formatted, raw);
+      }}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+function field() {
+  return screen.getByPlaceholderText('+55 11 99999-0000') as HTMLInputElement;
+}
+
+function change(input: HTMLInputElement, value: string) {
+  fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value } });
+}
+
+describe('PhoneInput ‚Äî BR e internacional', () => {
+  it('celular BR digitado sem m√°scara vira +55 XX XXXXX-XXXX', () => {
+    const onChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Harness onChange={onChange} />);
+
+    change(field(), '11987654321');
+
+    expect(field().value).toBe('+55 11 98765-4321');
+    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('+55 11 98765-4321', '5511987654321');
+  });
+
+  it('fixo BR de 10 d√≠gitos vira +55 XX XXXX-XXXX', () => {
+    const onChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Harness onChange={onChange} />);
+
+    change(field(), '1132345678');
+
+    expect(field().value).toBe('+55 11 3234-5678');
+    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('+55 11 3234-5678', '551132345678');
+  });
+
+  it('+1 (EUA) permanece E.164, sem ganhar +55', () => {
+    const onChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Harness onChange={onChange} />);
+
+    change(field(), '+1 415 555 0100');
+
+    expect(field().value).toBe('+14155550100');
+    expect(field().value).not.toContain('+55');
+    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('+14155550100', '14155550100');
+  });
+
+  it('+351 (Portugal) permanece E.164, sem ganhar +55', () => {
+    const onChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Harness onChange={onChange} />);
+

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join } from 'node:path';
+
+import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
+import { act, render, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
+
+import { Toaster, toast } from '@/components/ui/sonner';
+
+/**
+ * U1-04 (2¬™ passada da auditoria de paridade V3 -> V2, doc 13 ‚Äî primitivos de UI).
+ *
+ * No celular o aviso do Sonner nascia a 16px do rodap√© (`MOBILE_VIEWPORT_OFFSET`
+ * do sonner 2.0.8, aplicado por `bottom: var(--mobile-offset-bottom)` dentro do
+ * `@media (max-width: 600px)`) e cobria a `BottomNavigation` e o `MobileFAB`.
+ *
+ * A prova renderiza o `<Toaster/>` REAL (com um aviso de verdade) e l√™ o offset
+ * que ele aplica no elemento do sonner; a geometria da barra e do FAB √© lida dos
+ * arquivos de origem, ent√£o mudar qualquer um dos tr√™s quebra o teste.
+ */
+
+const RAIZ_SRC = join(process.cwd(), 'src');
+
+function ler(relativo: string): string {
+  return readFileSync(join(RAIZ_SRC, relativo), 'utf8');
+}
+
+function pxDe(fonte: string, regex: RegExp, rotulo: string): number {
+  const achado = fonte.match(regex);
+  if (!achado) throw new Error(`n√£o achei ${rotulo} com ${regex}`);
+  return Number(achado[1]);
+}
+
+async function toasterMontado(): Promise<HTMLElement> {
+  render(<Toaster />);
+  act(() => {
+    toast('Aviso de teste');
+  });
+  const elemento = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-sonner-toaster]');
+  await waitFor(() => expect(document.querySelector('[data-sonner-toaster]')).not.toBeNull());
+  return elemento ?? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-sonner-toaster]')!;
+}
+
+function valorDoOffset(elemento: HTMLElement, propriedade: string): string {
+  const doStyle = elemento.style.getPropertyValue(propriedade);
+  return doStyle || extrairDoAtributo(elemento, propriedade);
+}
+
+function extrairDoAtributo(elemento: HTMLElement, propriedade: string): string {
+  const atributo = elemento.getAttribute('style') ?? '';
+  const achado = new RegExp(`${propriedade}\\s*:\\s*([^;]+)`).exec(atributo);
+  return achado ? achado[1].trim() : '';
+}
+
+/** `calc(140px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))` -> 140 + inset informado. */
+function emPx(declaracao: string, insetDaAreaSegura: number): number {
+  const expressao = declaracao
+    .replace(/^calc\(/, '')
+    .replace(/\)\s*$/, '')
+    .replace(/env\(\s*safe-area-inset-bottom[^)]*\)/g, `${insetDaAreaSegura}px`);
+
+  return expressao
+    .split('+')
+    .reduce((total, parcela) => total + Number.parseFloat(parcela.trim()), 0);
+}
+
+describe('sonner ‚Äî offset no celular (U1-04)', () => {
+  it('aplica --mobile-offset-bottom em calc() com a √°rea segura e preserva as laterais', async () => {
+    const toaster = await toasterMontado();
+
+    const offset = valorDoOffset(toaster, '--mobile-offset-bottom');
+    expect(offset).not.toBe('');
+    expect(offset).toMatch(/^calc\(\s*[\d.]+px\s*\+\s*env\(\s*safe-area-inset-bottom[^)]*\)\s*\)$/);
+
+    // S√≥ o rodap√© muda: as laterais seguem o padr√£o do sonner (16px no mobile).
+    expect(valorDoOffset(toaster, '--mobile-offset-right')).toBe('16px');
+    expect(valorDoOffset(toaster, '--mobile-offset-left')).toBe('16px');
+  });
+
+  it('n√£o sobrep√µe a BottomNavigation (h-[60px] + borda) nem o MobileFAB', async () => {
+    const toaster = await toasterMontado();
+
+    const navSrc = ler('components/ui/mobile-components.tsx');
+    const fabSrc = ler('components/mobile/MobileFAB.tsx');
+
+    const alturaDaBarra = pxDe(navSrc, /h-\[(\d+)px\] px-1/, 'a altura da BottomNavigation') + 1; // border-t
+    const baseDoFab = pxDe(fabSrc, /bottom-\[(\d+)px\]/, 'a base do MobileFAB');
+    expect(fabSrc).toMatch(/h-14\b/); // h-14 = 56px
+    const topoDoFab = baseDoFab + 56;
+
+    const folgaSemNotch = emPx(valorDoOffset(toaster, '--mobile-offset-bottom'), 0);
+    const folgaComNotch = emPx(valorDoOffset(toaster, '--mobile-offset-bottom'), 34);
+
+    expect(folgaSemNotch).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(alturaDaBarra);
+    expect(folgaSemNotch).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(topoDoFab);
+    // O inset s√≥ desloca o aviso junto com a barra: a folga acima dos dois √© a mesma.
+    expect(folgaComNotch - 34).toBe(folgaSemNotch);
+  });
+
+  it('no desktop o offset continua o padr√£o do sonner (24px nas laterais e no rodap√©)', async () => {
+    const toaster = await toasterMontado();
+
+    expect(valorDoOffset(toaster, '--offset-bottom')).toBe('24px');
+    expect(valorDoOffset(toaster, '--offset-right')).toBe('24px');
+  });
+});

+/**
+ * UI-11 (2¬™ passada da auditoria do doc 13) ‚Äî temporizadores dos primitivos de UI.
+ *
+ * Cada componente que agenda `setTimeout`/`setInterval` precisa LIMPAR o que estiver
+ * pendente quando sai da tela: um id vivo depois do unmount chama `setState` em
+ * componente desmontado (aviso do React) e, no caso do skip link, mantinha uma
+ * varredura por intervalo rodando a sess√£o inteira.

+ * pelo caminho real do componente, desmonta e exige contagem ZERO.
+ */
+import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
+import { render, fireEvent, act, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';

+import * as React from 'react';
+import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/toggle-group';
+import { Form, FormControl, FormField, FormItem, useFormField } from '@/components/ui/form';
+import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
+
+const FONTE_SKIP = readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), 'src/components/ui/skip-link.tsx'), 'utf8');
+const FONTE_PEEK = readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), 'src/components/ui/quick-peek.tsx'), 'utf8');
+const FONTE_FORM = readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), 'src/components/ui/form.tsx'), 'utf8');
+const FONTE_TOGGLE = readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), 'src/components/ui/toggle-group.tsx'), 'utf8');
+
+function alvo(id: string, tag = 'main') {
+  const el = document.createElement(tag);
+  el.id = id;
+  document.body.appendChild(el);
+  return el;
+}
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  vi.useFakeTimers();
+});
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  cleanup();
+  document.body.innerHTML = '';
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+});
+
+describe('skip-link', () => {
+  it('n√£o abre varredura por intervalo e limpa o aviso de Tab no unmount', () => {
+    alvo('main-content');
+    const { unmount } = render(<SkipLinks />);
+
+    // Sem `setInterval`: montar o skip link n√£o deixa nenhum temporizador pendente.
+    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0);
+
+    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'Tab' });
+    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(1); // prazo do aviso "Pressione Tab"
+
+    unmount();
+    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('n√£o renderiza <nav> vazio quando nenhum alvo existe na tela', () => {
+    const { container } = render(<SkipLinks />);
+
+    expect(container.querySelector('nav')).toBeNull();
+    expect(container.innerHTML).toBe('');
+  });
+
+  it('a detec√ß√£o de alvo √© por muta√ß√£o do documento, n√£o por intervalo', () => {
+    expect(FONTE_SKIP).not.toMatch(/setInterval/);
+    expect(FONTE_SKIP).toMatch(/new MutationObserver\(/);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('command-palette', () => {

+import { motion, useReducedMotion, type MotionProps } from 'framer-motion';
+
+/**
+ * Artes SVG dos estados vazios (s√≥ componentes, seguindo a regra da casa
+ * `react-refresh/only-export-components`: o mapa `illustrations` fica em
+ * `empty-state-illustrations.tsx`).
+ *
+ * A11Y (movimento reduzido): cada ilustra√ß√£o passa suas anima√ß√µes pelo port√£o
+ * `useMotionGate()`. Com `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` o port√£o devolve
+ * `{ initial: false }`, ou seja, o elemento fica no estado final e NENHUM loop
+ * (`repeat: Infinity`) roda. O `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"` da raiz j√°
+ * cobre as anima√ß√µes de transform, mas n√£o as de `pathLength` (ex.: dashboard)
+ * ‚Äî por isso o port√£o expl√≠cito aqui.
+ */
+
+/**
+ * Port√£o √∫nico de movimento das ilustra√ß√µes. Chame uma vez por componente e
+ * espalhe o retorno nos elementos `motion.*`.
+ */
+function useMotionGate(): (props: MotionProps) => MotionProps {
+  const reduzido = useReducedMotion();
+  return (props) => (reduzido ? { initial: false } : props);
+}

+import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
+import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+
+interface PhoneInputProps {
+  value: string;
+  onChange: (formatted: string, raw: string) => void;
+  placeholder?: string;
+  className?: string;
+  disabled?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formata uma string de d√≠gitos em telefone brasileiro:
+ *   +55 XX XXXXX-XXXX  (celular, 11 d√≠gitos no total)
+ *   +55 XX XXXX-XXXX   (fixo, 10)
+ *   +CC XXXXXXXXX      (internacional/incompleto ‚Äî passthrough)
+ * Comportamento portado do `PhoneInput` da V3.
+ */
+function formatPhone(digits: string): string {
+  if (!digits) return '';
+
+  // Come√ßa com 55 e tem corpo suficiente: formata como BR.
+  if (digits.startsWith('55') && digits.length >= 4) {
+    const ddd = digits.slice(2, 4);
+    const rest = digits.slice(4);
+    if (rest.length <= 5) {
+      return `+55 ${ddd} ${rest}`;
+    }
+    // Fixo (10 d√≠gitos no total): 8 ap√≥s o DDD ‚Üí XXXX-XXXX.
+    if (rest.length === 8) {
+      return `+55 ${ddd} ${rest.slice(0, 4)}-${rest.slice(4)}`;
+    }
+    // Celular (11 d√≠gitos) e parciais: 5-4.
+    // Teto: no m√°ximo 9 d√≠gitos ap√≥s o DDD.
+    const capped = rest.slice(0, 9);
+    return `+55 ${ddd} ${capped.slice(0, 5)}-${capped.slice(5)}`;
+  }
+
+  // Parcial: usu√°rio come√ßou a digitar.
+  if (digits.length <= 2) return `+${digits}`;
+  if (digits.length <= 4) return `+${digits.slice(0, 2)} ${digits.slice(2)}`;
+
+  // Internacional ou incompleto.
+  return `+${digits.slice(0, 2)} ${digits.slice(2)}`;
+}
+
+/** Extrai apenas os d√≠gitos de uma string. */
+function extractDigits(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/\D/g, '');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Campo de telefone com m√°scara brasileira (+55 XX XXXXX-XXXX).
+ * - Prefixa +55 quando o operador digita um DDD direto
+ * - Aceita apenas d√≠gitos
+ * - Formata em tempo real
+ * - `onChange` devolve (formatado, bruto)
+ * - Sem pr√©-preenchimento no foco: o campo vazio continua vazio e o
+ *   placeholder faz o papel de dica ([refazer 1] P1 ‚Äî '+55' sozinho n√£o
+ *   pode contar como n√∫mero preenchido).
+ */
+export function PhoneInput({ value, onChange, placeholder = '+55 11 99999-0000', className, disabled }: PhoneInputProps) {
+  // O valor exibido √© DERIVADO do `value` controlado (sem effect): o que sobe
+  // pelo onChange j√° vem formatado, ent√£o formatar de novo √© idempotente.
+  const displayValue = useMemo(() => formatPhone(extractDigits(value)), [value]);
+
+  const handleChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+    let digits = extractDigits(e.target.value);
+
+    // Prefixa 55 quando o operador digita um DDD brasileiro direto (ex.: "11...").
+    if (digits.length >= 2 && !digits.startsWith('55')) {
+      const possibleDDD = parseInt(digits.slice(0, 2), 10);
+      if (possibleDDD >= 11 && possibleDDD <= 99) {
+        digits = '55' + digits;
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Teto de 13 d√≠gitos (55 + 2 DDD + 9 n√∫mero).
+    if (digits.length > 13) digits = digits.slice(0, 13);
+
+    onChange(formatPhone(digits), digits);
+  }, [onChange]);
+
+  return (
+    <Input
+      type="tel"
+      inputMode="tel"
+      autoComplete="tel"
+      placeholder={placeholder}
+      value={displayValue}
+      onChange={handleChange}
+      disabled={disabled}
+      className={cn('tracking-wide', className)}
+    />
+  );
+}

+import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

+import React from 'react';
+import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';

+

+}));
+

+  useToast: () => ({ toast: vi.fn() }),
+  toast: vi.fn(),
+}));

+function createWrapper() {
+  const qc = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false, gcTime: 0 } } });
+  return ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
+    <QueryClientProvider client={qc}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
+  );
+}
+
+type QueryResult = { data: unknown; error: unknown };
+type RecordedCall = { method: string; args: unknown[] };
+
+/**
+ * Builder do PostgREST de mentira. Registra cada filtro chamado (para o teste
+ * provar que o filtro saiu na consulta) e responde na ordem dada; a ultima
+ * resposta se repete, e a pagina vazia que encerra o loop de paginacao.
+ */
+function makeQuery(results: QueryResult | QueryResult[]) {
+  const pending = Array.isArray(results) ? [...results] : [results];
+  const calls: RecordedCall[] = [];
+  const builder: Record<string, unknown> = { calls };
+  for (const method of ['select', 'not', 'gte', 'order', 'limit', 'or', 'eq', 'insert']) {
+    builder[method] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
+      calls.push({ method, args });
+      return builder;
+    };
+  }
+  builder.then = (onFulfilled: (v: unknown) => unknown, onRejected?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
+    Promise.resolve(pending.length > 1 ? pending.shift()! : pending[0]).then(onFulfilled, onRejected);
+  return builder as { calls: RecordedCall[] };
+}
+
+/** Convite sem nota = rating nulo: a consulta precisa mandar `rating IS NOT NULL`. */
+const ratingFilterSent = (q: { calls: RecordedCall[] }) =>
+  q.calls.some(
+    (c) => c.method === 'not' && c.args[0] === 'rating' && c.args[1] === 'is' && c.args[2] === null
+  );
+
+describe('useCSAT ‚Äî convite sem nota', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+  });
+
+  it('lista e estatisticas ignoram convite enviado e nunca respondido', async () => {
+    const now = new Date().toISOString();
+    const rated = {
+      id: 's1',
+      contact_id: 'c1',
+      agent_id: 'a1',
+      rating: 5,
+      feedback: null,
+      created_at: now,
+      conversation_resolved_at: null,
+    };
+    // So o convite respondido tem nota; o segundo foi enviado e ficou sem resposta.
+    const unrated = { ...rated, id: 's2', contact_id: 'c2', rating: null };
+    const query = makeQuery({ data: [rated, unrated], error: null });
+    mockFrom.mockReturnValue(query);
+
+    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCSAT(), { wrapper: createWrapper() });
+    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false));
+
+    expect(ratingFilterSent(query)).toBe(true);
+    expect(result.current.surveys.map((s) => s.id)).toEqual(['s1']);
+    expect(result.current.stats.total).toBe(1);
+    expect(result.current.stats.average).toBe(5);
+    expect(result.current.stats.distribution[5]).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('submitSurvey grava avaliacao sem agente com agent_id nulo', async () => {
+    const query = makeQuery({ data: [], error: null });
+    mockFrom.mockReturnValue(query);
+
+    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCSAT(), { wrapper: createWrapper() });
+    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false));
+
+    await act(async () => {

+    });
+
+    const insert = query.calls.find((c) => c.method === 'insert');
+    expect(insert?.args[0]).toMatchObject({ contact_id: 'c9', agent_id: null, rating: 4 });
+  });
+
+  it('janela do breakdown ignora convite sem nota no total, na taxa e por fila', async () => {
+    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
+    const rated = {
+      id: 's1',
+      agent_id: 'a1',
+      rating: 5,
+      created_at: nowIso,
+      agent: { name: 'Ana' },
+      contact: { queue_id: 'q1' },
+    };
+    const unrated = { ...rated, id: 's2', rating: null };
+    const csat = makeQuery([
+      { data: [rated, unrated], error: null },
+      { data: [], error: null },
+    ]);
+    const queues = makeQuery({ data: [{ id: 'q1', name: 'Fila 1' }], error: null });
+    mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) => (table === 'queues' ? queues : csat));
+
+    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSatisfactionBreakdown(7), { wrapper: createWrapper() });
+    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
+

+  });
+});

+/**
+ * PK-14 ‚Äî o callback de busca do chat precisa ser lido na hora em que o debounce
+ * dispara, n√£o na hora em que a query mudou.
+ *
+ * O timer de 200 ms do debounce guarda a closure do render em que `query` mudou.
+ * Se o pai troca `onSearchQueryChange` no meio (o ChatPanel troca `setSearchQuery`
+ * a cada render), o timer chamava a vers√£o ANTIGA ‚Äî e a sincroniza√ß√£o com o pai
+ * ia para o callback errado. Agora o hook guarda o callback num ref lido na
+ * hora do disparo, como j√° fazia com onHighlightChange/onNavigateToMessage.
+ */

+import { Message } from '@/types/chat';

+import '@/hooks/__tests__/helpers/alertMocks';
+import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';

+
+/**
+ * Comportamento (n√£o encanamento) de duas regras de conviv√™ncia do alerta de mensagem:
+ * 1. a permiss√£o de notifica√ß√£o do navegador NUNCA √© pedida sem gesto do usu√°rio
+ *    (era pedida na montagem do hook);
+ * 2. com o Zapp aberto em v√°rias abas, s√≥ UMA toca o som e mostra o aviso do navegador ‚Äî
+ *    as outras seguem atualizando o aviso em tela (contador/lista).
+ */
+import {
+  playNotificationSound,
+  showBrowserNotification,
+  requestNotificationPermission,
+  resetAlertKit,
+  settingsCfg,
+} from '@/hooks/__tests__/helpers/alertBehaviorTestKit';
+
+import { useRealtimeNotifications } from '@/hooks/realtime/useRealtimeNotifications';
+
+const contato = { id: 'c1', name: 'Fulano', phone: '1199' } as never;
+
+function mensagemNova(over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
+  return { id: 'm1', contact_id: 'c2', sender: 'contact', is_read: false, content: 'oi', ...over } as never;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Web Locks de mentira, com a mesma sem√¢ntica do navegador para o que este hook usa:
+ * um dono por nome de lock; quem chega depois entra na fila e s√≥ √© chamado quando o
+ * dono atual solta o lock. √â isso que faz a segunda "aba" ficar como seguidora.
+ */
+class FakeWebLocks {
+  private readonly donos = new Set<string>();
+  private readonly fila = new Map<string, Array<() => void>>();
+
+  request(name: string, callback: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> {
+    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
+      const tentar = () => {
+        if (this.donos.has(name)) {
+          const espera = this.fila.get(name) ?? [];
+          espera.push(tentar);
+          this.fila.set(name, espera);
+          return;
+        }
+        this.donos.add(name);
+        void Promise.resolve()
+          .then(callback)
+          .catch(() => undefined)
+          .finally(() => {
+            this.donos.delete(name);
+            const espera = this.fila.get(name) ?? [];
+            const proximo = espera.shift();
+            if (proximo) proximo();
+            resolve();
+          });
+      };
+      tentar();
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+function instalarLocks() {
+  Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'locks', { value: new FakeWebLocks(), configurable: true });
+}
+
+/** Deixa a fila de microtarefas do lock correr (concess√£o/repassse s√£o ass√≠ncronos). */
+async function liberarMicrotarefas() {
+  await act(async () => {
+    await Promise.resolve();
+    await Promise.resolve();
+  });
+}
+

+  afterEach(() => {

+  });

+  it('n√£o pede a permiss√£o ao chegar mensagem nova (o pedido √© s√≥ do bot√£o das configura√ß√µes)', () => {

+/**
+ * useSearchInsights
+ *
+ * HZ1-06: n√∫meros da busca global para a tela de admin "Insights de Busca".
+ * Faz UMA consulta √† RPC `get_search_insights(p_days)` (migration
+ * 20261016112552, trilha irm√£) e normaliza o jsonb para a tela.
+ *
+ * Sem PII: a RPC l√™ apenas `search_events.term_normalized` (nada de contato,
+ * telefone ou conte√∫do de conversa).
+ * Visibilidade: quem barra √© a pr√≥pria RPC ‚Äî ela nega quem n√£o √© admin/supervisor
+ * (42501). O hook n√£o acrescenta nem contorna recorte de papel.
+ */
+import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
+
+export type SearchInsightsPeriod = 7 | 30 | 90;
+
+export const SEARCH_INSIGHTS_PERIODS: readonly SearchInsightsPeriod[] = [7, 30, 90];
+export const DEFAULT_SEARCH_INSIGHTS_PERIOD: SearchInsightsPeriod = 30;
+
+/** Linha das tabelas de topo. `count` √© quantas buscas usaram o termo. */
+export interface SearchInsightTerm {
+  term: string;
+  count: number;
+}
+
+export interface SearchInsights {
+  /** Janela (em dias) que a RPC aplicou na agrega√ß√£o. */
+  days: number;
+  total: number;
+  noResults: number;
+  clicks: number;
+  /** Fra√ß√£o 0..1 ‚Äî quantas buscas geraram clique. */
+  clickRate: number;
+  topQueries: SearchInsightTerm[];
+  noResultTerms: SearchInsightTerm[];
+}
+
+export const searchInsightsQueryKey = (days: number) => ['search-insights', days] as const;
+
+function toCount(value: unknown): number {
+  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
+}
+
+function toTerms(value: unknown): SearchInsightTerm[] {
+  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
+  return value.flatMap((row) => {
+    if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return [];
+    const { term, count } = row as { term?: unknown; count?: unknown };
+    if (typeof term !== 'string' || term.length === 0) return [];
+    return [{ term, count: toCount(count) }];
+  });
+}
+
+/** Normaliza o jsonb da RPC: campo ausente ou de tipo inesperado vira 0/[] em vez de quebrar a tela. */
+export function parseSearchInsights(raw: unknown): SearchInsights {
+  const data = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
+  const clickRate = typeof data.click_rate === 'number' && Number.isFinite(data.click_rate)
+    ? data.click_rate
+    : 0;
+
+  return {
+    days: toCount(data.days),
+    total: toCount(data.total),
+    noResults: toCount(data.no_results),
+    clicks: toCount(data.clicks),
+    clickRate,
+    topQueries: toTerms(data.top_queries),
+    noResultTerms: toTerms(data.no_result_terms),
+  };
+}
+
+export class SearchInsightsError extends Error {
+  constructor(message: string) {
+    super(message);
+    this.name = 'SearchInsightsError';
+  }
+}
+
+async function fetchSearchInsights(days: number): Promise<SearchInsights> {
+  // A RPC nasce na migration irm√£ 20261016112552 (HZ1-06) e ainda n√£o est√° no
+  // types.ts gerado. O contrato fica replicado aqui at√© o artefato ser
+  // ressincronizado ‚Äî ent√£o esta ponte vira um `supabase.rpc('get_search_insights', ‚Ä¶)`.
+  const rpc = supabase.rpc as unknown as (
+    fn: 'get_search_insights',
+    args: { p_days: number },
+  ) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>;
+
+  const { data, error } = await rpc('get_search_insights', { p_days: days });
+  if (error) throw new SearchInsightsError(error.message);
+  return parseSearchInsights(data);
+}
+
+export function useSearchInsights(days: SearchInsightsPeriod = DEFAULT_SEARCH_INSIGHTS_PERIOD) {
+  return useQuery({
+    queryKey: searchInsightsQueryKey(days),
+    queryFn: () => fetchSearchInsights(days),
+    staleTime: 60_000,
+  });
+}

+/**
+ * Cart√£o t_549f87e1 (PM-02, avisos de limite das metas de fila).

+ * O hook REAL `useQueueGoalAlerts` roda sobre um mock de `rpc_queue_goal_metrics` e prova:
+ *  1. as faixas 50 ‚Üí 75 ‚Üí 100 % do limite avisam UMA vez cada, e a quarta varredura no mesmo dia
+ *     n√£o repete nada (a chave anunciada persiste em `sessionStorage`);
+ *  2. `null` (n√£o medido) n√£o avisa e `0` (dado ‚Äî fila vazia) n√£o vira aviso nem derruba a m√©trica

+ *  4. as quatro m√©tricas s√£o avaliadas (todas as faixas que o cart√£o pede);

+import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
+import { act, cleanup, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Regress√£o do cart√£o t_264db8df: o snapshot do dashboard rodava num
+// `setInterval(fetchInitialData, 5 * 60 * 1000)` que ignorava
+// `document.visibilityState` e `navigator.onLine` ‚Äî a cada 5 minutos sa√≠am 4
+// contagens exatas e uma leitura de at√© 5000 linhas mesmo com a aba oculta, e
+// os contadores n√£o se corrigiam ao voltar de uma queda. Estes testes fixam o
+// comportamento novo: aba oculta/offline N√ÉO l√™; o foco e a rede refazem o
+// snapshot imediatamente (uma vez); vis√≠vel e online continua de 5 em 5 min.
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+type RealtimePayload = {
+  new: Record<string, unknown>;
+  old?: Record<string, unknown>;
+};
+
+const handlersRealtime: Array<{
+  table: string;
+  event: string;
+  handler: (payload: RealtimePayload) => void;
+}> = [];
+
+const mockChannel = vi.fn((_topic: string) => {
+  const instance = {
+    on: vi.fn(
+      (
+        _tipo: string,
+        filtro: { event: string; table: string },
+        handler: (payload: RealtimePayload) => void
+      ) => {
+        handlersRealtime.push({ table: filtro.table, event: filtro.event, handler });
+        return instance;
+      }
+    ),
+    subscribe: vi.fn(() => instance),
+  };
+  return instance;
+});
+
+const mockRemoveChannel = vi.fn();
+
+type Chamada = { metodo: string; args: unknown[] };
+
+/** Todas as consultas montadas (`from()`), na ordem em que o hook as pediu. */
+const consultasFeitas: Array<{ table: string; chamadas: Chamada[] }> = [];
+
+/** Uma rodada completa do snapshot = 4 contagens (`head: true`) + a lista de
+ * `contact_id` das conversas ativas. */
+const CONSULTAS_POR_RODADA = 5;
+
+function resultadoQuery(table: string, chamadas: Chamada[]) {
+  const select = chamadas.find(c => c.metodo === 'select');
+  const ehContagem = (select?.args[1] as { head?: boolean } | undefined)?.head === true;
+  if (ehContagem && table === 'contacts') return { count: 2, data: null, error: null };
+  if (ehContagem && table === 'messages') {
+    if (chamadas.some(c => c.metodo === 'eq' && c.args[0] === 'is_read')) {
+      return { count: 3, data: null, error: null };
+    }
+    if (chamadas.some(c => c.metodo === 'lt')) return { count: 4, data: null, error: null };
+    return { count: 10, data: null, error: null };
+  }
+  return { count: null, data: [{ contact_id: 'contato-1' }], error: null };
+}
+
+function makeBuilder(table: string) {
+  const chamadas: Chamada[] = [];
+  consultasFeitas.push({ table, chamadas });
+  const builder: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+  for (const metodo of ['select', 'gte', 'lt', 'eq', 'not', 'limit', 'order']) {
+    builder[metodo] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
+      chamadas.push({ metodo, args });
+      return builder;
+    };
+  }
+  builder.then = (resolve: (valor: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (erro: unknown) => unknown) =>
+    Promise.resolve().then(() => resultadoQuery(table, chamadas)).then(resolve, reject);
+  return builder;
+}
+
+vi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => ({
+  supabase: {
+    from: (table: string) => makeBuilder(table),
+    channel: (topic: string) => mockChannel(topic),
+    removeChannel: (...args: unknown[]) => mockRemoveChannel(...args),
+  },
+}));
+
+vi.mock('@/lib/logger', () => ({
+  getLogger: () => ({ error: vi.fn(), debug: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(), warn: vi.fn() }),
+}));

+import { useRealtimeDashboard } from '@/hooks/analytics/useRealtimeDashboard';
+
+const CINCO_MIN = 5 * 60 * 1000;
+
+const visible = (valor: boolean) =>
+  Object.defineProperty(document, 'visibilityState', {
+    configurable: true,
+    value: valor ? 'visible' : 'hidden',
+  });
+const online = (valor: boolean) =>
+  Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'onLine', { configurable: true, value: valor });
+
+async function avancar(ms = 0) {
+  await act(async () => {
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(ms);
+  });
+}
+
+describe('useRealtimeDashboard ‚Äî snapshot de 5 min s√≥ com aba vis√≠vel e online', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    vi.clearAllMocks();
+    handlersRealtime.length = 0;
+    consultasFeitas.length = 0;
+    visible(true);
+    online(true);
+  });

+  afterEach(() => {
+    cleanup();
+    vi.useRealTimers();
+    visible(true);
+    online(true);
+  });
+
+  it('aba oculta: nenhuma consulta, nem na montagem nem ao longo de 10 min', async () => {
+    visible(false);
+    renderHook(() => useRealtimeDashboard({ agentId: 'agente-1' }));
+    await avancar(10 * 60 * 1000);
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('voltar ao foco (visibilitychange) refaz o snapshot uma √∫nica vez', async () => {

+  it('voltar √† rede (online) refaz o snapshot uma √∫nica vez', async () => {
+    online(false);
+    const { result } = renderHook(() => useRealtimeDashboard({ agentId: 'agente-1' }));
+    await avancar(10 * 60 * 1000);
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(0);
+
+    online(true);
+    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('online'));
+    await avancar();
+
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(CONSULTAS_POR_RODADA);
+    expect(result.current.messagesThisHour).toBe(10);
+  });
+
+  it('aba vis√≠vel e online: o snapshot continua de 5 em 5 min', async () => {
+    const { result } = renderHook(() => useRealtimeDashboard({ agentId: 'agente-1' }));
+    await avancar();
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(CONSULTAS_POR_RODADA);
+    expect(result.current.messagesThisHour).toBe(10);
+
+    await avancar(CINCO_MIN);
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(2 * CONSULTAS_POR_RODADA);
+    expect(result.current.messagesThisHour).toBe(10);
+  });
+
+  it('ficar oculta entre duas rodadas n√£o gera leitura extra e o foco retoma', async () => {
+    renderHook(() => useRealtimeDashboard({ agentId: 'agente-1' }));
+    await avancar();
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(CONSULTAS_POR_RODADA);
+
+    visible(false);
+    await avancar(CINCO_MIN);
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(CONSULTAS_POR_RODADA);
+
+    visible(true);
+    document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange'));
+    await avancar();
+    expect(consultasFeitas).toHaveLength(2 * CONSULTAS_POR_RODADA);
