+import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.87.1";
+import { z } from "https://esm.sh/zod@3.23.8";
+import { handleCors, errorResponse, internalErrorResponse, jsonResponse, requireEnv, Logger, checkRateLimit, getClientIP } from "../_shared/validation.ts";
+
+/**
+ * invite-user ‚Äî convite por e-mail com papel definido (paridade V3 -> V2).
+ *
+ * Regras de autoriza√ß√£o (fechadas, valem no caminho padr√£o):
+ *   - Sem JWT v√°lido: 401.
+ *   - Quem chama precisa ser admin OU supervisor (lido de user_roles com o
+ *     cliente de escopo do usu√°rio, nunca com a service role).
+ *   - Supervisor s√≥ convida papel 'agent'; qualquer outro papel exige admin.
+ *   - O papel do convidado √© garantido pelo caminho de servi√ßo (update/insert
+ *     em user_roles com service_role): handle_new_user_role s√≥ cria 'agent'
+ *     para dominio confiavel, entao o convite NAO depende dele.
+ *   - Se a atribuicao de papel falhar, a conta recem-convidada √© desfeita.
+ *   - O e-mail vai pelo proprio GoTrue (inviteUserByEmail); a resposta NAO
+ *     carrega link de convite.
+ */
+
+export interface InviteUserCallerClient {
+  auth: {
+    getUser: () => PromiseLike<{ data: { user: { id: string } | null }; error: unknown }>;
+  };
+  // deno-lint-ignore no-explicit-any
+  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
+  from: (table: string) => any;
+}
+
+export interface InviteUserAdminClient {
+  auth: {
+    admin: {
+      inviteUserByEmail: (
+        email: string,
+        options?: Record<string, unknown>,
+      ) => PromiseLike<{
+        data: { user: { id: string } | null } | null;
+        error: { message: string } | null;
+      }>;
+      deleteUser: (
+        id: string,
+      ) => PromiseLike<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>;
+    };
+  };
+  // deno-lint-ignore no-explicit-any
+  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
+  from: (table: string) => any;
+}
+
+export interface InviteUserDeps {
+  env?: (name: string) => string;
+  checkRateLimit?: (key: string, maxRequests: number, windowMs: number) => { allowed: boolean };
+  caller?: InviteUserCallerClient;
+  admin?: InviteUserAdminClient;
+}
+
+const INVITABLE_ROLES = ["admin", "supervisor", "agent", "special_agent"] as const;
+
+const bodySchema = z.object({
+  email: z.string().email("Email inv√°lido").max(255),
+  role: z.enum(INVITABLE_ROLES).optional().default("agent"),
+}).strict();
+
+export async function handleInviteUserRequest(req: Request, deps: InviteUserDeps = {}): Promise<Response> {
+  const cors = handleCors(req);
+  if (cors) return cors;
+
+  const log = new Logger("invite-user");
+  const env = deps.env ?? requireEnv;
+  const rateLimit = deps.checkRateLimit ?? checkRateLimit;
+
+  const ip = getClientIP(req);
+  const rl = rateLimit(`invite-user:${ip}`, 10, 60_000);
+  if (!rl.allowed) return errorResponse("Rate limit exceeded", 429, req);
+
+  try {
+    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") || req.headers.get("authorization");
+    if (!authHeader) {
+      log.warn("Missing auth header");
+      return errorResponse("N√£o autorizado", 401, req);
+    }
+
+    const callerClient: InviteUserCallerClient = deps.caller ?? createClient(
+      env("SUPABASE_URL"),
+      env("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY"),
+      { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } },
+    );
+
+    const { data: { user: caller } } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
+    if (!caller) {
+      log.warn("Invalid auth token");
+      return errorResponse("N√£o autorizado", 401, req);
+    }
+
+    // Papel do chamador lido no escopo do proprio usuario (RLS de user_roles).
+    // Consulta com erro FECHA: nao abrimos por falha.
+    const { data: roleRows, error: roleError } = await callerClient
+      .from("user_roles")
+      .select("role")
+      .eq("user_id", caller.id);
+    if (roleError) {
+      log.error("Falha ao confirmar papel do chamador", { error: roleError.message ?? String(roleError) });
+      return errorResponse("N√£o foi poss√≠vel confirmar suas permiss√µes", 403, req);
+    }
+    const roles: string[] = (roleRows ?? []).map((r: { role: string }) => r.role);
+    const isAdmin = roles.includes("admin");
+    const isSupervisor = roles.includes("supervisor");
+    if (!isAdmin && !isSupervisor) {
+      log.warn("N√£o autorizado a convidar", { callerId: caller.id });
+      return errorResponse("Apenas administradores e supervisores podem convidar usu√°rios", 403, req);
+    }
+
+    const parsed = bodySchema.safeParse(await req.json());
+    if (!parsed.success) {
+      const errors = parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors;
+      return errorResponse(Object.values(errors).flat().join("; "), 400, req);
+    }
+    const { email, role } = parsed.data;
+
+    // Supervisor so convida 'agent'; qualquer outro papel exige admin.
+    if (!isAdmin && role !== "agent") {
+      log.warn("Supervisor tentou convidar papel privilegiado", { callerId: caller.id, role });
+      return errorResponse("Supervisor s√≥ pode convidar usu√°rios com o papel agent", 403, req);
+    }
+
+    const adminClient: InviteUserAdminClient = deps.admin ?? createClient(
+      env("SUPABASE_URL"),
+      env("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"),
+    );
+
+    const { data: inviteData, error: inviteError } = await adminClient.auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(
+      email,
+      { data: { role } },
+    );
+    if (inviteError) {
+      log.error("Falha ao convidar", { error: inviteError.message });
+      return errorResponse(inviteError.message, 400, req);
+    }
+
+    const invitedId = inviteData?.user?.id;
+    if (!invitedId) {
+      log.error("Convite sem usu√°rio retornado");
+      return internalErrorResponse(new Error("invite_failed"), req);
+    }
+
+    // Papel garantido pelo caminho de servi√ßo: atualiza a linha existente
+    // (auto-provisionada por handle_new_user_role) ou insere quando ela nao
+    // existe (dominio diferente do da empresa). Falha aqui desfaz a conta.
+    try {
+      const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await adminClient
+        .from("user_roles")
+        .update({ role })
+        .eq("user_id", invitedId)
+        .select("id");
+      if (updateError) throw updateError;
+      if (!updated || updated.length === 0) {
+        const { error: insertError } = await adminClient
+          .from("user_roles")
+          .insert({ user_id: invitedId, role });
+        if (insertError) throw insertError;
+      }
+    } catch (assignError) {
+      const motivo = assignError && typeof assignError === "object" && "message" in assignError
+        ? String((assignError as { message: unknown }).message)
+        : String(assignError);
+      log.error("Falha ao atribuir papel; desfazendo convite", { error: motivo });
+      const { error: deleteError } = await adminClient.auth.admin.deleteUser(invitedId);
+      if (deleteError) log.error("Falha ao desfazer convite", { error: deleteError.message });
+      return errorResponse("N√£o foi poss√≠vel concluir o convite", 500, req);
+    }
+
+    // Auditoria: registra quem convidou (service_role nao carrega auth.uid()).
+    const { error: auditError } = await adminClient.from("audit_logs").insert({
+      user_id: caller.id,
+      action: "user_invited",
+      entity_type: "user_invitation",
+      entity_id: invitedId,
+      details: { invited_by: caller.id, email, role },
+    });
+    if (auditError) {
+      log.error("Falha ao registrar auditoria do convite", { error: auditError.message });
+    }
+
+    log.done(200, { userId: invitedId, role });
+    // Resposta NAO carrega link de convite (o e-mail vai pelo GoTrue).
+    return jsonResponse({ success: true, user_id: invitedId, email, role }, 200, req);
+  } catch (err: unknown) {
+    log.error("Unhandled error", { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
+    return internalErrorResponse(err, req);
+  }
+}

+/** Linha de auditoria de uma revoga√ß√£o bem-sucedida. Campos decididos aqui, sem rede,
+ *  para poderem ser provados por teste. NUNCA carrega token/JWT/sess√£o em claro ‚Äî

+export interface RevocationAuditRow {
+  user_id: string;
+  action: "auth_sessions_revoke";
+  entity_type: "auth_session";
+  entity_id: string | null;
+  details: { scope: Scope; target_user_id: string; revoked: number };
+  ip_address: string;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Monta a linha de auditoria a partir do plano j√° autorizado. O ator (`user_id`) √©
+ * SEMPRE o chamador autenticado (`callerId`), nunca o alvo ‚Äî quem revogou a sess√£o de
+ * um terceiro fica registrado como quem agiu, e o terceiro s√≥ em `details.target_user_id`.
+ * `entity_id` √© a sess√£o alvo quando conhecida (escopo local); fora disso, null.
+ */
+export function buildRevocationAudit(
+  plan: Extract<RevocationPlan, { ok: true }>,
+  callerId: string,
+  revoked: number,
+  ip: string,
+): RevocationAuditRow {
+  const targetUserId = plan.target ?? plan.actor ?? callerId;
+  const entityId = plan.targetSession ?? null;
+  return {
+    user_id: callerId,
+    action: "auth_sessions_revoke",
+    entity_type: "auth_session",
+    entity_id: entityId,
+    details: { scope: plan.scope, target_user_id: targetUserId, revoked },
+    ip_address: ip,
+  };
+}
+
+/** Cliente m√≠nimo necess√°rio para gravar a auditoria (a service role real satisfaz). */
+export interface AuditSink {
+  from(table: string): {
+    insert(row: unknown): PromiseLike<{ error: { message: string } | null }>;
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Grava a auditoria pela service role (RLS bloqueia INSERT direto do usu√°rio). Chamada
+ * s√≥ AP√ìS a revoga√ß√£o ter efeito. Devolve o resultado em vez de lan√ßar: uma falha de
+ * auditoria n√£o deve derrubar a resposta j√° conquistada, mas tamb√©m n√£o √© engolida ‚Äî
+ * o chamador registra no log e informa `audited: false`.
+ */
+export async function recordRevocationAudit(
+  sink: AuditSink,
+  row: RevocationAuditRow,
+): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error: string | null }> {
+  const { error } = await sink.from("audit_logs").insert(row);
+  return error ? { ok: false, error: error.message } : { ok: true, error: null };
+}
+
+/** Pap√©is can√¥nicos do app (public.app_role). Preced√™ncia: admin > supervisor > special_agent > agent. */
+export type AppRole = "admin" | "supervisor" | "special_agent" | "agent";
+
+const KNOWN_ROLES: readonly AppRole[] = ["admin", "supervisor", "special_agent", "agent"];
+
+/** Normaliza o valor de `effective_role`/`user_roles.role`. Desconhecido -> null (fail-closed). */
+export function normalizeRole(value: unknown): AppRole | null {
+  if (typeof value !== "string") return null;
+  return (KNOWN_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(value) ? (value as AppRole) : null;
+}
+
+/** Pap√©is que um supervisor PODE atingir ao revogar a sess√£o de um terceiro. */
+export const SUPERVISOR_MAY_TARGET: readonly AppRole[] = ["agent", "special_agent"];
+
+export interface ThirdPartyRevocationInput {
+  /** alvo √© o pr√≥prio chamador? ent√£o qualquer um revoga a pr√≥pria sess√£o. */
+  isSelf: boolean;
+  /** papel efetivo do chamador (null/desconhecido -> negado). */
+  callerRole: AppRole | null;
+  /** papel efetivo do alvo (null/desconhecido -> negado para supervisor). */
+  targetRole: AppRole | null;
+}
+
+export interface ThirdPartyDecision {
+  allowed: boolean;
+  status: number;
+  message: string;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Matriz de pap√©is da revoga√ß√£o de sess√µes de TERCEIRO (a pr√≥pria sess√£o nunca √© barrada):
+ * - admin        -> revoga a sess√£o de administrador, supervisor ou agente.
+ * - supervisor   -> S√ì revoga a de agentes (`agent`/`special_agent`); NUNCA a de admin
+ *                   nem a de outro supervisor.
+ * - agent/outros -> 403 (s√≥ a pr√≥pria sess√£o).
+ * Papel desconhecido/ausente nega (fail-closed), inclusive o alvo de um supervisor.
+ */
+export function decideThirdPartyRevocation(input: ThirdPartyRevocationInput): ThirdPartyDecision {
+  const ALLOW = { allowed: true, status: 200, message: "ok" } as const;
+  const DENY = { allowed: false, status: 403, message: "Forbidden" } as const;
+
+  if (input.isSelf) return ALLOW;
+  if (input.callerRole === "admin") return ALLOW;
+  if (
+    input.callerRole === "supervisor" &&
+    input.targetRole !== null &&
+    (SUPERVISOR_MAY_TARGET as readonly string[]).includes(input.targetRole)
+  ) {
+    return ALLOW;
+  }
+  return DENY;
+}
+
+/** Cliente m√≠nimo para resolver o papel efetivo (a service role real satisfaz). */
+export interface RoleResolver {
+  rpc(fn: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): PromiseLike<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>;
+}
+
+/** Resolve o papel efetivo de um usu√°rio pela fun√ß√£o SQL `effective_role` (service role).
+ *  Erro/timeout -> null (fail-closed: sem papel confirmado, nega a revoga√ß√£o de terceiro). */
+export async function resolveEffectiveRole(client: RoleResolver, userId: string): Promise<AppRole | null> {
+  const { data, error } = await client.rpc("effective_role", { _user_id: userId });
+  if (error) return null;
+  return normalizeRole(data);
+}

+/** Define/limpa TRUSTED_EMAIL_DOMAINS durante o teste e restaura o valor anterior. */
+async function withTrustedDomainsEnv<T>(value: string | null, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
+  const previous = Deno.env.get("TRUSTED_EMAIL_DOMAINS");
+  if (value === null) Deno.env.delete("TRUSTED_EMAIL_DOMAINS");
+  else Deno.env.set("TRUSTED_EMAIL_DOMAINS", value);
+  try {
+    return await fn();
+  } finally {
+    if (previous === undefined) Deno.env.delete("TRUSTED_EMAIL_DOMAINS");
+    else Deno.env.set("TRUSTED_EMAIL_DOMAINS", previous);
+  }
+}

+// ‚îÄ‚îÄ [refazer 1+2] GET com token opaco (?r=<token>) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+// O token √© montado literalmente aqui (o teste N√ÉO importa fun√ß√£o do
+// handler): UUID cifrado com m√°scara SHA-256(secret + "|talkx-track-enc-v1")
+// + MAC HMAC-SHA256(secret, "talkx-track-v1" + cifra) truncada em 8 bytes,
+// 24 bytes em base64url (32 chars). √â uma implementa√ß√£o INDEPENDENTE do
+// mesmo contrato ‚Äî se o talkx-send assinar outro payload, o teste de token

+const TRACKING_SECRET = "test-convert-secret";
+const TOKEN_UUID_A = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
+const TOKEN_UUID_B = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";

+function uuidBytesForTest(uuid: string): Uint8Array {
+  const hex = uuid.replace(/-/g, "");
+  const out = new Uint8Array(16);
+  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) out[i] = parseInt(hex.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
+  return out;
+}
+
+function b64urlForTest(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
+  const bin = Array.from(bytes).map((b) => String.fromCharCode(b)).join("");
+  return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
+}
+
+function b64urlToBytesForTest(token: string): Uint8Array {
+  const padded = token.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/") + "==".slice(0, (4 - (token.length % 4)) % 4);
+  const bin = atob(padded);
+  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
+  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
+  return out;
+}

+async function trackingTokenForTest(secret: string, recipientId: string): Promise<string> {
+  const uuid = uuidBytesForTest(recipientId);
+  const maskFull = new Uint8Array(
+    await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(secret + "|talkx-track-enc-v1")),
+  );
+  const cipher = new Uint8Array(16);
+  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) cipher[i] = uuid[i] ^ maskFull[i];
+  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
+    "raw",
+    new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
+    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" },
+    false,
+    ["sign"],
+  );
+  const domain = new TextEncoder().encode("talkx-track-v1");
+  const payload = new Uint8Array(domain.length + 16);
+  payload.set(domain, 0);
+  payload.set(cipher, domain.length);
+  const tag = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, payload)).slice(0, 8);
+  const token = new Uint8Array(24);
+  token.set(cipher, 0);
+  token.set(tag, 16);
+  return b64urlForTest(token);
+}

+function makeTokenFake(opts: {
+  link?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
+  recipientIds?: string[];
+  recipients?: Record<string, string>;
+  clickResult?: unknown;
+  seen?: Array<{ fn: string; args: Record<string, unknown> }>;
+}) {
+  const seen = opts.seen ?? [];
+  const queries: Array<{ table: string; col: string; val: unknown }> = [];
+  const byId = new Map<string, string>();
+  for (const id of opts.recipientIds ?? []) byId.set(id, "camp-1");
+  for (const [id, camp] of Object.entries(opts.recipients ?? {})) byId.set(id, camp);
+  const supabase = {
+    rpc: async (fn: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => {
+      seen.push({ fn, args });
+      if (fn === "record_talkx_link_click") return { data: opts.clickResult, error: null };
+      return { data: null, error: { message: `rpc inesperada: ${fn}` } };
+    },
+    from: (table: string) => ({
+      select: (_cols: string) => ({
+        eq: (col: string, val: unknown) => ({
+          maybeSingle: async () => {
+            queries.push({ table, col, val });
+            if (table === "talkx_links") return { data: opts.link ?? null, error: null };
+            if (table === "talkx_recipients" && col === "id") {
+              const id = String(val);
+              const camp = byId.get(id);
+              if (!camp) return { data: null, error: null };
+              return { data: { id, campaign_id: camp }, error: null };
+            }
+            return { data: null, error: { message: `maybeSingle inesperado: ${table}.${col}` } };
+          },
+          then: (_onF: (v: unknown) => void, _onR?: (e: unknown) => void) => {
+            throw new Error(
+              `varredura O(N) proibida: ${table}.eq(${col}) com lista ‚Äî use point lookup por id`,
+            );
+          },
+        }),
+      }),
+    }),
+  };
+  return { supabase: supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient, seen, queries };
+}

+/**
+ * Resolve o token opaco de rastreamento (?r=<token>) para o recipient_id
+ * em O(1): decodifica local (MAC em tempo constante, 1 import de chave),
+ * depois 2 point lookups indexados (link por slug, recipient por id com
+ * checagem de campanha). Sem varredura, sem paginacao: o custo por clique
+ * nao depende do tamanho da campanha. Token forjado, de outra campanha ou
+ * sem TALKX_CONVERT_SECRET resulta em null (clique anonimo, nunca
+ * atribuicao indevida). `r=` aleatorio falha no decode antes de qualquer
+ * SELECT (sem amplificacao de custo por clique invalido).
+ */
+async function resolveTalkxLinkToken(params: {
+  slug: string;
+  token: string;
+  supabase: SupabaseClient;
+  env: TalkxLinkDeps["env"];
+}): Promise<string | null> {
+  const secret = params.env.get("TALKX_CONVERT_SECRET");
+  if (!secret) return null;
+  const recipientId = await decodeTalkxRecipientToken(params.token, secret);
+  if (!recipientId) return null;
+  const { data: link } = await params.supabase
+    .from("talkx_links")
+    .select("id,campaign_id")
+    .eq("slug", params.slug)
+    .maybeSingle();
+  const campaignId = (link as { campaign_id?: unknown } | null)?.campaign_id;
+  if (typeof campaignId !== "string" || campaignId.length === 0) return null;
+  const { data: recipient } = await params.supabase
+    .from("talkx_recipients")
+    .select("id,campaign_id")
+    .eq("id", recipientId)
+    .maybeSingle();
+  const row = recipient as { id?: unknown; campaign_id?: unknown } | null;
+  if (!row || row.id !== recipientId || row.campaign_id !== campaignId) return null;
+  return recipientId;
+}

+// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- recorr√™ncia
+
+interface RecurrenceCall { rpc: string; args: Record<string, unknown> }
+
+/**
+ * Client falso s√≥ para o passo de recorr√™ncia: registra os filtros aplicados na
+ * consulta de campanhas 'completed' e as chamadas de RPC. As consultas de
+ * agendadas/pausadas voltam vazias.
+ */
+function makeRecurrenceClient(opts: {
+  completed?: CampaignRow[];
+  outcomes?: Record<string, { data?: unknown; error?: { message: string } | null }>;
+}): { client: unknown; filters: string[]; calls: RecurrenceCall[] } {
+  const filters: string[] = [];
+  const calls: RecurrenceCall[] = [];
+  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
+  function from(_table: string): any {
+    let status: string | null = null;
+    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
+    const b: Record<string, any> = {};
+    b.select = () => b;
+    b.lte = () => b;
+    b.in = () => b;
+    b.limit = () => b;
+    b.eq = (col: string, val: unknown) => { if (col === "status") status = String(val); return b; };
+    b.not = (col: string, op: string, val: unknown) => { filters.push(`not:${col}:${op}:${val}`); return b; };
+    b.is = (col: string, val: unknown) => { filters.push(`is:${col}:${val}`); return b; };
+    const rows = () => ({ data: status === "completed" ? (opts.completed ?? []) : [], error: null });
+    b.then = (res: (v: unknown) => unknown, rej?: (e: unknown) => unknown) => Promise.resolve(rows()).then(res, rej);
+    return b;
+  }
+  const rpc = (name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => {
+    calls.push({ rpc: name, args });
+    const configured = opts.outcomes?.[String(args.p_campaign_id)];
+    return Promise.resolve({ data: configured?.data ?? null, error: configured?.error ?? null });
+  };
+  return { client: { rpc, from }, filters, calls };
+}

+/**
+ * Gera o token opaco do recipient_id (?r=<token>): UUID cifrado de forma
+ * deterministica com chave derivada de TALKX_CONVERT_SECRET + MAC truncada
+ * (ver _shared/talkx-tracking-token.ts - contrato UNICO entre send e link).
+ * Sem segredo configurado recusa-se a gerar (undefined): o chamador NAO
+ * pode cair no id cru. 32 chars base64url (16 cipher + 8 tag).
+ */
+export async function hmacTokenForRecipient(
+  recipientId: string,
+  secret?: string,
+): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  const key = secret ?? Deno.env.get("TALKX_CONVERT_SECRET");
+  return encodeTalkxRecipientToken(recipientId, key);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Helpers de link rastre√°vel no n√≠vel usado pelo envio (trackingUrlFor /
+ * linksByLabelFor): monta as URLs de TODOS os links da campanha para um
+ * destinat√°rio. Pura (recebe as linhas j√° lidas) para ser test√°vel sem
+ * banco: sem segredo, trackingUrlFor devolve undefined e linksByLabelFor
+ * devolve {} ‚Äî NUNCA o recipient_id cru.
+ */
+export function buildTalkxTrackingLinkHelpers(params: {
+  links: Array<{ slug?: unknown; label?: unknown }>;
+  secret: string | undefined;
+  configuredBase: string;
+  supabaseUrl: string;
+}): {
+  trackingUrlFor: (recipientId: string) => Promise<string | undefined>;
+  linksByLabelFor: (recipientId: string) => Promise<Record<string, string>>;
+} {
+  const urlFor = (slug: string, recipientId: string): Promise<string | undefined> =>
+    buildTalkxTrackingUrl({
+      slug,
+      recipientId,
+      secret: params.secret,
+      configuredBase: params.configuredBase,
+      supabaseUrl: params.supabaseUrl,
+    });
+  const oldestSlug = typeof params.links[0]?.slug === "string" ? params.links[0].slug : undefined;
+  const slugByLabel = new Map<string, string>();
+  for (const row of params.links) {
+    if (typeof row.slug === "string" && typeof row.label === "string" && row.label.trim()) {
+      slugByLabel.set(row.label.trim().toLowerCase(), row.slug);
+    }
+  }
+  // Declarada SEM `async` de prop√≥sito: `urlFor` j√° devolve a Promise, ent√£o o `async`/`await`
+  // aqui s√≥ embrulharia de novo ‚Äî e o contrato scripts/db-audit/talkx-e90-links-contract.test.mjs
+  // trava esta assinatura (`const trackingUrlFor = (recipientId: string)`) para garantir que o
+  // call site real do envio receba a URL por destinat√°rio. Mesmo comportamento, uma camada menos.
+  const trackingUrlFor = (recipientId: string): Promise<string | undefined> =>
+    oldestSlug ? urlFor(oldestSlug, recipientId) : Promise.resolve(undefined);
+  const linksByLabelFor = async (recipientId: string): Promise<Record<string, string>> => {
+    const out: Record<string, string> = {};
+    for (const [label, slug] of Array.from(slugByLabel.entries())) {
+      const url = await urlFor(slug, recipientId);
+      if (url) out[label] = url;
+    }
+    return out;
+  };
+  return { trackingUrlFor, linksByLabelFor };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Monta a URL rastre√°vel de um slug para um destinat√°rio. O par√¢metro `r`
+ * carrega o TOKEN opaco ‚Äî nunca o recipient_id cru. Sem segredo devolve
+ * undefined: o chamador trata como "link indispon√≠vel" (placeholder
+ * "[link]"/skipped, o caminho j√° existente de link ausente).
+ */
+export async function buildTalkxTrackingUrl(params: {
+  slug: string;
+  recipientId: string;
+  secret: string | undefined;
+  configuredBase: string;
+  supabaseUrl: string;
+}): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  const token = await hmacTokenForRecipient(params.recipientId, params.secret);
+  if (!token) return undefined;
+  const rParam = encodeURIComponent(token);
+  return params.configuredBase.length > 0
+    ? `${params.configuredBase}/l/${encodeURIComponent(params.slug)}?r=${rParam}`
+    : `${params.supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/talkx-link?s=${encodeURIComponent(params.slug)}&r=${rParam}`;
+}

+function withEnv(env: Record<string, string>, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
+  const anterior: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
+  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(env)) {
+    anterior[k] = Deno.env.get(k);
+    Deno.env.set(k, v);
+  }
+  return fn().finally(() => {
+    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(anterior)) {

+/** A linha que o handler escreveu no ledger (insert no `ai_usage_logs`). */
+function linhaDoLedger(calls: Call[]): Record<string, unknown> | null {
+  const escrita = callsTo(calls, "/rest/v1/ai_usage_logs").at(-1);
+  if (!escrita) return null;
+  const corpo = (escrita.init as { body?: unknown }).body;
+  if (typeof corpo !== "string") return null;
+  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(corpo);
+  if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return (parsed[0] ?? null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
+  return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
+}

+function makeCallerClient(isAdmin: boolean): any {
+  return {
+    auth: { getUser: () => Promise.resolve({ data: { user: { id: "admin-1" } }, error: null }) },
+    rpc: (fn: string) => fn === "is_admin_or_supervisor"
+      ? Promise.resolve({ data: isAdmin, error: null })
+      : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null }),
+  };
+}

+interface MessageQuery {
+  filters: Record<string, unknown>;
+  countMode: boolean;
+}
+
+function makeServiceClient(opts: {
+  token?: string | null;
+  connections?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
+  counts?: Record<string, { contact: number; agent: number }>;
+  onMessagesQuery?: (q: MessageQuery) => void;
+}): any {
+  const connections = opts.connections ?? [];
+  const counts = opts.counts ?? {};
+  return {
+    from(table: string) {
+      if (table === "whatsapp_connections") {
+        const conn: any = {
+          select: () => conn,
+          eq: () => conn,
+          neq: () => conn,
+          order: () => conn,
+          limit: () => conn,
+          maybeSingle: () => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null }),
+          then: (res: any, rej: any) => Promise.resolve({ data: connections, error: null }).then(res, rej),
+        };
+        return conn;
+      }
+      // messages
+      const state: MessageQuery = { filters: {}, countMode: false };
+      const b: any = {
+        select: (_c: string, o?: { count?: string; head?: boolean }) => { state.countMode = o?.count === "exact"; return b; },
+        eq: (col: string, val: unknown) => { state.filters[col] = val; return b; },
+        neq: () => b,
+        gte: () => b,
+        order: () => b,
+        limit: () => b,
+        maybeSingle: () => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null }),
+        then: (res: any, rej: any) => {
+          opts.onMessagesQuery?.({ filters: state.filters, countMode: state.countMode });
+          const connId = state.filters["whatsapp_connection_id"] as string | undefined;
+          const sender = state.filters["sender"] as string | undefined;
+          const c = countFor(connId ? counts[connId] : undefined, sender);
+          return Promise.resolve({ count: c, data: null, error: null }).then(res, rej);
+        },
+      };
+      return b;
+    },
+    rpc: (fn: string) => fn === "get_instance_token"
+      ? Promise.resolve({ data: opts.token ?? null, error: null })
+      : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null }),
+  };
+}
+
+function countFor(c: { contact: number; agent: number } | undefined, sender?: string): number {
+  if (!c) return 0;
+  if (sender === "contact") return c.contact;
+  if (sender === "agent") return c.agent;
+  return c.contact + c.agent;
+}

+/** Servidor local que faz o papel do evolution-webhook real e grava o que recebeu. */
+function startFakeWebhook() {

+  const whenReady = new Promise<{ url: string }>((resolve) => { ready = resolve; });
+  const server = Deno.serve(
+    { port: 0, onListen: ({ hostname, port }) => ready({ url: `http://${hostname}:${port}` }) },

+      const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
+      calls.push({ path: new URL(req.url).pathname, body });
+      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
+    },
+  );
+  return { calls, whenReady, stop: () => server.shutdown() };
+}

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_rich_outbound_message(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_client_message_id uuid,
+  p_display_content text,
+  p_message_type text,
+  p_delivery_payload jsonb,
+  p_reply_to_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_whatsapp_connection_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+) RETURNS public.messages
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_message public.messages%ROWTYPE;
+  v_payload jsonb := p_delivery_payload;
+  v_option_count integer;
+  v_selectable_count integer;
+  v_button_count integer;
+  v_section_count integer;
+  v_bad_section_count integer;
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_connection_id uuid;
+  v_assigned_connection_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_contact_id IS NULL OR p_client_message_id IS NULL
+     OR p_display_content IS NULL OR length(p_display_content) > 65536
+     OR p_message_type IS NULL OR p_message_type NOT IN ('poll', 'contact', 'buttons', 'list')
+     OR v_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(v_payload) <> 'object'
+     OR pg_column_size(v_payload) > 16384 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_rich_outbound_message' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_message_type = 'poll' THEN
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'name') <> 'string'
+       OR length(v_payload->>'name') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
+       OR jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'values') <> 'array' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_poll_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_option_count FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_payload->'values');
+    IF v_option_count NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 12
+       OR EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_payload->'values') AS option_value
+         WHERE length(btrim(option_value)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
+       ) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_poll_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'selectableCount') <> 'number'
+       OR v_payload->>'selectableCount' !~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_poll_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    BEGIN
+      v_selectable_count := (v_payload->>'selectableCount')::integer;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_poll_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END;
+    IF v_selectable_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND v_option_count THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_poll_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF p_message_type = 'contact' THEN
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'fullName') <> 'string'
+       OR length(v_payload->>'fullName') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 512
+       OR jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'phoneNumber') <> 'string'
+       OR regexp_replace(v_payload->>'phoneNumber', '\D', '', 'g') !~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
+       OR (v_payload ? 'organization' AND (
+         jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'organization') <> 'string'
+         OR length(v_payload->>'organization') > 512
+       ))
+       OR (v_payload ? 'email' AND (
+         jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'email') <> 'string'
+         OR length(v_payload->>'email') > 320
+       )) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_contact_card_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF p_message_type = 'buttons' THEN
+    -- IS DISTINCT FROM: chave obrigat√≥ria ausente (ou null) produziria NULL no
+    -- `->` e passaria num `<> 'string'` ‚Äî aqui ela √© inv√°lida de verdade.
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'body') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+       OR length(btrim(v_payload->>'body')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
+       OR (v_payload ? 'title' AND (
+         jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'title') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+         OR length(v_payload->>'title') > 60
+       ))
+       OR (v_payload ? 'footer' AND (
+         jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'footer') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+         OR length(v_payload->>'footer') > 60
+       ))
+       OR jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'buttons') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_buttons_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_button_count FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_payload->'buttons');
+    IF v_button_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3
+       OR EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_payload->'buttons') AS button
+         WHERE jsonb_typeof(button) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
+           OR jsonb_typeof(button->'type') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+           OR button->>'type' NOT IN ('reply', 'url', 'call')
+           OR jsonb_typeof(button->'displayText') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+           OR length(btrim(button->>'displayText')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20
+           OR (button ? 'id' AND (
+             jsonb_typeof(button->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+             OR length(button->>'id') > 256
+           ))
+           OR (button->>'type' = 'reply' AND (
+             jsonb_typeof(button->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+             OR length(button->>'id') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
+           ))
+           OR (button->>'type' = 'url' AND (
+             jsonb_typeof(button->'url') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+             OR length(button->>'url') > 2048
+             OR button->>'url' !~ '^https?://'
+           ))
+           OR (button->>'type' = 'call' AND (
+             jsonb_typeof(button->'phoneNumber') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+             OR regexp_replace(button->>'phoneNumber', '\D', '', 'g') !~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
+           ))
+       ) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_buttons_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  ELSE
+    -- p_message_type = 'list'
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'body') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+       OR length(btrim(v_payload->>'body')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
+       OR (v_payload ? 'title' AND (
+         jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'title') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+         OR length(v_payload->>'title') > 60
+       ))
+       OR (v_payload ? 'footer' AND (
+         jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'footer') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+         OR length(v_payload->>'footer') > 60
+       ))
+       OR jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'buttonText') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+       OR length(btrim(v_payload->>'buttonText')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20
+       OR jsonb_typeof(v_payload->'sections') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_list_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_section_count FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_payload->'sections');
+    -- CASE avalia os WHEN em ordem: jsonb_array_elements s√≥ roda depois de
+    -- confirmar que rows √© array (evita "cannot extract elements" mascarando
+    -- o erro can√¥nico).
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_bad_section_count
+    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_payload->'sections') AS section
+    WHERE CASE
+      WHEN jsonb_typeof(section) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN true
+      WHEN jsonb_typeof(section->'title') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+        OR length(btrim(section->>'title')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 24 THEN true
+      WHEN jsonb_typeof(section->'rows') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN true
+      WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(section->'rows')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN true
+      WHEN EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM jsonb_array_elements(section->'rows') AS list_row
+        WHERE jsonb_typeof(list_row) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
+          OR jsonb_typeof(list_row->'title') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+          OR length(btrim(list_row->>'title')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 24
+          OR (list_row ? 'description' AND (
+            jsonb_typeof(list_row->'description') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+            OR length(list_row->>'description') > 72
+          ))
+          OR jsonb_typeof(list_row->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+          OR length(list_row->>'id') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
+      ) THEN true
+      ELSE false
+    END;
+    IF v_section_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10 OR v_bad_section_count > 0 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_list_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Authorize before probing an existing idempotency key. The replay path is
+  -- otherwise an oracle for a guessed contact/client UUID pair.
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT contact.whatsapp_connection_id INTO v_assigned_connection_id
+  FROM public.contacts AS contact
+  WHERE contact.id = p_contact_id
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = p_whatsapp_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+    IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF v_assigned_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = v_assigned_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL
+    ORDER BY connection.updated_at DESC, connection.id
+    LIMIT 1;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_connected_whatsapp_connection' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_profile_id
+  FROM public.profiles AS profile
+  WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.is_active = true
+  LIMIT 1
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF public.is_contact_visible_to_user(p_contact_id, auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  -- Serialize check-and-enqueue for the idempotency key. Without this lock a
+  -- concurrent base enqueue could observe its temporary text row mid-upgrade.
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_contact_id::text || ':' || p_client_message_id::text, 0));
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_message
+  FROM public.messages AS message
+  WHERE message.contact_id = p_contact_id
+    AND message.client_message_id = p_client_message_id;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_message.sender = 'agent'
+       AND v_message.agent_id = v_profile_id
+       AND v_message.content = p_display_content
+       AND v_message.message_type = p_message_type
+       AND v_message.whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_connection_id
+       AND v_message.reply_to_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_reply_to_id
+       AND v_message.media_meta->'outbound_delivery_payload' = v_payload THEN
+      RETURN v_message;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_message_id_reused_with_different_payload'
+      USING ERRCODE = '23505';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Reuse the canonical authorization, profile, connection and reply checks.
+  PERFORM public.enqueue_outbound_message(
+    p_contact_id,
+    p_client_message_id,
+    p_display_content,
+    'text',
+    NULL,
+    p_reply_to_id,
+    p_whatsapp_connection_id,
+    NULL
+  );
+
+  UPDATE public.messages
+  SET message_type = p_message_type,
+      media_meta = jsonb_build_object('outbound_delivery_payload', v_payload),
+      updated_at = statement_timestamp()
+  WHERE contact_id = p_contact_id
+    AND client_message_id = p_client_message_id
+  RETURNING * INTO v_message;
+  RETURN v_message;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_rich_outbound_message(
+  uuid, uuid, text, text, jsonb, uuid, uuid
+) FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_rich_outbound_message(
+  uuid, uuid, text, text, jsonb, uuid, uuid
+) TO authenticated;

+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_rich_outbound_message(
+  uuid, uuid, text, text, jsonb, uuid, uuid
+) IS 'Authorized idempotent enqueue for poll/contact/buttons/list messages; transport payload is immutable after claim.';

+-- mx01_legacy_queue_materialize
+-- vers√£o 20261005150259 reservada para hermes-composer-materializa-fila-2610051151125f (hermes-db-migrar --nova)
+--
+-- Rollback: devolve ao estado 'sending' os disparos que esta migration pausou (so os que
+-- Rollback: ainda nao materializaram a fila por item) e remove a funcao. SQL executavel abaixo.
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   UPDATE public.multiplix_dispatches AS d SET status = 'sending', pause_reason = NULL, paused_at = NULL WHERE d.status = 'paused' AND d.pause_reason = 'legacy_queue_unmaterialized' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item WHERE item.dispatch_id = d.id);
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.multiplix_materialize_legacy_queue(uuid, uuid);
+-- Rollback honesto: mensagem enviada depois de uma retomada manual nao tem rollback.
+--
+-- MX01 (BACKLOG_VERIFICADO item 45 / achado MX01 da reconciliacao TALKX_MULTIPLIX):
+-- "Composer inicia rascunho sem materializar a fila por itens".
+--
+-- O composer cria o disparo pela RPC `multiplix_create_draft` (SOMENTE
+-- `multiplix_dispatches` + `multiplix_recipients`, nenhum bloco/item) e chama
+-- `multiplix-send/start` logo em seguida. O worker novo, porem, consome
+-- EXCLUSIVAMENTE `multiplix_delivery_items`: sem materializar a fila, o disparo
+-- entrava em 'sending' com destinatarios pendentes e ZERO itens processaveis ‚Äî
+-- nada era enviado e nenhum erro aparecia ("sucesso" silencioso).
+--
+-- Esta funcao e a CONVERSAO EXPLICITA E IDEMPOTENTE do rascunho legado. Antes
+-- de cria-la, a migration pausa todo legado que ja estava em 'sending' sem fila:
+-- ele so volta a 'sending' pelo clique Retomar no Monitor. O worker chama esta
+-- funcao depois da transicao manual e ANTES do loop de envio. A forma da fila e
+-- a MESMA do `multiplix_confirm_dispatch`
+-- (F51): um item por (destinatario elegivel x bloco), com a idempotencia vinda do
+-- `idempotency_key` gerado (UNIQUE), entao repetir a chamada nao duplica item.
+--
+-- Guard de conteudo (rodada 2 do cartao): um rascunho legado com
+-- `message_template` vazio ou so espacos NAO vira fila ‚Äî a funcao lanca
+-- 'multiplix_legacy_empty_template' (SQLSTATE 22023) ANTES de inserir bloco ou
+-- item, entao nao sobra nem bloco parcial. Sem o guard, o COALESCE antigo
+-- gravava um bloco com texto '' e a fila mandaria mensagem em branco a
+-- contatos reais.
+--
+-- Por que nao reusar o `multiplix_confirm_dispatch`: ele exige status
+-- draft/scheduled, bloco ja criado e conexao escolhida ‚Äî nada disso existe no
+-- rascunho legado do composer. E materializar com o dispatch ainda em 'draft'
+-- esbarra no trigger de versionamento do F05 (`multiplix_bump_version_on_block_change`
+-- -> UPDATE no dispatch -> `multiplix_bump_version_on_dispatch_edit`, que le
+-- NEW.template, coluna inexistente nesta base: 42703). Com o dispatch em
+-- 'sending' as duas guardas sao inertes (a de versao so age em 'draft').
+--
+-- Depende de: F30 (enum multiplix_item_status/eligibility), F31
+-- (dispatch_version, singu_contact_id), F32a (multiplix_delivery_items),
+-- F33 (multiplix_blocks.content), F34 (multiplix_events).
+
+-- Gate de seguranca do legado: a migration roda uma unica vez e transforma
+-- qualquer envio antigo sem fila em decisao explicita do operador. O predicado
+-- NOT EXISTS evita tocar disparos novos que ja possuem fila materializada. O
+-- trigger generico de updated_at e desligado so neste backfill de dados: pausar
+-- um legado antigo nao e edicao humana e nao deve reordenar o Monitor por
+-- updated_at.
+ALTER TABLE public.multiplix_dispatches DISABLE TRIGGER update_multiplix_dispatches_updated_at;
+
+UPDATE public.multiplix_dispatches AS d
+   SET status = 'paused',
+       pause_reason = 'legacy_queue_unmaterialized',
+       paused_at = now()
+ WHERE d.status = 'sending'
+   AND NOT EXISTS (
+     SELECT 1
+       FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item
+      WHERE item.dispatch_id = d.id
+   );
+
+ALTER TABLE public.multiplix_dispatches ENABLE TRIGGER update_multiplix_dispatches_updated_at;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.multiplix_materialize_legacy_queue(
+  p_dispatch_id uuid,
+  p_correlation_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS TABLE(items_created integer, items_total integer, created boolean)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_dispatch public.multiplix_dispatches%ROWTYPE;
+  v_existing integer;
+  v_blocks   integer;
+  v_eligible integer;
+  v_created  integer;
+  v_block_created boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_dispatch_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_multiplix_materialize' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Serializa materializacoes concorrentes do MESMO disparo (duas passadas do
+  -- cron, ou cron + clique): o 2o a chegar ve os itens do 1o e sai no no-op.
+  SELECT * INTO v_dispatch
+    FROM public.multiplix_dispatches AS d
+   WHERE d.id = p_dispatch_id
+   FOR UPDATE;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'multiplix_dispatch_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_existing
+    FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item
+   WHERE item.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id;
+
+  -- Ja materializada (fluxo novo do F51/F72, ou passada anterior do worker):
+  -- NO-OP. Fora de 'sending' (pausado/cancelado/concluido) tambem: nao se
+  -- enfileira item novo para um disparo que nao esta andando.
+  IF v_existing > 0 OR v_dispatch.status <> 'sending' THEN
+    RETURN QUERY SELECT 0, v_existing, false;
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_blocks
+    FROM public.multiplix_blocks AS b
+   WHERE b.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id;
+
+  IF v_blocks = 0 THEN
+    -- Rascunho legado SEM TEXTO nao pode virar fila: um bloco vazio geraria
+    -- itens enviaveis de mensagem em branco para contatos reais. Recusa ANTES
+    -- de qualquer INSERT ‚Äî o RAISE desfaz a funcao inteira, sem bloco parcial.
+    IF btrim(COALESCE(v_dispatch.message_template, '')) = '' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'multiplix_legacy_empty_template' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    -- Rascunho legado nao tem bloco: o `message_template` do disparo vira o
+    -- bloco unico (block_order 1) ‚Äî `multiplix_delivery_items.block_id` e NOT
+    -- NULL e a fila e (destinatario x bloco). O guard acima garante nao-vazio,
+    -- entao nao ha COALESCE aqui.
+    INSERT INTO public.multiplix_blocks (dispatch_id, block_order, block_type, content)
+    VALUES (
+      p_dispatch_id,
+      1,
+      'text',
+      jsonb_build_object('text', v_dispatch.message_template)
+    );
+    v_blocks := 1;
+    v_block_created := true;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Mesmo predicado de "apto" do F49/F51: so destinatario com PESSOA (contato do
+  -- Singu OU destino E.164) vira item; sem isso a fila nasceria inenvi√°vel.
+  SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_eligible
+    FROM public.multiplix_recipients AS r
+   WHERE r.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
+     AND r.status = 'pending'
+     AND r.eligibility IN ('eligible', 'media_pending', 'connection_unavailable', 'requires_template')
+     AND (r.singu_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR r.destino_e164 IS NOT NULL);
+
+  INSERT INTO public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item (
+    dispatch_id, recipient_id, block_id, dispatch_version, status
+  )
+  SELECT p_dispatch_id, r.id, b.id, v_dispatch.dispatch_version, 'pending'
+    FROM public.multiplix_recipients AS r
+    CROSS JOIN public.multiplix_blocks AS b
+   WHERE r.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
+     AND b.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
+     AND r.status = 'pending'
+     AND r.eligibility IN ('eligible', 'media_pending', 'connection_unavailable', 'requires_template')
+     AND (r.singu_contact_id IS NOT NULL OR r.destino_e164 IS NOT NULL)
+  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
+
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_created = ROW_COUNT;
+
+  IF v_block_created OR v_created > 0 THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.multiplix_events (dispatch_id, kind, payload, correlation_id)
+    VALUES (
+      p_dispatch_id,
+      -- 'item_queued' e o vocabulario do CHECK da F34 para item entrando na fila
+      -- (nao existe kind novo para conversao legada; nao se acrescenta um agora).
+      'item_queued',
+      jsonb_build_object(
+        'items_created', v_created,
+        'recipients', v_eligible,
+        'blocks', v_blocks
+      ),
+      p_correlation_id
+    );
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_created, v_created, (v_block_created OR v_created > 0);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.multiplix_materialize_legacy_queue(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.multiplix_materialize_legacy_queue(uuid, uuid) TO service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.multiplix_materialize_legacy_queue(uuid, uuid) IS
+  'MX01: materializa a fila por itens de um rascunho LEGADO (dispatch + recipients, sem bloco/item) '
+  'com o worker ja em ''sending''. Cria o bloco texto do message_template quando faltar e insere '
+  'destinatario elegivel x bloco de forma idempotente (idempotency_key). Template vazio/so espacos '
+  'e recusado: multiplix_legacy_empty_template (22023). service_role apenas.';

+-- sla_first_response_granular
+-- Rollback: DROP FUNCTION public.resolve_applicable_first_response_minutes(uuid); recriar public.register_first_response_internal com o corpo de prazo fixo de 5 min abaixo; refazer o REVOKE da assinatura exata.
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.resolve_applicable_first_response_minutes(uuid);
+--   CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_first_response_internal(p_contact_id uuid, p_responded_at timestamptz, p_before_created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ DECLARE v_first_message_at timestamptz; BEGIN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_contact_id::text, 42)); SELECT min(m.created_at) INTO v_first_message_at FROM public.messages m WHERE m.contact_id = p_contact_id AND m.sender = 'contact' AND m.created_at <= p_responded_at AND m.created_at > coalesce((SELECT max(r.created_at) FROM public.messages r WHERE r.contact_id = p_contact_id AND r.sender = 'agent' AND r.status IN ('sent','delivered','read') AND r.created_at < coalesce(p_before_created_at, p_responded_at)), timestamptz '-infinity'); IF v_first_message_at IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF; INSERT INTO public.conversation_sla (contact_id, first_message_at, first_response_at, first_response_breached) VALUES (p_contact_id, v_first_message_at, p_responded_at, p_responded_at > v_first_message_at + interval '5 minutes') ON CONFLICT (contact_id) WHERE first_response_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET first_response_at = EXCLUDED.first_response_at, first_response_breached = EXCLUDED.first_response_breached; END; $$;
+--   REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.register_first_response_internal(uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+--
+-- R2-SLA-003: register_first_response_internal comparava a resposta com um
+-- intervalo fixo de 5 minutos; uma regra ativa de 2 min continuava persistida
+-- como dentro do prazo. Agora o banco resolve o MESMO prazo granular da UI
+-- (resolveHierarchy em src/hooks/sla/useApplicableSLA.ts), por contato:
+--   1) sla_rules ativas por priority DESC, created_at, id ‚Äî primeiro casamento
+--      de cada nivel; vale o primeiro nao-nulo em
+--      contact > company > job_title > contact_type > queue > agent;
+--   2) sla_configurations is_active + is_default (limit 1);
+--   3) padrao do sistema: 5 minutos.
+-- Semantica nula = mesma da UI: regra/param nulo nunca casa (= com NULL ja
+-- devolve desconhecido).
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_applicable_first_response_minutes(p_contact_id uuid)
+RETURNS integer
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_company text;
+  v_job_title text;
+  v_contact_type text;
+  v_queue_id uuid;
+  v_assigned_to uuid;
+  v_company_minutes integer;
+  v_job_title_minutes integer;
+  v_contact_type_minutes integer;
+  v_queue_minutes integer;
+  v_agent_minutes integer;
+  v_minutes integer;
+  r record;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT c.company, c.job_title, c.contact_type, c.queue_id, c.assigned_to
+  INTO v_company, v_job_title, v_contact_type, v_queue_id, v_assigned_to
+  FROM public.contacts c
+  WHERE c.id = p_contact_id;
+
+  -- single-pass: primeiro casamento de CADA nivel, na ordem das regras
+  FOR r IN
+    SELECT rule.first_response_minutes, rule.contact_id, rule.company,
+           rule.job_title, rule.contact_type, rule.queue_id, rule.agent_id
+    FROM public.sla_rules rule
+    WHERE rule.is_active = true
+    ORDER BY rule.priority DESC, rule.created_at, rule.id
+  LOOP
+    -- nivel contact tem a maior precedencia: primeiro casamento encerra (break da UI)
+    IF r.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND r.contact_id = p_contact_id THEN
+      RETURN r.first_response_minutes;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_company_minutes IS NULL AND r.contact_id IS NULL
+       AND r.company IS NOT NULL AND r.company = v_company THEN
+      v_company_minutes := r.first_response_minutes;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_job_title_minutes IS NULL AND r.contact_id IS NULL AND r.company IS NULL
+       AND r.job_title IS NOT NULL AND r.job_title = v_job_title THEN
+      v_job_title_minutes := r.first_response_minutes;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_contact_type_minutes IS NULL AND r.contact_id IS NULL AND r.company IS NULL
+       AND r.job_title IS NULL AND r.contact_type IS NOT NULL
+       AND r.contact_type = v_contact_type THEN
+      v_contact_type_minutes := r.first_response_minutes;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_queue_minutes IS NULL AND r.contact_id IS NULL
+       AND r.queue_id IS NOT NULL AND r.queue_id = v_queue_id THEN
+      v_queue_minutes := r.first_response_minutes;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_agent_minutes IS NULL AND r.contact_id IS NULL
+       AND r.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND r.agent_id = v_assigned_to THEN
+      v_agent_minutes := r.first_response_minutes;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  v_minutes := coalesce(v_company_minutes, v_job_title_minutes, v_contact_type_minutes,
+                        v_queue_minutes, v_agent_minutes);
+  IF v_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RETURN v_minutes;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- fallback global: configuracao default ativa (a UI usa .limit(1))
+  SELECT sc.first_response_minutes
+  INTO v_minutes
+  FROM public.sla_configurations sc
+  WHERE sc.is_active = true AND sc.is_default = true
+  LIMIT 1;
+
+  RETURN coalesce(v_minutes, 5);
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_first_response_internal(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_responded_at timestamptz,
+  p_before_created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_first_message_at timestamptz;
+BEGIN
+  -- serializa por contato (fecha corrida de UPDATE concorrente)
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_contact_id::text, 42));
+
+  -- base: primeira mensagem do cliente ainda sem resposta EFETIVA do atendente
+  -- (mensagens sending/failed nao contam como resposta anterior)
+  SELECT min(m.created_at)
+  INTO v_first_message_at
+  FROM public.messages m
+  WHERE m.contact_id = p_contact_id
+    AND m.sender = 'contact'
+    AND m.created_at <= p_responded_at
+    AND m.created_at > coalesce(
+      (SELECT max(r.created_at)
+       FROM public.messages r
+       WHERE r.contact_id = p_contact_id
+         AND r.sender = 'agent'
+         AND r.status IN ('sent','delivered','read')
+         AND r.created_at < coalesce(p_before_created_at, p_responded_at)),
+      timestamptz '-infinity'
+    );
+
+  IF v_first_message_at IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.conversation_sla (contact_id, first_message_at, first_response_at, first_response_breached)
+  VALUES (
+    p_contact_id,
+    v_first_message_at,
+    p_responded_at,
+    p_responded_at > v_first_message_at
+      + make_interval(mins => public.resolve_applicable_first_response_minutes(p_contact_id))
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (contact_id) WHERE first_response_at IS NULL
+  DO UPDATE SET first_response_at = EXCLUDED.first_response_at,
+                first_response_breached = EXCLUDED.first_response_breached;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.resolve_applicable_first_response_minutes(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.register_first_response_internal(uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

+-- talkx_purge_nao_falsa_falha_recente
+-- Rollback: recriar a view public.talkx_engine_health com a definicao ORIGINAL (que le
+--   outcome_unknown_24h e failure_rate_15m por r.updated_at, de 20261003242707) + REVOKE/GRANT e
+--   COMMENT originais; depois drop trigger trg_talkx_recipients_status_changed_at, drop function
+--   set_talkx_recipient_status_changed_at() e drop column status_changed_at. O SQL literal,
+--   executavel e na ordem, esta entre os marcadores BEGIN-ROLLBACK-SQL / END-ROLLBACK-SQL.
+--
+-- Defeito (#126, achado R3-DELTA-009): a purga LGPD (public.purge_talkx_expired_data) anula
+-- personalized_message/media de destinatarios de campanhas TERMINAIS vencidas e, no mesmo
+-- UPDATE, grava updated_at = now(). O gatilho generico update_talkx_recipients_updated_at
+-- (BEFORE UPDATE FOR EACH ROW) tambem empurra updated_at em QUALQUER update da linha.
+-- A view de saude public.talkx_engine_health mede "falha recente" por r.updated_at
+-- (failure_rate_15m, janela de 15 min) e "outcome_unknown_24h" por r.updated_at (janela de
+-- 24 h). Resultado: a purga do dia faz destinatarios ANTIGOS e ja terminais (inclusive
+-- 'failed') aparecerem como se tivessem acabado de mudar de estado -> a saude acusa
+-- failure_rate_15m alto e talkx_engine_alerts() abre alertas falsos ('high_failure_rate' e
+-- 'outcome_unknown') numa campanha completed/cancelled.
+--
+-- Correcao: a saude nao pode ler updated_at (que muda por expurgo/PII e por qualquer edicao)
+-- para dizer "mudou de estado agora". Ela passa a ler a coluna nova
+-- public.talkx_recipients.status_changed_at, que SO muda quando o status do destinatario
+-- muda de verdade (gatilho proprio, BEFORE UPDATE OF status). O expurgo nao mexe em status,
+-- entao nao move esse carimbo; uma falha real (status virando 'failed' agora) continua sendo
+-- detectada. Mesmo padrao ja usado no modulo de tarefas (public.conversation_tasks.status_changed_at).
+--
+-- Marcador do harness (nao remover): talkx_status_changed_at_na_saude
+--
+-- Notas e limites conhecidos:
+-- * updated_at continua sendo empurrado pelo gatilho generico no expurgo (comportamento antigo
+--   do banco, fora do escopo deste cartao); por isso o sinal de saude e que muda de fonte, e
+--   nao o expurgo que deixa de gravar updated_at.
+-- * O backfill usa updated_at (melhor aproximacao disponivel) e NAO now(), para a propria
+--   migration nao criar o falso "recente" que ela corrige. Excecao: se uma purga tiver rodado
+--   nos 15 min anteriores a aplicacao desta migration, as linhas que ela acabou de expurgar
+--   herdam esse updated_at recente e podem aparecer UMA vez em failure_rate_15m; a purga roda
+--   no maximo 1x/dia e o alerta exige >= 5 falhas e >= 50%, entao o efeito e pontual e nao se
+--   repete (as purgas seguintes nao movem mais status_changed_at).
+-- * O backfill faz UPDATE em todas as linhas (a coluna e nova) e, sem cuidado, o gatilho
+--   generico empurraria updated_at = now() em todas elas ‚Äî destruindo o carimbo real de cada
+--   destinatario e fazendo a view ANTIGA (a que o rollback devolve) enxergar todo o historico
+--   como recente. Por isso o gatilho public.update_talkx_recipients_updated_at fica DESLIGADO
+--   APENAS durante esse UPDATE e e religado em seguida, na mesma transacao (secao 1).
+-- * O SQL de rollback e so DDL (create or replace view, drop trigger/function/column): nao faz
+--   UPDATE em talkx_recipients, entao tambem nao regrava updated_at em massa.
+-- * updated_at continua sendo escrito pelo gatilho generico no expurgo e em qualquer edicao da
+--   linha, e continua sendo lido por quem ja lia. Este cartao NAO audita os demais consumidores
+--   de talkx_recipients.updated_at e NAO afirma que ele seja dispensavel: o que muda de fonte e
+--   so o sinal de saude (que passa a ler status_changed_at).
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- (1) coluna de transicao REAL de status do destinatario
+-- ============================================================================
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_recipients
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_changed_at timestamptz;
+
+-- O UPDATE abaixo toca TODAS as linhas (a coluna acabou de nascer) e o gatilho generico
+-- public.update_talkx_recipients_updated_at (BEFORE UPDATE FOR EACH ROW) regravaria
+-- updated_at = now() em todas elas. Ele fica desligado SOMENTE durante este UPDATE e volta
+-- ligado logo em seguida; o ALTER TABLE segura o lock exclusivo ate o COMMIT, entao nenhum
+-- outro escritor chega a ver a tabela com o gatilho desligado.
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_recipients DISABLE TRIGGER update_talkx_recipients_updated_at;
+
+UPDATE public.talkx_recipients AS r
+   SET status_changed_at = COALESCE(r.updated_at, r.created_at, now())
+ WHERE r.status_changed_at IS NULL;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_recipients ENABLE TRIGGER update_talkx_recipients_updated_at;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_recipients
+  ALTER COLUMN status_changed_at SET DEFAULT now();
+
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_recipients
+  ALTER COLUMN status_changed_at SET NOT NULL;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.talkx_recipients.status_changed_at IS
+  'X126: instante da ultima troca REAL de status do destinatario (gatilho trg_talkx_recipients_status_changed_at). Nao acompanha expurgo de PII nem edicao de outros campos (updated_at acompanha). A saude do motor (talkx_engine_health.failure_rate_15m e outcome_unknown_24h) usa esta coluna.';
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- (2) gatilho: so a troca de status grava status_changed_at
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_talkx_recipient_status_changed_at()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
+    NEW.status_changed_at := now();
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;

+-- Gatilho nao e chamavel por cliente nenhum: a execucao por gatilho nao passa pelo privilegio

+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.set_talkx_recipient_status_changed_at()

+  BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.talkx_recipients

+-- ============================================================================
+-- (3) view de saude: "mudou agora" passa a ler status_changed_at, nao updated_at
+-- ============================================================================

+CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.talkx_engine_health
+WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
+WITH sending_activity AS (

+   WHERE c.status = 'sending'
+)
+SELECT 'stalled_campaign'::text AS kind,
+       a.campaign_id,
+       NULL::uuid AS recipient_id,
+       NULL::text AS status,
+       NULL::text AS return_message,
+       NULL::bigint AS metric_count,
+       NULL::numeric AS metric_rate,
+       jsonb_build_object(
+         'last_activity_at', a.last_activity_at,
+         'stalled_minutes', floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - a.last_activity_at)) / 60)::integer
+       ) AS detail,
+       a.last_activity_at AS observed_at
+  FROM sending_activity AS a
+ WHERE a.last_activity_at < now() - interval '15 minutes'
+   AND public.talkx_engine_window_open(a.campaign_id)
+UNION ALL
+SELECT 'stale_lease'::text, r.campaign_id, r.id, r.status, NULL, NULL, NULL,
+       jsonb_build_object('delivery_claim_expires_at', r.delivery_claim_expires_at),
+       r.delivery_claim_expires_at
+  FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+ WHERE r.status = 'sending'
+   AND r.delivery_claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL
+   AND r.delivery_claim_expires_at < now()
+UNION ALL
+SELECT 'outcome_unknown_24h'::text, r.campaign_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, count(*)::bigint, NULL,
+       jsonb_build_object('window_hours', 24), now()
+  FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+ WHERE r.status = 'outcome_unknown'
+   AND r.status_changed_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
+ GROUP BY r.campaign_id
+UNION ALL
+SELECT 'failure_rate_15m'::text, r.campaign_id, NULL, NULL, NULL,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed')::bigint,
+       round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed')::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 4),
+       jsonb_build_object('window_minutes', 15), now()
+  FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+ WHERE r.status_changed_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
+   AND r.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'failed', 'outcome_unknown')
+ GROUP BY r.campaign_id
+UNION ALL
+SELECT 'cron_run'::text, NULL, NULL, cr.status, cr.return_message, NULL, NULL,
+       jsonb_build_object('runid', cr.runid, 'jobid', cr.jobid,
+                          'start_time', cr.start_time, 'end_time', cr.end_time),
+       cr.start_time
+  FROM public.talkx_engine_cron_runs(60) AS cr
+ WHERE (COALESCE(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role' OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+
+REVOKE ALL ON public.talkx_engine_health FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.talkx_engine_health TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON VIEW public.talkx_engine_health IS
+  'X033 + X126: saude do motor Talk X (security_invoker). Sinais: stalled_campaign (sending sem envio novo >15min com janela aberta), stale_lease (destinatario sending com lease vencido), outcome_unknown_24h e failure_rate_15m (ambos por status_changed_at: so a troca REAL de status conta, nunca o expurgo de PII) e cron_run (ultimas 60 execucoes do cron do Talk X com status/return_message).';

+-- Rollback: volta a assinatura de 20261003242707_talkx_log_saude_alertas.sql ‚Äî o corpo anterior da
+--   funcao e o ACL originais ficam comentados abaixo, prontos para colar. Nada de dado se perde:

+-- Item 122 (BACKLOG_VERIFICADO / R3-DELTA-003): o cursor de log do Talk X por
+-- timestamp perde linhas empatadas.

+-- DEFEITO (confirmado no codigo vigente, 20261003242707_talkx_log_saude_alertas.sql):
+--   public.talkx_campaign_logs(p_campaign_id, p_after timestamptz, p_limit) lia
+--   `WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND (p_after IS NULL OR created_at > p_after)`
+--   com `ORDER BY created_at, id`. O log e gravado EM LOTE: a edge talkx-send insere
+--   varias linhas na mesma transacao, todas com o MESMO created_at (now() de transacao).
+--   A pagina seguinte recebe p_after = created_at da ultima linha lida e o filtro
+--   `created_at > p_after` descarta TODA a cauda empatada ‚Äî as linhas de mesmo
+--   created_at que ordenam depois da ultima lida nunca aparecem. Perda silenciosa:
+--   a paginacao devolve menos linhas do que existem, sem erro.
+--
+-- CORRECAO: cursor COMPOSTO (created_at, id) ‚Äî o mesmo keyset do ORDER BY. A pagina
+--   seguinte repete p_after (created_at da ultima linha) E passa p_after_id (o id da
+--   ultima linha); o filtro vira a comparacao de linha `(created_at, id) > (p_after, p_after_id)`.
+--   `id` e a PK (uuid, unico) e desempata a ordem de forma determinista.
+--
+-- COMPATIBILIDADE: p_after_id entra como ULTIMO argumento com DEFAULT NULL para nao
+--   quebrar a chamada de primeira pagina ja documentada em docs/talkx/OPERACAO.md
+--   (p_campaign_id, NULL, limite). Nenhum cliente do navegador chama esta RPC (so o
+--   exemplo da doc e o teste db-audit). Para o defeito nao voltar em silencio,
+--   p_after sem p_after_id agora ERRA (talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto) em vez de
+--   devolver menos linhas.
+--
+-- Classe: CONTRATO (assinatura de funcao + ACL). Idempotente: DROP IF EXISTS do contrato
+-- antigo + CREATE OR REPLACE do novo. Troca de assinatura: DROP FUNCTION f(uuid,timestamptz,integer)
+-- + CREATE f(uuid,timestamptz,integer,uuid) mantem o NOME no catalogo (o gate de remocoes
+-- destrutivas observa o objeto, nao a assinatura).

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_logs(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,

+  p_limit integer DEFAULT 200,
+  p_after_id uuid DEFAULT NULL

+RETURNS TABLE(

+  campaign_id uuid,

+BEGIN

+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_admin_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_id' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  -- Cursor composto: so created_at (p_after) nao identifica a posicao quando ha
+  -- empate e perde linhas. Exigir o id torna o defeito impossivel, e ruidoso se
+  -- alguem repetir o padrao antigo.
+  IF p_after IS NOT NULL AND p_after_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_logs_cursor_incompleto' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_limit := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 200), 1), 1000);
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+    SELECT l.id, l.campaign_id, l.recipient_id, l.attempt, l.stage, l.outcome,
+           l.http_status, l.error_code, l.worker_id, l.duration_ms, l.created_at
+      FROM public.talkx_delivery_log AS l
+     WHERE l.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+       AND (p_after IS NULL OR (l.created_at, l.id) > (p_after, p_after_id))
+     ORDER BY l.created_at, l.id
+     LIMIT v_limit;
+END;
+$function$;

+  FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid, timestamptz, integer, uuid)
+  TO authenticated, service_role;

+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_logs(uuid, timestamptz, integer, uuid) IS

+--      as duas passam a abortar. A lista tem de acompanhar a frota.
+--
+-- NAO TOCA: nenhum outro job, nenhuma cadencia, nenhum dado de aplicacao. So o

+  END IF;
+END;
+$$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(p_reverter boolean DEFAULT false)
+RETURNS integer
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, cron
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  alvo       record;
+  jid        bigint;
+  qtd        integer;
+  aplicados  integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  FOR alvo IN
+    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
+      -- job                          horario original   horario escalonado
+      ('expire-stale-agent-presence', '*/2 * * * *',        '1-59/2 * * * *'),
+      ('multiplix-send-trigger',      '*/2 * * * *',        '0-58/2 * * * *'),
+      ('gmail-incremental-sync',      '*/5 * * * *',        '0-55/5 * * * *'),
+      ('connection-health-check',     '*/5 * * * *',        '2-57/5 * * * *'),
+      ('cleanup-edge-rate-limits',    '*/15 * * * *',       '7-52/15 * * * *'),
+      ('avatars-refresh',             '0 * * * *',          '7 * * * *'),
+      ('cleanup-link-preview-cache',  '0 3 * * *',          '12 3 * * *'),
+      ('vacuum-contacts-daily',       '30 3 * * *',         '42 3 * * *')
+      -- 2026-10-06: 'vacuum-messages-post-expurgo' saiu desta lista nesta migration.
+    ) AS t(jobname, horario_original, horario_escalonado)
+  LOOP
+    SELECT count(*) INTO qtd FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = alvo.jobname;
+    IF qtd <> 1 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION
+        'job % esperado 1x em cron.job, encontrado % - escalonamento abortado sem aplicar nada',
+        alvo.jobname, qtd;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT jobid INTO jid FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = alvo.jobname;
+    PERFORM cron.alter_job(
+      job_id   := jid,
+      schedule := CASE WHEN p_reverter THEN alvo.horario_original
+                       ELSE alvo.horario_escalonado END
+    );
+    aplicados := aplicados + 1;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  RETURN aplicados;
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+-- ACL mantida igual a da versao anterior: ninguem alem do owner executa.
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(boolean)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.apply_pg_cron_escalonamento(boolean) TO service_role;

+-- etiqueta HUMANA hom√¥nima em etiqueta de IA.

+-- inicial, mas o UPSERT final ("on conflict (contact_id, tag_name) do update ... set source = 'ai'")
+-- conflitava pela chave √∫nica (contact_id, tag_name) e FOR√áAVA source='ai' na linha existente.
+-- Bastava a sugest√£o da IA usar um nome que o humano j√° havia etiquetado √† m√£o: a etiqueta humana
+-- passava a ter source='ai' e a pr√≥xima reclassifica√ß√£o (delete where source='ai') a apagava ‚Äî
+-- a IA removia uma decis√£o do humano que ela nunca criou.

+-- existente √© humana/manual (ou de origem desconhecida), o UPSERT n√£o a toca: nome, confian√ßa e
+-- source permanecem como o humano definiu. Assim a IA nunca adota nem herda uma etiqueta que n√£o √© dela.
+create or replace function public.replace_ai_conversation_tags(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_tags jsonb
+)
+returns jsonb
+language plpgsql
+security invoker
+set search_path = public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_count integer;
+begin
+  if p_contact_id is null then
+    raise exception 'p_contact_id √© obrigat√≥rio' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Apaga SOMENTE etiquetas de IA: linha com outro `source` (humana/manual) √©
+  -- preservada, ao contr√°rio do delete().eq('contact_id') anterior, que
+  -- apagava qualquer origem.
+  delete from public.ai_conversation_tags
+   where contact_id = p_contact_id
+     and source = 'ai';
+
+  -- Resultado vazio tem sem√¢ntica expl√≠cita: LIMPA as etiquetas de IA.
+  insert into public.ai_conversation_tags (contact_id, tag_name, confidence, source)
+  select p_contact_id, t.tag_name, max(t.confidence), 'ai'
+    from (
+      select
+        btrim(coalesce(e ->> 'name', '')) as tag_name,
+        case
+          when nullif(btrim(coalesce(e ->> 'confidence', '')), '') is null then null
+          else least(greatest(nullif(btrim(coalesce(e ->> 'confidence', '')), '')::numeric, 0), 1)
+        end as confidence
+      from jsonb_array_elements(
+        case when jsonb_typeof(p_tags) = 'array' then p_tags else '[]'::jsonb end
+      ) as e
+    ) t
+   where t.tag_name <> ''
+   group by t.tag_name
+  on conflict (contact_id, tag_name) do update
+     set confidence = greatest(
+           coalesce(excluded.confidence, public.ai_conversation_tags.confidence),
+           coalesce(public.ai_conversation_tags.confidence, excluded.confidence)
+         ),
+         source = 'ai'
+   -- R2-DB-012: a IA s√≥ reescreve a etiqueta que ELA criou. Linha humana/manual
+   -- (ou com source nulo, origem desconhecida) fica intacta ‚Äî inclusive a confian√ßa.
+   where public.ai_conversation_tags.source = 'ai';
+
+  select count(*) into v_count
+    from public.ai_conversation_tags
+   where contact_id = p_contact_id and source = 'ai';
+
+  return jsonb_build_object('contact_id', p_contact_id, 'replaced', true, 'count', v_count);
+end;
+$$;
