+-- mini_game_xp_daily_limit
+-- Rollback: dropa a RPC nova e a tabela do contador do dia; nada alem disso foi alterado.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(uuid, text, integer);
+--   drop table if exists public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily;
+--
+-- Por que: os mini-games passaram a creditar o XP real da partida (xpEarned) e o
+-- credito anterior (add_agent_xp) nao tinha trava antifarm. Esta RPC nova conta
+-- partidas creditadas por agente + mini-game + dia e recusa a partir da 6a, com a
+-- trava feita por INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE ... WHERE (race-safe).
+
+CREATE TABLE public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily (
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  game_id    text NOT NULL,
+  dia        date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
+  partidas   integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+  xp_total   bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT agent_mini_game_xp_daily_pkey PRIMARY KEY (profile_id, game_id, dia),
+  CONSTRAINT agent_mini_game_xp_daily_game_id_check CHECK (game_id IN ('speed-typing', 'quiz', 'response-match', 'emoji-decode')),
+  CONSTRAINT agent_mini_game_xp_daily_partidas_check CHECK (partidas >= 0),
+  CONSTRAINT agent_mini_game_xp_daily_xp_total_check CHECK (xp_total >= 0)
+);
+
+COMMENT ON TABLE public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily IS
+  'Contador antifarm: partidas de mini-game que ja creditaram XP por agente, por mini-game e por dia (limite 5). Sem policy de RLS: so as funcoes SECURITY DEFINER e o service_role alcancam.';
+
+ALTER TABLE public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily FROM anon;
+REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily FROM authenticated;
+REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily FROM PUBLIC;
+GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily TO service_role;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(
+  p_profile_id uuid,
+  p_game_id    text,
+  p_xp         integer
+) RETURNS json
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_game_id   text;
+  v_row       agent_stats%ROWTYPE;
+  v_partidas  integer;
+  v_new_xp    bigint;
+  v_new_level int;
+  v_max       constant integer := 5;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.role() = 'anon' OR (
+    auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND NOT (
+      p_profile_id IN (SELECT id FROM profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
+      OR is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+    )
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission denied';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_game_id := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_game_id, '')));
+  IF v_game_id !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_game_id invalido: %', p_game_id;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_game_id NOT IN ('speed-typing', 'quiz', 'response-match', 'emoji-decode') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_game_id desconhecido: %', p_game_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_xp IS NULL OR p_xp < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_xp nao pode ser negativo, got %', p_xp;
+  END IF;
+  IF p_xp > 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_xp exceeds single-call maximum of 500, got %', p_xp;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- 0 XP nao credita nada e NAO consome partida do dia.
+  IF p_xp = 0 THEN
+    SELECT d.partidas INTO v_partidas
+      FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily d
+     WHERE d.profile_id = p_profile_id AND d.game_id = v_game_id AND d.dia = CURRENT_DATE;
+    RETURN json_build_object('credited', false, 'reason', 'zero_xp',
+      'partidas', coalesce(v_partidas, 0), 'maxPartidasDia', v_max, 'xpCreditado', 0);
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.agent_stats WHERE profile_id = p_profile_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RETURN json_build_object('credited', false, 'reason', 'sem_stats',
+      'partidas', 0, 'maxPartidasDia', v_max, 'xpCreditado', 0);
+  END IF;
+
+  -- O INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE ... WHERE e a trava do limite: a linha do dia
+  -- fica presa por quem chega primeiro e a segunda chamada so reavalia depois do commit
+  -- (nunca credita a 6a partida, mesmo em chamadas concorrentes).
+  INSERT INTO public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily (profile_id, game_id, dia, partidas, xp_total)
+  VALUES (p_profile_id, v_game_id, CURRENT_DATE, 1, p_xp)
+  ON CONFLICT (profile_id, game_id, dia) DO UPDATE
+     SET partidas   = agent_mini_game_xp_daily.partidas + 1,
+         xp_total   = agent_mini_game_xp_daily.xp_total + p_xp,
+         updated_at = now()
+   WHERE agent_mini_game_xp_daily.partidas < v_max
+  RETURNING partidas INTO v_partidas;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RETURN json_build_object('credited', false, 'reason', 'daily_limit',
+      'partidas', v_max, 'maxPartidasDia', v_max, 'xpCreditado', 0,
+      'newXp', v_row.xp, 'newLevel', v_row.level,
+      'previousLevel', v_row.level, 'leveledUp', false);
+  END IF;
+
+  v_new_xp    := v_row.xp + p_xp;
+  v_new_level := public.calculate_level(v_new_xp);
+
+  UPDATE public.agent_stats
+     SET xp = v_new_xp, level = v_new_level, updated_at = now()
+   WHERE profile_id = p_profile_id;
+
+  RETURN json_build_object('credited', true, 'reason', 'ok',
+    'partidas', v_partidas, 'maxPartidasDia', v_max, 'xpCreditado', p_xp,
+    'newXp', v_new_xp, 'newLevel', v_new_level,
+    'previousLevel', v_row.level, 'leveledUp', v_new_level > v_row.level);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(uuid, text, integer) FROM anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(uuid, text, integer) FROM PUBLIC;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(uuid, text, integer)
+  TO authenticated, service_role;

+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_sent integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_connection' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT
+    (SELECT count(*)
+       FROM public.talkx_recipients AS recipient
+       JOIN public.talkx_campaigns AS campaign ON campaign.id = recipient.campaign_id
+      WHERE campaign.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id
+        AND recipient.sent_at IS NOT NULL
+        AND recipient.sent_at >= p_since)
+    +
+    (SELECT count(*)
+       FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item
+       JOIN public.multiplix_dispatches AS dispatch ON dispatch.id = item.dispatch_id
+      WHERE dispatch.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id
+        AND item.sent_at IS NOT NULL
+        AND item.sent_at >= p_since)
+    +
+    (SELECT count(*)
+       FROM public.multiplix_recipients AS recipient
+       JOIN public.multiplix_dispatches AS dispatch ON dispatch.id = recipient.dispatch_id
+      WHERE dispatch.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id
+        AND recipient.sent_at IS NOT NULL
+        AND recipient.sent_at >= p_since
+        AND NOT EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1
+            FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item
+           WHERE item.recipient_id = recipient.id
+             AND item.sent_at IS NOT NULL
+        ))
+    INTO v_sent;
+
+  RETURN COALESCE(v_sent, 0);
+END;
+$function$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.multiplix_connection_daily_usage(p_connection_id uuid)

+    'day_remaining', GREATEST(v_day_limit - v_day_sent, 0),

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_talkx_conversion(
+  p_campaign_id   uuid,
+  p_external_ref  text,
+  p_value         numeric,
+  p_source        text,
+  p_currency      text DEFAULT 'BRL',
+  p_link_id       uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_recipient_id  uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_occurred_at   timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+  p_attribution   jsonb DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp

+DECLARE
+  v_max_value     numeric;
+  v_link_campaign uuid;
+  v_id            uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_conversion_service_role_only' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_max_value := COALESCE(
+    (SELECT (value #>> '{}')::numeric FROM public.talkx_settings WHERE key = 'conversion_max_value'),
+    100000
+  );
+
+  IF p_value < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_conversion_value_negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_value > v_max_value THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_conversion_value_exceeds_max' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+

+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_conversion_invalid_source' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;

+    IF v_link_campaign IS DISTINCT FROM p_campaign_id THEN

+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_occurred_at > now() + interval '1 hour' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_conversion_occurred_at_in_future' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;

+

+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'recorded', 'id', v_id);
+END;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- (5) talkx_attribute_purchases ‚Äî √∫ltimo toque na janela de atribui√ß√£o
+--     SECURITY DEFINER porque chama record_talkx_conversion (service_role only);
+--     EXECUTE s√≥ para service_role (o job de dados).
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_attribute_purchases(p_since timestamptz DEFAULT NULL)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_window_days integer;
+  v_since       timestamptz;
+  v_scanned     integer := 0;
+  v_attributed  integer := 0;
+  v_no_touch    integer := 0;
+  v_duplicate   integer := 0;
+  v_rejected    integer := 0;
+  v_purchase    record;
+  v_recipient   record;
+  v_result      jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  -- Janela de atribui√ß√£o em dias; padr√£o 30 quando a chave n√£o existe.
+  v_window_days := COALESCE(
+    (SELECT NULLIF(value #>> '{}', '')::integer
+       FROM public.talkx_settings WHERE key = 'attribution_window_days'),
+    30
+  );
+  IF v_window_days < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_attribution_window_invalid' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_since := COALESCE(p_since, now() - (v_window_days || ' days')::interval);
+
+  FOR v_purchase IN
+    SELECT cp.id, cp.contact_id, cp.external_id, cp.amount, cp.currency, cp.purchased_at
+      FROM public.contact_purchases cp
+     WHERE cp.source = 'bitrix24'
+       AND cp.external_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND cp.purchased_at IS NOT NULL
+       AND cp.purchased_at >= v_since
+       AND NOT EXISTS (
+             SELECT 1
+               FROM public.talkx_conversions tc
+              WHERE tc.source = 'deal'
+                AND tc.external_ref = cp.external_id
+           )
+     ORDER BY cp.purchased_at, cp.id
+  LOOP
+    v_scanned := v_scanned + 1;
+
+    -- √öltimo toque: o envio mais recente ao MESMO contato, anterior √† compra e
+    -- dentro da janela. Uma compra conta para uma √∫nica campanha.
+    SELECT r.id, r.campaign_id
+      INTO v_recipient
+      FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+     WHERE r.contact_id = v_purchase.contact_id
+       AND r.sent_at IS NOT NULL
+       AND r.sent_at <= v_purchase.purchased_at
+       AND r.sent_at >= v_purchase.purchased_at - (v_window_days || ' days')::interval
+     ORDER BY r.sent_at DESC, r.id
+     LIMIT 1;
+
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN
+      v_no_touch := v_no_touch + 1;
+      CONTINUE;
+    END IF;
+
+    BEGIN
+      v_result := public.record_talkx_conversion(
+        v_recipient.campaign_id,
+        v_purchase.external_id,
+        COALESCE(v_purchase.amount, 0),
+        'deal',
+        COALESCE(v_purchase.currency, 'BRL'),
+        NULL,
+        v_recipient.id,
+        v_purchase.purchased_at,
+        jsonb_build_object(
+          'purchase_id', v_purchase.id,
+          'recipient_id', v_recipient.id,
+          'window_days', v_window_days
+        )
+      );
+    EXCEPTION
+      WHEN invalid_parameter_value OR check_violation THEN
+        -- Uma compra inv√°lida n√£o pode travar o lote inteiro de atribui√ß√£o.
+        -- record_talkx_conversion usa SQLSTATE 22023 para valor negativo,
+        -- valor acima de conversion_max_value e occurred_at no futuro.
+        v_rejected := v_rejected + 1;
+        CONTINUE;
+    END;
+
+    IF v_result ->> 'status' = 'recorded' THEN
+      v_attributed := v_attributed + 1;
+    ELSE
+      v_duplicate := v_duplicate + 1;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'scanned',          v_scanned,
+    'attributed',       v_attributed,
+    'skipped_no_touch', v_no_touch,
+    'duplicates',       v_duplicate,
+    'rejected',         v_rejected,
+    'since',            v_since,
+    'window_days',      v_window_days
+  );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_attribute_purchases(timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_attribute_purchases(timestamptz) TO service_role;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- (6) talkx_campaign_revenue ‚Äî convers√µes, receita, investimento e ROI
+--     SECURITY INVOKER: a leitura de talkx_conversions/talkx_campaigns passa pela
+--     RLS do chamador (dono da campanha / admin-supervisor).
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_revenue(p_campaign uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+  WITH agg AS (
+    SELECT count(*)::integer                    AS conversions,
+           COALESCE(sum(value), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS revenue
+      FROM public.talkx_conversions
+     WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign
+  )
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'campaign_id', p_campaign,
+    'conversions', agg.conversions,
+    'revenue',     agg.revenue,
+    'investment',  camp.investment,
+    'roi', CASE
+             WHEN camp.investment IS NOT NULL AND camp.investment > 0
+             THEN round((agg.revenue - camp.investment) / camp.investment, 4)
+           END,
+    'roi_percent', CASE
+             WHEN camp.investment IS NOT NULL AND camp.investment > 0
+             THEN round(100 * (agg.revenue - camp.investment) / camp.investment, 2)
+           END
+  )
+    FROM agg
+    LEFT JOIN public.talkx_campaigns camp ON camp.id = p_campaign;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_revenue(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_revenue(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

+--   A etapa que define a proje√ß√£o `talkx_contact_attributes` (X037) e a tabela de jobs
+--   `talkx_contact_attributes`/`talkx_data_jobs` (X036) N√ÉO integra a 3¬™ leva (o plano de
+--   08/10 deixa banco/migrations fora da leva) e n√£o existe em nenhum branch
+--   (`git grep -l talkx_contact_attributes` = 0) ‚Äî a pr√≥pria auditoria (P046.json) registra
+--   "dependem do pipeline ainda ausente". Sem elas a fun√ß√£o n√£o tem onde gravar e a
+--   migration n√£o sobe num banco limpo. A cria√ß√£o aqui √© ADITIVA e COMPOS√ÅVEL
+--   (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS): quando as ondas de banco de
+--   X036/X037 rodarem, elas s√≥ acrescentam as colunas pr√≥prias (CRM, vendedor, regi√£o...) e
+--   a proje√ß√£o continua √≠ntegra. As colunas abaixo s√£o exatamente as que a X040 "Fecha":
+--   dados:ultima_compra, dados:ticket_medio, dados:total_pedidos, dados:valor_total,
+--   dados:rfm_recencia, dados:rfm_frequencia, dados:rfm_monetario, dados:rfm_segmento.
+--
+-- Contrato da fun√ß√£o public.talkx_recompute_purchase_metrics(p_limit integer DEFAULT 5000):
+--   * varre public.contact_purchases (compra local EFETIVA: status approved/completed
+--     e tipo purchase/subscription) agrupando por contato com compra;
+--   * grava last_purchase_at, orders_count, total_spent, avg_ticket, rfm_recency_days,
+--     rfm_frequency (nota F), rfm_monetary (nota M), rfm_segment;
+--   * notas R/F/M de 1 a 5 por faixas em public.talkx_settings.rfm_bands (default embutido:
+--     rec√™ncia 30/90/180/365 dias; frequ√™ncia 1, 2, 3‚Äì4, 5‚Äì9, 10+; valor por faixas), e por
+--     QUINTIS quando h√° >= rfm_bands.monetary_min_buyers_for_quintiles compradores (padr√£o 100);
+--   * SEGMENTO por tabela de decis√£o versionada abaixo (Campe√µes, Leais, Em potencial, Novos,
+--     Em risco, Hibernando, Perdidos);
+--   * contato SEM compra nunca vira "Hibernando": se ainda n√£o existe proje√ß√£o, n√£o √©
+--     gravado; se tinha proje√ß√£o e perdeu/cancelou todas as compras efetivas, os campos
+--     de compra/RFM s√£o zerados ou nulos;
+--   * fuso America/Sao_Paulo na conta da rec√™ncia;
+--   * idempotente: p_limit limita os CANDIDATOS QUE MUDARAM por chamada (novos,
+--     alterados ou que precisam zerar), evitando fome quando h√° mais compradores que o
+--     limite; reexecutar sem compra nova devolve 0;
+--   * devolve o n√∫mero de linhas alteradas (changed).
+--   * EXECUTE s√≥ para service_role (job de manuten√ß√£o); nada para anon/PUBLIC/authenticated.
+--
+-- Job: linha em public.talkx_data_jobs (job='recompute_purchase_metrics', 1x/dia = 1440 min),
+--   disparada por talkx_run_data_jobs() (X036) e, quando existir, logo ap√≥s `pull_won_deals`
+--   com altera√ß√µes (X039).
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- (1) Tabela de jobs dos dados da trilha (X036) ‚Äî m√≠nimo, compos√°vel.

+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_data_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_data_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_started_at timestamptz;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_data_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_finished_at timestamptz;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_data_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now();
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_data_jobs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now();

+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS talkx_data_jobs_select ON public.talkx_data_jobs;

+  USING (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+

+GRANT SELECT ON public.talkx_data_jobs TO authenticated;
+GRANT ALL ON public.talkx_data_jobs TO service_role;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+  avg_ticket numeric(14,2),
+  rfm_recency_days integer,
+  rfm_frequency integer,
+  rfm_monetary integer,
+  rfm_segment text,
+  purchases_synced_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+-- compos√°vel com as ondas de banco (X037/X038): acrescenta sem conflito
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_contact_attributes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_purchase_at timestamptz;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_contact_attributes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS orders_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_contact_attributes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_spent numeric(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_contact_attributes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS avg_ticket numeric(14,2);
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_contact_attributes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rfm_recency_days integer;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_contact_attributes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rfm_frequency integer;
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_contact_attributes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rfm_monetary integer;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- (3) Faixas configur√°veis das notas R/F/M (talkx_settings.rfm_bands).
+--     Seed s√≥ se ainda n√£o houver valor (n√£o sobrescreve ajuste do dono).
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_settings (key, value, description)
+VALUES (
+  'rfm_bands',
+  '{"version":1,"recency_days":[30,90,180,365],"frequency":[1,2,4,9],"monetary":[100,500,1000,5000],"monetary_min_buyers_for_quintiles":100}'::jsonb,
+  'Talk X ¬∑ faixas das notas R/F/M (1 a 5); sobrep√µe o default embutido em talkx_recompute_purchase_metrics'

+ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- (4) Fun√ß√£o de recomputo.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_recompute_purchase_metrics(p_limit integer DEFAULT 5000)
+RETURNS integer
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_bands jsonb;
+  v_recency integer[];
+  v_frequency integer[];
+  v_monetary numeric[];
+  v_min_buyers integer;
+  v_buyer_count integer;
+  v_changed integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  v_bands := COALESCE((SELECT value FROM public.talkx_settings WHERE key = 'rfm_bands'), '{}'::jsonb);
+
+  v_recency := CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_bands -> 'recency_days') = 'array'
+    THEN ARRAY(SELECT x::integer FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_bands -> 'recency_days') AS t(x))
+    ELSE ARRAY[30, 90, 180, 365] END;
+  IF array_length(v_recency, 1) IS DISTINCT FROM 4 THEN v_recency := ARRAY[30, 90, 180, 365]; END IF;
+
+  v_frequency := CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_bands -> 'frequency') = 'array'
+    THEN ARRAY(SELECT x::integer FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_bands -> 'frequency') AS t(x))
+    ELSE ARRAY[1, 2, 4, 9] END;
+  IF array_length(v_frequency, 1) IS DISTINCT FROM 4 THEN v_frequency := ARRAY[1, 2, 4, 9]; END IF;
+
+  v_monetary := CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_bands -> 'monetary') = 'array'
+    THEN ARRAY(SELECT x::numeric FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_bands -> 'monetary') AS t(x))
+    ELSE ARRAY[100, 500, 1000, 5000] END;
+  IF array_length(v_monetary, 1) IS DISTINCT FROM 4 THEN v_monetary := ARRAY[100, 500, 1000, 5000]; END IF;
+
+  v_min_buyers := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_bands ->> 'monetary_min_buyers_for_quintiles', '')::integer, 100);
+
+  WITH effective_purchases AS (
+    SELECT p.contact_id,
+           p.purchased_at,
+           p.amount
+    FROM public.contact_purchases AS p
+    WHERE p.contact_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND p.purchased_at IS NOT NULL
+      AND COALESCE(p.status, '') IN ('approved', 'completed')
+      AND COALESCE(p.purchase_type, 'purchase') IN ('purchase', 'subscription')
+  ),
+  buyers AS (
+    SELECT p.contact_id,
+           max(p.purchased_at) AS last_purchase_at,
+           count(*)::integer AS orders_count,
+           COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(p.amount, 0)), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total_spent
+    FROM effective_purchases AS p
+    GROUP BY p.contact_id
+  ),
+  buyer_count AS (
+    SELECT count(*)::integer AS n FROM buyers
+  ),
+  scored AS (
+    SELECT b.contact_id,
+           b.last_purchase_at,
+           b.orders_count,
+           b.total_spent,
+           GREATEST(
+             0,
+             (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
+               - (b.last_purchase_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
+           )::integer AS recency_days,
+           ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY b.total_spent, b.contact_id) AS monetary_quintile
+    FROM buyers AS b
+  ),
+  noted AS (
+    SELECT s.contact_id,
+           s.last_purchase_at,
+           s.orders_count,
+           s.total_spent,
+           s.recency_days,
+           CASE WHEN s.recency_days <= v_recency[1] THEN 5
+                WHEN s.recency_days <= v_recency[2] THEN 4
+                WHEN s.recency_days <= v_recency[3] THEN 3
+                WHEN s.recency_days <= v_recency[4] THEN 2
+                ELSE 1 END AS r_note,
+           CASE WHEN s.orders_count <= v_frequency[1] THEN 1
+                WHEN s.orders_count <= v_frequency[2] THEN 2
+                WHEN s.orders_count <= v_frequency[3] THEN 3
+                WHEN s.orders_count <= v_frequency[4] THEN 4
+                ELSE 5 END AS f_note,
+           CASE WHEN (SELECT n FROM buyer_count) >= v_min_buyers THEN s.monetary_quintile::integer
+                WHEN s.total_spent <= v_monetary[1] THEN 1
+                WHEN s.total_spent <= v_monetary[2] THEN 2
+                WHEN s.total_spent <= v_monetary[3] THEN 3
+                WHEN s.total_spent <= v_monetary[4] THEN 4
+                ELSE 5 END AS m_note
+    FROM scored AS s
+  ),
+  final AS (
+    SELECT n.contact_id,
+           n.last_purchase_at,
+           n.orders_count,
+           n.total_spent,
+           round(n.total_spent / NULLIF(n.orders_count, 0), 2)::numeric(14,2) AS avg_ticket,
+           n.recency_days,
+           n.r_note,
+           n.f_note,
+           n.m_note,
+           CASE
+             WHEN n.r_note >= 4 AND n.f_note >= 4 AND n.m_note >= 4 THEN 'Campe√µes'
+             WHEN n.r_note >= 3 AND n.f_note >= 3 AND n.m_note >= 3 THEN 'Leais'
+             WHEN n.r_note >= 4 AND n.f_note = 1 THEN 'Novos'
+             WHEN n.r_note >= 3 THEN 'Em potencial'
+             WHEN n.f_note >= 3 THEN 'Em risco'
+             WHEN n.f_note <= 2 AND n.m_note >= 3 THEN 'Hibernando'
+             ELSE 'Perdidos'
+           END AS segment
+    FROM noted AS n
+  ),
+  upsert_candidates AS (
+    SELECT 'upsert'::text AS change_kind,
+           f.contact_id,
+           f.last_purchase_at,
+           f.orders_count,
+           f.total_spent,
+           f.avg_ticket,
+           f.recency_days,
+           f.f_note,
+           f.m_note,
+           f.segment,
+           a.purchases_synced_at AS previous_synced_at
+    FROM final AS f
+    LEFT JOIN public.talkx_contact_attributes AS a ON a.contact_id = f.contact_id
+    WHERE (a.last_purchase_at, a.orders_count, a.total_spent, a.avg_ticket,
+           a.rfm_recency_days, a.rfm_frequency, a.rfm_monetary, a.rfm_segment)
+          IS DISTINCT FROM
+          (f.last_purchase_at, f.orders_count, f.total_spent, f.avg_ticket,
+           f.recency_days, f.f_note, f.m_note, f.segment)
+  ),
+  reset_candidates AS (
+    SELECT 'reset'::text AS change_kind,
+           a.contact_id,
+           NULL::timestamptz AS last_purchase_at,
+           0::integer AS orders_count,
+           0::numeric(14,2) AS total_spent,
+           NULL::numeric(14,2) AS avg_ticket,
+           NULL::integer AS recency_days,
+           NULL::integer AS f_note,
+           NULL::integer AS m_note,
+           NULL::text AS segment,
+           a.purchases_synced_at AS previous_synced_at
+    FROM public.talkx_contact_attributes AS a
+    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM buyers AS b WHERE b.contact_id = a.contact_id)
+      AND (a.last_purchase_at, a.orders_count, a.total_spent, a.avg_ticket,
+           a.rfm_recency_days, a.rfm_frequency, a.rfm_monetary, a.rfm_segment)
+          IS DISTINCT FROM
+          (NULL::timestamptz, 0::integer, 0::numeric(14,2), NULL::numeric(14,2),
+           NULL::integer, NULL::integer, NULL::integer, NULL::text)
+  ),
+  selected AS (
+    SELECT * FROM upsert_candidates
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT * FROM reset_candidates
+    ORDER BY previous_synced_at ASC NULLS FIRST, contact_id, change_kind
+    LIMIT GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 0), 0)
+  ),
+  reseted AS (
+    UPDATE public.talkx_contact_attributes AS a
+    SET last_purchase_at = NULL,
+        orders_count = 0,
+        total_spent = 0,
+        avg_ticket = NULL,
+        rfm_recency_days = NULL,
+        rfm_frequency = NULL,
+        rfm_monetary = NULL,
+        rfm_segment = NULL,
+        purchases_synced_at = now(),
+        updated_at = now()
+    FROM selected AS s
+    WHERE s.change_kind = 'reset'
+      AND a.contact_id = s.contact_id
+    RETURNING 1
+  ),
+  upserted AS (
+    INSERT INTO public.talkx_contact_attributes AS a
+      (contact_id, last_purchase_at, orders_count, total_spent, avg_ticket,
+       rfm_recency_days, rfm_frequency, rfm_monetary, rfm_segment,
+       purchases_synced_at, updated_at)
+    SELECT s.contact_id,
+           s.last_purchase_at,
+           s.orders_count,
+           s.total_spent,
+           s.avg_ticket,
+           s.recency_days,
+           s.f_note,
+           s.m_note,
+           s.segment,
+           now(),
+           now()
+    FROM selected AS s
+    WHERE s.change_kind = 'upsert'
+    ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO UPDATE SET
+      last_purchase_at = EXCLUDED.last_purchase_at,
+      orders_count = EXCLUDED.orders_count,
+      total_spent = EXCLUDED.total_spent,
+      avg_ticket = EXCLUDED.avg_ticket,
+      rfm_recency_days = EXCLUDED.rfm_recency_days,
+      rfm_frequency = EXCLUDED.rfm_frequency,
+      rfm_monetary = EXCLUDED.rfm_monetary,
+      rfm_segment = EXCLUDED.rfm_segment,
+      purchases_synced_at = EXCLUDED.purchases_synced_at,
+      updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
+    RETURNING 1
+  )
+  SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM upserted) + (SELECT count(*) FROM reseted))::integer
+    INTO v_changed;
+
+  RETURN v_changed;
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_recompute_purchase_metrics(integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_recompute_purchase_metrics(integer) TO service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talkx_recompute_purchase_metrics(integer) IS
+  'Talk X ¬∑ X040: recalcula as m√©tricas de compra e o RFM local por contato (compras em contact_purchases). S√≥ service_role. Devolve quantas linhas mudaram.';
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- (5) Registro do job (1x/dia). Roda por talkx_run_data_jobs() (X036) e ap√≥s pull_won_deals.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+INSERT INTO public.talkx_data_jobs (job, interval_minutes, enabled)
+VALUES ('recompute_purchase_metrics', 1440, true)
+ON CONFLICT (job) DO NOTHING;

+  v_media_type text;
+  v_scheduled_at timestamptz;
+  v_schedule_timezone text;
+  v_window_start time;
+  v_window_end time;
+  v_speed_profile text;
+  v_typing_delay_min integer;
+  v_typing_delay_max integer;
+  v_send_interval_min integer;
+  v_send_interval_max integer;
+  v_business_hours_only boolean;
+  v_respect_suppression boolean;
+  v_confirm_consent boolean;
+  v_legal_basis text;
+  v_consent_by uuid;
+  v_consent_at timestamptz;
+  v_draft_step integer;
+  v_owner uuid;
+  v_template_version_id uuid;
+  v_requested_status text;
+  v_max_per_minute smallint;
+  v_pace record;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_actor_profile_id
+   FROM public.profiles profile
+   WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+     AND profile.is_active = true
+   LIMIT 1
+   FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_actor_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X014: criar/editar rascunho √© ato de admin/supervisor.
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) <> 'object'
+     OR pg_column_size(p_payload) > 65536 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_name := NULLIF(btrim(p_payload ->> 'name'), '');
+  v_message_template := COALESCE(p_payload ->> 'message_template', '');
+  v_description := p_payload ->> 'description';
+  v_objective := p_payload ->> 'objective';
+  v_audience_source := p_payload ->> 'audience_source';
+  v_audience_filters := COALESCE(p_payload -> 'audience_filters', '{}'::jsonb);
+  v_segment_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'segment_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_template_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'template_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_connection_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'whatsapp_connection_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_media_url := p_payload ->> 'media_url';
+  v_media_type := p_payload ->> 'media_type';
+  v_scheduled_at := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'scheduled_at', '')::timestamptz;
+  v_schedule_timezone := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'schedule_timezone', ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_window_start := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_window_start', '')::time;
+  v_window_end := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_window_end', '')::time;
+  v_business_hours_only := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'business_hours_only')::boolean, false);
+  v_respect_suppression := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'respect_suppression')::boolean, true);
+  v_confirm_consent := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'confirm_consent')::boolean, false);
+  v_draft_step := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'draft_step', '')::integer, 1);
+  v_owner := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'owner', '')::uuid;
+  v_template_version_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'template_version_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_requested_status := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'status', '');
+
+  -- X057b: lista ORDENADA de segmentos lida do MESMO payload. O primeiro vira
+  -- talkx_campaigns.segment_id, por compatibilidade com quem l√™ a coluna √∫nica.
+  IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload -> 'segment_ids') = 'array' THEN
+    BEGIN
+      SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(requested.value::uuid), ARRAY[]::uuid[])
+        INTO v_segment_ids
+        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_payload -> 'segment_ids') AS requested(value);
+    EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END;
+    IF cardinality(v_segment_ids) > 0 THEN
+      -- Se o cliente legado enviar segment_id junto com segment_ids, a lista
+      -- ordenada vence para manter a coluna unica alinhada ao snapshot.
+      v_segment_id := v_segment_ids[1];
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X032: base legal e carimbo do operador que confirmou. A confirmacao so e gravada
+  -- quando o operador marca o checkbox (confirm_consent); desmarcar limpa o carimbo.
+  -- O carimbo original e preservado mais abaixo (update), quando ja existia.
+  v_legal_basis := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_payload ->> 'legal_basis', '')), '');
+  IF v_confirm_consent THEN
+    v_consent_by := v_actor_profile_id;
+    v_consent_at := v_now;
+  ELSE
+    v_consent_by := NULL;
+    v_consent_at := NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: ritmo derivado do perfil (clamp na faixa) em vez dos valores crus.
+  SELECT * INTO v_pace FROM public.talkx_resolve_speed_pace(
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'speed_profile', ''),
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_interval_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_interval_max', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'typing_delay_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'typing_delay_max', '')::integer
+  );
+  v_speed_profile := v_pace.speed_profile;
+  v_send_interval_min := v_pace.send_interval_min;
+  v_send_interval_max := v_pace.send_interval_max;
+  v_typing_delay_min := v_pace.typing_delay_min;
+  v_typing_delay_max := v_pace.typing_delay_max;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute (nulo = usa o padr√£o do setting; acima do teto -> 22023).
+  v_max_per_minute := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'max_per_minute', '')::smallint;
+
+  -- Unifica√ß√£o owner √ó responsible_id: owner √© o √öNICO respons√°vel.
+  IF v_owner IS NULL THEN
+    v_owner := v_actor_profile_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X017: recusa desmarcar a supress√£o.
+  IF v_respect_suppression IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_respect_suppression_false_nao_liberado' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_name IS NULL OR length(v_name) > 200
+     OR v_objective IS NULL OR v_audience_source IS NULL
+     OR length(v_message_template) > 4096
+     OR (v_description IS NOT NULL AND length(v_description) > 4000)
+     OR v_objective NOT IN ('vendas', 'engajamento', 'reativacao', 'relacionamento', 'pesquisa', 'institucional')
+     OR v_audience_source NOT IN ('contacts', 'segment', 'crm360')
+     OR jsonb_typeof(v_audience_filters) <> 'object'
+     OR (v_audience_source = 'segment' AND v_segment_id IS NULL)
+     OR (v_audience_source <> 'segment' AND v_segment_id IS NOT NULL)
+     -- X057b: 1 a 10 segmentos, sem repeti√ß√£o (a repeti√ß√£o quebraria a PK e a
+     -- UNIQUE (campaign_id, position) de talkx_campaign_segments).
+     OR (v_segment_ids IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(v_segment_ids) < 1 OR cardinality(v_segment_ids) > 10))
+     OR (v_segment_ids IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(v_segment_ids) <> (SELECT count(DISTINCT distintos.x) FROM unnest(v_segment_ids) AS distintos(x)))
+     OR v_send_interval_min > v_send_interval_max
+     OR v_typing_delay_min > v_typing_delay_max
+     OR v_speed_profile NOT IN ('slow', 'moderate', 'fast')
+     OR (v_media_url IS NOT NULL AND (length(v_media_url) > 8192 OR v_media_url !~ '^https://'))
+     OR (v_media_type IS NOT NULL AND v_media_type NOT IN ('image', 'video', 'document', 'audio'))
+     OR ((v_media_url IS NULL) <> (v_media_type IS NULL))
+     OR public.is_valid_talkx_schedule_timezone(v_schedule_timezone) IS NOT TRUE
+     OR ((v_window_start IS NULL) <> (v_window_end IS NULL))
+     OR (v_window_start IS NOT NULL AND v_window_start >= v_window_end)
+     OR (v_legal_basis IS NOT NULL AND v_legal_basis NOT IN ('consent', 'legitimate_interest', 'contract'))
+     OR (v_draft_step < 1 OR v_draft_step > 4)
+     OR (v_requested_status IS NOT NULL AND v_requested_status <> 'draft')
+     OR (v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL AND v_max_per_minute < 1) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X057b: s√≥ segmento existente e `active` entra na lista (a lista expl√≠cita √©
+  -- recusada; o segment_id avulso legado continua tolerado como antes).
+  IF v_segment_ids IS NOT NULL THEN
+    IF EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1
+        FROM unnest(v_segment_ids) AS pedido(segment_id)
+       WHERE NOT EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1
+           FROM public.talkx_segments AS segment
+          WHERE segment.id = pedido.segment_id
+            AND segment.status = 'active'
+       )
+    ) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    v_segment_rows := v_segment_ids;
+  ELSIF v_segment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_segment_rows := ARRAY[v_segment_id];
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute acima do teto por minuto da conex√£o -> 22023.
+  IF v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL
+     AND v_max_per_minute > COALESCE((SELECT (settings.value)::text::integer
+                                        FROM public.talkx_settings settings
+                                       WHERE settings.key = 'max_per_minute_per_connection'), 6) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_max_per_minute_acima_do_teto' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_connection_id IS NOT NULL
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+         FROM public.whatsapp_connections connection
+        WHERE connection.id = v_connection_id
+          AND connection.status = 'connected'
+          AND NULLIF(btrim(connection.instance_id), '') IS NOT NULL
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
+    IF p_creation_key IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_key_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaigns (
+      name, message_template, description, objective, audience_source,
+      audience_filters, segment_id, template_id, whatsapp_connection_id,
+      media_url, media_type, scheduled_at, schedule_timezone,
+      send_window_start, send_window_end, business_hours_only, speed_profile,
+      typing_delay_min, typing_delay_max, send_interval_min, send_interval_max,
+      max_per_minute,
+      respect_suppression, confirm_consent, legal_basis, consent_confirmed_by, consent_confirmed_at,
+      draft_step, owner, template_version_id,
+      status, created_by, draft_creation_key, revision, created_at, updated_at
+    ) VALUES (
+      v_name, v_message_template, v_description, v_objective, v_audience_source,
+      v_audience_filters, v_segment_id, v_template_id, v_connection_id,
+      v_media_url, v_media_type, v_scheduled_at, v_schedule_timezone,
+      v_window_start, v_window_end, v_business_hours_only, v_speed_profile,
+      v_typing_delay_min, v_typing_delay_max, v_send_interval_min, v_send_interval_max,
+      v_max_per_minute,
+      v_respect_suppression, v_confirm_consent, v_legal_basis, v_consent_by, v_consent_at,
+      v_draft_step, v_owner, v_template_version_id,
+      'draft', v_actor_profile_id, p_creation_key, 1, v_now, v_now
+    )
+    ON CONFLICT (created_by, draft_creation_key) WHERE draft_creation_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
+    RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+    IF FOUND THEN
+      -- X057b: a lista ordenada acompanha a criacao, na mesma transacao.
+      PERFORM public.talkx_sync_campaign_segments(v_campaign.id, v_segment_rows);
+      RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, false;
+      RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+      FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     WHERE campaign.created_by = v_actor_profile_id
+       AND campaign.draft_creation_key = p_creation_key
+     FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_recovery_failed' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_campaign.name IS DISTINCT FROM v_name
+       OR v_campaign.message_template IS DISTINCT FROM v_message_template
+       OR v_campaign.description IS DISTINCT FROM v_description
+       OR v_campaign.objective IS DISTINCT FROM v_objective
+       OR v_campaign.audience_source IS DISTINCT FROM v_audience_source
+       OR v_campaign.audience_filters IS DISTINCT FROM v_audience_filters
+       OR v_campaign.segment_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_segment_id
+       -- X057b: a lista inteira entra na comparacao de replay (so quando veio expl√≠cita).
+       OR (v_segment_ids IS NOT NULL AND (
+            SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(cs.segment_id ORDER BY cs.position), ARRAY[]::uuid[])
+              FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments cs
+             WHERE cs.campaign_id = v_campaign.id
+          ) IS DISTINCT FROM v_segment_ids)
+       OR v_campaign.template_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_template_id
+       OR v_campaign.whatsapp_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_connection_id
+       OR v_campaign.media_url IS DISTINCT FROM v_media_url
+       OR v_campaign.media_type IS DISTINCT FROM v_media_type
+       OR v_campaign.scheduled_at IS DISTINCT FROM v_scheduled_at
+       OR v_campaign.schedule_timezone IS DISTINCT FROM v_schedule_timezone
+       OR v_campaign.send_window_start IS DISTINCT FROM v_window_start
+       OR v_campaign.send_window_end IS DISTINCT FROM v_window_end
+       OR v_campaign.business_hours_only IS DISTINCT FROM v_business_hours_only
+       OR v_campaign.respect_suppression IS DISTINCT FROM v_respect_suppression
+       OR v_campaign.confirm_consent IS DISTINCT FROM v_confirm_consent
+       OR v_campaign.legal_basis IS DISTINCT FROM v_legal_basis
+       OR (v_campaign.consent_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM v_confirm_consent
+       OR v_campaign.draft_step IS DISTINCT FROM v_draft_step
+       OR v_campaign.owner IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner
+       OR v_campaign.template_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_template_version_id
+       OR v_campaign.speed_profile IS DISTINCT FROM v_speed_profile
+       OR v_campaign.typing_delay_min IS DISTINCT FROM v_typing_delay_min
+       OR v_campaign.typing_delay_max IS DISTINCT FROM v_typing_delay_max
+       OR v_campaign.send_interval_min IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_interval_min
+       OR v_campaign.send_interval_max IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_interval_max
+       OR v_campaign.max_per_minute IS DISTINCT FROM v_max_per_minute THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_key_payload_conflict' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, true;
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_expected_revision IS NULL OR p_expected_revision < 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_expected_revision_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+   FOR UPDATE;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_profile_id
+     AND COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.status NOT IN ('draft', 'scheduled') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_editable' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X032: nao "piscar" o carimbo ‚Äî se ja havia confirmacao, mantem o autor/instante originais.
+  IF v_confirm_consent AND v_campaign.consent_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_consent_by := v_campaign.consent_confirmed_by;
+    v_consent_at := v_campaign.consent_confirmed_at;
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     SET name = v_name,
+         message_template = v_message_template,
+         description = v_description,
+         objective = v_objective,
+         audience_source = v_audience_source,
+         audience_filters = v_audience_filters,
+         segment_id = v_segment_id,
+         template_id = v_template_id,
+         whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id,
+         media_url = v_media_url,
+         media_type = v_media_type,
+         scheduled_at = v_scheduled_at,
+         schedule_timezone = v_schedule_timezone,
+         send_window_start = v_window_start,
+         send_window_end = v_window_end,
+         business_hours_only = v_business_hours_only,
+         respect_suppression = v_respect_suppression,
+         confirm_consent = v_confirm_consent,
+         legal_basis = v_legal_basis,
+         consent_confirmed_by = v_consent_by,
+         consent_confirmed_at = v_consent_at,
+         draft_step = v_draft_step,
+         owner = v_owner,
+         template_version_id = v_template_version_id,
+         speed_profile = v_speed_profile,
+         typing_delay_min = v_typing_delay_min,
+         typing_delay_max = v_typing_delay_max,
+         send_interval_min = v_send_interval_min,
+         send_interval_max = v_send_interval_max,
+         max_per_minute = v_max_per_minute,
+         status = COALESCE(v_requested_status, campaign.status),
+         revision = campaign.revision + 1,
+         updated_at = v_now
+   WHERE campaign.id = v_campaign.id
+   RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+  -- X057b: o rascunho foi gravado; a lista ordenada de segmentos entra na mesma transacao.
+  PERFORM public.talkx_sync_campaign_segments(v_campaign.id, v_segment_rows);
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, false;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.save_talkx_campaign_draft(uuid, bigint, uuid, jsonb)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.save_talkx_campaign_draft(uuid, bigint, uuid, jsonb)
+  TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.save_talkx_campaign_draft(uuid, bigint, uuid, jsonb) IS
+  'Talk X (X057b + X018 + X032): grava rascunho com ritmo derivado do perfil, consentimento e a lista ORDENADA de segmentos (payload.segment_ids, 1..10, active) em talkx_campaign_segments, mantendo segment_id = primeiro.';
+
+-- (a2) talkx_sync_campaign_segments: substitui a lista do rascunho sem duplicar
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Helper da RPC acima. Idempotente por natureza (DELETE + INSERT na mesma
+-- transacao): o UNIQUE (campaign_id, position) da tabela e o que garante a
+-- unicidade, nao uma consulta previa. Segmento inexistente e ignorado para nao
+-- romper a FK do caminho legado (segment_id avulso, sem a lista expl√≠cita).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_sync_campaign_segments(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_segment_ids uuid[]
+)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  DELETE FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments
+   WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id;
+
+  IF p_segment_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_segment_ids) = 0 THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaign_segments (campaign_id, segment_id, position, status)
+  SELECT p_campaign_id, pedido.segment_id, pedido.ord::smallint, 'pending'
+    FROM unnest(p_segment_ids) WITH ORDINALITY AS pedido(segment_id, ord)
+   WHERE EXISTS (
+     SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_segments AS segment WHERE segment.id = pedido.segment_id
+   );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_sync_campaign_segments(uuid, uuid[])
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_sync_campaign_segments(uuid, uuid[])
+  TO service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talkx_sync_campaign_segments(uuid, uuid[]) IS
+  'Talk X (X057b): substitui, na mesma transacao, a lista ORDENADA de segmentos de uma campanha (position 1..n, status pending) em talkx_campaign_segments. Helper de save_talkx_campaign_draft.';
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- (b) snapshot_talkx_campaign_audience ‚Äî corpo vivo 20261002421230 + ordem/dedupe
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.snapshot_talkx_campaign_audience(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_expected_revision bigint
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_actor_profile_id uuid;
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_rules jsonb := '{"groups":[]}'::jsonb;
+  v_contact_ids uuid[] := NULL;
+  v_respect boolean;
+  v_seg_list uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[];
+  v_rule_list jsonb[] := ARRAY[]::jsonb[];
+  v_eligible bigint := 0;
+  v_suppressed bigint := 0;
+  v_skipped_invalid bigint := 0;
+  v_ids uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[];
+  v_seg_by_id uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[];
+  v_count integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_actor_profile_id
+    FROM public.profiles AS profile
+   WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+     AND profile.is_active = true
+   LIMIT 1
+   FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_actor_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X014: gerar destinatarios e ato de admin/supervisor.
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_audience_snapshot' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS campaign
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+   FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_profile_id
+     AND COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.status NOT IN ('draft', 'scheduled') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_recipients_locked' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
+  END IF;
+  -- Revisao otimista: o snapshot so vale para a revisao que acabou de ser salva.
+  IF p_expected_revision IS NULL OR v_campaign.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X057b: a lista de regras, uma por segmento, na ORDEM de position.
+  IF v_campaign.audience_source = 'segment' THEN
+    SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(src.segment_id ORDER BY src.position), ARRAY[]::uuid[]),
+           COALESCE(array_agg(src.rules ORDER BY src.position), ARRAY[]::jsonb[])
+      INTO v_seg_list, v_rule_list
+      FROM (
+        SELECT cs.position,
+               cs.segment_id,
+               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(segment.rules) = 'object'
+                    THEN segment.rules ELSE '{"groups":[]}'::jsonb END AS rules
+          FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments AS cs
+          LEFT JOIN public.talkx_segments AS segment ON segment.id = cs.segment_id
+         WHERE cs.campaign_id = v_campaign.id
+        UNION ALL
+        -- Compatibilidade: campanha de segmento unico ainda sem linhas na tabela
+        -- nova (position 0, logo a primeira) resolve pela coluna segment_id.
+        SELECT 0 AS position,
+               v_campaign.segment_id,
+               COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(segundo.rules) = 'object'
+                                     THEN segundo.rules ELSE '{"groups":[]}'::jsonb END
+                           FROM public.talkx_segments AS segundo
+                          WHERE segundo.id = v_campaign.segment_id), '{"groups":[]}'::jsonb) AS rules
+         WHERE v_campaign.segment_id IS NOT NULL
+           AND NOT EXISTS (
+             SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments AS existente
+              WHERE existente.campaign_id = v_campaign.id
+           )
+      ) AS src;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF cardinality(v_seg_list) = 0 THEN
+    -- Origem contacts/crm360 (ou campanha de segmento sem nenhum segmento): regras
+    -- do proprio rascunho mais a selecao manual do passo 1 (X017).
+    v_rules := COALESCE(v_campaign.audience_filters, '{}'::jsonb);
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_rules) <> 'object' THEN
+      v_rules := '{}'::jsonb;
+    END IF;
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_campaign.audience_filters -> 'contact_ids') = 'array' THEN
+      BEGIN
+        SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(requested.value::uuid), ARRAY[]::uuid[])
+          INTO v_contact_ids
+          FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_campaign.audience_filters -> 'contact_ids') AS requested(value);
+      EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_audience_snapshot' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END;
+    END IF;
+    v_seg_list := ARRAY[NULL::uuid];
+    v_rule_list := ARRAY[v_rules];
+  END IF;
+
+  v_respect := COALESCE(v_campaign.respect_suppression, true);
+
+  -- X057b: uma avaliacao do motor (X016) POR segmento; cada contato fica com o
+  -- PRIMEIRO segmento (menor position) que o contem, sem repetir contato.
+  WITH seg AS (
+    SELECT lista.ord AS position, lista.seg_id AS segment_id, lista.rules
+      FROM unnest(v_seg_list, v_rule_list) WITH ORDINALITY AS lista(seg_id, rules, ord)
+  ),
+  base AS (
+    SELECT seg.position,
+           seg.segment_id,
+           q.id,
+           (NOT q.legacy_or_deleted AND NOT q.invalid_phone AND NOT q.is_suppressed) AS eligible,
+           (NOT q.legacy_or_deleted AND NOT q.invalid_phone AND q.is_suppressed) AS suppressed,
+           (q.legacy_or_deleted OR q.invalid_phone) AS skipped_invalid
+      FROM seg
+      JOIN LATERAL public.talkx_audience_query(seg.rules, v_contact_ids, v_respect) AS q ON true
+  ),
+  ranked AS (
+    SELECT b.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.id ORDER BY b.position) AS rn
+      FROM base AS b
+  )
+  SELECT count(DISTINCT ranked.id) FILTER (WHERE ranked.eligible),
+         count(DISTINCT ranked.id) FILTER (WHERE ranked.suppressed),
+         count(DISTINCT ranked.id) FILTER (WHERE ranked.skipped_invalid),
+         COALESCE(array_agg(ranked.id ORDER BY ranked.position, ranked.id) FILTER (WHERE ranked.eligible AND ranked.rn = 1), ARRAY[]::uuid[]),
+         COALESCE(array_agg(ranked.segment_id ORDER BY ranked.position, ranked.id) FILTER (WHERE ranked.eligible AND ranked.rn = 1), ARRAY[]::uuid[])
+    INTO v_eligible, v_suppressed, v_skipped_invalid, v_ids, v_seg_by_id
+    FROM ranked;
+
+  -- Mesma GUC transacional do replace_talkx_draft_recipients: e o que autoriza os
+  -- gatilhos de talkx_recipients/talkx_campaigns nesta transacao.
+  PERFORM set_config('app.talkx_recipient_snapshot_write', 'on', true);
+
+  DELETE FROM public.talkx_recipients
+   WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_recipients (campaign_id, contact_id, segment_id)
+  SELECT p_campaign_id, destinatario.contact_id, destinatario.segment_id
+    FROM unnest(v_ids, v_seg_by_id) AS destinatario(contact_id, segment_id);
+
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns
+     SET total_recipients = v_count,
+         audience_snapshot_at = statement_timestamp(),
+         updated_at = statement_timestamp()
+   WHERE id = p_campaign_id;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'eligible', v_eligible,
+    'suppressed', v_suppressed,
+    'skipped_invalid', v_skipped_invalid
+  );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.snapshot_talkx_campaign_audience(uuid, bigint)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.snapshot_talkx_campaign_audience(uuid, bigint)
+  TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.snapshot_talkx_campaign_audience(uuid, bigint) IS
+  'Talk X (X057b + X017): gera talkx_recipients/total_recipients/audience_snapshot_at a partir do proprio rascunho; resolve os segmentos NA ORDEM de position e grava em cada destinatario o PRIMEIRO segmento que o contem, sem duplicar contato. Devolve {eligible, suppressed, skipped_invalid}. Exige admin/supervisor (42501) e a revisao atual (40001).';

+-- Retencao: mantem as 20 ultimas revisoes de cada segmento -----------------------
+create or replace function public.talkx_segment_versions_trim()
+returns trigger
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $$
+begin
+  delete from public.talkx_segment_versions
+   where segment_id = new.segment_id
+     and version_no not in (
+       select version_no
+         from public.talkx_segment_versions
+        where segment_id = new.segment_id
+        order by version_no desc
+        limit 20
+     );
+  return null;
+end;
+$$;

+-- 5. Guarda de uso: arquivar/inativar/excluir segmento em uso --------------------
+-- N22: excluir segmento virou ARQUIVAR (reversivel). A guarda protege o caso que doi:
+-- o segmento que uma campanha agendada/em envio/pausada ainda vai usar nao sai de cena.
+-- Le as DUAS formas de uso da campanha: a coluna talkx_campaigns.segment_id (campanha de
+-- um segmento) e a lista talkx_campaign_segments (X057, campanha com varios segmentos).
+create or replace function public.talkx_segment_block_in_use()
+returns trigger
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $$
+declare
+  v_segment_id      uuid;
+  v_saindo_de_cena  boolean;
+  v_campaign_name   text;
+  v_campaign_status text;
+begin
+  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
+    v_segment_id     := old.id;
+    v_saindo_de_cena := true;
+  else
+    v_segment_id := new.id;
+    -- so barrar o ATO de sair de cena: arquivar agora ou inativar agora. Renomear,
+    -- marcar favorito ou gravar rascunho de um segmento ja arquivado seguem livres.
+    v_saindo_de_cena := (new.archived_at is not null and old.archived_at is null)
+                     or (new.status = 'inactive' and old.status is distinct from 'inactive');
+    if not v_saindo_de_cena then
+      return new;
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  select c.name, c.status
+    into v_campaign_name, v_campaign_status
+    from public.talkx_campaigns c
+   where c.status in ('scheduled','sending','paused')
+     and (
+       c.segment_id = v_segment_id
+       or exists (
+         select 1 from public.talkx_campaign_segments cs
+          where cs.campaign_id = c.id
+            and cs.segment_id  = v_segment_id
+       )
+     )
+   order by c.created_at
+   limit 1;
+
+  if v_campaign_name is not null then
+    raise exception
+      'talkx_segment_in_use: o segmento % esta em uso pela campanha "%" (%) e nao pode ser arquivado, inativado nem excluido',
+      v_segment_id, v_campaign_name, v_campaign_status
+      using errcode = 'P0001';
+  end if;
+
+  return case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old else new end;
+end;
+$$;
+comment on function public.talkx_segment_block_in_use() is
+  'Talk X (X101): guarda de uso ‚Äî recusa arquivar, inativar ou excluir segmento usado por campanha scheduled/sending/paused, devolvendo o nome da campanha (decisao N22).';
+
+-- funcao de gatilho: quem dispara e o proprio DML (o EXECUTE nao e concedido a ninguem)
+revoke execute on function public.talkx_segment_block_in_use() from public, anon, authenticated;
+
+drop trigger if exists talkx_segments_usage_guard on public.talkx_segments;
+create trigger talkx_segments_usage_guard
+  before update or delete on public.talkx_segments
+  for each row execute function public.talkx_segment_block_in_use();

+-- (02) require_contact_edit_permission era o unico caminho que dizia, em texto, se o uuid EXISTE:
+--      'contact not found: <uuid>' (inexistente) x 'contact_not_authorized' (existe, fora do alcance).
+--      Agora ha UM unico ponto de recusa: uuid inexistente e uuid fora do alcance levantam a MESMA
+--      excecao -- mesmo texto ('contact_not_authorized'), mesmo SQLSTATE (42501), mesmo ponto/contexto
+--      -- e o id NAO entra na mensagem. Quem PODE editar o contato nao muda em nada.
+--
+--      Mesmo defeito, mesmo arquivo, outro ponto de entrada: set_conversation_status levantava
+--      'contact not found: <uuid>' ANTES de delegar a require_contact_edit_permission -- o mesmo
+--      oraculo por outra RPC que tambem tem EXECUTE para `authenticated` (e que chega la antes de
+--      qualquer checagem de permissao). Corrigido aqui tambem: a delegacao passa a ser o UNICO ponto
+--      de recusa tambem para o chamador comum. Nao sobrou outro ponto que devolva texto diferente
+--      para uuid inexistente no modulo Contatos: delete_contact/delete_contacts ja unificam em
+--      'Contato nao encontrado ou sem permissao para excluir.'.
+--
+-- (03) can_delete_contacts devolvia linha (can_delete=false) para contato que o chamador NAO pode ver:
+--      a EXISTENCIA da linha ja era a resposta do oraculo. O predicado de alcance passa para o WHERE
+--      -- contato fora do alcance (ou inexistente, ou ja excluido) nao retorna linha, exatamente como
+--      o COMMENT da funcao ja prometia.
+--
+--      Nao ha perda para a UI: a lista (search_contacts) e a policy de SELECT de public.contacts usam
+--      o MESMO predicado can_edit_contact, entao contato que aparece na lista do usuario e sempre
+--      can_delete=true; e useContactsSearch -> ContactService.getDeletableContacts so manda os ids
+--      que ja vieram da lista visivel.
+--
+-- Sem BEGIN/COMMIT de topo: o gateway aplica a migration numa unica transacao (a atomicidade e
+-- preservada) -- a correcao toda e um unico conjunto de CREATE OR REPLACE.
+-- ====================================================================================================
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_contact_edit_permission(p_contact_id uuid)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_assigned_to uuid;
+  v_queue_id    uuid;
+  v_profile_id  uuid;
+  v_is_admin    boolean;
+  v_visible     uuid[];
+  v_encontrado  boolean;
+BEGIN
+  IF public.is_privileged_contact_caller() THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT assigned_to, queue_id INTO v_assigned_to, v_queue_id
+  FROM public.contacts
+  WHERE id = p_contact_id;
+  v_encontrado := FOUND;
+
+  v_profile_id := public.get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid());
+  v_is_admin   := public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid());
+
+  SELECT array_agg(ids.agent_id) INTO v_visible
+  FROM public.get_visible_agent_ids(auth.uid()) AS ids(agent_id);
+
+  -- (SEC-RLS-02) UM UNICO ponto de recusa: "uuid inexistente" (v_encontrado = false) e "uuid
+  -- existente fora do alcance" levantam a MESMA excecao -- mesmo texto, mesmo SQLSTATE (42501) e
+  -- mesmo ponto do codigo (o contexto do erro nao distingue os dois casos) -- e o id nao e ecoado.
+  IF NOT (v_encontrado
+          AND (v_is_admin
+               OR public.can_edit_contact(v_assigned_to, v_queue_id, v_visible, v_profile_id, v_is_admin))) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_conversation_status(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_next       text,
+  p_reason     text DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_current    TEXT;
+  v_encontrado boolean;
+  v_allowed    BOOLEAN := FALSE;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT conversation_status INTO v_current
+  FROM public.contacts
+  WHERE id = p_contact_id
+  FOR UPDATE;
+  v_encontrado := FOUND;
+
+  -- Autorizacao (e, para o chamador comum, tambem a EXISTENCIA) em UM unico ponto. Antes da
+  -- correcao, esta RPC levantava 'contact not found: <uuid>' aqui -- o mesmo oraculo de UUID do
+  -- SEC-RLS-02 por outro caminho (SEC-RLS-02: qualquer `authenticated` enumera contatos).
+  PERFORM public.require_contact_edit_permission(p_contact_id);
+
+  -- Chamador privilegiado (service_role/postgres/cron): require_contact_edit_permission nao checa
+  -- existencia, entao a inexistencia e recusada com a MESMA excecao de autorizacao -- nada aqui
+  -- distingue "nao existe" de "nao posso ver".
+  IF NOT v_encontrado THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- No-op idempotente: ja esta no estado desejado (o no-op VEM DEPOIS da autorizacao: um chamador
+  -- sem permissao nao pode inferir o estado atual do contato pelo silencio da RPC).
+  IF v_current = p_next THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_current = 'open'     AND p_next IN ('waiting', 'resolved', 'archived') THEN v_allowed := TRUE; END IF;
+  IF v_current = 'waiting'  AND p_next IN ('open', 'resolved')                THEN v_allowed := TRUE; END IF;
+  IF v_current = 'resolved' AND p_next IN ('open', 'archived')                THEN v_allowed := TRUE; END IF;
+  IF v_current = 'archived' AND p_next = 'open'                               THEN v_allowed := TRUE; END IF;
+
+  IF NOT v_allowed THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid transition % -> %', v_current, p_next;
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.contacts
+  SET conversation_status            = p_next,
+      conversation_status_changed_at = NOW()
+  WHERE id = p_contact_id;
+
+  IF p_next = 'resolved' THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.conversation_closures (contact_id, close_reason)
+    VALUES (p_contact_id, COALESCE(p_reason, 'resolved'))
+    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
+  END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_delete_contacts(p_ids uuid[])
+ RETURNS TABLE(contact_id uuid, can_delete boolean)
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT c.id,
+         public.can_edit_contact(
+           c.assigned_to,
+           c.queue_id,
+           (SELECT array_agg(v) FROM public.get_visible_agent_ids(auth.uid()) v),
+           (SELECT public.get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid())),
+           (SELECT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()))
+         )
+  FROM public.contacts c
+  WHERE c.id = ANY(p_ids)
+    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
+    -- (SEC-RLS-03) O predicado de alcance entra no WHERE: contato fora do alcance (ou inexistente,
+    -- ou ja excluido) NAO retorna linha -- a existencia da linha deixa de ser a resposta do oraculo.
+    -- O can_delete do SELECT ja e sempre true nas linhas que sobram (mesmo predicado).
+    AND public.can_edit_contact(
+          c.assigned_to,
+          c.queue_id,
+          (SELECT array_agg(v) FROM public.get_visible_agent_ids(auth.uid()) v),
+          (SELECT public.get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid())),
+          (SELECT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()))
+        )
+$function$;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.can_delete_contacts(uuid[]) IS
+  'Para cada id informado, se o chamador pode excluir o contato (mesmo predicado de can_edit_contact). Contatos inexistentes, ja excluidos OU fora do alcance do chamador nao retornam linha (a existencia da linha nao revela contato invisivel). Alimenta o gate do item "Excluir" na UI do modulo Contatos.';
+
+-- ACL pela ASSINATURA exata (CREATE OR REPLACE preserva a ACL: estas linhas reconfirmam o contrato de
+-- cada assinatura e NAO concedem nada novo).
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.require_contact_edit_permission(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.require_contact_edit_permission(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.can_delete_contacts(uuid[]) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.can_delete_contacts(uuid[]) TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- a ORIGEM da mensagem (sender) passa a ser do banco, nao do cliente. O papel
+-- autenticado nao insere linha com sender='contact' (mensagem de cliente
+-- forjada) nem troca a origem de uma linha existente.
+--
+-- Estado anterior (as duas policies de `messages`, nenhuma olhava `sender`):
+--   - INSERT "Users can insert messages", corpo de
+--     20260925120000_fix_messages_insert_rls_contact_visibility.sql: validava
+--     agent_id e contato visivel; a coluna so tem CHECK (sender IN
+--     ('agent','contact')) ‚Äî as duas origens passavam.
+--   - UPDATE "Users can update messages from their assigned contacts", USING de
+--     20260925223000_messages_update_policy_queue_parity.sql e SEM WITH CHECK:
+--     o Postgres usa a propria USING no registro novo, que so fala de contato
+--     visivel ‚Äî nem a origem, nem o contato do novo registro eram conferidos.
+--
+-- O que esta migration muda (so `messages` e duas policies + 1 helper):
+--   1. INSERT: exige sender='agent' para o chamador comum. O ramo
+--      public.is_privileged_contact_caller() mantem a ingestao inbound
+--      (service_role/cron/postgres) e o ramo de admin/supervisor segue valendo.
+--   2. UPDATE: WITH CHECK explicito. A visibilidade do registro NOVO passa a ser
+--      conferida (antes so a do antigo) e a origem fica PINada:
+--      sender IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.message_sender_atual(messages.id).
+--      O plano pedia `sender = 'agent'` aqui; medido, ele nao fecha o vetor e
+--      quebra o uso legitimo: (a) aceita virar mensagem de ENTRADA em resposta

+--      falso; e (b) recusa "marcar como lido" de mensagem de entrada, que o
+--      inbox faz direto pelo REST (src/services/chat.service.ts:101,

+--   3. public.message_sender_atual(uuid): helper STABLE SECURITY DEFINER que

+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can insert messages" ON public.messages;

+CREATE POLICY "Users can insert messages" ON public.messages
+FOR INSERT
+TO authenticated
+WITH CHECK (
+  public.is_privileged_contact_caller()
+  OR (
+    sender = 'agent'
+    AND (
+      is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+      OR (
+        (agent_id IS NULL OR agent_id IN (SELECT profiles.id FROM profiles WHERE profiles.user_id = auth.uid()))

+            WHERE c.id = messages.contact_id

+-- ============================================================================
+-- (2) a medicao de um mes, por escopo do chamador
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_library_month(
+  p_month_start date,
+  p_timezone    text DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo'
+)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  total_segments  integer,
+  active_segments integer,
+  crm360_segments integer,
+  deliveries      integer,
+  conversions     integer
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_tz   text        := coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_timezone, '')), ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_from timestamptz;
+  v_to   timestamptz;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_month_start IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_segment_library_month: p_month_start e obrigatorio' USING ERRCODE = '22004';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Inicio e fim do mes no fuso pedido (fuso invalido estoura, nao chuta).
+  v_from := (p_month_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz);
+  v_to   := ((p_month_start + interval '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz);
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+  WITH camp AS (
+    -- Campanhas COM SEGMENTO que iniciaram envio na janela (rascunho fora:
+    -- started_at nulo). Vale o segmento unico (segment_id) e a lista de X057.
+    SELECT c.id
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS c
+    WHERE c.started_at IS NOT NULL
+      AND c.started_at >= v_from
+      AND c.started_at <  v_to
+      AND (
+        c.segment_id IS NOT NULL
+        OR EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments AS cs
+          WHERE cs.campaign_id = c.id
+        )
+      )
+  )
+  SELECT
+    -- estoque no fim do mes (no mes corrente, v_to esta no futuro = tudo o que existe)
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_segments AS s
+      WHERE s.created_at < v_to)::integer,
+    -- uso real no mes
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_segments AS s
+      WHERE EXISTS (
+              SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS c
+              WHERE c.segment_id = s.id
+                AND c.started_at IS NOT NULL
+                AND c.started_at >= v_from
+                AND c.started_at <  v_to
+            )
+         OR EXISTS (
+              SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments AS cs
+                JOIN public.talkx_campaigns AS c2 ON c2.id = cs.campaign_id
+              WHERE cs.segment_id = s.id
+                AND c2.started_at IS NOT NULL
+                AND c2.started_at >= v_from
+                AND c2.started_at <  v_to
+            ))::integer,
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_segments AS s
+      WHERE s.origin = 'crm360'
+        AND s.created_at < v_to)::integer,
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+       JOIN camp ON camp.id = r.campaign_id
+      WHERE r.delivered_at >= v_from
+        AND r.delivered_at <  v_to)::integer,
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_conversions AS cv
+       JOIN camp ON camp.id = cv.campaign_id
+      WHERE coalesce(cv.occurred_at, cv.created_at) >= v_from
+        AND coalesce(cv.occurred_at, cv.created_at) <  v_to)::integer;
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_library_month(date, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_library_month(date, text) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_library_month(date, text) IS
+  'Talk X (X103): mede UM mes da biblioteca de segmentos no fuso pedido. total_segments/crm360_segments = estoque (created_at < fim do mes); active_segments = uso real (campanha com segmento que iniciou envio no mes); deliveries/conversions das campanhas com segmento. SECURITY INVOKER: o resultado segue a RLS do chamador.';
