+-- ============================================================================
+-- (3) a rotina idempotente do retrato
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_refresh_segment_library_history(
+  p_months   integer DEFAULT 8,
+  p_timezone text    DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo'
+)
+RETURNS integer
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_tz    text    := coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_timezone, '')), ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_today date    := (now() AT TIME ZONE v_tz)::date;
+  v_month date    := date_trunc('month', v_today::timestamp)::date;
+  v_start date;
+  v_end   date;
+  v_day   date;
+  v_row   record;
+  v_saved integer := 0;
+  i       integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_months IS NULL OR p_months < 1 OR p_months > 36 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_refresh_segment_library_history: p_months precisa estar entre 1 e 36'
+      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Do mes mais antigo para o corrente. A chave e o dia: o mes fechado ganha o
+  -- proprio ultimo dia e o mes corrente ganha hoje ‚Äî rodar duas vezes no mesmo
+  -- dia ATUALIZA a mesma linha (idempotente), nunca duplica.
+  FOR i IN REVERSE (p_months - 1) .. 0 LOOP
+    v_start := (v_month - make_interval(months => i))::date;
+    v_end   := (v_start + interval '1 month')::date;
+    v_day   := least(v_end - 1, v_today);
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_row
+    FROM public.talkx_segment_library_month(v_start, v_tz);
+
+    INSERT INTO public.talkx_segment_library_history
+      (counted_on, total_segments, active_segments, crm360_segments,
+       deliveries, conversions, captured_at)
+    VALUES
+      (v_day, v_row.total_segments, v_row.active_segments, v_row.crm360_segments,
+       v_row.deliveries, v_row.conversions, now())
+    ON CONFLICT (counted_on) DO UPDATE
+      SET total_segments  = excluded.total_segments,
+          active_segments = excluded.active_segments,
+          crm360_segments = excluded.crm360_segments,
+          deliveries      = excluded.deliveries,
+          conversions     = excluded.conversions,
+          captured_at     = excluded.captured_at;
+
+    v_saved := v_saved + 1;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  RETURN v_saved;
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+-- Escrita no retrato: so a rotina, e so para o service_role (o job diario).
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_refresh_segment_library_history(integer, text)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_refresh_segment_library_history(integer, text)
+  TO service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talkx_refresh_segment_library_history(integer, text) IS
+  'Talk X (X103): grava/atualiza o retrato da biblioteca dos ultimos p_months meses (1..36, padrao 8) de forma IDEMPOTENTE por dia (ON CONFLICT (counted_on) DO UPDATE). Devolve quantos meses processou. SECURITY INVOKER e EXECUTE so para service_role: o retrato e da biblioteca inteira, nao do escopo de um usuario ‚Äî quem chama e o job diario.';
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- (4) os KPIs da biblioteca
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_library_stats(
+  p_timezone text DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo'
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  -- Base minima de entregues para a conversao media existir. Abaixo dela a
+  -- resposta vem SEM numero (has_data = false e value_pct = null), nunca com
+  -- um percentual inventado.
+  c_min_deliveries constant integer := 100;
+
+  v_tz          text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_timezone, '')), ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_month       date;
+  v_previous    date;
+  v_cur         record;
+  v_prev        record;
+  v_has_current boolean;
+  v_has_prev    boolean;
+  v_value       numeric;
+  v_value_prev  numeric;
+  v_series      jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  v_month    := date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE v_tz)::timestamp)::date;
+  v_previous := (v_month - interval '1 month')::date;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_cur  FROM public.talkx_segment_library_month(v_month, v_tz);
+  SELECT * INTO v_prev FROM public.talkx_segment_library_month(v_previous, v_tz);
+
+  v_has_current := v_cur.deliveries >= c_min_deliveries;
+  v_has_prev    := v_prev.deliveries >= c_min_deliveries;
+
+  IF v_has_current THEN
+    v_value := round(v_cur.conversions::numeric / v_cur.deliveries * 100, 1);
+  END IF;
+  IF v_has_prev THEN
+    v_value_prev := round(v_prev.conversions::numeric / v_prev.deliveries * 100, 1);
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Serie de 8 meses (do mais antigo ao corrente). Cada ponto e o ULTIMO retrato
+  -- gravado para o mes no historico; mes sem retrato vem com has_data = false e
+  -- os numeros nulos ("sem dados ainda" na tela), nunca zeros disfarcados.
+  WITH months AS (
+    SELECT (v_month - make_interval(months => g))::date AS month_start
+    FROM generate_series(7, 0, -1) AS g
+  ),
+  pontos AS (
+    SELECT m.month_start,
+           h.total_segments, h.active_segments, h.crm360_segments,
+           h.deliveries, h.conversions
+    FROM months AS m
+    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT hh.total_segments, hh.active_segments, hh.crm360_segments,
+             hh.deliveries, hh.conversions
+      FROM public.talkx_segment_library_history AS hh
+      WHERE hh.counted_on >= m.month_start
+        AND hh.counted_on <  (m.month_start + interval '1 month')::date
+      ORDER BY hh.counted_on DESC
+      LIMIT 1
+    ) AS h ON TRUE
+    ORDER BY m.month_start
+  )
+  SELECT coalesce(
+           jsonb_agg(
+             jsonb_build_object(
+               'month',           p.month_start,
+               'has_data',        p.total_segments IS NOT NULL,
+               'total_segments',  p.total_segments,
+               'active_segments', p.active_segments,
+               'crm360_segments', p.crm360_segments,
+               'deliveries',      p.deliveries,
+               'conversions',     p.conversions,
+               'conversion_pct',  CASE
+                                    WHEN p.deliveries IS NOT NULL
+                                     AND p.deliveries >= c_min_deliveries
+                                    THEN round(p.conversions::numeric / p.deliveries * 100, 1)
+                                  END
+             ) ORDER BY p.month_start
+           ),
+           '[]'::jsonb
+         )
+    INTO v_series
+    FROM pontos AS p;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'generated_at',          now(),
+    'timezone',              v_tz,
+    'month_start',           v_month,
+    'total_segments',        v_cur.total_segments,
+    'active_this_month',     v_cur.active_segments,
+    'active_previous_month', v_prev.active_segments,
+    'active_delta',          v_cur.active_segments - v_prev.active_segments,
+    'crm360_connected',      v_cur.crm360_segments,
+    'crm360_previous_month', v_prev.crm360_segments,
+    'crm360_delta',          v_cur.crm360_segments - v_prev.crm360_segments,
+    'conversion', jsonb_build_object(
+      'value_pct',            v_value,
+      'previous_pct',         v_value_prev,
+      'delta_pp',             CASE
+                                WHEN v_value IS NOT NULL AND v_value_prev IS NOT NULL
+                                THEN round(v_value - v_value_prev, 1)
+                              END,
+      'has_data',             v_has_current,
+      'deliveries',           v_cur.deliveries,
+      'conversions',          v_cur.conversions,
+      'previous_deliveries',  v_prev.deliveries,
+      'previous_conversions', v_prev.conversions,
+      'min_deliveries',       c_min_deliveries
+    ),
+    'series', v_series
+  );
+END;
+$fn$;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- (a) listagem paginada
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_suppression_list(
+  p_busca     text    DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_origens   text[]  DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_motivos   text[]  DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_campanha  uuid    DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_de        date    DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_ate       date    DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_status    text    DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_ordenacao text    DEFAULT 'data',
+  p_direcao   text    DEFAULT 'desc',
+  p_limite    integer DEFAULT 25,
+  p_offset    integer DEFAULT 0
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid     uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_busca   text;
+  v_limite  integer;
+  v_offset  integer;
+  v_ordem   text;
+  v_direcao text;
+  v_status  text;
+  v_total   integer := 0;
+  v_rows    jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_rec     record;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_suppression_read_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_limite := COALESCE(p_limite, 25);
+  IF v_limite < 1 OR v_limite > 200 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_limit' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_offset := COALESCE(p_offset, 0);
+  IF v_offset < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_offset' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_direcao := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_direcao), ''), 'desc'));
+  IF v_direcao NOT IN ('asc', 'desc') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_direction' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_ordem := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_ordenacao), ''), 'data'));
+  IF v_ordem NOT IN ('contato', 'origem', 'motivo', 'data', 'status') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_sort' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_status := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_status), ''), 'suprimido'));
+  IF v_status NOT IN ('suprimido', 'expirado', 'removido', 'todos') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_status' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_busca := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_busca, '')), '');
+
+  FOR v_rec IN
+    WITH filtrado AS (
+      SELECT b.id,
+             b.contact_id,
+             b.phone,
+             b.origin,
+             b.reason,
+             b.reason_code::text AS reason_code,
+             b.campaign_id,
+             b.created_at,
+             b.expires_at,
+             b.removed_at,
+             c.name AS contact_name,
+             c.email AS contact_email,
+             c.avatar_url AS contact_avatar,
+             COALESCE(c.phone, b.phone) AS telefone,
+             tc.name AS campaign_name,
+             CASE b.reason_code
+               WHEN 'opt_out' THEN 'Opt-out solicitado'
+               WHEN 'invalid_number' THEN 'N√∫mero inv√°lido'
+               WHEN 'manual' THEN 'Bloqueio manual'
+               WHEN 'lgpd' THEN 'LGPD'
+               WHEN 'no_commercial_permission' THEN 'Sem permiss√£o comercial'
+               WHEN 'bounce' THEN 'Mensagem devolvida'
+               ELSE 'N√£o informado'
+             END AS reason_label,
+             CASE b.reason_code
+               WHEN 'opt_out' THEN 'destructive'
+               WHEN 'invalid_number' THEN 'warning'
+               WHEN 'manual' THEN 'info'
+               WHEN 'lgpd' THEN 'primary'
+               WHEN 'no_commercial_permission' THEN 'muted'
+               WHEN 'bounce' THEN 'warning'
+               ELSE 'muted'
+             END AS reason_tone,
+             CASE WHEN b.removed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'removido'
+                  WHEN b.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND b.expires_at <= statement_timestamp() THEN 'expirado'
+                  ELSE 'suprimido'
+             END AS row_status
+        FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+        LEFT JOIN public.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
+        LEFT JOIN public.talkx_campaigns tc ON tc.id = b.campaign_id
+       WHERE (p_origens IS NULL OR b.origin = ANY (p_origens))
+         AND (p_motivos IS NULL OR b.reason_code::text = ANY (p_motivos))
+         AND (p_campanha IS NULL OR b.campaign_id = p_campanha)
+         AND (p_de IS NULL OR b.created_at >= p_de::timestamp with time zone)
+         AND (p_ate IS NULL OR b.created_at < (p_ate + 1)::timestamp with time zone)
+         AND (
+           v_busca IS NULL
+           OR c.name ILIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_busca, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\'
+           OR c.email ILIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_busca, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\'
+           OR (NULLIF(regexp_replace(v_busca, '\D', '', 'g'), '') IS NOT NULL
+               AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(c.phone, b.phone), '\D', '', 'g')
+                   LIKE '%' || regexp_replace(v_busca, '\D', '', 'g') || '%')
+         )
+    ),
+    base AS (
+      SELECT * FROM filtrado f WHERE (v_status = 'todos' OR f.row_status = v_status)
+    )
+    SELECT b.*, count(*) OVER () AS total_count
+      FROM base b
+     ORDER BY
+       CASE WHEN v_ordem <> 'data' AND v_direcao = 'asc' THEN
+         CASE v_ordem
+           WHEN 'contato' THEN lower(b.contact_name)
+           WHEN 'origem'  THEN lower(b.origin)
+           WHEN 'motivo'  THEN lower(b.reason_label)
+           WHEN 'status'  THEN b.row_status
+           ELSE NULL
+         END
+       END ASC NULLS LAST,
+       CASE WHEN v_ordem <> 'data' AND v_direcao = 'desc' THEN
+         CASE v_ordem
+           WHEN 'contato' THEN lower(b.contact_name)
+           WHEN 'origem'  THEN lower(b.origin)
+           WHEN 'motivo'  THEN lower(b.reason_label)
+           WHEN 'status'  THEN b.row_status
+           ELSE NULL
+         END
+       END DESC NULLS LAST,
+       CASE WHEN v_ordem = 'data' AND v_direcao = 'asc' THEN b.created_at END ASC NULLS LAST,
+       CASE WHEN v_ordem = 'data' AND v_direcao = 'desc' THEN b.created_at END DESC NULLS LAST,
+       b.id DESC
+     LIMIT v_limite OFFSET v_offset
+  LOOP
+    v_total := v_rec.total_count;
+    v_rows := v_rows || jsonb_build_object(
+      'id',             v_rec.id,
+      'contact_id',     v_rec.contact_id,
+      'contact_name',   v_rec.contact_name,
+      'contact_email',  v_rec.contact_email,
+      'contact_avatar', v_rec.contact_avatar,
+      'phone',          v_rec.telefone,
+      'origin',         v_rec.origin,
+      'reason_code',    v_rec.reason_code,
+      'reason_label',   v_rec.reason_label,
+      'reason_tone',    v_rec.reason_tone,
+      'reason',         v_rec.reason,
+      'campaign_id',    v_rec.campaign_id,
+      'campaign_name',  v_rec.campaign_name,
+      'created_at',     v_rec.created_at,
+      'expires_at',     v_rec.expires_at,
+      'removed_at',     v_rec.removed_at,
+      'status',         v_rec.row_status
+    );
+  END LOOP;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('total', v_total, 'rows', v_rows);
+END;
+$fn$;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- (b) KPIs: valor, valor do per√≠odo anterior e s√©rie de 8 pontos
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_suppression_stats(p_days integer DEFAULT 30)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid             uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_days            integer;
+  v_now             timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
+  v_start           timestamptz;
+  v_prev_start      timestamptz;
+  v_active_value    integer;
+  v_active_prev     integer;
+  v_active_series   jsonb;
+  v_optout_value    integer;
+  v_optout_prev     integer;
+  v_optout_series   jsonb;
+  v_manual_value    integer;
+  v_manual_prev     integer;
+  v_manual_series   jsonb;
+  v_prot_value      integer;
+  v_prot_prev       integer;
+  v_prot_series     jsonb;
+  v_total_campaigns integer;
+  v_campaigns       jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_suppression_read_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_days := COALESCE(p_days, 30);
+  IF v_days < 1 OR v_days > 365 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_days' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_start := v_now - make_interval(days => v_days);
+  v_prev_start := v_start - make_interval(days => v_days);
+
+  -- suprimidos ativos (estoque): nem expirados nem removidos
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_active_value
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+   WHERE b.removed_at IS NULL
+     AND (b.expires_at IS NULL OR b.expires_at > v_now);
+
+  -- estoque √© compar√°vel no IN√çCIO do per√≠odo (v_start), n√£o na janela anterior (v_prev_start)
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_active_prev
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+   WHERE b.created_at <= v_start
+     AND (b.removed_at IS NULL OR b.removed_at > v_start)
+     AND (b.expires_at IS NULL OR b.expires_at > v_start);
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(cnt::integer ORDER BY g), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_active_series
+    FROM generate_series(0, 7) AS g
+    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT count(*) AS cnt
+        FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+       WHERE b.created_at <= v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * (g + 1) / 8)
+         AND (b.removed_at IS NULL OR b.removed_at > v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * (g + 1) / 8))
+         AND (b.expires_at IS NULL OR b.expires_at > v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * (g + 1) / 8))
+    ) s;
+
+  -- opt-outs do per√≠odo (reason_code='opt_out', o que inclui auto_optout)
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_optout_value
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+   WHERE b.reason_code = 'opt_out'
+     AND b.created_at >= v_start AND b.created_at <= v_now;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_optout_prev
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+   WHERE b.reason_code = 'opt_out'
+     AND b.created_at >= v_prev_start AND b.created_at < v_start;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(cnt::integer ORDER BY g), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_optout_series
+    FROM generate_series(0, 7) AS g
+    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT count(*) AS cnt
+        FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+       WHERE b.reason_code = 'opt_out'
+         AND b.created_at >= v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * g / 8)
+         AND b.created_at <  v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * (g + 1) / 8)
+    ) s;
+
+  -- bloqueios manuais (origem manual), mesma janela e mesma s√©rie
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_manual_value
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+   WHERE b.origin = 'manual'
+     AND b.created_at >= v_start AND b.created_at <= v_now;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_manual_prev
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+   WHERE b.origin = 'manual'
+     AND b.created_at >= v_prev_start AND b.created_at < v_start;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(cnt::integer ORDER BY g), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_manual_series
+    FROM generate_series(0, 7) AS g
+    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT count(*) AS cnt
+        FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+       WHERE b.origin = 'manual'
+         AND b.created_at >= v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * g / 8)
+         AND b.created_at <  v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * (g + 1) / 8)
+    ) s;
+
+  -- campanhas protegidas (estoque: iniciadas com respect_suppression)
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_prot_value
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns c
+   WHERE c.started_at IS NOT NULL AND c.respect_suppression;
+
+  -- estoque √© compar√°vel no IN√çCIO do per√≠odo (v_start), n√£o na janela anterior (v_prev_start)
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_prot_prev
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns c
+   WHERE c.started_at IS NOT NULL AND c.respect_suppression
+     AND c.started_at <= v_start;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(cnt::integer ORDER BY g), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_prot_series
+    FROM generate_series(0, 7) AS g
+    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT count(*) AS cnt
+        FROM public.talkx_campaigns c
+       WHERE c.started_at IS NOT NULL AND c.respect_suppression
+         AND c.started_at <= v_start + make_interval(days => v_days * (g + 1) / 8)
+    ) s;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total_campaigns
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns c
+   WHERE c.started_at IS NOT NULL;
+
+  -- campanhas que t√™m supress√£o (alimentam o filtro "Campanha")
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x.id, 'name', x.name) ORDER BY x.name), '[]'::jsonb)
+    INTO v_campaigns
+    FROM (
+      SELECT DISTINCT tc.id, tc.name
+        FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+        JOIN public.talkx_campaigns tc ON tc.id = b.campaign_id
+    ) x;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'period_days',     v_days,
+    'active',          jsonb_build_object('value', v_active_value, 'previous', v_active_prev, 'series', v_active_series),
+    'optouts',         jsonb_build_object('value', v_optout_value, 'previous', v_optout_prev, 'series', v_optout_series),
+    'manual',          jsonb_build_object('value', v_manual_value, 'previous', v_manual_prev, 'series', v_manual_series),
+    'protected',       jsonb_build_object('value', v_prot_value,   'previous', v_prot_prev,   'series', v_prot_series),
+    'total_campaigns', v_total_campaigns,
+    'campaigns',       v_campaigns
+  );
+END;
+$fn$;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- (c) atividade recente lida dos eventos de entidade suppression*
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_suppression_activity(
+  p_limite integer DEFAULT 5,
+  p_offset integer DEFAULT 0
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid    uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_limite integer;
+  v_offset integer;
+  v_total  integer := 0;
+  v_rows   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_rec    record;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_suppression_read_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_limite := COALESCE(p_limite, 5);
+  IF v_limite < 1 OR v_limite > 200 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_limit' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_offset := COALESCE(p_offset, 0);
+  IF v_offset < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_suppression_offset' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  FOR v_rec IN
+    WITH base AS (
+      SELECT e.id,
+             e.event_type,
+             e.message,
+             e.created_at,
+             e.entity_type,
+             e.entity_id,
+             pr.name AS actor_name,
+             c.name  AS contact_name,
+             c.email AS contact_email,
+             COALESCE(c.phone, b.phone) AS contact_phone,
+             CASE e.event_type
+               WHEN 'suppression_add'    THEN 'adicionado'
+               WHEN 'suppression_remove' THEN 'removido'
+               WHEN 'suppression_update' THEN 'atualizado'
+               WHEN 'suppression_import' THEN 'importacao'
+               WHEN 'suppression_export' THEN 'exportacao'
+             END AS kind
+        FROM public.talkx_campaign_events e
+        LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id = e.actor_id
+        LEFT JOIN public.talkx_blacklist b
+               ON e.entity_type = 'talkx_blacklist' AND b.id = e.entity_id
+        LEFT JOIN public.contacts c
+               ON c.id = COALESCE(b.contact_id, CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'contact' THEN e.entity_id END)
+       WHERE e.event_type IN (
+               'suppression_add', 'suppression_remove', 'suppression_update',
+               'suppression_import', 'suppression_export'
+             )
+    )
+    SELECT b.*, count(*) OVER () AS total_count
+      FROM base b
+     ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC
+     LIMIT v_limite OFFSET v_offset
+  LOOP
+    v_total := v_rec.total_count;
+    v_rows := v_rows || jsonb_build_object(
+      'id',            v_rec.id,
+      'event_type',    v_rec.event_type,
+      'kind',          v_rec.kind,
+      'actor_name',    v_rec.actor_name,
+      'contact_name',  v_rec.contact_name,
+      'contact_email', v_rec.contact_email,
+      'contact_phone', v_rec.contact_phone,
+      'message',       v_rec.message,
+      'created_at',    v_rec.created_at
+    );
+  END LOOP;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('total', v_total, 'rows', v_rows);
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_suppression_activity(integer, integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+-- service_role NAO tem EXECUTE por REVOKE nominal: o default do Supabase concede
+-- EXECUTE explicitamente e REVOKE de PUBLIC nao remove grant proprio do papel.
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_suppression_activity(integer, integer) TO authenticated;

+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $f$
+BEGIN

+  -- (edge function). O chamador final ali √© o provedor, n√£o um usu√°rio logado.

+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;

+  IF NEW.contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_id

+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$f$;

+   WHERE d.adrelid = 'public.messages'::regclass AND a.attname = 'created_at';
+  SELECT pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) INTO v_status_updated_default
+    FROM pg_attrdef d
+    JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = d.adrelid AND a.attnum = d.adnum
+   WHERE d.adrelid = 'public.messages'::regclass AND a.attname = 'status_updated_at';
+
+  IF v_status_default IS DISTINCT FROM '''sent''::text' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard_message_provenance_fields: messages.status default mudou (%), a guarda de status precisa ser revista', v_status_default;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_created_default IS DISTINCT FROM 'now()' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard_message_provenance_fields: messages.created_at default mudou (%), a guarda de created_at precisa ser revista', v_created_default;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_status_updated_default IS DISTINCT FROM 'now()' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard_message_provenance_fields: messages.status_updated_at default mudou (%), a guarda de status_updated_at precisa ser revista', v_status_updated_default;
+  END IF;
+END
+$check$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_message_provenance_fields()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  c_status_default constant text := 'sent';
+  c_deleted_content constant text := '[Mensagem apagada]';
+BEGIN
+  IF current_user IN ('postgres', 'service_role') THEN
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
+    IF NEW.sender IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_sender_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.external_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_external_id_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.media_url IS NOT NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_media_url_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- (SEC-RLS-01) status e os carimbos de entrega sao do banco, nao do cliente.
+    IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM c_status_default THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_status_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM now() THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_created_at_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.status_updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM now() THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_status_updated_at_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
+    IF NEW.media_url IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.media_url
+       OR NEW.contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_id
+       OR NEW.sender IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.sender
+       OR NEW.agent_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.agent_id
+       OR NEW.external_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.external_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_provenance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- (SEC-RLS-01) carimbos de entrega: nao se escolhe status nem instante numa
+    -- linha existente (era o vetor de forjar o SLA com 'failed' -> 'sent').
+    IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_status_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_created_at_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.status_updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status_updated_at THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_status_updated_at_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- (SEC-RLS-01) o texto do cliente nao se reescreve. Unica excecao: o par
+    -- exato do "apagar" usado pelo inbox em qualquer origem, com o caption
+    -- intacto.
+    IF OLD.sender = 'contact'
+       AND (NEW.content IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.content
+            OR NEW.caption IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.caption)
+       AND NOT (NEW.is_deleted IS TRUE
+                AND NEW.content = c_deleted_content
+                AND NEW.caption IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.caption) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_contact_content_forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.guard_message_provenance_fields()
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

+-- 20261009190000_talkx_mdb01_outcome_unknown_fix
+--
+-- Corrige talkx_engine_alerts(): a view talkx_engine_health emite
+-- kind = 'outcome_unknown_24h', mas o CHECK talkx_alerts_kind_check
+-- aceita apenas 'outcome_unknown' (sem o sufixo _24h).
+--
+-- A signals CTE passava h.kind direto ‚Üí INSERT violava o CHECK e
+-- abortava o lote inteiro, inclusive os outros alertas da rodada
+-- (item 33 / R3-DELTA-001). Fix: normalizar no momento da leitura.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_engine_alerts()
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_now      timestamptz := now();
+  v_firing   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_opened   integer := 0;
+  v_resolved integer := 0;
+  v_cron_bad boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Sinais que disparam alerta AGORA (kind de alerta + campanha).
+  -- DELTA vs X033: 'outcome_unknown_24h' normalizado para 'outcome_unknown'
+  -- (view emite _24h; CHECK da tabela aceita sem sufixo).
+  WITH signals AS (
+    SELECT CASE WHEN h.kind = 'outcome_unknown_24h' THEN 'outcome_unknown'
+                ELSE h.kind
+           END AS kind,
+           h.campaign_id
+      FROM public.talkx_engine_health AS h
+     WHERE h.kind IN ('stalled_campaign', 'outcome_unknown_24h')
+    UNION
+    SELECT 'stale_lease'::text, h.campaign_id
+      FROM public.talkx_engine_health AS h
+     WHERE h.kind = 'stale_lease'
+    UNION
+    SELECT 'high_failure_rate'::text, h.campaign_id
+      FROM public.talkx_engine_health AS h
+     WHERE h.kind = 'failure_rate_15m'
+       AND COALESCE(h.metric_count, 0) >= 5
+       AND COALESCE(h.metric_rate, 0) >= 0.5
+  )
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', s.kind, 'campaign_id', s.campaign_id)), '[]'::jsonb)
+    INTO v_firing
+    FROM signals AS s;
+
+  -- cron_degraded: ultimas 3 execucoes do cron do Talk X todas falhas (ex.: job startup timeout).
+  SELECT (count(*) = 3 AND bool_and(r.status = 'failed'))
+    INTO v_cron_bad
+    FROM (
+      SELECT cr.status
+        FROM public.talkx_engine_cron_runs(3) AS cr
+       ORDER BY cr.start_time DESC NULLS LAST, cr.runid DESC
+       LIMIT 3
+    ) AS r;
+  IF COALESCE(v_cron_bad, false) THEN
+    v_firing := v_firing || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'cron_degraded', 'campaign_id', NULL));
+  END IF;
+
+  -- 1) abrir alertas novos (dedup pelo indice parcial unico; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_alerts (kind, campaign_id, payload)
+  SELECT (s ->> 'kind'),
+         NULLIF(s ->> 'campaign_id', '')::uuid,
+         jsonb_build_object('detected_at', v_now, 'source', 'talkx_engine_health')
+    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_firing) AS s
+  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_opened = ROW_COUNT;
+
+  -- 2) fechar alertas cujo sinal deixou de disparar (fechamento automatico).
+  UPDATE public.talkx_alerts AS a
+     SET resolved_at = v_now
+   WHERE a.resolved_at IS NULL
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+         FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_firing) AS s
+        WHERE (s ->> 'kind') = a.kind
+          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(s ->> 'campaign_id', '')::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
+              = COALESCE(a.campaign_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
+     );

+UPDATE public.team_message_receipts r
+   SET conversation_id = m.conversation_id
+  FROM public.team_messages m

+  END IF;

+END;

+-- Rollback: remove a view (ela nao existia antes desta migration).
+--   DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.team_message_read_state;
+
+CREATE VIEW public.team_message_read_state
+WITH (security_invoker = true)
+AS
+SELECT
+  m.id AS message_id,
+  m.conversation_id,
+  COUNT(DISTINCT tcm.profile_id) AS member_count,
+  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
+    WHEN r.status = 'read' AND r.profile_id <> m.sender_id
+    THEN r.profile_id
+  END) AS read_count,
+  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
+    WHEN r.status = 'read' AND r.profile_id <> m.sender_id
+    THEN r.profile_id
+  END) = COUNT(DISTINCT tcm.profile_id) - 1 AS all_read
+FROM public.team_messages m
+JOIN public.team_conversation_members tcm
+  ON tcm.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
+LEFT JOIN public.team_message_receipts r
+  ON r.message_id = m.id
+  AND r.profile_id = tcm.profile_id
+  AND r.status = 'read'
+GROUP BY m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON public.team_message_read_state FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON public.team_message_read_state FROM anon;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.team_message_read_state TO authenticated;

+-- n099_talkx_confirm_launch (vers√£o 20261009230001)
+-- Rollback: remove a RPC confirm_talkx_campaign_launch e as colunas launch_confirmations/launch_confirmed_by/launch_confirmed_at.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.confirm_talkx_campaign_launch(p_campaign_id uuid, p_expected_revision bigint, p_confirmations jsonb);
+--   ALTER TABLE public.talkx_campaigns DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS launch_confirmations, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS launch_confirmed_by, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS launch_confirmed_at;
+--
+-- N-099: guardar as 3 confirmacoes pre-disparo (consentimento, conteudo, supressao),
+-- quem confirmou e quando em talkx_campaigns, e criar a RPC confirm_talkx_campaign_launch.
+
+-- 1) Colunas de confirmacao de lancamento -----------------------------------
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_campaigns
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS launch_confirmations jsonb,
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS launch_confirmed_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS launch_confirmed_at timestamptz;
+
+-- 2) RPC de confirmacao de lancamento --------------------------------------
+-- Chamada pelo cliente autenticado; a checagem de papel e interna (auth.uid()).
+-- launch_confirmed_by e FK de profiles(id), e auth.uid() e o user_id: o perfil
+-- ativo e resolvido por profiles.user_id.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_talkx_campaign_launch(
+  p_campaign_id       uuid,
+  p_expected_revision bigint,
+  p_confirmations     jsonb
+)
+RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, revision bigint, confirmed_at timestamptz)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_campaign   public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_now        timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL
+     OR COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_confirm_launch_unauthorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_profile_id
+  FROM public.profiles AS profile
+  WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+    AND profile.is_active = true
+  LIMIT 1;
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+  FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS campaign
+  WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+  FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_campaign.status NOT IN ('draft', 'scheduled') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_confirmable' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_campaign.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- As 3 confirmacoes precisam estar presentes e verdadeiras.
+  IF (p_confirmations -> 'consent')     IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
+     OR (p_confirmations -> 'content')     IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
+     OR (p_confirmations -> 'suppression') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_confirm_launch_missing_keys' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns AS campaign
+  SET launch_confirmations = jsonb_build_object('consent', true, 'content', true, 'suppression', true),
+      launch_confirmed_by  = v_profile_id,
+      launch_confirmed_at  = v_now,
+      revision             = campaign.revision + 1,
+      updated_at           = v_now
+  WHERE campaign.id = v_campaign.id;
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision + 1, v_now;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.confirm_talkx_campaign_launch(uuid, bigint, jsonb)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.confirm_talkx_campaign_launch(uuid, bigint, jsonb)
+  TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.confirm_talkx_campaign_launch(uuid, bigint, jsonb) IS
+  'N-099: confirma o pre-disparo de uma campanha Talk X (draft/scheduled). Exige admin/supervisor via auth.uid(), as 3 confirmacoes (consent, content, suppression = true) e a revisao atual; grava launch_confirmations/by/at e incrementa revision.';

+-- 2) RPC: request_department_access ‚Äî autenticado pede acesso, admins do departamento recebem notificacao e auditoria registra.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_department_access(p_department_id uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_admin_profile_id uuid;
+  v_admin_user_id uuid;
+  v_department_name text;
+BEGIN
+  v_profile_id := public.current_profile_id();
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'not_authenticated');
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT d.name INTO v_department_name FROM public.departments d WHERE d.id = p_department_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'department_not_found');
+  END IF;
+
+  FOR v_admin_profile_id, v_admin_user_id IN
+    SELECT p.id, p.user_id
+    FROM public.profiles p
+    WHERE p.department_id = p_department_id
+      AND p.role IN ('admin', 'supervisor')
+  LOOP
+    INSERT INTO public.notifications(user_id, title, message, type, metadata)
+    VALUES (
+      v_admin_user_id,
+      'Pedido de acesso ao departamento',
+      'Um agente solicitou acesso ao departamento ' || COALESCE(v_department_name, ''),
+      'info',
+      jsonb_build_object('department_id', p_department_id, 'requester_profile_id', v_profile_id)
+    );
+  END LOOP;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.department_audit_logs(department_id, action, profile_id, details)
+  VALUES (p_department_id, 'access_requested', v_profile_id, jsonb_build_object('department_name', v_department_name));
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.request_department_access(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.request_department_access(uuid) TO authenticated;

+-- Rollback:
+--   drop function if exists public.talkx_campaign_launch_checks(uuid);
+--
+-- N-098 / X120: checagens de lan√ßamento da campanha feitas no servidor.
+--
+-- HOJE: a prontid√£o √© calculada no navegador com 3 condi√ß√µes (Delivery:183-186) e
+-- ningu√©m impede um cliente adulterado de pular a confer√™ncia.
+--
+-- FAZER: public.talkx_campaign_launch_checks(p_campaign_id uuid) returns jsonb,
+-- somente leitura, devolve uma lista {code, severity (block|warn|ok), step, count,
+-- message}. Cobre: connection_ready, audience_not_empty, message_present,
+-- template_approved e schedule_reachable. N√ÉO FEITO (restante de X120):
+-- variables_resolved, suppression_applied, consent, daily_limit, connection_busy.
+--
+-- Acesso: dono da campanha ou admin/supervisor (42501 para os demais). SECURITY
+-- DEFINER com search_path fixo; REVOKE de PUBLIC/anon, GRANT s√≥ a authenticated.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_launch_checks(p_campaign_id uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_actor_profile_id uuid;
+  v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_conn_ok boolean;
+  v_audience integer;
+  v_template_status text;
+  v_hours jsonb;
+  v_bh_start time := time '08:00';
+  v_bh_end time := time '18:00';
+  v_bh_days integer[] := ARRAY[1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
+  v_ref timestamptz;
+  v_local timestamp;
+  v_local_time time;
+  v_in_window boolean := true;
+  v_reason text := NULL;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign FROM public.talkx_campaigns WHERE id = p_campaign_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_actor_profile_id
+    FROM public.profiles profile
+   WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.is_active = true
+   LIMIT 1;
+
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE
+     AND (v_actor_profile_id IS NULL
+          OR v_actor_profile_id IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(v_campaign.owner, v_campaign.created_by)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- connection_ready: conex√£o escolhida, viva e com inst√¢ncia.
+  SELECT (c.status = 'connected' AND NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(c.instance_id, '')), '') IS NOT NULL)
+    INTO v_conn_ok
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections c
+   WHERE c.id = v_campaign.whatsapp_connection_id;
+  v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
+    'code', 'connection_ready', 'step', 3, 'count', 0,
+    'severity', CASE WHEN COALESCE(v_conn_ok, false) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'block' END,
+    'message', CASE WHEN COALESCE(v_conn_ok, false) THEN 'Conex√£o WhatsApp pronta.'
+                    ELSE 'Escolha uma conex√£o WhatsApp conectada.' END);
+
+  -- audience_not_empty: destinat√°rios pendentes (lista vazia reprova).
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_audience
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+   WHERE r.campaign_id = v_campaign.id AND r.status = 'pending';
+  v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
+    'code', 'audience_not_empty', 'step', 1, 'count', v_audience,
+    'severity', CASE WHEN v_audience > 0 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'block' END,
+    'message', CASE WHEN v_audience > 0 THEN v_audience || ' destinat√°rios eleg√≠veis.'
+                    ELSE 'O p√∫blico est√° vazio.' END);
+
+  -- message_present
+  v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
+    'code', 'message_present', 'step', 2, 'count', 0,
+    'severity', CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(v_campaign.message_template), '') IS NOT NULL
+                       OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_campaign.media_url, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
+                     THEN 'ok' ELSE 'block' END,
+    'message', CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(v_campaign.message_template), '') IS NOT NULL
+                       OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_campaign.media_url, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
+                    THEN 'Mensagem preenchida.' ELSE 'Escreva a mensagem ou anexe uma m√≠dia.' END);
+
+  -- template_approved: sem template ou template fora de "approved" reprova.
+  SELECT t.status INTO v_template_status
+    FROM public.talkx_templates t WHERE t.id = v_campaign.template_id;
+  v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
+    'code', 'template_approved', 'step', 2, 'count', 0,
+    'severity', CASE WHEN v_template_status = 'approved' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'block' END,
+    'message', CASE WHEN v_template_status = 'approved' THEN 'Template aprovado.'
+                    ELSE 'Escolha um template aprovado.' END);
+
+  -- schedule_reachable: o instante de in√≠cio (agendado ou agora) precisa cair
+  -- dentro da janela da campanha e do hor√°rio comercial, se exigido.
+  BEGIN
+    v_ref := COALESCE(v_campaign.scheduled_at, statement_timestamp());
+    v_local := v_ref AT TIME ZONE v_campaign.schedule_timezone;
+    v_local_time := v_local::time;
+
+    IF v_campaign.send_window_start IS NOT NULL AND v_campaign.send_window_end IS NOT NULL THEN
+      IF v_campaign.send_window_start = v_campaign.send_window_end THEN
+        v_in_window := false;
+        v_reason := 'A janela de envio est√° vazia.';
+      ELSIF v_campaign.send_window_start < v_campaign.send_window_end THEN
+        v_in_window := v_local_time >= v_campaign.send_window_start
+                   AND v_local_time <  v_campaign.send_window_end;
+      ELSE
+        v_in_window := v_local_time >= v_campaign.send_window_start
+                    OR v_local_time <  v_campaign.send_window_end;
+      END IF;
+      IF NOT v_in_window AND v_reason IS NULL THEN
+        v_reason := 'O in√≠cio cai fora da janela de envio.';
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_in_window AND v_campaign.business_hours_only THEN
+      SELECT s.value INTO v_hours FROM public.talkx_settings s WHERE s.key = 'business_hours';
+      IF v_hours IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v_hours) = 'string' THEN
+        v_hours := (v_hours #>> '{}')::jsonb;
+      END IF;
+      IF v_hours IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v_hours) = 'object' THEN
+        v_bh_start := (v_hours ->> 'start')::time;
+        v_bh_end := (v_hours ->> 'end')::time;
+        SELECT array_agg(d::integer) INTO v_bh_days FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_hours -> 'days') d;
+      END IF;
+      IF v_bh_start IS NULL OR v_bh_end IS NULL OR v_bh_start >= v_bh_end THEN
+        v_in_window := false;
+        v_reason := 'Fuso ou hor√°rio comercial inv√°lido.';
+      ELSIF v_bh_days IS NULL OR cardinality(v_bh_days) = 0
+         OR NOT (extract(dow FROM v_local)::integer = ANY (v_bh_days))
+         OR v_local_time < v_bh_start OR v_local_time >= v_bh_end THEN
+        v_in_window := false;
+        v_reason := 'O in√≠cio cai fora do hor√°rio comercial.';
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    -- fuso ou hor√°rio comercial inv√°lido: fecha, nunca libera.
+    v_in_window := false;
+    v_reason := 'Fuso ou hor√°rio comercial inv√°lido.';
+  END;
+  v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object(
+    'code', 'schedule_reachable', 'step', 3, 'count', 0,
+    'severity', CASE WHEN v_in_window THEN 'ok' ELSE 'block' END,
+    'message', CASE WHEN v_in_window THEN 'In√≠cio dentro da janela de envio.' ELSE v_reason END);
+
+  RETURN v_items;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_launch_checks(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_launch_checks(uuid) FROM anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_launch_checks(uuid) TO authenticated;

+-- Rollback: drop function, trigger, indexes e column adicionados por esta migration.

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_talkx_recipients_failed_at()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.status = 'failed' AND NEW.failed_at IS NULL
+     AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed') THEN
+    NEW.failed_at := now();
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$fn$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_monitor_panel(
+  p_campaign_id    uuid,
+  p_window_minutes integer DEFAULT 60,
+  p_bucket         text    DEFAULT 'minute',
+  p_day            date    DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_segment_id     uuid    DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid        uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_now        timestamptz := now();
+  v_camp       public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_tz         text;
+  v_step       interval;
+  v_first      timestamptz;
+  v_last       timestamptz;
+  v_today      timestamptz;
+  v_yesterday  timestamptz;
+  v_threshold  interval;
+  v_conn       text;
+  v_sent integer; v_delivered integer; v_replied integer; v_failed integer;
+  v_unknown integer; v_skipped integer; v_remaining integer; v_total integer;
+  v_processed integer; v_old_sent integer; v_old_delivered integer; v_recent_sent integer;
+  v_peak_now integer; v_peak_prev integer;
+  v_replied_today integer; v_replied_yday integer; v_failed_today integer; v_failed_yday integer;
+  v_sent_yday integer;
+  v_last_activity timestamptz;
+  v_optouts    integer;
+  v_state      text;
+  v_reco       text;
+  v_series     jsonb;
+  v_spark      jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'acesso negado' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_bucket IS NULL OR p_bucket NOT IN ('minute', 'hour') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_bucket deve ser minute ou hour' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_window_minutes IS NULL OR p_window_minutes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10080 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_window_minutes deve estar entre 1 e 10080' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_camp FROM public.talkx_campaigns WHERE id = p_campaign_id;
+  -- NULL nunca autoriza: sem linha em profiles ou created_by nulo, a comparacao
+  -- de dono vira NULL e o IF precisa tratar como negado (42501).
+  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT (
+       COALESCE(v_camp.created_by = (SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_uid LIMIT 1), false)
+       OR COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid), false)
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'acesso negado' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_tz := COALESCE(v_camp.schedule_timezone, 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_timezone_names WHERE name = v_tz) THEN
+    v_tz := 'America/Sao_Paulo';
+  END IF;
+  v_step      := CASE p_bucket WHEN 'hour' THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '1 minute' END;
+  v_today     := date_trunc('day', v_now, v_tz);
+  v_yesterday := date_trunc('day', v_today - interval '12 hours', v_tz);
+
+  IF p_day IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_first := date_trunc(p_bucket, p_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz, v_tz);
+    v_last  := date_trunc(p_bucket,
+                 LEAST(((p_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz) - interval '1 microsecond', v_now), v_tz);
+  ELSE
+    v_last  := date_trunc(p_bucket, v_now, v_tz);
+    v_first := v_last - v_step * (CEIL(p_window_minutes::numeric
+                 / CASE p_bucket WHEN 'hour' THEN 60 ELSE 1 END)::integer - 1);
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'outcome_unknown'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'skipped'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('pending', 'sending')),
+         count(*),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'failed'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at < v_now - interval '10 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at < v_now - interval '10 minutes' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at >= v_now - interval '5 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_now - interval '10 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_now - interval '20 minutes'
+                            AND replied_at < v_now - interval '10 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_yesterday AND replied_at < v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE failed_at >= v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE failed_at >= v_yesterday AND failed_at < v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at >= v_yesterday AND sent_at < v_today),
+         GREATEST(max(sent_at), max(delivery_claimed_at))
+    INTO v_sent, v_delivered, v_replied, v_failed, v_unknown, v_skipped, v_remaining, v_total,
+         v_processed, v_old_sent, v_old_delivered, v_recent_sent, v_peak_now, v_peak_prev,
+         v_replied_today, v_replied_yday, v_failed_today, v_failed_yday, v_sent_yday,
+         v_last_activity
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients
+   WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+     AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR segment_id = p_segment_id);
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_optouts
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist
+   WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND origin = 'optout';
+
+  WITH r AS (
+    SELECT sent_at, delivered_at, replied_at, failed_at
+      FROM public.talkx_recipients
+     WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+       AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR segment_id = p_segment_id)
+  ), ev AS (
+    SELECT 's' AS k, date_trunc(p_bucket, sent_at, v_tz) AS b FROM r
+     WHERE sent_at >= v_first AND sent_at < v_last + v_step
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT 'd', date_trunc(p_bucket, delivered_at, v_tz) FROM r
+     WHERE delivered_at >= v_first AND delivered_at < v_last + v_step
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT 'r', date_trunc(p_bucket, replied_at, v_tz) FROM r
+     WHERE replied_at >= v_first AND replied_at < v_last + v_step
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT 'f', date_trunc(p_bucket, failed_at, v_tz) FROM r
+     WHERE failed_at >= v_first AND failed_at < v_last + v_step
+  ), cnt AS (
+    SELECT b,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 's') AS s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'd') AS d,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'r') AS r, count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'f') AS f
+      FROM ev GROUP BY b
+  )
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+           't', g.t, 'sent', COALESCE(c.s, 0), 'delivered', COALESCE(c.d, 0),
+           'replied', COALESCE(c.r, 0), 'failed', COALESCE(c.f, 0)) ORDER BY g.t), '[]'::jsonb)
+    INTO v_series
+    FROM generate_series(v_first, v_last, v_step) AS g(t)
+    LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.b = g.t;
+
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+           'sent',      jsonb_agg(x.s ORDER BY x.i), 'delivered', jsonb_agg(x.d ORDER BY x.i),
+           'replied',   jsonb_agg(x.r ORDER BY x.i), 'failed',    jsonb_agg(x.f ORDER BY x.i))
+    INTO v_spark
+    FROM (
+      SELECT i,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.sent_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.sent_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS s,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.delivered_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.delivered_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS d,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.replied_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.replied_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS r,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.failed_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.failed_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS f
+        FROM generate_series(0, 11) AS i
+    ) AS x;
+
+  -- Limiar de parada: o maior entre 180 s e 3x (intervalo maximo + digitacao maxima).
+  v_threshold := make_interval(secs => GREATEST(180,
+                   3 * (v_camp.send_interval_max + v_camp.typing_delay_max) / 1000.0));
+  v_last_activity := GREATEST(v_last_activity, v_camp.started_at, v_camp.updated_at);
+
+  IF v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT status INTO v_conn FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE id = v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_state := CASE
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'sending' AND v_remaining > 0 AND v_last_activity < v_now - v_threshold THEN 'stalled'
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'sending' THEN 'sending'
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'paused' AND COALESCE(v_camp.pause_reason, 'manual') = 'manual' THEN 'paused_manual'
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'paused' THEN 'paused_auto'
+    WHEN v_camp.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') THEN 'done'
+    ELSE 'idle'
+  END;
+
+  v_reco := CASE
+    WHEN v_state IN ('sending', 'stalled', 'paused_auto')
+         AND v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL
+         AND v_conn IS DISTINCT FROM 'connected' THEN 'connection_down'
+    WHEN v_state = 'stalled' THEN 'stalled'
+    WHEN v_processed >= 50 AND v_failed::numeric / v_processed > 0.05 THEN 'high_failure'
+    WHEN v_total > 0 AND v_optouts::numeric / v_total > 0.02 THEN 'optout_spike'
+    WHEN v_old_sent >= 50 AND v_old_delivered::numeric / v_old_sent < 0.8 THEN 'low_delivery'
+    ELSE 'ok'
+  END;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'kpis', jsonb_build_object(
+      'sent', v_sent, 'delivered', v_delivered, 'replied', v_replied, 'failed', v_failed,
+      'optouts', v_optouts, 'to_confirm', v_unknown, 'skipped', v_skipped,
+      'remaining', v_remaining, 'total', v_total,
+      'delivery_rate_pct', CASE WHEN v_sent > 0 THEN round(100.0 * v_delivered / v_sent, 1) END,
+      'optout_rate_pct',   CASE WHEN v_total > 0 THEN round(100.0 * v_optouts / v_total, 1) END),
+    'vs_yesterday', CASE WHEN v_sent_yday > 0 THEN jsonb_build_object(
+      'replied', jsonb_build_object('today', v_replied_today, 'yesterday', v_replied_yday),
+      'failed',  jsonb_build_object('today', v_failed_today,  'yesterday', v_failed_yday)) END,
+    'forecast', jsonb_build_object('per_minute', NULL, 'pct_vs_forecast', NULL, 'estimated_end', NULL),
+    'spark', v_spark,
+    'series', v_series,
+    'reply_peak', jsonb_build_object('last_10_min', v_peak_now, 'previous_10_min', v_peak_prev),
+    'health', jsonb_build_object(
+      'worker_state', v_state,
+      'pause_reason', CASE WHEN v_state = 'paused_auto' THEN v_camp.pause_reason END,
+      'last_activity_at', v_last_activity,
+      'rate_per_minute', round(v_recent_sent / 5.0, 1),
+      'recommendation_code', v_reco)
+  );
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid, integer, text, date, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;

+-- Rollback: RPC nova (N-131), sem corpo anterior. Desfazer nesta ordem:

+--
+-- N-131: lista paginada (keyset por created_at,id) dos destinatarios de uma
+-- campanha Talk X, com o contato embutido, filtro por status, busca por
+-- nome/telefone e KPIs calculados no servidor.
+-- Retorno: um unico objeto jsonb { rows, next_cursor, total, kpis } ‚Äî nada de
+-- origem/canal. Dono da campanha, admin/supervisor e service_role podem ler;
+-- os demais recebem 42501.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_recipients_page(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_page_size integer DEFAULT 50,
+  p_cursor text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_status text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_search text DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_can_view boolean;
+  v_size integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page_size, 50), 1), 100);
+  v_cur_at timestamptz;
+  v_cur_id uuid;
+  v_search text := NULLIF(btrim(p_search), '');
+  v_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_has_more boolean := false;
+  v_next text := NULL;
+  v_total bigint := 0;
+  v_kpis jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role' THEN
+    v_can_view := true;
+  ELSE
+    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_recipients_page: acesso negado' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT p.id INTO v_profile_id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_campaigns tc
+      WHERE tc.id = p_campaign_id
+        AND (tc.created_by = v_profile_id OR COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false))
+    ) INTO v_can_view;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT COALESCE(v_can_view, false) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_recipients_page: acesso negado' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Os status reais da tabela (talkx_recipients_status_check).
+  IF p_status IS NOT NULL
+     AND p_status NOT IN ('pending', 'sending', 'sent', 'delivered', 'failed', 'skipped', 'outcome_unknown') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_recipients_page: status invalido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_cursor IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_cur_at := (p_cursor::jsonb ->> 'created_at')::timestamptz;
+    v_cur_id := (p_cursor::jsonb ->> 'id')::uuid;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- KPIs de todo o coorte da campanha (independem do filtro de status/busca).
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'total', count(*),
+    'sent', count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'sent'),
+    'delivered', count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'delivered'),
+    'failed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed'),
+    'pending', count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('pending', 'sending')),
+    'outcome_unknown', count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'outcome_unknown')
+  ) INTO v_kpis
+  FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+  WHERE r.campaign_id = p_campaign_id;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total
+  FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+  LEFT JOIN public.contacts c ON c.id = r.contact_id
+  WHERE r.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+    AND (p_status IS NULL OR r.status = p_status)
+    AND (v_search IS NULL OR c.name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%' OR c.phone ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%');
+
+  WITH page AS (
+    SELECT r.*, c.name AS contact_name, c.phone AS contact_phone
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+    LEFT JOIN public.contacts c ON c.id = r.contact_id
+    WHERE r.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+      AND (p_status IS NULL OR r.status = p_status)
+      AND (v_search IS NULL OR c.name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%' OR c.phone ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%')
+      AND (v_cur_at IS NULL OR (r.created_at, r.id) > (v_cur_at, v_cur_id))
+    ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id
+    LIMIT v_size + 1
+  ), numbered AS (
+    SELECT page.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY page.created_at, page.id) AS rn FROM page
+  )
+  SELECT
+    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+      'id', n.id,
+      'campaign_id', n.campaign_id,
+      'contact_id', n.contact_id,
+      'status', n.status,
+      'segment_id', n.segment_id,
+      'sent_at', n.sent_at,
+      'delivered_at', n.delivered_at,
+      'error_message', n.error_message,
+      'manual_retry_count', n.manual_retry_count,
+      'created_at', n.created_at,
+      'updated_at', n.updated_at,
+      'contacts', CASE WHEN n.contact_id IS NULL THEN NULL
+                       ELSE jsonb_build_object('name', n.contact_name, 'phone', n.contact_phone) END
+    ) ORDER BY n.rn) FILTER (WHERE n.rn <= v_size), '[]'::jsonb),
+    COALESCE(bool_or(n.rn > v_size), false),
+    (SELECT jsonb_build_object('created_at', l.created_at, 'id', l.id)::text
+       FROM numbered l WHERE l.rn = v_size)
+  INTO v_rows, v_has_more, v_next
+  FROM numbered n;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'rows', v_rows,
+    'next_cursor', CASE WHEN v_has_more THEN v_next ELSE NULL END,
+    'total', v_total,
+    'kpis', v_kpis
+  );
+END;
+$$;

+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_recipients_page(uuid, integer, text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_recipients_page(uuid, integer, text, text, text) TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- is_contact_visible_to_user; (2) como o front (useConversationActions.transfer) insere sem
+-- performed_by, um BEFORE INSERT preenche o autor com o perfil do chamador quando o JWT e de
+-- usuario e o campo veio vazio. Escritas do servidor (service_role, triggers SECURITY DEFINER,
+-- auth.uid() nulo) seguem livres para gravar evento sem autor.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conversation_events_default_performed_by()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.performed_by IS NULL THEN
+    NEW.performed_by := public.current_profile_id();
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.conversation_events_default_performed_by()
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_conversation_events_default_performed_by ON public.conversation_events;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_events_default_performed_by
+BEFORE INSERT ON public.conversation_events
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.conversation_events_default_performed_by();
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Authorized users can insert events" ON public.conversation_events;
+CREATE POLICY "Authorized users can insert events"
+ON public.conversation_events
+FOR INSERT
+TO authenticated
+WITH CHECK (
+  performed_by = public.current_profile_id()
+  AND public.is_contact_visible_to_user(contact_id, auth.uid())
+);

+--
+-- N-123 (X075; P3, lista aprovada pelo Joaquim em 09/10): comparativos por periodo com nomes.
+-- talkx_benchmarks ganha a janela (p_days, default 90) e o limite (p_limit, default 5); a
+-- assinatura antiga sem argumentos e removida porque, mantendo as duas com defaults, a chamada
+-- sem argumentos ficaria ambigua. Acrescenta nome de segmento (so para admin/supervisor, como
+-- ja acontecia com by_segment) e de template, volume enviado (sent_count), ordena os templates
+-- por taxa de resposta e devolve has_baseline (true com 5+ campanhas concluidas na janela).
+-- A assinatura nova preserva a postura de seguranca de 20260916220000: SECURITY DEFINER com
+-- search_path fixo (agora public, pg_temp), by_segment so para admin/supervisor e REVOKE de
+-- PUBLIC/anon. talkx_templates ja e visivel a qualquer authenticated (policy auth.uid() is not
+-- null), entao expor template_name em by_template nao cria vazamento incremental.
+
+drop function if exists public.talkx_benchmarks();
+
+create or replace function public.talkx_benchmarks(
+  p_days  integer default 90,
+  p_limit integer default 5
+) returns jsonb
+language plpgsql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $fn$
+declare
+  v_days     integer := coalesce(p_days, 90);
+  v_limit    integer := coalesce(p_limit, 5);
+  v_cutoff   timestamptz;
+  v_global   jsonb;
+  v_by_seg   jsonb;
+  v_by_tpl   jsonb;
+  v_is_admin boolean := coalesce(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false);
+  v_count    integer := 0;
+begin
+  if v_days < 1 or v_days > 3650 then
+    raise exception 'invalid_talkx_benchmarks_days' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  if v_limit < 1 or v_limit > 50 then
+    raise exception 'invalid_talkx_benchmarks_limit' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  v_cutoff := now() - make_interval(days => v_days);
+
+  select jsonb_build_object(
+    'campaign_count',        count(*),
+    'avg_delivery_rate_pct', round(avg(metric.delivery_rate_pct)::numeric, 1),
+    'avg_reply_rate_pct',    round(avg(metric.reply_rate_pct)::numeric, 1),
+    'avg_duration_secs',     round(avg(metric.duration_secs)::numeric),
+    'p50_delivery_rate_pct', round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by metric.delivery_rate_pct))::numeric, 1),
+    'p90_delivery_rate_pct', round((percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by metric.delivery_rate_pct))::numeric, 1),
+    'avg_recipients',        round(avg(metric.total_recipients)::numeric)
+  ) into v_global
+  from public.talkx_campaign_metrics metric
+  where metric.completed_at >= v_cutoff;
+
+  v_count := coalesce((v_global ->> 'campaign_count')::integer, 0);
+
+  if v_is_admin then
+    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row order by (row ->> 'avg_reply_rate_pct')::numeric desc), '[]'::jsonb)
+    into v_by_seg
+    from (
+      select jsonb_build_object(
+        'segment_id',            metric.segment_id,
+        'segment_name',          segment.name,
+        'campaign_count',        count(*),
+        'sent_count',            coalesce(sum(metric.sent_count), 0),
+        'avg_delivery_rate_pct', round(avg(metric.delivery_rate_pct)::numeric, 1),
+        'avg_reply_rate_pct',    round(avg(metric.reply_rate_pct)::numeric, 1)
+      ) as row
+      from public.talkx_campaign_metrics metric
+      left join public.talkx_segments segment on segment.id = metric.segment_id
+      where metric.completed_at >= v_cutoff and metric.segment_id is not null
+      group by metric.segment_id, segment.name
+      order by avg(metric.reply_rate_pct) desc
+      limit v_limit
+    ) sub;
+  else
+    v_by_seg := '[]'::jsonb;
+  end if;
+
+  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row order by (row ->> 'avg_reply_rate_pct')::numeric desc), '[]'::jsonb)
+  into v_by_tpl
+  from (
+    select jsonb_build_object(
+      'template_id',           metric.template_id,
+      'template_name',         template.name,
+      'campaign_count',        count(*),
+      'sent_count',            coalesce(sum(metric.sent_count), 0),
+      'avg_delivery_rate_pct', round(avg(metric.delivery_rate_pct)::numeric, 1),
+      'avg_reply_rate_pct',    round(avg(metric.reply_rate_pct)::numeric, 1)
+    ) as row
+    from public.talkx_campaign_metrics metric
+    left join public.talkx_templates template on template.id = metric.template_id
+    where metric.completed_at >= v_cutoff and metric.template_id is not null
+    group by metric.template_id, template.name
+    order by avg(metric.reply_rate_pct) desc
+    limit v_limit
+  ) sub;
+
+  return jsonb_build_object(
+    'window_days',  v_days,
+    'limit',        v_limit,
+    'as_of',        now(),
+    'has_baseline', (v_count >= 5),
+    'global',       coalesce(v_global, '{}'::jsonb),
+    'by_segment',   coalesce(v_by_seg, '[]'::jsonb),
+    'by_template',  coalesce(v_by_tpl, '[]'::jsonb)
+  );
+end;
+$fn$;
+
+revoke all on function public.talkx_benchmarks(integer, integer) from public;
+revoke execute on function public.talkx_benchmarks(integer, integer) from anon;
+grant execute on function public.talkx_benchmarks(integer, integer) to service_role, authenticated;

+-- save_talkx_template_variants
+-- Rollback: a funcao e nova (nao substitui corpo anterior); basta remove-la.
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.save_talkx_template_variants(uuid, timestamptz, jsonb);
+-- Grava o conjunto de variantes A/B/C de um template numa transacao atomica (0, 2 ou 3
+-- variantes; 1 isolada nao e A/B). Regras: p_variants precisa ser array JSON; exatamente um
+-- controle com conteudo (so espacos nao conta); pesos inteiros > 0 somando 100; labels A/B/C
+-- sem duplicata; ids do input precisam ser uuid valido e pertencer ao template; ids
+-- existentes sao preservados (UPDATE por id, INSERT so para novas); remover variante com
+-- destinatario e recusado.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_talkx_template_variants(
+  p_template_id uuid,
+  p_expected_updated_at timestamptz,
+  p_variants jsonb
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $f$
+DECLARE
+  v_current_updated_at timestamptz;
+  v_is_owner boolean;
+  v_is_admin boolean;
+  v_variant_count integer;
+  v_bad_count bigint;
+  v_weight_sum integer;
+  v_recipient_count bigint;
+  v_input_ids uuid[];
+  v_removed_count integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'not_authenticated');
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT t.updated_at INTO v_current_updated_at
+  FROM public.talkx_templates t
+  WHERE t.id = p_template_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'template_not_found');
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT EXISTS (
+           SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_templates t
+           JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = t.created_by
+           WHERE t.id = p_template_id AND p.user_id = auth.uid()
+         ),
+         public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+  INTO v_is_owner, v_is_admin;
+  IF v_is_owner IS NOT TRUE AND v_is_admin IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'not_authorized');
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_expected_updated_at IS NOT NULL
+     AND p_expected_updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM v_current_updated_at THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'stale_template');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Payload precisa ser array: nao normalizar para [] (nao apagar variantes por payload invalido)
+  IF p_variants IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_variants) <> 'array' THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_variants_payload');
+  END IF;
+
+  v_variant_count := jsonb_array_length(p_variants);
+  IF v_variant_count NOT IN (0, 2, 3) THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_variant_count');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- 0 variantes: remove todas, desde que nenhuma tenha destinatario
+  IF v_variant_count = 0 THEN
+    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_recipient_count
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+    WHERE r.template_id = p_template_id
+      AND r.variant_id IS NOT NULL;
+    IF v_recipient_count > 0 THEN
+      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'talkx_variant_in_use');
+    END IF;
+
+    DELETE FROM public.talkx_template_variants WHERE template_id = p_template_id;
+    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_removed_count = ROW_COUNT;
+
+    UPDATE public.talkx_templates SET updated_at = now() WHERE id = p_template_id;
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'saved_count', 0, 'removed_count', v_removed_count);
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Exatamente uma variante com conteudo, ignorando espacos
+  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_bad_count
+  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+  WHERE btrim(COALESCE(v->>'content', '')) <> '';
+  IF v_bad_count <> 1 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'exactly_one_variant_must_have_content');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Labels validos
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+    WHERE v->>'label' IS NULL OR v->>'label' NOT IN ('A', 'B', 'C')
+  ) THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_label');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Labels duplicados
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+    GROUP BY v->>'label' HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
+  ) THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'duplicate_label');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Pesos: inteiro de 1 a 100 (regex de 1-3 digitos; CASE garante a ordem do cast)
+  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_bad_count
+  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+  WHERE NOT (v ? 'weight')
+     OR jsonb_typeof(v->'weight') <> 'number'
+     OR CASE WHEN (v->>'weight') ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN (v->>'weight')::numeric <= 0 OR (v->>'weight')::numeric > 100
+             ELSE true END;
+  IF v_bad_count > 0 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_weight');
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT SUM((v->>'weight')::integer) INTO v_weight_sum
+  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v;
+  IF v_weight_sum <> 100 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'weights_must_sum_to_100');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ids do input: precisam ter formato uuid (quando presentes)
+  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_bad_count
+  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+  WHERE v->>'id' IS NOT NULL
+    AND (v->>'id') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
+  IF v_bad_count > 0 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_variant_id');
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT (v->>'id')::uuid)
+  INTO v_input_ids
+  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+  WHERE v->>'id' IS NOT NULL;
+
+  -- ids do input precisam pertencer a este template
+  IF v_input_ids IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_bad_count
+    FROM unnest(v_input_ids) AS x(id)
+    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_template_variants t
+      WHERE t.id = x.id AND t.template_id = p_template_id
+    );
+    IF v_bad_count > 0 THEN
+      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'variant_not_found');
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Troca de label entre variantes que sobrevivem (A->B e B->A) violaria
+  -- UNIQUE(template_id,label) no UPDATE unico; recusar com erro estruturado.
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+    FROM (
+      SELECT (v->>'id')::uuid AS id, v->>'label' AS label
+      FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+      WHERE v->>'id' IS NOT NULL
+    ) n
+    JOIN public.talkx_template_variants cur
+      ON cur.id = n.id AND cur.template_id = p_template_id
+    WHERE n.label <> cur.label
+      AND EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.talkx_template_variants o
+        WHERE o.template_id = p_template_id
+          AND o.label = n.label
+          AND o.id <> n.id
+          AND o.id = ANY (v_input_ids)
+      )
+  ) THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'label_conflict');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Recusar remocao de variante que ja tem destinatario
+  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_recipient_count
+  FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+  WHERE r.template_id = p_template_id
+    AND r.variant_id IS NOT NULL
+    AND (v_input_ids IS NULL OR r.variant_id <> ALL(v_input_ids));
+  IF v_recipient_count > 0 THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'talkx_variant_in_use');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Remover (num unico DELETE) as variantes que nao estao no input
+  DELETE FROM public.talkx_template_variants
+  WHERE template_id = p_template_id
+    AND (v_input_ids IS NULL OR id <> ALL(v_input_ids));
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_removed_count = ROW_COUNT;
+
+  -- Atualizar as existentes pelo id (preserva o id)
+  UPDATE public.talkx_template_variants t
+  SET label      = n.label,
+      content    = n.content,
+      media_url  = n.media_url,
+      media_type = n.media_type,
+      weight     = n.weight
+  FROM (
+    SELECT (v->>'id')::uuid            AS id,
+           v->>'label'                 AS label,
+           COALESCE(v->>'content', '') AS content,
+           v->>'media_url'             AS media_url,
+           v->>'media_type'            AS media_type,
+           (v->>'weight')::integer     AS weight
+    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+    WHERE v->>'id' IS NOT NULL
+  ) AS n
+  WHERE t.id = n.id AND t.template_id = p_template_id;
+
+  -- Inserir apenas as novas (sem id)
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_template_variants (template_id, label, content, media_url, media_type, weight)
+  SELECT p_template_id,
+         v->>'label',
+         COALESCE(v->>'content', ''),
+         v->>'media_url',
+         v->>'media_type',
+         (v->>'weight')::integer
+  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_variants) AS v
+  WHERE v->>'id' IS NULL;
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_templates SET updated_at = now() WHERE id = p_template_id;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'saved_count', v_variant_count, 'removed_count', v_removed_count);
+END;
+$f$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.save_talkx_template_variants(uuid, timestamptz, jsonb) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.save_talkx_template_variants(uuid, timestamptz, jsonb) TO authenticated;
