+--
+-- Achado 01 (P1) de docs/audits/SEGURANCA_DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE_2026-10-07.md. O media_url da
+-- midia de saida e escrito pelo CLIENTE e, sem checagem, podia apontar para o objeto de OUTRA
+-- conversa dentro dos buckets internos (whatsapp-media / audio-messages). A mensagem resultante
+-- ficava com aquela URL e a policy de SELECT de storage.objects liberava a leitura da midia
+-- alheia (a base que a migration irma tambem fecha, em profundidade).
+--
+-- Aqui o caminho do objeto, quando a URL aponta para um bucket interno, tem de comecar pela pasta
+-- do contato desta mensagem (p_contact_id) ou de um contato visivel ao proprio chamador. Qualquer
+-- outra pasta e recusada com 42501 media_url_out_of_contact_scope. A checagem cobre as formas de
+-- locator (object/render/image x public/sign/authenticated), recusa segmento de travessia (..) e
+-- escape codificado (%2e). URLs que citam bucket interno fora do formato canonico (ex. verbos
+-- alternativos do Storage) sao recusadas com 22023 invalid_outbound_media_url (fail-closed); URLs
+-- de buckets externos (nao internos) seguem ignoradas. Nao altera a ACL.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_outbound_message(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_client_message_id uuid,
+  p_content text,
+  p_message_type text DEFAULT 'text',
+  p_media_url text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_reply_to_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_whatsapp_connection_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_caption text DEFAULT NULL
+) RETURNS public.messages
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_connection_id uuid;
+  v_assigned_connection_id uuid;
+  v_reply_contact_id uuid;
+  v_media_path text;
+  v_media_owner text;
+  v_message public.messages%ROWTYPE;
+  v_message_type text := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_message_type, ''), 'text');
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- L9 (docs/ia/IA-004-matriz-autorizacao.md): a permissao send_messages so era
+  -- checada no cliente (hasPermission sobre um array). Esconder o botao nao impedia
+  -- a acao: qualquer authenticated enfileirava mensagem por esta RPC. A checagem passa
+  -- a ser imposta aqui, no banco. user_has_permission() e SECURITY DEFINER e casa
+  -- user_roles.user_id com o auth.uid() do chamador (nao com profiles.id).
+  IF public.user_has_permission(auth.uid(), 'send_messages') IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'send_messages_permission_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_contact_id IS NULL OR p_client_message_id IS NULL
+     OR p_content IS NULL OR length(p_content) > 65536
+     OR v_message_type NOT IN ('text', 'image', 'audio', 'video', 'document', 'sticker', 'location')
+     OR length(COALESCE(p_media_url, '')) > 4096
+     OR length(COALESCE(p_caption, '')) > 65536
+     OR (p_media_url IS NOT NULL AND p_media_url !~ '^https://')
+     OR (v_message_type NOT IN ('text', 'location') AND p_media_url IS NULL)
+     OR (v_message_type = 'location' AND p_media_url IS NOT NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outbound_message' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- SEC-DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE-01: a URL de midia e controlada pelo cliente. Se apontar para
+  -- um bucket interno, o caminho do objeto tem de estar na pasta deste contato (ou de um
+  -- contato do proprio chamador). Sem isso, a mensagem carregaria a URL do objeto de outra
+  -- conversa e a policy de leitura do Storage liberaria a midia alheia.
+  -- Fail-closed: qualquer URL que mencione um bucket interno tem de estar no formato canonico
+  -- acima (object|render/image + public|sign|authenticated). Formas alternativas do Storage
+  -- (ex.: /object/download/, /object/upload/, variante de sign fora do padrao) cairiam fora do
+  -- IF abaixo e passariam sem escopo -- por isso sao recusadas aqui com 22023.
+  IF p_media_url IS NOT NULL
+     AND (p_media_url LIKE '%/whatsapp-media/%' OR p_media_url LIKE '%/audio-messages/%')
+     AND p_media_url !~ '^https://[^/]+/storage/v1/(object|render/image)/(public|sign|authenticated)/(whatsapp-media|audio-messages)/' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outbound_media_url' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_media_url IS NOT NULL
+     AND p_media_url ~ '^https://[^/]+/storage/v1/(object|render/image)/(public|sign|authenticated)/(whatsapp-media|audio-messages)/' THEN
+    v_media_path := split_part(
+      regexp_replace(
+        p_media_url,
+        '^https://[^/]+/storage/v1/(object|render/image)/(public|sign|authenticated)/(whatsapp-media|audio-messages)/',
+        ''
+      ),
+      '?', 1
+    );
+    IF v_media_path = ''
+       OR v_media_path LIKE '%..%'
+       OR lower(v_media_path) LIKE '%2e%2e%'
+       OR lower(v_media_path) LIKE '%2e/' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outbound_media_url' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    v_media_owner := split_part(v_media_path, '/', 1);
+    IF v_media_owner <> p_contact_id::text
+       AND NOT (
+         v_media_owner ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
+         AND public.is_contact_visible_to_user(v_media_owner::uuid, auth.uid()) IS TRUE
+       ) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'media_url_out_of_contact_scope' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT contact.whatsapp_connection_id INTO v_assigned_connection_id
+  FROM public.contacts AS contact
+  WHERE contact.id = p_contact_id
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  -- Preserve the established inbox behavior for legacy contacts that predate
+  -- per-contact connection assignment. The resolved connection is persisted on
+  -- the queued message, making the subsequent lease deterministic.
+  -- An explicit operator choice takes precedence, but must be a live
+  -- connection. Otherwise use the assigned connection only while it is live,
+  -- then deliberately fall back for historical/disconnected assignments.
+  IF p_whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = p_whatsapp_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+    IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF v_assigned_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = v_assigned_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL
+    ORDER BY connection.updated_at DESC, connection.id
+    LIMIT 1;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_connected_whatsapp_connection' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- L7 (docs/ia/IA-004-matriz-autorizacao.md): a escolha da conexao de envio nao
+  -- distinguia fila/departamento -- um agente podia enviar pelo numero de qualquer
+  -- conexao 'connected' (parametro explicito ou o fallback da linha de cima), sem
+  -- relacao com as filas dele. A regra passa a ser imposta aqui:
+  --   * admin/supervisor escolhem qualquer conexao;
+  --   * a conexao atribuida ao proprio contato continua valendo (o front manda
+  --     justamente a conexao do contato);
+  --   * conexao SEM vinculo em whatsapp_connection_queues nao tem escopo para
+  --     comparar -- permanece utilizavel (mesma filosofia de fallback historico
+  --     das conexoes atribuidas acima), entao a mudanca e inerte enquanto a
+  --     tabela de vinculos nao estiver configurada;
+  --   * conexao COM vinculo so pode ser usada por quem e membro ativo de uma das
+  --     filas dela.
+  IF public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
+     AND v_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_assigned_connection_id
+     AND EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id
+     )
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+       FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       JOIN public.queue_members AS member ON member.queue_id = link.queue_id
+       JOIN public.profiles AS caller_profile ON caller_profile.id = member.profile_id
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id
+         AND caller_profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+         AND COALESCE(member.is_active, true)
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'whatsapp_connection_out_of_scope' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_profile_id
+  FROM public.profiles AS profile
+  WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.is_active = true
+  LIMIT 1
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF public.is_contact_visible_to_user(p_contact_id, auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_contact_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_reply_to_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT reply.contact_id INTO v_reply_contact_id
+    FROM public.messages AS reply WHERE reply.id = p_reply_to_id;
+    IF NOT FOUND OR v_reply_contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_contact_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_message_contact_mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
+    hashtextextended(p_contact_id::text || ':' || p_client_message_id::text, 0)
+  );
+
+  INSERT INTO public.messages (
+    contact_id, client_message_id, whatsapp_connection_id, agent_id,
+    sender, content, message_type, media_url, caption, reply_to_id,
+    is_read, status, external_id, status_updated_at
+  ) VALUES (
+    p_contact_id, p_client_message_id, v_connection_id, v_profile_id,
+    'agent', p_content, v_message_type, p_media_url, p_caption, p_reply_to_id,
+    true, 'sending', NULL, statement_timestamp()
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (contact_id, client_message_id)
+    WHERE client_message_id IS NOT NULL
+  DO NOTHING RETURNING * INTO v_message;
+
+  IF v_message.id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT * INTO v_message
+    FROM public.messages AS message
+    WHERE message.contact_id = p_contact_id
+      AND message.client_message_id = p_client_message_id;
+    IF v_message.id IS NULL
+       OR v_message.agent_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_profile_id
+       OR v_message.sender IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent'
+       OR v_message.content IS DISTINCT FROM p_content
+       OR v_message.message_type IS DISTINCT FROM v_message_type
+       OR v_message.media_url IS DISTINCT FROM p_media_url
+       OR v_message.caption IS DISTINCT FROM p_caption
+       OR v_message.reply_to_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_reply_to_id
+       OR v_message.whatsapp_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_connection_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_message_id_reused_with_different_payload'
+        USING ERRCODE = '23505';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v_message;
+END;
+$function$;

+-- 2a) Validador de send_weekdays (erro de dom√≠nio 22023, nunca 22P02).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_talkx_send_weekdays(
+  p_weekdays jsonb,
+  p_error text
+)
+RETURNS smallint[]
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_out smallint[] := '{}';
+  v_elem text;
+  v_day integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_weekdays IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+  IF jsonb_typeof(p_weekdays) <> 'array' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '%', p_error USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  -- teto por chamada: nunca h√° mais de 7 dias v√°lidos (0..6).
+  IF jsonb_array_length(p_weekdays) > 32 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '%', p_error USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  FOR v_elem IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p_weekdays)
+  LOOP
+    BEGIN
+      v_day := v_elem::integer;
+    EXCEPTION
+      WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION '%', p_error USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END;
+    IF v_day IS NULL OR v_day < 0 OR v_day > 6 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION '%', p_error USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT (v_day::smallint = ANY(v_out)) THEN
+      v_out := v_out || v_day::smallint;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF v_out = '{}' THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v_out;
+END;
+$function$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_window_open(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
+)
+RETURNS TABLE (allowed boolean, reason text, next_window timestamptz)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp

+DECLARE
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_tz text;
+  v_local_ts timestamp;
+  v_dnd_hours jsonb;
+  v_weekday smallint;
+  v_now_minutes integer;
+  v_start_minutes integer;
+  v_end_minutes integer;
+BEGIN
+  -- X014: ler a janela de uma campanha √© ato de admin/supervisor, como nas
+  -- RPCs irm√£s (save/update). Sem papel = 42501.
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;

+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns
+   WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

+  END IF;

+  -- schedule_timezone dela. Fuso inv√°lido fecha (fail-closed).
+  BEGIN
+    v_tz := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_campaign.schedule_timezone, ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');

+  --    DND que vira a meia-noite cobre os dois lados; fim exclusivo.
+  --    Fora do contrato fecha (reason dnd). Domingos/feriados s√≥ bloqueiam

+      ELSE

+        v_bh_dow := EXTRACT(DOW FROM p_at AT TIME ZONE v_bh_tz)::smallint;
+      EXCEPTION
+        WHEN invalid_parameter_value THEN
+          RETURN QUERY SELECT false, 'invalid_business_hours', NULL::timestamptz;
+          RETURN;
+      END;
+      v_bh_now_min := EXTRACT(HOUR FROM v_bh_clock)::integer * 60
+        + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM v_bh_clock)::integer;
+
+      IF NOT (v_bh_dow = ANY(v_bh_days_arr))
+         OR v_bh_now_min < v_bh_start_min
+         OR v_bh_now_min >= v_bh_end_min THEN
+        RETURN QUERY SELECT false, 'outside_business_hours', NULL::timestamptz;
+        RETURN;
+      END IF;
+    END;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Tudo passou: janela aberta.
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT true, NULL::text, NULL::timestamptz;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid, timestamptz)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid, timestamptz)
+  TO authenticated;

+-- 3) save_talkx_campaign_draft vigente + novos campos.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_talkx_campaign_draft(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_expected_revision bigint,
+  p_creation_key uuid,
+  p_payload jsonb
+)
+RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, revision bigint, creation_replayed boolean)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_actor_profile_id uuid;
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_now timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
+  v_name text;
+  v_message_template text;
+  v_description text;
+  v_objective text;
+  v_audience_source text;
+  v_audience_filters jsonb;
+  v_segment_id uuid;
+  v_template_id uuid;
+  v_connection_id uuid;
+  v_media_url text;
+  v_media_type text;
+  v_scheduled_at timestamptz;
+  v_schedule_timezone text;
+  v_window_start time;
+  v_window_end time;
+  v_speed_profile text;
+  v_typing_delay_min integer;
+  v_typing_delay_max integer;
+  v_send_interval_min integer;
+  v_send_interval_max integer;
+  v_business_hours_only boolean;
+  v_send_weekdays smallint[];
+  v_respect_dnd boolean;
+  v_respect_suppression boolean;
+  v_confirm_consent boolean;
+  v_draft_step integer;
+  v_owner uuid;
+  v_template_version_id uuid;
+  v_requested_status text;
+  v_max_per_minute smallint;
+  v_pace record;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_actor_profile_id
+   FROM public.profiles profile
+   WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+     AND profile.is_active = true
+   LIMIT 1
+   FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_actor_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X014: criar/editar rascunho √© ato de admin/supervisor.
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) <> 'object'
+     OR pg_column_size(p_payload) > 65536 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_name := NULLIF(btrim(p_payload ->> 'name'), '');
+  v_message_template := COALESCE(p_payload ->> 'message_template', '');
+  v_description := p_payload ->> 'description';
+  v_objective := p_payload ->> 'objective';
+  v_audience_source := p_payload ->> 'audience_source';
+  v_audience_filters := COALESCE(p_payload -> 'audience_filters', '{}'::jsonb);
+  v_segment_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'segment_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_template_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'template_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_connection_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'whatsapp_connection_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_media_url := p_payload ->> 'media_url';
+  v_media_type := p_payload ->> 'media_type';
+  v_scheduled_at := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'scheduled_at', '')::timestamptz;
+  v_schedule_timezone := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'schedule_timezone', ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_window_start := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_window_start', '')::time;
+  v_window_end := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_window_end', '')::time;
+  v_business_hours_only := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'business_hours_only')::boolean, false);
+  -- N-118: dias de envio e opt-out do DND. Fora do contrato levanta
+  -- invalid_talkx_campaign_draft (22023); [] = irrestrito (NULL).
+  v_send_weekdays := public.validate_talkx_send_weekdays(p_payload -> 'send_weekdays', 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft');
+  v_respect_dnd := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'respect_dnd')::boolean, true);
+  v_respect_suppression := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'respect_suppression')::boolean, true);
+  v_confirm_consent := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'confirm_consent')::boolean, false);
+  v_draft_step := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'draft_step', '')::integer, 1);
+  v_owner := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'owner', '')::uuid;
+  v_template_version_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'template_version_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_requested_status := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'status', '');
+
+  -- X018: ritmo derivado do perfil (clamp na faixa) em vez dos valores crus.
+  SELECT * INTO v_pace FROM public.talkx_resolve_speed_pace(
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'speed_profile', ''),
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_interval_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_interval_max', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'typing_delay_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'typing_delay_max', '')::integer
+  );
+  v_speed_profile := v_pace.speed_profile;
+  v_send_interval_min := v_pace.send_interval_min;
+  v_send_interval_max := v_pace.send_interval_max;
+  v_typing_delay_min := v_pace.typing_delay_min;
+  v_typing_delay_max := v_pace.typing_delay_max;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute (nulo = usa o padr√£o do setting; acima do teto -> 22023).
+  v_max_per_minute := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'max_per_minute', '')::smallint;
+
+  -- Unifica√ß√£o owner √ó responsible_id: owner √© o √öNICO respons√°vel.
+  IF v_owner IS NULL THEN
+    v_owner := v_actor_profile_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X017: recusa desmarcar a supress√£o.
+  IF v_respect_suppression IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_respect_suppression_false_nao_liberado' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_name IS NULL OR length(v_name) > 200
+     OR v_objective IS NULL OR v_audience_source IS NULL
+     OR length(v_message_template) > 4096
+     OR (v_description IS NOT NULL AND length(v_description) > 4000)
+     OR v_objective NOT IN ('vendas', 'engajamento', 'reativacao', 'relacionamento', 'pesquisa', 'institucional')
+     OR v_audience_source NOT IN ('contacts', 'segment', 'crm360')
+     OR jsonb_typeof(v_audience_filters) <> 'object'
+     OR (v_audience_source = 'segment' AND v_segment_id IS NULL)
+     OR (v_audience_source <> 'segment' AND v_segment_id IS NOT NULL)
+     OR v_send_interval_min > v_send_interval_max
+     OR v_typing_delay_min > v_typing_delay_max
+     OR v_speed_profile NOT IN ('slow', 'moderate', 'fast')
+     OR (v_media_url IS NOT NULL AND (length(v_media_url) > 8192 OR v_media_url !~ '^https://'))
+     OR (v_media_type IS NOT NULL AND v_media_type NOT IN ('image', 'video', 'document', 'audio'))
+     OR ((v_media_url IS NULL) <> (v_media_type IS NULL))
+     OR public.is_valid_talkx_schedule_timezone(v_schedule_timezone) IS NOT TRUE
+     OR ((v_window_start IS NULL) <> (v_window_end IS NULL))
+     OR (v_window_start IS NOT NULL AND v_window_start >= v_window_end)
+     OR (v_draft_step < 1 OR v_draft_step > 4)
+     OR (v_requested_status IS NOT NULL AND v_requested_status <> 'draft')
+     OR (v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL AND v_max_per_minute < 1) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute acima do teto por minuto da conex√£o -> 22023.
+  IF v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL
+     AND v_max_per_minute > COALESCE((SELECT (settings.value)::text::integer
+                                        FROM public.talkx_settings settings
+                                       WHERE settings.key = 'max_per_minute_per_connection'), 6) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_max_per_minute_acima_do_teto' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_connection_id IS NOT NULL
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+         FROM public.whatsapp_connections connection
+        WHERE connection.id = v_connection_id
+          AND connection.status = 'connected'
+          AND NULLIF(btrim(connection.instance_id), '') IS NOT NULL
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
+    IF p_creation_key IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_key_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaigns (
+      name, message_template, description, objective, audience_source,
+      audience_filters, segment_id, template_id, whatsapp_connection_id,
+      media_url, media_type, scheduled_at, schedule_timezone,
+      send_window_start, send_window_end, business_hours_only, send_weekdays, respect_dnd, speed_profile,
+      typing_delay_min, typing_delay_max, send_interval_min, send_interval_max,
+      max_per_minute,
+      respect_suppression, confirm_consent, draft_step, owner, template_version_id,
+      status, created_by, draft_creation_key, revision, created_at, updated_at
+    ) VALUES (
+      v_name, v_message_template, v_description, v_objective, v_audience_source,
+      v_audience_filters, v_segment_id, v_template_id, v_connection_id,
+      v_media_url, v_media_type, v_scheduled_at, v_schedule_timezone,
+      v_window_start, v_window_end, v_business_hours_only, v_send_weekdays, v_respect_dnd, v_speed_profile,
+      v_typing_delay_min, v_typing_delay_max, v_send_interval_min, v_send_interval_max,
+      v_max_per_minute,
+      v_respect_suppression, v_confirm_consent, v_draft_step, v_owner, v_template_version_id,
+      'draft', v_actor_profile_id, p_creation_key, 1, v_now, v_now
+    )
+    ON CONFLICT (created_by, draft_creation_key) WHERE draft_creation_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
+    RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+    IF FOUND THEN
+      RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, false;
+      RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+      FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     WHERE campaign.created_by = v_actor_profile_id
+       AND campaign.draft_creation_key = p_creation_key
+     FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_recovery_failed' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_campaign.name IS DISTINCT FROM v_name
+       OR v_campaign.message_template IS DISTINCT FROM v_message_template
+       OR v_campaign.description IS DISTINCT FROM v_description
+       OR v_campaign.objective IS DISTINCT FROM v_objective
+       OR v_campaign.audience_source IS DISTINCT FROM v_audience_source
+       OR v_campaign.audience_filters IS DISTINCT FROM v_audience_filters
+       OR v_campaign.segment_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_segment_id
+       OR v_campaign.template_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_template_id
+       OR v_campaign.whatsapp_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_connection_id
+       OR v_campaign.media_url IS DISTINCT FROM v_media_url
+       OR v_campaign.media_type IS DISTINCT FROM v_media_type
+       OR v_campaign.scheduled_at IS DISTINCT FROM v_scheduled_at
+       OR v_campaign.schedule_timezone IS DISTINCT FROM v_schedule_timezone
+       OR v_campaign.send_window_start IS DISTINCT FROM v_window_start
+       OR v_campaign.send_window_end IS DISTINCT FROM v_window_end
+       OR v_campaign.business_hours_only IS DISTINCT FROM v_business_hours_only
+       OR v_campaign.send_weekdays IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_weekdays
+       OR v_campaign.respect_dnd IS DISTINCT FROM v_respect_dnd
+       OR v_campaign.respect_suppression IS DISTINCT FROM v_respect_suppression
+       OR v_campaign.confirm_consent IS DISTINCT FROM v_confirm_consent
+       OR v_campaign.draft_step IS DISTINCT FROM v_draft_step
+       OR v_campaign.owner IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner
+       OR v_campaign.template_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_template_version_id
+       OR v_campaign.speed_profile IS DISTINCT FROM v_speed_profile
+       OR v_campaign.typing_delay_min IS DISTINCT FROM v_typing_delay_min
+       OR v_campaign.typing_delay_max IS DISTINCT FROM v_typing_delay_max
+       OR v_campaign.send_interval_min IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_interval_min
+       OR v_campaign.send_interval_max IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_interval_max
+       OR v_campaign.max_per_minute IS DISTINCT FROM v_max_per_minute THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_key_payload_conflict' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, true;
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_expected_revision IS NULL OR p_expected_revision < 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_expected_revision_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+   FOR UPDATE;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_profile_id
+     AND COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.status NOT IN ('draft', 'scheduled') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_editable' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     SET name = v_name,
+         message_template = v_message_template,
+         description = v_description,
+         objective = v_objective,
+         audience_source = v_audience_source,
+         audience_filters = v_audience_filters,
+         segment_id = v_segment_id,
+         template_id = v_template_id,
+         whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id,
+         media_url = v_media_url,
+         media_type = v_media_type,
+         scheduled_at = v_scheduled_at,
+         schedule_timezone = v_schedule_timezone,
+         send_window_start = v_window_start,
+         send_window_end = v_window_end,
+         business_hours_only = v_business_hours_only,
+         send_weekdays = v_send_weekdays,
+         respect_dnd = v_respect_dnd,
+         respect_suppression = v_respect_suppression,
+         confirm_consent = v_confirm_consent,
+         draft_step = v_draft_step,
+         owner = v_owner,
+         template_version_id = v_template_version_id,
+         speed_profile = v_speed_profile,
+         typing_delay_min = v_typing_delay_min,
+         typing_delay_max = v_typing_delay_max,
+         send_interval_min = v_send_interval_min,
+         send_interval_max = v_send_interval_max,
+         max_per_minute = v_max_per_minute,
+         status = COALESCE(v_requested_status, campaign.status),
+         revision = campaign.revision + 1,
+         updated_at = v_now
+   WHERE campaign.id = v_campaign.id
+   RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, false;
+END;
+$function$;

+-- 4) update_talkx_campaign_limits vigente + novos campos.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_talkx_campaign_limits(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_expected_revision bigint,
+  p_limits jsonb
+)
+RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, revision bigint)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_actor_profile_id uuid;
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_now timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
+  v_speed_profile text;
+  v_send_interval_min integer;
+  v_send_interval_max integer;
+  v_typing_delay_min integer;
+  v_typing_delay_max integer;
+  v_max_per_minute smallint;
+  v_send_window_start time;
+  v_send_window_end time;
+  v_eff_start time;
+  v_eff_end time;
+  v_business_hours_only boolean;
+  v_send_weekdays smallint[];
+  v_respect_dnd boolean;
+  v_before jsonb;
+  v_after jsonb;
+  v_pace record;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_actor_profile_id
+    FROM public.profiles profile
+   WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+     AND profile.is_active = true
+   LIMIT 1
+   FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_actor_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X014: editar limites de campanha √© ato de admin/supervisor.
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_limits IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_limits) <> 'object' OR pg_column_size(p_limits) > 8192 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_limits) AS k
+     WHERE k NOT IN ('speed_profile','send_interval_min','send_interval_max',
+                     'typing_delay_min','typing_delay_max','max_per_minute',
+                     'send_window_start','send_window_end','business_hours_only',
+                     'send_weekdays','respect_dnd')
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_field' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Convers√µes de tipo: erro de convers√£o vira contrato 22023.
+  BEGIN
+    v_max_per_minute := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'max_per_minute', '')::smallint;
+    v_send_window_start := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_window_start', '')::time;
+    v_send_window_end := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_window_end', '')::time;
+    v_business_hours_only := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'business_hours_only', '')::boolean;
+    v_respect_dnd := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'respect_dnd', '')::boolean;
+  EXCEPTION
+    WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR SQLSTATE '22009' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END;
+
+  -- N-118: send_weekdays fora do contrato levanta invalid_talkx_limits_values
+  -- (22023), nunca o CAST cru; [] = irrestrito (NULL).
+  v_send_weekdays := public.validate_talkx_send_weekdays(p_limits -> 'send_weekdays', 'invalid_talkx_limits_values');
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+   FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_profile_id
+     AND COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_expected_revision IS NULL OR v_campaign.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: deriva o ritmo do perfil, clampa valores fora da faixa. Perfil ausente
+  -- no payload mant√©m o atual da campanha; intervalos ausentes derivam do perfil.
+  v_pace := NULL;
+  SELECT * INTO v_pace FROM public.talkx_resolve_speed_pace(
+    CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'speed_profile' THEN NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'speed_profile', '') ELSE v_campaign.speed_profile END,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_interval_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_interval_max', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'typing_delay_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'typing_delay_max', '')::integer
+  );
+  v_speed_profile := v_pace.speed_profile;
+  v_send_interval_min := v_pace.send_interval_min;
+  v_send_interval_max := v_pace.send_interval_max;
+  v_typing_delay_min := v_pace.typing_delay_min;
+  v_typing_delay_max := v_pace.typing_delay_max;
+
+  IF v_send_interval_min > v_send_interval_max
+     OR v_typing_delay_min > v_typing_delay_max THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute acima do teto por minuto da conex√£o -> 22023.
+  IF v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL
+     AND v_max_per_minute > COALESCE((SELECT (settings.value)::text::integer
+                                        FROM public.talkx_settings settings
+                                       WHERE settings.key = 'max_per_minute_per_connection'), 6) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_max_per_minute_acima_do_teto' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Janela de envio EFETIVA (mesma l√≥gica da V09b).
+  v_eff_start := CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_start' THEN v_send_window_start ELSE v_campaign.send_window_start END;
+  v_eff_end   := CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_end'   THEN v_send_window_end   ELSE v_campaign.send_window_end END;
+  IF NOT (
+    (v_eff_start IS NULL AND v_eff_end IS NULL)
+    OR (v_eff_start IS NOT NULL AND v_eff_end IS NOT NULL AND v_eff_start < v_eff_end)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_before := jsonb_build_object(
+    'speed_profile', v_campaign.speed_profile,
+    'send_interval_min', v_campaign.send_interval_min,
+    'send_interval_max', v_campaign.send_interval_max,
+    'typing_delay_min', v_campaign.typing_delay_min,
+    'typing_delay_max', v_campaign.typing_delay_max,
+    'max_per_minute', v_campaign.max_per_minute,
+    'send_window_start', v_campaign.send_window_start,
+    'send_window_end', v_campaign.send_window_end,
+    'business_hours_only', v_campaign.business_hours_only,
+    'send_weekdays', v_campaign.send_weekdays,
+    'respect_dnd', v_campaign.respect_dnd
+  );
+
+  PERFORM set_config('app.talkx_limits_write', 'on', true);
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     SET speed_profile = v_speed_profile,
+         send_interval_min = v_send_interval_min,
+         send_interval_max = v_send_interval_max,
+         typing_delay_min = v_typing_delay_min,
+         typing_delay_max = v_typing_delay_max,
+         max_per_minute = COALESCE(v_max_per_minute, campaign.max_per_minute),
+         send_window_start = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_start' THEN v_send_window_start ELSE campaign.send_window_start END,
+         send_window_end = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_end' THEN v_send_window_end ELSE campaign.send_window_end END,
+         business_hours_only = COALESCE(v_business_hours_only, campaign.business_hours_only),
+         send_weekdays = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_weekdays' THEN v_send_weekdays ELSE campaign.send_weekdays END,
+         respect_dnd = COALESCE(v_respect_dnd, campaign.respect_dnd),
+         revision = campaign.revision + 1,
+         updated_at = v_now
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+     AND campaign.revision = p_expected_revision
+   RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('app.talkx_limits_write', '', true);
+
+  v_after := jsonb_build_object(
+    'speed_profile', v_campaign.speed_profile,
+    'send_interval_min', v_campaign.send_interval_min,
+    'send_interval_max', v_campaign.send_interval_max,
+    'typing_delay_min', v_campaign.typing_delay_min,
+    'typing_delay_max', v_campaign.typing_delay_max,
+    'max_per_minute', v_campaign.max_per_minute,
+    'send_window_start', v_campaign.send_window_start,
+    'send_window_end', v_campaign.send_window_end,
+    'business_hours_only', v_campaign.business_hours_only,
+    'send_weekdays', v_campaign.send_weekdays,
+    'respect_dnd', v_campaign.respect_dnd
+  );
+
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaign_events (campaign_id, event_type, actor_id, message)
+  VALUES (p_campaign_id, 'limits_updated', v_actor_profile_id,
+          jsonb_build_object('before', v_before, 'after', v_after)::text);
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT p_campaign_id, v_campaign.revision;
+END;

+-- talkx_template_save_rpc
+-- Rollback: dropa a RPC save_talkx_template (nova) e a coluna note.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.save_talkx_template(uuid, timestamptz, text, text, text, text, text, text, text[], text[], text);
+--   alter table public.talkx_template_versions drop column if exists note;
+--
+-- Cartao t_a3551220: RPC atomica para salvar um template do Talk X com versao + nota.
+-- Segue o padrao canonico de public.update_talkx_template_with_snapshot
+-- (20260909210000_canonicalize_talkx_template_history.sql): a linha de historico
+-- (talkx_template_versions) guarda o estado ANTERIOR, imutavel, gravada na MESMA
+-- instrucao em que a linha viva e atualizada. E exatamente o que o
+-- guard_talkx_template_update exige (historico batendo com OLD, created_at =
+-- statement_timestamp() e saved_by = get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid())) para
+-- autorizar a mudanca de conteudo, sem service_role.
+
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_template_versions
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS note text;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.talkx_template_versions.note IS
+  'Nota do usuario no momento de salvar o template (cartao t_a3551220).';
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_talkx_template(
+  p_template_id uuid,
+  p_expected_updated_at timestamptz,
+  p_name text,
+  p_content text,
+  p_category text,
+  p_status text,
+  p_media_url text,
+  p_media_type text,
+  p_tags text[],
+  p_custom_variables text[],
+  p_note text
+)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_template public.talkx_templates%ROWTYPE;
+  v_current_updated_at timestamptz;
+  v_version_number integer;
+  v_version_id uuid;
+  v_actor_profile_id uuid;
+  v_saved_at timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
+BEGIN
+  -- Somente usuario autenticado com perfil ativo (nega por padrao).
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_actor_profile_id := public.get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid());
+  IF v_actor_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authenticated_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Optimistic locking: trava a linha e confere a versao esperada.
+  SELECT * INTO v_template
+  FROM public.talkx_templates
+  WHERE id = p_template_id
+  FOR UPDATE;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_template_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_current_updated_at := v_template.updated_at;
+  IF v_current_updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'optimistic_lock_failed' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- version_number = MAX + 1 desta linha.
+  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) + 1 INTO v_version_number
+  FROM public.talkx_template_versions
+  WHERE template_id = p_template_id;
+
+  -- Historico recebe o estado anterior (exigencia do guard canonico) + a nota.
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_template_versions (
+    template_id, version_number, name, description, content, category, status,
+    media_url, media_type, tags, custom_variables, saved_by, created_at, note
+  ) VALUES (
+    p_template_id, v_version_number, v_template.name, v_template.description,
+    v_template.content, v_template.category, v_template.status,
+    v_template.media_url, v_template.media_type, v_template.tags,
+    v_template.custom_variables, v_actor_profile_id, v_saved_at, p_note
+  )
+  RETURNING id INTO v_version_id;
+
+  -- Linha viva recebe o conteudo salvo.
+  UPDATE public.talkx_templates
+  SET name = p_name,
+      content = p_content,
+      category = p_category,
+      status = p_status,
+      media_url = p_media_url,
+      media_type = p_media_type,
+      tags = COALESCE(p_tags, '{}'),
+      custom_variables = COALESCE(p_custom_variables, '{}'),
+      updated_at = now()
+  WHERE id = p_template_id;
+
+  RETURN v_version_id;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION
+  public.save_talkx_template(uuid, timestamptz, text, text, text, text, text, text, text[], text[], text)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION
+  public.save_talkx_template(uuid, timestamptz, text, text, text, text, text, text, text[], text[], text)
+  TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- talkx_blacklist_realtime_column_scope
+-- Rollback: alter publication supabase_realtime drop table public.talkx_blacklist;
+--   alter publication supabase_realtime drop table public.talkx_blacklist;
+--
+-- Nota de rollback: retira public.talkx_blacklist da publicacao supabase_realtime, devolvendo o
+-- estado anterior (tabela NAO publicada). Nenhuma outra mudanca e desfeita porque
+-- a migration nao altera tabela, policy, GRANT nem dado.
+-- `alter publication ... drop table` nao aceita IF EXISTS: o rollback pressupoe
+-- a tabela publicada (estado pos-migration, o mesmo em que o caso (6) o executa).
+--
+-- X069p1 / Realtime: a lista de supressao (public.talkx_blacklist) precisa atualizar as
+-- telas abertas quando um telefone entra ou sai da lista. Para isso ela passa a integrar a
+-- publicacao supabase_realtime ‚Äî mas a tabela guarda o TELEFONE do contato em
+-- talkx_blacklist.phone, e a policy de SELECT da tabela e USING (true) para authenticated:
+-- publicar a tabela SEM lista de colunas entregaria o telefone no payload do Realtime a
+-- qualquer sessao autenticada. Por isso a publicacao entra com LISTA MINIMA DE COLUNAS:
+-- so (id, contact_id) ‚Äî exatamente o que a tela usa para reagir ‚Äî e NADA alem disso
+-- trafega no evento: nem `phone`, nem os metadados que a tela nao consome (reason,
+-- blocked_by, created_at, removed_by, removed_at, origin, campaign_id, reason_code,
+-- expires_at, source_message_id).
+--
+-- Fechado por padrao: id e contact_id existem desde a DDL original da tabela, e o
+-- `add table (...)` abaixo FALHA ALTO se um nome da lista deixar de existir ‚Äî deriva de
+-- DDL vira erro, nao silencio. Se uma DDL futura adicionar coluna que a tela passe a
+-- precisar, uma NOVA migration (revisada) estende a lista; coluna nova nunca entra sozinha.
+--
+-- Forma guardada (idempotente): se a publicacao nao existir, nada acontece; se a tabela ja
+-- estiver publicada (com lista antiga), ela e retirada e readicionada com a lista correta.
+-- Um `alter publication ... add table` direto, como em outras migrations do repo, falharia
+-- em replay com "is already member of publication" (42710).
+do $$
+begin
+  if exists (select 1 from pg_publication where pubname = 'supabase_realtime') then
+    if exists (
+      select 1 from pg_publication_tables
+      where pubname = 'supabase_realtime'
+        and schemaname = 'public'
+        and tablename = 'talkx_blacklist'
+    ) then
+      execute 'alter publication supabase_realtime drop table public.talkx_blacklist';
+    end if;
+    execute 'alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.talkx_blacklist (id, contact_id)';
+  end if;
+end $$;

+--       conversions     = conversoes com occurred_at no periodo;
+--       revenue         = soma de talkx_conversions.value no periodo;
+--       conversion_rate_pct        = conversions / sent * 100;
+--       segment_conversion_rate_pct = conversoes de destinatarios COM segmento / enviadas COM
+--                                     segmento * 100;
+--       funnel          = 5 degraus (sent, delivered, read, replied, conversions) com a contagem

+--   (3) Campo cuja FONTE nunca recebeu dado no escopo (nenhuma leitura registrada em read_at;
+--       nenhuma linha em talkx_conversions) vem NULL, nao zero, para a tela exibir "sem dados

+-- (M:20261002691230). Esta etapa NAO cria grant/REVOKE proprio nessa tabela.
+--

+-- Rollback: veja o bloco acima (recria a funcao X072 + ACL). Nenhum dado se perde.
+--
+-- Nota: nesta versao current/previous tambem ganham 'active' (jsonb_set), como na X072.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_overview_stats(
+  p_from            timestamptz,
+  p_to              timestamptz,
+  p_audience_source text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_department_id   uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_channel         text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_timezone        text DEFAULT 'America/Sao_Paulo'
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_prev_from timestamptz;
+  v_curr      jsonb;
+  v_prev      jsonb;
+  v_active    integer;
+  v_daily     jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_overview_stats: p_from e p_to sao obrigatorios' USING ERRCODE = '22004';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_to <= p_from THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_overview_stats: p_to precisa ser posterior a p_from' USING ERRCODE = '22007';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_prev_from := p_from - (p_to - p_from);
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- current
+  WITH sc AS (
+    SELECT campaign_id
+    FROM public.talkx_analytics_scope(p_audience_source, p_department_id, p_channel)
+  ),
+  camp AS (
+    SELECT c.status, c.failed_count, c.outcome_unknown_count
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS c
+    JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = c.id
+    WHERE c.started_at >= p_from AND c.started_at < p_to
+  ),
+  rec AS (
+    SELECT r.contact_id, r.sent_at, r.delivered_at, r.replied_at, r.read_at, r.segment_id
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+    JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
+    WHERE (r.sent_at >= p_from AND r.sent_at < p_to)
+       OR (r.delivered_at >= p_from AND r.delivered_at < p_to)
+       OR (r.replied_at >= p_from AND r.replied_at < p_to)
+       OR (r.read_at >= p_from AND r.read_at < p_to)
+  ),
+  cv AS (
+    SELECT cv.value,
+           (SELECT r2.segment_id FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r2 WHERE r2.id = cv.recipient_id) AS segment_id
+    FROM public.talkx_conversions AS cv
+    JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = cv.campaign_id
+    WHERE cv.occurred_at >= p_from AND cv.occurred_at < p_to
+  ),
+  flags AS (
+    SELECT
+      EXISTS (SELECT 1
+              FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r2
+              JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = r2.campaign_id
+              WHERE r2.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS any_read,
+      EXISTS (SELECT 1
+              FROM public.talkx_conversions AS c2
+              JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = c2.campaign_id) AS any_conv
+  ),
+  agg AS (
+    SELECT
+      (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE sent_at >= p_from AND sent_at < p_to) AS sent,
+      (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE delivered_at >= p_from AND delivered_at < p_to) AS delivered,
+      (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE replied_at >= p_from AND replied_at < p_to) AS replied,
+      (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE read_at >= p_from AND read_at < p_to) AS read_c,
+      (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE sent_at >= p_from AND sent_at < p_to AND segment_id IS NOT NULL) AS sent_seg,
+      (SELECT count(*) FROM cv) AS conv_c,
+      (SELECT count(*) FROM cv WHERE segment_id IS NOT NULL) AS conv_seg,
+      (SELECT coalesce(sum(value), 0) FROM cv) AS revenue
+  )
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'campaigns_sent',   (SELECT count(*) FROM camp),
+    'completed',        (SELECT count(*) FROM camp WHERE status = 'completed'),
+    'contacts_reached', (SELECT count(DISTINCT contact_id) FROM rec
+                         WHERE sent_at >= p_from AND sent_at < p_to),
+    'sent',             a.sent,
+    'delivered',        a.delivered,
+    'replied',          a.replied,
+    'read',             CASE WHEN f.any_read THEN to_jsonb(a.read_c) ELSE 'null'::jsonb END,
+    'conversions',      CASE WHEN f.any_conv THEN to_jsonb(a.conv_c) ELSE 'null'::jsonb END,
+    'revenue',          CASE WHEN f.any_conv THEN to_jsonb(a.revenue) ELSE 'null'::jsonb END,
+    'failed',           (SELECT coalesce(sum(failed_count), 0) FROM camp),
+    'unknown',          (SELECT coalesce(sum(outcome_unknown_count), 0) FROM camp),
+    'delivery_rate_pct', CASE
+        WHEN a.sent > 0
+        THEN round(a.delivered::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1)
+        ELSE 0 END,
+    'reply_rate_pct', CASE
+        WHEN a.sent > 0
+        THEN round(a.replied::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1)
+        ELSE 0 END,
+    'conversion_rate_pct', CASE
+        WHEN f.any_conv AND a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.conv_c::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1)
+        WHEN f.any_conv THEN 0
+        ELSE NULL END,
+    'segment_conversion_rate_pct', CASE
+        WHEN f.any_conv AND a.sent_seg > 0 THEN round(a.conv_seg::numeric / a.sent_seg * 100, 1)
+        ELSE NULL END,
+    'funnel', jsonb_build_array(
+      jsonb_build_object('step', 'sent',        'count', a.sent,
+        'pct', CASE WHEN a.sent > 0 THEN 100.0 END),
+      jsonb_build_object('step', 'delivered',   'count', a.delivered,
+        'pct', CASE WHEN a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.delivered::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1) END),
+      jsonb_build_object('step', 'read',        'count', CASE WHEN f.any_read THEN a.read_c END,
+        'pct', CASE WHEN f.any_read AND a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.read_c::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1) END),
+      jsonb_build_object('step', 'replied',     'count', a.replied,
+        'pct', CASE WHEN a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.replied::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1) END),
+      jsonb_build_object('step', 'conversions', 'count', CASE WHEN f.any_conv THEN a.conv_c END,
+        'pct', CASE WHEN f.any_conv AND a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.conv_c::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1) END)
+    )
+  ) INTO v_curr
+  FROM agg a CROSS JOIN flags f;
+
+  -- --------------------------------------------------------------- previous
+  -- NULL quando o periodo anterior nao tem campanha iniciada (sem base de comparacao).
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS c
+    JOIN public.talkx_analytics_scope(p_audience_source, p_department_id, p_channel) AS sc
+      ON sc.campaign_id = c.id
+    WHERE c.started_at >= v_prev_from AND c.started_at < p_from
+  ) THEN
+    WITH sc AS (
+      SELECT campaign_id
+      FROM public.talkx_analytics_scope(p_audience_source, p_department_id, p_channel)
+    ),
+    camp AS (
+      SELECT c.status, c.failed_count, c.outcome_unknown_count
+      FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS c
+      JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = c.id
+      WHERE c.started_at >= v_prev_from AND c.started_at < p_from
+    ),
+    rec AS (
+      SELECT r.contact_id, r.sent_at, r.delivered_at, r.replied_at, r.read_at, r.segment_id
+      FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+      JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
+      WHERE (r.sent_at >= v_prev_from AND r.sent_at < p_from)
+         OR (r.delivered_at >= v_prev_from AND r.delivered_at < p_from)
+         OR (r.replied_at >= v_prev_from AND r.replied_at < p_from)
+         OR (r.read_at >= v_prev_from AND r.read_at < p_from)
+    ),
+    cv AS (
+      SELECT cv.value,
+             (SELECT r2.segment_id FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r2 WHERE r2.id = cv.recipient_id) AS segment_id
+      FROM public.talkx_conversions AS cv
+      JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = cv.campaign_id
+      WHERE cv.occurred_at >= v_prev_from AND cv.occurred_at < p_from
+    ),
+    flags AS (
+      SELECT
+        EXISTS (SELECT 1
+                FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r2
+                JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = r2.campaign_id
+                WHERE r2.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS any_read,
+        EXISTS (SELECT 1
+                FROM public.talkx_conversions AS c2
+                JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = c2.campaign_id) AS any_conv
+    ),
+    agg AS (
+      SELECT
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE sent_at >= v_prev_from AND sent_at < p_from) AS sent,
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE delivered_at >= v_prev_from AND delivered_at < p_from) AS delivered,
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE replied_at >= v_prev_from AND replied_at < p_from) AS replied,
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE read_at >= v_prev_from AND read_at < p_from) AS read_c,
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM rec WHERE sent_at >= v_prev_from AND sent_at < p_from AND segment_id IS NOT NULL) AS sent_seg,
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM cv) AS conv_c,
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM cv WHERE segment_id IS NOT NULL) AS conv_seg,

+    )

+      'campaigns_sent',   (SELECT count(*) FROM camp),

+          WHEN f.any_conv THEN 0

+          ELSE NULL END,

+          'pct', CASE WHEN a.sent > 0 THEN 100.0 END),
+        jsonb_build_object('step', 'delivered',   'count', a.delivered,

+          'pct', CASE WHEN f.any_read AND a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.read_c::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1) END),

+          'pct', CASE WHEN a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.replied::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1) END),
+        jsonb_build_object('step', 'conversions', 'count', CASE WHEN f.any_conv THEN a.conv_c END,
+          'pct', CASE WHEN f.any_conv AND a.sent > 0 THEN round(a.conv_c::numeric / a.sent * 100, 1) END)

+  ELSE
+    v_prev := NULL;
+  END IF;

+  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------- active
+  -- O "agora" da operacao, sem recorte de periodo.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_active
+  FROM public.talkx_campaigns AS c

+    ON sc.campaign_id = c.id

+  WITH days AS (
+    SELECT gs::date AS day
+    FROM generate_series(
+      (p_from AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::date,
+      ((p_to - interval '1 microsecond') AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::date,
+      interval '1 day'
+    ) AS gs
+  ),

+    FROM public.talkx_analytics_scope(p_audience_source, p_department_id, p_channel)

+    FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+    JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
+    WHERE r.sent_at >= p_from AND r.sent_at < p_to
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  dlv AS (
+    SELECT (r.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::date AS day, count(*) AS c
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+    JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
+    WHERE r.delivered_at >= p_from AND r.delivered_at < p_to
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  rpl AS (
+    SELECT (r.replied_at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::date AS day, count(*) AS c
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients AS r
+    JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
+    WHERE r.replied_at >= p_from AND r.replied_at < p_to
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  cvd AS (
+    SELECT (cv.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::date AS day, count(*) AS c
+    FROM public.talkx_conversions AS cv
+    JOIN sc ON sc.campaign_id = cv.campaign_id
+    WHERE cv.occurred_at >= p_from AND cv.occurred_at < p_to
+    GROUP BY 1
+  )
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'day',         d.day,
+      'sent',        coalesce(snt.c, 0),
+      'delivered',   coalesce(dlv.c, 0),
+      'replied',     coalesce(rpl.c, 0),
+      'conversions', coalesce(cvd.c, 0)
+    ) ORDER BY d.day
+  )
+  INTO v_daily
+  FROM days d
+  LEFT JOIN snt ON snt.day = d.day
+  LEFT JOIN dlv ON dlv.day = d.day
+  LEFT JOIN rpl ON rpl.day = d.day
+  LEFT JOIN cvd ON cvd.day = d.day;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'period',   jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to, 'timezone', p_timezone),
+    'current',  jsonb_set(v_curr, '{active}', to_jsonb(v_active)),
+    'previous', v_prev,
+    'active',   v_active,
+    'daily',    coalesce(v_daily, '[]'::jsonb)
+  );
+END;
+$fn$;

+-- N-103 Talk X: pesos das variantes somam 100 e atribuicao estavel.
+-- Escopo: apenas a constraint de soma de pesos e a funcao talkx_assign_variant.
+-- Nao adiciona colunas (nenhum DDL de A/B aqui).
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS talkx_template_variants_weight_sum ON public.talkx_template_variants;
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.talkx_assign_variant(uuid, uuid);
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.talkx_validate_template_variant_weights();
+
+-- Constraint de soma de pesos, adiada para o fim da transacao.
+-- Cobre INSERT, UPDATE (de weight ou de template_id) e DELETE:
+--   * INSERT/UPDATE: o template de destino (NEW) precisa somar 100;
+--   * UPDATE que troca template_id: o template de origem (OLD) tambem precisa somar 100;
+--   * DELETE: o template de origem (OLD) precisa somar 100, exceto quando ele fica sem
+--     variantes (todas apagadas) ‚Äî nesse caso o template vazio e aceito.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_validate_template_variant_weights()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_template_id uuid;
+  v_sum integer;
+  v_count integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
+    v_template_id := OLD.template_id;
+  ELSE
+    v_template_id := NEW.template_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(weight), 0), COUNT(*) INTO v_sum, v_count
+  FROM public.talkx_template_variants
+  WHERE template_id = v_template_id;
+
+  -- Template sem variantes restantes (todas apagadas) e aceito.
+  IF v_count > 0 AND v_sum <> 100 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Variant weights for template % sum to %, expected 100', v_template_id, v_sum
+      USING errcode = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Troca de template_id: o template antigo precisa continuar somando 100.
+  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.template_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.template_id THEN
+    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(weight), 0), COUNT(*) INTO v_sum, v_count
+    FROM public.talkx_template_variants
+    WHERE template_id = OLD.template_id;
+
+    IF v_count > 0 AND v_sum <> 100 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Variant weights for template % sum to %, expected 100', OLD.template_id, v_sum
+        USING errcode = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
+END;
+$$;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS talkx_template_variants_weight_sum ON public.talkx_template_variants;
+CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER talkx_template_variants_weight_sum
+AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF weight, template_id OR DELETE
+ON public.talkx_template_variants
+DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
+FOR EACH ROW
+EXECUTE FUNCTION public.talkx_validate_template_variant_weights();
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_validate_template_variant_weights() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_validate_template_variant_weights() TO service_role;
+
+-- Atribuicao estavel: o mesmo contato recebe a mesma variante em dois snapshots.
+-- O bucket 0..99 e derivado do contato sem overflow de integer
+-- (hashtext devolve integer; a mascara bigint evita 'integer out of range' em -2147483648).
+-- Cada variante cobre o intervalo acumulado dos pesos; se nenhuma cobre o bucket,
+-- a funcao levanta erro em vez de devolver variante por fallback silencioso.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_assign_variant(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_template_id uuid
+)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_bucket integer;
+  v_variant_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+  v_bucket := (hashtext(p_contact_id::text)::bigint & 2147483647) % 100;
+
+  SELECT id INTO v_variant_id
+  FROM (
+    SELECT id,
+           SUM(weight) OVER (ORDER BY label ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative
+    FROM public.talkx_template_variants
+    WHERE template_id = p_template_id
+  ) ordered
+  WHERE v_bucket < cumulative
+  ORDER BY cumulative
+  LIMIT 1;
+
+  IF v_variant_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_assign_variant: template % has no variant covering bucket % (weights must sum to 100)', p_template_id, v_bucket
+      USING errcode = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN v_variant_id;
+END;
+$$;

+-- (src/hooks/integrations/useTalkXSegments.ts: RULE_FIELDS nas linhas 65-107 e

+-- por quote_literal/%L. O ramo de data (in_last_days/not_in_last_days)
+-- converte o valor para integer validado ANTES de montar o intervalo, de modo
+-- que o texto cru do valor nunca entra no SQL dinamico.
+--
+-- Semantica de data igual a RPC (20261002391230, linhas 248-259) e ao front
+-- (useTalkXSegments.ts, ramo de data nas linhas 217-224): inicio do dia de
+-- calendario em America/Sao_Paulo, (dias - 1) atras.

+-- CONFLICT, DROP POLICY IF EXISTS + CREATE POLICY, CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION,
+-- REVOKE/GRANT). Reaplicar na mesma base nao altera o resultado.

+-- Compila as regras do segmento em um predicado SQL sobre `c` (alias de
+-- contacts). Cada regra e validada contra talkx_segment_fields; campo,
+-- operador ou valor fora do contrato geram EXCEPTION 22023 (falha fechada).
+--
+-- p_depth existe para a compilacao de segmento dentro de segmento (in_segment):
+-- a profundidade maxima e 1 (docs/talkx/v4/etapas/F09-segmentos.md:46).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_compile_segment_rules(
+  p_rules jsonb,
+  p_depth int DEFAULT 0
+)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_groups     jsonb;
+  v_group      jsonb;
+  v_rule       jsonb;
+  v_match      text;
+  v_field      text;
+  v_op         text;
+  v_value      text;
+  v_kind       text;
+  v_ops        text[];
+  v_expr       text;
+  v_col        text;
+  v_days       integer;
+  v_threshold  timestamptz;
+  v_rule_sql   text;
+  v_rules_sql  text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
+  v_groups_sql text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
+  v_field_row  record;
+BEGIN
+  -- Defesa em profundidade contra recursao (profundidade maxima 1).
+  IF p_depth > 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'segment_rules_depth_exceeded' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_rules IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN '';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF jsonb_typeof(p_rules) <> 'object' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rules' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_groups := p_rules -> 'groups';
+  IF v_groups IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN '';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF jsonb_typeof(v_groups) <> 'array' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rules' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  FOR v_group IN SELECT grp.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_groups) AS grp(value) LOOP
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_group) <> 'object' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_group' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_match := v_group ->> 'match';
+    IF v_match IS NULL OR v_match NOT IN ('and', 'or') THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_group_match' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF jsonb_typeof(v_group -> 'rules') <> 'array' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_group_rules' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_rules_sql := ARRAY[]::text[];
+
+    FOR v_rule IN SELECT r.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_group -> 'rules') AS r(value) LOOP
+      IF jsonb_typeof(v_rule) <> 'object' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+
+      v_field := v_rule ->> 'field';
+      v_op    := v_rule ->> 'op';
+      v_value := v_rule ->> 'value';
+
+      -- Campo tem de existir (e estar habilitado) na lista oficial.
+      SELECT sf.kind, sf.ops, sf.expr
+        INTO v_field_row
+        FROM public.talkx_segment_fields sf
+       WHERE sf.field = v_field
+         AND sf.enabled = true;
+
+      IF NOT FOUND THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_field' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+
+      v_kind := v_field_row.kind;
+      v_ops  := v_field_row.ops;
+      v_expr := v_field_row.expr;
+
+      IF v_op IS NULL OR NOT (v_op = ANY(v_ops)) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_operator' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+
+      -- is_set/is_empty nao exigem valor; os demais exigem valor nao vazio.
+      IF v_op <> 'is_set' AND v_op <> 'is_empty'
+         AND (v_value IS NULL OR btrim(v_value) = '') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+
+      -- Valida o tipo do valor ANTES de montar qualquer cast, para o erro de
+      -- contrato ser sempre 22023 (nunca um 22P02 cru do ::numeric/::uuid).
+      -- No ramo de data o valor vira integer validado (> = 1): e este integer,
+      -- nunca o texto cru, que entra no intervalo do predicado.
+      IF v_kind = 'number' THEN
+        BEGIN
+          PERFORM btrim(v_value)::numeric;
+        EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
+          RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+        END;
+      ELSIF v_kind = 'uuid' AND v_op <> 'is_empty' THEN
+        BEGIN
+          PERFORM btrim(v_value)::uuid;
+        EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
+          RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+        END;
+      ELSIF v_kind = 'date' THEN
+        BEGIN
+          v_days := btrim(v_value)::integer;
+        EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
+          RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+        END;
+        IF v_days IS NULL OR v_days < 1 THEN
+          RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_rule_value' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+        END IF;
+      END IF;
+
+      -- Coluna do contato: identificador citado da tabela oficial, sempre
+      -- entre aspas por format('%I') ‚Äî nao ha como o valor da regra influir aqui.
+      v_col := format('c.%I', v_expr);
+
+      IF v_op = 'is_set' THEN
+        v_rule_sql := format('%s IS NOT NULL', v_col);
+      ELSIF v_op = 'is_empty' THEN
+        IF v_kind = 'array' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('(%s IS NULL OR %s = %L::text[])', v_col, v_col, '{}');
+        ELSIF v_kind = 'uuid' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s IS NULL', v_col);
+        ELSE
+          v_rule_sql := format('(%s IS NULL OR %s = %L)', v_col, v_col, '');
+        END IF;
+      ELSIF v_op = 'contains' THEN
+        IF v_kind = 'array' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s @> ARRAY[%L]::text[]', v_col, v_value);
+        ELSE
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s ILIKE %L', v_col, '%' || v_value || '%');
+        END IF;
+      ELSIF v_op = 'not_contains' THEN
+        IF v_kind = 'array' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('(%s IS NULL OR NOT (%s @> ARRAY[%L]::text[]))', v_col, v_col, v_value);
+        ELSE
+          v_rule_sql := format('(%s IS NULL OR %s NOT ILIKE %L)', v_col, v_col, '%' || v_value || '%');
+        END IF;
+      ELSIF v_op = 'eq' THEN
+        IF v_kind = 'number' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s = %L::numeric', v_col, v_value);
+        ELSIF v_kind = 'uuid' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s = %L::uuid', v_col, v_value);
+        ELSE
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s = %L', v_col, v_value);
+        END IF;
+      ELSIF v_op = 'neq' THEN
+        IF v_kind = 'number' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('(%s IS NULL OR %s <> %L::numeric)', v_col, v_col, v_value);
+        ELSIF v_kind = 'uuid' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('(%s IS NULL OR %s <> %L::uuid)', v_col, v_col, v_value);
+        ELSE
+          v_rule_sql := format('(%s IS NULL OR %s <> %L)', v_col, v_col, v_value);
+        END IF;
+      ELSIF v_op IN ('gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte') THEN
+        v_rule_sql := format('%s %s %L::numeric', v_col,
+          CASE v_op WHEN 'gt' THEN '>' WHEN 'gte' THEN '>=' WHEN 'lt' THEN '<' ELSE '<=' END,
+          v_value);
+      ELSIF v_op IN ('in_last_days', 'not_in_last_days') THEN
+        -- v_days ja e integer validado (>= 1). O intervalo usa o integer; o
+        -- texto cru do valor nunca chega ao SQL dinamico.
+        SELECT ((date_trunc('day', statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
+                 - make_interval(days => v_days - 1))
+                AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
+          INTO v_threshold;
+        IF v_op = 'in_last_days' THEN
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s >= %L::timestamptz', v_col, v_threshold);
+        ELSE
+          v_rule_sql := format('%s < %L::timestamptz', v_col, v_threshold);
+        END IF;
+      END IF;
+
+      v_rules_sql := v_rules_sql || v_rule_sql;
+    END LOOP;
+
+    IF array_length(v_rules_sql, 1) > 0 THEN
+      IF v_match = 'or' THEN
+        v_groups_sql := v_groups_sql || ('(' || array_to_string(v_rules_sql, ' OR ') || ')');
+      ELSE
+        v_groups_sql := v_groups_sql || ('(' || array_to_string(v_rules_sql, ' AND ') || ')');
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  IF array_length(v_groups_sql, 1) > 0 THEN
+    RETURN array_to_string(v_groups_sql, ' OR ');
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN '';
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_compile_segment_rules(jsonb, integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_compile_segment_rules(jsonb, integer) TO authenticated, service_role;
