+--     select jsonb_build_object('sent', jsonb_agg(x.s order by x.i), 'delivered', jsonb_agg(x.d order by x.i), 'replied', jsonb_agg(x.r order by x.i), 'failed', jsonb_agg(x.f order by x.i)) into v_spark from (select i, (select count(*) from public.talkx_recipients t where t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and (p_segment_id is null or t.segment_id = p_segment_id) and t.sent_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5) and t.sent_at < v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) as s, (select count(*) from public.talkx_recipients t where t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and (p_segment_id is null or t.segment_id = p_segment_id) and t.delivered_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5) and t.delivered_at < v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) as d, (select count(*) from public.talkx_recipients t where t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and (p_segment_id is null or t.segment_id = p_segment_id) and t.replied_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5) and t.replied_at < v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) as r, (select count(*) from public.talkx_recipients t where t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id and (p_segment_id is null or t.segment_id = p_segment_id) and t.failed_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5) and t.failed_at < v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) as f from generate_series(0, 11) as i) as x;
+--     v_threshold := make_interval(secs => greatest(180, 3 * (v_camp.send_interval_max + v_camp.typing_delay_max) / 1000.0));
+--     v_last_activity := greatest(v_last_activity, v_camp.started_at, v_camp.updated_at);
+--     if v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id is not null then select status into v_conn from public.whatsapp_connections where id = v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id; end if;
+--     v_state := case when v_camp.status = 'sending' and v_remaining > 0 and v_last_activity < v_now - v_threshold then 'stalled' when v_camp.status = 'sending' then 'sending' when v_camp.status = 'paused' and coalesce(v_camp.pause_reason, 'manual') = 'manual' then 'paused_manual' when v_camp.status = 'paused' then 'paused_auto' when v_camp.status in ('completed', 'cancelled') then 'done' else 'idle' end;
+--     v_reco := case when v_state in ('sending', 'stalled', 'paused_auto') and v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id is not null and v_conn is distinct from 'connected' then 'connection_down' when v_state = 'stalled' then 'stalled' when v_processed >= 50 and v_failed::numeric / v_processed > 0.05 then 'high_failure' when v_total > 0 and v_optouts::numeric / v_total > 0.02 then 'optout_spike' when v_old_sent >= 50 and v_old_delivered::numeric / v_old_sent < 0.8 then 'low_delivery' else 'ok' end;
+--     return jsonb_build_object('kpis', jsonb_build_object('sent', v_sent, 'delivered', v_delivered, 'replied', v_replied, 'failed', v_failed, 'optouts', v_optouts, 'to_confirm', v_unknown, 'skipped', v_skipped, 'remaining', v_remaining, 'total', v_total, 'delivery_rate_pct', case when v_sent > 0 then round(100.0 * v_delivered / v_sent, 1) end, 'optout_rate_pct', case when v_total > 0 then round(100.0 * v_optouts / v_total, 1) end), 'vs_yesterday', case when v_sent_yday > 0 then jsonb_build_object('replied', jsonb_build_object('today', v_replied_today, 'yesterday', v_replied_yday), 'failed', jsonb_build_object('today', v_failed_today, 'yesterday', v_failed_yday)) end, 'forecast', jsonb_build_object('per_minute', null, 'pct_vs_forecast', null, 'estimated_end', null), 'spark', v_spark, 'series', v_series, 'reply_peak', jsonb_build_object('last_10_min', v_peak_now, 'previous_10_min', v_peak_prev), 'health', jsonb_build_object('worker_state', v_state, 'pause_reason', case when v_state = 'paused_auto' then v_camp.pause_reason end, 'last_activity_at', v_last_activity, 'rate_per_minute', round(v_recent_sent / 5.0, 1), 'recommendation_code', v_reco));
+--   end;
+--   $fn$;
+--   revoke all on function public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid, integer, text, date, uuid) from public, anon;
+--   grant execute on function public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid, integer, text, date, uuid) to authenticated;
+--   comment on function public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid, integer, text, date, uuid) is 'Talk X (X140): numeros do monitor da campanha numa conta unica (kpis, vs_yesterday, forecast, spark, series com zeros, reply_peak, health). SECURITY DEFINER; dono ou admin/supervisor, senao 42501.';
+--
+-- N-117 (Fase 11 ¬∑ monitor): adiciona o bloco 'motor' √† saude do talkx_monitor_panel,
+-- lendo dados de public.talkx_engine_health. O bloco inclui:
+--   stalled_campaign, stale_lease, outcome_unknown_24h, failure_rate_15m, cron_status.
+-- A view e security_invoker, mas esta funcao e SECURITY DEFINER: aqui o contexto de quem
+-- consulta a view e o dono da funcao, entao a RLS da view nao filtra. O escopo por campanha
+-- e a barreira: os sinais por campanha sao filtrados por campaign_id = p_campaign_id (a
+-- campanha que o chamador ja provou poder ver). O cron e global (campaign_id IS NULL) e so
+-- aparece para admin/supervisor. Cada sinal usa agregacao (bool_or / max FILTER) para nao
+-- quebrar quando houver mais de uma linha para a mesma campanha.
+-- Autoriza dono da campanha ou admin/supervisor; campanha inexistente e campanha alheia
+-- respondem igual (42501), para nao revelar quais ids existem. Somente leitura.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_monitor_panel(
+  p_campaign_id    uuid,
+  p_window_minutes integer DEFAULT 60,
+  p_bucket         text    DEFAULT 'minute',
+  p_day            date    DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_segment_id     uuid    DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid        uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_now        timestamptz := now();
+  v_camp       public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_tz         text;
+  v_step       interval;
+  v_first      timestamptz;
+  v_last       timestamptz;
+  v_today      timestamptz;
+  v_yesterday  timestamptz;
+  v_threshold  interval;
+  v_conn       text;
+  v_sent integer; v_delivered integer; v_replied integer; v_failed integer;
+  v_unknown integer; v_skipped integer; v_remaining integer; v_total integer;
+  v_processed integer; v_old_sent integer; v_old_delivered integer; v_recent_sent integer;
+  v_peak_now integer; v_peak_prev integer;
+  v_replied_today integer; v_replied_yday integer; v_failed_today integer; v_failed_yday integer;
+  v_sent_yday integer;
+  v_last_activity timestamptz;
+  v_optouts    integer;
+  v_state      text;
+  v_reco       text;
+  v_series     jsonb;
+  v_spark      jsonb;
+  v_motor      jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  -- Autenticacao e autorizacao (mesma regra do X140: dono ou admin/supervisor).
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'acesso negado' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_bucket IS NULL OR p_bucket NOT IN ('minute', 'hour') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_bucket deve ser minute ou hour' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_window_minutes IS NULL OR p_window_minutes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10080 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_window_minutes deve estar entre 1 e 10080' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_camp FROM public.talkx_campaigns WHERE id = p_campaign_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT (
+       v_camp.created_by = (SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_uid LIMIT 1)
+       OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid)
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'acesso negado' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_tz := COALESCE(v_camp.schedule_timezone, 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_timezone_names WHERE name = v_tz) THEN
+    v_tz := 'America/Sao_Paulo';
+  END IF;
+  v_step      := CASE p_bucket WHEN 'hour' THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '1 minute' END;
+  v_today     := date_trunc('day', v_now, v_tz);
+  v_yesterday := date_trunc('day', v_today - interval '12 hours', v_tz);
+
+  IF p_day IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_first := date_trunc(p_bucket, p_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz, v_tz);
+    v_last  := date_trunc(p_bucket,
+                 LEAST(((p_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz) - interval '1 microsecond', v_now), v_tz);
+  ELSE
+    v_last  := date_trunc(p_bucket, v_now, v_tz);
+    v_first := v_last - v_step * (CEIL(p_window_minutes::numeric
+                 / CASE p_bucket WHEN 'hour' THEN 60 ELSE 1 END)::integer - 1);
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'outcome_unknown'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'skipped'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('pending', 'sending')),
+         count(*),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'failed'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at < v_now - interval '10 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at < v_now - interval '10 minutes' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at >= v_now - interval '5 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_now - interval '10 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_now - interval '20 minutes'
+                            AND replied_at < v_now - interval '10 minutes'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied_at >= v_yesterday AND replied_at < v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE failed_at >= v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE failed_at >= v_yesterday AND failed_at < v_today),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at >= v_yesterday AND sent_at < v_today),
+         GREATEST(max(sent_at), max(delivery_claimed_at))
+    INTO v_sent, v_delivered, v_replied, v_failed, v_unknown, v_skipped, v_remaining, v_total,
+         v_processed, v_old_sent, v_old_delivered, v_recent_sent, v_peak_now, v_peak_prev,
+         v_replied_today, v_replied_yday, v_failed_today, v_failed_yday, v_sent_yday,
+         v_last_activity
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients
+   WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+     AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR segment_id = p_segment_id);
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_optouts
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist
+   WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id AND origin = 'optout';
+
+  WITH r AS (
+    SELECT sent_at, delivered_at, replied_at, failed_at
+      FROM public.talkx_recipients
+     WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+       AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR segment_id = p_segment_id)
+  ), ev AS (
+    SELECT 's' AS k, date_trunc(p_bucket, sent_at, v_tz) AS b FROM r
+     WHERE sent_at >= v_first AND sent_at < v_last + v_step
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT 'd', date_trunc(p_bucket, delivered_at, v_tz) FROM r
+     WHERE delivered_at >= v_first AND delivered_at < v_last + v_step
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT 'r', date_trunc(p_bucket, replied_at, v_tz) FROM r
+     WHERE replied_at >= v_first AND replied_at < v_last + v_step
+    UNION ALL
+    SELECT 'f', date_trunc(p_bucket, failed_at, v_tz) FROM r
+     WHERE failed_at >= v_first AND failed_at < v_last + v_step
+  ), cnt AS (
+    SELECT b,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 's') AS s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'd') AS d,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'r') AS r, count(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'f') AS f
+      FROM ev GROUP BY b
+  )
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+           't', g.t, 'sent', COALESCE(c.s, 0), 'delivered', COALESCE(c.d, 0),
+           'replied', COALESCE(c.r, 0), 'failed', COALESCE(c.f, 0)) ORDER BY g.t), '[]'::jsonb)
+    INTO v_series
+    FROM generate_series(v_first, v_last, v_step) AS g(t)
+    LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.b = g.t;
+
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+           'sent',      jsonb_agg(x.s ORDER BY x.i), 'delivered', jsonb_agg(x.d ORDER BY x.i),
+           'replied',   jsonb_agg(x.r ORDER BY x.i), 'failed',    jsonb_agg(x.f ORDER BY x.i))
+    INTO v_spark
+    FROM (
+      SELECT i,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.sent_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.sent_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS s,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.delivered_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.delivered_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS d,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.replied_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.replied_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS r,
+             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.talkx_recipients t WHERE t.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+                 AND (p_segment_id IS NULL OR t.segment_id = p_segment_id)
+                 AND t.failed_at >= v_now - make_interval(mins => (12 - i) * 5)
+                 AND t.failed_at <  v_now - make_interval(mins => (11 - i) * 5)) AS f
+        FROM generate_series(0, 11) AS i
+    ) AS x;
+
+  -- Limiar de parada: o maior entre 180 s e 3x (intervalo maximo + digitacao maxima).
+  v_threshold := make_interval(secs => GREATEST(180,
+                   3 * (v_camp.send_interval_max + v_camp.typing_delay_max) / 1000.0));
+  v_last_activity := GREATEST(v_last_activity, v_camp.started_at, v_camp.updated_at);
+
+  IF v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT status INTO v_conn FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE id = v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_state := CASE
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'sending' AND v_remaining > 0 AND v_last_activity < v_now - v_threshold THEN 'stalled'
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'sending' THEN 'sending'
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'paused' AND COALESCE(v_camp.pause_reason, 'manual') = 'manual' THEN 'paused_manual'
+    WHEN v_camp.status = 'paused' THEN 'paused_auto'
+    WHEN v_camp.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') THEN 'done'
+    ELSE 'idle'
+  END;
+
+  v_reco := CASE
+    WHEN v_state IN ('sending', 'stalled', 'paused_auto')
+         AND v_camp.whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL
+         AND v_conn IS DISTINCT FROM 'connected' THEN 'connection_down'
+    WHEN v_state = 'stalled' THEN 'stalled'
+    WHEN v_processed >= 50 AND v_failed::numeric / v_processed > 0.05 THEN 'high_failure'
+    WHEN v_total > 0 AND v_optouts::numeric / v_total > 0.02 THEN 'optout_spike'
+    WHEN v_old_sent >= 50 AND v_old_delivered::numeric / v_old_sent < 0.8 THEN 'low_delivery'
+    ELSE 'ok'
+  END;
+
+  -- === N-117: bloco motor lido de talkx_engine_health, escopado a campanha ===
+  -- Agregacoes (bool_or / max FILTER) + filtro campaign_id tornam o bloco seguro contra
+  -- varias linhas para a mesma campanha e contra leitura de outra campanha (a view
+  -- security_invoker nao aplica RLS dentro desta funcao SECURITY DEFINER).
+  v_motor := (
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+      'stalled_campaign',    COALESCE(bool_or(h.kind = 'stalled_campaign'), false),
+      'stale_lease',         COALESCE(bool_or(h.kind = 'stale_lease'), false),
+      'outcome_unknown_24h', COALESCE(max(h.metric_count) FILTER (WHERE h.kind = 'outcome_unknown_24h'), 0),
+      'failure_rate_15m',    COALESCE(max(h.metric_rate)  FILTER (WHERE h.kind = 'failure_rate_15m'), 0),
+      'cron_status', CASE
+        WHEN public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid) THEN COALESCE((
+          SELECT c.status FROM public.talkx_engine_health AS c
+           WHERE c.kind = 'cron_run' AND c.campaign_id IS NULL
+           ORDER BY c.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'unknown')
+        ELSE 'unknown'
+      END
+    )
+      FROM public.talkx_engine_health AS h
+     WHERE h.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+  );
+
+  -- Resposta final (mesma estrutura do X140 + bloco motor na saude).
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'kpis', jsonb_build_object(
+      'sent', v_sent, 'delivered', v_delivered, 'replied', v_replied, 'failed', v_failed,
+      'optouts', v_optouts, 'to_confirm', v_unknown, 'skipped', v_skipped,
+      'remaining', v_remaining, 'total', v_total,
+      'delivery_rate_pct', CASE WHEN v_sent > 0 THEN round(100.0 * v_delivered / v_sent, 1) END,
+      'optout_rate_pct',   CASE WHEN v_total > 0 THEN round(100.0 * v_optouts / v_total, 1) END),
+    'vs_yesterday', CASE WHEN v_sent_yday > 0 THEN jsonb_build_object(
+      'replied', jsonb_build_object('today', v_replied_today, 'yesterday', v_replied_yday),
+      'failed',  jsonb_build_object('today', v_failed_today,  'yesterday', v_failed_yday)) END,
+    'forecast', jsonb_build_object('per_minute', NULL, 'pct_vs_forecast', NULL, 'estimated_end', NULL),
+    'spark', v_spark,
+    'series', v_series,
+    'reply_peak', jsonb_build_object('last_10_min', v_peak_now, 'previous_10_min', v_peak_prev),
+    'health', jsonb_build_object(
+      'worker_state', v_state,
+      'pause_reason', CASE WHEN v_state = 'paused_auto' THEN v_camp.pause_reason END,
+      'last_activity_at', v_last_activity,
+      'rate_per_minute', round(v_recent_sent / 5.0, 1),
+      'recommendation_code', v_reco,
+      'motor', v_motor)
+  );
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid, integer, text, date, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid, integer, text, date, uuid) TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talkx_monitor_panel(uuid, integer, text, date, uuid) IS
+  'Talk X (N-117 + X140): numeros do monitor da campanha numa conta unica (kpis, vs_yesterday, forecast, spark, series com zeros, reply_peak, health com bloco motor de talkx_engine_health escopado a campanha). SECURITY DEFINER; dono ou admin/supervisor, senao 42501.';

+--     -- X018: max_per_minute acima do teto por minuto da conex√£o -> 22023.
+--     IF v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL
+--        AND v_max_per_minute > COALESCE((SELECT (settings.value)::text::integer
+--                                           FROM public.talkx_settings settings
+--                                          WHERE settings.key = 'max_per_minute_per_connection'), 6) THEN
+--       RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_max_per_minute_acima_do_teto' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+--     END IF;
+--
+--     -- Janela de envio EFETIVA (mesma l√≥gica da V09b).
+--     v_eff_start := CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_start' THEN v_send_window_start ELSE v_campaign.send_window_start END;
+--     v_eff_end   := CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_end'   THEN v_send_window_end   ELSE v_campaign.send_window_end END;
+--     IF NOT (
+--       (v_eff_start IS NULL AND v_eff_end IS NULL)
+--       OR (v_eff_start IS NOT NULL AND v_eff_end IS NOT NULL AND v_eff_start < v_eff_end)
+--     ) THEN
+--       RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+--     END IF;
+--
+--     v_before := jsonb_build_object(
+--       'speed_profile', v_campaign.speed_profile,
+--       'send_interval_min', v_campaign.send_interval_min,
+--       'send_interval_max', v_campaign.send_interval_max,
+--       'typing_delay_min', v_campaign.typing_delay_min,
+--       'typing_delay_max', v_campaign.typing_delay_max,
+--       'max_per_minute', v_campaign.max_per_minute,
+--       'send_window_start', v_campaign.send_window_start,
+--       'send_window_end', v_campaign.send_window_end,
+--       'business_hours_only', v_campaign.business_hours_only
+--     );
+--
+--     PERFORM set_config('app.talkx_limits_write', 'on', true);
+--
+--     UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+--        SET speed_profile = v_speed_profile,
+--            send_interval_min = v_send_interval_min,
+--            send_interval_max = v_send_interval_max,
+--            typing_delay_min = v_typing_delay_min,
+--            typing_delay_max = v_typing_delay_max,
+--            max_per_minute = COALESCE(v_max_per_minute, campaign.max_per_minute),
+--            send_window_start = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_start' THEN v_send_window_start ELSE campaign.send_window_start END,
+--            send_window_end = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_end' THEN v_send_window_end ELSE campaign.send_window_end END,
+--            business_hours_only = COALESCE(v_business_hours_only, campaign.business_hours_only),
+--            revision = campaign.revision + 1,
+--            updated_at = v_now
+--      WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+--        AND campaign.revision = p_expected_revision
+--      RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+--
+--     IF NOT FOUND THEN
+--       RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+--     END IF;
+--
+--     PERFORM set_config('app.talkx_limits_write', '', true);
+--
+--     v_after := jsonb_build_object(
+--       'speed_profile', v_campaign.speed_profile,
+--       'send_interval_min', v_campaign.send_interval_min,
+--       'send_interval_max', v_campaign.send_interval_max,
+--       'typing_delay_min', v_campaign.typing_delay_min,
+--       'typing_delay_max', v_campaign.typing_delay_max,
+--       'max_per_minute', v_campaign.max_per_minute,
+--       'send_window_start', v_campaign.send_window_start,
+--       'send_window_end', v_campaign.send_window_end,
+--       'business_hours_only', v_campaign.business_hours_only
+--     );
+--
+--     INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaign_events (campaign_id, event_type, actor_id, message)
+--     VALUES (p_campaign_id, 'limits_updated', v_actor_profile_id,
+--             jsonb_build_object('before', v_before, 'after', v_after)::text);
+--
+--     RETURN QUERY SELECT p_campaign_id, v_campaign.revision;
+--   END;
+--   $function$;
+
+-- N-102b: corpos novos (vigentes + conversao de send_weekdays).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_talkx_campaign_draft(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_expected_revision bigint,
+  p_creation_key uuid,
+  p_payload jsonb
+)
+RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, revision bigint, creation_replayed boolean)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_actor_profile_id uuid;
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_now timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
+  v_name text;
+  v_message_template text;
+  v_description text;
+  v_objective text;
+  v_audience_source text;
+  v_audience_filters jsonb;
+  v_segment_id uuid;
+  v_template_id uuid;
+  v_connection_id uuid;
+  v_media_url text;
+  v_media_type text;
+  v_scheduled_at timestamptz;
+  v_schedule_timezone text;
+  v_window_start time;
+  v_window_end time;
+  v_speed_profile text;
+  v_typing_delay_min integer;
+  v_typing_delay_max integer;
+  v_send_interval_min integer;
+  v_send_interval_max integer;
+  v_business_hours_only boolean;
+  v_send_weekdays smallint[];
+  v_respect_dnd boolean;
+  v_respect_suppression boolean;
+  v_confirm_consent boolean;
+  v_legal_basis text;
+  v_consent_by uuid;
+  v_consent_at timestamptz;
+  v_draft_step integer;
+  v_owner uuid;
+  v_template_version_id uuid;
+  v_requested_status text;
+  v_max_per_minute smallint;
+  v_pace record;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_actor_profile_id
+   FROM public.profiles profile
+   WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+     AND profile.is_active = true
+   LIMIT 1
+   FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_actor_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X014: criar/editar rascunho √© ato de admin/supervisor.
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) <> 'object'
+     OR pg_column_size(p_payload) > 65536 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_name := NULLIF(btrim(p_payload ->> 'name'), '');
+  v_message_template := COALESCE(p_payload ->> 'message_template', '');
+  v_description := p_payload ->> 'description';
+  v_objective := p_payload ->> 'objective';
+  v_audience_source := p_payload ->> 'audience_source';
+  v_audience_filters := COALESCE(p_payload -> 'audience_filters', '{}'::jsonb);
+  v_segment_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'segment_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_template_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'template_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_connection_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'whatsapp_connection_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_media_url := p_payload ->> 'media_url';
+  v_media_type := p_payload ->> 'media_type';
+  v_scheduled_at := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'scheduled_at', '')::timestamptz;
+  v_schedule_timezone := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'schedule_timezone', ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_window_start := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_window_start', '')::time;
+  v_window_end := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_window_end', '')::time;
+  v_business_hours_only := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'business_hours_only')::boolean, false);
+  -- N-102b: send_weekdays chega como jsonb (array de 0=dom..6=sab). Converte
+  -- elemento a elemento por TEXTO para smallint[].
+  -- Faixa 0..6 validada ANTES do cast em numeric (sem overflow): [99999] cai em 22023.
+  IF (p_payload -> 'send_weekdays') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p_payload -> 'send_weekdays')) <> 'null' THEN
+    IF jsonb_typeof((p_payload -> 'send_weekdays')) <> 'array' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1
+        FROM jsonb_array_elements((p_payload -> 'send_weekdays')) AS item
+       WHERE jsonb_typeof(item) <> 'number'
+          OR (item)::text ~ '[.eE]'
+          OR (item)::numeric < 0
+          OR (item)::numeric > 6
+    ) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    v_send_weekdays := ARRAY(
+      SELECT element.value::text::smallint
+        FROM jsonb_array_elements((p_payload -> 'send_weekdays')) WITH ORDINALITY AS element(value, ord)
+       ORDER BY element.ord
+    );
+  ELSE
+    v_send_weekdays := NULL;
+  END IF;
+  v_respect_dnd := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'respect_dnd')::boolean, true);
+  v_respect_suppression := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'respect_suppression')::boolean, true);
+  v_confirm_consent := COALESCE((p_payload ->> 'confirm_consent')::boolean, false);
+  v_draft_step := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'draft_step', '')::integer, 1);
+  v_owner := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'owner', '')::uuid;
+  v_template_version_id := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'template_version_id', '')::uuid;
+  v_requested_status := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'status', '');
+
+  -- X032: base legal e carimbo do operador que confirmou. A confirmacao so e gravada
+  -- quando o operador marca o checkbox (confirm_consent); desmarcar limpa o carimbo.
+  -- O carimbo original e preservado mais abaixo (update), quando ja existia.
+  v_legal_basis := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_payload ->> 'legal_basis', '')), '');
+  IF v_confirm_consent THEN
+    v_consent_by := v_actor_profile_id;
+    v_consent_at := v_now;
+  ELSE
+    v_consent_by := NULL;
+    v_consent_at := NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: ritmo derivado do perfil (clamp na faixa) em vez dos valores crus.
+  SELECT * INTO v_pace FROM public.talkx_resolve_speed_pace(
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'speed_profile', ''),
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_interval_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'send_interval_max', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'typing_delay_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'typing_delay_max', '')::integer
+  );
+  v_speed_profile := v_pace.speed_profile;
+  v_send_interval_min := v_pace.send_interval_min;
+  v_send_interval_max := v_pace.send_interval_max;
+  v_typing_delay_min := v_pace.typing_delay_min;
+  v_typing_delay_max := v_pace.typing_delay_max;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute (nulo = usa o padr√£o do setting; acima do teto -> 22023).
+  v_max_per_minute := NULLIF(p_payload ->> 'max_per_minute', '')::smallint;
+
+  -- Unifica√ß√£o owner √ó responsible_id: owner √© o √öNICO respons√°vel.
+  IF v_owner IS NULL THEN
+    v_owner := v_actor_profile_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X017: recusa desmarcar a supress√£o.
+  IF v_respect_suppression IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_respect_suppression_false_nao_liberado' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_name IS NULL OR length(v_name) > 200
+     OR v_objective IS NULL OR v_audience_source IS NULL
+     OR length(v_message_template) > 4096
+     OR (v_description IS NOT NULL AND length(v_description) > 4000)
+     OR v_objective NOT IN ('vendas', 'engajamento', 'reativacao', 'relacionamento', 'pesquisa', 'institucional')
+     OR v_audience_source NOT IN ('contacts', 'segment', 'crm360')
+     OR jsonb_typeof(v_audience_filters) <> 'object'
+     OR (v_audience_source = 'segment' AND v_segment_id IS NULL)
+     OR (v_audience_source <> 'segment' AND v_segment_id IS NOT NULL)
+     OR v_send_interval_min > v_send_interval_max
+     OR v_typing_delay_min > v_typing_delay_max
+     OR v_speed_profile NOT IN ('slow', 'moderate', 'fast')
+     OR (v_media_url IS NOT NULL AND (length(v_media_url) > 8192 OR v_media_url !~ '^https://'))
+     OR (v_media_type IS NOT NULL AND v_media_type NOT IN ('image', 'video', 'document', 'audio'))
+     OR ((v_media_url IS NULL) <> (v_media_type IS NULL))
+     OR public.is_valid_talkx_schedule_timezone(v_schedule_timezone) IS NOT TRUE
+     OR ((v_window_start IS NULL) <> (v_window_end IS NULL))
+     OR (v_window_start IS NOT NULL AND v_window_start >= v_window_end)
+     OR (v_legal_basis IS NOT NULL AND v_legal_basis NOT IN ('consent', 'legitimate_interest', 'contract'))
+     OR (v_draft_step < 1 OR v_draft_step > 4)
+     OR (v_requested_status IS NOT NULL AND v_requested_status <> 'draft')
+     OR (v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL AND v_max_per_minute < 1)
+     OR (v_send_weekdays IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT bool_or(n < 0 OR n > 6) FROM unnest(v_send_weekdays) AS n)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_campaign_draft' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute acima do teto por minuto da conex√£o -> 22023.
+  IF v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL
+     AND v_max_per_minute > COALESCE((SELECT (settings.value)::text::integer
+                                        FROM public.talkx_settings settings
+                                       WHERE settings.key = 'max_per_minute_per_connection'), 6) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_max_per_minute_acima_do_teto' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_connection_id IS NOT NULL
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+         FROM public.whatsapp_connections connection
+        WHERE connection.id = v_connection_id
+          AND connection.status = 'connected'
+          AND NULLIF(btrim(connection.instance_id), '') IS NOT NULL
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_campaign_id IS NULL THEN
+    IF p_creation_key IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_key_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaigns (
+      name, message_template, description, objective, audience_source,
+      audience_filters, segment_id, template_id, whatsapp_connection_id,
+      media_url, media_type, scheduled_at, schedule_timezone,
+      send_window_start, send_window_end, business_hours_only, send_weekdays, respect_dnd, speed_profile,
+      typing_delay_min, typing_delay_max, send_interval_min, send_interval_max,
+      max_per_minute,
+      respect_suppression, confirm_consent, legal_basis, consent_confirmed_by, consent_confirmed_at,
+      draft_step, owner, template_version_id,
+      status, created_by, draft_creation_key, revision, created_at, updated_at
+    ) VALUES (
+      v_name, v_message_template, v_description, v_objective, v_audience_source,
+      v_audience_filters, v_segment_id, v_template_id, v_connection_id,
+      v_media_url, v_media_type, v_scheduled_at, v_schedule_timezone,
+      v_window_start, v_window_end, v_business_hours_only, v_send_weekdays, v_respect_dnd, v_speed_profile,
+      v_typing_delay_min, v_typing_delay_max, v_send_interval_min, v_send_interval_max,
+      v_max_per_minute,
+      v_respect_suppression, v_confirm_consent, v_legal_basis, v_consent_by, v_consent_at,
+      v_draft_step, v_owner, v_template_version_id,
+      'draft', v_actor_profile_id, p_creation_key, 1, v_now, v_now
+    )
+    ON CONFLICT (created_by, draft_creation_key) WHERE draft_creation_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
+    RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+    IF FOUND THEN
+      RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, false;
+      RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+      FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     WHERE campaign.created_by = v_actor_profile_id
+       AND campaign.draft_creation_key = p_creation_key
+     FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_recovery_failed' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_campaign.name IS DISTINCT FROM v_name
+       OR v_campaign.message_template IS DISTINCT FROM v_message_template
+       OR v_campaign.description IS DISTINCT FROM v_description
+       OR v_campaign.objective IS DISTINCT FROM v_objective
+       OR v_campaign.audience_source IS DISTINCT FROM v_audience_source
+       OR v_campaign.audience_filters IS DISTINCT FROM v_audience_filters
+       OR v_campaign.segment_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_segment_id
+       OR v_campaign.template_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_template_id
+       OR v_campaign.whatsapp_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_connection_id
+       OR v_campaign.media_url IS DISTINCT FROM v_media_url
+       OR v_campaign.media_type IS DISTINCT FROM v_media_type
+       OR v_campaign.scheduled_at IS DISTINCT FROM v_scheduled_at
+       OR v_campaign.schedule_timezone IS DISTINCT FROM v_schedule_timezone
+       OR v_campaign.send_window_start IS DISTINCT FROM v_window_start
+       OR v_campaign.send_window_end IS DISTINCT FROM v_window_end
+       OR v_campaign.business_hours_only IS DISTINCT FROM v_business_hours_only
+       OR v_campaign.send_weekdays IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_weekdays
+       OR v_campaign.respect_dnd IS DISTINCT FROM v_respect_dnd
+       OR v_campaign.respect_suppression IS DISTINCT FROM v_respect_suppression
+       OR v_campaign.confirm_consent IS DISTINCT FROM v_confirm_consent
+       OR v_campaign.legal_basis IS DISTINCT FROM v_legal_basis
+       OR (v_campaign.consent_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM v_confirm_consent
+       OR v_campaign.draft_step IS DISTINCT FROM v_draft_step
+       OR v_campaign.owner IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner
+       OR v_campaign.template_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_template_version_id
+       OR v_campaign.speed_profile IS DISTINCT FROM v_speed_profile
+       OR v_campaign.typing_delay_min IS DISTINCT FROM v_typing_delay_min
+       OR v_campaign.typing_delay_max IS DISTINCT FROM v_typing_delay_max
+       OR v_campaign.send_interval_min IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_interval_min
+       OR v_campaign.send_interval_max IS DISTINCT FROM v_send_interval_max
+       OR v_campaign.max_per_minute IS DISTINCT FROM v_max_per_minute THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_creation_key_payload_conflict' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, true;
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_expected_revision IS NULL OR p_expected_revision < 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_draft_expected_revision_required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+   FOR UPDATE;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_profile_id
+     AND COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.status NOT IN ('draft', 'scheduled') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_editable' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X032: nao "piscar" o carimbo ‚Äî se ja havia confirmacao, mantem o autor/instante originais.
+  IF v_confirm_consent AND v_campaign.consent_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_consent_by := v_campaign.consent_confirmed_by;
+    v_consent_at := v_campaign.consent_confirmed_at;
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     SET name = v_name,
+         message_template = v_message_template,
+         description = v_description,
+         objective = v_objective,
+         audience_source = v_audience_source,
+         audience_filters = v_audience_filters,
+         segment_id = v_segment_id,
+         template_id = v_template_id,
+         whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id,
+         media_url = v_media_url,
+         media_type = v_media_type,
+         scheduled_at = v_scheduled_at,
+         schedule_timezone = v_schedule_timezone,
+         send_window_start = v_window_start,
+         send_window_end = v_window_end,
+         business_hours_only = v_business_hours_only,
+         send_weekdays = v_send_weekdays,
+         respect_dnd = v_respect_dnd,
+         respect_suppression = v_respect_suppression,
+         confirm_consent = v_confirm_consent,
+         legal_basis = v_legal_basis,
+         consent_confirmed_by = v_consent_by,
+         consent_confirmed_at = v_consent_at,
+         draft_step = v_draft_step,
+         owner = v_owner,
+         template_version_id = v_template_version_id,
+         speed_profile = v_speed_profile,
+         typing_delay_min = v_typing_delay_min,
+         typing_delay_max = v_typing_delay_max,
+         send_interval_min = v_send_interval_min,
+         send_interval_max = v_send_interval_max,
+         max_per_minute = v_max_per_minute,
+         status = COALESCE(v_requested_status, campaign.status),
+         revision = campaign.revision + 1,
+         updated_at = v_now
+   WHERE campaign.id = v_campaign.id
+   RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_campaign.id, v_campaign.revision, false;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_talkx_campaign_limits(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_expected_revision bigint,
+  p_limits jsonb
+)
+RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id uuid, revision bigint)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_actor_profile_id uuid;
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_now timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
+  v_speed_profile text;
+  v_send_interval_min integer;
+  v_send_interval_max integer;
+  v_typing_delay_min integer;
+  v_typing_delay_max integer;
+  v_max_per_minute smallint;
+  v_send_window_start time;
+  v_send_window_end time;
+  v_eff_start time;
+  v_eff_end time;
+  v_business_hours_only boolean;
+  v_send_weekdays smallint[];
+  v_respect_dnd boolean;
+  v_before jsonb;
+  v_after jsonb;
+  v_pace record;
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_actor_profile_id
+    FROM public.profiles profile
+   WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+     AND profile.is_active = true
+   LIMIT 1
+   FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_actor_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X014: editar limites de campanha √© ato de admin/supervisor.
+  IF COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_limits IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_limits) <> 'object' OR pg_column_size(p_limits) > 8192 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_payload' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_limits) AS k
+     WHERE k NOT IN ('speed_profile','send_interval_min','send_interval_max',
+                     'typing_delay_min','typing_delay_max','max_per_minute',
+                     'send_window_start','send_window_end','business_hours_only',
+                     'send_weekdays','respect_dnd')
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_field' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Convers√µes de tipo: erro de convers√£o vira contrato 22023.
+  BEGIN
+    v_max_per_minute := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'max_per_minute', '')::smallint;
+    v_send_window_start := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_window_start', '')::time;
+    v_send_window_end := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_window_end', '')::time;
+    v_business_hours_only := NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'business_hours_only', '')::boolean;
+  -- N-102b: send_weekdays chega como jsonb (array de 0=dom..6=sab). Converte
+  -- elemento a elemento por TEXTO para smallint[]. Faixa 0..6 validada ANTES do
+  -- cast em numeric (sem overflow): [99999] cai em 22023 (dentro deste bloco,
+  -- numeric_value_out_of_range tambem mapeia para 22023).
+    IF (p_limits -> 'send_weekdays') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p_limits -> 'send_weekdays')) <> 'null' THEN
+      IF jsonb_typeof((p_limits -> 'send_weekdays')) <> 'array' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+      IF EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+          FROM jsonb_array_elements((p_limits -> 'send_weekdays')) AS item
+         WHERE jsonb_typeof(item) <> 'number'
+            OR (item)::text ~ '[.eE]'
+            OR (item)::numeric < 0
+            OR (item)::numeric > 6
+      ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+      END IF;
+      v_send_weekdays := ARRAY(
+        SELECT element.value::text::smallint
+          FROM jsonb_array_elements((p_limits -> 'send_weekdays')) WITH ORDINALITY AS element(value, ord)
+         ORDER BY element.ord
+      );
+    ELSE
+      v_send_weekdays := NULL;
+    END IF;
+    v_respect_dnd := COALESCE((p_limits ->> 'respect_dnd')::boolean, true);
+  EXCEPTION
+    WHEN invalid_text_representation OR invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR SQLSTATE '22009' THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END;
+  -- N-102b: defesa em profundidade (o EXISTS acima ja garante 0..6 antes do cast).
+  IF (v_send_weekdays IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT bool_or(n < 0 OR n > 6) FROM unnest(v_send_weekdays) AS n)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+   FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_campaign.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_profile_id
+     AND COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_expected_revision IS NULL OR v_campaign.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_revision THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: deriva o ritmo do perfil, clampa valores fora da faixa. Perfil ausente
+  -- no payload mant√©m o atual da campanha; intervalos ausentes derivam do perfil.
+  v_pace := NULL;
+  SELECT * INTO v_pace FROM public.talkx_resolve_speed_pace(
+    CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'speed_profile' THEN NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'speed_profile', '') ELSE v_campaign.speed_profile END,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_interval_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'send_interval_max', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'typing_delay_min', '')::integer,
+    NULLIF(p_limits ->> 'typing_delay_max', '')::integer
+  );
+  v_speed_profile := v_pace.speed_profile;
+  v_send_interval_min := v_pace.send_interval_min;
+  v_send_interval_max := v_pace.send_interval_max;
+  v_typing_delay_min := v_pace.typing_delay_min;
+  v_typing_delay_max := v_pace.typing_delay_max;
+
+  IF v_send_interval_min > v_send_interval_max
+     OR v_typing_delay_min > v_typing_delay_max THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- X018: max_per_minute acima do teto por minuto da conex√£o -> 22023.
+  IF v_max_per_minute IS NOT NULL
+     AND v_max_per_minute > COALESCE((SELECT (settings.value)::text::integer
+                                        FROM public.talkx_settings settings
+                                       WHERE settings.key = 'max_per_minute_per_connection'), 6) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_max_per_minute_acima_do_teto' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Janela de envio EFETIVA (mesma l√≥gica da V09b).
+  v_eff_start := CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_start' THEN v_send_window_start ELSE v_campaign.send_window_start END;
+  v_eff_end   := CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_end'   THEN v_send_window_end   ELSE v_campaign.send_window_end END;
+  IF NOT (
+    (v_eff_start IS NULL AND v_eff_end IS NULL)
+    OR (v_eff_start IS NOT NULL AND v_eff_end IS NOT NULL AND v_eff_start < v_eff_end)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_limits_values' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_before := jsonb_build_object(
+    'speed_profile', v_campaign.speed_profile,
+    'send_interval_min', v_campaign.send_interval_min,
+    'send_interval_max', v_campaign.send_interval_max,
+    'typing_delay_min', v_campaign.typing_delay_min,
+    'typing_delay_max', v_campaign.typing_delay_max,
+    'max_per_minute', v_campaign.max_per_minute,
+    'send_window_start', v_campaign.send_window_start,
+    'send_window_end', v_campaign.send_window_end,
+    'business_hours_only', v_campaign.business_hours_only,
+    'send_weekdays', v_campaign.send_weekdays,
+    'respect_dnd', v_campaign.respect_dnd
+  );
+
+  PERFORM set_config('app.talkx_limits_write', 'on', true);
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_campaigns campaign
+     SET speed_profile = v_speed_profile,
+         send_interval_min = v_send_interval_min,
+         send_interval_max = v_send_interval_max,
+         typing_delay_min = v_typing_delay_min,
+         typing_delay_max = v_typing_delay_max,
+         max_per_minute = COALESCE(v_max_per_minute, campaign.max_per_minute),
+         send_window_start = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_start' THEN v_send_window_start ELSE campaign.send_window_start END,
+         send_window_end = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_window_end' THEN v_send_window_end ELSE campaign.send_window_end END,
+         business_hours_only = COALESCE(v_business_hours_only, campaign.business_hours_only),
+         send_weekdays = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'send_weekdays' THEN v_send_weekdays ELSE campaign.send_weekdays END,
+         respect_dnd = CASE WHEN p_limits ? 'respect_dnd' THEN v_respect_dnd ELSE campaign.respect_dnd END,
+         revision = campaign.revision + 1,
+         updated_at = v_now
+   WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
+     AND campaign.revision = p_expected_revision
+   RETURNING * INTO v_campaign;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_stale_revision' USING ERRCODE = '40001';
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('app.talkx_limits_write', '', true);
+
+  v_after := jsonb_build_object(
+    'speed_profile', v_campaign.speed_profile,
+    'send_interval_min', v_campaign.send_interval_min,
+    'send_interval_max', v_campaign.send_interval_max,
+    'typing_delay_min', v_campaign.typing_delay_min,
+    'typing_delay_max', v_campaign.typing_delay_max,
+    'max_per_minute', v_campaign.max_per_minute,
+    'send_window_start', v_campaign.send_window_start,
+    'send_window_end', v_campaign.send_window_end,
+    'business_hours_only', v_campaign.business_hours_only,
+    'send_weekdays', v_campaign.send_weekdays,
+    'respect_dnd', v_campaign.respect_dnd
+  );
+
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaign_events (campaign_id, event_type, actor_id, message)
+  VALUES (p_campaign_id, 'limits_updated', v_actor_profile_id,
+          jsonb_build_object('before', v_before, 'after', v_after)::text);
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT p_campaign_id, v_campaign.revision;
+END;
+$function$;

+--    por origin e FORCA a autoria para o perfil do chamador (anti-forja):
+--    blocked_by no INSERT (no UPDATE o valor original e preservado quando
+--    autenticado) e removed_by SOMENTE na transicao NULL -> preenchido de

+--    gravar o uid cru quebraria a FK (23503) em todo INSERT autenticado.
+--    Sem linha em profiles para o uid, a coluna fica NULL (nula e sem forja).
+-- 3) Barreira real contra DELETE fisico: trigger BEFORE DELETE que levanta
+--    excecao para QUALQUER papel (authenticated, service_role e dono), mais
+--    policy talkx_blacklist_no_delete USING (false) para authenticated.
+--    Remocao logica continua via UPDATE de removed_at/removed_by.
+-- Idempotente: IF NOT EXISTS / OR REPLACE / DROP IF EXISTS antes do CREATE.
+-- =============================================================================
+
+-- 1. Colunas de trilha
+ALTER TABLE public.talkx_blacklist
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS import_batch_id uuid,
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS removal_reason text;

+-- 2. Trigger function de auditoria/normalizacao
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_blacklist_audit_trigger()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  -- Normaliza telefone: so digitos, formato 10-15 digitos; invalido vira NULL
+  IF NEW.phone IS NOT NULL THEN
+    NEW.phone := regexp_replace(NEW.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
+    IF NEW.phone !~ '^[0-9]{10,15}$' THEN
+      NEW.phone := NULL;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Preenche reason_code a partir de origin quando nulo (ex. 'manual','lgpd');
+  -- origin sem correspondente no enum (ex. 'optout','auto_optout') mantem NULL
+  IF NEW.reason_code IS NULL AND NEW.origin IS NOT NULL THEN
+    BEGIN
+      NEW.reason_code := NEW.origin::public.talkx_blacklist_reason;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
+      NULL;
+    END;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Forca blocked_by para o perfil do chamador no INSERT (sobrescreve o
+  -- valor enviado pelo cliente); com auth.uid() nulo mantem o informado.
+  -- No UPDATE o blocked_by original e preservado quando autenticado
+  -- (N-107: a trilha de quem bloqueou nao muda depois do INSERT).
+  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
+    NEW.blocked_by := (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1);
+  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
+    NEW.blocked_by := OLD.blocked_by;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Forca removed_by para o perfil do chamador SOMENTE na transicao
+  -- NULL -> preenchido de removed_at (o ato de remover); com auth.uid()
+  -- nulo mantem o informado (service_role/backend, ex. talkx_suppress_contact).
+  -- Linha ja removida que continua removida preserva a trilha original
+  -- (removed_by e removed_at), para que editar removal_reason ou outro
+  -- campo nao troque o autor da remocao.
+  IF NEW.removed_at IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
+     AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.removed_at IS NULL) THEN
+    NEW.removed_by := (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1);
+  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.removed_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.removed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+    NEW.removed_by := OLD.removed_by;
+    NEW.removed_at := OLD.removed_at;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_blacklist_audit_trigger() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_talkx_blacklist_audit ON public.talkx_blacklist;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_talkx_blacklist_audit
+  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.talkx_blacklist
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.talkx_blacklist_audit_trigger();
+
+-- 3. Barreira contra DELETE fisico (vale para todo papel, inclusive
+-- service_role e dono da tabela, que passam ao largo do RLS)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_blacklist_no_delete()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_blacklist_delete_bloqueado: use remocao logica via removed_at';
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_blacklist_no_delete() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_talkx_blacklist_no_delete ON public.talkx_blacklist;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_talkx_blacklist_no_delete
+  BEFORE DELETE ON public.talkx_blacklist
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.talkx_blacklist_no_delete();
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS talkx_blacklist_no_delete ON public.talkx_blacklist;
+CREATE POLICY talkx_blacklist_no_delete
+  ON public.talkx_blacklist
+  FOR DELETE
+  TO authenticated
+  USING (false);

+-- Rollback: remove a funcao talkx_campaign_window_open criada por esta migration (fatia c do N-102); sem dados nem ACL de objeto pre-existente a reverter.
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid, timestamptz);
+--
+-- N-102c (fatia de banco, split do t_25061962 recusado por diff de 90098 chars).
+-- Cria SOMENTE public.talkx_campaign_window_open, corrigida em 3 pontos:
+--   (a) le o schedule_timezone da campanha e converte p_at UMA vez com AT TIME ZONE,
+--       avaliando hora e dia da semana no horario local da campanha ‚Äî antes usava o
+--       fuso da sessao (Supabase = UTC);
+--   (b) usa EXTRACT(DOW ...) de ponta a ponta (0=domingo .. 6=sabado), coerente com o
+--       dicionario de send_weekdays ‚Äî antes misturava ISODOW (1=segunda .. 7=domingo)
+--       com o dicionario, deslocando o dia em 1;
+--   (c) restringe o acesso: REVOKE de PUBLIC/anon/authenticated e EXECUTE so para
+--       service_role ‚Äî antes a RPC era executavel por authenticated. Fecha tambem o
+--       check-secdef-public-execute (SECURITY DEFINER de public sem PUBLIC/anon).
+-- Nao toca DDL/colunas (fatia a), nem os casts de draft/limits (fatia b), nem o
+-- default do setting dnd_hours. Sem BEGIN/COMMIT (o ledger aplica cada migration em
+-- transacao propria).
+--
+-- Corpo copiado de 20261010124150_talkx_n102_window_fixes.sql (commit 2c186a480),
+-- SOMENTE a funcao talkx_campaign_window_open (o arquivo de origem tem outras 2 RPCs
+-- e o DDL, que vieram nas fatias a e b).
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_window_open(
+  p_campaign_id uuid,
+  p_at timestamptz
+)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_campaign public.talkx_campaigns%ROWTYPE;
+  v_dnd_hours jsonb;
+  v_timezone text;
+  v_local_at timestamp;
+  v_local_date date;
+  v_weekday integer;
+  v_start_minutes integer;
+  v_end_minutes integer;
+  v_minutes_of_day integer;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT * INTO v_campaign
+    FROM public.talkx_campaigns
+   WHERE id = p_campaign_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_campaign_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Fuso da campanha: weekday, feriados e DND sao avaliados no horario local do
+  -- schedule_timezone, nunca no fuso da sessao (Supabase = UTC). Mesmo fallback de
+  -- save_talkx_campaign_draft.
+  v_timezone := COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_campaign.schedule_timezone, '')), ''), 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_local_at := p_at AT TIME ZONE v_timezone;
+  v_local_date := v_local_at::date;
+
+  -- send_weekdays: null = todos os dias; array = dias permitidos (0=domingo .. 6=sabado)
+  IF v_campaign.send_weekdays IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_weekday := EXTRACT(DOW FROM v_local_at)::integer;
+    IF NOT (v_weekday = ANY(v_campaign.send_weekdays)) THEN
+      RETURN false;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- DND: se respect_dnd=true, verifica se o horario local esta na janela de nao perturbe
+  IF v_campaign.respect_dnd THEN
+    SELECT value INTO v_dnd_hours
+      FROM public.talkx_settings
+     WHERE key = 'dnd_hours';
+
+    IF v_dnd_hours IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v_dnd_hours) = 'object' THEN
+      v_minutes_of_day := EXTRACT(HOUR FROM v_local_at)::integer * 60
+                          + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM v_local_at)::integer;
+      v_start_minutes := (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'start', ':', 1))::integer * 60
+                         + (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'start', ':', 2))::integer;
+      v_end_minutes := (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'end', ':', 1))::integer * 60
+                       + (split_part(v_dnd_hours ->> 'end', ':', 2))::integer;
+
+      -- domingo: se sundays=false, DND nao aplica (janela aberta)
+      IF EXTRACT(DOW FROM v_local_at) = 0 AND (v_dnd_hours ->> 'sundays')::boolean = false THEN
+        RETURN true;
+      END IF;
+
+      -- feriados: comparados por data local, sem cast jsonb -> date[]
+      IF jsonb_array_length(v_dnd_hours -> 'holidays') > 0 THEN
+        IF v_local_date::text = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v_dnd_hours -> 'holidays'))) THEN
+          RETURN true;
+        END IF;
+      END IF;
+
+      -- Janela DND: se start < end, verifica se esta dentro; se start > end (cruza
+      -- meia-noite), verifica se esta fora do intervalo permitido
+      IF v_start_minutes < v_end_minutes THEN
+        IF v_minutes_of_day >= v_start_minutes AND v_minutes_of_day < v_end_minutes THEN
+          RETURN false;
+        END IF;
+      ELSIF v_start_minutes > v_end_minutes THEN
+        IF v_minutes_of_day >= v_start_minutes OR v_minutes_of_day < v_end_minutes THEN
+          RETURN false;
+        END IF;
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN true;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_window_open(uuid, timestamptz)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

+-- Rollback:
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.talkx_segment_health(jsonb, uuid);
+--   drop function if exists public.talkx_segment_health(jsonb, uuid);
+--
+-- N-116/X102: talkx_segment_health(p_rules, p_segment_id) - risco, sinais e composicao,
+-- so agregados; reusa talkx_audience_query. ACL/recusas: admin/supervisor (42501); sem regras ->
+-- 22023 'rules'; segmento inexistente -> P0002; so p_rules = campo livre; com os dois,
+-- p_rules vence e o segmento precisa existir. Sinais: warm/eligible>=70%; bloqueio<2%
+-- (sent>=100); engajamento>=media (sent>=100). Nivel: sem eligible NULL; Alto warm<40%
+-- ou bloqueio>=5%; Baixo 3 sinais ok; senao Moderado (sem envio: nota, bloqueio zero).
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_health(
+p_rules jsonb DEFAULT NULL,
+p_segment_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+c_window_days constant integer := 90;
+c_inactive_days constant integer := 180;
+c_min_sent constant integer := 100;
+c_warm_ok constant numeric := 0.70;
+c_warm_high constant numeric := 0.40;
+c_block_ok constant numeric := 0.02;
+c_block_high constant numeric := 0.05;
+c_sug_inactive constant numeric := 0.25;
+c_sug_suppressed constant numeric := 0.05;
+c_sug_consent constant numeric := 0.50;
+v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+v_rules jsonb;
+v_since timestamptz := statement_timestamp() - make_interval(days => c_window_days);
+v_matched bigint := 0;
+v_eligible bigint := 0;
+v_suppressed bigint := 0;
+v_base_total bigint := 0;
+v_ids uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[];
+v_hist_ids uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[];
+v_warm bigint := 0;
+v_inactive bigint := 0;
+v_no_consent bigint := 0;
+v_pessoas bigint := 0;
+v_empresas bigint := 0;
+v_nao_inf bigint := 0;
+v_sent bigint := 0;
+v_delivered bigint := 0;
+v_replied bigint := 0;
+v_failed bigint := 0;
+v_optout bigint := 0;
+v_mod_delivered bigint := 0;
+v_mod_replied bigint := 0;
+v_warm_ratio numeric;
+v_block_ratio numeric;
+v_reply_ratio numeric;
+v_mod_ratio numeric;
+v_sig1 boolean;
+v_sig2 boolean;
+v_sig3 boolean;
+v_level text;
+v_note text;
+v_score integer;
+v_top_tags jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+v_sugs jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+BEGIN
+IF v_uid IS NULL OR COALESCE(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid), false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_segment_health_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+END IF;
+
+IF p_rules IS NULL AND p_segment_id IS NULL THEN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_talkx_segment_health_rules' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+END IF;
+
+IF p_segment_id IS NULL THEN
+  -- Campo livre (previa nao salva): so p_rules vem preenchido, usa direto.
+  v_rules := p_rules;
+ELSE
+  -- Segmento salvo precisa existir mesmo quando p_rules vence (previa de edicao).
+  SELECT s.rules INTO v_rules FROM public.talkx_segments s WHERE s.id = p_segment_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_segment_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+  v_rules := COALESCE(p_rules, v_rules);
+END IF;
+
+SELECT count(*),
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT q.legacy_or_deleted AND NOT q.invalid_phone AND NOT q.is_suppressed),
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT q.legacy_or_deleted AND NOT q.invalid_phone AND q.is_suppressed),
+       COALESCE(array_agg(q.id) FILTER (WHERE NOT q.legacy_or_deleted AND NOT q.invalid_phone AND NOT q.is_suppressed),
+                ARRAY[]::uuid[]),
+       COALESCE(array_agg(q.id) FILTER (WHERE NOT q.legacy_or_deleted AND NOT q.invalid_phone),
+                ARRAY[]::uuid[])
+  INTO v_matched, v_eligible, v_suppressed, v_ids, v_hist_ids
+  FROM public.talkx_audience_query(v_rules, NULL, true) AS q;
+
+SELECT count(*) INTO v_base_total
+  FROM public.talkx_audience_query('{"groups":[]}'::jsonb, NULL, true) AS b
+ WHERE NOT b.legacy_or_deleted AND NOT b.invalid_phone AND NOT b.is_suppressed;
+
+IF v_eligible > 0 THEN
+  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
+           SELECT 1 FROM public.messages m WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.sender = 'contact')),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (
+           SELECT 1 FROM public.messages m
+            WHERE m.contact_id = c.id AND m.sender = 'contact'
+              AND m.created_at >= statement_timestamp() - make_interval(days => c_inactive_days))),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.consent_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'granted'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.contact_type IN ('pessoa', 'cliente', 'prospect')),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.contact_type IN ('empresa', 'company')),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.contact_type IS NULL
+                            OR c.contact_type NOT IN ('pessoa', 'cliente', 'prospect', 'empresa', 'company'))
+    INTO v_warm, v_inactive, v_no_consent, v_pessoas, v_empresas, v_nao_inf
+    FROM public.contacts c
+   WHERE c.id = ANY(v_ids);
+
+  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.sent_at IS NOT NULL OR r.status = 'failed'),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.replied_at IS NOT NULL),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed')
+    INTO v_sent, v_delivered, v_replied, v_failed
+    FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+   WHERE r.contact_id = ANY(v_hist_ids)
+     AND COALESCE(r.sent_at, r.created_at) >= v_since;
+
+  SELECT count(DISTINCT b.contact_id) INTO v_optout
+    FROM public.talkx_blacklist b
+   WHERE b.contact_id = ANY(v_hist_ids)
+     AND b.reason_code = 'opt_out'
+     AND b.removed_at IS NULL
+     AND b.created_at >= v_since;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('tag', t.tag, 'count', t.cnt) ORDER BY t.cnt DESC, t.tag), '[]'::jsonb)
+    INTO v_top_tags
+    FROM (
+      SELECT tag, count(*) AS cnt
+        FROM public.contacts c
+       CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.tags) AS tag
+       WHERE c.id = ANY(v_ids)
+       GROUP BY tag
+       ORDER BY cnt DESC, tag
+       LIMIT 10
+    ) t;
+END IF;
+
+SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL),
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.replied_at IS NOT NULL)
+  INTO v_mod_delivered, v_mod_replied
+  FROM public.talkx_recipients r
+ WHERE COALESCE(r.sent_at, r.created_at) >= v_since;
+
+IF v_eligible > 0 THEN
+  v_warm_ratio := v_warm::numeric / v_eligible;
+  v_sig1 := v_warm_ratio >= c_warm_ok;
+
+  IF v_sent >= c_min_sent THEN
+    v_block_ratio := (v_failed + v_optout)::numeric / v_sent;
+    v_sig2 := v_block_ratio < c_block_ok;
+    IF v_delivered > 0 AND v_mod_delivered > 0 THEN
+      v_reply_ratio := v_replied::numeric / v_delivered;
+      v_mod_ratio := v_mod_replied::numeric / v_mod_delivered;
+      v_sig3 := v_reply_ratio >= v_mod_ratio;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_warm_ratio < c_warm_high OR COALESCE(v_block_ratio, 0) >= c_block_high THEN
+    v_level := 'alto';
+  ELSIF v_sig1 AND v_sig2 IS TRUE AND v_sig3 IS TRUE THEN
+    v_level := 'baixo';
+  ELSE
+    v_level := 'moderado';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_sent < c_min_sent THEN
+    v_note := 'sem_historico_de_envio';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Sem historico o bloqueio entra como zero: o score mede a base, nao o envio.
+  v_score := round(100 * v_warm_ratio * (1 - least(COALESCE(v_block_ratio, 0), 1)))::integer;
+
+  IF v_inactive::numeric / v_eligible >= c_sug_inactive THEN
+    v_sugs := v_sugs || jsonb_build_object('code', 'split_active_inactive', 'count', v_inactive, 'of', v_eligible,
+      'action', 'Dividir em ativos e inativos');
+  END IF;
+  IF v_no_consent::numeric / v_eligible >= c_sug_consent
+     AND position('consent_status' IN v_rules::text) = 0 THEN
+    v_sugs := v_sugs || jsonb_build_object('code', 'add_consent_filter', 'count', v_no_consent, 'of', v_eligible,
+      'action', 'Adicionar filtro de consentimento');
+  END IF;
+END IF;
+
+IF v_matched > 0 AND v_suppressed::numeric / v_matched >= c_sug_suppressed THEN
+  v_sugs := v_sugs || jsonb_build_object('code', 'review_suppressed_origin', 'count', v_suppressed, 'of', v_matched,
+    'action', 'Revisar a origem dos contatos bloqueados');
+END IF;
+
+RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+  'matched', v_matched,
+  'eligible', v_eligible,
+  'base_total', v_base_total,
+  'suppressed', v_suppressed,
+  'warm', v_warm,
+  'inactive_180d', v_inactive,
+  'no_consent', v_no_consent,
+  'last_90d', jsonb_build_object('sent', v_sent, 'delivered', v_delivered, 'replied', v_replied,
+                                 'failed', v_failed, 'optout', v_optout),
+  'composition', jsonb_build_object('pessoas', v_pessoas, 'empresas', v_empresas, 'nao_informado', v_nao_inf),
+  'top_tags', v_top_tags,
+  'signals', jsonb_build_object('qualified_base', to_jsonb(v_sig1), 'low_block', to_jsonb(v_sig2),
+                                'engagement', to_jsonb(v_sig3)),
+  'level', to_jsonb(v_level),
+  'note', to_jsonb(v_note),
+  'score', to_jsonb(v_score),
+  'suggestions', v_sugs
+);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_health(jsonb, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_segment_health(jsonb, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- talkx_v4_insights_rules
+-- Rollback: dropa a funcao public.talkx_insights(timestamptz, timestamptz); nao altera tabelas nem dados.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.talkx_insights(timestamptz, timestamptz);
+--
+-- N-124 (X075; P3): dicas da tela 07 calculadas no servidor.
+-- Regras: (1) melhor faixa de 2h vs media (>=200 envios, 30 na faixa, +20%) ->
+-- 'prefill_send_window'; (2) com segmento vs sem (>=3 campanhas cada, taxa das
+-- sem > 0) -> 'open_segments'; (3) melhor template vs media (>=2 campanhas,
+-- 100 envios) -> 'open_template'; (4) cliques < 5% em 3+ concluidas ->
+-- 'review_clicks'. Inativos NAO entra (contacts.updated_at nao mede inatividade).
+-- summary.estimated_lift_pct so preenche com as regras 1-3 ativas e 10+
+-- concluidas nos 90 dias antes de p_to (maior ganho, teto 50%); senao nulo.
+-- Escopo: DEFINER com search_path fixo, mas SO campanhas visiveis ao chamador
+-- (created_by proprio ou admin/supervisor = OU das policies SELECT de
+-- talkx_campaigns); sem campanha visivel, `insights` vazio. Faixa lida em
+-- America/Sao_Paulo (appHour). REVOKE de PUBLIC/anon.
+
+create or replace function public.talkx_insights(
+  p_from timestamptz,
+  p_to   timestamptz
+) returns jsonb
+language plpgsql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $fn$
+declare
+  v_me         uuid := (select p.id from public.profiles p where p.user_id = auth.uid() limit 1);
+  v_is_admin   boolean := coalesce(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false);
+  v_insights   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_count      integer := 0;
+  v_has1       boolean := false;
+  v_has2       boolean := false;
+  v_has3       boolean := false;
+  v_lift1      numeric;
+  v_lift2      numeric;
+  v_lift3      numeric;
+  v_recent90   integer;
+  v_est        numeric;
+  v_total_sends integer;
+  v_hour        integer;
+  v_band_n      integer;
+  v_band_rate   numeric;
+  v_avg_rate    numeric;
+  v_with_n      integer;
+  v_without_n   integer;
+  v_wrep        numeric;
+  v_wsent       numeric;
+  v_owrep       numeric;
+  v_owsent      numeric;
+  v_with_rate   numeric;
+  v_without_rate numeric;
+  v_tpl_id      uuid;
+  v_tpl_camps   integer;
+  v_tpl_sent    integer;
+  v_tpl_rate    numeric;
+  v_avg_tpl_rate numeric;
+  v_done        integer;
+  v_low         integer;
+  v_clicks      numeric;
+  v_camps_sent  numeric;
+  v_avg_click   numeric;
+begin
+  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to <= p_from then
+    raise exception 'invalid_talkx_insights_period' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  -- (1) melhor faixa de 2h vs media
+  select count(*)::int into v_total_sends
+  from public.talkx_recipients r
+  join public.talkx_campaigns c on c.id = r.campaign_id
+  where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+    and r.sent_at >= p_from and r.sent_at < p_to;
+
+  if v_total_sends >= 200 then
+    select s.band, s.n, (s.rep::numeric / s.n), (g.rep::numeric / g.n)
+      into v_hour, v_band_n, v_band_rate, v_avg_rate
+    from (
+      select (floor(extract(hour from (r.sent_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')) / 2) * 2)::int as band,
+             (count(*))::int as n,
+             (count(*) filter (where r.replied_at is not null))::int as rep
+      from public.talkx_recipients r
+      join public.talkx_campaigns c on c.id = r.campaign_id
+      where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+        and r.sent_at >= p_from and r.sent_at < p_to
+      group by 1
+    ) s
+    cross join (
+      select (count(*))::int as n,
+             (count(*) filter (where r.replied_at is not null))::int as rep
+      from public.talkx_recipients r
+      join public.talkx_campaigns c on c.id = r.campaign_id
+      where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+        and r.sent_at >= p_from and r.sent_at < p_to
+    ) g
+    where s.n >= 30
+    order by (s.rep::numeric / s.n) desc, s.band asc
+    limit 1;
+
+    if v_band_n is not null and coalesce(v_avg_rate, 0) > 0 then
+      v_lift1 := round(((v_band_rate / v_avg_rate) - 1) * 100, 1);
+      if v_lift1 >= 20 then
+        v_has1 := true;
+        v_count := v_count + 1;
+        v_insights := v_insights || jsonb_build_object(
+          'id', 'best-window', 'type', 'timing', 'priority', 'high',
+          'action', 'prefill_send_window',
+          'sample', v_band_n,
+          'params', jsonb_build_object(
+            'hour', v_hour,
+            'window_hours', 2,
+            'reply_rate_pct', round(v_band_rate * 100, 1),
+            'avg_reply_rate_pct', round(v_avg_rate * 100, 1),
+            'lift_pct', v_lift1
+          ));
+      end if;
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  -- (2) com segmento vs sem segmento
+  select
+    (count(*) filter (where c.segment_id is not null))::int,
+    (count(*) filter (where c.segment_id is null))::int,
+    coalesce(sum(c.replied_count) filter (where c.segment_id is not null), 0)::numeric,
+    coalesce(sum(c.sent_count)    filter (where c.segment_id is not null), 0)::numeric,
+    coalesce(sum(c.replied_count) filter (where c.segment_id is null), 0)::numeric,
+    coalesce(sum(c.sent_count)    filter (where c.segment_id is null), 0)::numeric
+  into v_with_n, v_without_n, v_wrep, v_wsent, v_owrep, v_owsent
+  from public.talkx_campaigns c
+  where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+    and c.status = 'completed'
+    and c.completed_at >= p_from and c.completed_at < p_to;
+
+  if v_with_n >= 3 and v_without_n >= 3 and v_wsent > 0 and v_owsent > 0 then
+    v_with_rate := v_wrep / v_wsent;
+    v_without_rate := v_owrep / v_owsent;
+    if v_without_rate > 0 and v_with_rate > v_without_rate then
+      v_lift2 := round(((v_with_rate / v_without_rate) - 1) * 100, 1);
+      v_has2 := true;
+      v_count := v_count + 1;
+      v_insights := v_insights || jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', 'segment-lift', 'type', 'segment', 'priority', 'medium',
+        'action', 'open_segments',
+        'sample', v_with_n + v_without_n,
+        'params', jsonb_build_object(
+          'with_segment_campaigns', v_with_n,
+          'without_segment_campaigns', v_without_n,
+          'with_segment_reply_rate_pct', round(v_with_rate * 100, 1),
+          'without_segment_reply_rate_pct', round(v_without_rate * 100, 1),
+          'lift_pct', v_lift2
+        ));
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  -- (3) melhor template vs media
+  select t.template_id, t.campaigns, t.sent, (t.replied::numeric / t.sent), (g.rep::numeric / g.sent)
+    into v_tpl_id, v_tpl_camps, v_tpl_sent, v_tpl_rate, v_avg_tpl_rate
+  from (
+    select c.template_id,
+           (count(*))::int as campaigns,
+           coalesce(sum(c.sent_count), 0)::int as sent,
+           coalesce(sum(c.replied_count), 0)::int as replied
+    from public.talkx_campaigns c
+    where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+      and c.status = 'completed'
+      and c.completed_at >= p_from and c.completed_at < p_to
+      and c.template_id is not null
+    group by c.template_id
+  ) t
+  cross join (
+    select coalesce(sum(c.sent_count), 0)::numeric as sent,
+           coalesce(sum(c.replied_count), 0)::numeric as rep
+    from public.talkx_campaigns c
+    where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+      and c.status = 'completed'
+      and c.completed_at >= p_from and c.completed_at < p_to
+  ) g
+  where t.campaigns >= 2 and t.sent >= 100 and g.sent > 0
+  order by (t.replied::numeric / t.sent) desc, t.sent desc
+  limit 1;
+
+  if v_tpl_id is not null and coalesce(v_avg_tpl_rate, 0) > 0 and v_tpl_rate > v_avg_tpl_rate then
+    v_lift3 := round(((v_tpl_rate / v_avg_tpl_rate) - 1) * 100, 1);
+    v_has3 := true;
+    v_count := v_count + 1;
+    v_insights := v_insights || jsonb_build_object(
+      'id', 'best-template', 'type', 'template', 'priority', 'medium',
+      'action', 'open_template',
+      'sample', v_tpl_sent,
+      'params', jsonb_build_object(
+        'template_id', v_tpl_id,
+        'campaigns', v_tpl_camps,
+        'sent', v_tpl_sent,
+        'reply_rate_pct', round(v_tpl_rate * 100, 1),
+        'avg_reply_rate_pct', round(v_avg_tpl_rate * 100, 1),
+        'lift_pct', v_lift3
+      ));
+  end if;
+
+  -- (4) cliques baixos
+  select (count(*))::int,
+         (count(*) filter (where x.clicks::numeric / x.sent_count < 0.05))::int,
+         coalesce(sum(x.clicks), 0)::numeric,
+         coalesce(sum(x.sent_count), 0)::numeric
+    into v_done, v_low, v_clicks, v_camps_sent
+  from (
+    select c.sent_count,
+           coalesce((
+             select count(*) from public.talkx_link_clicks lc
+             join public.talkx_links l on l.id = lc.link_id
+             where l.campaign_id = c.id
+               and lc.clicked_at >= p_from and lc.clicked_at < p_to
+           ), 0)::int as clicks
+    from public.talkx_campaigns c
+    where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+      and c.status = 'completed'
+      and c.completed_at >= p_from and c.completed_at < p_to
+      and c.sent_count >= 10
+  ) x;
+
+  if v_done > 0 and v_camps_sent > 0 then
+    v_avg_click := v_clicks / v_camps_sent;
+    if v_avg_click < 0.05 and v_low >= 3 then
+      v_count := v_count + 1;
+      v_insights := v_insights || jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', 'low-clicks', 'type', 'links', 'priority', 'low',
+        'action', 'review_clicks',
+        'sample', v_done,
+        'params', jsonb_build_object(
+          'low_click_campaigns', v_low,
+          'completed_campaigns', v_done,
+          'avg_click_rate_pct', round(v_avg_click * 100, 1),
+          'max_rate_pct', 5
+        ));
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  -- summary: lift so com regras 1-3 ativas e 10+ concluidas 90d antes de p_to
+  if v_has1 and v_has2 and v_has3 then
+    select (count(*))::int into v_recent90
+    from public.talkx_campaigns c
+    where (v_is_admin or c.created_by = v_me)
+      and c.status = 'completed'
+      and c.completed_at >= p_to - interval '90 days' and c.completed_at < p_to;
+    if v_recent90 >= 10 then
+      v_est := least(50, greatest(v_lift1, v_lift2, v_lift3));
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  return jsonb_build_object(
+    'period', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to),
+    'insights', v_insights,
+    'summary', jsonb_build_object('rule_count', v_count, 'estimated_lift_pct', v_est)
+  );
+end;
+$fn$;
+
+revoke all on function public.talkx_insights(timestamptz, timestamptz) from public;
+revoke execute on function public.talkx_insights(timestamptz, timestamptz) from anon;
+grant execute on function public.talkx_insights(timestamptz, timestamptz) to service_role, authenticated;
