+-- p_after; o chamador repete com o last_id at√© processed = 0. Eleg√≠vel (AND): n√£o
+-- apagado (deleted_at IS NULL) e n√£o legado (is_lid_legacy = false). Telefone
+-- inv√°lido s√≥ zera UF/regi√£o. DO UPDATE sem guarda: colunas locais s√£o disjuntas
+-- das do CRM/compras (X038/X040).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_refresh_local_attributes(p_limit integer DEFAULT 500, p_after uuid DEFAULT NULL)
+RETURNS TABLE (processed integer, last_id uuid)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$ DECLARE v_processed integer := 0; v_last uuid := NULL; BEGIN
+  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_limit deve ser >= 1' USING ERRCODE = '2201W';
+  END IF;
+
+  WITH page AS (
+    SELECT
+      c.id,
+      c.assigned_to,
+      regexp_replace(c.phone, '\D', '', 'g') AS digits
+    FROM public.contacts c
+    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
+      AND c.is_lid_legacy = false
+      AND (p_after IS NULL OR c.id > p_after)
+    ORDER BY c.id
+    LIMIT p_limit
+  ),
+  ddd AS (
+    SELECT
+      id,
+      assigned_to,
+      CASE
+        WHEN digits LIKE '55%' AND length(digits) >= 12
+          THEN substring(digits from 3 for 2)::smallint
+        WHEN length(digits) >= 10
+          THEN substring(digits from 1 for 2)::smallint
+        ELSE NULL
+      END AS ddd_code
+    FROM page
+  ),
+  ins AS (
+    INSERT INTO public.talkx_contact_attributes (
+      contact_id, salesperson_name, salesperson_profile_id,
+      state, region, funnel_stage, last_message_at, sources, updated_at
+    )
+    SELECT
+      d.id,
+      p.name,
+      p.id,
+      r.state::text,
+      r.region,
+      s.name,
+      lm.last_message_at,
+      '{"vendedor":"local","state":"ddd","region":"ddd","funnel_stage":"local","last_message_at":"local"}'::jsonb,
+      now()
+    FROM ddd d
+    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = d.assigned_to
+    LEFT JOIN public.talkx_ddd_regions r ON r.ddd = d.ddd_code
+    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT st.name
+      FROM public.sales_deals sd
+      JOIN public.sales_pipeline_stages st ON st.id = sd.stage_id
+      WHERE sd.contact_id = d.id
+      ORDER BY sd.updated_at DESC, sd.id DESC
+      LIMIT 1
+    ) s ON true
+    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT max(m.created_at) AS last_message_at
+      FROM public.messages m
+      WHERE m.contact_id = d.id
+        AND m.sender = 'contact'
+    ) lm ON true
+    ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO UPDATE SET
+      salesperson_name = EXCLUDED.salesperson_name,
+      salesperson_profile_id = EXCLUDED.salesperson_profile_id,
+      state = EXCLUDED.state,
+      region = EXCLUDED.region,
+      funnel_stage = EXCLUDED.funnel_stage,
+      last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at,
+      sources = EXCLUDED.sources,
+      updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
+    RETURNING contact_id
+  )
+  SELECT count(*), (SELECT i.contact_id FROM ins i ORDER BY i.contact_id DESC LIMIT 1) INTO v_processed, v_last FROM ins;
+  processed := v_processed;
+  last_id := v_last;
+  RETURN NEXT;
+END; $fn$;

+-- login_block_log
+-- Rollback: dropa a RPC nova; nao altera tabela, coluna ou funcao existente.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.log_login_block(text, text, text, text, text);
+--
+-- Registra em public.audit_logs cada tentativa de login barrada pela politica de rede
+-- (IP/pais) aplicada em auth-login via public.resolve_network_policy (migration
+-- 20261004182245_resolve_network_policy_rpc.sql). A RPC nega mas nao grava nada; o registro
+-- visivel fica aqui, num unico ponto de escrita.
+--
+-- Por que reaproveitar audit_logs e nao criar tabela nova: a tabela ja tem action,
+-- ip_address, user_agent, created_at e details JSONB ‚Äî cobre todos os campos que o painel
+-- "Bloqueios de login" mostra, com indice idx_audit_logs_action e RLS de leitura so para
+-- admin/supervisor. Tabela nova so duplicaria isso. O painel le action = 'login_blocked'.
+--
+-- O bloqueio acontece ANTES de ler as credenciais (auth-login nao le o body quando nega,
+-- coberto por teste), entao o e-mail tentado nao existe nesse ponto e fica NULL ‚Äî por design.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_login_block(
+  p_email text,
+  p_ip text,
+  p_country_code text,
+  p_reason text,
+  p_user_agent text
+) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_reason text;
+  v_email text;
+  v_country text;
+  v_ip text;
+  v_ua text;
+BEGIN
+  v_reason := left(lower(btrim(coalesce(p_reason, ''))), 64);
+  IF v_reason = '' THEN
+    v_reason := 'unknown';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_email := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_email, '')), '');
+  v_country := left(nullif(upper(btrim(coalesce(p_country_code, ''))), ''), 8);
+  v_ip := left(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_ip, '')), ''), 64);
+  v_ua := left(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_user_agent, '')), ''), 512);
+
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, ip_address, user_agent)
+  VALUES (
+    NULL,
+    'login_blocked',
+    'login',
+    NULL,
+    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
+      'email', v_email,
+      'country_code', v_country,
+      'reason', v_reason
+    )),
+    v_ip,
+    v_ua
+  );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.log_login_block(text, text, text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.log_login_block(text, text, text, text, text) FROM anon;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.log_login_block(text, text, text, text, text) FROM authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.log_login_block(text, text, text, text, text) TO service_role;

+-- Rollback: restaura as policies de INSERT de conversation_tasks e conversation_events
+--   ao estado anterior e remove o trigger/funcao criados (nada de dado a desfazer).
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):

+--   drop function if exists public.conversation_event_assign_performed_by();

+--   create policy tasks_insert_own on public.conversation_tasks for insert to authenticated with check (created_by = public.current_profile_id());
+--
+-- SEC-RLS_CONTATOS_MENSAGENS-06 e -09 (docs/audits/SEGURANCA_RLS_CONTATOS_MENSAGENS_2026-10-07.md).
+--
+-- 06 ‚Äî conversation_tasks INSERT nao validava a visibilidade do contato: quem podia criar
+--   a PROPRIA tarefa (created_by = current_profile_id()) podia aponta-la para QUALQUER
+--   contato, mesmo um que nao enxerga. O guard de visibilidade existia so no UPDATE
+--   (trg_prevent_conversation_task_field_forgery). Aqui o mesmo predicado entra no
+--   WITH CHECK da policy de INSERT do dono. created_by NAO muda; contact_id nulo segue
+--   valido (o app usa upsert/tarefa sem contato).
+--
+-- 09 ‚Äî conversation_events INSERT aceitava performed_by nulo (evento de auditoria sem
+--   ator) e o predicado de contato usava so o assigned_to direto, ignorando fila e
+--   agente especial. Agora:
+--     (a) trigger BEFORE INSERT amarra performed_by ao proprio perfil para chamador
+--         nao privilegiado: NULL e preenchido com current_profile_id() (o app de
+--         transferencia nao manda performed_by) e valor de terceiro e recusado. Admin/
+--         supervisor e service_role/sistema seguem podendo deixar nulo.
+--     (b) a policy de INSERT passa a usar is_contact_visible_to_user (carteira, fila,
+--         agente especial e admin), superset estrito do predicado antigo.
+-- Nada de DROP de coluna, DML, GRANT ou papel: so policy + trigger.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 1. conversation_tasks: INSERT exige contato visivel ao chamador
+-- ============================================================================
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tasks_insert_own ON public.conversation_tasks;
+CREATE POLICY tasks_insert_own ON public.conversation_tasks
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
+  WITH CHECK (
+    created_by = public.current_profile_id()
+    AND (contact_id IS NULL OR public.is_contact_visible_to_user(contact_id, auth.uid()))
+  );
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 2. conversation_events: performed_by amarrado ao chamador nao privilegiado
+-- ============================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conversation_event_assign_performed_by()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  -- S√≥ age quando h√° sess√£o de usuario (authenticated) e o chamador nao e admin/supervisor.
+  -- service_role, cron (postgres) e chamadas de sistema tem auth.uid() nulo: passam.
+  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    IF NEW.performed_by IS NULL THEN
+      NEW.performed_by := public.current_profile_id();
+    ELSIF NEW.performed_by IS DISTINCT FROM public.current_profile_id() THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'performed_by deve ser o usuario atual'
+        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.conversation_event_assign_performed_by() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_conversation_event_assign_performed_by ON public.conversation_events;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_event_assign_performed_by
+  BEFORE INSERT ON public.conversation_events
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.conversation_event_assign_performed_by();
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 3. conversation_events: policy de INSERT (visibilidade real + ator)
+-- ============================================================================
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Authorized users can insert events" ON public.conversation_events;
+CREATE POLICY "Authorized users can insert events" ON public.conversation_events
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
+  WITH CHECK (
+    public.is_contact_visible_to_user(contact_id, auth.uid())
+    AND (
+      public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+      OR performed_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.current_profile_id()
+    )
+  );

+COMMIT;

+create or replace function public.talkx_resolve_audience(
+  p_rules jsonb default null,
+  p_segment_ids uuid[] default null,
+  p_mode text default 'count',
+  p_limit integer default null,
+  p_after uuid default null,
+  p_contact_ids uuid[] default null

+returns jsonb
+language plpgsql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $function$
+declare
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_mode text;
+  v_groups jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_rules jsonb;
+  v_limit integer;
+  v_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
+  v_matched bigint := 0;
+  v_eligible bigint := 0;
+  v_suppressed bigint := 0;
+  v_invalid bigint := 0;
+  v_legacy bigint := 0;
+  v_has_more boolean := false;
+  v_next_after uuid;
+begin
+  if v_uid is null or coalesce(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_uid), false) is not true then
+    raise exception 'talkx_audience_role_required' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  v_mode := lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_mode), ''), 'count'));
+  if v_mode not in ('count', 'sample', 'page') then
+    raise exception 'invalid_talkx_audience_mode' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  if p_after is not null and v_mode <> 'page' then
+    raise exception 'invalid_talkx_audience_after' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Une as regras explicitas (p_rules) com as dos segmentos salvos (p_segment_ids):
+  -- os grupos combinam por OU, entao concatenar grupos e exatamente a uniao das audiencias.
+  if p_rules is not null then
+    if jsonb_typeof(p_rules) <> 'object' then
+      raise exception 'invalid_talkx_audience_rules' using errcode = '22023';
+    end if;
+    if p_rules ? 'groups' then
+      if jsonb_typeof(p_rules -> 'groups') <> 'array' then
+        raise exception 'invalid_talkx_audience_rules' using errcode = '22023';
+      end if;
+      v_groups := v_groups || (p_rules -> 'groups');
+    end if;
+  end if;
+
+  if p_segment_ids is not null and cardinality(p_segment_ids) > 0 then
+    v_groups := v_groups || coalesce(
+      (select jsonb_agg(grp.value)
+         from public.talkx_segments seg
+         cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(seg.rules -> 'groups', '[]'::jsonb)) as grp(value)
+        where seg.id = any(p_segment_ids)),

+      'invalid_phone', v_invalid,
+      'legacy_or_deleted', v_legacy

+  end if;

+    v_limit := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 50);
+  else

+  end if;

+    into v_rows
+    from (
+      select c.id as cid,
+             jsonb_build_object(
+               'id', c.id,
+               'name', c.name,
+               'nickname', c.nickname,
+               'phone', case

+                 else left(regexp_replace(c.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 4)
+                      || repeat('*', greatest(length(regexp_replace(c.phone, '\D', '', 'g')) - 8, 0))
+                      || right(regexp_replace(c.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 4)
+               end,
+               'company', c.company,
+               'avatar_url', c.avatar_url,
+               'tags', c.tags
+             ) as row_data
+        from public.talkx_audience_query(v_rules, p_contact_ids, true) as q
+        join public.contacts as c on c.id = q.id
+       where not q.legacy_or_deleted
+         and not q.invalid_phone
+         and not q.is_suppressed
+         and (p_after is null or c.id > p_after)
+       order by c.id
+       limit v_limit
+    ) as s;
+
+  if v_mode = 'sample' then
+    return jsonb_build_object(
+      'mode', 'sample',
+      'rows', v_rows,
+      'count', jsonb_array_length(v_rows)
+    );
+  end if;
+
+  v_has_more := jsonb_array_length(v_rows) >= v_limit;
+  if v_has_more then
+    v_next_after := (v_rows -> -1 ->> 'id')::uuid;
+  end if;
+
+  return jsonb_build_object(
+    'mode', 'page',
+    'rows', v_rows,
+    'has_more', v_has_more,
+    'next_after', to_jsonb(v_next_after)
+  );
+end;

+--
+-- Achado 01 (P1) de docs/audits/SEGURANCA_DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE_2026-10-07.md.
+--
+-- A policy criada em 20261003142707 autorizava a leitura do objeto quando QUALQUER linha de
+-- public.messages visivel ao chamador tivesse media_url terminando no caminho do objeto. O
+-- media_url e escrito pela RPC public.enqueue_outbound_message (a migration irma tambem fecha
+-- a RPC), que aceitava texto do cliente. Assim, um atendente autenticado enfileirava no PROPRIO
+-- contato uma mensagem com p_media_url apontando para o objeto de OUTRA conversa; a mensagem
+-- (dele, legitima) carregava aquela URL e esta policy liberava o binario de um contato que ele
+-- nao atende.
+--
+-- Correcao: alem do casamento de URL, exigir que a pasta do objeto seja dona do contato da PROPRIA
+-- mensagem (m.contact_id = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[1]) -- a confirmacao de atribuicao
+-- usa public.is_contact_visible_to_user(m.contact_id, auth.uid()), o mesmo predicado canonico do
+-- projeto (admin / atribuido / membro de fila). O caminho LEGADO `<messageType>/...` (midia recebida
+-- gravada antes do formato `<contactId>/...`) continua legivel SOMENTE quando a mensagem e recebida
+-- (m.sender = 'contact') e a pasta do objeto e o proprio message_type, preservando o encaminhar de
+-- midia recebida (PR #1845). O vazamento
+-- cruzado nao volta por esse ramo porque a RPC irma recusa URL para pasta de contato alheio e o trigger
+-- de proveniencia barra insercao direta.

+-- tratado em 20261011003024, do cartao t_1561f524); recriar as duas aqui seria duplicar a correcao.

+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "whatsapp media readable via visible message" ON storage.objects;
+
+CREATE POLICY "whatsapp media readable via visible message"
+ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+USING (
+  objects.bucket_id = ANY (ARRAY['whatsapp-media'::text, 'audio-messages'::text])
+  AND EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+    FROM public.messages m
+    WHERE m.media_url IS NOT NULL
+      AND public.is_contact_visible_to_user(m.contact_id, auth.uid()) IS TRUE
+      AND (
+        -- caminho novo `<contactId>/...`: a pasta do objeto e o contato da PROPRIA mensagem
+        m.contact_id::text = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[1]
+        -- caminho legado `<messageType>/...`: vale SOMENTE para mensagem recebida (sender='contact')
+        -- cuja pasta do objeto e o proprio message_type -- sem isso, uma mensagem de SAIDA (agent)
+        -- forjada/propria com message_type igual ao nome da pasta liberaria objeto alheio.
+        OR (m.sender = 'contact' AND (storage.foldername(objects.name))[1] = m.message_type)
+      )
+      AND (
+        right(m.media_url, length('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || objects.name))
+          = '/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || objects.name
+        OR position('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || objects.name || '?' IN m.media_url) > 0
+        OR right(m.media_url, length('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || replace(objects.name, ' ', '%20')))

+        OR position('/' || objects.bucket_id || '/' || replace(objects.name, ' ', '%20') || '?' IN m.media_url) > 0
+      )
+  )

+-- higiene_grants_public_policies
+-- Rollback: devolve o EXECUTE da funcao de trigger e recria as duas policies redundantes. Na ordem:
+--   GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles() TO PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+--   CREATE POLICY "Avatar images are publicly accessible" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars');
+--   CREATE POLICY "Users can delete their own avatars" ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars');
+--
+-- Higiene de grants (docs/audits/SEGURANCA_DEFINER_GRANTS_STORAGE_2026-10-07.md).
+-- Nenhuma linha de dado e tocada: so ACL de funcao e policies de storage.objects.
+--
+-- 1. public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles() e uma funcao de TRIGGER (BEFORE
+--    INSERT OR UPDATE em public.multiplix_audiences, criada em 20261001261230_f35). Nasceu
+--    depois da varredura que fechou as outras 324 rotinas e por isso ficou com o EXECUTE
+--    padrao do Postgres em PUBLIC. O gatilho roda como o dono da funcao e NAO checa EXECUTE
+--    do papel que dispara o INSERT/UPDATE, entao revogar nao quebra o trigger ‚Äî mas deixa de
+--    expor a rotina a qualquer login (anon/authenticated). service_role segue com EXECUTE
+--    (nao pedido, preservado).
+--
+-- 2. Policies de storage.objects com predicado identico no MESMO bucket+verbo: permissivas se
+--    somam por OR e dificultam a revisao; se o bucket virar privado, a policy esquecida segue
+--    liberando. Fica uma por verbo/bucket:
+--      - avatars SELECT: "Anyone can view avatars" (mantida) x "Avatar images are publicly
+--        accessible" (redundante, removida).
+--      - avatars DELETE: "Users can delete their own avatar" (mantida) x "Users can delete
+--        their own avatars" (redundante, removida).
+--    Conferido no retrato do banco e no BLOCO_03 da exportacao: stickers, audio-memes e
+--    custom-emojis tem UMA unica policy de SELECT cada ("Anyone can view stickers",
+--    "Public read audio memes", "Public read for custom emojis") ‚Äî nada a remover ali; o
+--    teste prova o "uma por verbo/bucket" nos QUATRO buckets.
+
+-- 1. EXECUTE da funcao de trigger
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.multiplix_audiences_validate_shared_roles()
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- 2. policies duplicadas (so as redundantes; a canonica de cada par fica)
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Avatar images are publicly accessible" ON storage.objects;
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can delete their own avatars" ON storage.objects;

+  FOR SELECT TO authenticated

+    bucket_id = 'team-chat-files'

+      (storage.foldername(name))[1] = (public.current_profile_id())::text
+      OR is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())

+          FROM public.team_messages tm
+          JOIN public.team_conversation_members mem ON mem.conversation_id = tm.conversation_id
+          JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = mem.profile_id
+         WHERE tm.media_bucket = 'team-chat-files'
+           AND tm.media_path = name
+           AND p.user_id = auth.uid()
+      )
+    )
+  );
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can delete own team chat files" ON storage.objects;

+CREATE POLICY "Users can delete own team chat files" ON storage.objects
+  FOR DELETE TO authenticated
+  USING (
+    bucket_id = 'team-chat-files'
+    AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = (public.current_profile_id())::text

+-- talk_me_list_pending_messages: historico pendente do cliente antes do aceite.
+-- Rollback:
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.talk_me_list_pending_messages(uuid, integer);
+--
+-- A fila TALK ME so exp√µe a ultima mensagem; esta RPC devolve, sob demanda, o
+-- bloco de mensagens do cliente ainda sem resposta (o mesmo conjunto contado em
+-- pending_message_count). E leitura pura (STABLE): nao aceita o atendimento nem
+-- marca mensagens como lidas.
+--
+-- Regra de autorizacao (revalidada a cada chamada): perfil ativo, flag
+-- inbox.talk-me ligada, contato ainda elegivel (sem responsavel, aberto/
+-- aguardando, WhatsApp individual, ultima mensagem do cliente) e fila ativa que
+-- o chamador opera (admin/supervisor ou membro ativo). Campanhas de saida e
+-- notas internas nao entram: o bloco pendente so contem sender='contact' e
+-- qualquer saida do agente encerraria a elegibilidade.
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF to_regclass('public.messages') IS NULL
+     OR NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+       FROM pg_trigger t
+       WHERE t.tgrelid = 'public.messages'::regclass
+         AND t.tgname = 'trg_guard_message_provenance_fields'
+         AND NOT t.tgisinternal
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talk_me_pending_history_requires_provenance_trigger';
+  END IF;
+END $$;

+CREATE FUNCTION public.talk_me_list_pending_messages(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_limit integer DEFAULT 50
+)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  message_id uuid,
+  sender text,
+  content text,
+  message_type text,
+  media_url text,
+  caption text,
+  created_at timestamptz
+)
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+  WITH caller AS (
+    SELECT
+      auth.uid() AS user_id,
+      (
+        SELECT p.id
+        FROM public.profiles p
+        WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid()
+          AND p.is_active IS TRUE
+        LIMIT 1
+      ) AS profile_id,
+      public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) AS is_admin,
+      EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.feature_flags f
+        WHERE f.key = 'inbox.talk-me'
+          AND f.enabled IS TRUE
+      ) AS feature_enabled
+  ),
+  authorized_contact AS (
+    SELECT e.contact_id
+    FROM public.talk_me_eligible_waiting_contacts(NULL, p_contact_id) e
+    CROSS JOIN caller x
+    WHERE x.user_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND x.profile_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND x.feature_enabled
+      AND EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.queues q
+        WHERE q.id = e.queue_id
+          AND q.is_active = true
+      )
+      AND (
+        x.is_admin
+        OR EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1
+          FROM public.queue_members qm
+          WHERE qm.queue_id = e.queue_id
+            AND qm.profile_id = x.profile_id
+            AND qm.is_active = true
+        )
+      )
+  ),
+  recent AS (
+    SELECT
+      m.id,
+      m.sender,
+      m.content,
+      m.message_type,
+      m.media_url,
+      m.caption,
+      m.created_at
+    FROM public.messages m
+    JOIN authorized_contact ac ON ac.contact_id = m.contact_id
+    WHERE m.sender = 'contact'
+      AND COALESCE(m.is_deleted, false) = false
+      AND NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.messages agent_message
+        WHERE agent_message.contact_id = m.contact_id
+          AND agent_message.sender = 'agent'
+          AND COALESCE(agent_message.is_deleted, false) = false
+          AND (agent_message.created_at, agent_message.id) >= (m.created_at, m.id)
+      )
+    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
+    LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 50), 1), 200)
+  )
+  SELECT
+    r.id,
+    r.sender,
+    r.content,
+    r.message_type,
+    r.media_url,
+    r.caption,
+    r.created_at
+  FROM recent r
+  ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talk_me_list_pending_messages(uuid, integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talk_me_list_pending_messages(uuid, integer) TO authenticated;

+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talk_me_list_pending_messages(uuid, integer) IS
+  'Historico pendente do cliente em atendimento TALK ME ainda nao assumido: leitura sob demanda, sem aceite nem marcacao de lida, com autorizacao revalidada.';

+-- assume_return_conversation
+-- Rollback: executar as duas linhas SQL abaixo remove exatamente os objetos criados por esta migration.
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.assume_conversation(uuid);
+--   drop function if exists public.return_conversation_to_queue(uuid, text);
+--
+-- Paridade V3 -> V2 (auditoria 2026-10-11, faixa C): o TicketActionsBar da V3 tem
+-- "Assumir" e "Devolver a fila"; a V2 so tinha Transferir. Duas RPCs ADITIVAS,
+-- SECURITY DEFINER, restritas por fila/papel e auditadas. Sem roteador sticky.
+--
+-- Estados reais de contacts.conversation_status (FSM 20260905080000/090000):
+--   'open'    = em atendimento (com responsavel)  -> estado de "Assumir"
+--   'waiting' = na fila (sem responsavel)         -> estado de "Devolver a fila"
+--   'resolved' = encerrado que pode ser reaberto por Assumir; 'archived' permanece bloqueado
+--
+-- Nota de contrato: o texto do cartao cita auth.uid() para assigned_to, mas
+-- contacts.assigned_to REFERENCES public.profiles(id) (20260409014536); o valor
+-- correto e o profiles.id do chamador, obtido por get_profile_id_for_user().
+-- O user_id de audit_logs e o auth.uid() do chamador.
+--
+-- Nenhum dado pessoal entra em audit_logs: so ids (profile/fila), estados e motivo textual.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assume_conversation(p_contact_id uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $f$
+DECLARE
+  v_user_id    uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_contact    record;
+  v_expected   uuid;
+  v_is_admin   boolean;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_profile_id := public.get_profile_id_for_user(v_user_id);
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_is_admin := public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_user_id);
+
+  SELECT id, assigned_to, queue_id, conversation_status
+    INTO v_contact
+    FROM public.contacts
+   WHERE id = p_contact_id;
+
+  IF v_contact.id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'contact_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Assumir conversa resolved reabre o atendimento; archived continua bloqueado.
+  IF v_contact.conversation_status = 'archived' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversation_not_active' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Quem pode assumir: qualquer papel precisa pertencer ativamente a fila do contato.
+  -- Admin/supervisor podem tomar por cima, mas nao fora das suas filas nem sem fila.
+  IF v_contact.queue_id IS NULL
+     OR NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+         FROM public.queue_members qm
+        WHERE qm.queue_id = v_contact.queue_id
+          AND qm.profile_id = v_profile_id
+          AND qm.is_active IS TRUE
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Ja tem responsavel e nao sou eu: so admin/supervisor assume por cima.
+  v_expected := v_contact.assigned_to;
+  IF v_expected IS NOT NULL AND v_expected <> v_profile_id AND NOT v_is_admin THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'already_assigned' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Concorrencia otimista: so grava se o responsavel ainda for o que li.
+  UPDATE public.contacts
+     SET assigned_to = v_profile_id,
+         conversation_status = 'open',
+         conversation_status_changed_at = now()
+   WHERE id = p_contact_id
+     AND assigned_to IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_expected;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'concurrent_assignment' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+  VALUES (
+    v_user_id,
+    'conversation_assumed',
+    'contact',
+    p_contact_id,
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'queue_id', v_contact.queue_id,
+      'previous_assigned_to', v_expected,
+      'assigned_to', v_profile_id,
+      'previous_status', v_contact.conversation_status,
+      'status', 'open'
+    )
+  );
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'ok', true,
+    'contact_id', p_contact_id,
+    'assigned_to', v_profile_id,
+    'queue_id', v_contact.queue_id,
+    'conversation_status', 'open'
+  );
+END;
+$f$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.assume_conversation(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.assume_conversation(uuid) TO authenticated;
+
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.return_conversation_to_queue(p_contact_id uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $f$
+DECLARE
+  v_user_id    uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_contact    record;
+  v_expected   uuid;
+  v_is_admin   boolean;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_profile_id := public.get_profile_id_for_user(v_user_id);
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_is_admin := public.is_admin_or_supervisor(v_user_id);
+
+  SELECT id, assigned_to, queue_id, conversation_status
+    INTO v_contact
+    FROM public.contacts
+   WHERE id = p_contact_id;
+
+  IF v_contact.id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'contact_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_contact.conversation_status IN ('resolved', 'archived') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversation_not_active' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Devolver a fila tambem e restrito a fila: nem admin/supervisor atua fora
+  -- das suas filas, e contato sem fila nao pode ser devolvido "a fila".
+  IF v_contact.queue_id IS NULL
+     OR NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+         FROM public.queue_members qm
+        WHERE qm.queue_id = v_contact.queue_id
+          AND qm.profile_id = v_profile_id
+          AND qm.is_active IS TRUE
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Idempotente para usuario autorizado da fila: sem responsavel, ja esta na fila.
+  IF v_contact.assigned_to IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+      'ok', true,
+      'contact_id', p_contact_id,
+      'assigned_to', NULL,
+      'queue_id', v_contact.queue_id,
+      'conversation_status', v_contact.conversation_status
+    );
+  END IF;
+
+  -- So o responsavel atual ou admin/supervisor (ja validado na fila) devolvem a fila.
+  IF v_contact.assigned_to <> v_profile_id AND NOT v_is_admin THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_expected := v_contact.assigned_to;
+
+  UPDATE public.contacts
+     SET assigned_to = NULL,
+         conversation_status = 'waiting',
+         conversation_status_changed_at = now()
+   WHERE id = p_contact_id
+     AND assigned_to = v_expected;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'concurrent_update' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+  VALUES (
+    v_user_id,
+    'conversation_returned_to_queue',
+    'contact',
+    p_contact_id,
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'queue_id', v_contact.queue_id,
+      'previous_assigned_to', v_expected,
+      'reason', p_reason,
+      'previous_status', v_contact.conversation_status,
+      'status', 'waiting'
+    )
+  );

+-- message_attempts
+-- Rollback: tudo desta migration e NOVO, entao o inverso e so dropar as funcoes e a tabela (que leva junto a policy e as ACLs).
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.list_message_attempts_admin(uuid);
+--   drop function if exists public.list_message_attempts(uuid);
+--   drop function if exists public.log_message_attempt(uuid, integer, text, text, text, integer, jsonb, integer);
+--   drop table if exists public.message_attempts;
+--
+-- AUDITORIA_PARIDADE_V3_CHAT_UI_PARTE1 (11/10/2026), faixa C.
+-- DEFEITO: a V2 so guarda o ultimo status e a contagem (messages.status,
+-- status_updated_at, delivery_attempt_count). O erro do provedor de cada
+-- tentativa se perde, entao o Historico de envio nao diz POR QUE falhou.
+--
+-- Esta migration e ADITIVA: cria a tabela de tentativas, duas funcoes de
+-- leitura (resumo por conversa e visao completa do admin) e uma de escrita
+-- (so o service_role / Edge). Nenhum dado pessoal entra aqui: error_message e
+-- provider_response chegam JA SANITIZADOS pelo produtor (Edge funciona como
+-- service_role); nada de telefone nem texto de mensagem.
+--
+-- Efeitos colaterais: nenhum. Nao ha trigger novo (nao toca messages nem o
+-- updated_at de nada), nao ha publicacao de realtime e nenhum GRANT/REVOKE
+-- muda objeto que ja existia. O unico acesso retirado e o que ainda nao
+-- existia (a tabela nasce fechada).
+--
+-- MENSAGEM JA ENVIADA NAO TEM ROLLBACK de conteudo: o DROP TABLE do rollback
+-- devolve o schema, mas o historico de tentativas gravado se perde.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1) Tabela de tentativas de envio por mensagem ---------------------------
+-- O payload do provedor pode conter dado pessoal: por isso a leitura direta
+-- na tabela fica restrita ao admin (RLS abaixo) e a Edge so ESCREVE.
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.message_attempts (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  message_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  attempt_no integer NOT NULL,
+  outcome text NOT NULL,
+  error_code text,
+  error_message text,
+  provider_status integer,
+  provider_response jsonb,
+  duration_ms integer,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT message_attempts_outcome_check
+    CHECK (outcome IN ('claimed', 'sent', 'failed_retryable', 'failed_final')),
+  CONSTRAINT message_attempts_error_message_len_check
+    CHECK (error_message IS NULL OR length(error_message) <= 500),
+  CONSTRAINT message_attempts_unique
+    UNIQUE (message_id, attempt_no, outcome)
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS message_attempts_message_created_idx
+  ON public.message_attempts (message_id, created_at);
+
+-- 2) RLS: leitura direta SO para is_admin(); a API nao escreve direto ------
+ALTER TABLE public.message_attempts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS message_attempts_select_admin ON public.message_attempts;
+CREATE POLICY message_attempts_select_admin
+  ON public.message_attempts
+  FOR SELECT
+  TO authenticated
+  USING (public.is_admin(auth.uid()));
+
+-- ACL: nega por padrao. anon nada; authenticated so SELECT (limitado pela
+-- policy acima); nenhum INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE direto para authenticated.
+REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.message_attempts FROM anon, authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.message_attempts TO authenticated;
+
+-- 3) Escrita: log_message_attempt (SECURITY DEFINER, so service_role) ------
+-- A Edge chama com a service key. A barreira e o EXECUTE: PUBLIC, anon e
+-- authenticated nao podem chamar. Idempotente pela chave unica: repetir a
+-- mesma (message_id, attempt_no, outcome) nao duplica e devolve false.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_message_attempt(
+  p_message_id uuid,
+  p_attempt_no integer,
+  p_outcome text,
+  p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_error_message text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_provider_status integer DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_provider_response jsonb DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_duration_ms integer DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_outcome IS NULL
+     OR p_outcome NOT IN ('claimed', 'sent', 'failed_retryable', 'failed_final') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outcome: %', p_outcome USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_attempt_no IS NULL OR p_attempt_no < 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_attempt_no: %', p_attempt_no USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.messages AS m WHERE m.id = p_message_id) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_not_found: %', p_message_id USING ERRCODE = '23503';
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.message_attempts (
+    message_id, attempt_no, outcome, error_code, error_message,
+    provider_status, provider_response, duration_ms
+  ) VALUES (
+    p_message_id, p_attempt_no, p_outcome, p_error_code, p_error_message,
+    p_provider_status, p_provider_response, p_duration_ms
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (message_id, attempt_no, outcome) DO NOTHING;
+
+  RETURN FOUND;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION
+  public.log_message_attempt(uuid, integer, text, text, text, integer, jsonb, integer)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION
+  public.log_message_attempt(uuid, integer, text, text, text, integer, jsonb, integer)
+  TO service_role;
+
+-- 4) Leitura por conversa: resumo SEM provider_response ---------------------
+-- Espelha a RLS de messages: quem consegue ler a mensagem le o resumo das
+-- tentativas. SECURITY DEFINER porque a policy da tabela so abre para admin;
+-- a checagem explicita (is_contact_visible_to_user, caller-bound) e a barreira.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_message_attempts(p_message_id uuid)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  attempt_no integer,
+  outcome text,
+  error_code text,
+  error_message text,
+  created_at timestamptz
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+    FROM public.messages AS m
+    WHERE m.id = p_message_id
+      AND public.is_contact_visible_to_user(m.contact_id, auth.uid())
+  ) THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+    SELECT a.attempt_no, a.outcome, a.error_code, a.error_message, a.created_at
+    FROM public.message_attempts AS a
+    WHERE a.message_id = p_message_id
+    ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.attempt_no DESC;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.list_message_attempts(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.list_message_attempts(uuid)
+  TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- 5) Leitura completa: so admin, COM provider_response ----------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_message_attempts_admin(p_message_id uuid)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  attempt_no integer,
+  outcome text,
+  error_code text,
+  error_message text,
+  provider_response jsonb,
+  created_at timestamptz
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.is_admin(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+    SELECT a.attempt_no, a.outcome, a.error_code, a.error_message,
+           a.provider_response, a.created_at
+    FROM public.message_attempts AS a
+    WHERE a.message_id = p_message_id
+    ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.attempt_no DESC;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.list_message_attempts_admin(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.list_message_attempts_admin(uuid)
+  TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMIT;

+create or replace function public.toggle_message_favorite(p_message_id uuid)
+returns boolean
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = pg_catalog, public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_removed integer;
+begin
+  if v_user is null then
+    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  if not exists (
+    select 1
+    from public.messages m
+    where m.id = p_message_id
+      and public.is_contact_visible_to_user(m.contact_id, v_user)
+  ) then
+    raise exception 'message_not_visible' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  delete from public.message_favorites
+  where user_id = v_user and message_id = p_message_id;
+  get diagnostics v_removed = row_count;
+
+  if v_removed > 0 then
+    return false;
+  end if;
+
+  insert into public.message_favorites (user_id, message_id)
+  values (v_user, p_message_id);
+
+  return true;
+end;
+$$;

+create or replace function public.pin_message(p_message_id uuid)
+returns uuid
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = pg_catalog, public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_user    uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_contact uuid;
+  v_pin_id  uuid;
+  v_count   integer;
+begin
+  if v_user is null then
+    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  select m.contact_id into v_contact
+  from public.messages m
+  where m.id = p_message_id
+    and public.is_contact_visible_to_user(m.contact_id, v_user);
+
+  if v_contact is null then
+    raise exception 'message_not_visible' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  select id into v_pin_id
+  from public.message_pins
+  where contact_id = v_contact and message_id = p_message_id;
+
+  if v_pin_id is not null then
+    return v_pin_id;  -- idempotente: fixar de novo devolve o mesmo id
+  end if;
+
+  -- trava por conversa: o limite de 3 nao pode ser furado por dois chamadores
+  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_contact::text, 0));
+
+  select count(*) into v_count
+  from public.message_pins
+  where contact_id = v_contact;
+
+  if v_count >= 3 then
+    raise exception 'pin_limit_reached' using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  insert into public.message_pins (contact_id, message_id, pinned_by)
+  values (v_contact, p_message_id, v_user)
+  returning id into v_pin_id;
+
+  insert into public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+  values (v_user, 'message_pinned', 'message', p_message_id,
+          jsonb_build_object('contact_id', v_contact, 'pin_id', v_pin_id));
+
+  return v_pin_id;
+end;
+$$;
+
+create or replace function public.unpin_message(p_message_id uuid)
+returns boolean
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = pg_catalog, public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_user    uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_contact uuid;
+  v_removed integer;
+begin
+  if v_user is null then
+    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  select m.contact_id into v_contact
+  from public.messages m
+  where m.id = p_message_id;
+
+  if v_contact is null or not public.is_contact_visible_to_user(v_contact, v_user) then
+    raise exception 'message_not_visible' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  delete from public.message_pins
+  where contact_id = v_contact and message_id = p_message_id;
+  get diagnostics v_removed = row_count;
+
+  if v_removed > 0 then
+    insert into public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+    values (v_user, 'message_unpinned', 'message', p_message_id,
+            jsonb_build_object('contact_id', v_contact));
+  end if;
+
+  return v_removed > 0;
+end;
+$$;

+create or replace function public.report_message(
+  p_message_id uuid,
+  p_reason text,
+  p_note text default null
+)
+returns uuid
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = pg_catalog, public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_user    uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_contact uuid;
+  v_note    text;
+  v_id      uuid;
+begin
+  if v_user is null then
+    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  if p_reason is null or p_reason not in ('spam', 'improprio', 'urgencia', 'outro') then
+    raise exception 'invalid_report_reason' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  v_note := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note, '')), '');
+  if v_note is not null and char_length(v_note) > 500 then
+    raise exception 'invalid_report_note' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  select m.contact_id into v_contact
+  from public.messages m
+  where m.id = p_message_id
+    and public.is_contact_visible_to_user(m.contact_id, v_user);
+
+  if v_contact is null then
+    raise exception 'message_not_visible' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  insert into public.message_reports (message_id, reporter_id, reason, note)
+  values (p_message_id, v_user, p_reason, v_note)
+  on conflict (message_id, reporter_id) do nothing
+  returning id into v_id;
+
+  if v_id is null then
+    -- ja havia relato deste usuario para esta mensagem: devolve o existente
+    select id into v_id
+    from public.message_reports
+    where message_id = p_message_id and reporter_id = v_user;
+  else
+    insert into public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+    values (v_user, 'message_reported', 'message', p_message_id,
+            jsonb_build_object('report_id', v_id, 'reason', p_reason));
+  end if;
+
+  return v_id;
+end;
+$$;

+-- 2) RPC: request_department_access ‚Äî autenticado pede acesso, admins do departamento recebem notificacao e auditoria registra.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_department_access(p_department_id uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_admin_profile_id uuid;
+  v_admin_user_id uuid;
+  v_department_name text;
+BEGIN
+  v_profile_id := public.current_profile_id();
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'not_authenticated');
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT d.name INTO v_department_name FROM public.departments d WHERE d.id = p_department_id;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'department_not_found');
+  END IF;
+
+  FOR v_admin_profile_id, v_admin_user_id IN
+    SELECT p.id, p.user_id
+    FROM public.profiles p
+    WHERE p.department_id = p_department_id
+      AND p.role IN ('admin', 'supervisor')
+  LOOP
+    INSERT INTO public.notifications(user_id, title, message, type, metadata)
+    VALUES (
+      v_admin_user_id,
+      'Pedido de acesso ao departamento',
+      'Um agente solicitou acesso ao departamento ' || COALESCE(v_department_name, ''),
+      'info',
+      jsonb_build_object('department_id', p_department_id, 'requester_profile_id', v_profile_id)
+    );
+  END LOOP;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.department_audit_logs(department_id, action, profile_id, details)
+  VALUES (p_department_id, 'access_requested', v_profile_id, jsonb_build_object('department_name', v_department_name));
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
+END;
+$function$;

+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.request_department_access(uuid) TO authenticated;

+-- dispatch_scheduled_messages
+-- Rollback: remove o que esta migration cria ‚Äî tira o job do pg_cron, dropa a fun√ß√£o

+--   alter table public.scheduled_messages drop column if exists message_id;
+-- Mensagens j√° enfileiradas em messages permanecem (efeito externo, como qualquer envio).
+--
+-- Origem: auditoria de paridade V3 -> V2 (docs/audits/AUDITORIA_PARIDADE_V3_CHAT_UI_PARTE1_2026-10-11.md).
+--
+-- FATO: public.scheduled_messages tem √≠ndice de pendentes, RLS e hook de tela, mas NADA
+-- a envia quando chega a hora ‚Äî nenhuma Edge, nenhuma fun√ß√£o SQL e nenhum job do pg_cron

+--     enfileirada quando o despacho conclui; sem FK para n√£o travar o envio).
+--   * CHECK aditivo (NOT VALID para n√£o varrer legado) limita novos status a
+--     pending/sent/failed/cancelled/expired, coerente com a fun√ß√£o e com a UI.
+--   * public.dispatch_scheduled_messages(p_limit) SECURITY DEFINER: pega as PENDENTES
+--     vencidas (scheduled_at <= now()) em lote pequeno, com FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (duas
+--     execu√ß√µes concorrentes n√£o pegam a mesma linha), e para cada uma chama o
+--     enfileiramento can√¥nico public.enqueue_outbound_message como o USU√ÅRIO DONO
+--     (created_by -> profiles.user_id). client_message_id = id do agendamento (uuid
+--     est√°vel; a UNIQUE (contact_id, client_message_id) + advisory lock do enqueue
+--     tornam a reexecu√ß√£o idempotente ‚Äî 'sched:'||id n√£o cabe na coluna uuid).
+--   * Atraso tolerado (decis√£o do dono 11/10): atraso de at√© 15 min envia normal;
+--     acima disso N√ÉO envia: status 'expired' + error_message

+--   * Reautoriza√ß√£o no envio com a identidade do autor, motivos curtos e est√°veis:
+--     autor_inativo, sem_permissao, contato_invalido, contato_bloqueado
+--     (contacts.conversation_status = 'archived'; n√£o h√° flag de bloqueio em contacts),
+--     conexao_invalida. Erro residual do enqueue √© mapeado para o mesmo vocabul√°rio
+--     (fallback 'enqueue_failed').
+--   * Assinatura (decis√£o do dono 11/10, mesma regra de useMessageSignature):
+--     `*PrimeiroNome - Cargo:*` (s√≥ `*PrimeiroNome:*` sem cargo) de
+--     profiles.name/job_title prefixado ao conte√∫do; sem nome, n√£o assina.

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dispatch_scheduled_messages(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  scheduled_message_id uuid,
+  outcome text,
+  message_id uuid,
+  failure_reason text
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_row public.scheduled_messages%ROWTYPE;
+  v_owner_user_id uuid;
+  v_owner_name text;
+  v_owner_job text;
+  v_contact public.contacts%ROWTYPE;
+  v_conn_live boolean;
+  v_limit integer := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 500));
+  v_message_id uuid;
+  v_reason text;
+  v_claims text;
+  v_signed_content text;
+BEGIN
+  -- A infraestrutura √© a √∫nica chamadora (cron/service_role). O GRANT j√° barra o resto;
+  -- esta guarda √© defesa em profundidade contra um grant acidental a um papel de JWT.
+  IF coalesce(auth.role(), '') IN ('authenticated', 'anon') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission denied for function dispatch_scheduled_messages'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Preserva o JWT de quem chamou para devolv√™-lo ao fim (o la√ßo troca o claim por item).
+  v_claims := current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true);
+
+  FOR v_row IN
+    SELECT s.*
+    FROM public.scheduled_messages AS s
+    WHERE s.status = 'pending'
+      AND s.scheduled_at <= now()
+    ORDER BY s.scheduled_at, s.id
+    LIMIT v_limit
+    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
+  LOOP
+    scheduled_message_id := v_row.id;
+    outcome := NULL;
+    message_id := NULL;
+    failure_reason := NULL;
+    v_message_id := NULL;
+    v_reason := NULL;
+
+    -- Atraso tolerado: at√© 15 min envia normal; acima disso expira sem enviar.
+    IF now() - v_row.scheduled_at > interval '15 minutes' THEN
+      UPDATE public.scheduled_messages
+      SET status = 'expired',
+          message_id = NULL,
+          error_message = 'expirada: atraso acima de 15 min',
+          updated_at = now()
+      WHERE id = v_row.id;
+      outcome := 'expired';
+      failure_reason := 'expirada: atraso acima de 15 min';
+      RETURN NEXT;
+      CONTINUE;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- O remetente tem de existir e estar ativo: sem o dono n√£o h√° como respeitar a
+    -- permiss√£o send_messages nem a visibilidade de contato dele.
+    SELECT p.user_id, p.name, p.job_title
+      INTO v_owner_user_id, v_owner_name, v_owner_job
+    FROM public.profiles AS p
+    WHERE p.id = v_row.created_by
+      AND p.is_active = true
+    LIMIT 1;
+
+    IF v_owner_user_id IS NULL THEN
+      outcome := 'failed';
+      failure_reason := 'autor_inativo';
+    ELSE
+      -- Enfileira como o dono: auth.uid()/auth.role() passam a ser dele dentro do la√ßo,
+      -- para as checagens abaixo e o enqueue usarem a identidade do autor.
+      PERFORM set_config(
+        'request.jwt.claims',
+        jsonb_build_object('sub', v_owner_user_id::text, 'role', 'authenticated')::text,
+        true
+      );
+
+      -- Reautoriza√ß√£o no momento do envio, com vocabul√°rio curto e est√°vel.
+      IF public.user_has_permission(v_owner_user_id, 'send_messages') IS NOT TRUE THEN
+        v_reason := 'sem_permissao';
+      ELSE
+        SELECT c.* INTO v_contact
+        FROM public.contacts AS c
+        WHERE c.id = v_row.contact_id
+        LIMIT 1;
+
+        IF NOT FOUND OR v_contact.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+          v_reason := 'contato_invalido';
+        ELSIF v_contact.conversation_status = 'archived' THEN
+          v_reason := 'contato_bloqueado';
+        ELSIF public.is_contact_visible_to_user(v_row.contact_id, v_owner_user_id) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+          v_reason := 'contato_invalido';
+        ELSIF v_row.whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+          SELECT EXISTS (
+            SELECT 1 FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS w
+            WHERE w.id = v_row.whatsapp_connection_id
+              AND w.status = 'connected'
+              AND NULLIF(w.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL
+          ) INTO v_conn_live;
+          IF v_conn_live IS NOT TRUE THEN
+            v_reason := 'conexao_invalida';
+          END IF;
+        END IF;
+      END IF;
+
+      IF v_reason IS NOT NULL THEN
+        outcome := 'failed';
+        failure_reason := v_reason;
+      ELSE
+        -- Assinatura do atendente no momento do envio (regra de useMessageSignature).
+        v_signed_content := v_row.content;
+        IF v_owner_name IS NOT NULL AND v_owner_name <> '' THEN
+          v_signed_content := '*' || split_part(v_owner_name, ' ', 1)
+            || CASE WHEN v_owner_job IS NOT NULL AND v_owner_job <> ''
+                    THEN ' - ' || v_owner_job ELSE '' END
+            || ':*' || chr(10) || v_row.content;
+        END IF;
+
+        BEGIN
+          SELECT enqueued.id INTO v_message_id
+          FROM public.enqueue_outbound_message(
+            p_contact_id             => v_row.contact_id,
+            p_client_message_id      => v_row.id,
+            p_content                => v_signed_content,
+            p_message_type           => coalesce(nullif(v_row.message_type, ''), 'text'),
+            p_media_url              => v_row.media_url,
+            p_reply_to_id            => NULL,
+            p_whatsapp_connection_id => v_row.whatsapp_connection_id,
+            p_caption                => NULL
+          ) AS enqueued
+          LIMIT 1;
+
+          IF v_message_id IS NULL THEN
+            outcome := 'failed';
+            failure_reason := 'enqueue_returned_no_row';
+          ELSE
+            message_id := v_message_id;
+            outcome := 'sent';
+          END IF;
+        EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
+          -- Motivo curto e est√°vel (sem telefone nem conte√∫do); preserva o
+          -- vocabul√°rio da reautoriza√ß√£o quando o enqueue barra pelo mesmo motivo.
+          v_message_id := NULL;
+          message_id := NULL;
+          outcome := 'failed';
+          failure_reason := CASE
+            WHEN sqlerrm LIKE '%send_messages_permission_required%' THEN 'sem_permissao'
+            WHEN sqlerrm LIKE '%active_profile_not_found%' THEN 'autor_inativo'
+            WHEN sqlerrm LIKE '%message_contact_not_authorized%' THEN 'contato_invalido'
+            WHEN sqlerrm LIKE '%no_connected_whatsapp_connection%'
+              OR sqlerrm LIKE '%selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable%'
+              OR sqlerrm LIKE '%whatsapp_connection_out_of_scope%' THEN 'conexao_invalida'
+            ELSE 'enqueue_failed'
+          END;
+        END;
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF outcome = 'sent' THEN
+      UPDATE public.scheduled_messages
+      SET status = 'sent',
+          message_id = v_message_id,
+          sent_at = now(),
+          error_message = NULL,
+          updated_at = now()
+      WHERE id = v_row.id;
+    ELSIF outcome = 'expired' THEN
+      -- J√° gravado acima (status + error_message); sem auditoria: n√£o √© falha de envio.
+      NULL;
+    ELSE
+      UPDATE public.scheduled_messages
+      SET status = 'failed',
+          message_id = NULL,
+          error_message = failure_reason,
+          updated_at = now()
+      WHERE id = v_row.id;
+
+      INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+      VALUES (
+        v_owner_user_id,
+        'scheduled_message_dispatch_failed',
+        'scheduled_message',
+        v_row.id,
+        jsonb_build_object('reason', failure_reason)
+      );
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN NEXT;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', coalesce(v_claims, ''), true);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.dispatch_scheduled_messages(integer)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.dispatch_scheduled_messages(integer)
+  TO service_role;
+
+-- Job por minuto, idempotente (mesmo nome re-agenda em vez de duplicar).
+SELECT cron.unschedule('dispatch-scheduled-messages')
+WHERE EXISTS (
+  SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'dispatch-scheduled-messages'
+);
+
+SELECT cron.schedule(
+  'dispatch-scheduled-messages',
+  '* * * * *',
+  'SELECT public.dispatch_scheduled_messages()'
+);

+-- inbox_scope_permissions
+-- Rollback: dropa a funcao de auditoria e remove as permissoes de escopo semeadas por esta migration.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text);
+--   delete from public.role_permissions where permission_id in (select id from public.permissions where name in ('inbox.view_department', 'inbox.view_all'));
+--   delete from public.permissions where name in ('inbox.view_department', 'inbox.view_all');
+--
+-- Origem: auditoria de paridade V3 -> V2 (docs/audits/AUDITORIA_PARIDADE_V3_CHAT_UI_PARTE1_2026-10-11.md)
+-- e decisao do Joaquim em 11/10/2026. A V2 so libera "Mostrar todos" por permissao: existem
+-- 'view_inbox'/'send_messages', mas NAO existe permissao de escopo (departamento/todos) nem trilha de
+-- auditoria de tentativa indevida. Esta migration e ADITIVA: semeia duas permissoes novas na categoria
+-- 'inbox', atribui a admin/supervisor e cria uma funcao de registro de tentativa fora do escopo.
+-- Nenhuma tabela nova (RLS nao se aplica); nenhum DROP/RENAME/ALTER de objeto vivo; DML so nas tabelas
+-- de catalogo de permissao, com ON CONFLICT (idempotente e reaplicavel).
+--
+-- 1. Catalogo: permissoes de escopo da inbox (categoria 'inbox', descricao em portugues).
+--    'inbox.view_department' = ver as conversas do proprio departamento.
+--    'inbox.view_all'        = ver as conversas de todos os departamentos.
+INSERT INTO public.permissions (name, description, category) VALUES
+  ('inbox.view_department', 'Inbox: ver as conversas do proprio departamento', 'inbox'),
+  ('inbox.view_all',        'Inbox: ver as conversas de todos os departamentos', 'inbox')
+ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING;
+
+-- 2. Atribuicao padrao: admin e supervisor ganham os dois escopos; agente comum fica so com "Meus".
+--    (Ajustavel depois pela tela de permissoes.) Um unico INSERT ... SELECT evita N round-trips e o
+--    ON CONFLICT (role, permission_id) respeita a PK de role_permissions (idempotente).
+INSERT INTO public.role_permissions (role, permission_id)
+SELECT matrix.role, permission.id
+FROM (VALUES
+  ('admin'::public.app_role),
+  ('supervisor'::public.app_role)
+) AS matrix(role)
+JOIN public.permissions AS permission
+  ON permission.name IN ('inbox.view_department', 'inbox.view_all')
+ON CONFLICT (role, permission_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+-- 3. Registro de tentativa indevida de escopo. SECURITY DEFINER para escrever na trilha mesmo com a
+--    policy "Block direct audit log inserts" (WITH CHECK false TO authenticated).
+--    - auth.uid() nulo (anon ou claim ausente) => nao grava nada.
+--    - details carrega SOMENTE escopos permitidos ('mine', 'department', 'all') ou 'unknown' ‚Äî nada de telefone,
+--      mensagem ou qualquer dado pessoal.
+--    - dedupe_key por usuario+escopo+hora: uma linha por hora por usuario/escopo, sem inundar
+--      (usa o indice unico parcial ux_audit_logs_dedupe_key e ON CONFLICT).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(p_scope text)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_scope text;
+BEGIN
+  -- Anonimo (ou sessao sem claim): nada e registrado.
+  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Escopo pedido, normalizado e travado na lista que a inbox aceita. Entrada invalida
+  -- (nula/vazia/fora da lista/longa demais) nao quebra o chamador: vira 'unknown'
+  -- e ainda assim fica auditada sem armazenar texto arbitrario em details/dedupe_key.
+  v_scope := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_scope, '')));
+  IF v_scope NOT IN ('mine', 'department', 'all') THEN
+    v_scope := 'unknown';
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, details, dedupe_key)
+  VALUES (
+    v_user_id,
+    'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access',
+    'inbox_scope',
+    jsonb_build_object('scope', v_scope),
+    'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access:'
+      || v_user_id::text
+      || ':' || v_scope
+      || ':' || to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc', 'YYYYMMDDHH24')
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- ACL pela ASSINATURA EXATA: revoga do publico/anon/service_role e libera so para authenticated.
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text) TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text) IS
+  'Registra em audit_logs a tentativa de acessar um escopo de inbox sem permissao (action unauthorized_inbox_scope_access). Escopos permitidos: mine, department, all; qualquer outro vira unknown. Dedupe por usuario+escopo+hora via ux_audit_logs_dedupe_key. Sem dados pessoais; anonimo nao grava.';

+--
+-- Etapa 5 do plano de paridade V3 -> V2: rollout gradual por funcionalidade.
+-- A V2 s√≥ tinha key/enabled (useFeatureFlag, liga-desliga). A V3 liberava aos poucos:
+-- percentual est√°vel por usu√°rio, pap√©is, lista de permitidos/bloqueados e expira√ß√£o.

+-- servidor (public.evaluate_feature_flags) porque as listas de usu√°rios s√£o sens√≠veis

+-- 1. Colunas aditivas. Linhas existentes: rollout 100%, listas vazias, sem expira√ß√£o,
+--    metadata vazio ‚Äî comportamento id√™ntico ao de antes (flag ligada = ligada para todos).
+alter table public.feature_flags
+  add column if not exists rollout_percentage integer not null default 100 check (rollout_percentage between 0 and 100),
+  add column if not exists allowed_roles text[] not null default '{}',
+  add column if not exists allowed_user_ids uuid[] not null default '{}',
+  add column if not exists blocked_user_ids uuid[] not null default '{}',
+  add column if not exists expires_at timestamptz,
+  add column if not exists metadata jsonb not null default '{}';

+comment on column public.feature_flags.rollout_percentage is 'Percentual est√°vel (0..100) do rollout. Avaliado por hash de (user_id || key) mod 100 em public.evaluate_feature_flags.';
+comment on column public.feature_flags.allowed_roles is 'Pap√©is (app_role::text) com acesso garantido. Vazio = todos os pap√©is passam pelo port√£o de papel.';
+comment on column public.feature_flags.allowed_user_ids is 'UUIDs com acesso sempre garantido (vencem papel e percentual). NUNCA exposta ao cliente comum.';
+comment on column public.feature_flags.blocked_user_ids is 'UUIDs sempre barrados (vencem permitidos). NUNCA exposta ao cliente comum.';
+comment on column public.feature_flags.expires_at is 'Quando preenchida no passado, a flag deixa de valer. NULL = sem expira√ß√£o.';
+
+-- 2. RPC de avalia√ß√£o no servidor. Devolve s√≥ as chaves LIGADAS para o usu√°rio atual
+--    (text[]), nunca a linha nem as listas. Ordem de decis√£o:
+--      enabled (e n√£o expirada) -> n√£o bloqueado -> permitido explicitamente OU
+--      (papel aprovado E percentual aprovado).
+--    Hash est√°vel: hashtextextended(user_id::text || '|' || key, 0) mod 100 ‚Äî mesmo
+--    par (usu√°rio, chave) sempre cai no mesmo balde, entre sess√µes e deploys.
+create or replace function public.evaluate_feature_flags()
+returns text[]
+language plpgsql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path = pg_catalog, public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_keys text[];
+begin
+  if v_uid is null then
+    raise exception 'access_denied' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  select coalesce(array_agg(f.key order by f.key), '{}'::text[])
+    into v_keys
+  from public.feature_flags f
+  where f.enabled
+    and (f.expires_at is null or f.expires_at > now())
+    and not (v_uid = any(f.blocked_user_ids))
+    and (
+      v_uid = any(f.allowed_user_ids)
+      or (
+        (
+          cardinality(f.allowed_roles) = 0
+          or exists (
+            select 1
+            from public.user_roles ur
+            where ur.user_id = v_uid
+              and ur.role::text = any(f.allowed_roles)
+          )
+        )
+        and (
+          f.rollout_percentage >= 100
+          or ((hashtextextended(v_uid::text || '|' || f.key, 0) % 100) + 100) % 100 < f.rollout_percentage
+        )
+      )
+    );
+
+  return v_keys;
+end;
+$$;
+

+revoke all on function public.evaluate_feature_flags() from public;

+-- edit_message_rpc
+-- Rollback: recria o UPDATE direto de content (dropa a guarda de colunas imutaveis e a RPC edit_message).
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop trigger if exists trg_guard_message_immutable_columns on public.messages;
+--   drop function if exists public.guard_message_immutable_columns();
+--   drop function if exists public.edit_message(uuid, text);
+--
+-- Defeito: o cliente edita mensagem com UPDATE direto em public.messages. A
+-- policy de UPDATE e por CONTATO (visibilidade), nao por remetente: qualquer
+-- agente que ve o contato reescreve o conteudo de uma mensagem RECEBIDA ou ja
+-- enviada, e ainda pode trocar sender / external_id / created_at.
+--
+-- Correcao em duas pecas:
+--   1. public.edit_message(uuid, text) SECURITY DEFINER: unico caminho legitimo
+--      para mudar o conteudo. Valida remetente (sender='agent'), mensagem ja
+--      enviada (external_id), nao apagada, janela de 15 min, visibilidade do
+--      contato (mesma regra das policies) e permissao send_messages; grava
+--      is_edited=true e um evento de auditoria SEM o texto da mensagem.
+--   2. public.guard_message_immutable_columns() (trigger BEFORE UPDATE): sob o
+--      papel authenticated, recusa mudar sender / created_at / external_id /
+--      contact_id / agent_id e recusa mudar content fora da RPC. A sessao da
+--      RPC e sinalizada por uma configuracao local (app.edit_message_rpc) e so
+--      vale junto com o dono (postgres): um UPDATE direto de authenticated nao
+--      consegue se auto-marcar.
+--      O soft delete (is_deleted=true, tombstone '[Mensagem apagada]') continua
+--      funcionando, e service_role / Edge seguem escrevendo status e external_id.
+--
+-- Mapa dos fluxos legitimos que atualizam public.messages (item 1 do cartao) e as
+-- colunas de cada um. Nenhum deles e barrado pela guarda:
+--   - is_read (marcar lido/nao lido): src/services/chat.service.ts,
+--     src/services/realtime.service.ts, src/hooks/inbox/useInboxBulkActions.ts e
+--     supabase/functions/_shared/evolution-webhook-handlers.ts (service_role)
+--     -> coluna is_read (fora do UPDATE OF do gatilho).
+--   - soft delete: src/components/inbox/MessageContextActions.tsx e
+--     src/components/inbox/chat/MessageHoverToolbar.tsx -> is_deleted + content
+--      (tombstone '[Mensagem apagada]'); a guarda libera s√≥ esse tombstone exato
+--      na primeira transi√ß√£o para apagada e recusa desfazer is_deleted por cliente.
+--   - transcricao: src/components/inbox/AudioMessagePlayer.tsx -> transcription,
+--     transcription_status (fora do UPDATE OF do gatilho).
+--   - media_url: supabase/functions/migrate-media-storage e
+--     recover-corrupted-audios (service_role) -> media_url.
+--   - status/external_id/entrega: Edges com service_role e as RPCs
+--     claim/complete/fail_outbound_message (dono postgres) -> status,
+--     status_updated_at, external_id, delivery_*.
+--   - reactions: tabela public.message_reactions (nao messages).
+--   - edicao de conteudo pelo cliente: passa a ser SO a RPC edit_message.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_message_immutable_columns()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  -- Edges (service_role) continuam atualizando status, external_id e midia.
+  IF current_user = 'service_role' THEN
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Identidade da mensagem: nunca muda pelo cliente autenticado. O dono da RPC
+  -- (postgres) nao e barrado aqui porque complete_outbound_message troca
+  -- external_id/status; o conteudo tem guarda propria abaixo, que vale para ele
+  -- tambem.
+  IF current_user <> 'postgres' THEN
+    IF NEW.sender IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.sender
+       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
+       OR NEW.external_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.external_id
+       OR NEW.contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contact_id
+       OR NEW.agent_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.agent_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_immutable_columns_forbidden'
+        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Conteudo: so pela RPC edit_message (dono + marca de sessao) ou no soft
+  -- delete inicial com o tombstone padrao. Um UPDATE direto de content por
+  -- authenticated cai aqui, mesmo dentro da janela de edicao; ligar is_deleted=true
+  -- com outro texto, reescrever uma mensagem ja apagada ou desfazer is_deleted
+  -- nao vira atalho.
+  IF OLD.is_deleted IS TRUE
+     AND NEW.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
+     AND current_user NOT IN ('postgres', 'service_role') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_undelete_forbidden'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NEW.content IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.content
+     AND NOT (OLD.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
+              AND NEW.is_deleted IS TRUE
+              AND NEW.content = '[Mensagem apagada]')
+     AND NOT (current_user = 'postgres'
+              AND coalesce(current_setting('app.edit_message_rpc', true), 'off') = 'on') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_content_edit_requires_rpc'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.guard_message_immutable_columns()
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_message_immutable_columns
+BEFORE UPDATE OF content, sender, created_at, external_id, contact_id, agent_id, is_deleted
+ON public.messages
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_message_immutable_columns();
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edit_message(
+  p_message_id uuid,
+  p_new_content text
+)
+RETURNS public.messages
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_content text;
+  v_message public.messages%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_message_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_message_edit' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_content := btrim(p_new_content);
+  IF v_content IS NULL OR v_content = '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_message_edit_content' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+  IF length(v_content) > 4096 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_edit_content_too_long' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_message
+  FROM public.messages
+  WHERE id = p_message_id
+  FOR UPDATE;
+
+  -- Mesmo erro para "nao existe" e "nao pode ver": nao vira oraculo de
+  -- existencia de mensagem para quem nao tem visibilidade do contato.
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_not_found_or_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF public.is_contact_visible_to_user(v_message.contact_id, auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_not_found_or_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF public.user_has_permission(auth.uid(), 'send_messages') IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'send_messages_permission_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- S√≥ mensagem enviada pelo agente, ja com id do provedor, e viva.
+  IF v_message.sender <> 'agent'
+     OR v_message.external_id IS NULL
+     OR v_message.is_deleted IS TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_not_editable' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_message.created_at < statement_timestamp() - interval '15 minutes' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_edit_window_expired' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Marca de sessao lida pela guarda; so o dono (postgres) a carrega.
+  PERFORM set_config('app.edit_message_rpc', 'on', true);
+
+  UPDATE public.messages
+  SET content = v_content,
+      is_edited = true,
+      updated_at = statement_timestamp()
+  WHERE id = p_message_id
+  RETURNING * INTO v_message;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+  VALUES (
+    auth.uid(),
+    'message_edited',
+    'message',
+    p_message_id,
+    jsonb_build_object('contact_id', v_message.contact_id)
+  );
+
+  RETURN v_message;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.edit_message(uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.edit_message(uuid, text) TO authenticated;

+-- ===================== 2. report_message: corpo com a lista do cart√£o =====================
+create or replace function public.report_message(
+  p_message_id uuid,
+  p_reason text,
+  p_note text default null
+)
+returns uuid
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = pg_catalog, public
+as $$
+declare
+  v_user    uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_contact uuid;
+  v_note    text;
+  v_id      uuid;
+begin
+  if v_user is null then
+    raise exception 'not_authenticated' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  if p_reason is null or p_reason not in ('spam', 'improprio', 'urgencia', 'outro') then
+    raise exception 'invalid_report_reason' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  v_note := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note, '')), '');
+  if v_note is not null and char_length(v_note) > 500 then
+    raise exception 'invalid_report_note' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  select m.contact_id into v_contact
+  from public.messages m
+  where m.id = p_message_id
+    and public.is_contact_visible_to_user(m.contact_id, v_user);
+
+  if v_contact is null then
+    raise exception 'message_not_visible' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  insert into public.message_reports (message_id, reporter_id, reason, note)
+  values (p_message_id, v_user, p_reason, v_note)
+  on conflict (message_id, reporter_id) do nothing
+  returning id into v_id;
+
+  if v_id is null then
+    -- ja havia relato deste usuario para esta mensagem: devolve o existente
+    select id into v_id
+    from public.message_reports
+    where message_id = p_message_id and reporter_id = v_user;
+  else
+    insert into public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+    values (v_user, 'message_reported', 'message', p_message_id,
+            jsonb_build_object('report_id', v_id, 'reason', p_reason));
+  end if;
+
+  return v_id;
+end;
+$$;
+
+-- ===================== 3. CHECK do reason com os valores do cart√£o =====================
+alter table public.message_reports drop constraint if exists message_reports_reason_check;
+alter table public.message_reports add constraint message_reports_reason_check check (reason in ('spam', 'improprio', 'urgencia', 'outro'));
