+-- get_send_metrics
+-- Rollback: tudo desta migration e NOVO (uma funcao), entao o inverso e so dropar a funcao.
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.get_send_metrics(timestamptz, uuid);
+--
+-- AUDITORIA_PARIDADE_V3_CHAT_UI_PARTE1 (11/10/2026), faixa C.
+-- DEFEITO: o painel de metricas de envio (ChatMonitoringDialog da V3) nao tem
+-- numero agregado; sem RPC a tela varreria public.messages inteira (RLS linha a
+-- linha) para contar por status, taxa de falha, latencia e erros.
+--
+-- Esta migration e ADITIVA: cria UMA funcao de leitura agregada e restrita a
+-- admin/supervisor. Nao cria tabela, nao muda coluna, nao mexe em RLS/GRANT de
+-- objeto existente e nao grava nada. Sem payload, sem telefone e sem texto de
+-- mensagem: a funcao devolve apenas contagens, taxas, latencia e o error_code
+-- (ja sanitizado pelo produtor em message_attempts).
+--
+-- Efeitos colaterais: nenhum. Nao ha trigger novo, nao toca messages nem o
+-- updated_at de nada, nao publica no realtime e nenhum GRANT/REVOKE muda objeto
+-- que ja existia. A unica permissao concedida e EXECUTE a authenticated (para os
+-- papeis de leitura) e a service_role; anon e PUBLIC ficam de fora.
+--
+-- Janela: p_since e limitado a no maximo 30 dias; pedido mais antigo e RECUSADO
+-- com erro de parametro (nao truncado silenciosamente), para o painel nunca
+-- varrer o historico inteiro.
+--
+-- Sem dados pessoais: nenhum campo desta funcao guarda ou devolve telefone,
+-- texto de mensagem ou payload do provedor.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- get_send_metrics: resumo agregado das mensagens enviadas por agente --------
+-- SECURITY DEFINER porque soma por cima da RLS de messages; a barreira e o
+-- EXECUTE (so authenticated/service_role) + a checagem explicita de papel
+-- (is_admin_or_supervisor, que le user_roles) DEPOIS de barrar anon.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_send_metrics(
+  p_since timestamptz DEFAULT now() - interval '24 hours',
+  p_connection_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_since timestamptz := COALESCE(p_since, now() - interval '24 hours');
+  v_floor timestamptz := now() - interval '30 days';
+BEGIN
+  -- So admin ou supervisor. Agente comum e anon recebem erro de permissao.
+  IF NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: admin or supervisor required'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Janela maxima de 30 dias (recusa, nao trunca).
+  IF v_since < v_floor THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'period_too_wide: p_since must be within the last 30 days'
+      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'since', v_since,
+    'until', now(),
+
+    -- Totais por status das mensagens de saida (sender='agent') no periodo.
+    'totals', (
+      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+        'sending',   count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'sending'),
+        'sent',      count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'sent'),
+        'delivered', count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'delivered'),
+        'read',      count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'read'),
+        'failed',    count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'failed'),
+        'total',     count(*)
+      )
+      FROM public.messages AS m
+      WHERE m.sender = 'agent'
+        AND m.created_at >= v_since
+        AND (p_connection_id IS NULL OR m.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id)
+    ),
+
+    -- Taxa de falha (0..1), 4 casas. Zero quando nao ha mensagem no periodo.
+    'failure_rate', (
+      SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0
+             ELSE round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'failed')::numeric
+                        / count(*), 4)
+             END
+      FROM public.messages AS m
+      WHERE m.sender = 'agent'
+        AND m.created_at >= v_since
+        AND (p_connection_id IS NULL OR m.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id)
+    ),
+
+    -- Media de tentativas por mensagem (delivery_attempt_count).
+    'avg_attempts', (
+      SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(m.delivery_attempt_count)::numeric, 2), 0)
+      FROM public.messages AS m
+      WHERE m.sender = 'agent'
+        AND m.created_at >= v_since
+        AND (p_connection_id IS NULL OR m.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id)
+    ),
+
+    -- Latencia p95 de envio (ms): status_updated_at - created_at das enviadas.
+    'latency_p95_ms', (
+      SELECT round(
+               percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (
+                 ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (m.status_updated_at - m.created_at)) * 1000
+               )::numeric, 1)
+      FROM public.messages AS m
+      WHERE m.sender = 'agent'
+        AND m.created_at >= v_since
+        AND m.status_updated_at IS NOT NULL
+        AND m.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
+        AND (p_connection_id IS NULL OR m.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id)
+    ),
+
+    -- Top 10 error_code das tentativas de envio no periodo (contagem).
+    'top_errors', (
+      SELECT COALESCE(
+        jsonb_agg(
+          jsonb_build_object('error_code', e.error_code, 'count', e.count)
+          ORDER BY e.count DESC, e.error_code
+        ), '[]'::jsonb)
+      FROM (
+        SELECT a.error_code, count(*) AS count
+        FROM public.message_attempts AS a
+        JOIN public.messages AS m ON m.id = a.message_id
+        WHERE a.error_code IS NOT NULL
+          AND a.created_at >= v_since
+          AND m.sender = 'agent'
+          AND (p_connection_id IS NULL OR m.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id)
+        GROUP BY a.error_code
+        ORDER BY count(*) DESC, a.error_code
+        LIMIT 10
+      ) AS e
+    ),
+
+    -- Quebra por conexao: id e nome, NUNCA telefone.
+    'by_connection', (
+      SELECT COALESCE(
+        jsonb_agg(
+          jsonb_build_object(
+            'connection_id', c.connection_id,
+            'connection_name', c.connection_name,
+            'total', c.total,
+            'failed', c.failed
+          ) ORDER BY c.total DESC, c.connection_id
+        ), '[]'::jsonb)
+      FROM (
+        SELECT m.whatsapp_connection_id AS connection_id,
+               wc.name AS connection_name,
+               count(*) AS total,
+               count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'failed') AS failed
+        FROM public.messages AS m
+        LEFT JOIN public.whatsapp_connections AS wc
+          ON wc.id = m.whatsapp_connection_id
+        WHERE m.sender = 'agent'
+          AND m.created_at >= v_since
+          AND (p_connection_id IS NULL OR m.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id)
+        GROUP BY m.whatsapp_connection_id, wc.name
+        ORDER BY count(*) DESC, m.whatsapp_connection_id
+      ) AS c
+    )
+  );
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_send_metrics(timestamptz, uuid)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_send_metrics(timestamptz, uuid)
+  TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMIT;

+--   * INSERT de public.whisper_messages s√≥ exigia sender_id = perfil do chamador, sem

+-- o job entregaria. O mesmo valia para o sussurro a um contato que o agente n√£o enxerga.
+--
+-- Reaproveita os MESMOS helpers j√° usados pelas policies de public.messages e pela RPC
+-- enqueue_outbound_message (20260925120000 e 20260930200000):
+--   is_contact_visible_to_user(contact_id, auth.uid()) -> contato atribu√≠do ao chamador, ou
+--       admin/supervisor (√© exatamente a guarda de envio da RPC de fila);
+--   user_has_permission(auth.uid(), 'send_messages')    -> a mesma permiss√£o exigida no envio.

+BEGIN;
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can create scheduled messages" ON public.scheduled_messages;
+CREATE POLICY "Users can create scheduled messages" ON public.scheduled_messages
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
+  WITH CHECK (
+    public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+    OR (
+      created_by IN (SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
+      AND public.is_contact_visible_to_user(contact_id, auth.uid())
+      AND public.user_has_permission(auth.uid(), 'send_messages')
+    )
+  );
+

+-- apontar para contato n√£o vis√≠vel nem para created_by de outro usu√°rio. USING mant√©m

+CREATE POLICY "Users can update their scheduled messages" ON public.scheduled_messages

+  )

+    public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())

+      created_by IN (SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid())

+    )
+  );

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_group_outbound_message(
+  p_group_id uuid,
+  p_client_message_id uuid,
+  p_content text,
+  p_message_type text DEFAULT 'text',
+  p_media_url text DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_reply_to_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_whatsapp_connection_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_caption text DEFAULT NULL
+) RETURNS public.messages
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_connection_id uuid;
+  v_assigned_connection_id uuid;
+  v_group_jid text;
+  v_reply_group_id uuid;
+  v_message public.messages%ROWTYPE;
+  v_message_type text := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_message_type, ''), 'text');
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- L9 (docs/ia/IA-004-matriz-autorizacao.md): mesma guarda de permissao da versao de contato.
+  IF public.user_has_permission(auth.uid(), 'send_messages') IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'send_messages_permission_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_group_id IS NULL OR p_client_message_id IS NULL
+     OR p_content IS NULL OR length(p_content) > 65536
+     OR v_message_type NOT IN ('text', 'image', 'audio', 'video', 'document', 'sticker', 'location')
+     OR length(COALESCE(p_media_url, '')) > 4096
+     OR length(COALESCE(p_caption, '')) > 65536
+     OR (p_media_url IS NOT NULL AND p_media_url !~ '^https://')
+     OR (v_message_type NOT IN ('text', 'location') AND p_media_url IS NULL)
+     OR (v_message_type = 'location' AND p_media_url IS NOT NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outbound_message' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Acesso ao grupo: a policy de SELECT de public.whatsapp_groups ja autoriza todo authenticated
+  -- ("Authenticated users can view whatsapp groups", USING (true)); a fronteira real de escrita e a
+  -- permissao send_messages acima + o escopo de conexao abaixo. Grupo inexistente e grupo sem
+  -- acesso tem a MESMA resposta (sem oraculo de enumeracao).
+  SELECT grp.whatsapp_connection_id, grp.group_id
+    INTO v_assigned_connection_id, v_group_jid
+  FROM public.whatsapp_groups AS grp
+  WHERE grp.id = p_group_id
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_group_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  -- Sem JID de grupo valido a mensagem ficaria presa na fila para sempre (Evolution recebe `number`
+  -- invalido). Recusa cedo, como o telefone invalido e recusado no ramo de contato.
+  IF v_group_jid IS NULL OR v_group_jid !~ '^[0-9][0-9-]*@g[.]us$' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_group_not_deliverable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Mesma resolucao de conexao da versao de contato: conexao atribuida ao grupo, escolha explicita
+  -- valida, e fallback para a conexao 'connected' mais recente.
+  IF p_whatsapp_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = p_whatsapp_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+    IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected_whatsapp_connection_unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF v_assigned_connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.id = v_assigned_connection_id
+      AND connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT connection.id INTO v_connection_id
+    FROM public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    WHERE connection.status = 'connected'
+      AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL
+    ORDER BY connection.updated_at DESC, connection.id
+    LIMIT 1;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_connection_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_connected_whatsapp_connection' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Visibilidade do grupo: se a conexao do grupo (ou a conexao resolvida, quando o grupo
+  -- ainda nao tem conexao atribuida) esta vinculada a fila, usuario comum precisa ser
+  -- membro ativo de alguma dessas filas. A resposta fica igual a grupo inexistente para
+  -- nao criar oraculo de enumeracao.
+  IF public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
+     AND EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+       FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = COALESCE(v_assigned_connection_id, v_connection_id)
+     )
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+       FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       JOIN public.queue_members AS member ON member.queue_id = link.queue_id
+       JOIN public.profiles AS caller_profile ON caller_profile.id = member.profile_id
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = COALESCE(v_assigned_connection_id, v_connection_id)
+         AND caller_profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+         AND caller_profile.is_active
+         AND COALESCE(member.is_active, true)
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message_group_not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- L7: mesma regra de escopo de conexao por fila da versao de contato para a conexao
+  -- efetivamente usada no envio quando ela difere da conexao propria do grupo.
+  IF public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
+     AND v_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_assigned_connection_id
+     AND EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id
+     )
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1
+       FROM public.whatsapp_connection_queues AS link
+       JOIN public.queue_members AS member ON member.queue_id = link.queue_id
+       JOIN public.profiles AS caller_profile ON caller_profile.id = member.profile_id
+       WHERE link.whatsapp_connection_id = v_connection_id
+         AND caller_profile.user_id = auth.uid()
+         AND caller_profile.is_active
+         AND COALESCE(member.is_active, true)
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'whatsapp_connection_out_of_scope' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT profile.id INTO v_profile_id
+  FROM public.profiles AS profile
+  WHERE profile.user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.is_active = true
+  LIMIT 1
+  FOR SHARE;
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active_profile_not_found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_reply_to_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT reply.whatsapp_group_id INTO v_reply_group_id
+    FROM public.messages AS reply WHERE reply.id = p_reply_to_id;
+    IF NOT FOUND OR v_reply_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_group_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'reply_message_group_mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
+    hashtextextended('group:' || p_group_id::text || ':' || p_client_message_id::text, 0)
+  );
+
+  INSERT INTO public.messages (
+    contact_id, whatsapp_group_id, client_message_id, whatsapp_connection_id, agent_id,
+    sender, content, message_type, media_url, caption, reply_to_id,
+    is_read, status, external_id, status_updated_at
+  ) VALUES (
+    NULL, p_group_id, p_client_message_id, v_connection_id, v_profile_id,
+    'agent', p_content, v_message_type, p_media_url, p_caption, p_reply_to_id,
+    true, 'sending', NULL, statement_timestamp()
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_group_id, client_message_id)
+    WHERE client_message_id IS NOT NULL AND whatsapp_group_id IS NOT NULL
+  DO NOTHING RETURNING * INTO v_message;
+
+  IF v_message.id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT * INTO v_message
+    FROM public.messages AS message
+    WHERE message.whatsapp_group_id = p_group_id
+      AND message.client_message_id = p_client_message_id;
+    IF v_message.id IS NULL
+       OR v_message.agent_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_profile_id
+       OR v_message.sender IS DISTINCT FROM 'agent'
+       OR v_message.content IS DISTINCT FROM p_content
+       OR v_message.message_type IS DISTINCT FROM v_message_type
+       OR v_message.media_url IS DISTINCT FROM p_media_url
+       OR v_message.caption IS DISTINCT FROM p_caption
+       OR v_message.reply_to_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_reply_to_id
+       OR v_message.whatsapp_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_connection_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_message_id_reused_with_different_payload'
+        USING ERRCODE = '23505';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN v_message;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_group_outbound_message(
+  uuid, uuid, text, text, text, uuid, uuid, text
+) FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_group_outbound_message(
+  uuid, uuid, text, text, text, uuid, uuid, text
+) TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.enqueue_group_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, text, text, uuid, uuid, text) IS
+  'authenticated-only idempotent enqueue of an outbound message to a whatsapp_groups.id; same queue guarantees as enqueue_outbound_message.';
+
+-- 5) claim_outbound_message passa a resolver destino de grupo. Assinatura/retorno/ACL identicos:
+--    muda so o destino (JID do grupo no lugar do telefone) e a resolucao da conexao do grupo.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_outbound_message(
+  p_message_id uuid,
+  p_agent_id uuid,
+  p_worker text,
+  p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 90
+) RETURNS TABLE(
+  message_id uuid,
+  client_message_id uuid,
+  contact_id uuid,
+  agent_id uuid,
+  content text,
+  message_type text,
+  media_url text,
+  caption text,
+  media_filename text,
+  media_mimetype text,
+  reply_to_id uuid,
+  reply_external_id text,
+  whatsapp_connection_id uuid,
+  whatsapp_instance_name text,
+  contact_phone text,
+  claim_token uuid,
+  claim_expires_at timestamptz,
+  delivery_attempt_count integer
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+  IF p_message_id IS NULL OR p_agent_id IS NULL
+     OR p_worker IS NULL OR p_worker !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]{1,100}$'
+     OR p_lease_seconds IS NULL OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 300 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_delivery_claim' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+  WITH candidate AS (
+    SELECT message.id, connection.id AS resolved_connection_id
+    FROM public.messages AS message
+    LEFT JOIN public.contacts AS contact ON contact.id = message.contact_id
+    LEFT JOIN public.whatsapp_groups AS grp ON grp.id = message.whatsapp_group_id
+    JOIN public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+      ON connection.id = COALESCE(
+        message.whatsapp_connection_id, contact.whatsapp_connection_id,
+        grp.whatsapp_connection_id
+      )
+     AND connection.status = 'connected'
+     AND NULLIF(connection.instance_id, '') IS NOT NULL
+    WHERE message.id = p_message_id
+      AND message.agent_id = p_agent_id
+      AND message.sender = 'agent'
+      AND message.status = 'sending'
+      AND message.external_id IS NULL
+      AND message.client_message_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND (
+        (message.contact_id IS NOT NULL
+          AND regexp_replace(contact.phone, '\D', '', 'g') ~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$')
+        OR (message.whatsapp_group_id IS NOT NULL
+          AND grp.group_id ~ '^[0-9][0-9-]*@g[.]us$')
+      )
+      AND (message.delivery_claim_token IS NULL
+        OR message.delivery_claim_expires_at <= statement_timestamp())
+    FOR UPDATE OF message SKIP LOCKED
+  ), claimed AS (
+    UPDATE public.messages AS message
+    SET delivery_claim_token = gen_random_uuid(),
+        delivery_claimed_at = statement_timestamp(),
+        delivery_claim_expires_at = statement_timestamp()
+          + make_interval(secs => p_lease_seconds),
+        delivery_claimed_by = p_worker,
+        delivery_attempt_count = message.delivery_attempt_count + 1,
+        whatsapp_connection_id = candidate.resolved_connection_id,
+        updated_at = statement_timestamp()
+    FROM candidate
+    WHERE message.id = candidate.id
+    RETURNING message.*
+  )
+  SELECT claimed.id, claimed.client_message_id, claimed.contact_id,
+         claimed.agent_id, claimed.content, claimed.message_type,
+         claimed.media_url, claimed.caption, claimed.media_filename,
+         claimed.media_mimetype, claimed.reply_to_id, reply.external_id,
+         claimed.whatsapp_connection_id, connection.instance_id,
+         CASE
+           WHEN claimed.contact_id IS NOT NULL
+             THEN regexp_replace(contact.phone, '\D', '', 'g')
+           ELSE grp.group_id
+         END,
+         claimed.delivery_claim_token,
+         claimed.delivery_claim_expires_at, claimed.delivery_attempt_count
+  FROM claimed
+  LEFT JOIN public.contacts AS contact ON contact.id = claimed.contact_id
+  LEFT JOIN public.whatsapp_groups AS grp ON grp.id = claimed.whatsapp_group_id
+  JOIN public.whatsapp_connections AS connection
+    ON connection.id = claimed.whatsapp_connection_id
+  LEFT JOIN public.messages AS reply ON reply.id = claimed.reply_to_id;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.claim_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, integer)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.claim_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, integer)
+  TO service_role;

+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.claim_outbound_message(uuid, uuid, text, integer) IS
+  'service_role-only atomic lease; transport reuses a stable provider id. contact_phone carries the E.164 phone for contact messages or the group JID for group messages.';

+-- 20261011173000_admin_cron_jobs
+-- Rollback: dropa as tres funcoes novas (a lista de permitidos e as duas RPCs); o estado dos jobs do pg_cron nao muda (a funcao so liga/desliga por chamada do admin, nao no DDL).
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.admin_toggle_cron_job(text, boolean);
+--   drop function if exists public.admin_list_cron_jobs();
+--   drop function if exists public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos();
+--
+-- admin_list_cron_jobs() e admin_toggle_cron_job(p_jobname, p_ativo): leitura da agenda, do
+-- estado ativo e da ULTIMA execucao (cron.job_run_details) dos jobs do pg_cron da propria
+-- aplicacao, e liga/desliga controlado com auditoria em public.audit_logs.
+-- Paridade V3 -> V2 do painel admin (onda de paridade global, 11/10/2026).
+--
+-- Escopo: a lista de jobs TOCAVEIS e fixa (public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos) e cobre so os
+-- jobs que executam funcionalidade da aplicacao. Ficam FORA, de proposito:
+--   * vacuum-contacts-daily e vacuum-messages-post-expurgo -> VACUUM do banco (manutencao
+--     critica: parar acumula dead tuples e degrada o banco);
+--   * cleanup-edge-rate-limits e cleanup-link-preview-cache -> limpeza de tabela/cache
+--     (parar acumula lixo e incha as tabelas).
+-- Pausar qualquer um desses nao e operacao de produto; por isso nao ha caminho para eles.
+--
+-- Classe: RPC de admin (SECURITY DEFINER + checagem interna) ‚Äî aplicada pelo
+-- hermes-db-migrar na copia de trabalho.
+
+-- Lista unica dos jobs que o painel pode ver e ligar/desligar. Fonte da verdade dos dois
+-- lados (listar e alternar), para nao haver deriva entre o que aparece e o que muda.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos()
+RETURNS text[]
+LANGUAGE sql
+IMMUTABLE
+SET search_path = pg_catalog
+AS $$
+  SELECT ARRAY[
+    'ai-jobs-tick-1min',
+    'avatars-refresh',
+    'connection-health-check',
+    'expire-stale-agent-presence',
+    'gmail-incremental-sync',
+    'multiplix-send-trigger',
+    'searchbox-budget-alert',
+    'talkx-scheduler-1min',
+    'tasks-notify-due'

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_cron_jobs()
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  jobname             text,
+  schedule            text,
+  active              boolean,
+  last_status         text,
+  last_run_at         timestamptz,
+  last_return_message text
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, cron
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.is_admin(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_list_cron_jobs: acesso restrito a administradores'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT j.jobname::text,
+         j.schedule::text,
+         j.active,
+         d.status,
+         d.start_time,
+         left(coalesce(d.return_message, ''), 200)
+  FROM cron.job j
+  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+    SELECT r.status, r.start_time, r.return_message
+    FROM cron.job_run_details r
+    WHERE r.jobid = j.jobid
+    ORDER BY r.start_time DESC
+    LIMIT 1
+  ) d ON true
+  WHERE j.jobname = ANY (public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos())
+  ORDER BY j.jobname;
+END;
+$$;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_toggle_cron_job(
+  p_jobname text,
+  p_ativo   boolean
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, cron
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_jobid     bigint;
+  v_antes     boolean;
+  v_alterado  boolean := false;
+  v_resultado boolean;
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.is_admin(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_toggle_cron_job: acesso restrito a administradores'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_ativo IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_toggle_cron_job: p_ativo nao pode ser nulo'
+      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Allow-list: job fora da lista (manutencao/limpeza ou desconhecido) nao e tocavel aqui.
+  IF p_jobname IS NULL OR NOT (p_jobname = ANY (public.admin_cron_jobs_permitidos())) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_toggle_cron_job: job "%" nao esta na lista de jobs da aplicacao',
+      coalesce(p_jobname, '(nulo)')
+      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- So o job do dono atual: o indice unico do pg_cron e (jobname, username). Homonimo de
+  -- outro dono nao e alcancado (nem por engano ligado/desligado) e cai no "nao encontrado".
+  SELECT j.jobid, j.active INTO v_jobid, v_antes
+  FROM cron.job j
+  WHERE j.jobname = p_jobname
+    AND j.username = current_user
+  ORDER BY j.jobid
+  LIMIT 1;
+
+  IF v_jobid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_toggle_cron_job: job "%" nao encontrado', p_jobname
+      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Idempotente: se ja esta no estado pedido, nao reescreve o job (nao gera UPDATE no
+  -- cron.job nem muda nada). Senao altera NO LUGAR, preservando jobid e historico.
+  IF v_antes IS DISTINCT FROM p_ativo THEN
+    v_resultado := cron.alter_job(job_id := v_jobid, active := p_ativo);
+    IF v_resultado IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_toggle_cron_job: pg_cron nao confirmou a alteracao do job "%"', p_jobname
+        USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    v_alterado := true;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Auditoria na MESMA transacao do alter_job: se este insert falhar, a alteracao do
+  -- pg_cron tambem volta atras. Sem PII: so o nome do job e os estados.
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, details)
+  VALUES (
+    auth.uid(),
+    'admin_cron_job_toggle',
+    'cron_job',
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'jobname', p_jobname,
+      'ativo_antes', v_antes,
+      'ativo_depois', p_ativo,
+      'alterado', v_alterado
+    )
+  );
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'jobname', p_jobname,
+    'ativo', p_ativo,
+    'ativo_antes', v_antes,
+    'alterado', v_alterado
+  );
+END;
+$$;

+--      sao a UNICA via de escrita):

+--                         public.is_contact_visible_to_user, que ja inclui admin/

+-- ============================================================================

+  CONSTRAINT sla_alert_events_resolved_consistente

+-- admin/supervisor). INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE nao tem policy: por padrao a RLS nega,
+-- e nenhum papel de cliente tem o GRANT ‚Äî so as funcoes DEFINER escrevem.
+CREATE POLICY "sla_alert_events_select_policy"
+  ON public.sla_alert_events

+    public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())

+-- 2) Preferencias de alerta por usuario
+-- ============================================================================

+-- 3) Funcoes de escrita (SECURITY DEFINER) ‚Äî unica via de INSERT/UPDATE no historico
+-- ============================================================================

+-- Idempotente: se ja existe alerta ATIVO para (contato, tipo, severidade), devolve o
+-- id existente sem criar linha nova nem reordenar/reescrever nada. Autorizacao: precisa
+-- ver o contato (ou ser staff); service_role (cron futuro) pode registrar.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_sla_alert(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_alert_type text,
+  p_severity text
+) RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_queue_id uuid;
+  v_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL AND coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sessao_nao_autenticada' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_alert_type IS NULL OR p_alert_type NOT IN ('first_response', 'resolution') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'alert_type_invalido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_severity IS NULL OR p_severity NOT IN ('warning', 'breached') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'severity_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT c.queue_id INTO v_queue_id
+    FROM public.contacts c
+   WHERE c.id = p_contact_id;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'contato_inexistente' USING ERRCODE = '23503';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
+     AND NOT (
+       public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+       OR public.is_contact_visible_to_user(p_contact_id, auth.uid())
+     ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sem_permissao_para_o_contato' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.sla_alert_events (contact_id, alert_type, severity, queue_id)
+  VALUES (p_contact_id, p_alert_type, p_severity, v_queue_id)
+  ON CONFLICT (contact_id, alert_type, severity) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
+  DO NOTHING
+  RETURNING id INTO v_id;
+
+  IF v_id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT e.id INTO v_id
+      FROM public.sla_alert_events e
+     WHERE e.contact_id = p_contact_id
+       AND e.alert_type = p_alert_type
+       AND e.severity = p_severity
+       AND e.resolved_at IS NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN v_id;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.record_sla_alert(uuid, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_sla_alert(uuid, text, text)
+  TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Resolver e' ato de STAFF (admin/supervisor). Marca resolved_at/resolved_by na linha
+-- ATIVA (auditoria = id de perfil + instante, sem dado pessoal). Nao e idempotente:
+-- resolver de novo levanta P0002 (nada a resolver).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_sla_alert(p_event_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_id uuid;
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sessao_nao_autenticada' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'somente_staff_resolve_alerta' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_profile_id := public.get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid());
+
+  UPDATE public.sla_alert_events e
+     SET resolved_at = now(),
+         resolved_by = coalesce(v_profile_id, e.resolved_by)
+   WHERE e.id = p_event_id
+     AND e.resolved_at IS NULL
+  RETURNING e.id INTO v_id;
+
+  IF v_id IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'alerta_inexistente_ou_ja_resolvido' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN v_id;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.resolve_sla_alert(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.resolve_sla_alert(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- instance_pauses
+-- Rollback: remove a tabela nova e as quatro funcoes; nada pre-existente e tocado.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.auto_pause_instance(text, integer, text);
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.resume_instance(text);
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.pause_instance(text, integer, text);
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.is_instance_paused(text);
+--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.instance_pauses;
+--
+-- ETAPA: pausa de instancia de WhatsApp por TEMPO DETERMINADO (paridade com o outro
+-- sistema, que tinha `public.instance_processing_pauses (instance_name, paused_until)`
+-- ‚Äî ver supabase/migrations/_foreign/20260612110000_*.sql, que NAO se aplica aqui).
+-- No V2 o identificador de conexao e' `public.whatsapp_connections.instance_id`.
+--
+-- O QUE ESTA MIGRATION CRIA (tudo ADITIVO ‚Äî nenhuma coluna, policy ou GRANT existente muda):
+--
+--   1. public.instance_pauses ‚Äî o HISTORICO de pausas. Cada pausa e' UMA linha:
+--      `instance` (a conexao), `paused_until` (fim da pausa), `reason`, `paused_by`
+--      (perfil de quem pausou; NULL quando automatica), `auto` (true = pausada pelo
+--      sistema), `resumed_at`/`resumed_by` (retomada antecipada pelo staff) e
+--      `created_at`. Um indice unico PARCIAL em (instance) WHERE resumed_at IS NULL
+--      garante no maximo UMA pausa ABERTA por instancia ‚Äî e' o que torna
+--      pause_instance idempotente (pausar de novo ESTENDE a pausa aberta em vez de
+--      criar uma segunda). Retomar (resumed_at/resumed_by) fecha a linha aberta e
+--      libera a instancia para uma pausa futura.
+--
+--   2. Funcoes SECURITY DEFINER (dono = owner das tabelas, por isso ignoram a RLS e
+--      sao a UNICA via de escrita):
+--        pause_instance(instancia, minutos, motivo)   -> jsonb  (staff; 5..1440 min)
+--        resume_instance(instancia)                   -> integer (staff; n¬∫ de pausas fechadas)
+--        is_instance_paused(instancia)                -> boolean (STABLE; o que a ENTREGA consulta)
+--        auto_pause_instance(instancia, minutos, motivo) -> jsonb (SO service_role)
+--
+--   `is_instance_paused` e' a leitura que a entrega usa: true somente quando existe
+--   pausa ABERTA e ainda NO PRAZO (resumed_at IS NULL AND paused_until > now()). Pausa
+--   vencida (mas nao retomada) NAO conta ‚Äî a instancia volta a enviar sozinha. A funcao
+--   nega por padrao para quem nao e' staff nem service_role (42501).
+--
+-- RLS:
+--   instance_pauses ‚Äî SELECT so para STAFF (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())).
+--   INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE nao sao concedidos a anon nem a authenticated: do lado do
+--   cliente, so as funcoes SECURITY DEFINER escrevem. Sem USING (true) em lugar nenhum.
+--   O service_role (chave de servidor, fora da RLS) mantem o DML direto.
+--
+-- AUTORIZACAO ANTES DO EFEITO: as funcoes de escrita checam sessao + staff (ou o
+-- service_role, no caso da automatica) ANTES de tocar a tabela; entrada invalida
+-- (instancia em branco, minutos fora de 5..1440, motivo vazio) levanta 22023 sem gravar.
+--
+-- AUDITORIA SEM DADO PESSOAL: a "auditoria" da pausa sao as colunas paused_by/
+-- paused_until/auto/resumed_by da propria linha (id de perfil + instante + motivo curto).
+-- Nenhum telefone, texto de mensagem ou payload entra em log/gatilho.
+--
+-- search_path = pg_catalog, public (todas as funcoes; nomes publicos qualificados).
+-- Sem BEGIN/COMMIT de topo de proposito (o gateway/replay controla a transacao).
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 1) Historico de pausas de instancia
+-- ============================================================================
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.instance_pauses (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  instance text NOT NULL,
+  paused_until timestamptz NOT NULL,
+  reason text NOT NULL,
+  paused_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  auto boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  resumed_at timestamptz,
+  resumed_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT instance_pauses_reason_nao_vazio CHECK (btrim(reason) <> ''),
+  CONSTRAINT instance_pauses_autor_obrigatorio CHECK (auto OR paused_by IS NOT NULL),
+  CONSTRAINT instance_pauses_resume_consistente CHECK (resumed_at IS NOT NULL OR resumed_by IS NULL)
+);
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.instance_pauses.instance IS
+  'Identificador da conexao de WhatsApp (public.whatsapp_connections.instance_id).';

+-- No maximo UMA pausa ABERTA (nao retomada) por instancia. Sustenta a idempotencia
+-- de pause_instance/auto_pause_instance via ON CONFLICT ... WHERE resumed_at IS NULL.
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS instance_pauses_abertas_unicas

+CREATE POLICY "instance_pauses_select_staff"

+-- ============================================================================
+-- 2) Funcoes SECURITY DEFINER ‚Äî unica via de escrita / leitura da entrega

+-- se ja existe pausa aberta para a instancia, ESTENDE (paused_until/reason/paused_by)
+-- em vez de criar uma segunda ‚Äî o autor passa a ser quem estendeu.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pause_instance(
+  p_instance text,
+  p_minutes integer,
+  p_reason text
+) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_row public.instance_pauses;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sessao_nao_autenticada' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'somente_staff_pausa_instancia' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_instance IS NULL OR btrim(p_instance) = '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'instancia_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_minutes IS NULL OR p_minutes < 5 OR p_minutes > 1440 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'minutos_fora_da_faixa_5_1440' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_reason IS NULL OR btrim(p_reason) = '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'motivo_obrigatorio' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_profile_id := public.get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid());
+
+  UPDATE public.instance_pauses
+     SET resumed_at = paused_until
+   WHERE instance = btrim(p_instance)
+     AND resumed_at IS NULL
+     AND paused_until <= now();
+
+  INSERT INTO public.instance_pauses AS ip (instance, paused_until, reason, paused_by, auto)
+  VALUES (
+    btrim(p_instance),
+    now() + make_interval(mins => p_minutes),
+    btrim(p_reason),
+    v_profile_id,
+    false
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (instance) WHERE resumed_at IS NULL
+  DO UPDATE SET
+    paused_until = EXCLUDED.paused_until,
+    reason       = EXCLUDED.reason,
+    paused_by    = EXCLUDED.paused_by,
+    auto         = EXCLUDED.auto
+  RETURNING ip.* INTO v_row;
+
+  RETURN to_jsonb(v_row);
+END;
+$function$;

+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id uuid;
+  v_count integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sessao_nao_autenticada' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;

+  IF NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'somente_staff_retoma_instancia' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;

+  IF p_instance IS NULL OR btrim(p_instance) = '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'instancia_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '22023';

+-- Leitura da ENTREGA: true somente com pausa ABERTA e no prazo. STABLE (nao muda a

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_instance_paused(p_instance text)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE plpgsql

+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public

+BEGIN

+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_instance_paused(text) TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- Pausa AUTOMATICA (sistema): SO o service_role executa. paused_by fica NULL e
+-- auto=true. Se ja existe pausa aberta, apenas ESTENDE o prazo (greatest) e atualiza
+-- o motivo ‚Äî sem roubar o autor nem o `auto` de uma pausa manual ja aberta.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_pause_instance(
+  p_instance text,
+  p_minutes integer,
+  p_reason text
+) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_row public.instance_pauses;
+BEGIN
+  IF coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'somente_service_role' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_instance IS NULL OR btrim(p_instance) = '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'instancia_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_minutes IS NULL OR p_minutes < 5 OR p_minutes > 1440 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'minutos_fora_da_faixa_5_1440' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_reason IS NULL OR btrim(p_reason) = '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'motivo_obrigatorio' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.instance_pauses
+     SET resumed_at = paused_until
+   WHERE instance = btrim(p_instance)
+     AND resumed_at IS NULL
+     AND paused_until <= now();
+
+  INSERT INTO public.instance_pauses AS ip (instance, paused_until, reason, paused_by, auto)
+  VALUES (
+    btrim(p_instance),
+    now() + make_interval(mins => p_minutes),
+    btrim(p_reason),
+    NULL,
+    true
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (instance) WHERE resumed_at IS NULL
+  DO UPDATE SET
+    paused_until = greatest(ip.paused_until, EXCLUDED.paused_until),
+    reason       = EXCLUDED.reason
+  RETURNING ip.* INTO v_row;
+
+  RETURN to_jsonb(v_row);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.auto_pause_instance(text, integer, text)
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.auto_pause_instance(text, integer, text) TO service_role;

+-- 3: exclusao segura.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_department(
+  p_department_id uuid,
+  p_move_to uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_department_name text;
+  v_members integer := 0;
+  v_conversations integer := 0;
+  v_queues integer := 0;
+  v_moved_members integer := 0;
+  v_moved_conversations integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT public.is_admin(v_uid) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT d.name INTO v_department_name
+  FROM public.departments d
+  WHERE d.id = p_department_id;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'department_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_move_to IS NOT NULL THEN
+    IF p_move_to = p_department_id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_move_target' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.departments d WHERE d.id = p_move_to) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'move_target_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- O indice unico idx_team_conversations_dept_unique admite UMA conversa de
+    -- type='department' por departamento: mover duas colidiria. Recusa antes do DML.
+    IF EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1 FROM public.team_conversations tc
+          WHERE tc.department_id = p_department_id AND tc.type = 'department'
+       )
+       AND EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1 FROM public.team_conversations tc
+          WHERE tc.department_id = p_move_to AND tc.type = 'department'
+       )
+    THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'move_target_already_has_department_conversation' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_members
+  FROM public.profiles p
+  WHERE p.department_id = p_department_id;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_conversations
+  FROM public.team_conversations tc
+  WHERE tc.department_id = p_department_id;
+
+  SELECT count(DISTINCT qm.queue_id) INTO v_queues
+  FROM public.queue_members qm
+  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = qm.profile_id
+  WHERE p.department_id = p_department_id
+    AND qm.is_active IS NOT FALSE;
+
+  IF (v_members > 0 OR v_conversations > 0 OR v_queues > 0) AND p_move_to IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+      'ok', false,
+      'error', 'department_in_use',
+      'members', v_members,
+      'conversations', v_conversations,
+      'queues', v_queues
+    );
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_move_to IS NOT NULL THEN
+    -- O gatilho update_profiles_updated_at regrava updated_at em QUALQUER UPDATE. Uma
+    -- movimentacao de vinculo (quem pertence a qual departamento) nao e mudanca de conteudo
+    -- do perfil, entao a data nao deve ser reescrita (recusa real de 06/10). Desliga SO esse
+    -- gatilho durante o UPDATE e o religa logo depois, na MESMA transacao: erro adiante
+    -- aborta tudo e o gatilho volta intacto (DDL e transacional).
+    ALTER TABLE public.profiles DISABLE TRIGGER update_profiles_updated_at;
+    UPDATE public.profiles
+       SET department_id = p_move_to
+     WHERE department_id = p_department_id;
+    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_moved_members = ROW_COUNT;
+    ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE TRIGGER update_profiles_updated_at;
+
+    -- Mesmo motivo para as conversas migradas.
+    ALTER TABLE public.team_conversations DISABLE TRIGGER update_team_conversations_updated_at;
+    UPDATE public.team_conversations
+       SET department_id = p_move_to
+     WHERE department_id = p_department_id;
+    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_moved_conversations = ROW_COUNT;
+    -- A FK de team_conversations e DEFERRABLE: o UPDATE deixa evento pendente e o
+    -- ALTER ... ENABLE recusaria com "pending trigger events". Forco as checagens
+    -- diferidas agora (SET CONSTRAINTS e do escopo da transacao) e religo o gatilho.
+    SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE;
+    ALTER TABLE public.team_conversations ENABLE TRIGGER update_team_conversations_updated_at;
+  END IF;
+
+  DELETE FROM public.departments WHERE id = p_department_id;
+
+  IF p_move_to IS NOT NULL THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.department_audit_logs (department_id, action, profile_id, details)
+    VALUES (
+      p_move_to,
+      'delete_department',
+      public.current_profile_id(),
+      jsonb_build_object(
+        'deleted_department_id', p_department_id,
+        'deleted_department_name', v_department_name,
+        'moved_members', v_moved_members,
+        'moved_conversations', v_moved_conversations
+      )
+    );
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+  VALUES (
+    v_uid,
+    'delete_department',
+    'department',
+    p_department_id,
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'department_name', v_department_name,
+      'move_to', p_move_to,
+      'moved_members', v_moved_members,
+      'moved_conversations', v_moved_conversations,
+      'had_queue_links', v_queues
+    )
+  );
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'ok', true,
+    'department_id', p_department_id,
+    'name', v_department_name,
+    'moved_members', v_moved_members,
+    'moved_conversations', v_moved_conversations
+  );
+END;
+$fn$;

+-- 4: visao agregada por departamento.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.departments_overview()
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  department_id uuid,
+  name text,
+  is_active boolean,
+  member_count bigint,
+  queue_count bigint,
+  conversation_count bigint
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $fn$
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT public.is_admin(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT
+    d.id,

+    d.is_active,

+        AND qm.is_active IS NOT FALSE),
+    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.team_conversations tc WHERE tc.department_id = d.id)
+  FROM public.departments d
+  ORDER BY d.name;
+END;
+$fn$;

+--   alter table public.queues drop column if exists paused;
+--   alter table public.queues drop column if exists sticky_enabled;

+--
+-- Distribuicao configuravel de filas (round robin / menos ocupado / por habilidade),
+-- limite por atendente, fixacao por contato e transbordo para fila de overflow.
+-- Aditivo: colunas com default, CHECK, helper novo, dois triggers novos e o corpo
+-- novo de auto_assign_to_queue_agent/skill_based_assign. Nenhum dado existente e
+-- alterado (as colunas nascem com default) e nenhum GRANT/ACL muda.
+--
+-- Decisao de desenho: auto_assign_to_queue_agent (BEFORE) so ATRIBUI; o transbordo
+-- (troca de queue_id) acontece no trigger AFTER queue_overflow_rewrite, porque
+-- conversation_events.contact_id tem FK imediata para contacts(id) e o BEFORE INSERT
+-- nao pode gravar evento (a linha ainda nao existe). Fazendo a troca no AFTER, o
+-- trigger ja existente log_assignment_change (AFTER UPDATE OF queue_id) registra o
+-- 'queue_transfer' em conversation_events ‚Äî e o transbordo fica registrado sem
+-- escrever um logger novo.
+
+-- 1. Colunas de configuracao em public.queues
+ALTER TABLE public.queues
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS distribution text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'least_busy',
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS overflow_queue_id uuid REFERENCES public.queues(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_per_agent integer,
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sticky_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paused boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.queues
+  ADD CONSTRAINT queues_distribution_check

+-- 2. Transbordo sem ciclo: uma fila nao pode transbordar para si mesma nem fechar ciclo
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queues_prevent_overflow_cycle()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_cur uuid;
+  v_depth integer := 0;
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.overflow_queue_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+  IF NEW.overflow_queue_id = NEW.id THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'queues.overflow_queue_id: uma fila nao pode transbordar para si mesma (queue %)', NEW.id
+      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  v_cur := NEW.overflow_queue_id;
+  WHILE v_cur IS NOT NULL AND v_depth < 100 LOOP
+    IF v_cur = NEW.id THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'queues.overflow_queue_id: ciclo de transbordo detectado (queue %)', NEW.id
+        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT q.overflow_queue_id INTO v_cur FROM public.queues q WHERE q.id = v_cur;
+    v_depth := v_depth + 1;
+  END LOOP;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER queues_prevent_overflow_cycle
+  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF overflow_queue_id ON public.queues
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.queues_prevent_overflow_cycle();

+-- 3. Selecao de atendente (fonte unica do algoritmo)
+--  distribution: 'least_busy' (padrao, comportamento anterior) | 'round_robin' | 'skill'
+--  respeita fila ativa/nao-pausada, atendente ativo, papel 'agent', max_per_agent e,
+--  em 'skill', TODOS os requisitos de habilidade da fila.
+--  sticky (quando ligado): tenta antes o ultimo atendente do contato (conversation_events).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_pick_agent(p_queue_id uuid, p_contact_id uuid)
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_q record;
+  v_agent uuid;
+  v_last_agent uuid;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT id, is_active, paused, distribution, max_per_agent, sticky_enabled
+    INTO v_q
+  FROM public.queues
+  WHERE id = p_queue_id;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_q.paused IS TRUE THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_q.sticky_enabled AND p_contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    SELECT ce.to_agent_id INTO v_last_agent
+    FROM public.conversation_events ce
+    WHERE ce.contact_id = p_contact_id AND ce.to_agent_id IS NOT NULL
+    ORDER BY ce.created_at DESC, ce.id DESC
+    LIMIT 1;
+
+    IF v_last_agent IS NOT NULL THEN
+      SELECT qm.profile_id INTO v_agent
+      FROM public.queue_members qm
+      JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = qm.profile_id
+      JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = p.user_id
+      WHERE qm.queue_id = p_queue_id
+        AND qm.profile_id = v_last_agent
+        AND qm.is_active = true
+        AND p.is_active = true
+        AND ur.role = 'agent'
+        AND (v_q.max_per_agent IS NULL
+             OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id) < v_q.max_per_agent)
+        AND (v_q.distribution <> 'skill'
+             OR NOT EXISTS (
+                  SELECT 1 FROM public.queue_skill_requirements qsr
+                  WHERE qsr.queue_id = p_queue_id
+                    AND NOT EXISTS (
+                      SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_skills ags
+                      WHERE ags.profile_id = qm.profile_id
+                        AND ags.skill_name = qsr.skill_name
+                        AND ags.skill_level >= qsr.min_level)));
+      IF v_agent IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RETURN v_agent;
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT qm.profile_id INTO v_agent
+  FROM public.queue_members qm
+  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = qm.profile_id
+  JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = p.user_id
+  WHERE qm.queue_id = p_queue_id
+    AND qm.is_active = true
+    AND p.is_active = true
+    AND ur.role = 'agent'
+    AND (v_q.max_per_agent IS NULL
+         OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id) < v_q.max_per_agent)
+    AND (v_q.distribution <> 'skill'
+         OR NOT EXISTS (
+              SELECT 1 FROM public.queue_skill_requirements qsr
+              WHERE qsr.queue_id = p_queue_id
+                AND NOT EXISTS (
+                  SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_skills ags
+                  WHERE ags.profile_id = qm.profile_id
+                    AND ags.skill_name = qsr.skill_name
+                    AND ags.skill_level >= qsr.min_level)))
+  ORDER BY
+    CASE WHEN v_q.distribution = 'round_robin'
+         THEN GREATEST(
+           (SELECT MAX(ce.created_at)
+            FROM public.conversation_events ce
+            WHERE ce.to_agent_id = qm.profile_id
+              AND (ce.to_queue_id = p_queue_id
+                   OR ce.metadata->>'new_queue' = p_queue_id::text)),
+           (SELECT MAX(c.created_at) FROM public.contacts c
+            WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id AND c.queue_id = p_queue_id)
+         )
+    END ASC NULLS FIRST,
+    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id) ASC,
+    qm.profile_id ASC
+  LIMIT 1;
+
+  RETURN v_agent;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- 4. auto_assign_to_queue_agent (BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF queue_id)
+--  - fila default (queue_id NULL): a primeira ativa e NAO pausada (priority, created_at)
+--  - atribui pelo helper; fila pausada nao atribui
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_assign_to_queue_agent()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_default_queue uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.queue_id IS NULL AND NEW.assigned_to IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT id INTO v_default_queue
+    FROM public.queues
+    WHERE is_active = true AND paused = false
+    ORDER BY priority ASC, created_at ASC
+    LIMIT 1;
+    IF v_default_queue IS NOT NULL THEN
+      NEW.queue_id := v_default_queue;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NEW.queue_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.assigned_to IS NULL THEN
+    NEW.assigned_to := public.queue_pick_agent(NEW.queue_id, NEW.id);
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- 5. Transbordo: sem atendente elegivel e com overflow configurado, move a fila.
+--  A troca de queue_id dispara log_assignment_change -> conversation_events
+--  ('queue_transfer') e reavalia a atribuicao na fila de transbordo (BEFORE).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_overflow_rewrite()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_q record;
+BEGIN
+  IF NEW.queue_id IS NULL OR NEW.assigned_to IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT id, is_active, paused, overflow_queue_id INTO v_q
+  FROM public.queues
+  WHERE id = NEW.queue_id;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND
+     OR v_q.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM true
+     OR v_q.paused IS TRUE
+     OR v_q.overflow_queue_id IS NULL
+     OR v_q.overflow_queue_id = NEW.queue_id THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- So transborda se realmente nao ha atendente elegivel na fila de origem
+  IF public.queue_pick_agent(NEW.queue_id, NEW.id) IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.contacts
+     SET queue_id = v_q.overflow_queue_id
+   WHERE id = NEW.id
+     AND queue_id = NEW.queue_id;
+
+  RETURN NULL;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER queue_overflow_rewrite
+  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF queue_id ON public.contacts
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.queue_overflow_rewrite();
+
+-- 6. skill_based_assign passa a respeitar max_per_agent da fila (mantem a checagem
+--  de admin/supervisor e o filtro por habilidade com fallback)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.skill_based_assign(p_queue_id uuid)
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_agent_id uuid;
+  v_max integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF (current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb->>'role') = 'authenticated'
+     AND NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'skill_based_assign: requer perfil admin ou supervisor';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT max_per_agent INTO v_max FROM public.queues WHERE id = p_queue_id;
+
+  SELECT qm.profile_id INTO v_agent_id
+  FROM public.queue_members qm JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = qm.profile_id
+  WHERE qm.queue_id = p_queue_id AND qm.is_active = true AND p.is_active = true
+    AND (v_max IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id) < v_max)
+    AND NOT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.queue_skill_requirements qsr WHERE qsr.queue_id = p_queue_id
+      AND NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_skills ags WHERE ags.profile_id = qm.profile_id
+        AND ags.skill_name = qsr.skill_name AND ags.skill_level >= qsr.min_level
+      )
+    )
+  ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id) ASC, qm.profile_id ASC LIMIT 1;
+
+  IF v_agent_id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT qm.profile_id INTO v_agent_id
+    FROM public.queue_members qm JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = qm.profile_id
+    WHERE qm.queue_id = p_queue_id AND qm.is_active = true AND p.is_active = true
+      AND (v_max IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id) < v_max)
+    ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.assigned_to = qm.profile_id) ASC, qm.profile_id ASC LIMIT 1;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN v_agent_id;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- 7. Negar por padrao: as tres funcoes novas nascem com EXECUTE para PUBLIC (ACL padrao
+--  do Postgres) e nenhuma delas e RPC de cliente. auto_assign_to_queue_agent e
+--  skill_based_assign preservam o ACL anterior (CREATE OR REPLACE nao mexe em ACL).
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.queue_pick_agent(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.queue_overflow_rewrite() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.queues_prevent_overflow_cycle() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

+-- tasks_rearm_on_remind_change
+-- Rollback: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_task_rearm_on_remind_change ON public.conversation_tasks;
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.conversation_task_rearm_on_remind_change();
+--
+-- Esta migration so cria funcao e gatilho: nenhuma linha e lida ou escrita, entao nao ha dado a
+--   restaurar. Rodar os dois `DROP` acima devolve exatamente o comportamento anterior (o Salvar
+--   com hora nova volta a nao rearmar a tarefa ja notificada).
+--
+-- R2-MOD-052 / item 420 (P2) ‚Äî "Reagendar o alarme pelo Salvar nao rearma uma tarefa que ja
+-- foi notificada".
+--
+-- Defeito (medido no Postgres descartavel do teste, com este arquivo aplicado depois da fila atual de migrations):
+--   O alarme da tarefa mora em public.conversation_tasks.remind_at e o carimbo do disparo em
+--   notified_at. public.notify_due_tasks() so enxerga `remind_at <= now() AND notified_at IS
+--   NULL AND status NOT IN ('done','cancelled')`, que e o mesmo filtro do indice parcial
+--   idx_tasks_owner_remind_pending. O unico gatilho de estado da tabela,
+--   trg_task_state_change, tem WHEN (NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status): quem muda SO o
+--   remind_at nao passa por ele. E esse e exatamente o caminho do Salvar da ficha da tarefa
+--   (src/hooks/tasks/shared/WorkItemSheet.tsx monta `patch.remindAt` e
+--   src/hooks/tasks/useMyWorkItems.ts:154-163 traduz para `out.remind_at`, sem notified_at).
+--   Resultado: o alarme novo e gravado, notified_at continua preenchido e o cron
+--   tasks-notify-due nunca mais ve a linha ‚Äî a tarefa fica muda para sempre.
+--
+-- Correcao: gatilho BEFORE UPDATE OF remind_at que zera notified_at quando o alarme muda e o
+--   escritor NAO declarou um notified_at proprio. Quem depende disso:
+--     * Salvar com hora nova (o defeito): notified_at volta a NULL -> o cron rearma;
+--     * Adiar/soneca (useWorkItemNotifications.ts) ja manda `notified_at: null` no mesmo
+--       update: nada muda de resultado;
+--     * desfazer cancelamento/conclusao (R2-MOD-053, useMyWorkItems.restoreSnapshot) reescreve
+--       remind_at E notified_at juntos a partir do snapshot ‚Äî por isso o gatilho respeita um
+--       notified_at declarado e diferente do atual; sem essa condicao o undo perderia o
+--       "ja notificado";
+--     * UPDATE que nao lista remind_at (titulo, position, upsert de reordenacao) nao dispara.
+--
+-- Sem DML: nenhuma linha existente e lida ou alterada (sem backfill), entao nao ha gatilho de
+-- dado a desligar nem valor antigo a guardar. Como o arquivo so cria objeto novo, o unico ACL
+-- tocado e o da propria funcao criada aqui (logo abaixo), que nasce fechada.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conversation_task_rearm_on_remind_change()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+  -- O WHEN do gatilho ja garante que NEW.remind_at mudou. Aqui so decidimos se quem escreveu
+  -- disse algo proprio sobre notified_at: se disse (e diferente do atual), e ele quem manda
+  -- (restoreSnapshot do undo); se nao disse, o carimbo antigo nao vale mais para o alarme novo.
+  IF NEW.notified_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.notified_at THEN
+    NEW.notified_at := NULL;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- Funcao de gatilho NAO precisa de EXECUTE para disparar (o privilegio e conferido uma vez, no
+-- CREATE TRIGGER), e a 20261001191230 fechou por FAMILIA (RETURNS trigger em public) o EXECUTE
+-- de PUBLIC, anon, authenticated e service_role ‚Äî regra fail-closed no catalogo. Funcao nova que
+-- nasce com o privilegio padrao do schema (authenticated, service_role) furaria essa regra, entao
+-- ela e fechada aqui, pela assinatura exata: fica igual a irma conversation_task_state_trigger.
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.conversation_task_rearm_on_remind_change()
+  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_task_rearm_on_remind_change ON public.conversation_tasks;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_task_rearm_on_remind_change
+  BEFORE UPDATE OF remind_at ON public.conversation_tasks
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  WHEN (NEW.remind_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.remind_at)
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.conversation_task_rearm_on_remind_change();

+-- Rollback: dropa o trigger prevent_can_download_escalation em public.profiles e, em seguida, a funcao.

+-- profiles.can_download por PATCH direto em public.profiles. A policy PERMISSIVE
+-- "Users can update own profile" permite o UPDATE do proprio perfil (auth.uid() = user_id),

+-- como a tela de admin ja fazia. O UPDATE interno de papel
+-- (sync_profile_role_from_user_roles) nao toca can_download, entao nao e afetado.
+-- A policy RESTRICTIVE vigente permanece intacta (role/access_level/permissions/is_active).
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_can_download_escalation()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_escalada boolean;
+BEGIN
+  v_escalada := (OLD.can_download IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.can_download);
+  IF v_escalada AND NOT is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only administrators can change the can_download flag';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;

+-- talkx_campaign_segment_progress
+-- Rollback: funcao nova, dropada no rollback; nenhum dado e alterado, nada a restaurar.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.talkx_campaign_segment_progress(uuid);
+--
+-- N-096 / X142 (parte 1): progresso da campanha por segmento, na ordem de envio.
+-- Marcador interno: talkx_campaign_segment_progress
+--
+-- Por segmento (talkx_campaign_segments.position): total, enviadas (sent+delivered),
+-- entregues, falhas, restante (pending+sending), percentual processado e status
+--   done    = total > 0 e restante 0
+--   running = ha processados (total - restante) > 0 e ainda sobra restante
+--   pending = nada processado
+-- mais total_segments e pending_segments (segmentos ainda nao 'done') em cada linha.
+-- Leitura pura, sem telefone/texto. Autorizacao igual a do helper irmao
+-- talkx_engine_cron_runs: admin/supervisor ou service_role (42501 talkx_admin_required).
+-- A pre-checagem de retomada (talkx_campaign_resume_precheck) NAO faz parte deste passo.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_segment_progress(p_campaign_id uuid)
+RETURNS TABLE(
+  segment_id uuid,
+  "position" smallint,
+  total bigint,
+  sent bigint,
+  delivered bigint,
+  failed bigint,
+  remaining bigint,
+  percent numeric,
+  status text,
+  total_segments bigint,
+  pending_segments bigint
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) OR COALESCE(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'talkx_admin_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+  WITH agg AS (
+    SELECT s.segment_id AS seg_id,
+           s."position" AS pos,
+           count(r.id) AS total,
+           count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('sent', 'delivered')) AS sent,
+           count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'delivered') AS delivered,
+           count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed') AS failed,
+           count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('pending', 'sending')) AS remaining
+      FROM public.talkx_campaign_segments s
+      LEFT JOIN public.talkx_recipients r
+        ON r.campaign_id = s.campaign_id AND r.segment_id = s.segment_id
+     WHERE s.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
+     GROUP BY s.segment_id, s."position"
+  ), st AS (
+    SELECT a.*,
+           CASE
+             WHEN a.total > 0 AND a.remaining = 0 THEN 'done'
+             WHEN a.total - a.remaining > 0 THEN 'running'
+             ELSE 'pending'
+           END AS seg_status
+      FROM agg a
+  )
+  SELECT st.seg_id,
+         st.pos,
+         st.total,
+         st.sent,
+         st.delivered,
+         st.failed,
+         st.remaining,
+         CASE WHEN st.total = 0 THEN 0::numeric
+              ELSE round(100.0 * (st.total - st.remaining) / st.total, 1) END,
+         st.seg_status,
+         count(*) OVER (),
+         count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.seg_status <> 'done') OVER ()
+    FROM st
+   ORDER BY st.pos;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_segment_progress(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_segment_progress(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.talkx_campaign_segment_progress(uuid) IS
+  'N-096/X142: progresso por segmento na ordem de envio (total, enviadas, entregues, falhas, restante, percentual, status done/running/pending, total_segments, pending_segments). So admin/supervisor ou service_role (42501 talkx_admin_required).';

+CREATE POLICY contact_block_audit_select_admin_supervisor
+ON public.contact_block_audit FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+USING (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS contact_block_audit_block_authenticated_insert ON public.contact_block_audit;
+CREATE POLICY contact_block_audit_block_authenticated_insert
+ON public.contact_block_audit FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (false);
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS contact_block_audit_block_authenticated_update ON public.contact_block_audit;
+CREATE POLICY contact_block_audit_block_authenticated_update
+ON public.contact_block_audit FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (false) WITH CHECK (false);
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS contact_block_audit_block_authenticated_delete ON public.contact_block_audit;
+CREATE POLICY contact_block_audit_block_authenticated_delete
+ON public.contact_block_audit FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (false);
+
+-- Sem policy para `anon`: RLS ligada + nenhuma policy de SELECT = zero linhas, alem do REVOKE.
+
+-- Fail-closed de forma: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nao reconcilia drift. Se a tabela ja
+-- existir com forma diferente, aborta com a lista do que falta (roda com a RLS ja ligada).
+DO $drift_guard$ DECLARE v_faltando text; BEGIN
+  SELECT string_agg(esperada.nome, ', ' ORDER BY esperada.nome) INTO v_faltando
+  FROM (VALUES ('id'),('contact_id'),('operation'),('blocked_at_from'),('blocked_at_to'),
+               ('performed_by'),('performed_by_profile'),('performed_by_db_role'),('performed_at')
+       ) AS esperada(nome)
+  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a
+    JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = a.attrelid
+    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+    WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'contact_block_audit'
+      AND a.attname = esperada.nome AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
+  );
+  IF v_faltando IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.contact_block_audit tem forma divergente (drift): coluna(s) ausente(s): %. Nao adotar tabela estranha a trilha ‚Äî reconciliar manualmente.', v_faltando;
+  END IF;
+END
+$drift_guard$;

+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_contact_block_audit_contact
+  ON public.contact_block_audit (contact_id, performed_at DESC);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_contact_block_audit_recent
+  ON public.contact_block_audit (performed_at DESC);

+COMMENT ON TABLE public.contact_block_audit IS
+  'Trilha append-only do bloqueio/desbloqueio de contatos (substitui a etiqueta textual Bloqueado). Escrita apenas pelo trigger audit_contact_block_change.';
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.contact_block_audit.operation IS
+  'block = NULL->ts; unblock = ts->NULL; update_marker = ts->ts (marcador reescrito).';
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.contact_block_audit.performed_by IS
+  'auth.uid() (claim `sub`) do chamador. NULL no backfill da migration e nas escritas de papel sem `sub`. A autoria desses casos esta em performed_by_db_role.';
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.contact_block_audit.performed_by_db_role IS
+  'session_user da conexao que executou a mudanca. Sempre preenchido ‚Äî e o unico autor da trilha quando performed_by e NULL.';
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.contact_block_audit.performed_by_profile IS
+  'public.profiles.id correspondente a performed_by, resolvido na hora do evento.';

+-- ============================================================================================
+-- 3) Trigger function: grava somente quando blocked_at muda DE FATO
+-- ============================================================================================
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_contact_block_change()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
+AS $function$ DECLARE v_operation text; BEGIN
+  -- `AFTER UPDATE OF blocked_at` ja limita o disparo aos UPDATEs que citam a coluna no SET;
+  -- este teste barra `SET blocked_at = blocked_at` e qualquer UPDATE que a cite sem alterar
+  -- o valor (nao gravar sujeira).
+  IF OLD.blocked_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.blocked_at THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_operation := CASE
+    WHEN OLD.blocked_at IS NULL THEN 'block'          -- NULL -> ts  (bloqueio)
+    WHEN NEW.blocked_at IS NULL THEN 'unblock'        -- ts   -> NULL (desbloqueio)
+    ELSE 'update_marker'                              -- ts   -> ts   (marcador reescrito)
+  END;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.contact_block_audit
+    (contact_id, operation, blocked_at_from, blocked_at_to, performed_by, performed_by_profile)
+  VALUES (
+    NEW.id, v_operation, OLD.blocked_at, NEW.blocked_at, auth.uid(),
+    (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1)
+  );
+
+  RETURN NULL;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- Trigger function NAO checa EXECUTE do chamador; com EXECUTE, `authenticated` poderia criar
+-- trigger TEMP sobre ela. Tirar de todos nao quebra os triggers abaixo.
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.audit_contact_block_change() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_audit_contact_block_change ON public.contacts;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_contact_block_change
+AFTER UPDATE OF blocked_at ON public.contacts
+FOR EACH ROW
+EXECUTE FUNCTION public.audit_contact_block_change();
+
+-- ============================================================================================
+-- 4) Migracao de DADOS: etiqueta textual `Bloqueado` -> campo proprio
+-- ============================================================================================
+-- Contato que tem a etiqueta `Bloqueado` (comparacao sem caixa, para nao perder variacao de
+-- digitacao) recebe blocked_at. SO as linhas marcadas mudam (WHERE ... blocked_at IS NULL em
+-- contato com a etiqueta) ‚Äî nao e UPDATE em massa.
+--
+-- O gatilho BEFORE UPDATE `update_contacts_updated_at` (20260315172343) regrava `updated_at` em
+-- toda linha que o UPDATE toca. Como esta migracao so muda o estado de bloqueio e nao a data de
+-- modificacao do cadastro, o gatilho e desligado SO durante este UPDATE -- dentro de UMA
+-- transacao, entao falha no meio (ou no ENABLE) reabilita o gatilho no rollback e nada fica
+-- desligado por acidente. Preserva o updated_at das linhas migradas (prova antes/depois no
+-- contrato scripts/db-audit/contacts-soft-delete-and-status.test.sh).
+BEGIN;
+DO $bloqueio$
+BEGIN
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
+    WHERE tgrelid = 'public.contacts'::regclass
+      AND tgname = 'update_contacts_updated_at'
+      AND NOT tgisinternal
+  ) THEN
+    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public.contacts DISABLE TRIGGER update_contacts_updated_at';
+  END IF;
+END
+$bloqueio$;
+UPDATE public.contacts c
+SET blocked_at = now(),
+    blocked_by = NULL
+WHERE c.blocked_at IS NULL
+  AND EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+    FROM unnest(COALESCE(c.tags, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS tag(valor)
+    WHERE lower(valor) = 'bloqueado'
+  );
+DO $bloqueio$
+BEGIN
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
+    WHERE tgrelid = 'public.contacts'::regclass
+      AND tgname = 'update_contacts_updated_at'
+      AND NOT tgisinternal
+  ) THEN
+    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public.contacts ENABLE TRIGGER update_contacts_updated_at';
+  END IF;
+END
+$bloqueio$;
+COMMIT;
+
+-- ============================================================================================
+-- 5) RPC public.set_contact_blocked(contato, bloqueado)
+-- ============================================================================================
+-- Mesma regra de quem pode EDITAR o contato: a policy de UPDATE de public.contacts usa
+-- public.can_edit_contact(assigned_to, queue_id) ‚Äî aqui a MESMA funcao decide. SECURITY DEFINER
+-- com `search_path = pg_catalog, public` (funcoes do repo que resolvem auth.uid() por
+-- pg_catalog, sem pg_temp no caminho).
+--
+-- Nao ha oraculo: contato inexistente e contato sem permissao devolvem a MESMA excecao, e a
+-- ordem das checagens e: entrada valida -> tem sessao -> pode editar (que cobre o existente).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_contact_blocked(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_blocked boolean
+) RETURNS timestamptz
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_uid        uuid;
+  v_blocked_at timestamptz;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_contact_id IS NULL OR p_blocked IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_contact_block_request' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_uid := auth.uid();
+  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_privilege' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Autorizacao derivada da MESMA regra da policy de UPDATE de contacts. Se o contato NAO
+  -- existe, can_edit_contact recebe NULL/NULL e a funcao tambem recusa ‚Äî mesma excecao, sem
+  -- revelar existencia.
+  IF NOT EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1
+    FROM public.contacts c
+    WHERE c.id = p_contact_id
+      AND public.can_edit_contact(c.assigned_to, c.queue_id)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_privilege' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Uma unica instrucao = atomica. Idempotente: rebloquear mantem o instante/autor originais
+  -- (COALESCE) e nao gera linha nova na trilha (blocked_at nao muda).
+  UPDATE public.contacts
+  SET blocked_at = CASE WHEN p_blocked THEN COALESCE(blocked_at, now()) ELSE NULL END,
+      blocked_by = CASE WHEN p_blocked THEN COALESCE(blocked_by, v_uid) ELSE NULL END
+  WHERE id = p_contact_id
+  RETURNING blocked_at INTO v_blocked_at;
+
+  RETURN v_blocked_at;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- Publico da RPC: authenticated. anon NAO (REVOKE + auth.uid() nulo). service_role NAO precisa:
+-- ele fala com a tabela direto (BYPASSRLS) e nao carrega claim `sub`, logo nao teria autor.
+-- Os DEFAULTS do schema concedem EXECUTE em funcao nova a service_role; por isso ele entra no
+-- REVOKE -- senao nasceria executavel por um papel que a funcao sempre recusaria.
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.set_contact_blocked(uuid, boolean) FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.set_contact_blocked(uuid, boolean) TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.set_contact_blocked(uuid, boolean) IS
+  'Bloqueia (true) ou desbloqueia (false) um contato com a mesma permissao de edicao da policy de UPDATE de public.contacts. Devolve o novo blocked_at (NULL quando desbloqueado). Cada mudanca fica em public.contact_block_audit.';
