+-- warroom_rpcs_agentes_filas
+-- Rollback: dropa as duas fun√ß√µes novas (n√£o havia vers√£o anterior no reposit√≥rio).
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.warroom_agent_today(date);
+--   drop function if exists public.warroom_queue_stats();
+--
+-- R2-MOD-030: o War Room calculava os cart√µes do dia no NAVEGADOR ‚Äî lia `profiles`,
+-- `agent_stats`, `contacts` pagina a pagina com `fetchAllRows`, e resolvia a contagem do dia
+-- por somat√≥rio em mem√≥ria. Duas consequ√™ncias medidas: (a) a pagina√ß√£o do PostgREST corta em
+-- 1000 linhas e qualquer carteira acima disso virava subtotal silencioso; (b) `agent_stats`
+-- guarda acumulado de vida (`conversations_resolved`, `avg_response_time_seconds`,
+-- `customer_satisfaction_score`) ‚Äî o r√≥tulo "de hoje" mentia, e aus√™ncia de amostra sa√≠a como
+-- 0,0 (lido pela supervis√£o como "zero resolvido" em vez de "n√£o medido").
+--
+-- Estas duas RPCs agregam no banco, com o mesmo dia civil j√° usado pelo Dashboard
+-- (America/Sao_Paulo ‚Äî `(date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AT TIME
+-- ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'`) e reusam a regra de `conversation_sla` do
+-- `dashboard_contact_counts` (DISTINCT ON por contato, a linha de SLA MAIS RECENTE ‚Äî sem isso
+-- contato com mais de uma linha de SLA no per√≠odo multiplica linhas no fan-out por fila).
+-- N√£o h√° mais corte de 1000: o agregado √© uma linha por agente/fila.
+--
+-- Classe: aditiva ‚Äî s√≥ fun√ß√µes NOVAS, sem DML, sem tocar objeto vivo (nenhum DROP/ALTER/RENAME
+-- de tabela, coluna, policy ou fun√ß√£o existente) e sem mudar GRANT de nada que j√° existia.
+-- Contrato: os nomes de campo jsonb s√£o os mesmos que o hook j√° usa (camelCase) ‚Äî
+-- `WarRoomAgent` (src/hooks/business/useWarRoomData.ts) e `WarRoomQueue`.
+-- Medi√ß√£o ausente vai como `null`, nunca como 0: `avgResponseTime` e `satisfaction` por agente,
+-- `slaWarnings` e `avgWaitTime` por fila.
+--
+-- Fronteira de autoriza√ß√£o: dado de supervis√£o (desempenho por pessoa) ‚Äî EXECUTE fechado para
+-- PUBLIC e anon, aberto s√≥ a authenticated/service_role, e a fun√ß√£o ainda devolve `[]`
+-- (vazio) para quem n√£o √© admin/supervisor, mesmo autenticado.
+
+-- Prazo de "resposta em risco": fra√ß√£o do prazo configurado de 1¬™ resposta a partir da qual o
+-- contato ainda sem resposta √© contado como risco. O prazo vem de `sla_configurations`
+-- (`first_response_minutes`), com fallback para a configura√ß√£o default ativa.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.warroom_agent_today(p_date date DEFAULT NULL)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  WITH guard AS (
+    SELECT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) AS is_staff
+  ),
+  win AS (
+    SELECT COALESCE(p_date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) AS d
+  ),
+  bounds AS (
+    SELECT
+      (w.d::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AS t0,
+      ((w.d + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') AS t1
+    FROM win w
+  ),
+  sla_day AS (
+    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.contact_id)
+      s.contact_id, s.first_message_at, s.first_response_at
+    FROM public.conversation_sla s, bounds b
+    WHERE s.first_message_at >= b.t0
+      AND s.first_message_at < b.t1
+    ORDER BY s.contact_id, s.first_message_at DESC
+  ),
+  agents AS (
+    SELECT
+      p.id,
+      p.name,
+      COALESCE(p.avatar_url, '') AS avatar,
+      COALESCE(p.max_chats, 5) AS max_chats
+    FROM public.profiles p
+    WHERE p.is_active IS TRUE
+  ),
+  open_chats AS (
+    -- S√≥ o epis√≥dio aberto ocupa capacidade (resolvido/arquivado mant√©m `assigned_to`).
+    SELECT c.assigned_to AS agent_id, count(*) AS n
+    FROM public.contacts c
+    WHERE c.assigned_to IS NOT NULL
+      AND c.conversation_status = 'open'
+      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
+    GROUP BY c.assigned_to
+  ),
+  resolved AS (
+    -- Mesma regra do `dashboard_kpi`: DISTINCT contact_id (reabertura no mesmo dia n√£o conta 2x).
+    SELECT cc.closed_by AS agent_id, count(DISTINCT cc.contact_id) AS n
+    FROM public.conversation_closures cc, bounds b
+    WHERE cc.closed_by IS NOT NULL
+      AND cc.created_at >= b.t0
+      AND cc.created_at < b.t1
+    GROUP BY cc.closed_by
+  ),
+  resp AS (
+    SELECT
+      c.assigned_to AS agent_id,
+      percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
+        ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sd.first_response_at - sd.first_message_at))
+      ) AS median_seconds
+    FROM sla_day sd
+    JOIN public.contacts c ON c.id = sd.contact_id
+    WHERE sd.first_response_at IS NOT NULL
+      AND c.assigned_to IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY c.assigned_to
+  ),
+  csat AS (
+    SELECT
+      cs.agent_id,
+      round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE cs.rating >= 4) / count(*)) AS satisfaction
+    FROM public.csat_surveys cs, bounds b
+    WHERE cs.created_at >= b.t0
+      AND cs.created_at < b.t1
+    GROUP BY cs.agent_id
+  ),
+  rows AS (
+    SELECT
+      a.id AS sort_id,
+      a.name AS sort_name,
+      jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', a.id,
+        'name', a.name,
+        'avatar', a.avatar,
+        'maxChats', a.max_chats,
+        'activeChats', COALESCE(oc.n, 0),
+        'resolvedToday', COALESCE(r.n, 0),
+        'avgResponseTime', CASE WHEN rp.median_seconds IS NULL THEN NULL
+                                ELSE round(rp.median_seconds)::integer END,
+        'satisfaction', CASE WHEN cs.satisfaction IS NULL THEN NULL
+                             ELSE cs.satisfaction::integer END
+      ) AS row
+    FROM agents a
+    LEFT JOIN open_chats oc ON oc.agent_id = a.id
+    LEFT JOIN resolved r ON r.agent_id = a.id
+    LEFT JOIN resp rp ON rp.agent_id = a.id
+    LEFT JOIN csat cs ON cs.agent_id = a.id
+  )
+  SELECT CASE
+    WHEN (SELECT is_staff FROM guard)
+      THEN COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row ORDER BY sort_name, sort_id) FROM rows), '[]'::jsonb)
+    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
+  END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.warroom_queue_stats()
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  WITH guard AS (
+    SELECT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) AS is_staff
+  ),
+  ep AS (
+    -- Epis√≥dio em andamento: resolvido/arquivado n√£o √© espera nem atendimento.
+    SELECT c.id, c.queue_id, c.assigned_to, c.conversation_status
+    FROM public.contacts c
+    WHERE c.queue_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
+      AND c.conversation_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'archived')
+  ),
+  sla AS (
+    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.contact_id)
+      s.contact_id, s.first_message_at, s.first_response_at,
+      s.first_response_breached, s.sla_configuration_id
+    FROM public.conversation_sla s
+    ORDER BY s.contact_id, s.first_message_at DESC
+  ),
+  cfg AS (
+    SELECT
+      sl.contact_id,
+      COALESCE(sc.first_response_minutes, def.first_response_minutes) AS first_response_minutes
+    FROM sla sl
+    LEFT JOIN public.sla_configurations sc ON sc.id = sl.sla_configuration_id
+    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT min(dc.first_response_minutes) AS first_response_minutes
+      FROM public.sla_configurations dc
+      WHERE dc.is_default IS TRUE AND dc.is_active IS TRUE
+    ) def ON TRUE
+  ),
+  agg AS (
+    SELECT
+      q.id,
+      q.name,
+      q.color,
+      count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.assigned_to IS NULL) AS waiting,
+      count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.assigned_to IS NOT NULL AND e.conversation_status = 'open') AS in_progress,
+      count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE sl.first_response_breached IS TRUE) AS breaches,
+      count(e.id) FILTER (
+        WHERE sl.first_response_at IS NULL
+          AND sl.first_response_breached IS NOT TRUE
+          AND cf.first_response_minutes IS NOT NULL
+          AND now() >= sl.first_message_at + (cf.first_response_minutes * 0.8) * interval '1 minute'
+      ) AS warnings,
+      count(e.id) FILTER (
+        WHERE sl.first_response_at IS NULL AND cf.first_response_minutes IS NOT NULL
+      ) AS measurable,
+      round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - sl.first_message_at)) / 60.0)
+            FILTER (WHERE e.assigned_to IS NULL AND sl.first_message_at IS NOT NULL))::integer AS avg_wait_minutes
+    FROM public.queues q
+    LEFT JOIN ep e ON e.queue_id = q.id
+    LEFT JOIN sla sl ON sl.contact_id = e.id
+    LEFT JOIN cfg cf ON cf.contact_id = e.id
+    WHERE q.is_active IS TRUE
+    GROUP BY q.id, q.name, q.color
+  )
+  SELECT CASE
+    WHEN (SELECT is_staff FROM guard) THEN COALESCE((
+      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', a.id,
+        'name', a.name,
+        'color', a.color,
+        'waiting', a.waiting,
+        'inProgress', a.in_progress,
+        'slaBreaches', a.breaches,
+        'slaWarnings', CASE WHEN a.measurable = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.warnings END,
+        'avgWaitTime', a.avg_wait_minutes
+      ) ORDER BY a.name, a.id)
+      FROM agg a
+    ), '[]'::jsonb)
+    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
+  END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.warroom_agent_today(date) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.warroom_agent_today(date) FROM anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.warroom_agent_today(date) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.warroom_queue_stats() FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.warroom_queue_stats() FROM anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.warroom_queue_stats() TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.warroom_agent_today(date) IS
+  'War Room: desempenho do dia (America/Sao_Paulo) por agente ativo ‚Äî activeChats (episodio aberto), resolvedToday (conversation_closures DISTINCT por contato), avgResponseTime (mediana de 1a resposta do dia via conversation_sla), satisfaction (% de csat_surveys com rating >= 4). Amostra ausente = null, nunca 0.';
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.warroom_queue_stats() IS
+  'War Room: episodio em andamento por fila ativa ‚Äî waiting, inProgress, slaBreaches (first_response_breached, linha de SLA mais recente por contato) e slaWarnings (sem resposta e >= 80% do prazo de 1a resposta de sla_configurations); sem contato mensuravel, slaWarnings e avgWaitTime vem null.';

+-- dashboard_daily_series
+-- Rollback: dropa a RPC public.dashboard_daily_series(integer); nao remove dado, coluna, policy, GRANT de outro objeto nem tabela.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.dashboard_daily_series(integer);
+--
+-- DASHBOARD-03 (paridade V3 -> V2, doc 02-features-batch1): a V3 tem os KPIs

+-- view NAO existe na V2 e NAO deve ser recriada; esta RPC calcula a MESMA serie
+-- diaria direto das tabelas operacionais, no fuso de Sao Paulo.
+--
+-- A serie devolve UMA linha por dia civil de Sao Paulo do periodo [hoje-N+1, hoje],
+-- em ordem crescente, incluindo dias sem movimento (contadores = 0). p_days e
+-- limitado ao intervalo [1, 90] (mesma trava defensiva de dashboard_hourly_volume).
+--
+-- Colunas e definicao (espelham evolution_daily_metrics):
+--   metric_date                 dia civil (America/Sao_Paulo).
+--   messages_received           mensagens com sender='contact' (nao deletadas).
+--   messages_sent               mensagens com sender='agent' (nao deletadas).
+--   new_contacts                contatos criados no dia (fora os soft-deleted).
+--   conversations_opened        contatos cuja PRIMEIRA mensagem (nao deletada) caiu
+--                               no dia = conversa iniciada no dia.
+--   conversations_resolved      contatos com encerramento no dia (DISTINCT, igual
+--                               a resolvedToday/resolvedYesterday de dashboard_kpi:
+--                               reabrir/encerrar de novo no mesmo dia conta 1 vez).
+--   active_contacts             contatos distintos com mensagem no dia.
+--   median_response_time_seconds  mediana (percentile_cont 0.5) de
+--                               first_response_at - first_message_at das SLA com
+--                               first_message_at no dia; NULL quando nao ha amostra.
+--
+-- Seguranca: SECURITY DEFINER (o agregado precisa ler TODAS as linhas, sem a RLS do
+-- chamador). Por isso a funcao RECUSA quem nao e staff: admin/supervisor (via
+-- auth.uid()) ou service_role. authenticated nao-staff leva 42501; anon nao tem
+-- EXECUTE. search_path fixo e EXECUTE so para authenticated/service_role.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_daily_series(p_days integer DEFAULT 7)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  metric_date date,
+  messages_received bigint,
+  messages_sent bigint,
+  new_contacts bigint,
+  conversations_opened bigint,
+  conversations_resolved bigint,
+  active_contacts bigint,
+  median_response_time_seconds numeric
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_days      integer     := greatest(least(coalesce(p_days, 7), 90), 1);
+  v_today     date        := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date;
+  v_start_day date        := v_today - (v_days - 1);
+  v_end_day   date        := v_today + 1;
+  v_start     timestamptz := (v_start_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_end       timestamptz := (v_end_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) OR coalesce(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'dashboard_daily_series_requires_staff' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+  WITH dias AS (
+    SELECT generate_series(v_start_day, v_today, interval '1 day')::date AS dia
+  ),
+  recebidas AS (
+    SELECT (m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia, count(*) AS c
+    FROM public.messages m
+    WHERE m.created_at >= v_start AND m.created_at < v_end
+      AND m.sender = 'contact' AND m.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  enviadas AS (
+    SELECT (m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia, count(*) AS c
+    FROM public.messages m
+    WHERE m.created_at >= v_start AND m.created_at < v_end
+      AND m.sender = 'agent' AND m.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  ativos AS (
+    SELECT (m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia,
+           count(DISTINCT m.contact_id) AS c
+    FROM public.messages m
+    WHERE m.created_at >= v_start AND m.created_at < v_end
+      AND m.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND m.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  abertas AS (
+    SELECT (f.primeira AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia, count(*) AS c
+    FROM (
+      SELECT m.contact_id, min(m.created_at) AS primeira
+      FROM public.messages m
+      WHERE m.created_at >= v_start AND m.created_at < v_end
+        AND m.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND m.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
+      GROUP BY m.contact_id
+    ) f
+    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1
+      FROM public.messages p
+      WHERE p.contact_id = f.contact_id
+        AND p.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
+        AND p.created_at < v_start
+    )
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  resolvidas AS (
+    SELECT (cc.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia,
+           count(DISTINCT cc.contact_id) AS c
+    FROM public.conversation_closures cc
+    WHERE cc.created_at >= v_start AND cc.created_at < v_end
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  novos AS (
+    SELECT (c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia, count(*) AS c
+    FROM public.contacts c
+    WHERE c.created_at >= v_start AND c.created_at < v_end
+      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
+    GROUP BY 1
+  ),
+  resposta AS (
+    SELECT (s.first_message_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS dia,
+           round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
+             ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (s.first_response_at - s.first_message_at))
+           ))::numeric AS mediana
+    FROM public.conversation_sla s
+    WHERE s.first_message_at >= v_start AND s.first_message_at < v_end
+      AND s.first_response_at IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY 1
+  )
+  SELECT dias.dia,
+         coalesce(r.c, 0)::bigint,
+         coalesce(e.c, 0)::bigint,
+         coalesce(n.c, 0)::bigint,
+         coalesce(o.c, 0)::bigint,
+         coalesce(rs.c, 0)::bigint,
+         coalesce(a.c, 0)::bigint,
+         m.mediana
+  FROM dias
+  LEFT JOIN recebidas  r  ON r.dia  = dias.dia
+  LEFT JOIN enviadas   e  ON e.dia  = dias.dia
+  LEFT JOIN novos      n  ON n.dia  = dias.dia
+  LEFT JOIN abertas    o  ON o.dia  = dias.dia
+  LEFT JOIN resolvidas rs ON rs.dia = dias.dia
+  LEFT JOIN ativos     a  ON a.dia  = dias.dia
+  LEFT JOIN resposta   m  ON m.dia  = dias.dia
+  ORDER BY dias.dia;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.dashboard_daily_series(integer) IS
+  'Dashboard-03 (2026-10-12): serie diaria dos KPIs de atividade (V3 evolution_daily_metrics) '
+  'calculada das tabelas operacionais no fuso de America/Sao_Paulo. SECURITY DEFINER com trava '
+  'de papel (admin/supervisor ou service_role); p_days no intervalo [1, 90]; uma linha por dia, '
+  'inclusive sem movimento; mediana de resposta NULL quando nao ha amostra na SLA.';
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.dashboard_daily_series(integer) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.dashboard_daily_series(integer) FROM anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.dashboard_daily_series(integer) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.dashboard_daily_series(integer) TO service_role;

+-- contacts_presence
+-- Rollback: remove as 3 colunas aditivas de presenca em public.contacts (nao ha policy, grant nem dado novo).
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   alter table public.contacts drop column if exists last_seen_at;
+--   alter table public.contacts drop column if exists presence_updated_at;
+--   alter table public.contacts drop column if exists presence_status;
+--
+-- Presenca REAL do contato (R2-INB-030 removeu o "Online" FIXO e falso; mostrar o
+-- sinal verdadeiro vindo do WhatsApp e permitido). O webhook da Evolution GO ja
+-- entrega `presence.update` com online/offline (evolution-go-adapter.ts), mas o
+-- handler (evolution-webhook-handlers.ts:handlePresenceUpdate) descartava esses
+-- estados. As colunas abaixo guardam o que o evento informa:
+--   presence_status     -> 'online' | 'offline' (null = nunca informado, o front
+--                          mantem o estado NEUTRO; nunca afirma o que nao sabe);
+--   presence_updated_at -> instante do ultimo evento de presenca (o front so mostra
+--                          "Online" se for recente);
+--   last_seen_at        -> instante em que o contato passou de online para offline
+--                          ("visto por ultimo").
+--
+-- Natureza: ADITIVA e IDEMPOTENTE (colunas nullable + `add column if not exists`).
+-- Sem backfill e sem tocar dado existente. O CHECK so restringe os valores que o
+-- proprio handler escreve. A RLS/GRANT sao herdados da tabela `contacts` (coluna
+-- nova nao cria superficie de acesso propria), entao nao ha policy nem grant novos.
+
+alter table public.contacts
+  add column if not exists presence_status text
+    check (presence_status in ('online', 'offline')),
+  add column if not exists presence_updated_at timestamptz,
+  add column if not exists last_seen_at timestamptz;

+-- ou admin/supervisor (policy vigente desde 20260320133103). Logo o `use_count + 1`
+-- no emoji de OUTRO atendente n√£o √© recusado com erro: o UPDATE atinge 0 linhas e o
+-- contador fica parado ‚Äî a ordena√ß√£o por uso (StickerPicker/MediaLibraryAdmin) fica
+-- enviesada. A corre√ß√£o N√ÉO abre UPDATE na tabela: cria uma RPC estreita que s√≥ faz
+-- `use_count = use_count + 1`, com o dono (DEFINER) escrevendo no lugar do atendente.

+-- Contrato: RETURN o novo use_count; 22023 para p_emoji_id nulo; P0002 se o emoji
+-- n√£o existe; 42501 se n√£o h√° sess√£o de usu√°rio. N√£o toca em name, category,
+-- is_favorite, uploaded_by nem updated_at (o contador n√£o √© uma edi√ß√£o do emoji).
+--
+-- ACL: EXECUTE s√≥ para `authenticated` (o caminho do app √© o PostgREST com esse papel);
+-- PUBLIC, anon e service_role ficam de fora. Nenhum GRANT de tabela muda.
+
+create function public.increment_custom_emoji_use(p_emoji_id uuid)
+returns integer
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $$
+declare
+  v_use_count integer;
+begin
+  -- Segunda barreira: o EXECUTE j√° √© s√≥ de authenticated; esta checagem garante que
+  -- um afrouxamento acidental da ACL ainda exija uma sess√£o de usu√°rio logado.
+  if auth.uid() is null then
+    raise exception 'autenticacao_obrigatoria' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  if p_emoji_id is null then
+    raise exception 'custom_emoji_id_obrigatorio' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  update public.custom_emojis as e
+     set use_count = coalesce(e.use_count, 0) + 1
+   where e.id = p_emoji_id
+  returning e.use_count into v_use_count;
+
+  if not found then
+    raise exception 'custom_emoji_nao_encontrado' using errcode = 'P0002';
+  end if;
+
+  return v_use_count;
+end;
+$$;
+
+comment on function public.increment_custom_emoji_use(uuid) is
+  'PB-35: sobe use_count do emoji personalizado em 1 para QUALQUER atendente (inclusive emoji de outro dono), sem abrir UPDATE na tabela. N√£o altera nenhum outro campo. Devolve o novo contador (P0002 se o emoji n√£o existe).';

+--   create or replace function public.handle_message_gamification() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare v_new_sent int; v_received int; v_total int; begin if tg_op = 'update' and (old.agent_id is not null or new.agent_id is null) then return new; end if; if new.sender = 'agent' and new.agent_id is not null then insert into public.agent_stats (profile_id, messages_sent, messages_received, current_streak, best_streak, updated_at) values (new.agent_id, 1, 0, 1, 1, now()) on conflict (profile_id) do update set messages_sent = public.agent_stats.messages_sent + 1, current_streak = public.agent_stats.current_streak + 1, best_streak = greatest(public.agent_stats.best_streak, public.agent_stats.current_streak + 1), updated_at = now() returning messages_sent, messages_received into v_new_sent, v_received; v_total := v_new_sent + v_received; if v_total = any (array[10, 50, 100, 500, 1000]) then perform public.grant_agent_achievement_internal(new.agent_id, 'message_milestone', v_total || ' Mensagens', 'Voc√™ enviou/recebeu ' || v_total || ' mensagens!', least(100, v_total / 10)); end if; end if; return new; exception when others then raise warning 'gamification error in handle_message_gamification (message_id=%): % [%]', new.id, sqlerrm, sqlstate; return new; end; $$;

+--   create or replace function public.update_agent_streak(p_profile_id uuid, p_increment boolean) returns json language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as $$ declare v_row agent_stats%rowtype; v_new_streak int; v_new_best_streak int; begin if auth.role() = 'anon' or (auth.role() = 'authenticated' and not (p_profile_id in (select id from profiles where user_id = auth.uid()) or is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()))) then raise exception 'permission denied'; end if; select * into v_row from agent_stats where profile_id = p_profile_id for update; if not found then return null; end if; v_new_best_streak := coalesce(v_row.best_streak, 0); if p_increment then v_new_streak := coalesce(v_row.current_streak, 0) + 1; if v_new_streak > v_new_best_streak then v_new_best_streak := v_new_streak; end if; else v_new_streak := 0; end if; update agent_stats set current_streak = v_new_streak, best_streak = v_new_best_streak, updated_at = now() where profile_id = p_profile_id; return json_build_object('newStreak', v_new_streak, 'newBestStreak', v_new_best_streak); end; $$;
+--
+-- PROBLEMA (PE-30, docs/plans/PLANO_PARIDADE_V3_DOCS_10_A_40_2026-10-12.md):
+--   "Dias seguidos" mostrava a contagem de MENSAGENS, n√£o de dias. O gatilho
+--   trg_gamification_on_message_sent (handle_message_gamification) fazia
+--   current_streak = current_streak + 1 A CADA mensagem enviada e o RPC
+--   update_agent_streak(true), chamado pelo navegador, fazia o mesmo ‚Äî medido
+--   em produ√ß√£o: streak = messages_sent nos 9 agentes (ex.: 1204 = 1204 mensagens).
+--   A migration 20260927620000 chegou a igualar current_streak/best_streak a
+--   messages_sent, consolidando o defeito.
+--
+-- CORRE√á√ÉO: a sequ√™ncia passa a ser de DIAS consecutivos com atividade. A
+--   atividade √©: mensagem ENVIADA pelo agente (messages.sender='agent') OU
+--   conversa ENCERRADA pelo agente (conversation_closures.closed_by). O dia √© o
+--   de America/Sao_Paulo (mesma base de "hoje" usada em daily_goal).
+--
+--   1. Coluna aditiva public.agent_stats.last_active_date (date): √∫ltimo dia com
+--      atividade. Sem default (nulos = agentes nunca ativos).
+--   2. Rotina interna public.register_agent_active_day(profile_id, day): idempotente
+--      no mesmo dia (v√°rias mensagens no dia contam 1); soma 1 se o √∫ltimo dia
+--      ativo foi o anterior; reinicia em 1 se pulou um dia ou mais; ignora dia
+--      anterior ao √∫ltimo (evento retrocedido). N√£o √© execut√°vel por cliente.
+--   3. handle_message_gamification PARA de somar streak por mensagem e passa a
+--      registrar o dia (created_at do pr√≥prio evento). update_agent_streak(true)
+--      (caminho do navegador) passa a registrar o dia de hoje ‚Äî idempotente.
+--      handle_conversation_closure_gamification tamb√©m registra o dia.
+--   4. Backfill a partir do hist√≥rico real (mensagens por dia + encerramentos por
+--      dia), SEM inflar: current_streak = dias consecutivos at√© hoje (0 se o
+--      √∫ltimo dia ativo √© anterior a ontem); best_streak = maior corrida do
+--      hist√≥rico. N√£o usa as fun√ß√µes de XP (a PB-18 revoga v√°rias delas).
+
+-- 1. Coluna aditiva ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ALTER TABLE public.agent_stats
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_active_date date;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.agent_stats.last_active_date IS
+  'Ultimo dia (America/Sao_Paulo) com atividade do agente (mensagem enviada ou conversa encerrada). Base da sequencia current_streak em DIAS.';

+-- 2. Registro idempotente do dia ativo ------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_agent_active_day(p_profile_id uuid, p_day date)
+ RETURNS json
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_row        agent_stats%ROWTYPE;
+  v_new_streak int;
+  v_new_best   int;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_profile_id IS NULL OR p_day IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN json_build_object('registered', false, 'newStreak', NULL, 'newBestStreak', NULL);
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.agent_stats WHERE profile_id = p_profile_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Mesmo dia: idempotente (N mensagens no dia contam 1).
+  IF v_row.last_active_date = p_day THEN
+    RETURN json_build_object('registered', false, 'newStreak', v_row.current_streak, 'newBestStreak', v_row.best_streak);
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Evento retrocedido (dia anterior ao √∫ltimo registrado): n√£o mexe na sequ√™ncia.
+  IF v_row.last_active_date IS NOT NULL AND p_day < v_row.last_active_date THEN
+    RETURN json_build_object('registered', false, 'newStreak', v_row.current_streak, 'newBestStreak', v_row.best_streak);
+  END IF;
+
+  IF v_row.last_active_date = p_day - 1 THEN
+    v_new_streak := COALESCE(v_row.current_streak, 0) + 1;   -- dia seguinte: soma 1
+  ELSE
+    v_new_streak := 1;                                        -- pulou um dia ou mais: reinicia
+  END IF;
+  v_new_best := GREATEST(COALESCE(v_row.best_streak, 0), v_new_streak);
+
+  UPDATE public.agent_stats
+     SET current_streak   = v_new_streak,
+         best_streak      = v_new_best,
+         last_active_date = p_day
+   WHERE profile_id = p_profile_id;
+
+  RETURN json_build_object('registered', true, 'newStreak', v_new_streak, 'newBestStreak', v_new_best);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- Rotina interna: nenhum cliente a alcan√ßa (o default de CREATE FUNCTION seria EXECUTE para PUBLIC).
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.register_agent_active_day(uuid, date) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

+-- 3a. Trigger de mensagem: n√£o soma streak por mensagem; registra o DIA do evento ------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_message_gamification()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_new_sent  int;
+  v_received  int;
+  v_total     int;
+  v_agent_id  uuid;
+  v_day       date;
+BEGIN
+  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND (OLD.agent_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.agent_id IS NULL) THEN
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+  IF NEW.sender = 'agent' AND NEW.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_day := (COALESCE(NEW.created_at, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date;
+    INSERT INTO public.agent_stats (profile_id, messages_sent, messages_received, current_streak, best_streak, last_active_date, updated_at)
+    VALUES (NEW.agent_id, 1, 0, 0, 0, NULL, now())
+    ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO UPDATE
+    SET messages_sent   = public.agent_stats.messages_sent + 1,
+        updated_at      = now()
+    RETURNING messages_sent, messages_received INTO v_new_sent, v_received;
+
+    -- Sequ√™ncia em DIAS: no primeiro envio do dia soma 1 (ou reinicia), e nada nos demais.
+    PERFORM public.register_agent_active_day(NEW.agent_id, v_day);
+
+    v_total := v_new_sent + v_received;
+    IF v_total = ANY (ARRAY[10, 50, 100, 500, 1000]) THEN
+      PERFORM public.grant_agent_achievement_internal(
+        NEW.agent_id, 'message_milestone', v_total || ' Mensagens',
+        'Voc√™ enviou/recebeu ' || v_total || ' mensagens!',
+        LEAST(100, v_total / 10)
+      );
+    END IF;
+  ELSIF NEW.sender = 'contact' THEN
+    SELECT assigned_to INTO v_agent_id FROM public.contacts WHERE id = NEW.contact_id;
+    IF v_agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+      INSERT INTO public.agent_stats (profile_id, messages_sent, messages_received, current_streak, best_streak, updated_at)
+      VALUES (v_agent_id, 0, 1, 0, 0, now())
+      ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO UPDATE
+      SET messages_received = public.agent_stats.messages_received + 1,
+          updated_at        = now()
+      RETURNING messages_sent, messages_received INTO v_new_sent, v_received;
+      v_total := v_new_sent + v_received;
+      IF v_total = ANY (ARRAY[10, 50, 100, 500, 1000]) THEN
+        PERFORM public.grant_agent_achievement_internal(
+          v_agent_id, 'message_milestone', v_total || ' Mensagens',
+          'Voc√™ enviou/recebeu ' || v_total || ' mensagens!',
+          LEAST(100, v_total / 10)
+        );
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+  -- Gamificacao NUNCA pode reverter o enfileiramento/atendimento.
+  RAISE WARNING 'gamification error in handle_message_gamification (message_id=%): % [%]',
+    NEW.id, SQLERRM, SQLSTATE;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- 3b. Trigger de encerramento: conversa encerrada TAMB√âM √© dia ativo --------------------------------
+--     SECURITY DEFINER + search_path vazio: o gatilho dispara no INSERT/UPDATE feito pelo papel
+--     real (authenticated) em conversation_closures, mas a escrita em agent_stats (RLS) e a
+--     rotina interna register_agent_active_day (REVOKE de PUBLIC/anon/authenticated na se√ß√£o 2)
+--     exigem o owner. Sem DEFINER, o corpo roda com os direitos do chamador, falha com 42501
+--     (medido: RLS no INSERT em agent_stats), cai no EXCEPTION e desfaz o INSERT/UPDATE
+--     de conversations_resolved do pr√≥prio fechamento.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_conversation_closure_gamification()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_resolved  bigint;
+  v_day       date;
+BEGIN
+  -- Para UPDATE: s√≥ contar quando closed_by muda de NULL para NOT NULL
+  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND (OLD.closed_by IS NOT NULL OR NEW.closed_by IS NULL) THEN
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NEW.closed_by IS NOT NULL THEN
+    INSERT INTO public.agent_stats (
+      profile_id, messages_sent, messages_received,
+      conversations_resolved, current_streak, best_streak, updated_at
+    )
+    VALUES (NEW.closed_by, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, now())
+    ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO UPDATE
+    SET conversations_resolved = public.agent_stats.conversations_resolved + 1,
+        updated_at              = now()
+    RETURNING conversations_resolved INTO v_resolved;
+
+    v_day := (COALESCE(NEW.created_at, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date;
+    PERFORM public.register_agent_active_day(NEW.closed_by, v_day);
+
+    IF v_resolved = ANY (ARRAY[1, 10, 50, 100, 500]) THEN
+      -- Bloco aninhado: se a conquista falhar, o dia ativo (e conversations_resolved)
+      -- ja gravados ACIMA continuam valendo. Sem isto, o EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS do
+      -- bloco externo desfazia tudo o que a funcao tinha escrito naquele fechamento
+      -- (o gancho de streak se perdia junto).
+      BEGIN
+        PERFORM public.grant_agent_achievement(
+          NEW.closed_by,
+          'resolution_milestone',
+          v_resolved || ' Conversas Encerradas',
+          'Voc√™ encerrou ' || v_resolved || ' conversas!',
+          LEAST(100, v_resolved)
+        );
+      EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        RAISE WARNING 'gamification achievement error in closure (closure_id=%): % [%]',
+          NEW.id, SQLERRM, SQLSTATE;
+      END;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+  -- Gamifica√ß√£o NUNCA pode reverter fechamento de conversa
+  RAISE WARNING 'gamification error in handle_conversation_closure_gamification (closure_id=%): % [%]',
+    NEW.id, SQLERRM, SQLSTATE;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;

+-- 3c. RPC do navegador (update_agent_streak): incremento passa a ser por DIA ----------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_agent_streak(p_profile_id uuid, p_increment boolean)
+ RETURNS json
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_row        agent_stats%ROWTYPE;
+  v_res        json;
+  v_today      date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.role() = 'anon'
+     OR (auth.role() = 'authenticated' AND NOT (
+           p_profile_id IN (SELECT id FROM profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
+           OR is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+         ))
+  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission denied'; END IF;
+
+  -- Incremento por dia: idempotente no mesmo dia (o navegador pode chamar a cada envio).
+  IF p_increment THEN
+    v_res := public.register_agent_active_day(p_profile_id, v_today);
+    IF v_res IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+    RETURN json_build_object(
+      'newStreak',     (v_res->>'newStreak')::int,
+      'newBestStreak', (v_res->>'newBestStreak')::int
+    );
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Reset expl√≠cito (p_increment = false): zera a sequ√™ncia e libera o dia.
+  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM agent_stats WHERE profile_id = p_profile_id FOR UPDATE;
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  UPDATE agent_stats
+     SET current_streak   = 0,
+         last_active_date = NULL,
+         updated_at       = now()
+   WHERE profile_id = p_profile_id;
+  RETURN json_build_object('newStreak', 0, 'newBestStreak', COALESCE(v_row.best_streak, 0));
+END; $function$;
+
+-- 4. Backfill do hist√≥rico real (SEM inflar) --------------------------------------------------------
+-- O gatilho BEFORE UPDATE update_agent_stats_updated_at regrava updated_at em TODA linha tocada.
+-- Desligo S√ì ele durante o backfill (a migration roda em transa√ß√£o √∫nica; o rollback restaura) para
+-- a corre√ß√£o de streak n√£o reescrever a data das linhas. O rollback p√≥s-merge reabilita.
+ALTER TABLE public.agent_stats DISABLE TRIGGER update_agent_stats_updated_at;
+WITH activity AS (
+  SELECT m.agent_id AS profile_id,
+         (m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS d
+    FROM public.messages m
+   WHERE m.sender = 'agent' AND m.agent_id IS NOT NULL
+  UNION
+  SELECT c.closed_by AS profile_id,
+         (c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS d
+    FROM public.conversation_closures c
+   WHERE c.closed_by IS NOT NULL
+),
+dias AS (
+  SELECT DISTINCT profile_id, d FROM activity
+),
+runs AS (
+  SELECT profile_id, d,
+         d - (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY profile_id ORDER BY d))::int AS grp
+    FROM dias
+),
+tamanhos AS (
+  SELECT profile_id, grp, count(*)::int AS len, max(d) AS fim
+    FROM runs GROUP BY profile_id, grp
+),
+ultima AS (
+  SELECT DISTINCT ON (profile_id) profile_id, len, fim
+    FROM tamanhos ORDER BY profile_id, fim DESC
+),
+melhor AS (
+  SELECT profile_id, max(len)::int AS best FROM tamanhos GROUP BY profile_id
+),
+hoje AS (
+  SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS d
+),
+novo AS (
+  SELECT s.profile_id,
+         CASE WHEN u.fim >= (SELECT d FROM hoje) - 1 THEN u.len ELSE 0 END AS cs,
+         GREATEST(m.best, u.len) AS bs,
+         u.fim AS lad
+    FROM public.agent_stats s
+    JOIN ultima u ON u.profile_id = s.profile_id
+    JOIN melhor m ON m.profile_id = s.profile_id
+)
+UPDATE public.agent_stats s
+   SET current_streak   = n.cs,
+       best_streak      = n.bs,
+       last_active_date = n.lad
+  FROM novo n
+ WHERE s.profile_id = n.profile_id
+   AND (s.current_streak   IS DISTINCT FROM n.cs
+     OR s.best_streak      IS DISTINCT FROM n.bs
+     OR s.last_active_date IS DISTINCT FROM n.lad);
+
+-- Agentes sem NENHUMA atividade no hist√≥rico: sequ√™ncia zerada e sem data.
+UPDATE public.agent_stats s
+   SET current_streak   = 0,
+       best_streak      = 0,
+       last_active_date = NULL
+ WHERE (s.current_streak <> 0 OR s.best_streak <> 0 OR s.last_active_date IS NOT NULL)
+   AND NOT EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1 FROM public.messages m
+          WHERE m.sender = 'agent' AND m.agent_id = s.profile_id
+       )
+   AND NOT EXISTS (
+         SELECT 1 FROM public.conversation_closures c
+          WHERE c.closed_by = s.profile_id
+       );
+
+ALTER TABLE public.agent_stats ENABLE TRIGGER update_agent_stats_updated_at;

+-- crisis_room_snapshot
+-- Rollback: drop function if exists public.crisis_room_snapshot();
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.crisis_room_snapshot();
+--
+-- R2-AUTH-036 (Sala de Crise) ‚Äî as 4 m√©tricas da tela passam a ser medidas no
+-- banco, num √∫nico agregado. Dois defeitos da ponte no navegador morrem aqui:
+--   (1) o corte silencioso de 1.000 linhas do PostgREST transformava opera√ß√£o
+--       grande em n√∫mero pequeno (m√©trica que mente justamente na crise);
+--   (2) n√£o havia funil √∫nico de janela/fuso ‚Äî o SLA contava estouros de todo o
+--       hist√≥rico, n√£o das √∫ltimas 24 h.
+--
+-- Paridade com src/components/admin/CrisisRoom.tsx (defini√ß√µes das m√©tricas):
+--   * unanswered_messages / unanswered_conversations ‚Äî "Msgs sem resposta (1h)":
+--     mensagens de contato (sender='contact') dos √∫ltimos 60 min SEM resposta
+--     posterior do atendimento (sender='agent') na mesma conversa (contact_id).
+--     Conta mensagens e contatos distintos.
+--   * online_agents / total_agents ‚Äî "Agentes ativos": presen√ßa REAL em
+--     public.agent_presence (status='online' e heartbeat h√° menos de 75 s, o
+--     mesmo corte do useAgentPresenceMap), restrita a contas habilitadas de
+--     atendimento (profiles.is_active e role in agent/admin/supervisor).
+--     NUNCA profiles.is_active sozinho ‚Äî era exatamente o proxy que inflava.
+--   * sla_breached ‚Äî "SLA estourados": conversation_sla.first_response_breached
+--     E (first_response_at IS NULL OU criado nas √∫ltimas 24 h), no fuso
+--     America/Sao_Paulo.
+--   * queue_ratio ‚Äî "Carga por agente": contatos pendentes / agentes online;
+--     NULL quando n√£o h√° agente online (n√£o inventa 0).
+--
+-- Acesso: SECURITY DEFINER (precisa enxergar TODAS as conversas, n√£o apenas as
+-- do chamador) com barreira expl√≠cita de admin/supervisor. Quem n√£o for, recebe
+-- exce√ß√£o ‚Äî nunca zeros. Falha de medi√ß√£o nunca vira "opera√ß√£o normal".
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crisis_room_snapshot()
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_now              timestamptz := now();
+  v_window           interval := interval '60 minutes';
+  v_presence_ttl     interval := interval '75 seconds';
+  v_sla_window       interval := interval '24 hours';
+  v_unanswered_msgs  integer;
+  v_unanswered_convs integer;
+  v_online_agents    integer;
+  v_total_agents     integer;
+  v_sla_breached     integer;
+  v_queue_ratio      numeric;
+BEGIN
+  -- Sem barreira de RLS aqui (DEFINER): a autoriza√ß√£o √© expl√≠cita e id√™ntica
+  -- para todo n√£o autorizado (sem or√°culo de enumera√ß√£o).
+  IF NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'crisis_room_snapshot requires admin or supervisor'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- 1) Mensagens de contato da √∫ltima hora ainda sem resposta posterior.
+  SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT m.contact_id)
+    INTO v_unanswered_msgs, v_unanswered_convs
+  FROM public.messages m
+  WHERE m.sender = 'contact'
+    AND m.contact_id IS NOT NULL
+    AND m.created_at >= v_now - v_window
+    AND NOT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1
+      FROM public.messages r
+      WHERE r.contact_id = m.contact_id
+        AND r.sender = 'agent'
+        AND r.created_at > m.created_at
+    );
+
+  -- 2) Universo habilitado de atendimento (quem PODE estar online).
+  SELECT count(DISTINCT p.user_id)
+    INTO v_total_agents
+  FROM public.profiles p
+  WHERE p.is_active
+    AND p.role IN ('agent', 'admin', 'supervisor');
+
+  -- 3) Presen√ßa real: heartbeat recente, dentro do universo habilitado.
+  SELECT count(DISTINCT ap.user_id)
+    INTO v_online_agents
+  FROM public.agent_presence ap
+  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = ap.user_id
+  WHERE ap.status = 'online'
+    AND ap.updated_at >= v_now - v_presence_ttl
+    AND p.is_active
+    AND p.role IN ('agent', 'admin', 'supervisor');
+
+  -- 4) SLA estourado e ainda em aberto, ou estourado nas √∫ltimas 24 h.
+  SELECT count(*)
+    INTO v_sla_breached
+  FROM public.conversation_sla s
+  WHERE s.first_response_breached
+    AND (s.first_response_at IS NULL
+         OR s.created_at >= v_now - v_sla_window);
+
+  -- 5) Carga pendente por agente online (NULL sem agente online, nunca 0).
+  IF v_online_agents > 0 THEN
+    v_queue_ratio := round(v_unanswered_convs::numeric / v_online_agents, 2);
+  ELSE
+    v_queue_ratio := NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'unanswered_messages', v_unanswered_msgs,
+    'unanswered_conversations', v_unanswered_convs,
+    'online_agents', v_online_agents,
+    'total_agents', v_total_agents,
+    'sla_breached', v_sla_breached,
+    'queue_ratio', v_queue_ratio,
+    'window_minutes', 60,
+    'sla_window_hours', 24,
+    'cycle_date_sp', (v_now AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date::text,
+    'generated_at', v_now
+  );
+END;
+$fn$;
+
+-- S√≥ admin/supervisor autenticado chama; anon e service_role ficam de fora (a
+-- fun√ß√£o enxerga tudo e n√£o deve virar atalho de leitura por chave de servi√ßo).
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.crisis_room_snapshot() FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.crisis_room_snapshot() TO authenticated;

+create or replace function public.can_access_realtime_topic(_topic text)
+returns boolean
+language sql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $$
+  select case
+    when auth.uid() is null then

+    when _topic ~ '^typing:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'

+      )
+    else
+      false
+  end;

+-- reabre_conversa_com_nova_mensagem
+-- Rollback: dropa o gatilho e as tr√™s fun√ß√µes criadas; o estado das conversas fica como est√° (a reabertura √© efeito de dado, sem marca pr√≥pria).
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop trigger if exists trg_conversation_reopen_on_inbound on public.messages;
+--   drop function if exists public.handle_inbound_message_reopen();
+--   drop function if exists public.reopen_conversation(uuid);

+--
+-- R2-INB-035: conversa resolvida/arquivada n√£o reabria sozinha quando o cliente voltava a
+-- escrever ‚Äî o atendente s√≥ via a resposta nova no hist√≥rico de um contato fora da inbox.
+--

+--   1. reopen_conversation_core(contact_id, performed_by): n√∫cleo travado por FOR UPDATE,
+--      sem checagem de chamador (interno). Reabre S√ì contato ativo (n√£o soft-deleted) em
+--      'resolved'/'archived' para 'waiting' (sem respons√°vel) ou 'open' (com respons√°vel),
+--      seguindo o FSM can√¥nico: resolved/archived n√£o v√£o direto a 'waiting', ent√£o a
+--      transi√ß√£o √© feita em dois passos (-> open e, se for o caso, -> waiting). Idempotente:

+--      cobrindo TODOS os caminhos de entrada (webhook/ingest/Edge) ‚Äî n√£o s√≥ a RPC de ingest.
+--
+-- Evento: conversation_events event_type='reopen' (sem texto de mensagem e sem PII),
+-- com previous_status/destination no metadata. Uma opera√ß√£o at√¥mica: se o evento falhar,
+-- nada (nem a mudan√ßa de estado) persiste.

+-- (indiferentes a mensagem de contato sem agent_id). Nada disso √© desligado.
+--
+-- Aplicada depois do merge (classe contrato).
+
+create or replace function public.reopen_conversation_core(
+  p_contact_id uuid,
+  p_performed_by uuid default null
+) returns table(
+  contact_id uuid,
+  conversation_status text,
+  conversation_status_changed_at timestamptz,
+  event_id uuid,
+  reopened boolean
+)
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $function$
+declare
+  v_status text;
+  v_assigned uuid;
+  v_deleted timestamptz;
+  v_dest text;
+  v_changed_at timestamptz;
+  v_event_id uuid; begin
+  if p_contact_id is null then
+    raise exception 'invalid_reopen_request' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  select contact.conversation_status,
+         contact.assigned_to,
+         contact.deleted_at
+    into v_status, v_assigned, v_deleted
+  from public.contacts as contact
+  where contact.id = p_contact_id
+  for update;
+
+  if not found then
+    raise exception 'contact_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002';
+  end if;
+
+  -- No-op idempotente: contato soft-deleted ou j√° ativo n√£o reabre nem grava evento.
+  if v_deleted is not null or v_status is null or v_status not in ('resolved', 'archived') then
+    select contact.conversation_status_changed_at into v_changed_at
+    from public.contacts as contact where contact.id = p_contact_id;
+    return query select p_contact_id, v_status, v_changed_at, null::uuid, false;
+    return;
+  end if;
+
+  v_dest := case when v_assigned is null then 'waiting' else 'open' end;
+
+  -- Passo 1: resolved/archived s√≥ alcan√ßam estado ativo por 'open' (FSM can√¥nico).
+  update public.contacts as contact
+     set conversation_status = 'open'
+   where contact.id = p_contact_id
+   returning contact.conversation_status_changed_at into v_changed_at;
+
+  -- Passo 2: sem respons√°vel, o estado can√¥nico do FSM √© 'waiting' (Aguardando, W1/W2).
+  if v_dest = 'waiting' then
+    update public.contacts as contact
+       set conversation_status = 'waiting'
+     where contact.id = p_contact_id
+     returning contact.conversation_status_changed_at into v_changed_at;
+  end if;
+
+  insert into public.conversation_events (contact_id, event_type, performed_by, metadata)
+  values (
+    p_contact_id,
+    'reopen',
+    p_performed_by,
+    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
+      'previous_status', v_status,
+      'destination', v_dest
+    ))
+  )
+  returning id into v_event_id;
+
+  return query select p_contact_id, v_dest, v_changed_at, v_event_id, true;
+end;

+-- ai_sentiment_summary
+-- Rollback: drop function if exists public.ai_sentiment_summary(integer);
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.ai_sentiment_summary(integer);
+--
+-- IA-DB-002 ‚Äî o resumo de sentimento do widget de IA (PF-10) era montado no
+-- navegador: useAIStats baixava as linhas cruas de conversation_analyses,
+-- messages e audit_logs e somava tudo no cliente. Duas consequ√™ncias medidas:
+--   (a) o total exibido nunca passava dos 1000/limite de linhas do PostgREST ‚Äî
+--       uma janela com mais de 1000 an√°lises devolvia um n√∫mero truncado;
+--   (b) a m√©dia do per√≠odo anterior era recalculada sobre as mesmas linhas
+--       achatadas, ent√£o "per√≠odo anterior vazio" virava divis√£o por zero.
+-- Esta migration move o c√°lculo para o servidor, numa √∫nica RPC, e devolve o
+-- agregado real (sem truncar), as classes de sentimento, a s√©rie di√°ria e o
+-- mesmo agregado do bloco de dias imediatamente anterior.
+--
+-- Contrato (leia antes de consumir no front):
+--   * STAFF-ONLY. S√≥ admin/supervisor executam; agente comum, anon e
+--     service_role recebem erro 42501 (fail-closed, sem or√°culo).
+--   * A janela √© de `p_days` DIAS DE CALEND√ÅRIO em America/Sao_Paulo,
+--     INCLUINDO o dia de hoje (ex.: p_days=7 => os 7 dias terminando hoje).
+--     O per√≠odo anterior s√£o os `p_days` dias de calend√°rio imediatamente
+--     antes dessa janela.
+--   * `sentiment` √© o vocabul√°rio can√¥nico (positivo|neutro|negativo|critico,
+--     garantido por ai_is_canonical_sentiment em conversation_analyses).
+--     `critico` conta como NEGATIVO (regra IA-SENTIMENT-001) ‚Äî √© o extremo
+--     da escala, nunca neutro. Valor desconhecido/ausente n√£o vira classe.
+--   * `media` s√≥ existe quando h√° ao menos uma nota (`sentiment_score`) no
+--     bloco; sem amostra v√°lida volta NULL (nunca 0/50 inventado). O `total`
+--     conta TODAS as an√°lises, inclusive as sem nota.
+--   * `anterior` volta NULL (n√£o um objeto zerado) quando o per√≠odo anterior
+--     n√£o tem nenhuma an√°lise ‚Äî o consumidor l√™ "sem base de compara√ß√£o", n√£o
+--     queda de 100%.
+
+create or replace function public.ai_sentiment_summary(p_days integer default 30)
+returns jsonb
+language plpgsql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $fn$
+declare
+  v_dias         integer;
+  v_fim          timestamptz := now();
+  v_hoje         date;
+  v_ini_dia      date;
+  v_inicio       timestamptz;
+  v_ant_ini      timestamptz;
+  v_atual        jsonb;
+  v_anterior     jsonb;
+  v_serie        jsonb;
+  v_transcricoes integer := 0;
+  v_transc_ant   integer := 0;
+begin
+  -- Fail-closed: sem papel de staff a fun√ß√£o n√£o responde nada al√©m do erro.
+  -- N√£o revela se h√° ou n√£o dados (mesma resposta para qualquer agente).
+  if not public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) then
+    raise exception 'ai_sentiment_summary requires admin or supervisor'
+      using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Entrada inv√°lida √© normalizada (1..366 dias), nunca gera janela absurda.
+  v_dias := least(greatest(coalesce(p_days, 30), 1), 366);
+
+  v_hoje    := (v_fim at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date;
+  v_ini_dia := v_hoje - (v_dias - 1);
+  v_inicio  := (v_ini_dia::timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_ant_ini := ((v_ini_dia - v_dias)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+
+  -- Agregado da janela atual. `count(*)` conta tudo; `avg` ignora NULL.
+  select jsonb_build_object(
+           'total',     count(*),
+           'positivos', count(*) filter (where a.sentiment = 'positivo'),
+           'neutros',   count(*) filter (where a.sentiment = 'neutro'),
+           'negativos', count(*) filter (where a.sentiment in ('negativo', 'critico')),
+           'media',     round(avg(a.sentiment_score)::numeric, 2)
+         )
+    into v_atual
+  from public.conversation_analyses a
+  where a.created_at >= v_inicio and a.created_at < v_fim;
+
+  -- Agregado da janela anterior (mesma forma).
+  select jsonb_build_object(
+           'total',     count(*),
+           'positivos', count(*) filter (where a.sentiment = 'positivo'),
+           'neutros',   count(*) filter (where a.sentiment = 'neutro'),
+           'negativos', count(*) filter (where a.sentiment in ('negativo', 'critico')),
+           'media',     round(avg(a.sentiment_score)::numeric, 2)
+         )
+    into v_anterior
+  from public.conversation_analyses a
+  where a.created_at >= v_ant_ini and a.created_at < v_inicio;
+
+  -- Per√≠odo anterior vazio => NULL, n√£o objeto zerado.
+  if (v_anterior->>'total')::integer = 0 then
+    v_anterior := null;
+  end if;
+
+  -- Transcri√ß√µes (o outro "total" do cart√£o), na janela atual.
+  select count(*)
+    into v_transcricoes
+  from public.messages m
+  where m.transcription is not null
+    and m.created_at >= v_inicio and m.created_at < v_fim;
+
+  -- Transcri√ß√µes da janela anterior, anexadas ao objeto `anterior` (que s√≥
+  -- existe quando h√° an√°lises no bloco ‚Äî coerente com o restante do agregado).
+  if v_anterior is not null then
+    select count(*)
+      into v_transc_ant
+    from public.messages m
+    where m.transcription is not null
+      and m.created_at >= v_ant_ini and m.created_at < v_inicio;
+    v_anterior := v_anterior || jsonb_build_object('transcricoes', v_transc_ant);
+  end if;
+
+  -- S√©rie di√°ria: exatamente v_dias baldes (um por dia, inclusive os vazios),
+  -- no fuso America/Sao_Paulo, para o gr√°fico n√£o pular dias sem an√°lise.
+  select jsonb_agg(
+           jsonb_build_object(
+             'dia',       to_char(g.dia, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
+             'total',     s.total,
+             'positivos', s.positivos,
+             'neutros',   s.neutros,
+             'negativos', s.negativos,
+             'media',     s.media
+           ) order by g.dia
+         )
+    into v_serie
+  from generate_series(v_ini_dia, v_hoje, interval '1 day') as g(dia)
+  left join lateral (
+    select count(*) as total,
+           count(*) filter (where a.sentiment = 'positivo') as positivos,
+           count(*) filter (where a.sentiment = 'neutro') as neutros,
+           count(*) filter (where a.sentiment in ('negativo', 'critico')) as negativos,
+           round(avg(a.sentiment_score)::numeric, 2) as media
+      from public.conversation_analyses a
+     where a.created_at >= v_inicio and a.created_at < v_fim
+       and (a.created_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date = g.dia::date
+  ) as s on true;
+
+  return jsonb_build_object(
+    'periodo_dias',  v_dias,
+    'inicio',        v_inicio,
+    'fim',           v_fim,
+    'total',         v_atual->'total',
+    'positivos',     v_atual->'positivos',
+    'neutros',       v_atual->'neutros',
+    'negativos',     v_atual->'negativos',
+    'media',         v_atual->'media',
+    'transcricoes',  v_transcricoes,
+    'serie_diaria',  v_serie,
+    'anterior',      v_anterior
+  );
+end;
+$fn$;
+
+comment on function public.ai_sentiment_summary(integer) is
+  'Agregado de sentimento do widget IA (IA-DB-002): staff-only, janela de p_days dias em America/Sao_Paulo + mesmo bloco anterior.';

+-- Fail-closed: nasce fechada. S√≥ authenticated (staff checado dentro) executa.
+revoke all on function public.ai_sentiment_summary(integer) from public, anon, service_role;
+grant execute on function public.ai_sentiment_summary(integer) to authenticated;

+-- search_email_threads
+-- Rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.search_email_threads(uuid, text, integer, timestamptz); DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.email_messages_body_text_trgm_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.email_attachments_filename_trgm_idx;
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.search_email_threads(uuid, text, integer, timestamptz);
+--   drop index if exists public.email_messages_body_text_trgm_idx;
+--   drop index if exists public.email_attachments_filename_trgm_idx;
+--
+-- Auditoria de paridade V3 -> V2 (docs 10..40), achado PE-09 (t_59d66c7a):
+-- a caixa promete "Buscar e-mails, remetentes, assuntos, anexos" (EmailChatInbox.tsx:252),
+-- mas emailThreadSearchOr (src/lib/emailThreadQuery.ts:115) so procura em email_threads
+-- (subject, snippet, last_from_name, last_from_address). A busca NAO alcanca o corpo da
+-- mensagem nem o nome do anexo, que so existem em email_messages/email_attachments.
+--
+-- Esta migracao entrega a RPC que o pre-filtro da caixa consome:
+--   public.search_email_threads(p_account uuid, p_q text, p_limit integer, p_after timestamptz)
+--     -> (thread_id, match_field, match_snippet, last_message_at)
+--
+-- SECURITY INVOKER (padrao): a funcao roda como o chamador e NAO fura a RLS de
+-- email_threads/email_messages/email_attachments. O predicado de visibilidade vigente
+-- (dono da conta ou admin/supervisor, via gmail_accounts) vale sem ser copiado aqui --
+-- por isso a busca e "limitada ao que o usuario ve" mesmo se a politica mudar depois.
+--
+-- Termo sanitizado: trim, corte em 120 chars, e os curingas de LIKE (% _ \) escapados
+-- para virarem literais. Termo vazio (ou so espacos) devolve ZERO linhas -- nunca a caixa
+-- inteira. Sem regex do usuario.
+
+CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
+
+-- Indices GIN de trigrama para o ILIKE '%termo%'. CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY nao pode:
+-- migrations rodam dentro de uma transacao (o CONCURRENTLY e proibido em bloco) e, no
+-- volume atual dessas duas tabelas, o build comum e curto. O indice de trigrama so e
+-- aproveitado a partir de 3 caracteres; termos mais curtos caem em varredura (aceitavel).
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS email_messages_body_text_trgm_idx
+  ON public.email_messages USING gin (body_text extensions.gin_trgm_ops);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS email_attachments_filename_trgm_idx
+  ON public.email_attachments USING gin (filename extensions.gin_trgm_ops);
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_email_threads(
+  p_account uuid,
+  p_q text,
+  p_limit integer DEFAULT 20,
+  p_after timestamptz DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  thread_id uuid,
+  match_field text,
+  match_snippet text,
+  last_message_at timestamptz
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_term text;
+  v_pattern text;
+  v_limit integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF p_account IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'search_email_threads: p_account obrigatorio'
+      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_term := btrim(coalesce(p_q, ''));
+  IF v_term = '' THEN
+    -- Termo vazio NUNCA devolve a caixa inteira: devolve nada.
+    RETURN;
+  END IF;
+
+  IF char_length(v_term) > 120 THEN
+    v_term := left(v_term, 120);
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Escapa os curingas de LIKE (barra primeiro) para o termo casar como literal.
+  v_pattern := '%'
+    || replace(replace(replace(v_term, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_')
+    || '%';
+
+  v_limit := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
+
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT h.thread_id, h.match_field, h.match_snippet, h.last_message_at
+  FROM (
+    SELECT
+      t.id AS thread_id,
+      t.last_message_at AS last_message_at,
+      -- Onde casou, em ordem de prioridade: assunto > anexo > corpo > remetente > snippet.
+      coalesce(
+        CASE WHEN t.subject ILIKE v_pattern THEN 'subject' END,
+        att.match_field,
+        msg.match_field,
+        CASE WHEN t.last_from_name ILIKE v_pattern
+               OR t.last_from_address ILIKE v_pattern THEN 'from' END,
+        CASE WHEN t.snippet ILIKE v_pattern THEN 'snippet' END
+      ) AS match_field,
+      -- Trecho mostrado na lista (o componente troca o assunto por ele, com fallback).
+      coalesce(
+        CASE WHEN t.subject ILIKE v_pattern THEN t.subject END,
+        att.match_snippet,
+        msg.match_snippet,
+        CASE WHEN t.last_from_name ILIKE v_pattern THEN t.last_from_name
+             WHEN t.last_from_address ILIKE v_pattern THEN t.last_from_address END,
+        CASE WHEN t.snippet ILIKE v_pattern THEN t.snippet END
+      ) AS match_snippet
+    FROM public.email_threads t
+    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT 'attachment'::text AS match_field,
+             coalesce(a.filename, '') AS match_snippet
+      FROM public.email_messages m
+      JOIN public.email_attachments a ON a.email_message_id = m.id
+      WHERE m.thread_id = t.id
+        AND a.filename ILIKE v_pattern
+      ORDER BY m.internal_date DESC
+      LIMIT 1
+    ) att ON true
+    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
+      SELECT 'body'::text AS match_field,
+             substring(
+               m.body_text
+               FROM greatest(1, position(lower(v_term) IN lower(m.body_text)) - 40)
+               FOR 160
+             ) AS match_snippet
+      FROM public.email_messages m
+      WHERE m.thread_id = t.id
+        AND m.body_text ILIKE v_pattern
+      ORDER BY m.internal_date DESC
+      LIMIT 1
+    ) msg ON true
+    WHERE t.gmail_account_id = p_account
+      AND (p_after IS NULL OR t.last_message_at < p_after)
+      AND (
+        t.subject ILIKE v_pattern
+        OR t.snippet ILIKE v_pattern
+        OR t.last_from_name ILIKE v_pattern
+        OR t.last_from_address ILIKE v_pattern
+        OR att.match_field IS NOT NULL
+        OR msg.match_field IS NOT NULL
+      )
+    ORDER BY t.last_message_at DESC, t.id DESC
+    LIMIT v_limit
+  ) h;
+
+  RETURN;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.search_email_threads(uuid, text, integer, timestamptz) IS
+  'Busca de e-mail (PE-09): procura o termo em email_threads (assunto/remetente/snippet), no corpo de email_messages.body_text e no nome de email_attachments.filename. SECURITY INVOKER: respeita a RLS de e-mail (limita ao que o usuario ve). Termo vazio devolve zero linhas. Devolve (thread_id, match_field, match_snippet, last_message_at); p_after e cursor de last_message_at para paginacao.';

+-- e get_last_message_dates), entao nao vaza conversa fora do alcance do usuario.
+--
+-- Leveza: o indice parcial idx_messages_unread_conversas reduz a varredura APENAS
+-- as mensagens de entrada nao lidas (linhas raras) e o DISTINCT contact_id sai do
+-- indice; o predicado de visibilidade e aplicado so nos contatos candidatos, nao na
+-- tabela messages inteira. E' estritamente mais leve que get_inbox_contact_summaries,
+-- que aplica o MESMO predicado por contato e ainda baixa as mensagens.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inbox_unread_total()
+RETURNS bigint
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  WITH candidatos AS MATERIALIZED (
+    SELECT DISTINCT m.contact_id
+    FROM public.messages AS m
+    WHERE m.sender = 'contact'
+      AND m.is_read IS NOT TRUE
+      AND m.contact_id IS NOT NULL
+  )
+  SELECT COALESCE(count(*), 0)::bigint
+  FROM candidatos AS c
+  WHERE public.is_contact_visible_to_user(c.contact_id, auth.uid());
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.inbox_unread_total() FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.inbox_unread_total() FROM anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.inbox_unread_total() TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Cobre exatamente o predicado da RPC: mensagens de entrada nao lidas. E' parcial
+-- (linhas raras) e NAO duplica idx_messages_unread_contact, que e' parcial em
+-- (is_read = false AND sender = 'contact') e portanto deixa de fora is_read NULO.
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_unread_conversas
+  ON public.messages (contact_id)
+  WHERE sender = 'contact' AND is_read IS NOT TRUE;

+-- whisper_audio_path
+-- Rollback: remove a policy de SELECT nova do storage, o gatilho, a funcao de validacao, a constraint de formato e a coluna audio_path de public.whisper_messages.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop policy if exists "Whisper audio readable by whisper member" on storage.objects;
+--   drop trigger if exists whisper_messages_valida_audio_path on public.whisper_messages;
+--   drop function if exists public.whisper_messages_valida_audio_path();
+--   alter table public.whisper_messages drop constraint if exists whisper_messages_audio_path_formato;
+--   alter table public.whisper_messages drop column if exists audio_path;
+--
+-- Nota de audio do sussurro (nota interna por voz, paridade V3 WhisperMode -> V2).
+-- A V3 guardava a URL assinada de 7 dias em `audio_url` (WhisperMode.tsx:238); aqui guardamos
+-- o CAMINHO do objeto no bucket e a assinatura acontece na leitura. O bucket e o
+-- `audio-messages` que a V2 ja usa (privado desde 20260905030000 e membro de
+-- PRIVATE_MEDIA_BUCKETS em src/lib/storage_object_reference.ts) para o locator ser
+-- resolvido por useResolvedStorageUrl sem trilha nova.
+--
+-- Formato do caminho: `<uid>/<conversa>/<uuid>` (3 segmentos, os tres UUID).
+--   `<uid>`      = auth.uid() de quem grava -> mantem a policy de INSERT existente
+--                  ("Users can upload assigned audio messages") e a de DELETE
+--                  ("Users can delete own audio messages"), que exigem foldername[1] = auth.uid().
+--   `<conversa>` = contacts.id da conversa do sussurro.
+--   `<uuid>`     = identificador estavel do objeto (createStorageObjectId).
+--
+-- Visibilidade da leitura: espelha a da propria linha de sussurro (remetente, agente destino
+-- ou admin/supervisor) pela policy nova "Whisper audio readable by whisper member". Nenhuma
+-- policy existente e trocada nem removida: a migration e aditiva.
+--
+-- Limite de tamanho/duracao: o bucket `audio-messages` e compartilhado com o audio de mensagem
+-- enviada, entao o limite NAO e aplicado no bucket (isso mudaria o audio de mensagem comum).
+-- O limite e aplicado por gatilho na linha do sussurro, que so aceita referenciar um objeto
+-- que existe, e de audio, com ate 10 MiB; quando o upload declara `duration` no metadata do
+-- objeto, ate 300 s. O audio cru pode ate subir, mas nenhum sussurro pode apontar para ele.
+
+SET search_path = public, storage, pg_temp;
+
+-- 1. Coluna do caminho (locator), nullable: as notas de sussurro de texto continuam valendo.
+alter table public.whisper_messages
+  add column if not exists audio_path text;
+
+-- 2. Formato do caminho. Ancora ^...$ com classe de caractere por segmento: recusa '..',
+--    caminho absoluto, barra dupla, segmento vazio, espaco, extensao e segmento a mais.
+alter table public.whisper_messages
+  drop constraint if exists whisper_messages_audio_path_formato;
+
+alter table public.whisper_messages
+  add constraint whisper_messages_audio_path_formato
+  check (
+    audio_path is null
+    or audio_path ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
+  );
+
+-- 3. Limite de tamanho/duracao e integridade do locator. SECURITY DEFINER porque o
+--    remetente nao enxerga o objeto pela RLS de storage.objects antes da linha do sussurro
+--    existir (a policy nova depende da propria linha); a funcao so LE metadata do objeto.
+--    search_path fixo; chamavel apenas como gatilho (retorna trigger), sem EXECUTE para
+--    PUBLIC/anon/authenticated (negado por padrao).
+create or replace function public.whisper_messages_valida_audio_path()
+returns trigger
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, storage, pg_temp
+as $$
+declare
+  v_limite_bytes bigint := 10485760; -- 10 MiB
+  v_limite_segundos numeric := 300;  -- 5 min
+  v_size bigint;
+  v_mime text;
+  v_duracao numeric;
+begin
+  if new.audio_path is null then
+    return new;
+  end if;
+
+  select (o.metadata->>'size')::bigint,
+         o.metadata->>'mimetype',
+         nullif(o.metadata->>'duration', '')::numeric
+    into v_size, v_mime, v_duracao
+    from storage.objects o
+   where o.bucket_id = 'audio-messages'
+     and o.name = new.audio_path;
+
+  if not found then
+    raise exception 'audio_path % nao existe no bucket audio-messages; envie o audio antes de gravar o sussurro', new.audio_path
+      using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  if v_size is null or v_size <= 0 then
+    raise exception 'nao consegui medir o tamanho do audio do sussurro'
+      using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  if v_size > v_limite_bytes then
+    raise exception 'audio do sussurro com % bytes excede o limite de % bytes', v_size, v_limite_bytes
+      using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  if v_mime is null or v_mime not like 'audio/%' then
+    raise exception 'audio do sussurro com tipo % nao e audio', coalesce(v_mime, '(ausente)')
+      using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  if v_duracao is not null and v_duracao > v_limite_segundos then
+    raise exception 'audio do sussurro com % s excede o limite de % s', v_duracao, v_limite_segundos
+      using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  return new;
+end;
+$$;
+
+revoke execute on function public.whisper_messages_valida_audio_path() from public, anon, authenticated;
+
+drop trigger if exists whisper_messages_valida_audio_path on public.whisper_messages;
+create trigger whisper_messages_valida_audio_path
+  before insert or update of audio_path on public.whisper_messages
+  for each row execute function public.whisper_messages_valida_audio_path();
+
+-- 4. Leitura do audio do sussurro pelos mesmos membros que enxergam a linha: remetente,
+--    agente destino ou admin/supervisor. `storage.objects.name` qualificado de proposito
+--    (sem ele o nome do objeto fica coberto pela coluna da subquery). Igualdade exata, sem LIKE.
+drop policy if exists "Whisper audio readable by whisper member" on storage.objects;
+create policy "Whisper audio readable by whisper member"
+  on storage.objects for select to authenticated
+  using (
+    storage.objects.bucket_id = 'audio-messages'
+    and exists (
+      select 1
+        from public.whisper_messages w
+       where w.audio_path = storage.objects.name
+         and (
+           w.sender_id in (select p.id from public.profiles p where p.user_id = auth.uid())
+           or w.target_agent_id in (select p.id from public.profiles p where p.user_id = auth.uid())
+           or public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+         )
+    )
+  );
+
+comment on column public.whisper_messages.audio_path is
+  'Caminho do audio da nota de sussurro no bucket audio-messages (<uid>/<conversa>/<uuid>); locator, assinado na leitura. NULL em sussurro de texto.';

+-- my_active_sessions
+-- Rollback: desagenda o job diario 'expire-orphan-user-sessions' e remove as funcoes public.my_active_sessions() e public.expire_orphan_user_sessions(); o cliente volta a ler public.user_sessions direto (com as linhas mortas reaparecendo).

+--
+-- Defeito: DevicesPanel/SecurityOverview listam as sessoes lendo a tabela
+-- public.user_sessions direto (filtro is_active=true). Essa tabela e um INVENTARIO do
+-- cliente: linha sem auth.sessions correspondente (sessao Auth revogada/limpa) continua
+-- com is_active=true e aparece como "dispositivo conectado" para sempre -- as 13 linhas
+-- orfas medidas. Pior: nao ha como saber QUAL linha e' a sessao de agora (o JWT nao e'
+-- lido), entao o cartao "Sessao atual" nao consegue se identificar.

+--  1. public.my_active_sessions(): devolve SO as sessoes vivas do PROPRIO chamador
+--     (us.user_id = auth.uid()), casando public.user_sessions com auth.sessions por

+--     (mesmo criterio da V3). Uma feature flag nao pode montar isso: a decisao depende
+--     do auth.uid() e do JWT do chamador, que so o banco ve com seguranca.
+--  2. public.expire_orphan_user_sessions() + job diario do pg_cron: marca is_active=false
+--     nas linhas sem auth.sessions viva. NAO apaga nada -- so expira. Idempotente (a
+--     2a execucao devolve 0). Roda o saneamento das orfas ja existentes no fim do arquivo.
+--
+-- Semantica de "viva" (mesma nos dois objetos): auth_session_id nao nulo, existe
+-- auth.sessions com o MESMO id e o MESMO user_id, e a sessao Auth ainda nao passou do
+-- not_after. Nao uso expires_at de user_sessions para expirar: o DEFAULT dessa coluna e'
+-- now()+24h, entao expirar por ela mataria sessao legitima de quem fica logado >24h.
+
+-- 1) RPC do chamador: so as sessoes vivas DELE, com o marcador de sessao atual.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_active_sessions()
+RETURNS TABLE (
+  id uuid,
+  device_id uuid,
+  ip_address text,
+  user_agent text,
+  started_at timestamptz,
+  last_activity_at timestamptz,
+  auth_session_id uuid,
+  is_current boolean
+)
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+  SELECT
+    us.id,
+    us.device_id,
+    us.ip_address,
+    us.user_agent,
+    us.started_at,
+    us.last_activity_at,
+    us.auth_session_id,
+    COALESCE(
+      us.auth_session_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND us.auth_session_id = NULLIF(
+              COALESCE(
+                NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.session_id', true), ''),
+                current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb ->> 'session_id'
+              ), ''
+            )::uuid,
+      false
+    ) AS is_current
+  FROM public.user_sessions AS us
+  JOIN auth.sessions AS s
+    ON s.id = us.auth_session_id
+   AND s.user_id = us.user_id
+   AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after > now())
+  WHERE us.user_id = auth.uid()
+    AND us.is_active IS TRUE
+  ORDER BY us.last_activity_at DESC NULLS LAST;
+$function$;
+
+-- ACL: PUBLIC e anon nao podem nem chamar (anon recebe 42501). Como a funcao depende de
+-- auth.uid() e do JWT do chamador, quem executa precisa ser authenticated.
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.my_active_sessions() FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.my_active_sessions() FROM anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.my_active_sessions() TO authenticated;
+
+-- 2) Limpeza: expira (nao apaga) as sessoes sem auth.sessions viva. Reexecutavel.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_orphan_user_sessions()
+RETURNS integer
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_marcadas integer;
+BEGIN
+  UPDATE public.user_sessions AS us
+     SET is_active = false,
+         ended_at = COALESCE(us.ended_at, now())
+   WHERE us.is_active IS TRUE
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+           SELECT 1
+             FROM auth.sessions AS s
+            WHERE s.id = us.auth_session_id
+              AND s.user_id = us.user_id
+              AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after > now())
+         );
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_marcadas = ROW_COUNT;
+  RETURN v_marcadas;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- A limpeza e' server-side (pg_cron roda como postgres dono do job): nao abre EXECUTE
+-- para authenticated nem anon. service_role fica com EXECUTE para reuso em operacao.
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.expire_orphan_user_sessions() FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.expire_orphan_user_sessions() FROM anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.expire_orphan_user_sessions() TO service_role;
+
+-- 3) Job diario (03:23 evita a fila de vacuum/limpezas das 03:12/03:42). Idempotente:
+-- se ja existe, nao recria nem duplica.
+SELECT cron.schedule(
+  'expire-orphan-user-sessions',
+  '23 3 * * *',
+  $cron$SELECT public.expire_orphan_user_sessions();$cron$
+)
+WHERE NOT EXISTS (
+  SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'expire-orphan-user-sessions'
+);
+
+-- 4) Saneamento unico das orfas ja existentes (as 13 medidas). Reexecutar nao muda nada.
+SELECT public.expire_orphan_user_sessions() AS orfas_expiradas;
