+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.score_security_acl()
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_tipos text[] := ARRAY[
+    'SECDEF_ANON_EXECUTE', 'SECDEF_SEM_SEARCH_PATH', 'TABELA_SEM_RLS',
+    'POLICY_ESCRITA_LIBERADA', 'BUCKET_PUBLICO'
+  ];
+  v_novos int := 0;
+  v_resolvidos int := 0;
+BEGIN
+  -- Achados desta rodada (temp, some no fim da transa√ß√£o).
+  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp._acl_achados;
+  CREATE TEMP TABLE _acl_achados (
+    alert_type  text,
+    object_name text,
+    role_name   text,
+    privilege   text,
+    severity    text,
+    details     jsonb
+  ) ON COMMIT DROP;
+
+  -- 1. SECURITY DEFINER em public com EXECUTE para anon/PUBLIC.
+  INSERT INTO _acl_achados
+  SELECT 'SECDEF_ANON_EXECUTE',
+         p.oid::regprocedure::text,
+         CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE r.rolname END,
+         'EXECUTE', 'CRITICAL',
+         jsonb_build_object('tipo', 'funcao_security_definer', 'schema', n.nspname)
+  FROM pg_proc p
+  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+  CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a
+  LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = a.grantee
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND p.prosecdef
+    AND p.prokind = 'f'
+    AND a.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE'
+    AND (a.grantee = 0 OR r.rolname = 'anon');
+
+  -- 2. SECURITY DEFINER sem search_path fixo.
+  INSERT INTO _acl_achados
+  SELECT 'SECDEF_SEM_SEARCH_PATH',
+         p.oid::regprocedure::text, '-', '-', 'HIGH',
+         jsonb_build_object('tipo', 'funcao_security_definer', 'schema', n.nspname)
+  FROM pg_proc p
+  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND p.prosecdef
+    AND p.prokind = 'f'
+    AND NOT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM unnest(coalesce(p.proconfig, '{}'::text[])) c
+      WHERE c LIKE 'search_path=%'
+    );
+
+  -- 3. Tabela comum (n√£o de extens√£o) sem RLS.
+  INSERT INTO _acl_achados
+  SELECT 'TABELA_SEM_RLS',
+         n.nspname || '.' || c.relname, '-', '-', 'CRITICAL',
+         jsonb_build_object('tipo', 'tabela', 'schema', n.nspname)
+  FROM pg_class c
+  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+    AND c.relkind = 'r'
+    AND NOT c.relrowsecurity
+    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.objid = c.oid AND d.deptype = 'e');
+
+  -- 4. Policy de ESCRITA permissiva (USING(true) / WITH CHECK(true)) p/ authenticated.
+  INSERT INTO _acl_achados
+  SELECT 'POLICY_ESCRITA_LIBERADA',
+         pp.schemaname || '.' || pp.tablename || ' [' || pp.cmd || ']',
+         'authenticated', pp.cmd, 'HIGH',
+         jsonb_build_object(
+           'tipo', 'policy', 'policy', pp.policyname,
+           'forma', CASE WHEN coalesce(pp.qual, '') ~* '^\s*true\s*$'
+                         THEN 'USING(true)' ELSE 'WITH CHECK(true)' END
+         )
+  FROM pg_policies pp
+  WHERE pp.schemaname = 'public'
+    AND pp.cmd IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'ALL')
+    AND pg_catalog.array_position(pp.roles, 'authenticated') IS NOT NULL
+    AND (coalesce(pp.qual, '') ~* '^\s*true\s*$' OR coalesce(pp.with_check, '') ~* '^\s*true\s*$');
+
+  -- 5. Bucket de storage p√∫blico (list√°vel por anon). Din√¢mico: o schema
+  --    storage pode n√£o existir em banco de teste.
+  IF to_regclass('storage.buckets') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    EXECUTE $q$
+      INSERT INTO _acl_achados
+      SELECT 'BUCKET_PUBLICO', b.name, 'anon', 'READ', 'HIGH',
+             jsonb_build_object('tipo', 'bucket', 'bucket_id', b.id)
+      FROM storage.buckets b
+      WHERE b.public IS TRUE
+    $q$;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Grava s√≥ o que ainda n√£o est√° aberto (n√£o repete alerta aberto).
+  INSERT INTO public.security_acl_alerts (alert_type, object_name, role_name, privilege, severity, details)
+  SELECT DISTINCT ON (alert_type, object_name, role_name, privilege)
+         alert_type, object_name, role_name, privilege, severity, details
+  FROM _acl_achados
+  ORDER BY alert_type, object_name, role_name, privilege, severity
+  ON CONFLICT (alert_type, object_name, role_name, privilege) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
+  DO NOTHING;
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_novos = ROW_COUNT;
+
+  -- Resolve o que voltou ao normal (n√£o est√° mais nos achados).
+  UPDATE public.security_acl_alerts a
+     SET resolved_at = now(),
+         resolved_by = 'score_security_acl'
+   WHERE a.resolved_at IS NULL
+     AND a.alert_type = ANY (v_tipos)
+     AND NOT EXISTS (
+       SELECT 1 FROM _acl_achados f
+       WHERE f.alert_type = a.alert_type
+         AND f.object_name = a.object_name
+         AND f.role_name = a.role_name
+         AND f.privilege = a.privilege
+     );
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_resolvidos = ROW_COUNT;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'achados', (SELECT count(*) FROM _acl_achados),
+    'novos', v_novos,
+    'resolvidos', v_resolvidos,
+    'abertos', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.security_acl_alerts WHERE resolved_at IS NULL),
+    'criticos_abertos', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.security_acl_alerts WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND severity = 'CRITICAL'),
+    'executado_em', now()
+  );
+END
+$fn$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.score_security_acl() FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.score_security_acl() FROM anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.score_security_acl() TO service_role;
+

+SELECT cron.unschedule(jobid)
+FROM cron.job
+WHERE jobname = 'security-acl-score';

+-- admin_inbox_silence
+-- Rollback: remove a RPC public.admin_inbox_silence(), o indice idx_messages_sender_created_at, a restricao global_settings_inbox_silence_minutes_range e a chave inbox_silence_minutes; o painel de silencio da caixa de entrada volta a nao existir.

+--   drop function if exists public.admin_inbox_silence();
+--   drop index if exists public.idx_messages_sender_created_at;
+--   alter table public.global_settings drop constraint if exists global_settings_inbox_silence_minutes_range;
+--   delete from public.global_settings where key = 'inbox_silence_minutes';
+--
+-- R2-ADM-0xx (P1, painel/admin): nao existe nenhuma lista de silencio da ingestao.
+-- Quando o webhook para de entregar mensagem (conexao caida, ingestao travada,
+-- instancia deslogada), o admin so descobre pelo cliente reclamando: o painel de
+-- monitoramento mostra taxa de entrega das SAIDAS, nao a AUSENCIA de ENTRADAS.
+--
+-- Esta migration entrega a UNICA peca que o front precisa do banco para o painel
+-- decidir. O front (src/) calcula o aviso "uma vez por episodio" e desenha a tela;
+-- aqui nao ha estado de aviso nem escrita ‚Äî a RPC e somente leitura.
+--
+-- A RPC devolve, POR CONEXAO (whatsapp_connections):
+--   received_5m / received_1h / received_24h -> quantas mensagens RECEBIDAS a
+--     conexao teve em cada janela. "Recebida" e a direcao canonica do projeto:
+--     sender = 'contact' (mesmo predicado de get_inbox_contact_summaries e do
+--     buildConversation do cliente). Todo o resto (agente, bot, sistema) e saida.
+--   last_inbound_at / last_outbound_at -> carimbo da ULTIMA mensagem recebida e
+--     da ultima enviada, sem janela (quando foi a ultima vez).
+--   silence_minutes -> o limiar configurado (abaixo), o mesmo para todas as linhas.
+--   is_silent -> true quando a conexao nao tem mensagem recebida alguma, ou a
+--     ultima recebida e mais antiga que o limiar. Nao olha o status da conexao de
+--     proposito: uma conexao 'disconnected' que continua silenciosa aparece como
+--     silenciosa, e o front decide o que mostrar.
+--   top_conversations -> ate 10 contatos mais ativos da conexao nas ultimas 24h
+--     ({contact_id, contact_name, received, last_at}); so nome de contato, sem
+--     telefone, sem texto de mensagem.
+--
+-- Nada de PII nova nem log: nao devolve phone_number da conexao, token nem
+-- conteudo de mensagem. A RPC so roda para admin/supervisor (RAISE 42501 para o
+-- resto) e o EXECUTE e concedido so a authenticated e service_role.
+--
+-- Limiar configuravel: a chave global_settings.inbox_silence_minutes (padrao 10,
+-- inteiro de 1 a 1440 minutos). A escrita ja e limitada a admin pela RLS
+-- existente de global_settings ("Admins can manage global settings", Gate 16);
+-- aqui entra so a restricao de FAIXA, que a RLS nao da.
+--
+-- Performance (medido): messages nao tem indice por (direcao, created_at). O mais
+-- proximo e idx_messages_read_sender (is_read, sender) e idx_messages_created_at
+-- (so created_at); nenhum cobre "sender = 'contact' no intervalo de created_at".
+-- O painel chama esta RPC em intervalo curto, entao o indice entra agora.
+-- Convencao do projeto: sem CONCURRENTLY (a migration roda em transacao unica).
+--
+-- Natureza: aditiva e idempotente. Nao altera dado existente nem objeto com dado.
+
+create index if not exists idx_messages_sender_created_at
+  on public.messages (sender, created_at desc);

+  'inbox_silence_minutes',

+create or replace function public.admin_inbox_silence()
+returns table (
+  connection_id uuid,
+  connection_name text,
+  connection_status text,
+  received_5m bigint,
+  received_1h bigint,
+  received_24h bigint,
+  last_inbound_at timestamptz,
+  last_outbound_at timestamptz,
+  silence_minutes integer,
+  is_silent boolean,
+  top_conversations jsonb
+)
+language plpgsql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $f$
+declare
+  v_minutos integer;
+  v_agora   timestamptz := now();
+begin
+  if not public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) then
+    raise exception 'not_authorized' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Le o limiar sem nunca estourar: valor fora do padrao cai no 10, e o clamp
+  -- repete a faixa do CHECK (defesa em profundidade).
+  select coalesce(max(case when value ~ '^[0-9]{1,4}$' then value::integer end), 10)
+    into v_minutos
+    from public.global_settings
+   where key = 'inbox_silence_minutes';
+  v_minutos := greatest(1, least(coalesce(v_minutos, 10), 1440));
+
+  return query
+  with recebidas as (
+    select m.whatsapp_connection_id as cid,
+           count(*) filter (where m.created_at >= v_agora - interval '5 minutes')::bigint as r5m,
+           count(*) filter (where m.created_at >= v_agora - interval '1 hour')::bigint as r1h,
+           count(*)::bigint as r24h
+      from public.messages m
+     where m.sender = 'contact'
+       and m.created_at >= v_agora - interval '24 hours'
+     group by m.whatsapp_connection_id
+  ),
+  entradas as (
+    select distinct on (m.whatsapp_connection_id)
+           m.whatsapp_connection_id as cid,
+           m.created_at as ultima_entrada
+      from public.messages m
+     where m.sender = 'contact'
+     order by m.whatsapp_connection_id, m.created_at desc
+  ),
+  saidas as (
+    select distinct on (m.whatsapp_connection_id)
+           m.whatsapp_connection_id as cid,
+           m.created_at as ultima_saida
+      from public.messages m
+     where m.sender <> 'contact'
+     order by m.whatsapp_connection_id, m.created_at desc
+  ),
+  ativas as (
+    select z.cid,
+           jsonb_agg(
+             jsonb_build_object(
+               'contact_id', z.contact_id,
+               'contact_name', z.contact_name,
+               'received', z.recebidas,
+               'last_at', z.ultima
+             )
+             order by z.recebidas desc, z.ultima desc
+           ) as top_conversations
+      from (
+        select m.whatsapp_connection_id as cid,
+               m.contact_id,
+               ct.name as contact_name,
+               count(*)::bigint as recebidas,
+               max(m.created_at) as ultima,
+               row_number() over (
+                 partition by m.whatsapp_connection_id
+                 order by count(*) desc, max(m.created_at) desc
+               ) as rn
+          from public.messages m
+          left join public.contacts ct on ct.id = m.contact_id
+         where m.sender = 'contact'
+           and m.contact_id is not null
+           and m.created_at >= v_agora - interval '24 hours'
+         group by m.whatsapp_connection_id, m.contact_id, ct.name
+      ) z
+     where z.rn <= 10
+     group by z.cid
+  )
+  select c.id,
+         c.name,
+         c.status,
+         coalesce(r.r5m, 0)::bigint,
+         coalesce(r.r1h, 0)::bigint,
+         coalesce(r.r24h, 0)::bigint,
+         e.ultima_entrada,
+         s.ultima_saida,
+         v_minutos,
+         (e.ultima_entrada is null
+            or e.ultima_entrada < v_agora - make_interval(mins => v_minutos)),
+         coalesce(a.top_conversations, '[]'::jsonb)
+    from public.whatsapp_connections c
+    left join recebidas r on r.cid = c.id
+    left join entradas  e on e.cid = c.id
+    left join saidas    s on s.cid = c.id
+    left join ativas    a on a.cid = c.id
+   order by c.name nulls last, c.id;
+end;
+$f$;
+
+revoke all on function public.admin_inbox_silence() from public;
+revoke execute on function public.admin_inbox_silence() from anon;
+grant execute on function public.admin_inbox_silence() to authenticated, service_role;

+-- voip_profile_credentials ‚Äî credencial SIP por atendente (ramal + senha no Vault)
+-- Rollback: dropa as duas RPCs novas e a tabela nova (nada mais √© tocado; a migration √© aditiva e n√£o cria segredo algum no Vault em tempo de aplica√ß√£o).
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.set_voip_profile_credentials(uuid, text, text);
+--   drop function if exists public.get_voip_profile_credentials(uuid);
+--   drop table if exists public.voip_profile_credentials;
+--
+-- Problema (achado conferido no c√≥digo da branch viva em 12/10/2026):
+--   a Edge `get-sip-password` devolve a MESMA senha (`SIP_PASSWORD`) e a MESMA linha
+--   (`phone1`, host fixo no c√≥digo) a todo perfil ativo. Duas sess√µes com o mesmo ramal se
+--   derrubam e a chamada n√£o se atribui a quem ligou. A V3 tem `zapp.voip_profile_credentials`
+--   (migration 20260817260012, refer√™ncia ‚Äî N√ÉO copiemos o defeito dela: l√° a senha mora em
+--   coluna comum `sip_password`).
+--
+-- Solu√ß√£o (V2): tabela `public.voip_profile_credentials` com UMA credencial por atendente
+--   (UNIQUE por profile e por ramal), guardando S√ì o ramal e a refer√™ncia do segredo no
+--   Supabase Vault (`vault_secret_id`). A senha SIP nunca √© gravada em coluna comum: fica
+--   cifrada no Vault e s√≥ √© decifrada dentro de RPC SECURITY DEFINER.
+--
+-- Seguran√ßa (o que este arquivo garante):
+--   * RLS LIGADA (defesa em profundidade) e REVOKE ALL de PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role:
+--     n√£o existe nenhum caminho de tabela pelo PostgREST (nem com service_role).
+--   * Leitura (`get_voip_profile_credentials`): s√≥ `service_role` (a Edge). Devolve ramal + senha
+--     decifrada, e ZERO linhas tanto para "perfil sem credencial" quanto para "perfil inexistente"
+--     (sem or√°culo de exist√™ncia).
+--   * Provisionamento (`set_voip_profile_credentials`): RPC administrativa, s√≥ admin/supervisor
+--     (authenticated) ou service_role. Cria/rotaciona o segredo no Vault e faz o upsert da linha
+--     numa √∫nica opera√ß√£o at√¥mica (fail = nada aplicado).
+--   * Um ramal pertence a um √∫nico atendente (√≠ndice √∫nico em lower(ramal)): √© a trava de dados
+--     que impede o "duas sess√µes com o mesmo ramal se derrubam".
+--   * Nenhum objeto existente √© criado, alterado ou tem ACL tocada.
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 1. Tabela ‚Äî uma credencial por atendente; a senha N√ÉO mora aqui
+-- ============================================================================
+create table if not exists public.voip_profile_credentials (
+  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
+  profile_id      uuid not null unique references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
+  ramal           text not null check (ramal ~ '^[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z._@+-]{0,63}$'),
+  vault_secret_id uuid not null,
+  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
+  updated_at      timestamptz not null default now()
+);
+
+comment on table public.voip_profile_credentials is
+  'Credencial SIP/VoIP por atendente. Guarda o ramal e a refer√™ncia do segredo no Vault (vault_secret_id); a senha SIP nunca √© gravada em coluna comum. Sem GRANT ao PostgREST ‚Äî leitura s√≥ pela RPC SECURITY DEFINER chamada pela Edge com service_role.';
+comment on column public.voip_profile_credentials.ramal is
+  'Ramal/usu√°rio SIP do atendente. √önico sem diferenciar mai√∫sculas/min√∫sculas: um ramal pertence a um √∫nico atendente.';
+comment on column public.voip_profile_credentials.vault_secret_id is
+  'id do segredo em vault.secrets. A senha √© decifrada apenas dentro das RPCs SECURITY DEFINER deste arquivo.';
+
+-- um ramal = no m√°ximo um atendente (case-insensitive)
+create unique index if not exists voip_profile_credentials_ramal_lower_key
+  on public.voip_profile_credentials (lower(ramal));
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 2. RLS ligada (defesa em profundidade ‚Äî deny-all: n√£o h√° policy)
+-- ============================================================================
+alter table public.voip_profile_credentials enable row level security;
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 3. ACL ‚Äî nenhum acesso de tabela pelo PostgREST
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Sem GRANT de tabela para ningu√©m (inclui service_role): o √∫nico caminho de leitura √© a RPC.
+revoke all on table public.voip_profile_credentials
+  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- updated_at ‚Äî padr√£o da casa
+drop trigger if exists trg_voip_profile_credentials_updated_at
+  on public.voip_profile_credentials;
+create trigger trg_voip_profile_credentials_updated_at
+  before update on public.voip_profile_credentials
+  for each row execute function public.update_updated_at_column();
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 4. Leitura ‚Äî s√≥ a Edge (service_role): ramal + senha decifrada do Vault
+-- ============================================================================
+create or replace function public.get_voip_profile_credentials(p_profile_id uuid)
+returns table (ramal text, sip_password text)
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, vault, pg_temp
+as $fn$
+declare
+  v_secret_id uuid;
+begin
+  if coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' then
+    raise exception 'service_role_required' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  if p_profile_id is null then
+    raise exception 'invalid_profile_id' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  select c.vault_secret_id into v_secret_id
+  from public.voip_profile_credentials c
+  where c.profile_id = p_profile_id;
+
+  -- mesma resposta (zero linhas) para perfil sem credencial e para perfil inexistente.
+  if v_secret_id is null then
+    return;
+  end if;
+
+  return query
+    select c.ramal, d.decrypted_secret
+    from public.voip_profile_credentials c
+    join vault.decrypted_secrets d on d.id = c.vault_secret_id
+    where c.profile_id = p_profile_id;
+end;
+$fn$;
+
+revoke all on function public.get_voip_profile_credentials(uuid)
+  from public, anon, authenticated;
+grant execute on function public.get_voip_profile_credentials(uuid) to service_role;
+
+-- ============================================================================
+-- 5. Provisionamento ‚Äî RPC administrativa (admin/supervisor ou service_role)
+-- ============================================================================
+create or replace function public.set_voip_profile_credentials(
+  p_profile_id uuid,
+  p_ramal text,
+  p_sip_password text
+)
+returns uuid
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, vault, pg_temp
+as $fn$
+declare
+  v_secret_id uuid;
+  v_cred_id   uuid;
+begin
+  -- Autoriza√ß√£o: a Edge (service_role) ou um admin/supervisor autenticado.
+  if not (
+    coalesce(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role'
+    or public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
+  ) then
+    raise exception 'not_authorized' using errcode = '42501';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Valida TUDO antes de tocar qualquer coisa (fail = nada aplicado).
+  if p_profile_id is null then
+    raise exception 'invalid_profile_id' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  if p_ramal is null or p_ramal !~ '^[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z._@+-]{0,63}$' then
+    raise exception 'invalid_ramal' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  if p_sip_password is null or char_length(p_sip_password) not between 1 and 256 then
+    raise exception 'invalid_sip_password' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  if not exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = p_profile_id) then
+    raise exception 'profile_not_found' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  if exists (
+    select 1 from public.voip_profile_credentials c
+    where lower(c.ramal) = lower(p_ramal) and c.profile_id <> p_profile_id
+  ) then
+    raise exception 'ramal_em_uso' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Serializa provisionamentos do MESMO perfil (corrida n√£o gera dois segredos √≥rf√£os).
+  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(
+    hashtextextended('voip_profile_credentials:' || p_profile_id::text, 0)
+  );
+
+  select c.vault_secret_id into v_secret_id
+  from public.voip_profile_credentials c
+  where c.profile_id = p_profile_id
+  for update;

+  if v_secret_id is null then
+    v_secret_id := vault.create_secret(
+      p_sip_password,
+      'voip_sip_password:' || p_profile_id::text
+    );
+  else
+    perform vault.update_secret(v_secret_id, p_sip_password);
+  end if;
+
+  insert into public.voip_profile_credentials as c (profile_id, ramal, vault_secret_id)
+  values (p_profile_id, p_ramal, v_secret_id)
+  on conflict (profile_id) do update
+    set ramal           = excluded.ramal,
+        vault_secret_id = excluded.vault_secret_id,
+        updated_at      = now()
+  returning c.id into v_cred_id;
+
+  return v_cred_id;
+end;
+$fn$;

+-- contacts_stats_series
+-- Rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.contacts_stats_series(boolean);
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.contacts_stats_series(boolean);
+--
+-- CT-E / PB-30 (paridade V3 -> V2): s√©rie aditiva a `contacts_stats` para o
+-- `useContactsKpi` parar de paginar a tabela `contacts` no navegador. A RPC de
+-- contadores cobre total/e-mail/empresa/status/crescimento/duplicados, mas o
+-- `aggregateKpi` tamb√©m consome `empresasDistinct` e QUATRO s√©ries que alimentam
+-- as sparklines e o card "Empresas". Sem elas o card exibe NaN e as sparklines
+-- somem. Esta fun√ß√£o devolve s√≥ o que falta, com o MESMO predicado de
+-- visibilidade e o MESMO escopo de `contacts_stats` (deleted_at IS NULL +
+-- include_legacy + can_edit_contact(...) com os helpers resolvidos uma vez).
+--
+-- Contrato (jsonb, uma linha) ‚Äî chaves EXATAS do hook:
+--   empresas_distinct              -- count(distinct lower(btrim(company))) n√£o vazio
+--   series_novos_daily_30          -- array de 7 n√∫meros; di√°ria de 30 dias em buckets
+--                                     de 4 dias, EXCETO o 7¬∫ que soma 6 (√≠ndices 24..29).
+--                                     Soma dos 7 = contatos dos √∫ltimos 30 dias.
+--   series_total_cumulative_12w    -- array de 12; cumulativo semanal (√∫ltimo = total)
+--   series_empresas_cumulative_12w -- array de 12; empresas distintas acumuladas (√∫ltimo = empresas_distinct)
+--   series_fornecedores_weekly_12  -- array de 12; contact_type='fornecedor' por semana
+--
+-- Sem√¢ntica de janelas (id√™ntica ao `aggregateKpi`): "now" = now(); dia D atr√°s =
+-- created_at com idade em [D, D+1); 12 semanas = idade em [(11-i)*7, (12-i)*7)
+-- dias, das mais antigas para as mais novas (i=0 a mais antiga, i=11 a mais nova).
+-- O bucket di√°rio i do array de 7 cobre idade em [26-i*4, 30-i*4) para i=0..5 e
+-- [0, 6) para i=6 ‚Äî exatamente os cortes `daily30.slice`/`bucket7` do hook.
+--
+-- `include_legacy boolean DEFAULT false`: mesmo interruptor de `search_contacts` /
+-- `contacts_count_by_type`. Parametrizar sem default criaria ambiguidade no
+-- PostgREST. Entrada inv√°lida: `COALESCE(p_include_legacy, false)` ‚Äî um NULL
+-- expl√≠cito viraria `NULL OR ...` = NULL e esconderia TODOS os contatos.
+--
+-- Escopo: SECURITY DEFINER com a MESMA trava de `contacts_stats`/`search_contacts`
+-- ‚Äî lista de agentes vis√≠veis, profile e flag admin resolvidos UMA vez e passados
+-- a `can_edit_contact` (par√¢metros hoisted, migration 20260929810000) em vez de
+-- chamar os lookups caros por linha. `auth.role() = 'service_role'` (chamador
+-- interno) enxerga tudo.
+--
+-- ACL: fun√ß√µes novas ganham EXECUTE de `anon` por ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES, ent√£o
+-- o REVOKE √© expl√≠cito em PUBLIC e anon; s√≥ authenticated e service_role executam.
+--
+-- Layout: `DECLARE ...; BEGIN` na mesma linha da abertura do bloco (heur√≠stica do
+-- hermes-db-migrar). Sem transa√ß√£o expl√≠cita: uma aplica√ß√£o = uma transa√ß√£o.
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.contacts_stats_series(p_include_legacy boolean DEFAULT false)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$ DECLARE
+  v_visible uuid[];
+  v_profile uuid;
+  v_admin boolean;
+  v_out jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  v_admin := COALESCE(auth.role() = 'service_role', false)
+             OR public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid());
+  v_visible := (SELECT array_agg(v) FROM public.get_visible_agent_ids(auth.uid()) v);
+  v_profile := (SELECT public.get_profile_id_for_user(auth.uid()));
+
+  WITH base AS (
+    SELECT c.company, c.contact_type, now() - c.created_at AS age
+    FROM public.contacts c
+    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
+      AND (COALESCE(p_include_legacy, false)
+           OR (c.is_lid_legacy = false AND c.phone ~ '^[0-9]{10,15}$'))
+      AND public.can_edit_contact(c.assigned_to, c.queue_id, v_visible, v_profile, v_admin)
+  ),
+  empr AS (
+    SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(btrim(company)))::integer AS n
+    FROM base WHERE NULLIF(btrim(company), '') IS NOT NULL
+  ),
+  buckets AS (
+    SELECT i,
+      (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM base b
+        WHERE b.age >= (CASE WHEN i < 6 THEN (26 - i * 4) ELSE 0 END) * interval '1 day'
+          AND b.age <  (CASE WHEN i < 6 THEN (30 - i * 4) ELSE 6 END) * interval '1 day') AS n
+    FROM generate_series(0, 6) i
+  ),
+  total_cum AS (
+    SELECT i,
+      (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM base b
+        WHERE b.age >= (11 - i) * 7 * interval '1 day') AS n
+    FROM generate_series(0, 11) i
+  ),
+  emp_cum AS (
+    SELECT i,
+      (SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(btrim(b.company)))::integer FROM base b
+        WHERE b.age >= (11 - i) * 7 * interval '1 day'
+          AND NULLIF(btrim(b.company), '') IS NOT NULL) AS n
+    FROM generate_series(0, 11) i
+  ),
+  forn_cum AS (
+    SELECT i,
+      (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM base b
+        WHERE b.contact_type = 'fornecedor'
+          AND b.age >= (11 - i) * 7 * interval '1 day'
+          AND b.age <  (12 - i) * 7 * interval '1 day') AS n
+    FROM generate_series(0, 11) i
+  )
+  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+    'empresas_distinct',              empr.n,
+    'series_novos_daily_30',          (SELECT jsonb_agg(b.n ORDER BY b.i) FROM buckets b),
+    'series_total_cumulative_12w',    (SELECT jsonb_agg(t.n ORDER BY t.i) FROM total_cum t),
+    'series_empresas_cumulative_12w', (SELECT jsonb_agg(e.n ORDER BY e.i) FROM emp_cum e),
+    'series_fornecedores_weekly_12',  (SELECT jsonb_agg(f.n ORDER BY f.i) FROM forn_cum f)
+  )
+  INTO v_out
+  FROM empr;
+
+  RETURN v_out;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.contacts_stats_series(boolean) IS
+  'S√©ries e empresas distintas de Contatos (CT-E/PB-30) para o useContactsKpi: empresas_distinct + as 4 s√©ries (novos 30d em buckets de 4/6 dias, total cumulativo 12s, empresas cumulativas 12s, fornecedores por semana). Mesmo escopo de contacts_stats/search_contacts.';
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.contacts_stats_series(boolean) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.contacts_stats_series(boolean) TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- parametros VIVA ao lado (overload) e o caminho do e-mail seguiria aberto; por isso a assinatura
+-- antiga e dropada antes.
+--
+-- Correcao 2 (defeito pre-existente encontrado na prova, mesma funcao): o corpo herdado apontava
+-- para profiles.display_name, coluna que NAO existe (o schema real tem profiles.name, text NOT
+-- NULL ‚Äî conferido em supabase/schema-catalog.json e no banco local reaplicado), e jogava
+-- p_birthday TEXT direto em profiles.birthday DATE. Ou seja, a funcao estourava 42703 em qualquer
+-- chamada e nao era um caminho de escrita vivo. Sem acertar isso, a assinatura nova nao teria como
+-- ser exercitada em schema real e a prova viraria ficcao. Mapeamento p_display_name -> name segue o
+-- resto do projeto (get_identity_matrix devolve p.name AS display_name; a UI le profiles.name).
+--
+-- Nenhum outro campo muda: avatar_url, phone, signature e updated_at seguem como antes, a funcao
+-- continua mexendo so na linha do proprio auth.uid() e segue SECURITY DEFINER com search_path fixo.
+--
+-- Unica chamadora hoje e o hook src/hooks/auth/useSecureProfile.ts (exportado, sem uso em tela);
+-- o parametro sai junto com a tipagem do RPC. Nada em Edge Function ou trigger chama esta funcao.
+
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.update_own_profile(text, text, text, text, text, text);
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_own_profile(
+  p_display_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_avatar_url TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_phone TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_signature TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
+  p_birthday TEXT DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS BOOLEAN
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile_id UUID;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT id INTO v_profile_id FROM profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid();
+  IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN FALSE;
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE profiles SET
+    name = COALESCE(p_display_name, name),
+    avatar_url = COALESCE(p_avatar_url, avatar_url),
+    phone = COALESCE(p_phone, phone),
+    signature = COALESCE(p_signature, signature),
+    birthday = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_birthday, '')::date, birthday),
+    updated_at = now()
+  WHERE id = v_profile_id;
+
+  RETURN TRUE;
+END;
+$$;

+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.update_own_profile(text, text, text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;

+-- agent_workload
+-- Rollback: a fun√ß√£o √© nova e s√≥ existe por causa desta migration (√© o √∫nico objeto que
+--   ela cria; nenhum dado, policy, GRANT de outro objeto ou trigger √© tocado). O DROP
+--   abaixo devolve o banco ao estado anterior e o painel /agentes volta a usar as
+--   consultas dos hooks (useAgents/useAgentPendingCounts/useAgentRecentSends).
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.agent_workload();
+
+-- R2-MOD-*/3¬™ passada da auditoria V3 -> V2 (docs/estado/05-features-admin.md):
+-- carga por atendente agregada no SERVIDOR.
+--
+-- PROBLEMA: o painel /agentes montava a carga de cada atendente no navegador baixando
+-- linhas cruas: `useAgents.ts` puxava TODOS os contatos com `assigned_to` n√£o nulo
+-- (via fetchAllRows), `useAgentPendingCounts.ts` puxava TODOS os contatos em `waiting`
+-- e `useAgentRecentSends.ts` puxava TODAS as mensagens de agente dos √∫ltimos 30 dias s√≥
+-- para achar o `MAX(created_at)` por atendente ‚Äî milhares de linhas trafegadas para
+-- calcular tr√™s contagens.
+--
+-- ENTREGA (s√≥ este problema): a RPC `agent_workload()` devolve, POR PERFIL, os tr√™s
+-- n√∫meros que os hooks calculam hoje:
+--   open_chats    = contatos com `assigned_to` = perfil, `conversation_status = 'open'`
+--                   e n√£o exclu√≠dos (`deleted_at IS NULL`);
+--   waiting_chats = idem, com `conversation_status = 'waiting'`;
+--   last_send_at  = `MAX(created_at)` das mensagens com `sender = 'agent'` e
+--                   `agent_id` = perfil dentro da MESMA janela de 30 dias do hook
+--                   (`RECENT_SENDS_WINDOW_DAYS`), NULL quando n√£o houve envio na janela.
+-- A r√©gua √© copiada linha a linha dos hooks atuais (mesmos filtros, mesmo estado de espera
+-- persistido), ent√£o os n√∫meros coincidem ‚Äî n√£o √© uma segunda defini√ß√£o de "carga".
+--
+-- Autoriza√ß√£o: SECURITY DEFINER (a agrega√ß√£o l√™ contatos e mensagens de TODA a equipe, o
+-- que a RLS de leitura por atendente barraria para um supervisor). O acesso √© restrito a
+-- admin/supervisor pelo MESMO predicado das outras RPCs de painel
+-- (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())); agente comum √© NEGADO com
+-- `insufficient_privilege` (n√£o devolve conjunto vazio ‚Äî o painel de equipe √© s√≥ de staff).
+-- service_role (chamada interna de Edge) passa, como nas demais RPCs de painel.
+
+create or replace function public.agent_workload()
+returns table (
+  profile_id uuid,
+  open_chats integer,
+  waiting_chats integer,
+  last_send_at timestamptz
+)
+language plpgsql
+stable
+security definer
+set search_path to 'public', 'pg_temp'
+as $function$
+declare
+  v_jwt_role text;
+  v_since timestamptz;
+begin
+  v_jwt_role := coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role', '');
+
+  if v_jwt_role <> 'service_role'
+     and coalesce(public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()), false) is not true then
+    raise exception 'agent_workload: acesso restrito a admin ou supervisor'
+      using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege';
+  end if;
+
+  -- Mesma janela de 30 dias de RECENT_SENDS_WINDOW_DAYS (useAgentRecentSends.ts).
+  v_since := now() - interval '30 days';
+
+  return query
+  with open_counts as (
+    select c.assigned_to as profile_id, count(*)::integer as total
+      from public.contacts c
+     where c.assigned_to is not null
+       and c.conversation_status = 'open'
+       and c.deleted_at is null
+     group by c.assigned_to
+  ),
+  waiting_counts as (
+    select c.assigned_to as profile_id, count(*)::integer as total
+      from public.contacts c
+     where c.assigned_to is not null
+       and c.conversation_status = 'waiting'
+       and c.deleted_at is null
+     group by c.assigned_to
+  ),
+  last_sends as (
+    select m.agent_id as profile_id, max(m.created_at) as last_send_at
+      from public.messages m
+     where m.sender = 'agent'
+       and m.agent_id is not null
+       and m.created_at >= v_since
+     group by m.agent_id
+  )
+  select p.id as profile_id,
+         coalesce(o.total, 0) as open_chats,
+         coalesce(w.total, 0) as waiting_chats,
+         l.last_send_at as last_send_at
+    from public.profiles p
+    left join open_counts o on o.profile_id = p.id
+    left join waiting_counts w on w.profile_id = p.id
+    left join last_sends l on l.profile_id = p.id
+   order by p.id;
+end;
+$function$;
+
+revoke all on function public.agent_workload() from public, anon;
+grant execute on function public.agent_workload() to authenticated, service_role;
+
+comment on function public.agent_workload() is
+  'Carga por atendente agregada no servidor (3¬™ passada admin): por perfil devolve open_chats (contacts.conversation_status=open, assigned_to=perfil, deleted_at IS NULL), waiting_chats (idem waiting) e last_send_at (MAX(messages.created_at) com sender=agent e agent_id=perfil nos √∫ltimos 30 dias). SECURITY DEFINER, s√≥ admin/supervisor (agente comum recebe insufficient_privilege) ‚Äî mesmos filtros dos hooks useAgents/useAgentPendingCounts/useAgentRecentSends.';

+--   grant execute on function public.ingest_inbound_message(uuid, text, text, text, text, text, text, timestamptz) to service_role;
+--
+-- ADR-005 ¬ß3: mensagem inbound do contato reabre a conversa (resolved|archived -> open).
+-- O corpo vigente de public.ingest_inbound_message (migration 20260905070000) nao tocava
+-- contacts.conversation_status: em resolved e em archived a mensagem entrava mas o status
+-- continuava fechado, e a conversa sumia da fila. Esta migration adiciona AO FINAL do corpo
+-- vigente, preservado integralmente, um bloco que:
+--  - age SO na insercao real da mensagem (v_outcome = 'inserted'); redelivery fica em
+--  'updated' e repeticao do mesmo external_id em 'duplicate', e nenhum dos dois reabre;
+--  - so com a flag public.feature_flags 'inbox.status-fsm' habilitada (enabled = true);
+--  - faz UPDATE de resolved|archived -> open; conversa ja 'open' nao entra no WHERE, entao
+--  conversation_status_changed_at fica intacto;
+--  - respeita o gatilho public.enforce_conversation_status_transition (resolved->open e
+--  archived->open sao transicoes validas);
+--  - NAO mexe em assigned_to: a conversa reaberta volta para o mesmo responsavel.
+-- A assinatura, o retorno (outcome) e o SET search_path = public sao os MESMOS; o REVOKE e o
+-- GRANT da assinatura sao reemitidos no fim para nao depender da ACL herdada.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ingest_inbound_message(p_connection_id uuid, p_phone text, p_push_name text, p_content text, p_message_type text, p_media_url text, p_external_id text, p_created_at timestamptz)
+ RETURNS TABLE(contact_id uuid, contact_name text, assigned_to uuid, avatar_url text, contact_created boolean, message_id uuid, outcome text)
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_variants text[] := public.phone_variants(p_phone);
+  v_clean text := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g');
+  v_canonical text;
+  v_contact record;
+  v_created boolean := false;
+  v_existing record;
+  v_message_id uuid;
+  v_outcome text;
+  v_status text;
+  v_content text;
+BEGIN
+  -- Forma canonica: BR com 13 digitos e 9o digito vira a forma de 12; o resto fica como esta.
+  v_canonical := CASE
+    WHEN v_clean LIKE '55%' AND length(v_clean) = 13 AND substr(v_clean, 5, 1) = '9'
+      THEN substr(v_clean, 1, 4) || substr(v_clean, 6)
+    ELSE v_clean
+  END;
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('ingest_inbound_message:' || v_canonical));
+
+  SELECT c.id, c.name, c.assigned_to, c.avatar_url INTO v_contact
+  FROM public.contacts c
+  WHERE c.phone = ANY(v_variants) AND c.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id
+  ORDER BY c.created_at
+  LIMIT 1;
+
+  IF v_contact.id IS NULL THEN
+    SELECT c.id, c.name, c.assigned_to, c.avatar_url INTO v_contact
+    FROM public.contacts c
+    WHERE c.phone = ANY(v_variants)
+    ORDER BY c.created_at
+    LIMIT 1;
+
+    IF v_contact.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+      UPDATE public.contacts SET whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id, updated_at = now() WHERE id = v_contact.id;
+    ELSE
+      INSERT INTO public.contacts (phone, name, whatsapp_connection_id)
+      VALUES (p_phone, coalesce(nullif(p_push_name, ''), p_phone), p_connection_id)
+      ON CONFLICT (phone) DO NOTHING
+      RETURNING contacts.id, contacts.name, contacts.assigned_to, contacts.avatar_url INTO v_contact;
+
+      IF v_contact.id IS NULL THEN
+        SELECT c.id, c.name, c.assigned_to, c.avatar_url INTO v_contact
+        FROM public.contacts c
+        WHERE c.phone = ANY(v_variants)
+        ORDER BY c.created_at
+        LIMIT 1;
+        IF v_contact.id IS NULL THEN
+          RAISE EXCEPTION 'ingest_inbound_message: contato % nao encontrado apos conflito', p_phone USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+        END IF;
+        UPDATE public.contacts SET whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id, updated_at = now() WHERE id = v_contact.id;
+      ELSE
+        v_created := true;
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT m.id, m.status, m.content INTO v_existing
+  FROM public.messages m
+  WHERE m.whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id AND m.sender = 'contact' AND m.external_id = p_external_id
+  ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
+  LIMIT 1;
+
+  IF v_existing.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+    v_status := CASE WHEN v_existing.status IS NOT NULL AND v_existing.status <> 'received' THEN v_existing.status ELSE 'received' END;
+    v_content := CASE WHEN v_existing.status = 'deleted' THEN coalesce(v_existing.content, '[Mensagem apagada]') ELSE p_content END;
+    UPDATE public.messages
+    SET contact_id = v_contact.id, whatsapp_connection_id = p_connection_id, content = v_content,
+        message_type = p_message_type, media_url = p_media_url, sender = 'contact',
+        status = v_status
+    WHERE id = v_existing.id;
+    v_message_id := v_existing.id;
+    v_outcome := 'updated';
+  ELSE
+    INSERT INTO public.messages (contact_id, whatsapp_connection_id, content, message_type, media_url, sender, external_id, status, created_at)
+    VALUES (v_contact.id, p_connection_id, p_content, p_message_type, p_media_url, 'contact', p_external_id, 'received', p_created_at)
+    ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_connection_id, external_id, sender) DO NOTHING
+    RETURNING id INTO v_message_id;
+    v_outcome := CASE WHEN v_message_id IS NULL THEN 'duplicate' ELSE 'inserted' END;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ADR-005 ¬ß3: inbound do contato reabre conversa encerrada/arquivada. So quando a mensagem
+  -- entrou de verdade (v_outcome = 'inserted'); redelivery ('updated') e duplicata ('duplicate')
+  -- nao reabrem. So com a flag inbox.status-fsm ligada. resolved->open e archived->open sao
+  -- validas no gatilho FSM. Nao toca assigned_to.
+  IF v_outcome = 'inserted'
+     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.feature_flags WHERE key = 'inbox.status-fsm' AND enabled) THEN
+    UPDATE public.contacts
+       SET conversation_status = 'open',
+           conversation_status_changed_at = now()
+     WHERE id = v_contact.id
+       AND conversation_status IN ('resolved', 'archived');
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_contact.id, v_contact.name, v_contact.assigned_to, v_contact.avatar_url, v_created, v_message_id, v_outcome;
+END;
+$function$;

+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.ingest_inbound_message(uuid, text, text, text, text, text, text, timestamptz) TO service_role;

+--   GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_within_business_hours(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+--
+-- CT-024 / horario comercial (t_d30b49e0): public.is_within_business_hours(uuid)
+-- decidia com `agora >= open_time AND agora <= close_time`. Numa janela que VIRA A
+-- NOITE (open_time > close_time, ex.: 18:00 -> 02:00) essa condicao e impossivel de
+-- satisfazer: a funcao respondia FALSO o dia inteiro ‚Äî o horario de atendimento
+-- configurado nunca abria (nem as 19h, nem a 1h). Alem disso o `<=` tratava o
+-- minuto do close_time como ABERTO.
+--
+-- O QUE MUDA (so o corpo; assinatura, guarda de chamador, SECURITY DEFINER,
+-- search_path e ACL ficam como estao):
+--   1. janela que vira a noite (open_time > close_time): aberta quando
+--      `agora >= open_time` OU `agora < close_time`;
+--   2. janela normal: `agora >= open_time AND agora < close_time` ‚Äî FECHAMENTO
+--      EXCLUSIVO (no minuto do close_time a casa esta fechada);
+--   3. open_time ou close_time NULL: devolve NULL, como antes (comparacao com NULL).
+-- O padrao preservado: sem linha para o dia -> true; is_open = false -> false; dia
+-- que vira a noite e lido na linha do DIA DE HOJE (nao ha busca do dia anterior).
+--
+-- A entrada `connection_id` e um UUID de conexao (o nome do parametro na
+-- assinatura em vigor e `connection_id`, mantido para nao criar overload).
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_within_business_hours(connection_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_current_day INTEGER;
+  v_current_time TIME;
+  v_is_open BOOLEAN;
+  v_open_at TIME;
+  v_close_at TIME;
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT public.secd_caller_ok(NULL, false) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'is_within_business_hours: chamador sem sessao de usuario'
+      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Get current day of week (0=Sunday) and time in Brazil timezone
+  v_current_day := EXTRACT(DOW FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo');
+  v_current_time := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::TIME;
+
+  -- Check business hours for this day
+  SELECT bh.is_open, bh.open_time, bh.close_time
+  INTO v_is_open, v_open_at, v_close_at
+  FROM public.business_hours bh
+  WHERE bh.whatsapp_connection_id = connection_id
+  AND bh.day_of_week = v_current_day;
+
+  -- If no configuration found, assume open (default behavior)
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RETURN true;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- If marked as closed
+  IF NOT v_is_open THEN
+    RETURN false;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Sem janela configurada: comparacao com NULL (comportamento anterior preservado)
+  IF v_open_at IS NULL OR v_close_at IS NULL THEN
+    RETURN NULL;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Janela que vira a noite (ex.: 18:00 -> 02:00): aberta de open_time ate a
+  -- meia-noite OU da meia-noite ate close_time (close_time exclusivo).
+  IF v_open_at > v_close_at THEN
+    RETURN v_current_time >= v_open_at OR v_current_time < v_close_at;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Check if current time is within open hours (close_time exclusivo: no minuto
+  -- do fechamento a casa ja esta fechada)
+  RETURN v_current_time >= v_open_at AND v_current_time < v_close_at;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- ACL explicita (idempotente: e a mesma de 20261007004545; CREATE OR REPLACE
+-- preserva a ACL, este par so garante que ela nao ficou mais aberta).
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_within_business_hours(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_within_business_hours(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

+-- Rollback: recria a funcao de gatilho com o corpo ANTERIOR exato (inclusive a referencia a coluna

+--     CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sanitize_reset_request()
+--      RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public'
+--     AS $function$
+--     BEGIN
+--       IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
+--         NEW.reset_token := NULL;
+--         NEW.token_expires_at := NULL;
+--         NEW.reviewed_by := NULL;

+--   Nenhuma linha de dado foi gravada, alterada ou apagada por esta migration: nao ha dado a desfazer.
+--
+-- R2-AUTH-006 (item 72 / #72c): "Recuperacao anonima consulta profiles protegido e nao cria
+-- solicitacao". A tela /forgot-password (pessoa SEM sessao) montava o pedido no cliente:
+--   1) lia a conta por `profiles` (policies SELECT sao TO authenticated) -> 0 linhas para anon;
+--   2) com a conta "inexistente", mostrava sucesso generico e NUNCA chegava ao INSERT;
+--   3) mesmo chegando, o INSERT nao tinha caminho: a policy de INSERT e TO authenticated com
+--      `user_id = auth.uid()` e o anon nao tem como (nem deve) descobrir o user_id;
+--   4) e o gatilho BEFORE INSERT public.sanitize_reset_request() ainda escrevia em
+--      NEW.reset_token, coluna REMOVIDA em 20260827170000_drop_dead_reset_token_subsystem:
+--      TODO INSERT na tabela morria com `record "new" has no field "reset_token"` (defeito medido
+--      no banco local tambem no caminho authenticated, ver .tmp/exp4.sql).
+-- Resultado: o pedido real nunca era entregue ao administrador.
+--
+-- Correcao (fronteira server-side anonima, sem expor existencia de conta e sem abrir funcao
+-- SECURITY DEFINER para anon ‚Äî o que a guarda scripts/db-audit/check-secdef-public-execute.sql
+-- proibe):
+--   a) public.sanitize_reset_request() deixa de citar a coluna morta reset_token e passa a
+--      resolver a identidade NO SERVIDOR quando nao existe sessao (auth.uid() IS NULL).
+--      O cliente anonimo envia SO email/reason/user_agent; user_id e email canonicos vem de
+--      auth.users. Conta inexistente ou conta com 3 pendentes na ultima hora -> devolve NULL:
+--      nada e gravado e a resposta publica e a mesma (nao enumera emails nem limite). O caminho
+--      authenticated fica identico ao anterior e continua passando pelo rate_limit_reset_requests().
+--   b) policy de INSERT TO anon em public.password_reset_requests: a tabela ja concede INSERT a
+--      anon, faltava a policy. O WITH CHECK so aceita a linha canonica que o gatilho produz
+--      (pedido pendente, sem campos de revisao/token) ‚Äî o gatilho e a fronteira, e o remendo
+--      impede que um INSERT direto se disfarce de pedido ja revisado.
+--   c) REVOKE EXECUTE da funcao de gatilho (regra do repo 20261001191230): gatilho nao confere
+--      EXECUTE do chamador no disparo, entao fechar o privilegio nao afeta o disparo.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sanitize_reset_request()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_user_id uuid;
+  v_canonical_email text;
+  v_pending_count integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
+    -- Caminho autenticado: inalterado (o pedido e sempre do proprio usuario).
+    NEW.token_expires_at := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_by := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_at := NULL;
+    NEW.rejection_reason := NULL;
+    NEW.status := 'pending';
+  ELSE
+    -- Fronteira anonima (/forgot-password): o cliente informa somente o email; a conta e
+    -- resolvida AQUI, no servidor, contra auth.users (fonte do link de reset que o
+    -- administrador gera). Nada de profiles (o email de profiles pode estar nulo/divergente).
+    SELECT u.id, u.email
+      INTO v_user_id, v_canonical_email
+      FROM auth.users u
+     WHERE lower(btrim(u.email)) = lower(btrim(NEW.email))
+     LIMIT 1;
+
+    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
+      -- Conta inexistente: nao persiste e nao revela (mesma resposta publica).
+      RETURN NULL;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT COUNT(*)
+      INTO v_pending_count
+      FROM public.password_reset_requests
+     WHERE user_id = v_user_id
+       AND status = 'pending'
+       AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
+
+    IF v_pending_count >= 3 THEN
+      -- Conta existente, mas limitada: mesmo resultado publico de conta inexistente.
+      RETURN NULL;
+    END IF;
+
+    NEW.user_id := v_user_id;
+    NEW.email := v_canonical_email;
+    NEW.token_expires_at := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_by := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_at := NULL;
+    NEW.rejection_reason := NULL;
+    NEW.status := 'pending';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+-- Gatilho nao e RPC: nao precisa (nem pode) ter EXECUTE para os papeis da API.
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.sanitize_reset_request() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- Caminho anonimo de escrita: a tabela ja concede INSERT a anon; faltava a policy.
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anon can file a password reset request" ON public.password_reset_requests;
+CREATE POLICY "Anon can file a password reset request"
+  ON public.password_reset_requests
+  FOR INSERT
+  TO anon
+  WITH CHECK (
+    user_id IS NOT NULL
+    AND status = 'pending'
+    AND reviewed_by IS NULL
+    AND reviewed_at IS NULL
+    AND rejection_reason IS NULL
+    AND token_expires_at IS NULL
+  );

+-- read when viewing") faz exatamente `.update({ is_read: true }).eq('contact_id', X)
+-- .eq('is_read', false)`, mas a tabela nao tem NENHUMA policy de UPDATE: a policy
+-- "Authenticated users can manage whisper_messages" (FOR ALL) foi DROPada pela
+-- migration 20260317222442, que recriou so INSERT/SELECT/DELETE. Com RLS ligada e
+-- sem policy de UPDATE, o PostgREST devolve 200 com 0 linhas e nenhum erro ‚Äî o
+-- contador de nao lidas (useWhisperCount) fica cravado para sempre.
+--
+-- CORRECAO (so DDL/RLS; nao toca dado, nao mexe em gatilho, nao afrouxa nada)
+-- 1) Policy de UPDATE para o papel authenticated, restrita a QUEM A MENSAGEM E
+--    DIRIGIDA: target_agent_id = public.current_profile_id(). O remetente (que ja
+--    pode LER a propria mensagem pela policy de SELECT) e os demais agentes NAO
+--    entram; nao existe ramo para admin/supervisor (o is_read e leitura pessoal de
+--    quem recebeu).
+-- 2) Recorte de coluna: REVOKE UPDATE na tabela + GRANT UPDATE (is_read) apenas.
+--    Policy RLS nao sabe dizer QUAL COLUNA muda; sem isso o destinatario poderia
+--    reescrever `content`, `sender_id`, `contact_id` ou `created_at` do sussurro
+--    (usando o UPDATE novo como caminho de edicao). Hoje ninguem consegue esse
+--    UPDATE (nao ha policy), entao o REVOKE nao tira de ninguem nada que funcione.
+--    `anon` fica como esta (a policy e TO authenticated; sem policy, o anon segue
+--    barrado pela RLS).
+-- Efeitos colaterais conferidos: nao ha gatilho em public.whisper_messages
+-- (nenhuma coluna updated_at na tabela); a operacao e uma transacao so; a tabela
+-- esta na publicacao supabase_realtime, mas o UPDATE nao muda a visibilidade de
+-- ninguem alem do proprio destinatario (a policy de SELECT continua a mesma).
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can mark own whisper messages as read" ON public.whisper_messages;
+CREATE POLICY "Users can mark own whisper messages as read" ON public.whisper_messages
+  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
+  USING (target_agent_id = public.current_profile_id())
+  WITH CHECK (target_agent_id = public.current_profile_id());
+
+REVOKE UPDATE ON public.whisper_messages FROM authenticated;
+GRANT UPDATE (is_read) ON public.whisper_messages TO authenticated;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- 1. Guarda de identidade: autor preenchido no INSERT, autor e contato imut√°veis
+-- ============================================================================
+create or replace function public.guard_contact_purchase_identity()
+returns trigger
+language plpgsql
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $$
+declare
+  v_uid     uuid := auth.uid();
+  v_profile uuid;
+begin
+  -- Caminho servidor (service_role, cron, psql do dono): sem JWT n√£o h√° autor a
+  -- impor nem a comparar ‚Äî o registro de sistema segue gravando como sempre.
+  if v_uid is null then
+    return new;
+  end if;
+
+  v_profile := public.get_profile_id_for_user(v_uid);
+
+  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
+    if new.created_by is null then
+      if v_profile is null then
+        raise exception 'purchase author cannot be resolved for the current user'
+          using errcode = '42501';
+      end if;
+      new.created_by := v_profile;
+    elsif v_profile is null or new.created_by is distinct from v_profile then
+      raise exception 'purchase cannot be registered on behalf of another user'
+        using errcode = '42501';
+    end if;
+    return new;
+  end if;

+  -- UPDATE direto de uma linha: identidade do registro √© imut√°vel.
+  if new.contact_id is distinct from old.contact_id then
+    raise exception 'purchase contact is immutable'
+      using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  if new.created_by is distinct from old.created_by then
+    raise exception 'purchase author is immutable'
+      using errcode = '23514';
+  end if;
+
+  return new;
+end;
+$$;

+-- ops_metrics_rpc
+-- Rollback: dropa a RPC public.ops_metrics(integer) e seus grants/comentario.
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   revoke all on function public.ops_metrics(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
+--   drop function if exists public.ops_metrics(integer);
+--
+-- Metricas operacionais para o painel de Operacoes (item de banco XPTO):
+-- volume de ENTRADA/SAIDA/FALHA por conexao de WhatsApp e ESPERA (media e p95)
+-- por fila, tudo dentro de uma janela movel de horas.
+--
+-- Somente ADITIVO: cria a funcao public.ops_metrics(p_window_hours integer).
+-- Nao altera tabela, coluna, policy, dado nem grant existente.
+--
+-- Fontes (leituras, sem escrita):
+--   * volume   -> public.messages agrupado por whatsapp_connection_id;
+--                 entrada = sender 'contact'; saida = sender 'agent';
+--                 falha   = sender 'agent' AND status 'failed'.
+--   * espera   -> public.conversation_sla: first_response_at - first_message_at
+--                 (segundos) por fila (contacts.queue_id), apenas conversas
+--                 iniciadas na janela e ja respondidas.
+--
+-- Permissao: RPC de leitura gerencial. Chamador precisa ser staff
+-- (public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid())); agente comum recebe 42501.
+-- EXECUTE negado a PUBLIC e anon, concedido apenas a authenticated (a checagem
+-- de staff acontece dentro da funcao). SECURITY DEFINER com search_path fixo.
+--
+-- Janelas permitidas: 24, 168 e 720 horas (default 24); qualquer outro valor
+-- levanta 22023 (invalid_window_hours).
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ops_metrics(p_window_hours integer DEFAULT 24)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_since timestamptz;
+  v_connections jsonb;
+  v_queues jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'staff_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+  END IF;
+
+  IF p_window_hours IS NULL OR p_window_hours NOT IN (24, 168, 720) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_window_hours' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+  END IF;
+
+  v_since := statement_timestamp() - make_interval(hours => p_window_hours);
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(conn) ORDER BY conn.incoming + conn.outgoing DESC, conn.connection_id), '[]'::jsonb)
+    INTO v_connections
+  FROM (
+    SELECT
+      m.whatsapp_connection_id AS connection_id,
+      wc.name AS connection_name,
+      count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.sender = 'contact')::bigint AS incoming,
+      count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.sender = 'agent')::bigint AS outgoing,
+      count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.sender = 'agent' AND m.status = 'failed')::bigint AS failed
+    FROM public.messages AS m
+    LEFT JOIN public.whatsapp_connections AS wc ON wc.id = m.whatsapp_connection_id
+    WHERE m.created_at >= v_since
+      AND COALESCE(m.is_deleted, false) = false
+    GROUP BY m.whatsapp_connection_id, wc.name
+  ) AS conn;
+
+  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q.avg_wait_seconds DESC NULLS LAST, q.queue_id), '[]'::jsonb)
+    INTO v_queues
+  FROM (
+    SELECT
+      c.queue_id,
+      q.name AS queue_name,
+      count(*)::bigint AS answered,
+      round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (sla.first_response_at - sla.first_message_at)))::numeric, 2) AS avg_wait_seconds,
+      round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (
+        ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (sla.first_response_at - sla.first_message_at))
+      )::numeric, 2) AS p95_wait_seconds
+    FROM public.conversation_sla AS sla
+    JOIN public.contacts AS c ON c.id = sla.contact_id
+    JOIN public.queues AS q ON q.id = c.queue_id
+    WHERE sla.first_message_at >= v_since
+      AND sla.first_response_at IS NOT NULL
+      AND c.queue_id IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY c.queue_id, q.name
+  ) AS q;
+
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+    'window_hours', p_window_hours,
+    'since', v_since,
+    'connections', v_connections,
+    'queues', v_queues
+  );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.ops_metrics(integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.ops_metrics(integer) TO authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.ops_metrics(integer) IS
+  'Operacoes (2026-10-15): metricas da janela movel de p_window_hours (24/168/720, default 24). '
+  'Devolve {window_hours, since, connections:[{connection_id, connection_name, incoming, outgoing, failed}], '
+  'queues:[{queue_id, queue_name, answered, avg_wait_seconds, p95_wait_seconds}]}. '
+  'Volume por conexao vem de messages (entrada=sender contact, saida=sender agent, falha=agent+status failed, '
+  'sem deletadas); espera por fila vem de conversation_sla (first_response_at - first_message_at, segundos), '
+  'apenas conversas iniciadas na janela e ja respondidas. SECURITY DEFINER, search_path fixo, staff-only '
+  '(is_admin_or_supervisor); EXECUTE fechado a PUBLIC/anon.';

+-- instance_auth_event_series
+-- Rollback: RPC nova, sem tabela alterada ‚Äî o rollback s√≥ dropa a fun√ß√£o.
+-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):
+--   drop function if exists public.instance_auth_event_series(text);
+--
+-- Serie temporal de eventos de autenticacao por instancia WhatsApp, lida da fonte
+-- real public.connection_health_logs (gravada pelo watchdog connection-health-check):
+-- 'no_credentials' = Evolution devolveu 401/403; 'disconnected'; 'error'/'timeout'
+-- = demais falhas. Coluna auth_failures separa 401/403 do resto, nao um do outro.
+-- Aditivo: sem tabela nova. Devolve SO contagens (sem error_message, IP, telefone).
+-- Janela '24h' = baldes de 1 h; '7d' = baldes de 1 dia; sem argumento = '24h'.
+-- Permissao: so admin/supervisor (42501); janela fora de {'24h','7d'} = 22023.
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.instance_auth_event_series(p_window text DEFAULT '24h')
+RETURNS TABLE (bucket timestamptz, instance text, auth_failures integer, disconnected integer, errors integer, total integer)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $instance_auth_event_series$
+DECLARE v_desde timestamptz; v_passo interval;
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sem_permissao_para_ver_eventos_de_auth' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
+  IF p_window IS NULL OR p_window NOT IN ('24h', '7d') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'janela_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;
+  IF p_window = '24h' THEN v_desde := now() - interval '24 hours'; v_passo := interval '1 hour';
+  ELSE v_desde := now() - interval '7 days'; v_passo := interval '1 day'; END IF;
+  RETURN QUERY
+  SELECT date_bin(v_passo, l.checked_at, timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00'),
+    l.instance_id,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'no_credentials')::integer,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'disconnected')::integer,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('error', 'timeout'))::integer,
+    count(*)::integer
+  FROM public.connection_health_logs l WHERE l.checked_at >= v_desde GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
+END $instance_auth_event_series$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.instance_auth_event_series(text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.instance_auth_event_series(text) TO authenticated;

+--     'unknown', 'opt_in' e nulo liberam. N√£o h√° CHECK de consent_status na base, ent√£o a
+--     leitura √© por valor: s√≥ 'revoked' barra.
+--   * O cooldown conta CONVITES (linhas de csat_surveys em 'sent'/'responded' criadas nos
+--     √∫ltimos 30 dias), n√£o encerramentos de conversa. Um convite que falhou ('failed') n√£o
+--     consome o cooldown; duas pesquisas para a MESMA conversa nunca coexistem (√≠ndice √∫nico
+--     parcial em conversation_id).
+--   * V2 n√£o tem tabela de conversas (a conversa √© o contato): conversation_id fica sem FK,
+--     s√≥ como identificador da conversa de origem informado pelo sistema.
+-- ADITIVO: nenhuma coluna, policy, grant ou dado existente √© removido. RLS j√° est√° ligada
+-- em csat_surveys; a leitura por agente/admin (policies atuais) fica como est√°.
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 1. colunas do ciclo ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+alter table public.csat_surveys
+  add column if not exists status         text,
+  add column if not exists send_at        timestamptz,
+  add column if not exists responded_at   timestamptz,
+  add column if not exists conversation_id uuid,
+  add column if not exists message_text   text;
+
+-- Backfill das linhas legadas (s√≥ resposta): elas j√° nasceram respondidas.
+-- N√£o h√° gatilho em csat_surveys (conferido no teste), ent√£o este UPDATE n√£o
+-- reescreve data de ningu√©m nem dispara efeito colateral.
+update public.csat_surveys
+   set status       = 'responded',
+       send_at      = coalesce(conversation_resolved_at, created_at),
+       responded_at = created_at
+ where status is null;
+
+alter table public.csat_surveys alter column status  set default 'scheduled';
+alter table public.csat_surveys alter column send_at set default now();
+alter table public.csat_surveys alter column status  set not null;
+alter table public.csat_surveys alter column send_at set not null;
+
+-- Convite n√£o tem nota nem agente at√© o envio/registro: as duas colunas afrouxam.
+alter table public.csat_surveys alter column rating   drop not null;
+alter table public.csat_surveys alter column agent_id drop not null;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 2. invariantes ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+-- not valid + validate: n√£o trava escrita concorrente durante a valida√ß√£o.
+-- drop antes do add: o replay local reaplica as migrations, ent√£o o arquivo
+-- precisa poder rodar duas vezes sem estourar 'constraint already exists'.
+alter table public.csat_surveys drop constraint if exists csat_surveys_status_check;
+alter table public.csat_surveys
+  add constraint csat_surveys_status_check
+  check (status in ('scheduled', 'sent', 'responded', 'failed')) not valid;
+alter table public.csat_surveys validate constraint csat_surveys_status_check;
+
+alter table public.csat_surveys drop constraint if exists csat_surveys_rating_range;
+alter table public.csat_surveys
+  add constraint csat_surveys_rating_range
+  check (rating is null or rating between 1 and 5) not valid;
+alter table public.csat_surveys validate constraint csat_surveys_rating_range;
+
+-- 'responded' e responded_at andam juntos (nem resposta sem carimbo, nem carimbo sem resposta).
+alter table public.csat_surveys drop constraint if exists csat_surveys_responded_consistency;
+alter table public.csat_surveys
+  add constraint csat_surveys_responded_consistency
+  check ((status = 'responded') = (responded_at is not null)) not valid;
+alter table public.csat_surveys validate constraint csat_surveys_responded_consistency;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 3. √≠ndices do ciclo ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+-- Uma pesquisa por conversa (convite √© √∫nico; conversa repetida n√£o gera 2¬∫ convite).
+create unique index if not exists uq_csat_surveys_conversation
+  on public.csat_surveys (conversation_id)
+  where conversation_id is not null;
+
+-- Fila do claim: s√≥ os pendentes importam.
+create index if not exists idx_csat_surveys_dispatch
+  on public.csat_surveys (send_at)
+  where status = 'scheduled';
+
+-- Cooldown por contato (conta convites entregues).
+create index if not exists idx_csat_surveys_contact_invites
+  on public.csat_surveys (contact_id, created_at)
+  where status in ('sent', 'responded');
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 4. policy do sistema ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+-- O sistema grava com service_role (que j√° tem BYPASSRLS); a policy fica expl√≠cita,
+-- como no resto do schema. A leitura por agente/admin N√ÉO √© tocada.
+drop policy if exists "Service role manages CSAT surveys" on public.csat_surveys;
+create policy "Service role manages CSAT surveys" on public.csat_surveys
+  for all to service_role using (true) with check (true);
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 5. RPC do envio: claim at√¥mico dos convites devidos ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+create or replace function public.claim_due_csat_surveys(p_limit integer default 50)
+returns table (
+  id uuid,
+  contact_id uuid,
+  agent_id uuid,
+  phone text,
+  message_text text,
+  send_at timestamptz,
+  conversation_id uuid
+)
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $$
+declare
+  v_limit integer;
+begin
+  if p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 then
+    raise exception 'invalid_csat_limit' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  v_limit := least(p_limit, 200);
+
+  -- 1) convite que N√ÉO pode sair: contato ausente/apagado ou consentimento revogado.
+  --    Vira terminal ('failed') em vez de ficar preso na fila para sempre.
+  update public.csat_surveys s
+     set status = 'failed'
+   where s.status = 'scheduled'
+     and not exists (
+       select 1
+         from public.contacts c
+        where c.id = s.contact_id
+          and c.deleted_at is null
+          and coalesce(c.consent_status, 'unknown') <> 'revoked'
+     );
+
+  -- 2) claim: marca 'sent' e devolve o lote. for update skip locked evita dois
+  --    workers pegarem a mesma linha; o cooldown conta convites dos √∫ltimos 30 dias.
+  return query
+  with devidos as (
+    select s.id, s.contact_id, s.agent_id, c.phone, s.message_text, s.send_at, s.conversation_id
+      from public.csat_surveys s
+      join public.contacts c on c.id = s.contact_id
+     where s.status = 'scheduled'
+       and s.send_at <= now()
+       and c.deleted_at is null
+       and coalesce(c.consent_status, 'unknown') <> 'revoked'
+       and not exists (
+         select 1
+           from public.csat_surveys anterior
+          where anterior.contact_id = s.contact_id
+            and anterior.id <> s.id
+            and anterior.status in ('sent', 'responded')
+            and anterior.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
+       )
+     order by s.send_at, s.created_at
+     for update of s skip locked
+     limit v_limit
+  )
+  update public.csat_surveys s
+     set status = 'sent'
+    from devidos d
+   where s.id = d.id
+  returning s.id, d.contact_id, d.agent_id, d.phone, d.message_text, d.send_at, d.conversation_id;
+end;
+$$;
+
+comment on function public.claim_due_csat_surveys(integer) is
+  'Reivindica convites de CSAT devidos (scheduled, send_at <= now(), contato eleg√≠vel e fora do cooldown de 30 dias), marca sent e devolve o lote. S√≥ service_role.';
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 6. RPC da captura: resposta "1..5" do contato vira nota ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+create or replace function public.fn_capture_csat_replies(p_limit integer default 50)
+returns integer
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public, pg_temp
+as $$
+declare
+  v_limit integer;
+  v_captured integer := 0;
+begin
+  if p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 then
+    raise exception 'invalid_csat_limit' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  v_limit := least(p_limit, 500);
+
+  -- Resposta = mensagem ENTRANTE (sender 'contact'), texto de um d√≠gito 1..5,
+  -- dentro da janela de 72 h do convite. A mais antiga da janela √© a resposta.
+  -- Idempotente: s√≥ linhas ainda 'sent' e sem nota entram; rodar de novo captura 0.
+  with respostas as (
+    select distinct on (s.id)
+           s.id               as survey_id,
+           btrim(m.content)::integer as rating,
+           m.created_at       as responded_at
+      from public.csat_surveys s
+      join public.messages m
+        on m.contact_id = s.contact_id
+       and m.sender = 'contact'
+       and coalesce(m.is_deleted, false) = false
+       and btrim(m.content) ~ '^[1-5]$'
+       and m.created_at >= s.send_at
+       and m.created_at <= s.send_at + interval '72 hours'
+     where s.status = 'sent'
+       and s.rating is null
+       and s.responded_at is null
+     order by s.id, m.created_at
+     limit v_limit
+  )
+  update public.csat_surveys s
+     set rating       = r.rating,
+         responded_at = r.responded_at,
+         status       = 'responded'
+    from respostas r
+   where s.id = r.survey_id
+     and s.status = 'sent'
+     and s.rating is null
+     and s.responded_at is null;
+  get diagnostics v_captured = row_count;
+  return v_captured;
+end;
+$$;
+
+comment on function public.fn_capture_csat_replies(integer) is
+  'Captura a resposta 1..5 do contato na janela de 72 h do convite e grava a nota na mesma transa√ß√£o. Idempotente. S√≥ service_role.';
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 7. ACL: negar por padr√£o e abrir s√≥ para service_role ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+revoke all on function public.claim_due_csat_surveys(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
+grant execute on function public.claim_due_csat_surveys(integer) to service_role;
+
+revoke all on function public.fn_capture_csat_replies(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
+grant execute on function public.fn_capture_csat_replies(integer) to service_role;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ 8. agendamento (modelo PE-102) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+-- Comando de cron √© a chamada qualificada da fun√ß√£o (sem DDL/DML direto), igual ao
+-- 'close-stale-calls'. S√≥ quando pg_cron existe (local e produ√ß√£o t√™m).
+do $$
+begin
+  if exists (select 1 from pg_extension where extname = 'pg_cron') then
+    perform cron.unschedule(jobid)
+      from cron.job
+     where jobname = 'csat-reply-capture-tick';
+    perform cron.schedule(
+      'csat-reply-capture-tick',
+      '*/2 * * * *',
+      'select public.fn_capture_csat_replies()'
+    );
+  end if;
+end $$;

+-- auditoria_config_operacional
+-- Rollback: derruba os quatro gatilhos e a funcao de auditoria criados aqui; nao ha tabela,
+-- coluna, policy, dado ou GRANT alterado, e a funcao nasce com EXECUTE revogado, entao nada
+-- mais precisa voltar.
+-- Rollback (SQL executavel, na ordem):
+--   DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS audit_queues_config ON public.queues;
+--   DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS audit_queue_members_config ON public.queue_members;
+--   DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS audit_connection_queues_config ON public.whatsapp_connection_queues;
+--   DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS audit_rate_limit_configs_config ON public.rate_limit_configs;
+--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.audit_operational_config();
+--
+-- Mudanca de configuracao operacional nao deixava rastro. Os unicos gatilhos de auditoria
+-- do banco cobriam user_roles, role_permissions e contatos; fila, membros da fila, vinculo
+-- conexao-fila e rate_limit_configs eram alterados em silencio (cartao t_a8be1908, segunda
+-- passada da auditoria de paridade V3 -> V2 do doc 25-hooks-raiz-3).
+--
+-- Esta migration e ADITIVA: nao cria tabela nem coluna, nao muda policy, nao toca dado
+-- existente e so acrescenta o rastro das quatro tabelas de configuracao operacional.
+-- O que o evento grava:
+--   autor        -> audit_logs.user_id (auth.uid()) + details.actor_* (mesmo bloco da
+--                   20261003272707: actor_kind jwt/service_role_or_direct_sql, actor_db_role,
+--                   actor_app_name, actor_addr);
+--   acao         -> vocabulario deste cartao: queue_created|queue_updated|queue_deleted,
+--                   queue_member_created|queue_member_updated|queue_member_deleted,
+--                   connection_queue_linked|connection_queue_updated|connection_queue_unlinked,
+--                   rate_limit_config_created|rate_limit_config_updated|rate_limit_config_deleted;
+--   entity_type  -> nome da tabela (queues, queue_members, whatsapp_connection_queues,
+--                   rate_limit_configs) e entity_id -> id da linha mexida (uuid);
+--   diff minimo  -> UPDATE grava so as colunas que mudaram, em details.changed
+--                   ({<coluna>: {old, new}}); INSERT grava details.new; DELETE grava
+--                   details.old (o estado anterior, exigido pelo cartao). updated_at fica
+--                   de fora do diff porque o gatilho update_<tabela>_updated_at o reescreve
+--                   em todo UPDATE, sem que o autor tenha mexido nele.
+-- Nenhum dado pessoal entra no evento: as quatro tabelas guardam nome/descricao de fila,
+-- ids de profile/conexao e limites numericos (sem telefone e sem texto de mensagem).
+--
+-- ALLOWLIST do log_audit_event (PE-19, dona ainda nao integrada): as 11 acoes acima sao as
+-- que este cartao acrescenta e devem entrar na lista quando PE-19 definir onde ela mora.
+
+-- Uma funcao generica serve as quatro tabelas: o gatilho e por tabela, o corpo e o mesmo.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_operational_config()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_entity    text := TG_TABLE_NAME;
+  v_op        text := lower(TG_OP);
+  v_action    text;
+  v_entity_id uuid;
+  v_details   jsonb;
+  v_before    jsonb;
+  v_after     jsonb;
+  v_changed   jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
+  v_key       text;
+  v_actor     jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  v_entity_id := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD.id ELSE NEW.id END;
+
+  v_action := CASE v_entity
+                WHEN 'queues'                     THEN 'queue'
+                WHEN 'queue_members'              THEN 'queue_member'
+                WHEN 'whatsapp_connection_queues'  THEN 'connection_queue'
+                WHEN 'rate_limit_configs'         THEN 'rate_limit_config'
+                ELSE v_entity
+              END
+              || '_'
+              || CASE
+                   WHEN v_entity = 'whatsapp_connection_queues'
+                     THEN CASE v_op WHEN 'insert' THEN 'linked'
+                                    WHEN 'delete' THEN 'unlinked'
+                                    ELSE 'updated' END
+                   WHEN v_op = 'insert' THEN 'created'
+                   WHEN v_op = 'update' THEN 'updated'
+                   WHEN v_op = 'delete' THEN 'deleted'
+                   ELSE v_op
+                 END;
+
+  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
+    v_details := jsonb_build_object('op', v_op, 'new', to_jsonb(NEW));
+  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
+    v_details := jsonb_build_object('op', v_op, 'old', to_jsonb(OLD));
+  ELSE
+    v_before := to_jsonb(OLD);
+    v_after  := to_jsonb(NEW);
+    FOR v_key IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(v_after) LOOP
+      IF v_key <> 'updated_at'
+         AND (v_after -> v_key) IS DISTINCT FROM (v_before -> v_key) THEN
+        v_changed := v_changed || jsonb_build_object(
+          v_key, jsonb_build_object('old', v_before -> v_key, 'new', v_after -> v_key));
+      END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+    v_details := jsonb_build_object('op', v_op, 'changed', v_changed);
+  END IF;
+
+  v_actor := jsonb_build_object(
+    'actor_kind', CASE WHEN auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN 'jwt' ELSE 'service_role_or_direct_sql' END,
+    'actor_db_role', current_user,
+    'actor_app_name', nullif(current_setting('application_name', true), ''),
+    'actor_addr', coalesce(host(inet_client_addr()), 'local')
+  );
+
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
+  VALUES (auth.uid(), v_action, v_entity, v_entity_id, v_details || v_actor);
+
+  RETURN NULL;
+END;
+$function$;

+-- Postgres (PUBLIC) e tambem anon/authenticated, como as demais funcoes de gatilho
