+-- ===== T10: backfill ===========================================================
+-- e: 3 dias seguidos terminando hoje (streak inflado 999 -> 3)
+-- f: sem atividade DE hoje-2 a hoje-1 (gap) -> so o sufixo de hoje = 1
+update public.agent_stats set current_streak = 999, best_streak = 999, last_active_date = null

+insert into public.messages (id, sender, content, agent_id, created_at)

+union all
+select gen_random_uuid(), 'agent', 'bf', (select e from t_ids),
+       (((now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - 1) + time '10:00') at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'
+union all
+select gen_random_uuid(), 'agent', 'bf', (select e from t_ids),

+select gen_random_uuid(), 'agent', 'bf', (select f from t_ids),

+-- updated_at que o backfill NAO pode reescrever (guardado antes de rodar o bloco)
+create temp table t_tu on commit drop as
+select profile_id, updated_at from public.agent_stats

+-- Mesmo bloco de backfill da migration (migration 20261013044500, secao 4), inclusive o
+-- DISABLE/ENABLE do gatilho update_agent_stats_updated_at, igual ao arquivo versionado.
+alter table public.agent_stats disable trigger update_agent_stats_updated_at;
+with activity as (
+  select m.agent_id as profile_id, (m.created_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date as d
+    from public.messages m where m.sender = 'agent' and m.agent_id is not null
+  union
+  select c.closed_by, (c.created_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
+    from public.conversation_closures c where c.closed_by is not null
+),
+dias as ( select distinct profile_id, d from activity ),
+runs as (
+  select profile_id, d, d - (row_number() over (partition by profile_id order by d))::int as grp from dias
+),
+tamanhos as ( select profile_id, grp, count(*)::int as len, max(d) as fim from runs group by profile_id, grp ),
+ultima as ( select distinct on (profile_id) profile_id, len, fim from tamanhos order by profile_id, fim desc ),
+melhor as ( select profile_id, max(len)::int as best from tamanhos group by profile_id ),
+hoje as ( select (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date as d ),
+novo as (
+  select s.profile_id,
+         case when u.fim >= (select d from hoje) - 1 then u.len else 0 end as cs,
+         greatest(m.best, u.len) as bs,
+         u.fim as lad
+    from public.agent_stats s join ultima u on u.profile_id = s.profile_id join melhor m on m.profile_id = s.profile_id
+)
+update public.agent_stats s
+   set current_streak = n.cs, best_streak = n.bs, last_active_date = n.lad
+  from novo n
+ where s.profile_id = n.profile_id
+   and (s.current_streak is distinct from n.cs or s.best_streak is distinct from n.bs or s.last_active_date is distinct from n.lad);
+
+update public.agent_stats s
+   set current_streak = 0, best_streak = 0, last_active_date = null
+ where (s.current_streak <> 0 or s.best_streak <> 0 or s.last_active_date is not null)
+   and not exists (select 1 from public.messages m where m.sender='agent' and m.agent_id = s.profile_id)
+   and not exists (select 1 from public.conversation_closures c where c.closed_by = s.profile_id);
+
+alter table public.agent_stats enable trigger update_agent_stats_updated_at;
+
+do $$
+declare st_e int; bs_e int; lad_e date; st_f int; bs_f int; lad_f date; st_a int; bs_a int; lad_a date; hoje date;
+begin
+  hoje := (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date;
+  select current_streak, best_streak, last_active_date into st_e, bs_e, lad_e from public.agent_stats where profile_id = (select e from t_ids);
+  if st_e <> 3 or bs_e <> 3 or lad_e <> hoje then
+    raise exception 'T10a FALHOU: 3 dias seguidos ate hoje deveriam dar 3/3/%, veio %/%/%', hoje, st_e, bs_e, lad_e;
+  end if;

+  if st_f <> 1 or bs_f <> 1 or lad_f <> hoje then
+    raise exception 'T10b FALHOU: sufixo de hoje (com gap) deveria dar 1/1/%, veio %/%/%', hoje, st_f, bs_f, lad_f;
+  end if;

+  if st_a <> 0 or bs_a <> 0 or lad_a is not null then
+    raise exception 'T10c FALHOU: agente sem historico deveria zerar, veio %/%/%', st_a, bs_a, lad_a;
+  end if;

+     is distinct from (select updated_at from t_tu where profile_id = (select e from t_ids)) then
+    raise exception 'T10d FALHOU: updated_at de e foi reescrito pelo backfill';
+  end if;

+create or replace function public.handle_message_gamification() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path to '' as $$ declare v_new_sent int; v_received int; v_total int; begin if tg_op = 'update' and (old.agent_id is not null or new.agent_id is null) then return new; end if; if new.sender = 'agent' and new.agent_id is not null then insert into public.agent_stats (profile_id, messages_sent, messages_received, current_streak, best_streak, updated_at) values (new.agent_id, 1, 0, 1, 1, now()) on conflict (profile_id) do update set messages_sent = public.agent_stats.messages_sent + 1, current_streak = public.agent_stats.current_streak + 1, best_streak = greatest(public.agent_stats.best_streak, public.agent_stats.current_streak + 1), updated_at = now() returning messages_sent, messages_received into v_new_sent, v_received; v_total := v_new_sent + v_received; if v_total = any (array[10, 50, 100, 500, 1000]) then perform public.grant_agent_achievement_internal(new.agent_id, 'message_milestone', v_total || ' Mensagens', 'Voc√™ enviou/recebeu ' || v_total || ' mensagens!', least(100, v_total / 10)); end if; end if; return new; exception when others then raise warning 'gamification error in handle_message_gamification (message_id=%): % [%]', new.id, sqlerrm, sqlstate; return new; end; $$;

+create or replace function public.update_agent_streak(p_profile_id uuid, p_increment boolean) returns json language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as $$ declare v_row agent_stats%rowtype; v_new_streak int; v_new_best_streak int; begin if auth.role() = 'anon' or (auth.role() = 'authenticated' and not (p_profile_id in (select id from profiles where user_id = auth.uid()) or is_admin_or_supervisor(auth.uid()))) then raise exception 'permission denied'; end if; select * into v_row from agent_stats where profile_id = p_profile_id for update; if not found then return null; end if; v_new_best_streak := coalesce(v_row.best_streak, 0); if p_increment then v_new_streak := coalesce(v_row.current_streak, 0) + 1; if v_new_streak > v_new_best_streak then v_new_best_streak := v_new_streak; end if; else v_new_streak := 0; end if; update agent_stats set current_streak = v_new_streak, best_streak = v_new_best_streak, updated_at = now() where profile_id = p_profile_id; return json_build_object('newStreak', v_new_streak, 'newBestStreak', v_new_best_streak); end; $$;

+--   zapp-db-local psql . <conjunto> -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/inbox_scope_permissions.sql
+--
+-- Cria dados SINT√âTICOS e desfaz TUDO no ROLLBACK final (inclusive o DROP/DELETE de T11, que s√£o
+-- transacionais): n√£o sobra linha nem objeto alterado. Sem EXCEPTION = su√≠te verde.
+BEGIN;
+
+-- O stack local da tarefa parte de um retrato enxuto; garante, dentro da transa√ß√£o do teste,
+-- a coluna/√≠ndice que j√° existem no manifesto da produ√ß√£o e que a fun√ß√£o usa para dedupe real.
+ALTER TABLE public.audit_logs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS dedupe_key text;
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_audit_logs_dedupe_key
+  ON public.audit_logs (dedupe_key)
+  WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL;
+
+DO $inbox_scope_perm$
+DECLARE
+  v_user     uuid := '77777777-7777-7777-7777-777777777701';
+  v_uid      uuid;
+  v_perms    int;
+  v_agent    int;
+  v_rows     int;
+  v_scope    text;
+  v_acl      text;
+  v_barrado  boolean;
+  v_erro     boolean;
+BEGIN
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- fixtures
+  INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES (v_user, 'inbox-scope@local.test')
+  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
+  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, name) VALUES (v_user, 'Agente escopo (sintetico)')
+  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T1 cat√°logo
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_perms FROM public.permissions
+   WHERE name IN ('inbox.view_department','inbox.view_all') AND category = 'inbox';
+  IF v_perms <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: esperava 2 permissoes na categoria inbox e achei %', v_perms;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T2 atribui√ß√£o
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_perms
+    FROM public.role_permissions rp
+    JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
+   WHERE rp.role IN ('admin'::public.app_role, 'supervisor'::public.app_role)
+     AND p.name IN ('inbox.view_department','inbox.view_all');
+  IF v_perms <> 4 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: esperava 4 atribuicoes (admin+supervisor x 2) e achei %', v_perms;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_agent
+    FROM public.role_permissions rp
+    JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
+   WHERE rp.role = 'agent'::public.app_role
+     AND p.name IN ('inbox.view_department','inbox.view_all');
+  IF v_agent <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: agente comum recebeu escopo (%)', v_agent;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T3 ACL da fun√ß√£o
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text)', 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: authenticated SEM EXECUTE na funcao';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: anon com EXECUTE na funcao';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: service_role com EXECUTE na funcao';
+  END IF;
+  -- PUBLIC: no ACL do Postgres o EXECUTE a PUBLIC aparece como o item `=X/<owner>` (sem grantee
+  -- antes do `=`, no comeco ou apos uma virgula); o `postgres=X/postgres` do dono nao conta.
+  SELECT coalesce(p.proacl::text, '') INTO v_acl
+    FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid = 'public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text)'::regprocedure;
+  IF v_acl ~ '(^|,)=X/' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: PUBLIC ainda tem EXECUTE na funcao (acl=%)', v_acl;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T4 grava 1 linha
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('all');
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_rows <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: esperava 1 linha de auditoria e achei %', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT details->>'scope' INTO v_scope FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_scope <> 'all' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: escopo gravado errado (%)', v_scope;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T5 dedupe mesmo escopo/hora
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('all');
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_rows <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: dedupe nao segurou (esperava 1, achei %)', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T6 escopo diferente
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('department');
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_rows <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: escopo diferente nao gerou nova linha (esperava 2, achei %)', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T7 entrada inv√°lida
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(NULL);
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('');
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('todos');
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('foo');
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(repeat('x', 30));  -- curto, mas fora da lista permitida
+  PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(repeat('x', 200)); -- longo e fora da lista permitida
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user AND details->>'scope' = 'unknown';
+  IF v_rows <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: entrada invalida deveria virar 1 linha unknown e veio %', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_rows <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: escopo arbitrario foi gravado (esperava so all, department e unknown; achei % linhas)', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T8 anon barrado
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'anon', true);
+  v_barrado := false;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('all');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    v_barrado := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_barrado = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8 FALHOU: anon conseguiu chamar a funcao';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_rows <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8 FALHOU: anon gravou algo (esperava 3 linhas, achei %)', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T9 authenticated sem identidade
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{}', true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_erro := false;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope('all');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v_erro := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_erro THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: uid nulo levantou erro em vez de nao gravar';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_rows <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: uid nulo gravou (esperava 3, achei %)', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T10 escrita direta barrada
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_barrado := false;
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action) VALUES (v_user, 'bypass_direto_teste');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v_barrado := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_barrado = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T10 FALHOU: authenticated gravou direto em audit_logs';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs WHERE action = 'bypass_direto_teste';
+  IF v_rows <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T10 FALHOU: linha de bypass sobrou (%)', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ------------------------------------------------ T12 seed idempotente (roda de novo, nao duplica)
+  -- Mesmas duas instru√ß√µes da migration; a segunda vez nao pode mudar as contagens.
+  INSERT INTO public.permissions (name, description, category) VALUES
+    ('inbox.view_department', 'Inbox: ver as conversas do proprio departamento', 'inbox'),
+    ('inbox.view_all',        'Inbox: ver as conversas de todos os departamentos', 'inbox')
+  ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING;
+  INSERT INTO public.role_permissions (role, permission_id)
+  SELECT matrix.role, permission.id
+    FROM (VALUES ('admin'::public.app_role), ('supervisor'::public.app_role)) AS matrix(role)
+    JOIN public.permissions AS permission
+      ON permission.name IN ('inbox.view_department', 'inbox.view_all')
+  ON CONFLICT (role, permission_id) DO NOTHING;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_perms FROM public.permissions
+   WHERE name IN ('inbox.view_department','inbox.view_all');
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.role_permissions rp
+   JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
+   WHERE p.name IN ('inbox.view_department','inbox.view_all');
+  IF v_perms <> 2 OR v_rows <> 4 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T12 FALHOU: seed nao idempotente (permissoes=%, atribuicoes=%)', v_perms, v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ------------------------------------------------ T13 a hora compoe a dedupe_key
+  -- A chave gravada termina no balde da hora UTC; mesma linha numa hora diferente NAO colide.
+  SELECT dedupe_key INTO v_acl FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user AND details->>'scope' = 'all';
+  IF v_acl <> 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access:'||v_user||':all:'
+             ||to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYYMMDDHH24') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T13 FALHOU: dedupe_key sem a composicao usuario+escopo+hora (%)', v_acl;
+  END IF;
+  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, details, dedupe_key)
+  VALUES (v_user, 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access', '{"scope":"all"}'::jsonb,
+          'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access:'||v_user||':all:'
+          ||to_char((now() at time zone 'utc') + interval '1 hour', 'YYYYMMDDHH24'));
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_rows FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'unauthorized_inbox_scope_access' AND user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_rows <> 4 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T13 FALHOU: hora diferente deveria gerar nova linha (achei %)', v_rows;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T11 rollback do cabe√ßalho EXECUTA
+  -- As 3 linhas abaixo s√£o, literalmente, o `-- Rollback (SQL execut√°vel, na ordem):` da migration.
+  -- Rodam dentro da transa√ß√£o: ao final o ROLLBACK desfaz o DROP/DELETE e o banco volta ao estado.
+  DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text);
+  DELETE FROM public.role_permissions
+   WHERE permission_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.permissions
+                            WHERE name IN ('inbox.view_department', 'inbox.view_all'));
+  DELETE FROM public.permissions
+   WHERE name IN ('inbox.view_department', 'inbox.view_all');
+
+  IF to_regprocedure('public.log_unauthorized_inbox_scope(text)') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T11 FALHOU: rollback nao removeu a funcao';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_perms FROM public.permissions
+   WHERE name IN ('inbox.view_department','inbox.view_all');
+  IF v_perms <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T11 FALHOU: rollback nao removeu as permissoes (%)', v_perms;
+  END IF;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'inbox_scope_permissions: suite OK (T1 catalogo, T2 papeis, T3 ACL, T4 gravacao, T5 dedupe, T6 escopo, T7 invalido, T8 anon, T9 sem identidade, T10 escrita direta, T12 seed idempotente, T13 dedupe por hora, T11 rollback)';
+END $inbox_scope_perm$;
+
+ROLLBACK;

+-- Teste SQL de public.inbox_unread_total() (selo de nao lidas do Chat / shell).
+--
+-- O que prova:
+--   T1  agente conta SO as conversas que enxerga (contato de outro agente nao entra);
+--       com 3 nao lidas num contato o total e 1 CONVERSA, nao 3 mensagens (T4);
+--   T2  admin/supervisor ve todas as conversas com nao lida (visibilidade ampla);
+--   T3  marcar como lida reduz a contagem (a conversa sai do total);
+--   T2b ACL: anon NAO pode chamar (permissao negada de verdade); authenticated e
+--       service_role tem EXECUTE (controle positivo);
+--   T4  "nao lida" com is_read NULO conta (mesma semantica do cliente);
+--   T5  contato visivel SEM mensagem nao entra no total;
+--   T7  escala: 3.650 contatos com 1 nao lida cada -> total exato e medicao de tempo
+--       (o indice parcial idx_messages_unread_conversas e' o caminho esperado).
+--
+-- COMO RODAR (banco LOCAL da tarefa, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <conjunto> -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/inbox_unread_total.sql
+--
+-- Cria dados SINTETICOS e desfaz tudo no ROLLBACK final: nao sobra linha no banco.
+-- Sem EXCEPTION = suite verde.
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $inbox_unread_total$
+DECLARE
+  v_user_a        uuid := '11111111-1111-1111-1111-1111111111a1';
+  v_user_b        uuid := '11111111-1111-1111-1111-1111111111b2';
+  v_user_admin    uuid := '11111111-1111-1111-1111-1111111111ad';
+  v_profile_a     uuid;
+  v_profile_b     uuid;
+  v_contact_vis   uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-3333333333c1';
+  v_contact_oculto uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-3333333333c2';
+  v_contact_vazio uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-3333333333c3';
+  v_msg_m1        uuid := '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444401';
+  v_msg_m2        uuid := '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444402';
+  v_msg_m3        uuid := '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444403';
+  v_msg_m4        uuid := '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444404';
+  v_msg_m5        uuid := '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444405';
+  v_msg_b1        uuid := '44444444-4444-4444-4444-4444444444b1';
+  v_t_base        timestamptz := '2026-10-05T12:00:00Z';
+  v_total         bigint;
+  v_base_a        bigint;
+  v_base_admin    bigint;
+  v_barrado       boolean;
+  v_ms            numeric;
+  v_ok            int := 0;
+BEGIN
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- dados
+  INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+    (v_user_a,     'inbox-total-a@local.test'),
+    (v_user_b,     'inbox-total-b@local.test'),
+    (v_user_admin, 'inbox-total-admin@local.test');
+
+  -- O gatilho on_auth_user_created cria o perfil; o upsert cobre os dois mundos.
+  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, name) VALUES
+    (v_user_a,     'Agente A (sintetico)'),
+    (v_user_b,     'Agente B (sintetico)'),
+    (v_user_admin, 'Admin (sintetico)')
+  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name;
+
+  SELECT id INTO v_profile_a FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_user_a;
+  SELECT id INTO v_profile_b FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_user_b;
+  IF v_profile_a IS NULL OR v_profile_b IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture invalida: perfil sintetico nao encontrado';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- admin/supervisor: e' o que da visibilidade ampla em is_contact_visible_to_user
+  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (v_user_admin, 'admin');
+
+  -- Linha de base: o banco LOCAL ja' vem com o seed (contatos com nao lidas de
+  -- outros agentes). O agente A e' novo, entao sua base e' 0; a do admin nao.
+  -- As assercoes usam base + delta, para nao depender do que o seed traz.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_admin)::text, true);
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_base_admin;
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_base_a;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'bases do seed: agente A=% admin=%', v_base_a, v_base_admin;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.contacts (id, name, phone, assigned_to) VALUES
+    (v_contact_vis,    'Contato A visivel',   '5511000000941', v_profile_a),
+    (v_contact_oculto, 'Contato B oculto',    '5511000000942', v_profile_b),
+    (v_contact_vazio,  'Contato A sem msgs',  '5511000000943', v_profile_a);
+
+  -- m1: contato, is_read NULO  -> CONTA
+  -- m2: contato, is_read false -> conta
+  -- m3: agent,   is_read true  -> NAO conta
+  -- m4: contato, is_read true  -> nao conta
+  -- m5: contato, is_read NULO  -> conta   (3 nao lidas no MESMO contato -> 1 conversa)
+  INSERT INTO public.messages (id, contact_id, sender, content, message_type, is_read, created_at) VALUES
+    (v_msg_m1, v_contact_vis, 'contact', 'm1 nao lida (nulo)', 'text', NULL,  v_t_base - interval '2 hours'),
+    (v_msg_m2, v_contact_vis, 'contact', 'm2 nao lida',        'text', false, v_t_base - interval '1 hour'),
+    (v_msg_m3, v_contact_vis, 'agent',   'm3 do agente',       'text', true,  v_t_base - interval '30 minutes'),
+    (v_msg_m4, v_contact_vis, 'contact', 'm4 lida',            'text', true,  v_t_base - interval '15 minutes'),
+    (v_msg_m5, v_contact_vis, 'contact', 'm5 nao lida (nulo)', 'text', NULL,  v_t_base);
+  -- contato do agente B: 1 nao lida, so visivel para B (e para o admin)
+  INSERT INTO public.messages (id, contact_id, sender, content, message_type, is_read, created_at) VALUES
+    (v_msg_b1, v_contact_oculto, 'contact', 'b1 nao lida', 'text', NULL, v_t_base);
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T1/T4/T5
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_total;
+  IF v_total <> v_base_a + 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1/T4 FALHOU: agente A esperava % (base+1) e veio %', v_base_a + 1, v_total;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- T5: contato visivel sem mensagem nao infla (ja' coberto: contato_vazio existe e
+  -- o total acima continua base+1). Prova explicita: so o contato vazio -> 0 se nada
+  -- mais houvesse. Aqui apenas confirmamos que ele nao somou (o total acima e' base+1).
+
+  -- T2: admin ve as duas conversas com nao lida (do A e do B) alem da base do seed.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_admin)::text, true);
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_total;
+  IF v_total <> v_base_admin + 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: admin esperava % (base+2) e veio %', v_base_admin + 2, v_total;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- T3: marcar como lida a conversa do A reduz o total do admin para base+1 (so' B).
+  UPDATE public.messages SET is_read = true
+   WHERE contact_id = v_contact_vis AND sender = 'contact' AND is_read IS NOT TRUE;
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_total;
+  IF v_total <> v_base_admin + 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: apos marcar como lida o admin esperava % e veio %', v_base_admin + 1, v_total;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_total;
+  IF v_total <> v_base_a THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: agente A apos marcar como lida esperava % e veio %', v_base_a, v_total;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T2b ACL
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.inbox_unread_total()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2b FALHOU: anon com EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.inbox_unread_total()', 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2b FALHOU: authenticated SEM EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.inbox_unread_total()', 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2b FALHOU: service_role SEM EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'anon', true);
+  v_barrado := false;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.inbox_unread_total();
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    v_barrado := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_barrado = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2b FALHOU: anon conseguiu chamar a RPC';
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  BEGIN
+    SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_total;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2b FALHOU: authenticated nao conseguiu chamar a RPC';
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_total <> v_base_a THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2b FALHOU: authenticated esperava % e veio %', v_base_a, v_total;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T7 escala
+  -- 3.650 contatos do agente A, cada um com 1 nao lida (mesma regra do cliente).
+  INSERT INTO public.contacts (id, name, phone, assigned_to)
+  SELECT ('55555555-5555-5555-5555-' || lpad(g::text, 12, '0'))::uuid,
+         'Contato escala ' || g,
+         '55119' || lpad(g::text, 8, '0'),
+         v_profile_a
+  FROM generate_series(1, 3650) AS g;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.messages (id, contact_id, sender, content, message_type, is_read, created_at)
+  SELECT ('66666666-6666-6666-6666-' || lpad(g::text, 12, '0'))::uuid,
+         ('55555555-5555-5555-5555-' || lpad(g::text, 12, '0'))::uuid,
+         'contact', 'escala', 'text', NULL, v_t_base
+  FROM generate_series(1, 3650) AS g;
+
+  -- Agente A: 3.650 da escala (as dele ja' foram lidas no T3) + base (0) = 3.650.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  v_ms := extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp());
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_total;
+  v_ms := (extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) - v_ms) * 1000;
+  IF v_total <> v_base_a + 3650 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: agente A com 3.650 contatos esperava % e veio %', v_base_a + 3650, v_total;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T7 escala (agente A, 3.650 contatos): total=% em % ms', v_total, round(v_ms, 1);
+
+  -- Admin: base + 3.650 (escala) + 1 (contato do B, ainda nao lido) = base + 3.651.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_admin)::text, true);
+  v_ms := extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp());
+  SELECT public.inbox_unread_total() INTO v_total;
+  v_ms := (extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) - v_ms) * 1000;
+  IF v_total <> v_base_admin + 3651 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: admin com 3.650 contatos esperava % e veio %', v_base_admin + 3651, v_total;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T7 escala (admin, % conversas): total=% em % ms', v_base_admin + 3651, v_total, round(v_ms, 1);
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'inbox_unread_total: suite OK (T1 visibilidade do agente, T2 admin ve todas, T3 ler reduz, T2b ACL, T4 is_read nulo, T5 contato sem mensagem, T7 escala 3.650) ‚Äî % grupo(s)', v_ok;
+END $inbox_unread_total$;
+
+ROLLBACK;

+-- Teste SQL da RPC public.inbox_wait_summary (metricas de espera da inbox por fila).
+--
+-- O que prova (o contrato que o front vai consumir no lugar da amostra de 500):
+--   T1  VISIBILIDADE: contato fora do escopo do chamador nao entra em nenhuma
+--       metrica (mesma trava de is_contact_visible_to_user); o agente B nao ve
+--       as conversas do agente A;
+--   T2  ACL: anon/PUBLIC sem EXECUTE; authenticated e service_role com EXECUTE.
+--       Prova funcional: como `anon` a chamada e barrada; como `authenticated`
+--       responde;
+--   T3  METRICAS por grupo: "aguardando" conta so conversation_status='waiting';
+--       max_wait_seconds e a MAIOR espera atual entre os aguardando;
+--       avg_open_seconds e a media entre as conversas EM ABERTO (open+waiting);
+--   T4  GUARDA DE ATIVIDADE (ADR-005, passo 3): contato open/waiting SEM nenhuma
+--       mensagem nao conta como conversa;
+--   T5  SOFT-DELETE: contato com deleted_at preenchido fica fora;
+--   T6  POR FILA: uma linha por fila (inclusive queue_id NULL) e p_queue_id
+--       estreita para exatamente uma fila; fila sem conversa visivel => 0 linhas;
+--   T7  SEGURANCA da propria funcao: SECURITY DEFINER com search_path fixo.
+--
+-- COMO RODAR (banco LOCAL da tarefa, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <conjunto> -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/inbox_wait_summary.sql
+--
+-- Cria dados SINTETICOS (usuarios, perfis, filas, contatos e mensagens) e desfaz
+-- tudo no ROLLBACK final: nao sobra linha no banco. Sem EXCEPTION = suite verde.
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $inbox_wait_summary$
+DECLARE
+  -- usuarios/perfis sinteticos
+  v_user_a        uuid := '11111111-1111-1111-1111-1111111111a1';
+  v_user_b        uuid := '11111111-1111-1111-1111-1111111111b2';
+  v_profile_a     uuid;
+  v_profile_b     uuid;
+  -- filas sinteticas
+  v_queue_a       uuid := '22222222-2222-2222-2222-2222222222a1';
+  v_queue_b       uuid := '22222222-2222-2222-2222-2222222222b2';
+  -- contatos sinteticos
+  v_w1            uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330001';
+  v_w2            uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330002';
+  v_o1            uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330003';
+  v_sem_msg       uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330004';
+  v_apagado       uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330005';
+  v_oculto        uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330006';
+  v_h1            uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330007';
+  v_x1            uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330008';
+  -- mensagens (uma por contato que conta; sender 'contact')
+  v_msg           uuid;
+  v_ok            int := 0;
+  v_linhas        int;
+  v_waiting       int;
+  v_max           bigint;
+  v_avg           bigint;
+  v_barrado       boolean;
+  v_erro          boolean;
+BEGIN
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- dados
+  INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+    (v_user_a, 'inbox-wait-a@local.test'),
+    (v_user_b, 'inbox-wait-b@local.test');
+
+  -- O gatilho on_auth_user_created cria o perfil; o upsert cobre os dois mundos.
+  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, name) VALUES
+    (v_user_a, 'Agente A (sintetico)'),
+    (v_user_b, 'Agente B (sintetico)')
+  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name;
+
+  SELECT id INTO v_profile_a FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_user_a;
+  SELECT id INTO v_profile_b FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_user_b;
+  IF v_profile_a IS NULL OR v_profile_b IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture invalida: perfil sintetico nao encontrado (% / %)',
+      v_profile_a, v_profile_b;
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.queues (id, name, color) VALUES
+    (v_queue_a, 'Fila A (sintetica)', '#111111'),
+    (v_queue_b, 'Fila B (sintetica)', '#222222');
+
+  -- updated_at explicito (offset em minutos relativo a now(), que e estavel na
+  -- transacao): os segundos esperados saem exatos.
+  INSERT INTO public.contacts
+    (id, name, phone, assigned_to, queue_id, conversation_status, updated_at, deleted_at)
+  VALUES
+    (v_w1,      'W1 aguardando fila A',  '5511000000901', v_profile_a, v_queue_a, 'waiting', now() - interval '30 minutes', NULL),
+    (v_w2,      'W2 aguardando fila A',  '5511000000902', v_profile_a, v_queue_a, 'waiting', now() - interval '10 minutes', NULL),
+    (v_o1,      'O1 aberta fila A',      '5511000000903', v_profile_a, v_queue_a, 'open',    now() - interval '5 minutes',  NULL),
+    (v_sem_msg, 'S1 aguardando sem msg', '5511000000904', v_profile_a, v_queue_a, 'waiting', now() - interval '99 minutes', NULL),
+    (v_apagado, 'D1 aguardando apagado', '5511000000905', v_profile_a, v_queue_a, 'waiting', now() - interval '80 minutes', now() - interval '1 minute'),
+    (v_oculto,  'X9 aguardando do B',    '5511000000906', v_profile_b, v_queue_a, 'waiting', now() - interval '20 minutes', NULL),
+    (v_h1,      'H1 aguardando fila B',  '5511000000907', v_profile_a, v_queue_b, 'waiting', now() - interval '50 minutes', NULL),
+    (v_x1,      'X1 aberta sem fila',    '5511000000908', v_profile_a, NULL,      'open',    now() - interval '1 minute',   NULL);
+
+  -- Uma mensagem por contato que deve contar; v_sem_msg fica SEM mensagem.
+  FOR v_msg IN
+    SELECT id FROM public.contacts
+     WHERE id IN (v_w1, v_w2, v_o1, v_apagado, v_oculto, v_h1, v_x1)
+  LOOP
+    INSERT INTO public.messages (id, contact_id, sender, content, message_type, created_at)
+    VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), v_msg, 'contact', 'msg sintetica', 'text', now() - interval '1 minute');
+  END LOOP;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T1/T3/T4/T5/T6
+  -- Como A (agente comum: so ve o que esta atribuido a ele), no PAPEL REAL
+  -- `authenticated` ‚Äî nao como postgres: e o papel com que a RPC roda no app.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+
+  -- Tres grupos: fila A, fila B e "sem fila" (queue_id NULL).
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_linhas FROM public.inbox_wait_summary();
+  IF v_linhas <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: esperava 3 grupos (fila A, fila B, sem fila) e veio %', v_linhas;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Fila A: aguardando = W1 + W2 (S1 sem msg e D1 apagado NAO contam; X9 e do B).
+  SELECT waiting_count, max_wait_seconds, avg_open_seconds
+    INTO v_waiting, v_max, v_avg
+    FROM public.inbox_wait_summary()
+   WHERE queue_id = v_queue_a AND queue_id IS NOT NULL;
+  IF v_waiting <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3/T4/T5 FALHOU: fila A deveria ter 2 aguardando (sem-msg e apagado fora) e veio %', v_waiting;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_max <> 1800 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: maior espera da fila A deveria ser 1800s (W1, 30min) e veio %', v_max;
+  END IF;
+  -- media em aberto: (1800 + 600 + 300) / 3 = 900
+  IF v_avg <> 900 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: media em aberto da fila A deveria ser 900s e veio %', v_avg;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- Fila B: so H1 (50 min).
+  SELECT waiting_count, max_wait_seconds, avg_open_seconds
+    INTO v_waiting, v_max, v_avg
+    FROM public.inbox_wait_summary()
+   WHERE queue_id = v_queue_b;
+  IF v_waiting <> 1 OR v_max <> 3000 OR v_avg <> 3000 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: fila B esperava 1 aguardando / 3000s / 3000s e veio % / % / %',
+      v_waiting, v_max, v_avg;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- Grupo sem fila: X1 aberta (1 min), nenhum aguardando (max NULO).
+  SELECT waiting_count, max_wait_seconds, avg_open_seconds
+    INTO v_waiting, v_max, v_avg
+    FROM public.inbox_wait_summary()
+   WHERE queue_id IS NULL;
+  IF v_waiting <> 0 OR v_max IS NOT NULL OR v_avg <> 60 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: grupo sem fila esperava 0 / NULO / 60s e veio % / % / %',
+      v_waiting, v_max, v_avg;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;

+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T6 (p_queue_id)
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_linhas FROM public.inbox_wait_summary(v_queue_a);
+  IF v_linhas <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: p_queue_id=fila A deveria devolver 1 linha e veio %', v_linhas;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- p_queue_id=v_queue_b devolve so a fila B (H1, do proprio A).
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_linhas FROM public.inbox_wait_summary(v_queue_b);
+  IF v_linhas <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: p_queue_id=fila B deveria devolver 1 linha e veio %', v_linhas;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Fila sem contato visivel (uuid que nao existe) => nenhuma linha.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_linhas FROM public.inbox_wait_summary('99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999');
+  IF v_linhas <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: fila inexistente nao deveria devolver linha (% linha(s))', v_linhas;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;

+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T1 (visibilidade)
+  -- Como B (tambem no papel `authenticated`): enxerga apenas X9 (o contato do B), na fila A.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_b)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_linhas FROM public.inbox_wait_summary();
+  IF v_linhas <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: B deveria ver so 1 grupo (fila A do proprio B) e veio %', v_linhas;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT waiting_count, max_wait_seconds
+    INTO v_waiting, v_max
+    FROM public.inbox_wait_summary()
+   WHERE queue_id = v_queue_a;
+  IF v_waiting <> 1 OR v_max <> 1200 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: B deveria ver 1 aguardando / 1200s (X9, 20min) e veio % / %',
+      v_waiting, v_max;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T2 (ACL)
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.inbox_wait_summary(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: anon com EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.inbox_wait_summary(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: authenticated SEM EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.inbox_wait_summary(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: service_role SEM EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Prova funcional: como `anon` a chamada e barrada de verdade.
+  -- (volta ao papel do script para poder assumir `anon`: `authenticated` nao e membro de `anon`.)
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'anon', true);
+  v_barrado := false;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM 1 FROM public.inbox_wait_summary();

+    v_barrado := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_barrado = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: anon conseguiu chamar a RPC';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Controle positivo: como `authenticated` a RPC responde (GRANT correto).
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_erro := false;
+  BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_linhas FROM public.inbox_wait_summary();
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v_erro := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_erro OR v_linhas <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: authenticated nao conseguiu chamar a RPC (erro=%, linhas=%)',
+      v_erro, v_linhas;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T7 (seguranca)
+  IF (SELECT prosecdef FROM pg_proc WHERE oid = 'public.inbox_wait_summary(uuid)'::regprocedure) = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: a RPC nao e SECURITY DEFINER';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc
+     WHERE oid = 'public.inbox_wait_summary(uuid)'::regprocedure
+       AND proconfig IS NOT NULL
+       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(proconfig) cfg WHERE cfg LIKE 'search_path=%')
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: a RPC nao tem search_path fixo';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'inbox_wait_summary: suite OK (T1 visibilidade, T2 ACL anon/authenticated, T3 metricas por grupo, T4 guarda ADR-005 sem mensagem, T5 soft-delete, T6 por fila + p_queue_id, T7 SECURITY DEFINER/search_path) ‚Äî % grupo(s) verificado(s)', v_ok;
+END $inbox_wait_summary$;
+
+ROLLBACK;

+-- Suite SQL da reabertura de conversa no inbound (ADR-005 ¬ß3).
+--
+-- O que prova (contrato do corpo vigente de public.ingest_inbound_message, migration
+-- 20260905070000, recriado por 20261014160000_ingest_inbound_message_reabre_conversa):
+--   T1  contato 'resolved' + mensagem inbound NOVA volta para 'open' na hora, com
+--       conversation_status_changed_at renovado ‚Äî e o assigned_to NAO muda;
+--   T2  contato 'archived' + inbound NOVO volta para 'open';
+--   T3  contato ja 'open' recebe inbound novo, mas mantem conversation_status_changed_at
+--       (nao "reabre" o que ja estava aberto) e o assigned_to;
+--   T4  com a flag inbox.status-fsm DESLIGADA nada reabre (contato fica 'resolved');
+--   T5  redelivery do MESMO external_id (outcome 'updated') NAO reabre: contato que foi
+--       arquivado de novo continua 'archived' e nao duplica mensagem;
+--   T6  ACL preservada: anon/authenticated/PUBLIC sem EXECUTE, so service_role com EXECUTE
+--       (flag e prova funcional);
+--   T7  a funcao continua sem SECURITY DEFINER e com search_path = public.
+--
+-- COMO RODAR (banco LOCAL da tarefa, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <conjunto> -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/ingest_inbound_message_reabre_conversa.sql
+--
+-- Dados SINTETICOS (UUIDs/telefones de faixa de teste); tudo desfeito no ROLLBACK.
+-- Sem EXCEPTION = suite verde.
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $ingest_reabre$
+DECLARE
+  v_conn        uuid := 'aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+  v_user        uuid := '11111111-1111-1111-1111-1111111111a1';
+  v_profile     uuid;
+  c_res         uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330001';
+  c_arch        uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330002';
+  c_open        uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330003';
+  c_flag        uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330004';
+  c_dup         uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333330005';
+  v_t0          timestamptz := now() - interval '10 days';
+  v_sig         text := 'public.ingest_inbound_message(uuid,text,text,text,text,text,text,timestamptz)';
+  v_ok          int := 0;
+  v_outcome     text;
+  v_status      text;
+  v_changed     timestamptz;
+  v_changed_before timestamptz;
+  v_assigned    uuid;
+  v_msgs        bigint;
+  v_barrado     boolean;
+  v_definer     boolean;
+  v_conf        text[];
+BEGIN
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- dados
+  INSERT INTO public.whatsapp_connections (id, name, phone_number, capabilities)
+  VALUES (v_conn, 'Conexao sintetica (suite)', '+5511000003000', '{}'::jsonb);
+
+  INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES (v_user, 'ingest-reabre@local.test');
+  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, name) VALUES (v_user, 'Agente reabre (sintetico)')
+  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name;
+  SELECT id INTO v_profile FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_user;
+  IF v_profile IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture invalida: perfil sintetico nao encontrado';
+  END IF;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.contacts
+    (id, name, phone, whatsapp_connection_id, assigned_to, conversation_status, conversation_status_changed_at)
+  VALUES
+    (c_res,  'Contato resolvido',  '5511000003001', v_conn, v_profile, 'resolved', v_t0),
+    (c_arch, 'Contato arquivado',  '5511000003002', v_conn, v_profile, 'archived', v_t0),
+    (c_open, 'Contato aberto',     '5511000003003', v_conn, v_profile, 'open',     v_t0),
+    (c_flag, 'Contato flag off',   '5511000003004', v_conn, v_profile, 'resolved', v_t0),
+    (c_dup,  'Contato redelivery', '5511000003005', v_conn, v_profile, 'archived', v_t0);
+
+  -- Fixture determinista: o gatilho de auto-atribuicao nao pode ter mexido no que
+  -- este teste mede. Se mexeu, a suite falha no setup (nao esconde o defeito).
+  SELECT conversation_status, conversation_status_changed_at
+    INTO v_status, v_changed FROM public.contacts WHERE id = c_res;
+  IF v_status <> 'resolved' OR v_changed <> v_t0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture invalida: c_res ficou % / %', v_status, v_changed;
+  END IF;
+
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- T1
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  SELECT t.outcome INTO v_outcome
+    FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003001', 'Contato resolvido',
+         'primeira resposta depois do encerramento', 'text', NULL, 'ext-res-1', now()) t;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  IF v_outcome <> 'inserted' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: outcome esperado inserted, veio %', v_outcome;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT conversation_status, conversation_status_changed_at, assigned_to
+    INTO v_status, v_changed, v_assigned FROM public.contacts WHERE id = c_res;
+  IF v_status <> 'open' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: contato resolvido nao reabriu (status=%)', v_status;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_changed <= v_t0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: conversation_status_changed_at nao foi renovado (% <= %)', v_changed, v_t0;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_assigned IS DISTINCT FROM v_profile THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: assigned_to mudou (% -> %)', v_profile, v_assigned;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- T2
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  SELECT t.outcome INTO v_outcome
+    FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003002', 'Contato arquivado',
+         'voltou a falar', 'text', NULL, 'ext-arch-1', now()) t;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  IF v_outcome <> 'inserted' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: outcome esperado inserted, veio %', v_outcome;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT conversation_status, conversation_status_changed_at
+    INTO v_status, v_changed FROM public.contacts WHERE id = c_arch;
+  IF v_status <> 'open' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: contato arquivado nao reabriu (status=%)', v_status;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_changed <= v_t0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: changed_at nao renovado (% <= %)', v_changed, v_t0;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- T3
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  SELECT t.outcome INTO v_outcome
+    FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003003', 'Contato aberto',
+         'mensagem em conversa aberta', 'text', NULL, 'ext-open-1', now()) t;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  IF v_outcome <> 'inserted' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: outcome esperado inserted, veio %', v_outcome;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT conversation_status, conversation_status_changed_at, assigned_to
+    INTO v_status, v_changed, v_assigned FROM public.contacts WHERE id = c_open;
+  IF v_status <> 'open' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: contato aberto mudou de status (%)', v_status;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_changed <> v_t0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: changed_at de contato ja aberto foi reescrito (% <> %)', v_changed, v_t0;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_assigned IS DISTINCT FROM v_profile THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: assigned_to mudou em contato aberto';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- T4 (flag desligada)
+  UPDATE public.feature_flags SET enabled = false WHERE key = 'inbox.status-fsm';
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  SELECT t.outcome INTO v_outcome
+    FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003004', 'Contato flag off',
+         'inbound com flag desligada', 'text', NULL, 'ext-flag-1', now()) t;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  UPDATE public.feature_flags SET enabled = true WHERE key = 'inbox.status-fsm';
+
+  IF v_outcome <> 'inserted' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: outcome esperado inserted, veio %', v_outcome;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT conversation_status, conversation_status_changed_at
+    INTO v_status, v_changed FROM public.contacts WHERE id = c_flag;
+  IF v_status <> 'resolved' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: com a flag desligada o contato reabriu (status=%)', v_status;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_changed <> v_t0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: changed_at mexeu com a flag desligada';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- T5 (redelivery mesmo external_id)
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  SELECT t.outcome INTO v_outcome
+    FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003005', 'Contato redelivery',
+         'mensagem 1', 'text', NULL, 'ext-dup-1', now()) t;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_outcome <> 'inserted' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU(pre): primeira entrega esperava inserted, veio %', v_outcome;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Arquivado de novo antes da reentrega (open -> archived e transicao valida; o gatilho
+  -- FSM carimba changed_at = now(), entao guardamos o valor para comparar depois).
+  UPDATE public.contacts
+     SET conversation_status = 'archived', conversation_status_changed_at = v_t0
+   WHERE id = c_dup;
+  SELECT conversation_status_changed_at INTO v_changed_before
+    FROM public.contacts WHERE id = c_dup;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  SELECT t.outcome INTO v_outcome
+    FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003005', 'Contato redelivery',
+         'mensagem 1', 'text', NULL, 'ext-dup-1', now()) t;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  IF v_outcome <> 'updated' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: reentrega do mesmo external_id esperava updated, veio %', v_outcome;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT conversation_status, conversation_status_changed_at
+    INTO v_status, v_changed FROM public.contacts WHERE id = c_dup;
+  IF v_status <> 'archived' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: redelivery reabriu o contato (status=%)', v_status;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_changed <> v_changed_before THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: redelivery tocou changed_at (% <> %)', v_changed, v_changed_before;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_msgs FROM public.messages WHERE contact_id = c_dup;
+  IF v_msgs <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: redelivery duplicou mensagem (% linhas)', v_msgs;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- T6 (ACL)
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', v_sig, 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: anon com EXECUTE';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', v_sig, 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: authenticated com EXECUTE';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('service_role', v_sig, 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: service_role SEM EXECUTE';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p,
+         aclexplode(p.proacl) a
+    WHERE p.proname = 'ingest_inbound_message'
+      AND a.grantee = 0 AND a.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE'
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: PUBLIC com EXECUTE';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Prova funcional: anon e authenticated sao barrados de verdade.
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'anon', true);
+  v_barrado := false;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM 1 FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003001', 'x', 'x', 'text', NULL, 'x-anon', now());
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    v_barrado := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_barrado = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: anon conseguiu chamar a RPC';
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_barrado := false;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM 1 FROM public.ingest_inbound_message(v_conn, '5511000003001', 'x', 'x', 'text', NULL, 'x-auth', now());
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    v_barrado := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_barrado = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: authenticated conseguiu chamar a RPC';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  ---------------------------------------------------------------- T7 (forma da funcao)
+  SELECT prosecdef, proconfig INTO v_definer, v_conf
+    FROM pg_proc
+   WHERE proname = 'ingest_inbound_message'
+     AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(oid) = 'p_connection_id uuid, p_phone text, p_push_name text, p_content text, p_message_type text, p_media_url text, p_external_id text, p_created_at timestamp with time zone';
+  IF v_definer IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: funcao virou SECURITY DEFINER (%)', v_definer;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_conf IS NULL OR NOT ('search_path=public' = ANY(v_conf)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: search_path public ausente (%)', v_conf;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'ingest_inbound_message_reabre_conversa: suite OK (T1 resolved, T2 archived, T3 open preserva changed_at, T4 flag off, T5 redelivery, T6 ACL, T7 forma) ‚Äî % grupo(s)', v_ok;
+END $ingest_reabre$;

+ROLLBACK;

+-- instance_auth_event_series ‚Äî prova da serie de eventos de auth por instancia
+-- (cartao t_e75e24e9, filho do IP2 t_3ca58cb7).
+--
+-- O QUE PROVA:
+--   1) '24h' soma 5 eventos (A=4: auth 2/disc 1/err 0; B=1: err 1); o de 30 h fica fora;
+--   2) '7d' soma 7 (A=5: auth 3/disc 1; B=2: err 2); o de 9 d fica fora;
+--   3) sem argumento = '24h'; chaves exatas do resultado; so contagens;
+--   4) admin passa; agent e anon recebem 42501; '30d'/NULL/'7D' recebem 22023;
+--   5) ACL: EXECUTE para authenticated, nao para anon/PUBLIC;
+--   6) o `-- Rollback:` da migration executa, remove a funcao, e ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT restaura.
+--
+-- COMO RODA (banco LOCAL do cartao, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <nome-do-conjunto> < supabase/tests/instance_auth_event_series.sql
+-- Papel real: request.jwt.claims + SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated/anon. Termina em ROLLBACK.

+    FROM public.instance_auth_event_series('24h') WHERE instance = 'itest-A';
+  IF v_a IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[2, 1, 0, 4] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '24h A: % (esperado {2,1,0,4})', v_a; END IF;
+  SELECT ARRAY[sum(auth_failures), sum(disconnected), sum(errors), sum(total)]::int[] INTO v_b
+    FROM public.instance_auth_event_series('24h') WHERE instance = 'itest-B';
+  IF v_b IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[0, 0, 1, 1] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '24h B: % (esperado {0,0,1,1})', v_b; END IF;

+  SELECT ARRAY[sum(auth_failures), sum(disconnected), sum(errors), sum(total)]::int[] INTO v_b

+  -- janela invalida (admin): 22023
+  FOREACH v_w IN ARRAY ARRAY['30d', '7D', '']::text[] LOOP
