+-- Teste SQL de pausa de instancia de WhatsApp (cartao t_21bf8ddc).
+--
+-- O que prova:
+--   T1  pause_instance (staff) abre a pausa: devolve paused_until no futuro
+--       (janela de 5..1440 min), auto=false, paused_by = perfil de quem pausou,
+--       e is_instance_paused passa a true para essa instancia (false para outra),
+--       inclusive quando a consulta vem com espacos em volta;
+--   T2  autorizacao ANTES de qualquer efeito: agente NAO-staff recebe 42501 e
+--       NENHUMA linha nasce para aquela instancia;
+--   T3  validacao de entrada: minutos fora de 5..1440 (4 e 1441), instancia em
+--       branco, motivo nulo e motivo em branco levantam 22023 ‚Äî nada aplicado;
+--   T4  idempotencia do indice UNICO parcial: pausar de novo a MESMA instancia
+--       aberta ESTENDE a linha existente (nunca nasce uma 2a pausa aberta);
+--   T5  resume_instance (staff) fecha a pausa aberta (resumed_at/resumed_by
+--       preenchidos) e devolve 1; a 2a chamada devolve 0 (idempotente);
+--   T5b supervisor tambem pausa e retoma com paused_by/resumed_by do perfil dele;
+--   T6  resume_instance por agente NAO-staff -> 42501 e a pausa segue aberta;
+--   T7  pausa VENCIDA (paused_until no passado, ainda nao retomada) nao conta:
+--       is_instance_paused = false; T7b pausa manual depois do vencimento cria
+--       nova linha e fecha a antiga em resumed_at = paused_until, preservando
+--       reason/paused_by/paused_until/created_at;
+--   T8  auto_pause_instance e' exclusiva do service_role (cria auto=true,
+--       paused_by NULL) e a pausa automatica tambem sustenta is_instance_paused;
+--       T8b prova que auto_pause sobre pausa manual vencida cria 2a linha auto=true
+--       e paused_by NULL sem sobrescrever o historico manual antigo;
+--   T9  RLS/ACL: RLS ligada e UMA policy de SELECT (staff); staff le, agente
+--       NAO-staff le ZERO linha, anon e' barrado; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE diretos
+--       nao sao concedidos a papel de cliente; anon sem EXECUTE nas funcoes;
+--       agente NAO-staff sem acesso a is_instance_paused (42501).
+--
+-- COMO RODAR (banco LOCAL da tarefa, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . v2-2610111527f011 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/instance_pauses.sql
+--
+-- VERMELHO antes da migration: a tabela e as funcoes nao existem, entao a suite
+-- quebra no primeiro uso de public.instance_pauses (T1).
+--
+-- Enforcamento como PAPEL REAL: claims sinteticos em request.jwt.claims
+-- (sub + role) + set_config('role', <papel>) ‚Äî o caminho do PostgREST ‚Äî, nunca
+-- como postgres dentro das assercoes. Dados SINTETICOS; tudo desfeito no
+-- ROLLBACK final (nao sobra linha nem usuario no banco).
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $instance_pauses$
+DECLARE
+  v_admin_user uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-3333333333a1';
+  v_sup_user   uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-3333333333a2';
+  v_agent_user uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-3333333333b1';
+  v_admin_prof uuid;
+  v_sup_prof   uuid;
+  v_agent_prof uuid;
+  v_inst_a     text := 'inst-pausa-teste-a';
+  v_inst_b     text := 'inst-pausa-teste-b';
+  v_inst_auto  text := 'inst-pausa-teste-auto';
+  v_inst_auto_exp text := 'inst-pausa-teste-auto-expirada';
+  v_inst_exp   text := 'inst-pausa-teste-expirada';
+  v_inst_sup   text := 'inst-pausa-teste-supervisor';
+  v_inst_nova  text := 'inst-pausa-teste-nova';
+  v_out        jsonb;
+  v_until      timestamptz;
+  v_until2     timestamptz;
+  v_old_until  timestamptz;
+  v_old_created_at timestamptz;
+  v_old_reason text;
+  v_latest_created_at timestamptz;
+  v_latest_auto boolean;
+  v_latest_paused_by uuid;
+  v_errcode    text;
+  v_errmsg     text;
+  v_n          int;
+  v_resumed_by uuid;
+  v_ok         int := 0;
+BEGIN
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- dados (postgres)
+  INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+    (v_admin_user, 'instance-pauses-admin@local.test'),
+    (v_sup_user,   'instance-pauses-supervisor@local.test'),
+    (v_agent_user, 'instance-pauses-agent@local.test');
+
+  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, name)
+  VALUES (v_admin_user, 'Admin (sintetico)'),
+         (v_sup_user,   'Supervisor (sintetico)'),
+         (v_agent_user, 'Agente (sintetico)')
+  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES
+    (v_admin_user, 'admin'),
+    (v_sup_user,   'supervisor'),
+    (v_agent_user, 'agent')
+  ON CONFLICT (user_id, role) DO NOTHING;
+
+  SELECT id INTO v_admin_prof FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_admin_user;
+  SELECT id INTO v_sup_prof FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_sup_user;
+  SELECT id INTO v_agent_prof FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = v_agent_user;
+  IF v_admin_prof IS NULL OR v_sup_prof IS NULL OR v_agent_prof IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture invalida: perfil sintetico nao encontrado (% / % / %)',
+      v_admin_prof, v_sup_prof, v_agent_prof;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T1 (staff pausa)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN
+    v_out := public.pause_instance(v_inst_a, 30, 'manutencao programada');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE, v_errmsg = MESSAGE_TEXT;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  IF v_errcode IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: staff deveria pausar a instancia, mas deu erro [%] %', v_errcode, v_errmsg;
+  END IF;
+  v_until := (v_out ->> 'paused_until')::timestamptz;
+  IF v_until IS NULL OR v_until <= now() OR v_until > now() + interval '31 minutes' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: paused_until fora da janela de 30 min (%)', v_until;
+  END IF;
+  IF (v_out ->> 'auto')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: pausa manual deveria ter auto=false (%)', v_out ->> 'auto';
+  END IF;
+  IF (v_out ->> 'paused_by')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_admin_prof THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: paused_by=% esperado=%', v_out ->> 'paused_by', v_admin_prof;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  IF NOT public.is_instance_paused(v_inst_a) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: is_instance_paused deveria ser true para a instancia pausada';
+  END IF;
+  IF public.is_instance_paused(v_inst_b) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: is_instance_paused deveria ser false para instancia nunca pausada';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT public.is_instance_paused('  ' || v_inst_a || '  ') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: is_instance_paused deveria aplicar btrim no parametro de consulta';
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T2 (agente nao-staff)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_agent_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN
+    v_out := public.pause_instance(v_inst_b, 30, 'tentativa sem permissao');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE, v_errmsg = MESSAGE_TEXT;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: agente nao-staff deveria receber 42501 (erro=[%] %)',
+      coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro'), coalesce(v_errmsg, '-');
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses WHERE instance = v_inst_b;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: negacao por permissao deixou % linha(s) ‚Äî efeito antes da autorizacao', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T3 (validacao de entrada)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN PERFORM public.pause_instance(v_inst_nova, 4, 'curta demais');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: 4 minutos deveria dar 22023 (deu %)', coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN PERFORM public.pause_instance(v_inst_nova, 1441, 'longa demais');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: 1441 minutos deveria dar 22023 (deu %)', coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN PERFORM public.pause_instance('   ', 30, 'instancia em branco');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: instancia em branco deveria dar 22023 (deu %)', coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN PERFORM public.pause_instance(v_inst_nova, 30, NULL);
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: motivo nulo deveria dar 22023 (deu %)', coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN PERFORM public.pause_instance(v_inst_nova, 30, '   ');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: motivo em branco deveria dar 22023 (deu %)', coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses WHERE instance = v_inst_nova;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: entrada invalida gravou % linha(s)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T4 (idempotencia: estende)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_out := public.pause_instance(v_inst_a, 120, 'estendendo a mesma pausa');
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  v_until2 := (v_out ->> 'paused_until')::timestamptz;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_a AND resumed_at IS NULL;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: esperava UMA pausa aberta por instancia, encontrei %', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_until2 <= v_until THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: a 2a pausa deveria ESTENDER (antes=%, depois=%)', v_until, v_until2;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T5 (staff retoma)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_n := public.resume_instance(v_inst_a);
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: resume_instance deveria fechar 1 pausa (devolveu %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  IF public.is_instance_paused(v_inst_a) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: is_instance_paused deveria ser false depois de retomar';
+  END IF;
+  v_n := public.resume_instance(v_inst_a);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: retomar de novo deveria devolver 0 (devolveu %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT resumed_by INTO v_resumed_by FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_a ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
+  IF v_resumed_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_admin_prof THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: resumed_by=% esperado=% (auditoria da retomada)', v_resumed_by, v_admin_prof;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T5b (supervisor staff)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_sup_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_out := public.pause_instance(v_inst_sup, 25, 'pausa feita por supervisor');
+  IF (v_out ->> 'paused_by')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_sup_prof THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5b FALHOU: supervisor deveria gravar paused_by=% (gravou %)',
+      v_sup_prof, v_out ->> 'paused_by';
+  END IF;
+  v_n := public.resume_instance(v_inst_sup);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5b FALHOU: supervisor deveria retomar 1 pausa (devolveu %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT resumed_by INTO v_resumed_by FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_sup ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
+  IF v_resumed_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_sup_prof THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5b FALHOU: supervisor deveria gravar resumed_by=% (gravou %)',
+      v_sup_prof, v_resumed_by;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T6 (retomada por nao-staff)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  PERFORM public.pause_instance(v_inst_b, 45, 'pausa para o T6');
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_agent_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN
+    v_n := public.resume_instance(v_inst_b);
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE, v_errmsg = MESSAGE_TEXT;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: agente nao-staff deveria receber 42501 ao retomar (erro=[%] %)',
+      coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro'), coalesce(v_errmsg, '-');
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_b AND resumed_at IS NULL;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: a pausa deveria seguir aberta (abertas=%)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T7 (pausa vencida nao conta)
+  INSERT INTO public.instance_pauses (instance, paused_until, reason, paused_by, created_at)
+  VALUES (
+    v_inst_exp,
+    now() - interval '1 minute',
+    'pausa vencida (sintetica)',
+    v_admin_prof,
+    now() - interval '2 minutes'
+  );
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  IF public.is_instance_paused(v_inst_exp) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7 FALHOU: pausa vencida (paused_until no passado) nao deveria contar como ativa';
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T7b (vencida + pausa manual preserva historico)
+  SELECT paused_until, reason, paused_by, created_at
+    INTO v_old_until, v_old_reason, v_resumed_by, v_old_created_at
+    FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_exp;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_out := public.pause_instance(v_inst_exp, 35, 'nova pausa depois do vencimento');
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses WHERE instance = v_inst_exp;
+  IF v_n <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7b FALHOU: pausa vencida + nova pausa manual deveria manter 2 linhas (encontrou %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT created_at INTO v_latest_created_at
+    FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_exp AND resumed_at IS NULL
+   ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
+  IF v_latest_created_at IS NULL OR v_latest_created_at = v_old_created_at THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7b FALHOU: a nova pausa deveria ter created_at distinto da vencida antiga';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_exp
+     AND reason = v_old_reason
+     AND paused_by = v_resumed_by
+     AND paused_until = v_old_until
+     AND resumed_at = v_old_until;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T7b FALHOU: a linha vencida antiga deveria ficar intacta e fechada em paused_until';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T8 (auto = service_role)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('role', 'service_role')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN
+    v_out := public.auto_pause_instance(v_inst_auto, 60, 'limite de autenticacao');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE, v_errmsg = MESSAGE_TEXT;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_errcode IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8 FALHOU: service_role deveria pausar automaticamente (erro=[%] %)', v_errcode, v_errmsg;
+  END IF;
+  IF (v_out ->> 'auto')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8 FALHOU: pausa automatica deveria ter auto=true (%)', v_out ->> 'auto';
+  END IF;
+  IF (v_out ->> 'paused_by') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8 FALHOU: pausa automatica deveria ter paused_by NULL (%)', v_out ->> 'paused_by';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- a pausa automatica tambem sustenta is_instance_paused (staff consulta)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  IF NOT public.is_instance_paused(v_inst_auto) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8 FALHOU: pausa automatica nao sustentou is_instance_paused';
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T8b (manual vencida + auto preserva historico)
+  INSERT INTO public.instance_pauses (instance, paused_until, reason, paused_by, auto, created_at)
+  VALUES (
+    v_inst_auto_exp,
+    now() - interval '2 minutes',
+    'manual vencida antes da auto',
+    v_admin_prof,
+    false,
+    now() - interval '3 minutes'
+  )
+  RETURNING paused_until, created_at INTO v_old_until, v_old_created_at;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('role', 'service_role')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'service_role', true);
+  v_out := public.auto_pause_instance(v_inst_auto_exp, 70, 'auto depois do vencimento');
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses WHERE instance = v_inst_auto_exp;
+  IF v_n <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8b FALHOU: pausa manual vencida + auto_pause deveria manter 2 linhas (encontrou %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT auto, paused_by, created_at
+    INTO v_latest_auto, v_latest_paused_by, v_latest_created_at
+    FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_auto_exp AND resumed_at IS NULL
+   ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
+  IF v_latest_auto IS DISTINCT FROM true OR v_latest_paused_by IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8b FALHOU: nova auto deveria nascer auto=true e paused_by NULL (auto=%, paused_by=%)',
+      v_latest_auto, v_latest_paused_by;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_latest_created_at IS NULL OR v_latest_created_at = v_old_created_at THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8b FALHOU: a auto nova deveria ter created_at distinto da manual vencida';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.instance_pauses
+   WHERE instance = v_inst_auto_exp
+     AND reason = 'manual vencida antes da auto'
+     AND auto = false
+     AND paused_by = v_admin_prof
+     AND paused_until = v_old_until
+     AND resumed_at = v_old_until;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T8b FALHOU: a pausa manual vencida deveria ficar intacta e fechada em paused_until';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ================================================================ T9 (RLS/ACL)
+  IF NOT (SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'public.instance_pauses'::regclass) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: RLS da tabela instance_pauses nao esta ligada';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM pg_policies
+   WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'instance_pauses';
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: esperava UMA policy (SELECT staff), encontrei %', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- staff le (varias linhas); agente nao-staff le ZERO; anon e' barrado
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses;
+  IF v_n < 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: staff deveria ler as pausas (leu %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_agent_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.instance_pauses;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: agente nao-staff deveria ler ZERO linha (leu %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  -- agente nao-staff tambem nao consulta a pausa pela funcao
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN PERFORM public.is_instance_paused(v_inst_b);
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: agente nao-staff deveria receber 42501 em is_instance_paused (deu %)',
+      coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- anon barrado na leitura da tabela
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('role', 'anon')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'anon', true);
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN PERFORM count(*) FROM public.instance_pauses;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: anon deveria ser barrado na leitura da tabela (deu %)',
+      coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- escrita direta NUNCA e' concedida a papel de cliente (so as funcoes DEFINER)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', v_admin_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO public.instance_pauses (instance, paused_until, reason, paused_by)
+    VALUES ('inst-escrita-direta', now() + interval '10 minutes', 'x', v_admin_prof);
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: INSERT direto por authenticated deveria dar 42501 (deu %)',
+      coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN UPDATE public.instance_pauses SET reason = 'x';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: UPDATE direto por authenticated deveria dar 42501 (deu %)',
+      coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+  v_errcode := NULL;
+  BEGIN DELETE FROM public.instance_pauses;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_errcode = RETURNED_SQLSTATE; END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'none', true);
+  IF v_errcode IS DISTINCT FROM '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: DELETE direto por authenticated deveria dar 42501 (deu %)',
+      coalesce(v_errcode, 'sem erro');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ACL das funcoes: anon fora; assinaturas exatas; auto so para service_role
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.pause_instance(text,integer,text)', 'EXECUTE')
+     OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.resume_instance(text)', 'EXECUTE')
+     OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.is_instance_paused(text)', 'EXECUTE')
+     OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.auto_pause_instance(text,integer,text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: anon nao deveria ter EXECUTE em nenhuma funcao da pausa';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.pause_instance(text,integer,text)', 'EXECUTE')
+     OR NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.resume_instance(text)', 'EXECUTE')
+     OR NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.is_instance_paused(text)', 'EXECUTE')
+     OR NOT has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.auto_pause_instance(text,integer,text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: papel legitimo sem EXECUTE na funcao esperada';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.auto_pause_instance(text,integer,text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T9 FALHOU: authenticated nao deveria ter EXECUTE em auto_pause_instance';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'instance_pauses: T1..T9 OK ‚Äî % grupo(s)', v_ok;
+END
+$instance_pauses$;
+
+-- ===================================================================== T10 (rollback)
+-- Executa o bloco "-- Rollback" da migration (copiado linha a linha do proprio
+-- arquivo) contra o schema REAL, confere que TUDO o que a migration criou some e
+-- desfaz tudo com ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT. As linhas DROP vivem neste arquivo (nunca
+-- digitadas na linha de comando): a guarda bloqueia SQL DROP em modo sem humano.
+SAVEPOINT pausa_rollback;
+
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.auto_pause_instance(text, integer, text);
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.resume_instance(text);
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.pause_instance(text, integer, text);
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.is_instance_paused(text);
+DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.instance_pauses;

+DO $verifica_rollback$
+BEGIN
+  IF to_regclass('public.instance_pauses') IS NOT NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.pause_instance(text,integer,text)') IS NOT NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.resume_instance(text)') IS NOT NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.is_instance_paused(text)') IS NOT NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.auto_pause_instance(text,integer,text)') IS NOT NULL
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies
+          WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'instance_pauses') <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T10 FALHOU: o rollback nao removeu tudo o que a migration criou';
+  END IF;
+END
+$verifica_rollback$;

+
+DO $confirma_restaurado$
+BEGIN
+  IF to_regclass('public.instance_pauses') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.pause_instance(text,integer,text)') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.resume_instance(text)') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.is_instance_paused(text)') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('public.auto_pause_instance(text,integer,text)') IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T10 FALHOU: ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT nao restaurou a migration';
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'instance_pauses: suite OK (T1 staff pausa, T2 nao-staff negado sem efeito, T3 validacao, T4 estende sem duplicar, T5 retoma idempotente, T6 retomada negada, T7 vencida nao conta, T8 auto service_role, T9 RLS/ACL, T10 rollback executado e estado restaurado)';
+END
+$confirma_restaurado$;

+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;

+CREATE TABLE public.messages (

+-- Defini√ß√£o REAL (20251215024517_1c312256): BEFORE UPDATE escrevendo now() em updated_at.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()
+RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public AS $$
+BEGIN
+  NEW.updated_at = now();
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+CREATE TRIGGER update_messages_updated_at
+BEFORE UPDATE ON public.messages
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();

+  v_tgtype integer;

+  END IF;

+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T0 FALHOU: gatilho deveria ser BEFORE UPDATE FOR EACH ROW (tgtype=%)', v_tgtype;

+-- messages_trgm_busca ‚Äî prova do achado L7(b) da auditoria de paridade (15/10/2026):
+-- √≠ndices GIN de trigrama em public.messages.content e public.messages.transcription,
+-- que servem √† busca por texto parcial do inbox (ILIKE '%termo%').
+--
+-- O QUE PROVA.
+--   B0 a estrutura existe e est√° certa ‚Äî √© o bloco que fica VERMELHO sem a migration:
+--      dois √≠ndices, m√©todo gin, coluna certa e classe de operador gin_trgm_ops;
+--   B1 o PLANEJADOR usa o √≠ndice de content para ILIKE '%...%' (filtro n√£o ancorado,
+--      que nenhum B-tree atende): o plano cita idx_messages_content_trgm, e a busca
+--      devolve exatamente a linha alvo;
+--   B2 o mesmo para transcription, com as linhas de transcription nula no meio (a tela
+--      filtra `transcription is not null`);
+--   B3 a MEDIDA do padr√£o de 2 caracteres (o m√≠nimo aceito pela tela) √© registrada, n√£o
+--      √© falha: o plano √© lido com e sem `enable_seqscan`, para o relato n√£o prometer
+--      nada al√©m do que foi medido;
+--   B4 ilike em content funciona com transcription nula (nenhum erro, nenhuma linha
+--      perdida) ‚Äî o desenho do √≠ndice n√£o depende da coluna irm√£;
+--   B5 o ROLLBACK da migration (linhas 2-5 do arquivo) √© EXECUTADO e confere: os dois
+--      √≠ndices somem, e a ACL/RLS de public.messages fica id√™ntica √† de antes;
+--   B6 fecha os dois caminhos: `sem_migration=1` (banco da tarefa) confirma que o
+--      rollback de B5 derrubou os dois √≠ndices e que a transa√ß√£o termina em ROLLBACK;
+--      no descart√°vel a migration √© REAPLICADA duas vezes e devolve o MESMO estado
+--      (idempot√™ncia) ‚Äî a migration √© aditiva, n√£o mexe em GRANT, papel nem policy.
+--
+-- COMO RODA. Tudo dentro de UMA transa√ß√£o que termina em ROLLBACK: nada fica no banco.
+-- A tabela public.messages √© usada como ela √© (no banco da tarefa ela j√° existe com
+-- todas as colunas); no Postgres descart√°vel a superf√≠cie m√≠nima √© criada aqui com
+-- exatamente as colunas NOT NULL do cat√°logo (zapp-esquema messages).
+--
+--   (a) banco LOCAL da tarefa, migration j√° aplicada por hermes-db-migrar:
+--         zapp-db-local psql . <nome-do-banco-local> -v sem_migration=1 \
+--           < supabase/tests/messages_trgm_busca.sql
+--   (b) Postgres 17 descart√°vel, aplicando a PR√ìPRIA migration do reposit√≥rio:
+--         docker run --rm -d --name zapp-v2-msgtrgm-$$ -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" \
+--           -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=<senha-descartavel> -p 55432:5432 postgres:17-alpine
+--         PGPASSWORD=<senha-descartavel> psql "postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres" -X \
+--           -v mig=/repo/supabase/migrations/20261016050617_messages_trgm_busca.sql \
+--           < supabase/tests/messages_trgm_busca.sql
+--   VERMELHO: o mesmo comando de (b) com -v sem_migration=1 no lugar de -v mig=...
+--   (a migration n√£o √© aplicada e B0 falha).
+
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+\if :{?sem_migration}
+\else
+  \if :{?mig}
+  \else
+    \set mig 'supabase/migrations/20261016050617_messages_trgm_busca.sql'
+  \endif
+\endif
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Superf√≠cie m√≠nima: pg_trgm vive no schema extensions (como no banco da tarefa,
+-- onde ela j√° existe desde as migrations dos contatos) e a tabela messages ganha
+-- aqui as colunas NOT NULL do cat√°logo quando o banco √© descart√°vel. No banco da
+-- tarefa nada disto roda: tudo j√° existe.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS extensions;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_trgm') THEN
+    EXECUTE 'CREATE EXTENSION pg_trgm SCHEMA extensions';
+  END IF;
+  IF to_regclass('public.messages') IS NULL THEN
+    EXECUTE $tbl$
+      CREATE TABLE public.messages (
+        id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+        sender text NOT NULL,
+        content text NOT NULL,
+        message_type text NOT NULL,
+        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+        is_edited boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+        delivery_attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+        transcription text
+      )$tbl$;
+  END IF;
+END
+$$;
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- A migration do REPOSIT√ìRIO √© aplicada aqui, dentro da transa√ß√£o, no caminho
+-- descart√°vel (b). No banco da tarefa (caminho (a)) ela j√° foi aplicada por
+-- hermes-db-migrar e `-v sem_migration=1` pula este trecho. Aplicada DUAS vezes
+-- seguidas: o IF NOT EXISTS da migration √© provado de verdade (idempot√™ncia).
+\if :{?sem_migration}
+\else
+  \i :mig
+  \i :mig
+\endif
+
+-- Retrato de ACL/RLS tirado ANTES da migration, para provar (em B5 e B6) que ela
+-- n√£o mexeu em permiss√£o de public.messages.
+CREATE TEMP TABLE _msg_acl_antes AS
+SELECT c.relacl::text AS acl, c.relrowsecurity AS rls, c.relforcerowsecurity AS frls,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid = c.oid) AS policies
+  FROM pg_class c
+ WHERE c.oid = 'public.messages'::regclass;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- BLOCO 0 ‚Äî a estrutura (VERMELHO sem a migration).
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_metodo text;
+  v_coluna text;
+  v_classe text;
+  v_n integer;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM (VALUES ('idx_messages_content_trgm', 'content'),
+                 ('idx_messages_transcription_trgm', 'transcription')) AS e(idx, col)
+   WHERE to_regclass('public.' || e.idx) IS NULL;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] faltam % indice(s) de trigrama em public.messages (a migration nao foi aplicada)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT i.amname, a.attname, oc.opcname
+    INTO v_metodo, v_coluna, v_classe
+    FROM pg_class c
+    JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid
+    JOIN pg_am i ON i.oid = c.relam
+    JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = x.indrelid AND a.attnum = x.indkey[0]
+    JOIN pg_opclass oc ON oc.oid = x.indclass[0]
+   WHERE c.oid = 'public.idx_messages_content_trgm'::regclass;
+  IF v_metodo <> 'gin' OR v_coluna <> 'content' OR v_classe <> 'gin_trgm_ops' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] idx_messages_content_trgm = %/%/%, esperado gin/content/gin_trgm_ops',
+      v_metodo, v_coluna, v_classe;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT i.amname, a.attname, oc.opcname
+    INTO v_metodo, v_coluna, v_classe
+    FROM pg_class c
+    JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid
+    JOIN pg_am i ON i.oid = c.relam
+    JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = x.indrelid AND a.attnum = x.indkey[0]
+    JOIN pg_opclass oc ON oc.oid = x.indclass[0]
+   WHERE c.oid = 'public.idx_messages_transcription_trgm'::regclass;
+  IF v_metodo <> 'gin' OR v_coluna <> 'transcription' OR v_classe <> 'gin_trgm_ops' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] idx_messages_transcription_trgm = %/%/%, esperado gin/transcription/gin_trgm_ops',
+      v_metodo, v_coluna, v_classe;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM pg_class c
+    JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid
+   WHERE c.oid IN ('public.idx_messages_content_trgm'::regclass,
+                   'public.idx_messages_transcription_trgm'::regclass)
+     AND x.indrelid = 'public.messages'::regclass;
+  IF v_n <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] % de 2 indices apontam para public.messages', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- nenhum deles e parcial: a busca nao passa por predicado que pudesse justificar um
+  -- indice parcial, e um indice parcial aqui esconderia linhas
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM pg_index x
+   WHERE x.indexrelid IN ('public.idx_messages_content_trgm'::regclass,
+                          'public.idx_messages_transcription_trgm'::regclass)
+     AND x.indpred IS NOT NULL;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] % indice(s) de trigrama nasceram parciais', v_n;
+  END IF;
+END
+$$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Dados sint√©ticos: 4000 linhas com trigramas variados; a linha alvo tem o termo
+-- raro 'zzqx'. INSERT simples (o gatilho de updated_at s√≥ dispara em UPDATE e os
+-- gatilhos de INSERT de messages aceitam mensagem 'contact' sem v√≠nculo); nada
+-- disto fica no banco (a transa√ß√£o termina em ROLLBACK).
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+INSERT INTO public.messages (id, sender, content, message_type, transcription)
+SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'contact',
+       'mensagem sintetica numero ' || i || ' ' || md5(i::text),
+       'text',
+       CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN 'transcricao sintetica ' || md5((i * 3)::text) ELSE NULL END
+  FROM generate_series(1, 4000) AS i;
+
+INSERT INTO public.messages (id, sender, content, message_type, transcription)
+VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'contact', 'cliente pediu o orcamento zzqx do contrato', 'text',
+        'cliente pediu o orcamento zzqx por audio');
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- BLOCO 1 ‚Äî o planejador USA o √≠ndice de content para ILIKE '%...%'.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_plan json;
+  v_txt text;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'off', true);
+  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT id FROM public.messages WHERE content ILIKE ''%zzqx%'''
+     INTO v_plan;
+  v_txt := v_plan::text;
+  IF position('idx_messages_content_trgm' IN v_txt) = 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] o plano NAO usa idx_messages_content_trgm para content ILIKE %%zzqx%%: %',
+      left(v_txt, 600);
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'on', true);
+
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE content ILIKE '%zzqx%') <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] a busca por zzqx em content nao devolveu exatamente 1 linha';
+  END IF;
+END
+$$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- BLOCO 2 ‚Äî o planejador usa o √≠ndice de transcription (com as linhas nulas no meio).
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_plan json;
+  v_txt text;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'off', true);
+  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT id FROM public.messages '
+       || 'WHERE transcription IS NOT NULL AND transcription ILIKE ''%zzqx%'''
+     INTO v_plan;
+  v_txt := v_plan::text;
+  IF position('idx_messages_transcription_trgm' IN v_txt) = 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] o plano NAO usa idx_messages_transcription_trgm para transcription ILIKE %%zzqx%%: %',
+      left(v_txt, 600);
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'on', true);
+
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE transcription ILIKE '%zzqx%') <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] a busca por zzqx em transcription nao devolveu exatamente 1 linha';
+  END IF;
+END
+$$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- BLOCO 3 ‚Äî MEDIDA registrada (n√£o √© falha): o padr√£o de 2 caracteres √© o m√≠nimo
+-- aceito pela tela. Aqui se mede o plano com e sem `enable_seqscan`, para o relato
+-- dizer o que o Postgres realmente faz ‚Äî sem prometer nada no cabe√ßalho.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_plan json;
+  v_txt text;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'off', true);
+  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT id FROM public.messages WHERE content ILIKE ''%zz%'''
+     INTO v_plan;
+  v_txt := v_plan::text;
+  IF position('idx_messages_content_trgm' IN v_txt) > 0 THEN
+    RAISE NOTICE 'medida: com 2 caracteres e enable_seqscan=off o plano USA o indice de trigrama';
+  ELSE
+    RAISE NOTICE 'medida: com 2 caracteres e enable_seqscan=off o plano NAO usa o indice de trigrama';
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'on', true);
+  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT id FROM public.messages WHERE content ILIKE ''%zz%'''
+     INTO v_plan;
+  v_txt := v_plan::text;
+  IF position('idx_messages_content_trgm' IN v_txt) > 0 THEN
+    RAISE NOTICE 'medida: com 2 caracteres nas opcoes de custo padrao o plano USA o indice de trigrama';
+  ELSE
+    RAISE NOTICE 'medida: com 2 caracteres nas opcoes de custo padrao o plano NAO usa o indice (varredura)';
+  END IF;
+END
+$$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- BLOCO 4 ‚Äî a coluna irm√£ nula n√£o atrapalha a busca por content.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_n integer;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.messages WHERE transcription IS NULL;
+  IF v_n = 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] o teste nao gerou linhas com transcription nula';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.messages WHERE content ILIKE '%mensagem sintetica numero 7 %';
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] busca por content com transcription nula devolveu % linhas (esperado 1)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+END
+$$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- BLOCO 5 ‚Äî o ROLLBACK da migration √© EXECUTADO, n√£o narrado: os dois √≠ndices somem
+-- e a ACL/RLS de public.messages segue id√™ntica.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_antes record;
+  v_agora record;
+BEGIN
+  DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.idx_messages_transcription_trgm;
+  DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.idx_messages_content_trgm;
+
+  IF to_regclass('public.idx_messages_content_trgm') IS NOT NULL
+     OR to_regclass('public.idx_messages_transcription_trgm') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] o rollback da migration nao removeu os indices de trigrama';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_antes FROM _msg_acl_antes;
+  SELECT c.relacl::text AS acl, c.relrowsecurity AS rls, c.relforcerowsecurity AS frls,
+         (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid = c.oid) AS policies
+    INTO v_agora
+    FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid = 'public.messages'::regclass;
+  IF v_agora.acl IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.acl
+     OR v_agora.rls IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.rls
+     OR v_agora.frls IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.frls
+     OR v_agora.policies IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.policies THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] o rollback mexeu em ACL/RLS/policy de public.messages';
+  END IF;
+END
+$$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- BLOCO 6 ‚Äî fecha os dois caminhos sem tocar em ACL/RLS:
+--   (a) `sem_migration=1` (banco da tarefa): o rollback de B5 j√° derrubou os dois
+--       √≠ndices e a transa√ß√£o termina em ROLLBACK ‚Äî o banco fica como estava;
+--   (b) descart√°vel: a migration √© REAPLICADA (duas vezes) e devolve os dois √≠ndices.
+-- O mito do `IF NOT EXISTS` some aqui: sem ele, a segunda aplica√ß√£o falharia.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+\if :{?sem_migration}
+  DO $$
+  DECLARE
+    v_antes record;
+    v_agora record;
+  BEGIN
+    IF to_regclass('public.idx_messages_content_trgm') IS NOT NULL
+       OR to_regclass('public.idx_messages_transcription_trgm') IS NOT NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] o rollback executado em B5 nao removeu os dois indices';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT * INTO v_antes FROM _msg_acl_antes;
+    SELECT c.relacl::text AS acl, c.relrowsecurity AS rls, c.relforcerowsecurity AS frls,
+           (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid = c.oid) AS policies
+      INTO v_agora
+      FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid = 'public.messages'::regclass;
+    IF v_agora.acl IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.acl OR v_agora.rls IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.rls
+       OR v_agora.frls IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.frls
+       OR v_agora.policies IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.policies THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] a migration mexeu em ACL/RLS/policy de public.messages';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'messages_trgm_busca: rollback conferido no banco ja migrado (a transacao termina em ROLLBACK e devolve os indices)';
+  END;
+  $$;
+\else
+  \i :mig
+  \i :mig
+
+  DO $$
+  DECLARE
+    v_antes record;
+    v_agora record;
+    v_n integer;
+  BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+      FROM pg_class c
+      JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid
+     WHERE c.oid IN ('public.idx_messages_content_trgm'::regclass,
+                     'public.idx_messages_transcription_trgm'::regclass)
+       AND x.indrelid = 'public.messages'::regclass;
+    IF v_n <> 2 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] reaplicar a migration nao devolveu os 2 indices (% encontrados)', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_antes FROM _msg_acl_antes;
+    SELECT c.relacl::text AS acl, c.relrowsecurity AS rls, c.relforcerowsecurity AS frls,
+           (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid = c.oid) AS policies
+      INTO v_agora
+      FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid = 'public.messages'::regclass;
+    IF v_agora.acl IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.acl OR v_agora.rls IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.rls
+       OR v_agora.frls IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.frls
+       OR v_agora.policies IS DISTINCT FROM v_antes.policies THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION '[FALHA] a migration mexeu em ACL/RLS/policy de public.messages';
+    END IF;
+  END;
+  $$;
+\endif
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  RAISE NOTICE 'messages_trgm_busca: SUITE VERDE ‚Äî indices gin/gin_trgm_ops em content e transcription, plano usando os dois, medida de 2 caracteres registrada, rollback executado e reaplicacao idempotente sem tocar em ACL/RLS';
+END
+$$;
+
+ROLLBACK;

+-- mini_game_xp_daily_limit ‚Äî prova da RPC public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp e da
+-- tabela public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily no banco REAL local da tarefa.
+--
+-- Roda SOMENTE no banco local (zapp-db-local), nunca em produ√ß√£o.
+-- Tudo dentro de BEGIN ... ROLLBACK: nao deixa lixo no banco da tarefa.
+-- Cada asser√ß√£o falha com RAISE EXCEPTION (com ON_ERROR_STOP o comando sai != 0).
+--
+-- Como rodar (na raiz do workspace; NOME = DB_LOCAL do .hermes-tarefa):
+--   { echo '\set ON_ERROR_STOP on'; cat supabase/tests/mini_game_xp_daily_limit.sql; } \
+--     | zapp-db-local psql . <NOME>
+--
+-- A prova de CONCORR√äNCIA (duas sess√µes em paralelo) fica em
+-- supabase/tests/mini_game_xp_daily_limit_race.sh.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_profile   uuid;
+  v_xp0       bigint;
+  v_xp        bigint;
+  v_res       json;
+  v_partidas  integer;
+  v_xp_total  bigint;
+  v_count     integer;
+  v_xp_before bigint;
+  v_other_user uuid := gen_random_uuid();
+  v_user_id   uuid;
+BEGIN
+  -- Perfil de prova: o primeiro com agent_stats; se nao houver, cria stats para
+  -- o primeiro profiles.id; se nem profiles existir, cria usuario/perfil sinteticos
+  -- dentro da transacao (o ROLLBACK final apaga tudo).
+  SELECT s.profile_id INTO v_profile FROM public.agent_stats s LIMIT 1;
+  IF v_profile IS NULL THEN

+        now(),
+        now()

+      IF v_profile IS NULL THEN

+        VALUES (v_profile, v_user_id, 'Mini Game XP Test', 'mini-game-xp-test@example.invalid', 'agent');
+      END IF;
+    END IF;
+    INSERT INTO public.agent_stats (profile_id) VALUES (v_profile)
+    ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO NOTHING;
+  END IF;

+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp0 FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|setup|perfil=% xp_inicial=%', v_profile, v_xp0;

+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|1-2|cinco creditos de 33 XP aceitos';
+
+  -- 3. xp = inicial + 165.
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  IF v_xp <> v_xp0 + 165 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '3 FALHOU: xp deveria ser inicial+165, delta=%', v_xp - v_xp0;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|3|agent_stats.xp = inicial + 165';
+
+  -- 4. 6a chamada do mesmo dia/jogo: daily_limit e xp inalterado.
+  v_res := public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(v_profile, 'quiz', 33);
+  IF (v_res->>'credited')::boolean IS NOT FALSE
+     OR v_res->>'reason' <> 'daily_limit' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '4 FALHOU: 6a chamada deveria ser daily_limit, veio %', v_res;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  IF v_xp <> v_xp0 + 165 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '4 FALHOU: 6a chamada alterou o xp, delta=%', v_xp - v_xp0;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|4|6a chamada recusada (daily_limit) sem alterar xp';
+
+  -- 5. outro mini-game no mesmo dia: o limite e POR mini-game, credita 12.
+  v_res := public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(v_profile, 'emoji-decode', 12);
+  IF (v_res->>'credited')::boolean IS NOT TRUE
+     OR (v_res->>'xpCreditado')::integer <> 12 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '5 FALHOU: emoji-decode deveria creditar 12, veio %', v_res;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  IF v_xp <> v_xp0 + 177 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '5 FALHOU: xp deveria ser inicial+177, delta=%', v_xp - v_xp0;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|5|limite e por mini-game (emoji-decode creditou)';
+
+  -- 6. xp=0: reason=zero_xp, nao credita e nao consome partida do dia.
+  v_res := public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(v_profile, 'quiz', 0);
+  IF (v_res->>'credited')::boolean IS NOT FALSE
+     OR v_res->>'reason' <> 'zero_xp' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '6 FALHOU: xp=0 deveria ser zero_xp, veio %', v_res;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  IF v_xp <> v_xp0 + 177 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '6 FALHOU: zero_xp alterou o xp, delta=%', v_xp - v_xp0;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT d.partidas INTO v_partidas FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily d
+   WHERE d.profile_id = v_profile AND d.game_id = 'quiz' AND d.dia = CURRENT_DATE;
+  IF v_partidas <> 5 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '6 FALHOU: zero_xp mexeu nas partidas do dia: %', v_partidas;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|6|zero_xp nao credita nem consome partida';
+
+  -- 7. linha do dia de 'quiz': partidas=5, xp_total=165.
+  SELECT d.partidas, d.xp_total INTO v_partidas, v_xp_total
+    FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily d
+   WHERE d.profile_id = v_profile AND d.game_id = 'quiz' AND d.dia = CURRENT_DATE;
+  IF v_partidas <> 5 OR v_xp_total <> 165 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '7 FALHOU: contador diario errado: partidas=% xp_total=%', v_partidas, v_xp_total;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|7|contador diario: partidas=5, xp_total=165';
+
+  -- 8. nenhuma linha passa do limite de 5.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily WHERE partidas > 5;
+  IF v_count <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '8 FALHOU: % linha(s) com partidas > 5', v_count;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|8|nenhuma linha acima de 5 partidas';
+
+  -- 9. game_id desconhecido mas regex-valido: a RPC recusa e nao altera XP
+  -- nem cria contador. Sem esta regra, um atacante contornaria o limite trocando
+  -- o id do jogo a cada 5 chamadas.
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp_before FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(v_profile, 'farm-1', 33);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '9 FALHOU: farm-1 deveria ser recusado';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    IF SQLERRM NOT LIKE 'p_game_id desconhecido:%' THEN
+      RAISE;
+    END IF;
+  END;
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  IF v_xp <> v_xp_before THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '9 FALHOU: farm-1 alterou o xp, antes=% depois=%', v_xp_before, v_xp;
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily d
+     WHERE d.profile_id = v_profile AND d.game_id = 'farm-1' AND d.dia = CURRENT_DATE
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '9 FALHOU: farm-1 criou linha no contador diario';
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|9|game_id desconhecido regex-valido recusado sem alterar xp';
+
+  -- 10. ramo de autorizacao real: authenticated com JWT de outro usuario nao
+  -- pode creditar XP no perfil-alvo. A chamada deve cair em permission denied.
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp_before FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_other_user::text, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', v_other_user::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.role', 'authenticated', true);
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated';
+    PERFORM public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(v_profile, 'speed-typing', 33);
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '10 FALHOU: outro usuario authenticated deveria receber permission denied';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    IF SQLERRM <> 'permission denied' THEN
+      RAISE;
+    END IF;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.role', '', true);
+  SELECT s.xp INTO v_xp FROM public.agent_stats s WHERE s.profile_id = v_profile;
+  IF v_xp <> v_xp_before THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '10 FALHOU: permission denied alterou xp, antes=% depois=%', v_xp_before, v_xp;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|10|authenticated de outro usuario recebe permission denied sem alterar xp';
+
+  -- 11. ACL: anon sem EXECUTE; authenticated com EXECUTE; tabela fechada para
+  -- authenticated (sem SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE).
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(uuid,text,integer)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '11 FALHOU: anon nao deveria ter EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp(uuid,text,integer)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '11 FALHOU: authenticated deveria ter EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily', 'SELECT')
+     OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily', 'INSERT')
+     OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily', 'UPDATE')
+     OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily', 'DELETE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '11 FALHOU: authenticated nao deveria ter privilegio na tabela';
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS|11|ACL confere (anon sem EXECUTE, authenticated com EXECUTE, tabela fechada)';
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'mini_game_xp_daily_limit: suite OK';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Prova de CONCORR√äNCIA do limite di√°rio de mini-games no banco REAL local da
+# tarefa (zapp-db-local). Nunca roda em produ√ß√£o.
+#
+# Uso:  supabase/tests/mini_game_xp_daily_limit_race.sh <copia> <nome-do-conjunto>
+#       (NOME = DB_LOCAL do .hermes-tarefa, ex.: v2-26100700384c3f)
+#
+# Cen√°rio: a linha do dia come√ßa com partidas=4 e DUAS sess√µes chamam
+# credit_agent_mini_game_xp('quiz', 33) quase ao mesmo tempo. A sess√£o A segura
+# as travas por 3 s; a sess√£o B entra 1 s depois e precisa ESPERAR o commit de A
+# e ent√£o enxergar partidas=5 -> daily_limit. Resultado exigido: exatamente um
+# "credited": true, um "daily_limit", partidas final = 5 e XP +33 (n√£o +66).
+#
+# Detalhe de desenho: a sess√£o A trava agent_stats ANTES da linha di√°ria ‚Äî a
+# mesma ordem de travas da fun√ß√£o (que faz SELECT ... agent_stats FOR UPDATE
+# antes do INSERT ... ON CONFLICT). Se A travasse s√≥ a linha di√°ria, haveria
+# AB-BA garantido (A: di√°ria->stats; B: stats->di√°ria) e uma das sess√µes morreria
+# com "deadlock detected" em vez de devolver daily_limit.
+set -u
+COPIA="${1:?uso: mini_game_xp_daily_limit_race.sh <copia> <nome-do-conjunto>}"
+NOME="${2:?uso: mini_game_xp_daily_limit_race.sh <copia> <nome-do-conjunto>}"
+
+sql()    { zapp-db-local psql "$COPIA" "$NOME"; }
+scalar() { zapp-db-local psql "$COPIA" "$NOME" -At; }
+falhou() { echo "FALHOU: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+# Perfil de prova (mesmo crit√©rio do teste .sql).
+PROFILE="$(echo 'SELECT profile_id FROM public.agent_stats LIMIT 1;' | scalar)"
+CRIOU_STATS=0
+CRIOU_PROFILE=0
+if [ -z "$PROFILE" ]; then
+  PROFILE="$(echo 'SELECT id FROM public.profiles LIMIT 1;' | scalar)"
+  if [ -z "$PROFILE" ]; then
+    PROFILE="$(scalar <<'SQL'
+WITH novo_user AS (
+  INSERT INTO auth.users (id, aud, role, email, email_confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at)
+  SELECT
+    gen_random_uuid(),
+    'authenticated',
+    'authenticated',
+    'mini-game-race-' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') || '@example.invalid',
+    now(),
+    now(),
+    now()
+  RETURNING id, email
+), novo_profile AS (
+  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, name, email, role)
+  SELECT u.id, 'Mini Game Race Test', u.email, 'agent'
+  FROM novo_user u
+  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = u.id)
+  RETURNING id, user_id
+)
+SELECT COALESCE(
+  (SELECT id FROM novo_profile),
+  (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p JOIN novo_user u ON u.id = p.user_id)
+);
+SQL
+)"
+    [ -n "$PROFILE" ] || falhou "n√£o consegui criar profile sint√©tico"
+    CRIOU_PROFILE=1
+  fi
+  echo "INSERT INTO public.agent_stats (profile_id) VALUES ('$PROFILE') ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO NOTHING;" | sql >/dev/null \
+    || falhou "n√£o consegui semear agent_stats"
+  CRIOU_STATS=1
+fi
+export PROFILE
+XP0="$(echo "SELECT xp FROM public.agent_stats WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE';" | scalar)"
+[ -n "$XP0" ] || falhou "sem agent_stats para $PROFILE"
+
+cleanup() {
+  echo "DELETE FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE' AND game_id = 'quiz' AND dia = CURRENT_DATE;" | sql >/dev/null 2>&1
+  if [ "$CRIOU_STATS" = 1 ]; then
+    echo "DELETE FROM public.agent_stats WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE';" | sql >/dev/null 2>&1
+  else
+    echo "UPDATE public.agent_stats SET xp = $XP0 WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE';" | sql >/dev/null 2>&1
+  fi
+  if [ "${CRIOU_PROFILE:-0}" = 1 ]; then
+    echo "DELETE FROM auth.users u USING public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.id = '$PROFILE';" | sql >/dev/null 2>&1
+    echo "DELETE FROM public.profiles WHERE id = '$PROFILE';" | sql >/dev/null 2>&1
+  fi
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+TMPDIR_LOCAL="$COPIA/.tmp"
+mkdir -p "$TMPDIR_LOCAL"
+A_OUT="$TMPDIR_LOCAL/race-mini-game-a.out"
+B_OUT="$TMPDIR_LOCAL/race-mini-game-b.out"
+
+# 1. Semeia a linha do dia com partidas=4, xp_total=132 (COMMIT de verdade).
+sql >/dev/null <<SQL || falhou "semente falhou"
+INSERT INTO public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily (profile_id, game_id, dia, partidas, xp_total)
+VALUES ('$PROFILE', 'quiz', CURRENT_DATE, 4, 132)
+ON CONFLICT (profile_id, game_id, dia) DO UPDATE SET partidas = 4, xp_total = 132;
+SQL
+
+# 2. Duas sess√µes em paralelo. A prende as linhas (ordem de travas da fun√ß√£o) e
+#    dorme 3 s antes de creditar; B dorme 1 s e chega com a linha j√° presa.
+sql -At >"$A_OUT" 2>&1 <<SQL &
+BEGIN;
+SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_stats WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE' FOR UPDATE;
+SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE' AND game_id = 'quiz' AND dia = CURRENT_DATE FOR UPDATE;
+SELECT pg_sleep(3);
+SELECT public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp('$PROFILE', 'quiz', 33);
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+PID_A=$!
+
+sql -At >"$B_OUT" 2>&1 <<SQL &
+BEGIN;
+SELECT pg_sleep(1);
+SELECT public.credit_agent_mini_game_xp('$PROFILE', 'quiz', 33);
+COMMIT;
+SQL
+PID_B=$!
+
+wait "$PID_A" "$PID_B"
+
+A_JSON="$(grep -o '{.*}' "$A_OUT" | head -1)"
+B_JSON="$(grep -o '{.*}' "$B_OUT" | head -1)"
+echo "sessao A: ${A_JSON:-$(cat "$A_OUT")}"
+echo "sessao B: ${B_JSON:-$(cat "$B_OUT")}"
+
+# 3. Asser√ß√µes.
+[ -n "$A_JSON" ] || falhou "sess√£o A n√£o devolveu json (veio: $(tail -2 "$A_OUT"))"
+[ -n "$B_JSON" ] || falhou "sess√£o B n√£o devolveu json (veio: $(tail -2 "$B_OUT"))"
+
+A_OK=0; B_OK=0; A_LIM=0; B_LIM=0
+echo "$A_JSON" | grep -q '"credited" *: *true' && A_OK=1
+echo "$B_JSON" | grep -q '"credited" *: *true' && B_OK=1
+echo "$A_JSON" | grep -q '"reason" *: *"daily_limit"' && A_LIM=1
+echo "$B_JSON" | grep -q '"reason" *: *"daily_limit"' && B_LIM=1
+
+[ $((A_OK + B_OK)) -eq 1 ] || falhou "esperava exatamente 1 credited:true (A_OK=$A_OK B_OK=$B_OK)"
+[ $((A_LIM + B_LIM)) -eq 1 ] || falhou "esperava exatamente 1 daily_limit (A_LIM=$A_LIM B_LIM=$B_LIM)"
+
+PARTIDAS="$(echo "SELECT partidas FROM public.agent_mini_game_xp_daily WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE' AND game_id = 'quiz' AND dia = CURRENT_DATE;" | scalar)"
+[ "$PARTIDAS" = 5 ] || falhou "partidas finais deveriam ser 5, veio '$PARTIDAS'"
+
+XP1="$(echo "SELECT xp FROM public.agent_stats WHERE profile_id = '$PROFILE';" | scalar)"
+[ "$XP1" = $((XP0 + 33)) ] || falhou "xp deveria subir 33 (de $XP0 para $((XP0 + 33))), veio $XP1"
+
+echo "PASS|race|1 credited:true + 1 daily_limit, partidas=5, xp +33 (s√≥ um creditou)"

+  IF (v_uso ->> 'limit') <> '0' OR (v_uso ->> 'sent') <> '9' OR (v_uso ->> 'remaining') <> '0' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(11) teto gigante deveria fechar em 0 (fail-closed): esperado 0:9:0, obtido %:%:%',
+      v_uso ->> 'limit', v_uso ->> 'sent', v_uso ->> 'remaining';
+  END IF;
+  IF jsonb_typeof(v_uso -> 'remaining') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(11) remaining ausente/nao-numerico com teto gigante (tipo: %)', COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(v_uso -> 'remaining'), 'ausente');
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Talk X: teto gigante -> default documentado da funcao (6/minuto, 500/dia).
+  v_orc := public.talkx_connection_send_budget(c_conn_p);
+  IF (v_orc ->> 'day_sent') <> '9' OR (v_orc ->> 'minute_sent') <> '9' OR (v_orc ->> 'day_limit') <> '500'
+     OR (v_orc ->> 'minute_limit') <> '6' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(11) defaults do orcamento com medicao invalida divergiram: dia=% minuto=% teto_dia=% teto_minuto=%',
+      v_orc ->> 'day_sent', v_orc ->> 'minute_sent', v_orc ->> 'day_limit', v_orc ->> 'minute_limit';
+  END IF;
+  IF jsonb_typeof(v_orc -> 'day_remaining') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+     OR jsonb_typeof(v_orc -> 'minute_remaining') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(11) orcamento com medicao invalida devolveu remaining ausente/nao-numerico';
+  END IF;
+
+  UPDATE public.talkx_settings SET value = '500'::jsonb WHERE key = 'daily_limit_per_connection';
+  UPDATE public.talkx_settings SET value = '6'::jsonb WHERE key = 'max_per_minute_per_connection';
+  v_uso := public.multiplix_connection_daily_usage(c_conn_p);
+  IF (v_uso ->> 'limit') <> '500' OR (v_uso ->> 'sent') <> '9' OR (v_uso ->> 'remaining') <> '491' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(11) cotas restauradas divergiram: esperado 500:9:491, obtido %:%:%',
+      v_uso ->> 'limit', v_uso ->> 'sent', v_uso ->> 'remaining';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ (12) quem nao e service_role nao le nem executa a cota (tentativa REAL)
+  SET LOCAL ROLE anon;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.multiplix_connection_daily_usage(c_conn_p);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(12) anon conseguiu executar a cota do Multiplix';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    NULL; -- esperado
+  END;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.talkx_connection_send_budget(c_conn_p);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(12) anon conseguiu executar o orcamento do Talk X';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    NULL; -- esperado
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+
+  SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.multiplix_connection_daily_usage(c_conn_p);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(12) authenticated conseguiu executar a cota do Multiplix';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    NULL; -- esperado
+  END;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.talkx_connection_send_budget(c_conn_p);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '(12) authenticated conseguiu executar o orcamento do Talk X';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    NULL; -- esperado
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'MX04: suite OK ‚Äî cota soma ITENS (1 por mensagem), legado sem contar duas vezes, teto compartilhado com o Talk X, trafego sem carimbo cobrado da primeira conectada, medicao invalida fail-closed com remaining sempre numerico, cron F17c adia no limite exato e so service_role le a cota';
+END $$;

+ROLLBACK;

+-- Teste SQL de public.my_active_sessions() + public.expire_orphan_user_sessions().
+--
+-- O que prova:
+--   T1  so' as sessoes VIVAS e SO' as do proprio chamador: a orfa (sem auth.sessions)
+--       e a de auth_session expirada NAO saem; a sessao do outro usuario NAO sai;
+--   T2  is_current marca exatamente a sessao do claim session_id do JWT (e muda quando
+--       o claim muda), tanto por request.jwt.claims quanto por request.jwt.claim.session_id;
+--   T3  anon NAO executa (42501 de verdade) e PUBLIC nao tem EXECUTE; authenticated tem;
+--   T4  sem identidade (auth.uid() nulo) a RPC devolve 0 linhas -- nao vaza nada;
+--   T5  limpeza expira (is_active=false + ended_at) a orfa e a expirada, preserva as
+--       vivas, e' idempotente (2a chamada = 0) e pega sessao Auth APAGADA;
+--   T6  ACL de expire_orphan_user_sessions: anon/authenticated sem EXECUTE, service_role com.
+--
+-- COMO RODAR (banco LOCAL da tarefa, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <conjunto> -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/my_active_sessions.sql
+--
+-- Cria dados SINTETICOS e desfaz tudo no ROLLBACK final: nao sobra linha no banco.
+-- Sem EXCEPTION = suite verde.
+BEGIN;

+DO $my_active_sessions$
+DECLARE
+  v_user_a     uuid := 'a1111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111a1';
+  v_user_b     uuid := 'b1111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111b2';
+  v_sa1        uuid := '51111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111a1'; -- Auth viva 1 do A (sessao atual)
+  v_sa2        uuid := '51111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111a2'; -- Auth viva 2 do A
+  v_sa3        uuid := '51111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111a3'; -- Auth EXPIRADA (not_after passado)
+  v_sb1        uuid := '52222222-2222-4222-8222-2222222222b1'; -- Auth viva do B
+  v_us_a1      uuid := '61111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111a1';
+  v_us_a2      uuid := '61111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111a2';

+  v_us_aghost  uuid := '61111111-1111-4111-8111-1111111111a4';

+  v_total      integer;
+  v_cur        integer;
+  v_cur_id     uuid;
+  v_barrado    boolean;
+  v_n          integer;
+  v_n2         integer;

+    (v_user_b, 'sessoes-reais-b@local.test');

+    (v_sa1, v_user_a, now() + interval '7 days'),
+    (v_sa2, v_user_a, now() + interval '7 days'),
+    (v_sa3, v_user_a, now() - interval '1 day'),   -- ja' passou: sessao morta
+    (v_sb1, v_user_b, now() + interval '7 days');
+
+  -- us_a1/us_a2 vivas; us_adead aponta para Auth EXPIRADA; us_aghost sem auth_session.
+  INSERT INTO public.user_sessions
+    (id, user_id, ip_address, user_agent, is_active, started_at, last_activity_at, expires_at, auth_session_id) VALUES
+    (v_us_a1,    v_user_a, '10.0.0.1', 'ua-a1',   true, now() - interval '1 hour',  now() - interval '5 minutes',  now() + interval '1 day', v_sa1),
+    (v_us_a2,    v_user_a, '10.0.0.2', 'ua-a2',   true, now() - interval '2 hours', now() - interval '1 hour',     now() + interval '1 day', v_sa2),
+    (v_us_adead, v_user_a, '10.0.0.3', 'ua-dead', true, now() - interval '2 days',  now() - interval '2 days',     now() + interval '1 day', v_sa3),
+    (v_us_aghost,v_user_a, '10.0.0.4', 'ua-ghost',true, now() - interval '3 days',  now() - interval '3 days',     now() + interval '1 day', NULL),
+    (v_us_b1,    v_user_b, '10.0.1.1', 'ua-b1',   true, now() - interval '1 hour',  now() - interval '10 minutes', now() + interval '1 day', v_sb1);
+

+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a, 'session_id', v_sa1)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);

+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total FROM public.my_active_sessions();
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_cur   FROM public.my_active_sessions() WHERE is_current;

+  IF v_cur_id <> v_sa1 THEN
+    PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);

+  END IF;

+  -- Troca o claim para sa2: a sessao atual acompanha o JWT.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a, 'session_id', v_sa2)::text, true);
+  SELECT auth_session_id INTO v_cur_id FROM public.my_active_sessions() WHERE is_current;
+  IF v_cur_id <> v_sa2 THEN
+    PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: com o claim sa2, is_current apontou %', v_cur_id;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Via claim dedicado request.jwt.claim.session_id (o outro caminho do COALESCE).
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.session_id', v_sa1::text, true);
+  SELECT auth_session_id INTO v_cur_id FROM public.my_active_sessions() WHERE is_current;
+  IF v_cur_id <> v_sa1 THEN
+    PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: claim dedicado sa1 -> is_current apontou %', v_cur_id;
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.session_id', '', true);
+
+  -- B so' ve' a dele.
+  PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_b, 'session_id', v_sb1)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) INTO v_total, v_cur FROM public.my_active_sessions();
+  IF v_total <> 1 OR v_cur <> 1 THEN
+    PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: B esperava 1 sessao (1 atual) e veio total=% atual=%', v_total, v_cur;
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T3/T4 (identidade)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total FROM public.my_active_sessions();  -- sem claim session_id: nenhuma atual
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_cur   FROM public.my_active_sessions() WHERE is_current;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+  IF v_total <> 2 OR v_cur <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: sem claim de sessao esperava 2 linhas e 0 atuais (total=% atual=%)', v_total, v_cur;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Sem NENHUMA identidade (auth.uid() nulo): 0 linhas.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total FROM public.my_active_sessions();
+  PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+  IF v_total <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: sem identidade devia devolver 0 e veio %', v_total;
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ACL de my_active_sessions
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.my_active_sessions()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: anon com EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.my_active_sessions()', 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: authenticated SEM EXECUTE na RPC';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- anon tentando de verdade: 42501.
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a, 'session_id', v_sa1)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'anon', true);
+  v_barrado := false;
+  BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.my_active_sessions();
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    v_barrado := true;
+  END;
+  PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+  IF v_barrado = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: anon conseguiu chamar a RPC';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- T5 limpeza
+  v_n := public.expire_orphan_user_sessions();
+  IF v_n <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: saneamento esperava expirar 2 (orfa + expirada) e expirou %', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_sessions WHERE id IN (v_us_adead, v_us_aghost) AND (is_active OR ended_at IS NULL)) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: as linhas mortas nao ficaram inativas/ended_at nulo';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_sessions WHERE id IN (v_us_a1, v_us_a2, v_us_b1) AND is_active IS NOT TRUE) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: a limpeza mexeu em sessao viva';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- idempotente: 2a passada nao muda nada
+  v_n2 := public.expire_orphan_user_sessions();
+  IF v_n2 <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: nao era idempotente (2a passada expirou %)', v_n2;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- sessao Auth APAGADA (revogada de fato) tambem e' expirada na proxima passada
+  DELETE FROM auth.sessions WHERE id = v_sa2;
+  v_n := public.expire_orphan_user_sessions();

+  END IF;

+  END IF;

+  -- Depois da limpeza a RPC de A volta a mostrar so' a viva restante (us_a1)
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', v_user_a, 'session_id', v_sa1)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_total FROM public.my_active_sessions();
+  PERFORM set_config('role', session_user, true);
+  IF v_total <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: apos a limpeza A devia ver 1 sessao e viu %', v_total;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  -- ACL de expire_orphan_user_sessions
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.expire_orphan_user_sessions()', 'EXECUTE')
+     OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.expire_orphan_user_sessions()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: anon/authenticated com EXECUTE na limpeza';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.expire_orphan_user_sessions()', 'EXECUTE') = false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T6 FALHOU: service_role SEM EXECUTE na limpeza';
+  END IF;
+  v_ok := v_ok + 1;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'my_active_sessions: suite OK (T1 so as vivas do chamador, T2 is_current pelo JWT, T3 anon barrado, T4 sem identidade 0 linhas, T5 limpeza idempotente, T6 ACL) ‚Äî % grupo(s)', v_ok;
+END $my_active_sessions$;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- my_network_status ‚Äî RPC de diagnostico de rede para o painel de geo (t_684693d3)
+--
+-- DEFEITO QUE ESTE TESTE TRAVA: nao existia fonte no banco que dissesse ao admin
+-- "o que a politica de rede detecta para voce" (pais do cf-ipcountry e IP do
+-- x-forwarded-for, exatamente como request-policy.ts/getClientIP enxergam). Sem
+-- isso o painel nao distingue "geo funcionando" de "gateway nao informa pais".
+--
+-- O QUE PROVA (criterio de pronto do cartao), na ordem de execucao:
+--   T0 ESTRUTURA ‚Äî a funcao existe, e SECURITY DEFINER e tem search_path fixo;
+--   T1 ACL/ESTRUTURA ‚Äî PUBLIC e anon NAO tem EXECUTE; authenticated tem;
+--   T2 NEGACAO anon ‚Äî chamada negada (42501);
+--   T3 NEGACAO agente ‚Äî authenticated sem admin/supervisor negado (42501) e a
+--      mensagem e IDENTICA com ou sem usuario existente (sem oraculo);
+--   T4 ADMIN sem cabecalhos ‚Äî country NULL ("gateway nao informa pais") e
+--      ip_seen 'unknown' (a sentinela que getClientIP devolve);
+--   T5 ADMIN com cabecalhos ‚Äî country 'BR' e ip_seen = ULTIMO item de
+--      x-forwarded-for (9.9.9.9), nao o primeiro;
+--   T6 country normalizado/validado ‚Äî ' br ' vira 'BR'; 'brazil', 'b', '-', ''
+--      viram NULL (mesma regra de normalizeCountryCode);
+--   T7 so cabecalho confiavel ‚Äî 'x-country: RU' e IGNORADO (country NULL) e
+--      x-real-ip vale quando x-forwarded-for falta ou tem ultimo item vazio;
+--   T8 SUPERVISOR tambem passa (o cartao pede admin/supervisor);
+--   T9 service_role sem chamador humano NAO passa (42501);
+--   T10 ROLLBACK executavel ‚Äî o DROP FUNCTION do cabecalho da migration roda.
+--
+-- VERMELHO antes do verde: sem a migration, T0 falha (funcao ausente) e T4‚ÄìT8
+-- falham por nao haver o que chamar. Com a migration aplicada, a suite fecha
+-- verde. A negacao (T2/T3/T9) so passa a valer junto com o GRANT/REVOKE dela.
+--
+-- COMO A PROTECAO ENTRA NO TESTE: a funcao testada e o objeto REAL aplicado pela
+-- migration (via `hermes-db-migrar supabase/migrations/20261016002012_my_network_status.sql`
+-- no banco local da tarefa) ‚Äî DDL nenhuma e reescrita a mao aqui; o T10 prova o
+-- SQL de rollback do cabecalho da migration.
+--
+-- PAPEL REAL: as chamadas rodam com SET LOCAL ROLE (anon / authenticated /
+-- service_role) + request.jwt.claims sintetico ‚Äî nunca como postgres, que
+-- ignoraria o REVOKE e o auth.uid().
+--
+-- ZERO EFEITO COLATERAL: tudo numa transacao que termina em ROLLBACK (a fixture
+-- de auth.users roda com session_replication_role = replica e volta a origin).
+--
+-- COMO RODA (a partir da RAIZ do repositorio, contra o banco local da tarefa):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . v2-mynetstatus < supabase/tests/my_network_status.sql
+-- ============================================================================
+
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- Fixture: 1 admin, 1 supervisor, 1 agente ------------------------------------
+SET LOCAL session_replication_role = replica;
+INSERT INTO auth.users (id) VALUES
+  ('aaaaaaaa-1111-1111-1111-aaaaaaaaaaaa'),
+  ('bbbbbbbb-2222-2222-2222-bbbbbbbbbbbb'),
+  ('cccccccc-3333-3333-3333-cccccccccccc');
+INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES
+  ('aaaaaaaa-1111-1111-1111-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'admin'),
+  ('bbbbbbbb-2222-2222-2222-bbbbbbbbbbbb', 'supervisor'),
+  ('cccccccc-3333-3333-3333-cccccccccccc', 'agent');
+RESET session_replication_role;
+
+-- T0 ‚Äî estrutura --------------------------------------------------------------
+\echo 'T0: funcao existe, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path fixo'
+DO $$
+DECLARE v_secdef bool; v_cfg text[];
+BEGIN
+  SELECT p.prosecdef, p.proconfig INTO v_secdef, v_cfg
+    FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+   WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'my_network_status';
+  IF v_secdef IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T0 FALHOU: public.my_network_status() nao existe';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT v_secdef THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T0 FALHOU: nao e SECURITY DEFINER';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_cfg IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(v_cfg) c WHERE c LIKE 'search_path=%public%') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T0 FALHOU: sem search_path fixo (proconfig=%)', v_cfg;
+  END IF;
+  -- sem parametro: nao ha entrada vinda do cliente
+  IF (SELECT proargtypes::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
+       WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='my_network_status') <> '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T0 FALHOU: a funcao aceita parametro (deveria ser sem argumentos)';
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T0 OK: SECURITY DEFINER, search_path fixo, sem argumentos';
+END $$;
+
+-- T1 ‚Äî ACL: fechada por padrao -------------------------------------------------
+\echo 'T1: PUBLIC/anon sem EXECUTE; authenticated com EXECUTE'
+DO $$
+DECLARE v_public bool; v_anon bool; v_auth bool;
+BEGIN
