+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.espera(p_label text, p_atual text, p_esperado text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_atual IS DISTINCT FROM p_esperado THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PK-GRANTS FALHOU [%]: esperado %, obtido %', p_label, p_esperado, p_atual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] -> %', p_label, p_atual;
+END $h$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.espera_erro(p_label text, p_atual text, p_sqlstate text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_atual IS NULL OR p_atual NOT LIKE 'ERRO ' || p_sqlstate || ' %' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PK-GRANTS FALHOU [%]: esperava erro SQLSTATE %, veio: %', p_label, p_sqlstate, p_atual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] -> %', p_label, p_atual;
+END $h$;
+
+-- Roda p_sql sob o PAPEL REAL (SET LOCAL ROLE) com o JWT do usuario p_uid.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.operacao(p_papel text, p_uid uuid, p_sql text) RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE v_ret text; v_n bigint;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', p_uid, 'role', p_papel)::text, true);
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+  IF current_user <> p_papel THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PK-GRANTS FALHOU: papel real nao aplicado (current_user=%)', current_user;
+  END IF;
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE p_sql;
+    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
+    v_ret := 'OK ' || v_n;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v_ret := 'ERRO ' || SQLSTATE || ' ' || SQLERRM;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+  RETURN v_ret;
+END $h$;
+
+-- Um unico valor, lido sob o PAPEL REAL (controles de leitura).
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.valor(p_papel text, p_uid uuid, p_sql text) RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE v text;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', p_uid, 'role', p_papel)::text, true);
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE p_sql INTO v;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v := 'ERRO ' || SQLSTATE;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+  RETURN v;
+END $h$;

+  v_n    int := 0;

+  ('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d', '44444444-4444-4444-4444-44444444444d', 'ADMIN SENS',  'admin', 'admin', '{}'::jsonb, true, true, 100, 'outros', NULL);

+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ Helpers do pr√≥prio teste ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.espera(p_label text, p_atual text, p_esperado text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_atual IS DISTINCT FROM p_esperado THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SENS FALHOU [%]: esperado %, obtido %', p_label, p_esperado, p_atual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] -> %', p_label, p_atual;
+END $h$;
+
+-- Roda p_set_clause sobre a linha de p_target sob o PAPEL REAL, com o JWT p_claims.
+-- Devolve 'OK <linhas>' ou 'ERRO <sqlstate> <mensagem>'.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.operacao(p_papel text, p_claims jsonb, p_set_clause text, p_target uuid)
+RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE v_ret text; v_n bigint;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', coalesce(p_claims, '{}'::jsonb)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', coalesce(p_claims ->> 'sub', ''), true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.role', coalesce(p_claims ->> 'role', ''), true);
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+  IF current_user <> p_papel THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SENS FALHOU: papel real nao aplicado (current_user=%)', current_user;
+  END IF;
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE format('UPDATE public.profiles SET %s WHERE user_id = %L', p_set_clause, p_target);
+    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
+    v_ret := 'OK ' || v_n;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v_ret := 'ERRO ' || SQLSTATE || ' ' || SQLERRM;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+  RETURN v_ret;
+END $h$;
+
+-- Um √∫nico valor, lido sob o PAPEL REAL.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.valor(p_papel text, p_claims jsonb, p_sql text) RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE v text;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', coalesce(p_claims, '{}'::jsonb)::text, true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', coalesce(p_claims ->> 'sub', ''), true);
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claim.role', coalesce(p_claims ->> 'role', ''), true);
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE p_sql INTO v;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v := 'ERRO ' || SQLSTATE;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+  RETURN v;
+END $h$;

+-- ============================================================================
+-- purge_gmail_account_data ‚Äî limpeza administrativa dos e-mails de uma conta
+-- Gmail desconectada (cartao t_587bea4b, workersql).
+--
+-- O QUE PROVA (criterio de pronto do cartao):
+--   A) ACL: EXECUTE so para `authenticated`. `anon` e `service_role` NAO executam
+--      (42501 permission denied), e nao existe GRANT para PUBLIC.
+--   B) Como ADMIN (authenticated + is_admin): apaga, na ORDEM filho->pai,
+--      email_attachments -> email_messages -> email_threads -> email_drafts, e o
+--      retorno diz QUANTAS linhas foram apagadas por tabela (`deleted`).
+--   C) A linha de `gmail_accounts` NAO e apagada (a limpeza e dos e-mails) e a
+--      conta vizinha, fora do alcance, fica intacta.
+--   D) Recusa com o MESMO erro (22023 purge_not_allowed) para: conta ATIVA,
+--      confirmacao ERRADA e conta INEXISTENTE ‚Äî sem oraculo de existencia/estado.
+--   E) Recusa agente comum (authenticated que nao e admin) com 42501 admin_required.
+--   F) Entrada invalida (confirm NULL, id NULL) tambem recusa e nao apaga nada.
+--   G) Auditoria em public.audit_logs: registrar QUEM (user_id), QUANDO
+--      (created_at) e QUANTAS linhas (details->deleted) SEM o e-mail completo e
+--      SEM nenhum assunto/corpo/remetente.
+--   H) ATOMICIDADE: com um gatilho de prova que estoura no DELETE de
+--      email_threads (depois dos filhos ja terem sido apagados dentro da mesma
+--      chamada), a chamada inteira volta atras: nada fica apagado.
+--   I) email_drafts nao existe nesta branch -> o ramo condicional da funcao e
+--      inerte hoje (to_regclass NULL) e a funcao funciona sem a tabela.
+--
+-- ENFORCEMENT como PAPEL REAL: todas as chamadas passam por pg_temp.prova(), que
+-- faz `SET LOCAL ROLE <papel>` + JWT sintetico em request.jwt.claims (o caminho do
+-- PostgREST), nunca como postgres/superusuario ‚Äî postgres ignora GRANT e RLS.
+--
+-- COMO RODA (banco local descartavel do proprio Zapp Web V2):
+--   zapp-db-local up . v2-purgegmail          (14 min, aplica as migrations reais)
+--   zapp-db-local psql . v2-purgegmail < supabase/tests/purge_gmail_account_data.sql
+--
+-- Tudo roda numa unica transacao que termina em ROLLBACK: idempotente, sem

+-- ============================================================================

+  ('7d000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', '6c000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', 'gatt-ativa-1',  'vizinha.pdf');
+
+-- Contagem de partida: 3 anexos, 3 mensagens, 2 threads.
+DO $$
+DECLARE v_n bigint;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_attachments;
+  IF v_n <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[fixture] anexos esperados 3, achei %', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_messages;
+  IF v_n <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[fixture] mensagens esperadas 3, achei %', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_threads;
+  IF v_n <> 2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '[fixture] threads esperadas 2, achei %', v_n; END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ Helper: chama a funcao como PAPEL REAL, com JWT sintetico ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+-- Devolve o jsonb de retorno OU {"sqlstate":..,"erro":..} quando a funcao recusa.
+-- Se o papel pedido nao pegar, as assercoes caem (nao ha verde por engano).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pg_temp.prova(
+  p_papel   text,
+  p_uid     uuid,
+  p_account uuid,
+  p_confirm text
+) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  v_res   jsonb;
+  v_state text;
+  v_msg   text;
+  v_atual text;
+BEGIN
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+                     json_build_object('sub', p_uid, 'role', p_papel)::text,
+                     true);
+  SELECT current_user INTO v_atual;
+  IF v_atual <> p_papel THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '[prova] SET LOCAL ROLE % nao pegou (current_user=%)', p_papel, v_atual;
+  END IF;
+
+  BEGIN
+    v_res := public.purge_gmail_account_data(p_account, p_confirm);
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_state = RETURNED_SQLSTATE, v_msg = MESSAGE_TEXT;
+    v_res := jsonb_build_object('sqlstate', v_state, 'erro', v_msg);
+  END;
+
+  EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+  RETURN v_res;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ A) ACL: so authenticated executa ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+DO $$
+DECLARE v_acl text;
+BEGIN
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.purge_gmail_account_data(uuid,text)', 'EXECUTE') IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A: authenticated deveria ter EXECUTE';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.purge_gmail_account_data(uuid,text)', 'EXECUTE') IS NOT FALSE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A: anon NAO deveria ter EXECUTE';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.purge_gmail_account_data(uuid,text)', 'EXECUTE') IS NOT FALSE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A: service_role NAO deveria ter EXECUTE';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT string_agg(coalesce(g.grantee::regrole::text, 'PUBLIC') || '=' || g.privilege_type, ', ')
+    INTO v_acl
+    FROM aclexplode(
+      (SELECT p.proacl FROM pg_proc p
+        WHERE p.oid = 'public.purge_gmail_account_data(uuid,text)'::regprocedure)
+    ) g
+   WHERE g.grantee = 0;
+  IF v_acl IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A: existe GRANT para PUBLIC (%)', v_acl;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'A OK: EXECUTE so authenticated (PUBLIC/anon/service_role sem EXECUTE)';
+END $$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ E/F) Recusas de PAPEL e de ENTRADA (o admin tambem e barrado no invalido) ‚îÄ
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_anon    jsonb;
+  v_service jsonb;
+  v_agente  jsonb;
+  v_null_c  jsonb;
+  v_null_i  jsonb;
+  v_n       bigint;
+  v_admin   uuid := '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
+  v_ag_uid  uuid := '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
+  v_a1      uuid := '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
+BEGIN
+  -- anon: barrado pela ACL, antes de qualquer logica.
+  v_anon := pg_temp.prova('anon', NULL, v_a1, 'conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test');
+  IF v_anon ->> 'sqlstate' <> '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'E: anon deveria receber 42501, veio %', v_anon;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- service_role: barrado pela ACL (nenhum GRANT).
+  v_service := pg_temp.prova('service_role', NULL, v_a1, 'conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test');
+  IF v_service ->> 'sqlstate' <> '42501' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'E: service_role deveria receber 42501, veio %', v_service;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Agente comum (authenticated sem is_admin): 42501 admin_required.
+  v_agente := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_ag_uid, v_a1, 'conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test');
+  IF v_agente ->> 'sqlstate' <> '42501' OR v_agente ->> 'erro' <> 'admin_required' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'E: agente deveria receber admin_required, veio %', v_agente;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Entrada invalida: confirmacao NULL e id NULL.
+  v_null_c := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_admin, v_a1, NULL);
+  IF v_null_c ->> 'sqlstate' <> '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'F: confirm NULL deveria recusar (22023), veio %', v_null_c;
+  END IF;
+  v_null_i := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_admin, NULL, 'conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test');
+  IF v_null_i ->> 'sqlstate' <> '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'F: id NULL deveria recusar (22023), veio %', v_null_i;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Nada foi apagado por nenhuma das recusas acima.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_messages;
+  IF v_n <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E/F: mensagens intactas esperadas 3, achei %', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_attachments;
+  IF v_n <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E/F: anexos intactos esperados 3, achei %', v_n; END IF;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'E/F OK: anon=42501, service_role=42501, agente=admin_required, entrada invalida=22023 (nada apagado)';
+END $$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ D) Sem oraculo: conta ATIVA x confirmacao ERRADA x conta INEXISTENTE ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_ativa    jsonb;
+  v_confirm  jsonb;
+  v_inexiste jsonb;
+  v_n        bigint;
+  v_admin    uuid := '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
+  v_a1       uuid := '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
+  v_a2       uuid := '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
+  v_fantasma uuid := '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000dead';
+BEGIN
+  v_ativa    := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_admin, v_a2, 'conta-ativa@exemplo-teste.test');
+  v_confirm  := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_admin, v_a1, 'confirmacao-errada@exemplo-teste.test');
+  v_inexiste := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_admin, v_fantasma, 'conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test');
+
+  IF v_ativa ->> 'sqlstate' <> '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'D: conta ativa deveria recusar (22023), veio %', v_ativa;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_confirm ->> 'sqlstate' <> '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'D: confirmacao errada deveria recusar (22023), veio %', v_confirm;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_inexiste ->> 'sqlstate' <> '22023' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'D: conta inexistente deveria recusar (22023), veio %', v_inexiste;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- MESMA resposta para os tres: nenhum oraculo de existencia/estado.
+  IF v_ativa ->> 'erro' <> v_confirm ->> 'erro'
+     OR v_confirm ->> 'erro' <> v_inexiste ->> 'erro' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'D: respostas diferentes (oraculo): % / % / %', v_ativa, v_confirm, v_inexiste;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_ativa ->> 'erro' <> 'purge_not_allowed' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'D: erro esperado purge_not_allowed, veio %', v_ativa ->> 'erro';
+  END IF;
+
+  -- A conta ativa continua com todos os e-mails dela.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_messages WHERE gmail_account_id = v_a2;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'D: conta ativa perdeu mensagens (achei %)', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_attachments a
+     JOIN public.email_messages m ON m.id = a.email_message_id
+    WHERE m.gmail_account_id = v_a2;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'D: conta ativa perdeu anexos (achei %)', v_n; END IF;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'D OK: ativa/confirmacao errada/inexistente = mesmo 22023 purge_not_allowed; conta ativa intacta';
+END $$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ H) Atomicidade: falha no meio nao deixa nada apagado ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_res jsonb;
+  v_n   bigint;
+  v_adm uuid := '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
+  v_a1  uuid := '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
+BEGIN
+  -- Gatilho de prova: estoura no DELETE de email_threads, que acontece DEPOIS de
+  -- anexos e mensagens dentro da mesma chamada.
+  CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pg_temp.estoura_no_delete() RETURNS trigger
+  LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bloqueio de prova'; END $fn$;
+  CREATE TRIGGER trg_prova_atomicidade
+    BEFORE DELETE ON public.email_threads
+    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION pg_temp.estoura_no_delete();
+
+  v_res := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_adm, v_a1, 'conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test');
+
+  DROP TRIGGER trg_prova_atomicidade ON public.email_threads;
+
+  IF v_res ->> 'sqlstate' IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'H: a chamada deveria ter falhado pelo gatilho, veio %', v_res;
+  END IF;
+  IF position('bloqueio de prova' in v_res ->> 'erro') = 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'H: falha inesperada (nao foi a do gatilho): %', v_res;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Nada ficou pela metade: anexos e mensagens continuam todos.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_attachments;
+  IF v_n <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'H: anexos deveriam voltar atras (esperado 3, achei %)', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_messages;
+  IF v_n <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'H: mensagens deveriam voltar atras (esperado 3, achei %)', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_threads;
+  IF v_n <> 2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'H: threads deveriam voltar atras (esperado 2, achei %)', v_n; END IF;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'H OK: falha no meio da limpeza = nada apagado (transacao unica)';
+END $$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ I) email_drafts nao existe nesta branch: ramo condicional inerte ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF to_regclass('public.email_drafts') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE NOTICE 'I: public.email_drafts EXISTE nesta base ‚Äî o DELETE condicional da funcao vale e foi exercitado acima';
+  ELSE
+    RAISE NOTICE 'I OK: public.email_drafts nao existe nesta base ‚Äî o ramo condicional fica inerte (a funcao nao cria tabela nem quebra)';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ B/C) ADMIN apaga a conta desconectada ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_res jsonb;
+  v_n   bigint;
+  v_adm uuid := '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
+  v_a1  uuid := '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
+  v_a2  uuid := '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
+BEGIN
+  v_res := pg_temp.prova('authenticated', v_adm, v_a1, 'conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test');
+
+  IF v_res ->> 'sqlstate' IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B: admin deveria conseguir limpar a conta desconectada, veio %', v_res;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Contagens devolvidas: 2 anexos, 2 mensagens, 1 thread, 0 drafts, 5 no total.
+  IF (v_res -> 'deleted' ->> 'email_attachments')::bigint <> 2
+     OR (v_res -> 'deleted' ->> 'email_messages')::bigint <> 2
+     OR (v_res -> 'deleted' ->> 'email_threads')::bigint <> 1
+     OR (v_res -> 'deleted' ->> 'email_drafts')::bigint <> 0
+     OR (v_res ->> 'total_rows')::bigint <> 5 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B: contagens devolvidas erradas: %', v_res;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- E o banco confirma: os dados de e-mail da conta sumiram.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_threads WHERE gmail_account_id = v_a1;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B: sobraram threads da conta apagada (%)', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_messages WHERE gmail_account_id = v_a1;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B: sobraram mensagens da conta apagada (%)', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_attachments a
+     LEFT JOIN public.email_messages m ON m.id = a.email_message_id
+    WHERE a.id IN ('7d000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001','7d000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002');
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'B: sobraram anexos da conta apagada (%)', v_n; END IF;
+
+  -- C) A conta continua existindo (a limpeza e dos e-mails, nao da conta)...
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.gmail_accounts WHERE id = v_a1;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C: a conta deveria continuar existindo (%)', v_n; END IF;
+
+  -- ...e o vizinho (conta ativa) nao perdeu nada.
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_messages WHERE gmail_account_id = v_a2;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C: conta vizinha perdeu mensagens (%)', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_threads WHERE gmail_account_id = v_a2;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C: conta vizinha perdeu threads (%)', v_n; END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.email_attachments;
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C: anexos restantes esperados 1, achei %', v_n; END IF;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'B/C OK: admin apagou 5 linhas (anexos 2, mensagens 2, threads 1) e a conta vizinha ficou intacta';
+END $$;
+
+-- ‚îÄ‚îÄ G) Auditoria: quem, quando, quantas ‚Äî sem e-mail completo e sem conteudo ‚îÄ
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_linha public.audit_logs;
+  v_adm   uuid := '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
+BEGIN
+  SELECT * INTO v_linha
+    FROM public.audit_logs
+   WHERE action = 'gmail_account_data_purged'
+   ORDER BY created_at DESC
+   LIMIT 1;
+
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: nenhum registro de auditoria da limpeza'; END IF;
+
+  IF v_linha.user_id <> v_adm THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: auditoria sem o admin que executou (user_id=%)', v_linha.user_id;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_linha.created_at IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: auditoria sem data'; END IF;
+  IF v_linha.entity_type <> 'gmail_account'
+     OR v_linha.entity_id <> '4a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: auditoria aponta para o alvo errado (% / %)', v_linha.entity_type, v_linha.entity_id;
+  END IF;
+  IF (v_linha.details -> 'deleted' ->> 'email_messages')::bigint <> 2
+     OR (v_linha.details ->> 'total_rows')::bigint <> 5 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: auditoria sem a contagem de linhas: %', v_linha.details;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- Sem e-mail completo e sem nenhum assunto/corpo/remetente.
+  IF position('conta-apagar@exemplo-teste.test' in v_linha.details::text) > 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: o e-mail COMPLETO vazou para a auditoria: %', v_linha.details;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_linha.details ->> 'email_masked' <> 'c***@***' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: mascara inesperada: %', v_linha.details ->> 'email_masked';
+  END IF;
+  IF position('Assunto secreto' in v_linha.details::text) > 0
+     OR position('corpo reservado' in v_linha.details::text) > 0
+     OR position('remetente@exemplo-teste.test' in v_linha.details::text) > 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'G: conteudo de e-mail vazou para a auditoria: %', v_linha.details;
+  END IF;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'G OK: audit_logs com user_id/created_at/contagens e SEM e-mail completo e SEM conteudo';
+END $$;

+ROLLBACK;

+-- qr_attempts_history ‚Äî prova do historico de tentativas de QR (cartao t_433269a4).
+--
+-- O QUE PROVA (criterio do cartao):
+--   1) a tabela existe com connection_id/status/error_message/created_at, e o
+--      status so aceita pending|connected|expired|error (valor invalido e barrado);
+--   2) RLS LIGADA e a VISIBILIDADE espelha quem enxerga a conexao: admin/supervisor
+--      ve as tentativas da conexao; quem nao enxerga a conexao ve ZERO linhas;
+--   3) ESCRITA so pelo service_role: authenticated e anon sao NEGADOS no INSERT
+--      (a mensagem de erro sanitizada chega ao suporte pelo service_role, nunca pelo cliente);
+--   4) retencao de 30 dias no agendador existente: purge_qr_attempts() apaga o que
+--      passou de 30 dias, preserva o que esta dentro da janela e e idempotente;
+--   5) cascata: apagada a conexao, o historico dela vai junto;
+--   6) ACL: purge_qr_attempts() so o service_role executa.
+--
+-- COMO RODA (banco LOCAL do cartao, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <nome-do-conjunto> < supabase/tests/qr_attempts_history.sql
+-- Roda como postgres, troca para authenticated/anon/service_role dentro do bloco
+-- (SET LOCAL ROLE) e termina em ROLLBACK: nenhuma fixture fica no banco.
+-- Sem a migration aplicada o teste FALHA ja na 1a consulta (tabela inexistente).
+--
+-- LIMITACAO: a autorizacao e provada por GRANT + tentativa real com SET ROLE
+-- (ACL do Postgres) e o jwt e simulado em request.jwt.claims ‚Äî nao pelo caminho
+-- HTTP/JWT do PostgREST.
+
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  c_conn        constant uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333301';
+  c_conn_apagada constant uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333302';
+  c_admin       constant uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333334401';
+  c_agente      constant uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333334402';
+  c_antiga      constant uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333335501';
+  c_na_janela   constant uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333335502';
+  c_erro        constant uuid := '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333335503';
+  v_n       integer;
+  v_apagadas integer;
+  v_rls     boolean;
+BEGIN
+  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------- fixtures
+  SET LOCAL session_replication_role = replica;
+  INSERT INTO auth.users (id) VALUES (c_admin), (c_agente)
+    ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
+  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (c_admin, 'admin')
+    ON CONFLICT (user_id, role) DO NOTHING;
+  SET LOCAL session_replication_role = DEFAULT;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.whatsapp_connections (id, name, phone_number)
+  VALUES (c_conn, 'Conexao de teste QR', '+55 11 90000-0001'),
+         (c_conn_apagada, 'Conexao descartavel', '+55 11 90000-0002')
+  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
+
+  -- ------------------------------------------------------ 1) forma da tabela
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM information_schema.columns
+   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'qr_attempts'
+     AND column_name IN ('connection_id', 'status', 'error_message', 'created_at');
+  IF v_n <> 4 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'qr_attempts sem as 4 colunas do cartao (achei %)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT relrowsecurity INTO v_rls
+    FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'public.qr_attempts'::regclass;
+  IF v_rls IS NOT TRUE THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'qr_attempts SEM row level security ligada';
+  END IF;

+  SET LOCAL ROLE service_role;
+
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO public.qr_attempts (connection_id, status)
+    VALUES (c_conn, 'pendente');
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'status invalido (pendente) foi aceito';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation THEN
+    NULL;
+  END;
+
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO public.qr_attempts (connection_id, status, error_message)
+    VALUES (c_conn, 'error', repeat('x', 501));
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'error_message com 501 caracteres foi aceita';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation THEN
+    NULL;
+  END;
+
+  INSERT INTO public.qr_attempts (id, connection_id, status, error_message, created_at)
+  VALUES
+    (c_antiga,    c_conn, 'expired',   NULL,                    now() - interval '31 days'),
+    (c_na_janela, c_conn, 'connected', NULL,                    now() - interval '29 days'),
+    (c_erro,      c_conn, 'error',     'Evolution API: 503 ao gerar o QR', now() - interval '2 minutes');
+  RESET ROLE;
+
+  -- ------------------------------------------------- 3) quem enxerga a conexao
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', c_admin::text)::text, true);
+  SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.qr_attempts;
+  IF v_n <> 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin (ve a conexao) enxergou % tentativas (esperado 3)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', c_agente::text)::text, true);
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE id = c_conn;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'premissa falsa: usuario sem papel enxergou a conexao (% linhas)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.qr_attempts;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'usuario que nao enxerga a conexao enxergou % tentativas (esperado 0)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO public.qr_attempts (connection_id, status) VALUES (c_conn, 'pending');
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authenticated conseguiu INSERT em qr_attempts';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    NULL;
+  END;
+
+  BEGIN
+    UPDATE public.qr_attempts SET status = 'connected' WHERE id = c_na_janela;
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authenticated conseguiu UPDATE em qr_attempts';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    NULL;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+
+  SET LOCAL ROLE anon;
+  BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.qr_attempts;
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'anon conseguiu SELECT em qr_attempts';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+    NULL;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+
+  -- ---------------------------------------------- 4) retencao de 30 dias (job)
+  IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.purge_qr_attempts()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'anon tem EXECUTE em purge_qr_attempts';
+  END IF;
+  IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.purge_qr_attempts()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authenticated tem EXECUTE em purge_qr_attempts';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.purge_qr_attempts()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role NAO tem EXECUTE em purge_qr_attempts';
+  END IF;
+
+  SET LOCAL ROLE service_role;
+  v_apagadas := public.purge_qr_attempts();
+  RESET ROLE;
+  IF v_apagadas <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'purge apagou % linhas (esperado 1: so a de 31 dias)', v_apagadas;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.qr_attempts WHERE id = c_antiga;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a tentativa de 31 dias sobreviveu a retencao';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.qr_attempts WHERE id IN (c_na_janela, c_erro);
+  IF v_n <> 2 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'retencao apagou linha dentro da janela (% de 2 ficaram)', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  SET LOCAL ROLE service_role;
+  v_apagadas := public.purge_qr_attempts();
+  RESET ROLE;
+  IF v_apagadas <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '2a rodada do purge apagou % (esperado 0 ‚Äî idempotente)', v_apagadas;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- ------------------------------------------------------------- 5) cascata
+  DELETE FROM public.whatsapp_connections WHERE id = c_conn;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.qr_attempts WHERE connection_id = c_conn;
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'historico de % linhas sobreviveu a conexao apagada', v_n;
+  END IF;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'qr_attempts_history: suite OK (forma, RLS por conexao, escrita so service_role, retencao 30d, cascata)';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;

+CREATE FUNCTION public.t_eq(p_label text, p_actual text, p_expected text)
+RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_actual IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU % ‚Äî esperado [%], obtido [%]', p_label, p_expected, p_actual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'ok - %', p_label;
+END $fn$;

+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'

+--      que a RLS permite) e o gatilho aborta o INSERT inteiro citando a coluna removida

+-- sanitiza√ß√£o VIVO com o corpo que cita a coluna morta (o defeito), rate limit can√¥nico.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS;
+
+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+  )::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+  )::text $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE TABLE auth.users (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  email text
+);

+-- Tabela no estado ATUAL (sem reset_token). Colunas reais da tabela.
+CREATE TABLE public.password_reset_requests (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  email text NOT NULL,
+  reason text,
+  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
+  reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id),
+  reviewed_at timestamptz,
+  rejection_reason text,
+  token_expires_at timestamptz,
+  ip_address text,
+  user_agent text,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT password_reset_requests_status_check CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected'))
+);
+ALTER TABLE public.password_reset_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+-- Policy de SELECT do admin (no teste s√≥ existe o ramo autenticado comum; o corpo real usa
+-- has_role(auth.uid(),'admin'), que n√£o √© o objeto deste cart√£o).
+CREATE POLICY "Admins can view reset requests" ON public.password_reset_requests FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (false);
+-- Policy de INSERT vigente para o caminho autenticado.
+CREATE POLICY "Users can request own password reset" ON public.password_reset_requests FOR INSERT TO authenticated
+  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());
+
+-- Corpo VIGENTE (20260410103156): cita NEW.reset_token, coluna j√° removida -> ESTE √© o defeito.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sanitize_reset_request()
+ RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
+    NEW.reset_token := NULL;
+    NEW.token_expires_at := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_by := NULL;
+    NEW.reviewed_at := NULL;
+    NEW.rejection_reason := NULL;
+    NEW.status := 'pending';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE TRIGGER sanitize_reset_request_trigger BEFORE INSERT ON public.password_reset_requests
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.sanitize_reset_request();
+
+-- Gatilho can√¥nico de rate limit (20260410105209).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rate_limit_reset_requests()
+ RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  v_pending_count integer;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_pending_count
+  FROM public.password_reset_requests
+  WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id
+    AND status = 'pending'
+    AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
+
+  IF v_pending_count >= 3 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many pending reset requests. Please wait before trying again.';
+  END IF;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_rate_limit_reset BEFORE INSERT ON public.password_reset_requests
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.rate_limit_reset_requests();

+-- Uso: zapp-db-local psql . <nome-do-banco> < supabase/tests/rls_whatsapp_media_storage_acl.sql

+BEGIN;

+DO $trava_acl$
+DECLARE
+  -- as 3 policies do contrato (mesma lista usada pela trava em
+  -- rls_whatsapp_media_select_via_messages.sql)
+  v_policies text[] := ARRAY['Users can read assigned whatsapp media',
+                             'Users can read assigned audio messages',
+                             'whatsapp media readable via visible message'];
+  -- o filtro corrigido (card: `\m(from|join)\s+\(?(public\.)?messages\M`) e o
+  -- filtro anterior a esta corre√ß√£o, com o mesmo resto do predicado
+  v_re_novo      text := '\m(from|join)\s+\(?(public\.)?messages\M';
+  v_re_antigo    text := '\m(from|join)\s+(public\.)?messages\M';
+  v_adv          text[] := ARRAY['r2db022 trava adv join sem schema',
+                                 'r2db022 trava adv join public.messages',
+                                 'r2db022 trava adv media_url'];
+  v_citadas      text   := 'r2db022 trava adv funcoes citadas';
+  v_benigna      text   := 'r2db022 trava benigna audio';
+  v_fixtures     text[] := v_adv || v_citadas || v_benigna;
+  v_base         text[];
+  v_com_fixtures text[];
+  v_depois       text[];
+  v_q            text;
+  v_n            integer;
+BEGIN
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  -- T0 (registro): estado da base antes de qualquer fixture
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(p.policyname ORDER BY p.policyname), '{}')
+    INTO v_base
+    FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.cmd = 'SELECT'
+     AND (p.qual ~* 'media_url'
+          OR p.qual ~ '~~'
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?position"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?substring"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?replace"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?right"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* v_re_novo
+          OR p.qual ~ 'public\.messages')
+     AND (p.qual ~ 'whatsapp-media' OR p.qual ~ 'audio-messages'
+          OR p.policyname = ANY (v_policies));
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects'
+     AND p.policyname = ANY (v_policies);
+  IF array_length(v_base, 1) IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE NOTICE 'T0 base: vermelho esperado (a migration da ACL n√£o est√° nesta base): %', v_base;
+  ELSIF v_n > 0 THEN
+    RAISE NOTICE 'T0 base: contrato instalado ‚Äî % policies do contrato, nenhuma por media_url/join', v_n;
+  ELSE
+    RAISE NOTICE 'T0 base: nenhuma das 3 policies do contrato nesta base (replay/baseline sem os migrations do app) ‚Äî a trava abaixo mede sensibilidade, n√£o o estado da base';
+  END IF;

+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  -- fixtures: as formas do vetor que a trava tem de pegar, e uma que n√£o pode
+  -- ser pega. Nomes sem esquema (`messages`) e com esquema (`public.messages`)
+  -- de prop√≥sito: o deparse de um JOIN sai como `FROM (messages m JOIN ...)`.
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  CREATE POLICY "r2db022 trava adv join sem schema" ON storage.objects
+    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+    USING (bucket_id IN ('whatsapp-media','audio-messages')
+           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m JOIN contacts c ON c.id = m.contact_id
+                        WHERE c.assigned_to = auth.uid()));
+
+  CREATE POLICY "r2db022 trava adv join public.messages" ON storage.objects
+    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+    USING (bucket_id IN ('whatsapp-media','audio-messages')
+           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.messages m
+                        WHERE m.contact_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM contacts c
+                                                WHERE c.assigned_to = auth.uid())));
+
+  CREATE POLICY "r2db022 trava adv media_url" ON storage.objects
+    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+    USING (bucket_id IN ('whatsapp-media','audio-messages')
+           AND name = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT m.media_url FROM public.messages m)));
+
+  CREATE POLICY "r2db022 trava adv funcoes citadas" ON storage.objects
+    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+    USING (bucket_id IN ('whatsapp-media','audio-messages')
+           AND right(name, 6) = 'legado'
+           AND substring(name from 1 for 5) = 'image');
+
+  CREATE POLICY "r2db022 trava benigna audio" ON storage.objects
+    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+    USING (bucket_id = 'audio-messages' AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text);
+
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  -- T1: a trava pega as 4 formas do vetor
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(p.policyname ORDER BY p.policyname), '{}')
+    INTO v_com_fixtures
+    FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.cmd = 'SELECT'
+     AND (p.qual ~* 'media_url'
+          OR p.qual ~ '~~'
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?position"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?substring"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?replace"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?right"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* v_re_novo
+          OR p.qual ~ 'public\.messages')
+     AND (p.qual ~ 'whatsapp-media' OR p.qual ~ 'audio-messages'
+          OR p.policyname = ANY (v_policies));
+  IF NOT (v_fixtures[1:4] <@ v_com_fixtures) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: a trava n√£o pegou todas as formas do vetor. pegou=%, faltou=%',
+      v_com_fixtures, (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(x ORDER BY x), '{}')
+                         FROM unnest(v_fixtures[1:4]) x WHERE x <> ALL (v_com_fixtures));
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T1 ok: trava pegou as 4 formas adversariais (%)', v_fixtures[1:4];
+
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  -- T2: a forma que o filtro ANTIGO perdia (JOIN deparsado com par√™ntese).
+  -- Vermelho sem a corre√ß√£o: com `from\s+(public\.)?messages` o deparse
+  -- `FROM (messages m JOIN contacts c ...)` n√£o casa.
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  SELECT p.qual INTO v_q FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.policyname = v_adv[1];
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T2 deparse do JOIN sem esquema: %', replace(v_q, E'\n', ' ');
+  IF v_q !~* v_re_novo THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: o filtro corrigido n√£o pegou o deparse do JOIN: %', v_q;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_q ~* v_re_antigo THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: o filtro anterior (sem `\(?`) j√° pegava esta forma ‚Äî a corre√ß√£o n√£o se prova aqui: %', v_q;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT p.qual INTO v_q FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.policyname = v_adv[2];
+  IF v_q !~* v_re_novo THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T2 FALHOU: o filtro corrigido n√£o pegou `public.messages`: %', v_q;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T2 ok: JOIN casado pelo filtro corrigido e perdido pelo anterior (vermelho antes)';
+
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  -- T3: fun√ß√£o reservada sai com aspas no deparse e a trava reconhece
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  SELECT p.qual INTO v_q FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.policyname = v_citadas;
+  IF position('"right"(' IN v_q) = 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: o deparse n√£o citou a fun√ß√£o reservada como esperado: %', v_q;
+  END IF;
+  IF v_citadas <> ALL (v_com_fixtures) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T3 FALHOU: a trava n√£o pegou a policy que cita fun√ß√£o reservada';
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T3 ok: %', v_q;
+
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  -- T4: sem falso positivo no literal `audio-messages`. Vermelho antes: o
+  -- filtro ing√™nuo (`qual ~ ''messages''`) casava o bucket `audio-messages`.
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  IF v_benigna = ANY (v_com_fixtures) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: falso positivo ‚Äî a trava pegou a policy benigna do bucket audio-messages';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT p.qual INTO v_q FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.policyname = v_benigna;
+  IF v_q !~ 'messages' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T4 FALHOU: a fixture benigna deixou de citar `audio-messages` (a prova perdeu o sentido): %', v_q;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T4 ok: `audio-messages` n√£o √© pego pelo filtro corrigido (e era pelo ing√™nuo `qual ~ ''messages''`)';
+
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  -- T5: as fixtures saem e o conjunto da trava volta ao da base (delta 0)
+  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  DROP POLICY "r2db022 trava adv join sem schema" ON storage.objects;
+  DROP POLICY "r2db022 trava adv join public.messages" ON storage.objects;
+  DROP POLICY "r2db022 trava adv media_url" ON storage.objects;
+  DROP POLICY "r2db022 trava adv funcoes citadas" ON storage.objects;
+  DROP POLICY "r2db022 trava benigna audio" ON storage.objects;
+
+  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(p.policyname ORDER BY p.policyname), '{}')
+    INTO v_depois
+    FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.cmd = 'SELECT'
+     AND (p.qual ~* 'media_url'
+          OR p.qual ~ '~~'
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?position"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?substring"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?replace"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* '"?right"?\('
+          OR p.qual ~* v_re_novo
+          OR p.qual ~ 'public\.messages')
+     AND (p.qual ~ 'whatsapp-media' OR p.qual ~ 'audio-messages'
+          OR p.policyname = ANY (v_policies));
+  IF v_depois <> v_base THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: delta != 0 ‚Äî antes=%, depois=%', v_base, v_depois;
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM pg_policies p
+   WHERE p.schemaname = 'storage' AND p.tablename = 'objects' AND p.policyname = ANY (v_fixtures);
+  IF v_n <> 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: % fixture(s) ficaram para tr√°s', v_n;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'T5 ok: 0 sobras, conjunto da trava igual ao da base (%)', v_depois;
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'rls_whatsapp_media_storage_acl: ok ‚Äî a trava T2 pega as 4 formas do vetor (join sem esquema, join com public., media_url, fun√ß√µes reservadas citadas), n√£o tem falso positivo em audio-messages e n√£o deixa res√≠duo';
+END $trava_acl$;

+ROLLBACK;

+-- COMO RODAR (banco LOCAL do cartao, nunca producao):

+-- O QUE PROVA (cada bloco por PAPEL REAL, com SET LOCAL ROLE + request.jwt.claims):
+--   P1  admin (staff) ve as 4 filas ativas e as metricas REAIS batem fila a fila
+--       (conversas abertas, aguardando, espera media medida, taxa de atribuicao, pendentes);
+--   P2  supervisor (staff) ve o mesmo conjunto do admin;
+--   P3  agente MEMBRO ativo de UMA fila ve SO essa fila (fila alheia nao vaza);
+--   P4  agente que e membro INATIVO (is_active = false) nao ve a fila;
+--   P5  authenticated sem papel e sem vinculo recebe ZERO linhas (sem oraculo de fila alheia);
+--   P6  anon e NEGADO por ACL (42501) - nem entra no corpo da funcao;

+BEGIN

+  END IF;

+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'P12: authenticated NAO pode executar a RPC';
+  END IF;

+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'P12: anon NAO devia poder executar a RPC';
+  END IF;

+-- supabase/tests/scheduled_messages_state_machine.sql
+-- HZ5-03 / HZ1-03 -- maquina de estados, CHECKs e INSERT so para contato visivel em
+-- public.scheduled_messages (migration 20261016013528_scheduled_messages_state_machine.sql).
+--
+-- PROVA DE ENFORCEMENT NO BANCO LOCAL, com o papel real. Nao e suite estrutural: as
+-- assercoes trocam o papel (authenticated/admin, authenticated/agente, anon, service_role)
+-- e executam INSERT/UPDATE de verdade, mostrando o que passa e o que e negado. As divisoes
+-- de papel sao as do PostgREST (o JWT so executa como authenticated ou anon); o despachante
+-- entra como service_role (e, no cron, como o dono da RPC SECURITY DEFINER -- os dois caem
+-- no ramo "nao e authenticated/anon" do gatilho).

+-- BLOCO RED (logo abaixo das fixtures): com o gatilho removido e as policies antigas de volta,
+-- dentro de um SAVEPOINT, os MESMOS casos que a migration tem de barrar PASSAM. E a prova de
+-- que a suite falha sem a migration; o SAVEPOINT devolve o estado (DDL no Postgres e
+-- transacional) e o resto do arquivo roda contra o estado real.
+--
+-- Rodar no banco local em dia (todas as migrations aplicadas):
+--   zapp-db-local up . <nome-curto>      # ex.: hz503 (o nome derivado da pasta desta copia
+--                                        # tem 28 caracteres e a ferramenta nao acha o
+--                                        # conteiner do banco; o nome curto entra explicito)
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <nome-curto> < supabase/tests/scheduled_messages_state_machine.sql
+-- A sessao do psql precisa ser superusuario (postgres) para montar as fixtures e trocar de
+-- papel; as assercoes de acesso rodam sob SET LOCAL ROLE. Termina com PROVA_OK=1 e a
+-- contagem de assercoes. Nada fica no banco: a transacao inteira termina com ROLLBACK
+-- (inclusive a tabela-contador e as fixtures de auth/profiles/contacts).

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Helpers de assercao. Nao trocam de papel: quem troca e o proprio script, com
+-- SET LOCAL ROLE + set_config('request.jwt.claims') no nivel de cima -- o papel e as
+-- claims valem para tudo que roda depois, sem depender de escopo de funcao.
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.assert_permitido(p_sql text, p_rotulo text)
+RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
+BEGIN
+  INSERT INTO public.prova_hz503_asserts (marcador) VALUES ('assert');
+  EXECUTE p_sql;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'OK (passou): %', p_rotulo;
+EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU: % -- deveria passar e foi negado: % (SQLSTATE=%)',
+    p_rotulo, SQLERRM, SQLSTATE;
+END;
+$fn$;

+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.assert_negado(p_sql text, p_sqlstates text, p_trecho text, p_rotulo text)
+RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
+BEGIN
+  INSERT INTO public.prova_hz503_asserts (marcador) VALUES ('assert');
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE p_sql;
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU: % -- deveria ser negado e passou', p_rotulo;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    IF SQLERRM LIKE 'FALHOU:%' THEN
+      RAISE;
+    END IF;
+    IF position(SQLSTATE in p_sqlstates) = 0 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU: % -- negado com SQLSTATE % (esperado %): %',
+        p_rotulo, SQLSTATE, p_sqlstates, SQLERRM;
+    END IF;
+    IF position(p_trecho in SQLERRM) = 0 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU: % -- negado pelo motivo errado (esperado conter "%"): "%"',
+        p_rotulo, p_trecho, SQLERRM;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'OK (negado %): % -- %', SQLSTATE, p_rotulo, SQLERRM;
+  END;
+END;
+$fn$;

+-- O banco local revoga EXECUTE de PUBLIC por padrao nas funcoes novas: sem estes GRANT,
+-- a primeira chamada depois de SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated seria negada por privilegio.

+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_cols     text[];
+  v_int_cols text[];
+  v_rls      boolean;
+  v_pol      integer;
+  v_pol_cmd  text;
+  v_pol_roles text[];

+BEGIN
+  -- T5: a lista de colunas √© EXATAMENTE esta ‚Äî nada de `term`, `query`, `search`.
+  SELECT array_agg(a.attname ORDER BY a.attnum) INTO v_cols
+    FROM pg_attribute a
+    JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = a.attrelid
+    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+   WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'search_events'
+     AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped;

+  IF v_cols IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: tabela public.search_events n√£o existe (migration n√£o aplicada)';
+  END IF;

+  IF v_cols <> ARRAY['id','user_id','term_length','had_results','result_kind','clicked','created_at'] THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: colunas de search_events = % (esperado o conjunto sem texto livre)', v_cols;
+  END IF;
+
+  -- nenhuma coluna de texto pode carregar o termo: s√≥ `result_kind` √© texto.
+  SELECT array_agg(a.attname ORDER BY a.attnum) INTO v_int_cols
+    FROM pg_attribute a
+    JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = a.attrelid
+    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+    JOIN pg_type t      ON t.oid = a.atttypid
+   WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'search_events'
+     AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
+     AND t.typname IN ('text','varchar','bpchar','citext');

+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T5 FALHOU: colunas de texto = % (s√≥ result_kind √© esperada; o termo n√£o pode ter onde morar)', v_int_cols;
+  END IF;

+  SELECT c.relrowsecurity INTO v_rls

+   WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'search_events';
+  IF v_rls IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'T1 FALHOU: search_events sem RLS ligada';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*), min(polcmd), min(polroles::text) INTO v_n, v_pol_cmd, v_pol_roles
+    FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
+    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+   WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'search_events';
+  IF v_n <> 1 THEN

+  END IF;

+  END IF;

+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.espera(p_label text, p_atual text, p_esperado text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_atual IS DISTINCT FROM p_esperado THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 't_9dce259e FALHOU [%]: esperado %, obtido %', p_label, p_esperado, p_atual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] -> %', p_label, p_atual;
+END $h$;

+-- Executa p_sql sob o PAPEL REAL (SET LOCAL ROLE) com o JWT de p_uid.
+-- Devolve 'OK <sqlstate> <valor>'/'OK <linhas>' ou 'ERRO <sqlstate> <msg>'.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.roda(p_papel text, p_uid uuid, p_sql text, p_leitura boolean)
+RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE v text; v_n bigint;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', p_uid, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+  IF current_user <> p_papel THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 't_9dce259e FALHOU: papel real nao aplicado (current_user=%)', current_user;
+  END IF;
+  BEGIN
+    IF p_leitura THEN
+      EXECUTE p_sql INTO v;
+    ELSE
+      EXECUTE p_sql;
+      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
+      v := 'linhas ' || v_n;
+    END IF;
+    v := 'OK ' || coalesce(v, '');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v := 'ERRO ' || SQLSTATE || ' ' || SQLERRM;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+  RETURN v;
+END $h$;

+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub',
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')
+     ), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE
+  AS $$ SELECT coalesce(
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+       nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+     )::text $$;

+CREATE TABLE public.queue_members (

+CREATE TABLE public.agent_visibility_grants (
+  agent_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  can_see_agent_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  PRIMARY KEY (agent_id, can_see_agent_id)

+-- Predicado de visibilidade de contatos: mesmo contrato do real
+-- (admin OU atribuicao/carteira concedida OU fila ativa), exigindo
+-- _user_id = auth.uid() ‚Äî sem impersonacao.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_profile_id_for_user(_user_id uuid) RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public
+  AS $$ SELECT profile.id FROM public.profiles profile
+        WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.user_id = _user_id LIMIT 1 $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_visible_agent_ids(_user_id uuid) RETURNS SETOF uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public
+  AS $$ SELECT profile.id FROM public.profiles profile
+        WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND profile.user_id = _user_id
+        UNION
+        SELECT visibility.can_see_agent_id
+        FROM public.agent_visibility_grants AS visibility
+        JOIN public.profiles AS viewer ON viewer.id = visibility.agent_id
+        WHERE _user_id = auth.uid() AND viewer.user_id = _user_id $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public
+  AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
+                       WHERE ur.user_id = _user_id
+                         AND ur.role IN ('admin','supervisor')) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_contact_visible_to_user(_contact_id uuid, _user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public
+  AS $$ SELECT _user_id = auth.uid()
+        AND EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1 FROM public.contacts AS contact
+          WHERE contact.id = _contact_id
+            AND (
+              public.is_admin_or_supervisor(_user_id)
+              OR contact.assigned_to IN (SELECT public.get_visible_agent_ids(_user_id))
+              OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.queue_members AS member
+                         WHERE member.queue_id = contact.queue_id
+                           AND member.profile_id = public.get_profile_id_for_user(_user_id)
+                           AND member.is_active = true)
+            )
+        ) $$;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.assert_eq(label text, expected text, actual text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF expected IS DISTINCT FROM actual THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU [%]: esperado %, obtido %', label, expected, actual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%]', label;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.assert_role(label text, expected text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF current_user <> expected THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU [%]: current_user=% (esperado %)', label, current_user, expected;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] (current_user=%)', label, current_user;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect_state(label text, sql text, expected_state text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE sql;
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU [%]: deveria falhar com % mas passou', label, expected_state;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    IF SQLSTATE = expected_state THEN
+      RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] (SQLSTATE % = %)', label, SQLSTATE, SQLERRM;
+    ELSE
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU [%]: esperado %, obtido % (%)', label, expected_state, SQLSTATE, SQLERRM;
+    END IF;
+  END;
+END $$;

+-- Teste SQL de public.set_conversation_status ‚Äî transicao waiting -> archived (ADR-005).
+--
+-- O que prova (o contrato que o front consome; aberto pelo cartao t_79ca0cf1):
+--   T0  o GATILHO de banco public.enforce_conversation_status_transition ACEITA
+--       waiting -> archived (a divergencia que originou o cartao);
+--   T1  a RPC passa a PERMITIR waiting -> archived e grava
+--       conversation_status_changed_at (o defeito: recusava com 'invalid transition');
+--   T2  a autorizacao continua ANTES de qualquer efeito: chamador sem permissao
+--       recebe 42501 'contact_not_authorized' e o estado fica INTACTO;
+--   T3  o no-op idempotente (estado ja igual) sai silencioso SEM reescrever
+--       conversation_status_changed_at (nenhum efeito colateral);
+--   T4  archived -> open continua permitido;
+--   T5  archived -> waiting e archived -> resolved CONTINUAM recusados;
+--   T6  waiting -> resolved segue gravando conversation_closures, e a negacao por
+--       falta de permissao nao deixa fechamento nenhum (autorizacao antes do efeito);
+--   T7  contrato de ACL/assinatura preservado: unica sobrecarga (uuid,text,text),
+--       anon sem EXECUTE, authenticated/service_role/postgres com EXECUTE.
+--
+-- COMO RODAR (banco LOCAL da tarefa, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <conjunto> -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/set_conversation_status_waiting_para_archived.sql
+--
+-- Enforcamento exercido como PAPEL REAL: claims sinteticos em request.jwt.claims
+-- (sub + role='authenticated') e set_config('role','authenticated') ‚Äî o caminho do
+-- PostgREST. O role 'authenticated' no claim impede o bypass de
+-- is_privileged_contact_caller() (que so olha session_user quando nao ha claim).
+-- Cria dados SINTETICOS e desfaz tudo no ROLLBACK final: nao sobra linha no banco.
+-- Sem EXCEPTION nao tratada = suite verde.
+BEGIN;

+-- Compatibilidade do banco LOCAL da tarefa: algumas bases de teste n√£o trazem
+-- calculate_level(integer), mas o gatilho de onboarding de auth.users precisa dela

+-- ROLLBACK final; o contrato testado continua sendo a RPC/seta de contacts.
+DO $fixture_bootstrap$

+  IF to_regprocedure('public.calculate_level(integer)') IS NULL THEN

+    RETURNS integer
+    LANGUAGE sql

+    AS $calc$ SELECT 1 $calc$;
+  END IF;
+END $fixture_bootstrap$;

+-- O QUE PROVA:

+CREATE SCHEMA auth;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT nullif(coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+  ), '')::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+  )::text $$;

+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION auth.uid(), auth.role() TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.espera(p_label text, p_atual text, p_esperado text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_atual IS DISTINCT FROM p_esperado THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SLA FALHOU [%]: esperado %, obtido %', p_label, p_esperado, p_atual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] -> %', p_label, p_atual;
+END $h$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.espera_erro(p_label text, p_atual text, p_sqlstate text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_atual IS NULL OR p_atual NOT LIKE 'ERRO ' || p_sqlstate || ' %' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SLA FALHOU [%]: esperava erro SQLSTATE %, veio: %', p_label, p_sqlstate, p_atual;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'PASS [%] -> %', p_label, p_atual;
+END $h$;
+
+-- Roda p_sql sob o PAPEL REAL (SET LOCAL ROLE) com o JWT de p_uid. p_claim_role
+-- acompanha o papel (anon/service_role) para auth.role() nao mentir.
+-- Devolve 'OK <linhas>' ou 'ERRO <sqlstate> <mensagem>'.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.operacao(p_papel text, p_uid uuid, p_sql text,
+                                 p_claim_role text DEFAULT 'authenticated') RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE v_ret text; v_n bigint;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', p_uid, 'role', p_claim_role)::text, true);
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+  IF current_user <> p_papel THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SLA FALHOU: papel real nao aplicado (current_user=%)', current_user;
+  END IF;
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE p_sql;
+    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
+    v_ret := 'OK ' || v_n;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v_ret := 'ERRO ' || SQLSTATE || ' ' || SQLERRM;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+  RETURN v_ret;
+END $h$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.valor(p_papel text, p_uid uuid, p_sql text,
+                              p_claim_role text DEFAULT 'authenticated') RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE v text;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims',
+    json_build_object('sub', p_uid, 'role', p_claim_role)::text, true);
+  EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_papel);
+  BEGIN
+    EXECUTE p_sql INTO v;
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    v := 'ERRO ' || SQLSTATE;
+  END;
+  RESET ROLE;
+  RETURN v;
+END $h$;

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Helpers: monta o cen√°rio (campanha 'sending' com 1 pendente + 1 EM VOO) e
+-- compara com mensagem pr√≥pria. Criados como postgres (o papel do caller vem
+-- depois, por SET ROLE service_role ‚Äî o mesmo caminho da edge).
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.assert_igual(p_rotulo text, p_obtido text, p_esperado text)
+RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_obtido IS DISTINCT FROM p_esperado THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION '% FALHOU: esperado %, veio %', p_rotulo, p_esperado, COALESCE(p_obtido, '<nulo>');
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE '% OK: %', p_rotulo, p_obtido;
+END $fn$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.prepara(p_cid uuid, p_pend uuid, p_voo uuid)
+RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$
+DECLARE
+  v_token uuid;
+BEGIN
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_campaigns(id, status, message_template, total_recipients)
+    VALUES (p_cid, 'sending', 'Ola', 2);
+  INSERT INTO public.talkx_recipients(id, campaign_id, status) VALUES
+    (p_pend, p_cid, 'pending'),
+    (p_voo,  p_cid, 'pending');
+  PERFORM public.claim_talkx_recipient(p_cid, p_voo, 'edge-a', 90);
+  SELECT delivery_claim_token INTO v_token FROM public.talkx_recipients WHERE id = p_voo;
+  IF v_token IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'prepara: claim_talkx_recipient nao devolveu token';
+  END IF;
+  PERFORM public.mark_talkx_recipient_dispatch_started(p_voo, v_token);
+  RETURN v_token;
+END $fn$;

+DO $t$
+DECLARE
+  v_cid   uuid := '50000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a9';

+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TR FALHOU: erro inesperado do recibo: %', v_erro;
+  END IF;

+-- talkx_segment_lifecycle.sql
+-- TL-129 / X101 (Talk X, F09 Segmentos) ‚Äî teste SQL do ciclo de vida do segmento.
+--
+-- COMO RODAR (banco com as migrations REAIS aplicadas, inclusive a
+-- 20261009052830_talkx_segments_lifecycle.sql):
+--   psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/tests/talkx_segment_lifecycle.sql
+--   (-v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 e obrigatorio: sem ele o psql seguiria depois de uma falha)
+--
+-- O arquivo cria os PROPRIOS dados sinteticos e termina com ROLLBACK: nao deixa nada
+-- no banco. A prova de comportamento roda SEMPRE com o papel real (SET LOCAL ROLE
+-- authenticated / anon / service_role + request.jwt.claims). O papel dono do banco
+-- aparece so na criacao dos dados (fixture), nunca na assercao.
+--
+-- O QUE PROVA (o defeito e vermelho sem a migration):
+--   T1  status 'draft' e aceito (o CHECK antigo so aceitava 'active','inactive')
+--   T2  status fora da lista e rejeitado
+--   T3  tags persistem e o indice GIN responde a busca por tag
+--   T4  a revisao publicada persiste (revision/published_at/published_by + a linha
+--       em talkx_segment_versions) ‚Äî "preservar a revisao publicada"
+--   T5  segmento EM USO (campanha scheduled/sending/paused) nao e arquivado, inativado
+--       nem excluido; o erro devolve o nome da campanha (N22: arquivar, nao excluir)
+--   T6  segmento fora de uso arquiva, sai do filtro archived_at is null e pode ser excluido
+--   T7  authenticated nao grava versao; service_role grava (escrita so pelo caminho de servico)
+--   T8  authenticated que nao e dono nem admin nao ve a versao do outro (RLS de leitura)
+--   T9  retencao: a 21a versao descarta a 1a e sobram 20
+--   T10 anon nao le versao nenhuma e nao ve nenhum segmento

+-- FIXTURE (papel dono do banco: so prepara os dados; nenhuma assercao roda aqui)
+-- =====================================================================================
+-- Usuarios sinteticos. No banco do Supabase (local e canonico) profiles.user_id e
+-- user_roles.user_id apontam para auth.users e o gatilho on_auth_user_created cria o
+-- profile; por isso a criacao passa por auth.users QUANDO ela existe (e a insercao
+-- direta em profiles cobre o ambiente sem auth.users, o Postgres descartavel).
+do $$
+declare
+  v_novo record;
+begin
+  if to_regclass('auth.users') is not null then
+    for v_novo in
+      select * from (values
+        ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'::uuid, 'Dona do segmento'),
+        ('22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222'::uuid, 'Outro agente'),
+        ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'::uuid, 'Admin do modulo')
+      ) as t(user_id, nome)
+    loop
+      insert into auth.users (id, raw_user_meta_data)
+      values (v_novo.user_id, jsonb_build_object('name', v_novo.nome))
+      on conflict (id) do nothing;
+    end loop;
+  end if;
+end $$;

+insert into public.profiles (user_id, name, role, is_active) values
+  ('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', 'Dona do segmento', 'agent', true),
+  ('22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222', 'Outro agente',     'agent', true),

+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub'
+  )::uuid $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.role() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
+  SELECT coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role'
+  )::text $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  role text DEFAULT 'agent',
+  is_active boolean DEFAULT true
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE public.departments (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text
+);

+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversations (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct',
+  name text,
+  avatar_url text,
+  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  department_id uuid REFERENCES public.departments(id),
+  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
+  CONSTRAINT team_conversations_type_check CHECK (type IN ('direct', 'group', 'department'))

+CREATE TABLE public.team_conversation_members (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.team_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  last_read_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+  is_muted boolean DEFAULT false,
+  is_pinned boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  is_archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  member_role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  UNIQUE (conversation_id, profile_id),
+  CONSTRAINT team_conversation_members_member_role_check CHECK (member_role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member'))
+);

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() RETURNS uuid
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$ SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1; $function$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_profile_id() TO authenticated, service_role;

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(_user_id uuid, _conversation_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
+  LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+  AS $function$
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.team_conversation_members tcm
+      JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = tcm.profile_id
+      WHERE tcm.conversation_id = _conversation_id AND p.user_id = _user_id
+    );
+  $function$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_team_conversation_member(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

+ALTER TABLE public.team_conversations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.team_conversation_members ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY team_conversations_select_members ON public.team_conversations FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (public.is_team_conversation_member(auth.uid(), id)
+         OR created_by = (SELECT p.id FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1));
+CREATE POLICY team_conversation_members_select_members ON public.team_conversation_members FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+  USING (public.is_team_conversation_member(auth.uid(), conversation_id));

+GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO authenticated;

+-- Duas conex√µes de verdade, na mesma inst√¢ncia, para a corrida.
+CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS dblink;
+SELECT dblink_connect('tc002_a', 'dbname=postgres application_name=tc002_a');
+SELECT dblink_connect('tc002_b', 'dbname=postgres application_name=tc002_b');

+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Helpers (tempor√°rios, da sess√£o do psql)

+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.tc002_jwt(p_quem text) RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $h$ SELECT jwt FROM tc002_pessoa WHERE quem = p_quem $h$;

+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.tc002_perfil(p_quem text) RETURNS uuid

+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.tc002_afirmar(p_rotulo text, p_esperado text, p_obtido text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_obtido IS DISTINCT FROM p_esperado THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU ‚Äî %: esperado %, obtido %',
+      p_rotulo, quote_nullable(p_esperado), quote_nullable(p_obtido);
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'OK ‚Äî %', p_rotulo;
+END;
+$h$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.tc002_afirmar_diferente(p_rotulo text, p_a text, p_b text) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+BEGIN
+  IF p_a IS NULL OR p_b IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU ‚Äî %: as duas transacoes precisam devolver um id (%, %)', p_rotulo, p_a, p_b;
+  END IF;
+  IF p_a = p_b THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALHOU ‚Äî %: as duas transacoes devolveram o MESMO id (%)', p_rotulo, p_a;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'OK ‚Äî % (ids distintos: % / %)', p_rotulo, p_a, p_b;
+END;
+$h$;
+
+-- Duas transa√ß√µes SIMULT√ÇNEAS para o mesmo par: A insere e fica com a transa√ß√£o ABERTA
+-- (sem comitar) enquanto B entra pela segunda conex√£o. S√≥ depois A comita ‚Äî se o UPSERT do
+-- par estiver arbitrando o √≠ndice √∫nico, B espera A e devolve o MESMO id.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.tc002_corrida(
+  p_jwt_a text, p_alvo_a uuid, p_jwt_b text, p_alvo_b uuid
+) RETURNS TABLE(id_a uuid, id_b uuid, b_esperou boolean)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $h$
+DECLARE
+  v_id_a uuid;
+  v_id_b uuid;
+  v_esperou boolean := false;
+  v_i integer;
+BEGIN
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_a', 'BEGIN');
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_a', 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated');
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_a', format('SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims = %L', p_jwt_a));
+  SELECT t.r INTO v_id_a
+    FROM dblink('tc002_a',
+      format('SELECT public.find_or_create_direct_conversation(%L::uuid) AS r', p_alvo_a)) AS t(r uuid);
+
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_b', 'BEGIN');
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_b', 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated');
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_b', format('SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims = %L', p_jwt_b));
+  PERFORM dblink_send_query('tc002_b',
+    format('SELECT public.find_or_create_direct_conversation(%L::uuid)::text', p_alvo_b));
+
+  -- B terminou sozinho (o defeito n√£o toca o √≠ndice) ou est√° esperando o √≠ndice de A?
+  FOR v_i IN 1..160 LOOP
+    EXIT WHEN dblink_is_busy('tc002_b') = 0;
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM pg_stat_activity
+       WHERE application_name = 'tc002_b' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock'
+    ) INTO v_esperou;
+    EXIT WHEN v_esperou;
+    PERFORM pg_sleep(0.05);
+  END LOOP;
+
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_a', 'COMMIT');
+
+  SELECT t.r::uuid INTO v_id_b FROM dblink_get_result('tc002_b') AS t(r text);
+  PERFORM dblink_get_result('tc002_b');   -- drena o resultado at√© o fim
+  PERFORM dblink_exec('tc002_b', 'COMMIT');
+
+  id_a := v_id_a;
+  id_b := v_id_b;
+  b_esperou := v_esperou;
+  RETURN NEXT;
+END;
+$h$;

+DO $c_2$
+DECLARE
+  v_path text; v_linhas text[]; v_rollback text := '';
+  v_i int; v_linha text; v_achou boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+  SELECT fix_path INTO v_path FROM tc002_cfg;
+  v_linhas := string_to_array(pg_read_file(v_path), E'\n');
+
+  FOR v_i IN 1..coalesce(array_length(v_linhas, 1), 0) LOOP
+    v_linha := v_linhas[v_i];
+    IF NOT v_achou THEN
+      IF v_linha ~* '^--[[:space:]]*rollback[[:space:]]*:' THEN
+        v_achou := true;
+        v_linha := regexp_replace(v_linha, '^--[[:space:]]*rollback[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*', '');
+        IF btrim(v_linha) <> '' THEN v_rollback := v_linha; END IF;
+      END IF;
+    ELSE
+      EXIT WHEN v_linha ~* '^--[[:space:]]*rollback-fim';
+      EXIT WHEN v_linha !~ '^--';
+      v_linha := regexp_replace(v_linha, '^--[[:space:]]?', '');
+      v_rollback := v_rollback || CASE WHEN v_rollback = '' THEN '' ELSE E'\n' END || v_linha;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;

+  IF NOT v_achou THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'C.2 o arquivo % nao tem bloco -- Rollback:', regexp_replace(v_path, '^.*/', '');
+  END IF;
+  IF btrim(v_rollback) = '' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'C.2 o bloco -- Rollback: de % esta vazio', regexp_replace(v_path, '^.*/', '');
+  END IF;

+-- Teto de tamanho do bucket `team-chat-files` no SERVIDOR, na coluna
+-- `storage.buckets.file_size_limit` (cartao HZ5-10 / N-013).
+-- Arquivo PROVA da migration supabase/migrations/20261016102054_team_chat_files_limit.sql.
+--
+-- DEFEITO. O bucket nasceu em 20260402132435 sem teto de tamanho e a unica validacao viva
+-- era a do navegador (`MAX_TEAM_CHAT_FILE_SIZE` em src/lib/teamChatRules.ts, usado por
+-- TeamFileUploader). A 20260927270012 tentou fixar o teto com
+-- `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`, mas o bucket JA existia nessa altura: o INSERT
+-- foi ignorado e a coluna ficou NULL. Com NULL nao ha teto ‚Äî qualquer cliente autenticado
+-- sobe arquivo de qualquer tamanho por chamada direta a API do Storage, sem controle de custo.
+--
+-- COMO E EXECUTADO (banco descartavel local, nunca producao):
+--   zapp-db-local psql . <conjunto> < supabase/tests/team_chat_files_bucket_limit.sql
+-- O runner aplica as MIGRATIONS REAIS da copia antes de rodar: sem a migration deste cartao
+-- o bloco T1 abaixo e o vermelho (a coluna fica NULL).
+--
+-- O QUE A COLUNA SIGNIFICA. `file_size_limit` NULL = sem teto; o valor e conferido na
+-- ADMISSAO pela API do Storage (HTTP 413 quando size > file_size_limit; aceita quando
+-- size <= limite). O Postgres nao guarda o tamanho do objeto (ele vive em
+-- `storage.objects.metadata->>'size'`) e nao existe CHECK de tamanho, entao T2/T3 sao a
+-- MESMA regra de admissao avaliada contra o valor REAL da linha do bucket ‚Äî o comportamento
+-- da API (413 acima do teto, 200 dentro) e provado por HTTP na API local no relato do cartao.
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  v_public boolean;
+  v_limit  bigint;
+  v_tam    bigint;
+BEGIN
+  -- T0 (guarda de regressao): o bucket existe e segue privado (20260402214625 / 20260511233306).
+  SELECT public, file_size_limit
+    INTO v_public, v_limit
+    FROM storage.buckets
+   WHERE id = 'team-chat-files';
+  IF NOT FOUND THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T0 FALHOU: bucket team-chat-files nao existe';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_public IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T0 FALHOU: bucket team-chat-files voltou a public=%', v_public;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'HZ5-10: T0 ok (bucket existe e segue privado)';
+
+  -- T1 (o defeito): teto definido NO SERVIDOR, igual ao teto do front.
+  --     Sem a migration a coluna e NULL -> este bloco e o vermelho.
+  IF v_limit IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T1 FALHOU: bucket sem file_size_limit no banco (NULL) ‚Äî qualquer tamanho passa direto no Storage';
+  END IF;
+  IF v_limit <> 10485760 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T1 FALHOU: file_size_limit=% nao bate com MAX_TEAM_CHAT_FILE_SIZE do front (10485760)', v_limit;
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'HZ5-10: T1 ok (file_size_limit=10485760, igual ao front)';
+
+  -- T4 (guarda de regressao): a allowlist de MIME do bucket (20260902100002) segue no lugar ‚Äî
+  --     coerente com o `accept` do front. Esta migration NAO mexe nela.
+  IF (SELECT allowed_mime_types FROM storage.buckets WHERE id = 'team-chat-files') IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T4 FALHOU: allowed_mime_types voltou a NULL no bucket team-chat-files';
+  END IF;
+  IF NOT (SELECT allowed_mime_types @> ARRAY['image/jpeg', 'application/pdf']
+            FROM storage.buckets WHERE id = 'team-chat-files') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T4 FALHOU: allowed_mime_types perdeu MIME que o front aceita';
+  END IF;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'HZ5-10: T4 ok (allowlist de MIME do bucket segue preenchida)';
+
+  -- T2 (ACEITA): dentro do teto a API do Storage admite ‚Äî 1 byte e exatamente 10 MB.
+  FOREACH v_tam IN ARRAY ARRAY[1::bigint, 10485760::bigint] LOOP
+    IF v_tam > v_limit THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T2 FALHOU: tamanho % deveria ser ACEITO (limite=%)', v_tam, v_limit;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'HZ5-10: T2 ok (1 B e 10 MB dentro do teto sao admitidos)';
+
+  -- T3 (RECUSA): acima do teto a API do Storage recusa na admissao (HTTP 413) ‚Äî
+  --     10 MB + 1, 11 MB e os 50 MB que a 20260927270012 tentou aplicar sem efeito.
+  FOREACH v_tam IN ARRAY ARRAY[10485761::bigint, 11534336::bigint, 52428800::bigint] LOOP
+    IF v_tam <= v_limit THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'HZ5-10 T3 FALHOU: tamanho % deveria ser RECUSADO (limite=%)', v_tam, v_limit;
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  RAISE NOTICE 'HZ5-10: T3 ok (10 MB+1, 11 MB e 50 MB sao recusados)';
+
+  RAISE NOTICE 'HZ5-10: TODAS AS ASSERCOES OK';
+END $$;
